title: Utterance of Marvels: I
content: A mysterious woman gives the main character their Tacet Mark on their wrist before pushing them into an ocean of frequencies. When they wake up in the Gorges Of Spirits, they are found by Yangyang and Chixia, who give them the nickname Rover. During their meeting, Yangyang senses the Etheric Sea approaching, prompting the group to leave. While roaming the area, Rover gets a vision of the Sentinel, Jue, when faced with His statue and learns He is the Sentinel of Jinzhou. Upon reaching the exit, the trio find Baizhi inspecting a Tacet Field that manifests an unknown Tacet Discord. The TD leaves behind an Echo but when Rover fails to absorb it with their terminal, a mysterious voice inside their Tacet Mark forcefully absorbs the Echo. After this, Yangyang recalls the legend of how the first Echo came to be, saying that a powerful Resonator was able to absorb a strong Echo with their bare hands and thus was able to establish Huanglong.

title: Utterance of Marvels: I
content: Shortly after, a message is received from Jinzhou's Magistrate, Jinhsi. She talks about the upcoming Moon-chasing Festival and asks for Rover to meet her at the City Hall, anticipating their arrival. The group conclude that Rover must be someone important to Jinzhou and lead them into the city.

[Objective: (Cutscene plays)]
Blurry and Gentle Female Voice: ...Looks like drowning... Strange...
Blurry and Gentle Female Voice: ...No visible signs of trauma. Breathing seems...normal. Heart rate...should be fast... I think.
Gentle Female Voice: ...You're awake.
Joyful Female Voice: Let me see! Let me see!

title: Utterance of Marvels: I
content:
Gentle Female Voice: Are you alright? Do you feel any discomfort?
[Dialogue Option]  You are?
Chixia: You can call me Chixia... And, she's Yangyang!
[Dialogue Option]  Where am I?
Yangyang: We are in the Gorges of Spirits. It's on the outskirts of Jinzhou, Huanglong.
Yangyang: Your attire doesn't seem local. Are you a roving traveler from afar, or... someone returning home?
[Dialogue Option]  ...Rover?
[Dialogue Option]  I don't remember.
Yangyang: So you don't know why you're here, where you're from, or who you are...
Chixia: Baizhi didn't tell us you'd have these aftereffects when you wake up.
Yangyang: The wind has brought us a warning. The Etheric Sea is converging. It seems a new Tacet Field is taking shape.
[Dialogue Option]  What do you mean?
Chixia: That means it's probably gonna get dangerous here soon.
Chixia: Ugh, I knew it. Our gourds (Terminals) are out of service because of the  influence. We can't send or receive messages for help now. We better hurry over to meet up with Baizhi at our gathering spot and get outta here.
Chixia: Guess you really can't recall a thing, but don't worry!
Chixia: If you got any questions, we can talk as we move. Yangyang and I will give you the full scoop, every little detail, from the get-go!
Yangyang: Rover... can we call you that before you can remember your true name?
[Dialogue Option]  I believe so.
[Dialogue Option]  You can call me that for now.
[Dialogue Option]  It suits me.
Yangyang: We shouldn't stay here. If you don't have other plans, how about leaving with us for now?
[Dialogue Option]  Okay.
[Dialogue Option]  Is there only one way out of the gorge?
Yangyang: The terrain is complicated here, and we usually take that one route. If you don't mind, why don't we travel together for now? You can decide your future plans once we leave the gorge.
Chixia: Oh, that's great! Let's go together!

title: Utterance of Marvels: I
content:
[Objective: Chapter 1 Act 1 Utterance of Marvels [Unlocked]]
Chixia: Rover, I know you can't remember a thing, but there's one thing I'm 90%... no, 100% sure about you! You must be a Resonator too.
Yangyang: You've got a Tacet Mark on the back of your hand, and you have a gourd (Terminal). These are proofs you're a Resonator. Your gourd's design looks a bit different from the ones we use though.
Chixia: Also, we have  who can detect the formation of Tacet Fields nearby, like what Yangyang just did. She can tell all kinds of information by reading the Streams in the wind—that's her Resonance Ability.
Chixia: —while I couldn't feel a thing, haha.
Chixia: Plus, not a lot of people are going to hang out in the wilderness these days, unless they're Resonators.

title: Utterance of Marvels: I
content:
[Objective: (As the player performs Wall Dash)]
Chixia: It may seem all nice and quiet here now, but you never know when a Tacet Discord might pop up outta nowhere!
Chixia: Oh my, "speak of the devil".

Chixia: Bravo! So you still remember how to fight despite having forgotten everything, wow.
Chixia: Watch me lead the charge next time! No one messes with Ma Xiaofa... Ahem, I mean Chixia!

title: Utterance of Marvels: I
content:
Yangyang: What's wrong? Are you injured from the fight?
[Dialogue Option]  I think I remembered something.
Yangyang: You saw our Sentinel in your memories?
[Dialogue Option]  Sentinel?
Yangyang: Yes, the one we built this statue for. The Sentinel (Oracle Engine) in Jinzhou. There is one capital and six cities in Huanglong, with each city having its own Sentinel. While they share some similarities in appearance, there are also differences.
Yangyang: The Sentinel in Jinzhou is known as "Jué", manifesting in the form of a Loong (Dragon), like the statue you just saw.
[Dialogue Option]  What is this statue?
Yangyang: This is the statue of Jué, the Sentinel (Oracle Engine) in Jinzhou, in the shape of a Loong (dragon).
Yangyang:  one capital and six cities in Huanglong, with each city having its own Sentinel. While they share some similarities in appearance, there are also differences.
[Dialogue Option]  Are there other Sentinels outside Huanglong?
Yangyang: Sentinels are present where civilizations thrive. Huanglong stands out with the highest number of currently coexisting Sentinels, because of its long history and vast land.
Yangyang: Records state the Sentinels in Huanglong were once a single entity. Now they are each responsible for a part of Huanglong.
Yangyang: Naturally, there are Sentinels in other regions too, but far fewer compared to Huanglong.
[Dialogue Option]  What do the other Sentinels look like?
Yangyang: In Huanglong, most of the Sentinels take the shape of a Loong (dragon). In other regions, they manifest in various forms...
[Dialogue Option]  I saw myself standing face to face with it.
Yangyang: You were standing face to face with our Sentinel?
Yangyang: One can hardly see our Sentinel with their own eyes. Most people only get the chance during the Appointment Ceremonies.
Yangyang: According to your description, you stood pretty close. Only the Sentinel's Appointed Resonator is allowed in its proximity; for now, that person is the Magistrate (highest official) of Jinzhou...
[Dialogue Option]  Perhaps it's just my imagination?
[Dialogue Option]  ...
Chixia: Woah! Darn... That must be an Elite Class.
Yangyang: Chixia might be in danger. Rover, please..!

Chixia: That was close! You fought so well!
Chixia: I didn't even get a chance to help and Yangyang just rushed over to protect you like a ma...
Chixia!: Ahem, anyway, Yangyang was trying to shield you, and then BAM! The Tacet Discord was taken care of before I could get a good look!

Yangyang: Baizhi did some first-aid for you. You seemed to have drowned, but your airway was clear. Your clothes were dry and clean too.
Chixia: Oh and of course, it was Yangyang who investigated your clothes and mouth by feeling it through the Streams! She kept blushing and apologizing to you as she did while you were out cold.

title: Utterance of Marvels: I
subsection: (As the player arrives at the designated location)
content:
Yangyang: I will show you how to use it.



Chixia: Once we're outta the gorge, there's only a short walk to reach Jinzhou!
Chixia: Jinzhou is the safest place round here. The Resonance Nexus provides coverage for the whole city. Besides, we've got a protective barrier and strong fortifications!
[Dialogue Option]  Sounds impressive.
Chixia: Hehe, right?
[Dialogue Option]  Not bad.
Chixia: Hehe, maybe it's not as big as some other cities. BUT! Jinzhou is always the best place in my heart!
Yangyang: Jinzhou sits between the Desorock Highland and the Norfall Barrens. It's a border city and a fortress. It's very crucial to the safety of Huanglong.
Chixia: Huh? We've agreed to meet up with Baizhi here... Where is she?
Yangyang: This is the center of the Etheric Sea.
Chixia: ...A Tacet Field?
Chixia: ...When did it show up?
Chixia: It wasn't here when we just got here.
Yangyang: But I didn't sense a hint of a Tacet Field's presence...
Chixia: So it appeared while we weren't looking? Like, in the blink of an eye?
Chixia: Or maybe the Etheric Sea can tell where we are? Could it be following us?
Yangyang: The center of this Tacet Field...
[Dialogue Option]  Something is there.
[Dialogue Option]  Someone is there.
Chixia: Isn't that Baizhi?!
Chixia: Baizhi!
Chixia: BAIZHI!
Yangyang: We are too far away. Perhaps she can't hear us...
[Dialogue Option]  Isn't the Tacet Field dangerous?
Yangyang: Freshly formed Tacet Fields have a Dormant period. During this time, it is relatively safe.
[Dialogue Option]  During this time?
[Dialogue Option]  You mean this Tacet Field is relatively "safe" for now?
Yangyang: My apologies. I should have said it is "temporarily" safe.
Yangyang: The Dormant period of a Tacet Field varies based on its formation time. Generally, the shorter the formation time, the longer the Dormant period. However, with a longer Dormant period, the Tacet Discords born within are usually stronger.
[Dialogue Option]  Why is she there?
Chixia: We agreed to meet up 'round here, and she said she was off to collect some samples. Gosh, did she really go straight into the heart of a Tacet Field for that?!
Yangyang: Baizhi wouldn't take such risks without careful consideration. Freshly formed Tacet Fields goes through a Dormant period.
Yangyang: The faster a Tacet Field forms, the longer its Dormant period. For now, this Tacet Field should be safe.
[Dialogue Option]  Hopefully we won't bump into Tacet Discords as soon as we get there.
Chixia: Accordin' to the Hero Plays (Popular Shows in Jinzhou), yes! There's a chance for that!
[Dialogue Option]  Is there any chance that Baizhi down there is bait?
Chixia: True, who could've set the bait, then?
[Dialogue Option]  You.
Chixia: Oh, I see.. the one who seems simple-minded in the group is actually the mastermind with schemes. That's another popular trope!
Chixia: No, wait... I'm not the mastermind!
Yangyang: ...Rover.
[Dialogue Option]  Yangyang.
Chixia: Oh, I see... the one who seems gentle and quiet is actually the villain, hiding right under the protagonist's nose. That's a common trope, too!
Chixia: No, wait... Yangyang isn't the villain!
Yangyang: Well, that's not impossible, though...
[Dialogue Option]  Tacet Discord.
Yangyang: Some Tacet Discords can parrot human speech and behavior, namely the Whisperins. I doubt whether they can imitate a real person to this extent, though...
[Dialogue Option]  Let's go down then.
[Dialogue Option]  Can we not go in there?
Yangyang: Right. The Glider can't carry us beyond the Tacet Field's range. Besides, Baizhi is there. We'll have to go down and see what is going on.

content:
[Objective: (Cutscene plays)]
Chixia: Baizhi!
Chixia: Baizhi! We're in a Dormant Tacet Field, right? Why did you come here by yourself?
Chixia: Baizhi, you know, we... huh?
Baizhi: You are alright, it seems.
Chixia: You know, he was super energetic! Handled a super big TD! Way more spirited than me!

content:
[Objective: (Cutscene ends)]

[Dialogue Option]  What's going on?
[Dialogue Option]  Is this a mind-reading gathering?
Yangyang: It isn't.
Yangyang: Baizhi is just concerned about your condition. She must think we shouldn't be letting you move around that much, since you've just regained consciousness...
[Dialogue Option]  I'm alright.
[Dialogue Option]  Hah!
Chixia: Wow, would you look at that!
[Dialogue Option]  Oh, I suddenly feel sooo much pain.
Yangyang: Are you alright? Where does it hurt?
Baizhi: Worry has clouded your judgement, Yangyang.
Baizhi: His/Her vitals are stable, with normal-sized pupils and a steady breathing rythm.
Baizhi: ...This isn't the place for talking. Let's go.

title: Utterance of Marvels: I
content:
[Objective: (Cutscene ends)]

Chixia: Yangyang! Rover!
Chixia: Where are you?
Chixia: We're blocked outside. We can't get in. Are you alright?
Yangyang: Rover is with me. And... that strange Tacet Discord is here too.
Baizhi: It's the Tacet Discord's ability.
Baizhi: Be careful.

title: Utterance of Marvels: I
content:
Yangyang: Rover is with me. And... that strange Tacet Discord is here too.
Baizhi: It's the Tacet Discord's ability.
Baizhi: Be careful.



Chixia: Yangyang! Rover!
Chixia: Are you alright? Are you hurt?
[Dialogue Option]  (Shake your head.)
[Dialogue Option]  I'm fine.
Chixia: Ugh thank goodness! We could see that darn barrier, but couldn't lay a finger on it!
Yangyang: I'm fine too.
Yangyang:I have never seen such a formidable Tacet Discord before, but Rover was able to completely defeat it.
[Dialogue Option]  We beat it together.
Yangyang: I... didn't really do much. It was all thanks to you, Rover.
[Dialogue Option]  A piece of cake.
Chixia: Rover, what was that last move called? That looked as cool as Fiamma's killer move!
[Dialogue Option]  It's a hard-won battle.
Chixia: Aww c'mon, stop being modest! So you didn't even go all out earlier. I saw how you took down that fella with both of my eyes!
Chixia: You made a couple kicks and that thing vanished into thin air!
Yangyang: That's strange. This place isn't known to be so dangerous...
Chixia: Anyway, come check this out!
[Dialogue Option]  An illusion... left by the Tacet Discord?
[Dialogue Option]  And this is...?
Yangyang: Oh, this is... an Echo.
Chixia: Wow! An Echo of the Elite Class... Someone got lucky today!
Yangyang: My apologies. We got a little carried away. Does "Reverberation" or "Echo" ring a bell to you, Rover?
Yangyang: Everything in our world is made up of frequencies, and every sound generates a reverberation.
Yangyang: Those "Echoes" are the lingering Reverberations of Tacet Discords after they disintegrate. We can absorb them into the Data Banks in our Pangu Terminals.
Chixia: Oh, by Pangu Terminal, she means the gourd-shaped device every Resonator has, developed by researchers in Huanglong!
Chixia: But you see, it's not always we get to find these. Also, there's a limit to what your gourd can absorb.
Yangyang: Absorption is only possible when your Data Bank's level is equal to or higher than the Tacet Discord's level. The Terminal can then convert its Reverberation into an "Echo" for use in battle.
Yangyang: My Terminal issued a warning when it detected that Tacet Discord earlier. It should at least be an Overlord Class.
Yangyang: Rover, would you mind checking your Data Bank level?
Chixia: No need for that! Rover, why don't you just try absorbing it with your Terminal?
Chixia: ...Oh. So it doesn't work.
[Dialogue Option]  It says I'm Level 0.
Chixia: No worries! You can start with smaller ones before tackling this guy here.
Chixia:  There should be some sweet Baby Roseshrooms 'round here. Let's go check those out, shall we?
[Dialogue Option]  What will happen if I can't absorb it?
Baizhi: It won't take long before the reverberations disappear and the Etheric Sea vanishes. Once that happens, the Resonance Beacon signals will come back.
Baizhi: The Tacet Field will dissipate, biding time for its next resurgence.
Baizhi: ...
Baizhi: We'll need to report the unusual phenomena here to the City Hall and the Academy.
Baizhi: Let's make our exit.

title: Utterance of Marvels: I
content:
Chixia: What... What kinda power is that!
Chixia: Rover, you...
Chixia: You been playin' the fool all along?
Chixia: I've never seen a Resonance Ability quite like this. You got any other tricks up your sleeve? Like, eating a whole Tacet Discord? Grilling Echoes alive?
[Dialogue Option]  That wasn't my Resonance Ability.
Chixia: Wasn't it your Resonance Ability?
[Dialogue Option]  I have no idea what happened.
Yangyang: Could it be related to your lost memories? Can you recall anything now?
[Dialogue Option]  It's not that different from eating it alive.
Chixia: Indeed. So what would a Tacet Discord taste like? Spicy? Sweet?
[Dialogue Option]  How does that relate to my cooking skills...?
Chixia: I heard some folks tried to cook Gulpuffs, and they even made it a local , didn't they?
Chixia: Speaking of which, Gulpuff's a type of Tacet Discord, too!
Chixia: I'm even more curious now... Anyway, spicy food is always the best!
Yangyang: Rover, are you feeling alright? Any discomfort?
Yangyang: Could it be the side effect of fighting that Tacet Discord? Baizhi, can we take Rover to do a check-up at Huaxu Academy's Resonance Medical Department...
[Dialogue Option]  I'm fine.
[Dialogue Option]  Yeah, I need a check-up.
Baizhi: ...
Yangyang: Baizhi?
Baizhi: Absorbing Echoes with the human body is not entirely unprecedented.
Yangyang: With the human body...?
Yangyang: I remember Comprehensive Mirror for Historians mentioned this in the Huanglong section's opening...
Yangyang: "... A celestial being descended, commanding the Qiankun's (universe) boundless power. Assuming mortal form, they condensed the primordial essence, creating Pangu. Cleaving heaven and earth apart, they aligned the celestial and terrestrial. Their radiance encompassed the four corners. Thus began the illustrious annals of Huanglong, as provinces were first demarcated..."
[Dialogue Option]  What does that mean?
Chixia: There was a very strong person way back. Like they held the whole universe right in their hands. As there was no Terminal in those days, they absorbed the Tacet Discord with their bare hands!
Chixia: and the TD they absorbed was the most powerful of all. That person turned it into the first Echo ever.
Chixia: Then they used the power of that Echo to rebuild the world, sort out the laws, and that's how the history of Huanglong began...
[Dialogue Option]  Chixia, you must know a lot about history.
Chixia: Actually... I'm not, I hope I was though. That was just some old tales my parents used to tell men, kinda like the Sentinel's Appointment thing.
Chixia: Yangyang's got an impressive memory for the ancient texts. Me? I just happen to roughly remember what the story's about.
[Dialogue Option]  I see.
Chixia: Please, Yangyang, stop reciting that! I'm beggin' you!
Chixia: Oh my, it's takin' me back to my school days, when I had to recite pages and pages of them... Anyway, that's just a made-up legend, isn't it?
[Dialogue Option]  What if I am that person...
Chixia: Come on, that was eons ago. Us Resonators do live a little longer, but we're still looking at 'bout a hundred years or so. And the known history of Huanglong stretches back at least a thousand years...
[Dialogue Option]  That sounds mysterious.
Yangyang: If I may say, Rover, you seem quite "mysterious" too.
[Dialogue Option]  Pangu? Qiankun?
Yangyang: That's where the names "Pangu Terminal" and "Qiankun Data Bank" come from.
Chixia: Whether it's true or not, that story happened a long time ago when Jinzhou didn't even exist.
Chixia: Could it be that Rover's like, the great-great-great-great-great-granddaddy of us all?
Baizhi: Let's not jump to conclusions without enough data and proper analysis.
Baizhi: Rover.

title: Utterance of Marvels: I
content:
Baizhi: Let's not jump to conclusions without enough data and proper analysis.
Baizhi: Rover.



Chixia: Wait? The signal's back!
Yangyang: This is... a holographic message to all of Jinzhou from the City Hall.
Jinhsi: My fellow soldiers and citizens, I apologize for any inconvenience caused. I am Jinhsi, the Magistrate of Jinzhou.
Jinhsi: As the  approaches, our city welcomes visitors from around the world. The festivities are highly anticipated by our people, and I, too, share in this joyful sentiment.
Jinhsi: Jinzhou has always been a crucial defense against the Tacet Discord Outbreaks, safeguarding Huanglong. We have a heavy responsibility on our shoulders with no room for retreat or failure.
Jinhsi: It is the dedication of our warriors, along with the diligence of our citizens, that has allowed us to thrive in peace and prosperity.
Jinhsi: Despite the challenges of Tacet Discord, we remain steadfast and hospitable to visitors, upholding our enduring traditions.
Jinhsi: With that in mind, I have a favor to ask.
Jinhsi: Among our visitors, there is one  that holds utmost importance to me, the City of Jinzhou, and the entirety of Huanglong.
Jinhsi: We have awaited your arrival for a long time.
Jinhsi: Given the circumstances, you may be feeling bewildered at this time.
Jinhsi: You should have noticed some strange happenings related to you.
Jinhsi: If you plan to stay in Jinzhou for some time, I would be more than delighted to personally meet you in the City Hall of Jinzhou.
Jinhsi: While I cannot guarantee to provide all the answers you need, I will do my best to assist you and provide necessary permissions, if applicable.
Jinhsi: This is only my personal request. You can decide your course of action in any way you see fit.
Jinhsi: Therefore, I request the people and soldiers of Jinzhou to assist this esteemed visitor when the opportunity arises.

title: Utterance of Marvels: I
content:
Jinhsi: Therefore, I request the people and soldiers of Jinzhou to assist this esteemed visitor when the opportunity arises.



Chixia: Why do I get this feeling...
Baizhi: This person our Magistrate was talking about...
Yangyang: ...is Rover.
[Dialogue Option]  Yup, that's me.
Chixia: Wow, so this is the true measure of a Chief... I mean, of our Rover!
[Dialogue Option]  What were you going to say?
[Dialogue Option]  Chief...?
Chixia: "This is the true measure of a Chief!"
Chixia: It's a famous line from a good old Hero Play. It's been runnin' for almost four years! It's a really heart-warming tale about the Chief and their Squad.
Yangyang: Does that Hero Play story sound familiar to you?
[Dialogue Option]  It's still too early to tell.
Yangyang: Now you're talking a little like Baizhi, Rover.
[Dialogue Option]  Moon-chasing Festival?
Yangyang: The Moon-chasing Festival and the Spring Loong Festival are the liveliest times in Huanglong. They're two of our most famous traditional festivals.
Yangyang: Every region in Huanglong will be celebrating the festivals in their unique ways. Jinzhou is a city built on the borders, but it's no exception in that regard.
[Dialogue Option]  Jinhsi?
Yangyang: Are you curious about our Magistrate's title, Rover?
Yangyang: Our Magistrate's real name is "Hsi". usually, the Sentinel selects a candidate during the Appointment Ceremony to become our Magistrate. They will then take on the city's name as their surname. This signifies their wholehearted dedication to the city and its people.
Chixia: Hey, that ain't the point, okay?!
Yangyang: What are your plans now, Rover?
[Dialogue Option]  Go meet the Magistrate of the City Hall.
[Dialogue Option]  Go visit Jinzhou City.
[Dialogue Option]  I don't have any plans yet.
[Dialogue Option]  Take a look at those festivities.
Chixia: There's still a while before the festival break. The best part of it hasn't even started!
Yangyang: If you're eagerly anticipating the festival atmosphere now, I'm afraid you will end up disappointed.
Yangyang: But if you can stay in Jinzhou for a little while longer until the Moon-chasing Festival activities begin...
Yangyang: I remember you had a flashback of yourself looking into its eyes when you saw the statue of our Sentinel.
Yangyang: We can't confirm its authenticity, but based on the Magistrate's message, it seems Jinzhou has a lot to do with your past.
Yangyang: Whether you're the visitor our Magistrate mentioned or not, you are surely important to Jinzhou, and you will be our important...
Chixia: Friend!
Chixia: We've already entrusted our lives to each other. I've never seen so many TDs packed together, and that Elite one was so scary! Well, you did get rid of most of them, hehe.
Chixia: Anyway, once we're back in Jinzhou, I'll treat you to that famous specialty from Panhua's Restaurant.
[Dialogue Option]  Let's go.
[Dialogue Option]  Let's head to the city.
[Dialogue Option]  I don't have anywhere else to go anyway.

title: Utterance of Marvels: II
content: Utterance of Marvels: II is the second part in the Prologue chapter of the Main Quests.

title: Utterance of Marvels: II
content: Baizhi, Chixia, and Yangyang lead Rover to Jinzhou. On their way there, Chixia helps Rover properly absorb an Echo with their terminal. Once at Jinzhou, the trio split up, and Rover is left in Chixia’s care as they explore the city together before meeting the Magistrate.

content:

Defeat Stonewall Bracer
Absorb the Reverberation and obtain an Echo
Equip the Echo
Defeat nearby TDs: (0/2)
Return to Jinzhou
(Optional) Activate Resonance Beacon
Head to Jinzhou

title: Utterance of Marvels: II
content: Completing the quest will grant the Rover's Journey trophy From the New World and the Resonator Chixia.

title: Utterance of Marvels: II
content:
Quest Objective: Amidst a ripple of Reverberations, you hear the call... As you unravel your past, a new path unfolds before you, beckoning from the unknown.

Baizhi: It would be best for your well-being to have a thorough physical examination once we arrive in Jinzhou.
Baizhi: While there don't seem to be any immediate side effects following the absorption of that Echo, we cannot rule out the possibility of other latent risks.
Baizhi: Given our lack of data on you and your unusual physical signs, I suggest absorbing another Reverberation with your Terminal when we find one. That being said, please be sure to proceed cautiously.
Chixia: Yeah, don't go too hard on yourself. You should get a check-up just to be safe. Besides, Yangyang's very worried about you.
Yangyang: If you feel any discomfort along the way, please do let us know.

content:

Chixia: I'm gonna get you one you can absorb. I never go back on my promise! Your hero Chixia's on the hunt!

Baizhi: Can you reenact what you did before?
[Dialogue Option]  (Shake your head.)
[Dialogue Option]  I feel nothing.
[Dialogue Option]  I don't have the feeling of being pushed like I did before.
Chixia: Hmm, maybe you can only absorb the powerful ones with your body?
Chixia: Or does it have to be a certain type of Tacet Discord?
Chixia: Or maybe...
Chixia: Maybe we should give your Terminal a whirl?

Chixia: Yay! it worked!
Chixia: I've never seen a gourd quite like yours before, but it sure is working just fine.

Chixia: Hmm... Your Terminal's got a different look, but the functions are pretty much the same.

Chixia: Look! Jinzhou City's just up ahead!
Yangyang: ...Rover?

subsection: Chapter 1 Act 1 Utterance of Marvels [Quest Complete]
content:
Chixia: Alrighty. What should we do next?
Chixia: Shall we go grab a bite?
[Dialogue Option]  Sounds good.
[Dialogue Option]  We should visit the City Hall.
[Dialogue Option]  I should go get my body check-up.
[Dialogue Option]  Let's focus on the task at hand.
Baizhi: I am to return to the Academy.
Baizhi: The anomalies at the Gorges of Spirits, the resurgence of that Tacet Field, and the many Waveworn Phenomena occurrences... I should report them in time.
Yangyang: Then I'll go submit our report, and prepare the documentation needed for Rover's audience with the Magistrate while I'm there.
[Dialogue Option]  Documentation?
Yangyang: It's the political hub of Jinzhou, and where the Grand Library (Data Repository) is located.
Yangyang: The City Hall is an important place. Seeking an audience with the Magistrate isn't too difficult, but there are still rules to follow.
[Dialogue Option]  Sounds like a lot of work.
Yangyang: It may take some time, but there won't be too much paperwork.
[Dialogue Option]  What about me?
[Dialogue Option]  Okay.
Chixia: Then I guess I'll take Rover over to the Nexus Tower for registration first, and we'll just hang out for a while.
Chixia: Being new to Jinzhou and all, he can't be left standing outside the City Hall with nothing to do.
Chixia: Hospitality is our local speciality, you know!
Yangyang: Then I'll leave you in Chixia's care, Rover. Is that alright with you? I'll give you a call once the paperwork is done.
Chixia: Leave it to me!
Baizhi: I'll send the Branch of Resonmedical Science a notice. We need to conduct a throughout physical examination on you to make sure you are fine.
Baizhi: Come visit the Academy after your audience if you have no other plans.
[Dialogue Option]  A thorough examination?
Baizhi: Yes. A physical examination would be required to determine if any disease is present. If no medical issues are found, we'll conduct further monitoring and analysis to understand what happened to your body.
Baizhi: Of course, we won't do anything without your consent.
[Dialogue Option]  The Academy?
Baizhi: The unique nature of your condition requires specialized treatment only available in the Huaxu Academy.
Baizhi: And your body is bound to arouse the interest of many researchers.
Baizhi: Myself included.
Yangyang: Baizhi, I think your last sentence could be worded better...
Baizhi: I see. I agree that my phrasing lacked the attention to detail. Please allow me to reorganize my words.
[Dialogue Option]  Sure.
Chixia: You guys done yet?
Chixia: What's the hold up. Let's move, then I'll have more time to show Rover around!
Chixia: We've got loads of fun in Jinzhou! We can go watch Liondances, Hero Plays, Stand-up Shows, and then maybe the Martial Championships... Plus tons of different treats to try out. You think it, we have it.
[Dialogue Option]  Let's go.
[Dialogue Option]  Let's split up.
[Dialogue Option]  Yangyang, Baizhi, see you later.

title: Chapter I
content: Quest Objective: As the city lights twinkle, friendly faces beckon you to join them in the bustling border town. Immerse yourself in its prosperous yet tranquil ambiance.

title: Chapter I
content: Quest Objective: As the tides of danger retreat, Jinzhou appears tranquil and vibrant. But beyond its borders lies a fierce and desperate battleground.

title: Chapter I
content: Quest Objective: Forbidden memories of the past lay buried in ashes and ruins. The ominous "fractured star" beckons, holding untold secrets within its shadows. Secrets that still burn within a cindered heart.

title: Chapter I
content: Quest Objective: The purposes and directions of the three tokens have all been found. All the answers of the riddles seem to be hidden behind the mysterious gate that the sundial hints at.

title: Chapter I
content: Quest Objective: The previous puzzle's answers has been revealed, but it only leads to another one. With a storm on the horizon, you follow the Magistrate's advice and search for clues about "the Black Shores".

title: Chapter I
content:
Quest Objective:
As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

title: Chapter I
content: Quest Objective: After the battle of Norfall Barrens, everything came to an end. Your friends are calling you for a meet-up with snacks at Panhua's Restaurant. It seems they like to know more about that "little one" from within your body...

title: Chapter I
content: Quest Objective: Your forgotten past, hazy memories, and a strange dream... So many questions linger about your identity, and who you used to be. Meanwhile, a mysterious pull guides you to a hidden place on the distant sea...

title: Chapter I
section: Act VIII - To the Shore's End
content: Quest Objective: The future is still unknown, and the past remains buried beneath the waves. After your journey across Mt. Firmament, all clues now point to a hidden island in the sea—the Black Shores. Yangyang's message hints that in the Port City of Guixu, you might find the Bloom Bearer now stationed in Jinzhou...

title: First Resonance
content:
Quest Objective: As the city lights twinkle, friendly faces beckon you to join them in the bustling border town. Immerse yourself in its prosperous yet tranquil ambiance.

Chixia: Here we are. Jinzhou's Nexus Tower!
[Dialogue Option]  The Nexus Tower?
Chixia: Exactly. Lemme see, uh, think of it as Jinzhou's largest server station, or an integration hub. It's something along those lines. I'm not much of a tech person myself.
Chixia: Long story short, it's a navigator, a defense system, and a regional information center all in one enormous package.
Chixia: The smaller ones we ran into earlier are Resonance Beacons.
Chixia: Data is shared between all Beacons. You activate one, and the entire map's data will be relayed to your Terminal. Pretty nifty, huh?
Chixia: Just place your Terminal here.

title: First Resonance
content:
Chixia: Just place your Terminal here.



Yangyang: I have the arrangements in place. Rover, you can come visit the Magistrate at any time.
Yangyang: Chixia, do you mind bringing Rover over to the City Hall?

title: First Resonance
content:
Yangyang: Chixia, do you mind bringing Rover over to the City Hall?



Chixia: Whew. First time seeing such a crowd in front of the City Hall.
Yangyang: I was surprised too. I've never seen so many non-staff personnel here before.
[Dialogue Option]  Are they all here for an audience with the Magistrate?
Yangyang: Most of the people here have applied for an audience, but I heard they've all been turned down.
[Dialogue Option]  Turned down by who?
Yangyang: Most people were advised to leave by the Magistrate's bodyguard upon sending in their applications. The ones staying here are either trying to apply for some other people, or just too stubborn to leave.
Yangyang: The few that made it inside said it only took "one freezing look from Lady Sanhua", and they were compelled to leave.
Chixia: What kind of description is that? sounds like they've met some snake-haired lady, and got turned into stone.
[Dialogue Option]  Who's Sanhua?
Yangyang: She's the Magistrate's personal bodyguard.
Chixia: Oh, I've heard of her before. She's the "All-round Death Glare slash Terminator Ice Beauty."
Chixia: ...That's what the rumors say, at least.
[Dialogue Option]  Perhaps the Magistrate is not here yet.
Yangyang: There is a small chance she's not in the City Hall, but it is very unlikely for her not to be in Jinzhou.
Yangyang: Or rather, it's nearly impossible for the Magistrate to leave Jinzhou at all.
Yangyang: With her busy schedule, it's already difficult to find any time off. In addition, as the Magistrate of Jinzhou, leaving the land under her jurisdiction without authentication is not allowed.
Yangyang: Unless she's engaged on a business trip, or... when Jinzhou's safety is under threat.
Chixia: Yup, there's gotta be something big if that's the case!
[Dialogue Option]  It's me they're waiting for.
Chixia: So this is the true confidence of our Rover!
Chixia: I agree though. So far you've been ticking all the boxes in our Magistrate's description.
[Dialogue Option]  Can holographic messages be prerecorded?
Chixia: Sure they can.
Yangyang: Have you thought of something, Rover?
[Dialogue Option]  Perhaps the Magistrate did not know who her guest was.
[Dialogue Option]  I'm wondering why the Magistrate wanted to meet her guest in person.
[Dialogue Option]  She must have a reason for attracting all this attention.
Yangyang: You mean...?
[Dialogue Option]  She's not doing this to avoid confusion for her guest.
[Dialogue Option]  She should have anticipated the follow-up of her public message.
[Dialogue Option]  Still, how does she decide who is her guest, and who is not...
[Dialogue Option]  Nothing in particular.
Yangyang: I can't really keep up with your thoughts, but I think a meeting with the Magistrate wouldn't hurt.
Chixia: Same here. Anyway, our Magistrate's the best lead we have for now, no matter what she has in store for Rover.
[Dialogue Option]  I believe so.
[Dialogue Option]  What do you think?
Chixia: Huh? Me? I'm just wondering how to take you, Yangyang, and Baizhi for some chow after this!
Chixia: But my shift's almost coming up. Dunno if we'll make it...
Yangyang: I don't have anything particular in mind.
Yangyang: It was me who... I mean, we took you to Jinzhou. I think we should keep you company, at least while you're here.
Chixia: Oh, I see.
[Dialogue Option]  What if I am not the person?
Chixia: VIP or not VIP, special or not special... That doesn't matter at all.
Chixia: ...unless there's money to earn, of course!
[Dialogue Option]  What if I am the person?
Chixia: Then that's exactly what we're after!
Chixia: That means we're on the right track then. You'll be getting your memories back in no time.
Yangyang: What do you think, Rover? Are you in a hurry to recover your memories?
[Dialogue Option]  Most certainly.
[Dialogue Option]  The loss of memory doesn't bother me.
[Dialogue Option]  I don't know what to do.
[Dialogue Option]  What really matters is how I'll live my life and create new memories.
Yangyang: In that case...
Yangyang: How about meeting with the Magistrate first? She may have the answers you're looking for.
Yangyang: We are not allowed to go with you. Chixia and I will be right outside the City Hall.
Yangyang: We'll be waiting for you.
Chixia: That's right, we're not going anywhere! Just give us a shout if anything goes down—Wait, no, we won't be able to hear ya. Plus they've got this rule about not yelling inside the City Hall.

title: First Resonance
content:
Receptionist: Please, follow me.

Receptionist: Kindly have a seat.

Receptionist: Lady Sanhua will be with you shortly.

title: First Resonance
content:
??: Pleased to make your acquaintance. I apologize for the delay. My name is Sanhua, the bodyguard of Madam Magistrate.
[Dialogue Option]  Call me Rover for now.
[Dialogue Option]  Hello.
Sanhua: I regret to inform you that Madam Magistrate is currently away. Prior to her departure, she instructed me to bring you these tokens and a welcome gift.
Sanhua: Madam Magistrate advised you to explore what these tokens represent during her absence. This may help you acquire the information you desire sooner.
Sanhua: I apologize for the inconvenience, but please rest assured: she will be here to meet you in three days' time.
[Dialogue Option]  Where is the Magistrate?
Sanhua: Sorry... I cannot disclose her whereabouts at this time. Please trust me that she is eagerly looking forward to meeting you in person.
[Dialogue Option]  Did something happen to her?
Sanhua: Pardon my inability to provide a better answer. Madam Magistrate has a task that she must handle alone, but she has never for one moment forgotten about her meeting with you.
Sanhua: Not knowing exactly when you'd arrive, she had to leave without having the chance to welcome you in person.
[Dialogue Option]  Why three days?
Sanhua: Because she will require at least three days to complete her current task.
Sanhua: Madam Magistrate wanted to assure you that in three days, by any means, she will return to meet you in person.
[Dialogue Option]  Is there anything I can do to help?
Sanhua: You...
Sanhua: I'll be sure to convey your kindness to Madam Magistrate. Please accept my sincerest gratitude.
Sanhua: Yes, Madam Magistrate does hope to have your assistance, but there is no rush for a decision. She does not want to pressure you into anything you may not desire. We invite you to learn about our situation before making a final commitment.
[Dialogue Option]  How am I supposed to know what the tokens represent?
Sanhua: When it comes to these tokens, it is never her intention to confuse you with the puzzles. Instead, they should serve as clues that lead you toward the truth.
Sanhua: Madam Magistrate deeply regrets not having the time to deliver her messages to you in person.
Sanhua: We value your presence far more than you might imagine. The same goes for any and all information about you.
[Dialogue Option]  Got it.
[Dialogue Option]  How were you certain I was the guest?
Sanhua: Since Madam Magistrate is currently away, I cannot make the final confirmation on her behalf.
Sanhua: But you. You are truly exceptional.
[Dialogue Option]  I heard many people were "politely" asked to leave.
Sanhua: Regarding that...
Sanhua: My eyes can see the frequencies of all living beings.
Sanhua: Or rather, those "frequencies" are the only thing I can see.
Sanhua: You... You share the same frequency with Madam Magistrate.
[Dialogue Option]  What does my frequency look like?
Sanhua: You look undistorted and authentic, in your original form.
[Dialogue Option]  The same frequency?
Sanhua: Apologies. My description was not accurate.
Sanhua: Both you and Madam Magistrate look undistorted to me.
Sanhua: In my eyes, you appear the way you are.
[Dialogue Option]  What do the frequencies of others look like?
Sanhua: They all look different.
For some reason, you can tell Sanhua doesn't want to continue this topic.

title: First Resonance
content:
Sanhua: They all look different.
For some reason, you can tell Sanhua doesn't want to continue this topic.



Sanhua: May I have your Terminal for a moment?
[Dialogue Option]  What do you want with it?
Sanhua: I need your Terminal for Access Pass authorization. In the meantime, I willconfigure the latest Utility module for you.
[Dialogue Option]  My Terminal?
Sanhua: Yes, it's the "gourd" on your waist. The device every Resonator carries.
[Dialogue Option]  Are we exchanging contacts now?
Sanhua: Indeed. It was an oversight on my end. I will now import my contact information and that of all public services, like Patrol Stations, into your Terminal.
Sanhua: I will be here on standby, ready to assist whenever you need me.
Sanhua: I need your Terminal for regional access authorization. I will also configure the latest Utility module for you.
Sanhua: Madam Magistrate thought you might need it.
[Dialogue Option]  (Hand over the Terminal.)
You waited for a moment.
Sanhua: The Utility module on your Terminal has been upgraded to the latest iteration. Now all the Utilities, including Sensor, Levitator, and Grapple, should be fully functional.
Sanhua: You are now granted unlimited access to all regions in Jinzhou. I have sent your Terminal ID to every border pass and resonance Beacon. You will only need to display your Terminal ID, or activate a Beacon with your Terminal for entry.
Sanhua: You are now free to visit any part of Jinzhou.
[Dialogue Option]  And that includes the City Hall?
[Dialogue Option]  So no more annoying paperwork?
Sanhua: Yes, including the City Hall. You have full access to its facilities.
Sanhua: Also, may I ask... Have you decided your place of residence in Jinzhou?
Sanhua: If not, Madam Magistrate has arranged accommodation for you in advance, here in the City Hall.
[Dialogue Option]  Home sweet home.
[Dialogue Option]  Royal Suite. Here I come!
Sanhua: I will lead you to your room if you need.
[Dialogue Option]  That won't be necessary at the moment.
[Dialogue Option]  I have friends waiting outside.
[Dialogue Option]  That won't be necessary.
[Dialogue Option]  I have other plans.
Sanhua: Understood. We will be ready to accommodate you anytime.

title: First Resonance
subsection: (Optional - Interact with the door in City Hall.)
content:
[Objective: (Optional - Interact with the door in City Hall.)]
You heard the crisp sounds of Weiqi pieces being laid down on the board, followed by a long silence.
[Dialogue Option]  (Knock on the door.)
There was no response. Maybe those inside are too invested in their game of Weiqi.
[Dialogue Option]  (Push the door.)
The door didn't bulge.

title: First Resonance
subsection: (When the player talks to Sanhua again.)
content:
[Objective: (When the player talks to Sanhua again.)]
Sanhua: Anything I can help you with, Rover?
[Dialogue Option]  I have questions about Jinzhou.
Sanhua: With pleasure. What do you wish to know about Jinzhou?
[Dialogue Option]  Who are the Midnight Rangers?
Sanhua: The Midnight Rangers, under General Jiyan's command, are a garrison in Jinzhou. They consist of the Vanguards for offensive operations against Tacet Discords, and the Rearguards for city defense.
Sanhua: Additionally, there is a detachment unit called the Outriders, mostly made up of volunteers or reservists who serve as reconnaisance agents.
Sanhua: Most of the servicement of today are comprised of Resonators.
[Dialogue Option]  How about an introduction of the city?
Sanhua: Jinzhou is not the most populated city in Huanglong. As a border city, it is the frontline in countering Tacet Discord Outbreaks.
[Dialogue Option]  Care to give me an introduction that's not from the books?
Sanhua: ...
Sanhua: ...Jinzhou holds a special place in my heart.
Sanhua: ...I can't say I am too familiar with my hometown, but I do feel a homely sense of attachment to Jinzhou. Maybe it's because here lives a person who changed my life.
Sanhua: Hmm. If I were to introduce Jinzhou in my own words, I'd say it's a city one would easily grow attached to.
[Dialogue Option]  I still have other questions.
[Dialogue Option]  I have questions about the Magistrate.
Sanhua: Of course. Please feel free to ask me anything, and I will answer to the best of my ability.
[Dialogue Option]  I'd like to learn more about the Magistrate.
Sanhua: Our Magistrate's birth name was Hsi. She took on the name Jinhsi when she became the Magistrate of Jinzhou.
Sanhua: Nowadays, she is usually addressed as "Madam Magistrate."
[Dialogue Option]  What is the relationship between Magistrate Jinhsi and the Sentinel of Jinzhou?
Sanhua: She is also known as the "Loong Maiden", because of her Resonance connection with our Sentinel, "Jué", who manifests in the shape of a Loong (Dragon).
Sanhua: The ways Huanglong's Magistrates interact with their corresponding Sentinels can differ. In Jinzhou, our Magistrate seems to share a familial bond with the Sentinel.
Sanhua: Though... This is what I understand from what she has told me. I have only seen our Sentinel a handful of times.
[Dialogue Option]  When will the Magistrate return?
Sanhua: It depends on Madam Magistrate, and...
Sanhua: It depends on your decision, Rover.
Sanhua: Please pardon me. This is all I can say at the moment.
[Dialogue Option]  I still have other questions.
[Dialogue Option]  I have questions about the tokens.
Sanhua: With pleasure. What do you wish to know about the tokens?
[Dialogue Option]  How should I make use of the tokens?
Sanhua: I suggest looking into where these tokens come from.
Sanhua: Examine their locations of origin, and explore the sites or past events they represent... Then you should uncover the message Madam Magistrate wanted to convey, and hopefully learn everything you want to know.
[Dialogue Option]  Can I not investigate the tokens?
Sanhua: Of course. It is fully up to you.
[Dialogue Option]  I still have other questions.
[Dialogue Option]  I have questions about you.
Sanhua: Of course. Please feel free to ask me anything, and I will answer to the best of my ability.
[Dialogue Option]  Have we met before?
Sanhua: I'm afraid not. I have never seen you before.
Sanhua: If I had, I would never forget you.
[Dialogue Option]  Nothing in particular.

metadata.subsection: (When the player talks to Sanhua again.)

title: First Resonance
subsection: (When the player talks to Sanhua again.)
content:
Sanhua: I'm afraid not. I have never seen you before.
Sanhua: If I had, I would never forget you.
[Dialogue Option]  Nothing in particular.



Chixia: Rover!
Chixia: It took you so long. What gives? Was our Magistrate a chatterbox?
You told Chixia and Yangyang about your conversation with Sanhua.
Chixia: So Madam Magistrate's not in the City Hall...
Yangyang: ...
[Dialogue Option]  What's going on?
Yangyang: The wind is rising. In it, I sense disturbance and unrest.
[Dialogue Option]  Why the long face, Yangyang?
Chixia: Hahaha. It sure is.
Yangyang: ...Chixia.
Yangyang: The increasing Tacet Fields, uncannily powerful Tacet Discords, and now, our Magistrate's absence...
Chixia: Plus... The mysterious Rover!
Yangyang: I'm afraid...
[Dialogue Option]  Jinzhou might be in danger.
Chixia: Well, we've reported to the City Hall, the Ministry of War, AND the Academy. We've done everything we can.
Chixia: I mean, this is Huanglong! And we're talking about Jinzhou, of all places! We've been through our fair share of unrest over the past thousand years, and we've made it together every time.
Chixia: There's been TD outbreaks every year, but we can always trust General Jiyan, Madam Magistrate, and our Sentinel to have our backs! We're not ones to mess with!
Yangyang: "United we stand, a bastion of might; one equals a legion, invulnerable in fight"... Well said, Chixia.
[Dialogue Option]  There's no need to worry.
Chixia: Yeah! We've reported to the City Hall, the Ministry of War, AND the Academy. We've done everything we can so far.
Chixia: I mean, this is Huanglong! And we're talking about Jinzhou of all places. It's never actually been safe here over the past thousands of years. We made it through all those TD outbreaks anyway.
Chixia: We can always trust General Jiyan, Madam Magistrate, and our Sentinel to have our backs! We're not ones to mess with.
Yangyang: Well said.
[Dialogue Option]  Before that, what should we get for dinner?
Chixia: Aren't you the practical type!
Chixia: I'd love me some Chili Sauce Tofu, Jinzhou Maocai, Spicy Meat Slices... Ugh, I'm starving. Wait a sec, we still need to meet up with Baizhi first, right?
[Dialogue Option]  What should we do next?
Yangyang: So Madam Magistrate is meeting you in three days, and she left these tokens for you, said you can look into what they represent while she is away...
Yangyang: Do you have any plans, Rover?
[Dialogue Option]  I don't think there's much for me to do.
[Dialogue Option]  Let's investigate the items.
[Dialogue Option]  That's a three-day vacation in my books.
Chixia: Fair point. A three-day vacation it is!
Chixia: Let's just go chill out then! We'll figure out the tokens when we have the chance.
Chixia: Ooh, reminds me of the tokens of love in those stories... It sounds like you're off to a secret date or something. What is our Magistrate planning to do with these token puzzles?
[Dialogue Option]  Maybe she is looking for a soulmate.

[Dialogue Option]  I have no idea.
Yangyang: So Madam Magistrate left some hidden clues in her tokens. Clues that only the right person would be able to decipher...
Yangyang: But Rover has lost all memories, and would likely forget any kind of decryption method they agreed on. It doesn't quite make sense. Or maybe... She is trying to make Rover notice something else?
Yangyang: Rover, do you mind if we have a look at the tokens?
You showed Yangyang and Chixia the tokens.
Chixia: So, what's so special about them?
[Dialogue Option]  (Take the candy.)
Chixia: A candy? Oh! I've had these when i was a kid. I think they were called... Sugar pearls?
Chixia: But I haven't seen anything like this in a while... Went out of trend maybe?
Yangyang: It reminds me of my childhood. I still remember the taste. It was so sweet.
Yangyang: I was really scared of getting my flu shots when I was little, and sometimes the nurse lady would hand out candies like this as a prize for being good.
Yangyang: But... What does it mean as a token?
[Dialogue Option]  (Take the small device.)
Yangyang: It seems like... a miniature sundial.
[Dialogue Option]  A sundial?
Yangyang: It is a horological device that tells time by using sunlight's direction.
Yangyang: Sundials in Huanglong usually have marked lines for the twelve Shichens (Time Periods) in a day, and every Shichen is 2 hours long, with some showing seasons or months. The design of this sundial looks a bit unusual, though...
[Dialogue Option]  I believe so.
Yangyang: On this sundial... Time seems to be represented by the twelve Earthly Branches, drawn on the outer ring of its surface.
Yangyang: And its inner ring shows the "Four Symbols", reach representing one cardinal direction. These are the four famous auspicious beasts in Huanglong's folklore. They are believed to protect people from all four directions under Heaven.
Yangyang: Generally, The Teal Loong represents the , the White Tiger stands for the , the Vermillion Bird stands for the , and finally, we have the Black Tortoise for the .
Yangyang: It seems this sundial is supposed to show both time and direction, but how could it work when there is not a compass attached? Not to mention the lack of sunlight basically renders it useless...
Chixia: Ugh. That requires way too much brain power...
[Dialogue Option]  (Take the leaf.)
Chixia: The color of this leaf seems a bit odd. Can't tell what tree it is.
Yangyang: I think... I can feel something from it.
Yangyang: Hmm... Nevermind. It's too faint. Maybe it was just my imagination...
Yangyang: Sorry. I can't tell what kind of tree this leaf belongs to, either.
[Dialogue Option]  (Take the black fruit.)
Yangyang: This is... a mangosteen fruit.
Yangyang: Mangosteens are not native to Jinzhou. They are usually imported by boat. I think we can find more mangosteens being sold at the nearby markets.
Yangyang: They're not always available for purchase, though. The frequent Tacet Discord Outbreaks can disrupt transportation and cause shortages. The Midnight Rangers have greatly improved the situation in recent years, but still...
[Dialogue Option]  (That's all.)
Yangyang: So Chixia and I share similar childhood memories of the sugar pearl... Do you remember it too, Rover?
[Dialogue Option]  It doesn't ring a bell.
[Dialogue Option]  It does look a bit familiar.
Chixia: When it comes to candies, no one knows them better than the kids of Jinzhou!
[Dialogue Option]  Let's go ask around.
[Dialogue Option]  We should go find Baizhi first.
[Dialogue Option]  We should visit the Academy first.

title: First Resonance
subsection: (Upon approaching Mortefi and two other men)
content:
[Objective: (Upon approaching Mortefi and two other men)]
Man wearing white: The previous prototype almost met all our needs, but we're wondering if you can further optimize it.
Man wearing gray: Well... Um...
Mortefi: Make your feedback specific.
Man wearing white: We find it a bit hard to use. It's heavy, and the engine doesn't work that well.
Man wearing white: Can you reduce its weight by another ten percent and double the Tacetite Energy output?
Mortefi: I see, so you want a portable heavy tank. That's quite a BRILLIANT idea.
Man wearing white: Yeah, you got me. There must be something you can do, right? Try to cut cost as much as you can, but you can invest in better materials to reduce the weight.
Mortefi: That's easy, but in order to cut costs, I need you to double my research budget.
Man wearing white: What do you mean? How can we save money when the budget is doubled?
Mortefi: Oh? So, you do know doubling the budget won't lead to cost savings? Funny how you apply double standards when you're the one making requests.
Mortefi: Regarding the "good material" you asked for... Well, I see some right in front of me. You're the perfect material to be shipped off to the blacksmith's... for a good old-fashioned beating. Marvelous.
Mortefi: Trying to exhaust public research resources for personal gain at a time like this... You must think you're so smart.
Man wearing white: You... You could just admit you can't do it! How dare you spew such insults in public?!
Mortefi: Oh, I apologize if you felt humiliated. I thought you must have a thick skin to present such an unreasonable request.
Mortefi: Besides, didn't I just tell you?
Mortefi: I can fulfill any request you may have, but that's gonna cost extra.
Man wearing white: How... how dare you! We're divesting! I'm telling you! I'm leaving!
Mortefi: Interesting. Do you really think the meager investment you made over a decade ago is enough to make any difference? I've been paying more money every day to treat my colleagues to afternoon teas.
Mortefi: People in Huanglong have a good tradition of reciprocating help generously, and the Academy has been treating its investors with respect. You've already received a 120% return on your investment, haven't you?
Mortefi: I suggest you take what you can get. Blame your bad luck for crossing paths with me, the only foreigner here at the Academy. I don't plan to follow that "good tradition". I speak up when you get on my nerves. Farewell, you're free to leave.

content:
Baizhi: Here you are. The data we collected in the Gorges of Spirits have been submitted for analysis, and we'll have the results today. I have the equipment for your physical examinations ready, too.
Baizhi: Any discoveries during your trip to the City Hall?
You showed Baizhi the tokens you received and told her about what happened.
Yangyang: What do you think, Baizhi?
Baizhi: ...
Baizhi: I have a hypothesis about the sugar pearl, but I need to verify it first. If possible, I recommend conducting non-destructive tests of all these tokens you have.
[Dialogue Option]  Wish i could have thought of it earlier.
[Dialogue Option]  That's a straightforward solution.
[Dialogue Option]  That sounds simple and clear.
Baizhi: Data is always straightforward.
Baizhi: The first three tokens can be tested at my branch's laboratory (Branch of Remnant Studies). This miniature sundial will require radiographic testing, though. To access the necessary equipment, we'll need to file a request with one of the Tacetite Studies related branches.
[Dialogue Option]  Tacetite... that's the field Mortefi specializes in, isn't it?
Baizhi: Yes, Mortefi is the Branch of Tacetite Weaponry's head within the Department of Safety.
[Dialogue Option]  We can ask them about the other tokens too.
Baizhi: Indeed.
Baizhi: One moment, please.
Soon after, Baizhi returned with Mortefi.
Mortefi: Give me the items to be tested. Anything else you need me to know, you can let me know now. You may retrieve your items in twenty minutes, and the analysis report will be ready five minutes after that. Take a right, and you'll find me in the testing room.
[Dialogue Option]  (Take out the sundial.)
Mortefi took the sundial and gently weighed it in his hand.
Mortefi: This one looks like the early handiwork of someone I know.
Mortefi: It's lightweight, and its design differs from that of the typical sundial. And it appears to be missing a part. See, there's a groove here.
[Dialogue Option]  (Show him all the tokens.)
Mortefi: I don't see anything special with these items. Speaking of this sugar pearl... So you all remember eating sugar pearls like this when you were kids? I don't think I've ever had anything like this in my childhood.
[Dialogue Option]  Mr. Mortefi, I heard you weren't raised in Huanglong?
Mortefi: No. I'm from the New Federation. You mean this sugar pearl might be unique to Huanglong?
[Dialogue Option]  I believe so.
Yangyang: I remember a nurse lady giving me a candy like that.
Mortefi: So, sugar pearls like this were distributed at hospitals? Perhaps...
Baizhi: The sugar pearl might be a type of medicine. Its sweet taste would've made it more palatable to children.
Mortefi: Ms. Baizhi. As a Huanglong local working at the Academy, I suppose you already had an idea about what it is?
Baizhi: I do have my theory as to what it is, but it still needs verification. I wouldn't proclaim any solid answers before confirming the chemical composition of this item with reliable data.
Mortefi: Seconded. Let's find out through actual testing, then.
[Dialogue Option]  Understood.
Baizhi: It will take some time before the results are ready. If you have other matters to take care of, you should go ahead. I'll let you know once we have the results.
Yangyang: Shall we wait here at the Academy, Rover?
[Dialogue Option]  Sure.
[Dialogue Option]  We'll take a quick look around here, then?
Baizhi: Sure you can, but don't forget your physical examination—I'll see you in a while for that.

title: First Resonance
subsection: (Upon approaching Mortefi and two other men)
content:
Baizhi: Sure you can, but don't forget your physical examination—I'll see you in a while for that.



Baizhi: I have the equipment ready. I'll need to check your health status and see if there are any unusual fluctuations.
Baizhi: Now, let's begin if you're ready.
[Dialogue Option]  One moment please. Can I ask about...
Baizhi: Do you have any questions before we begin?
[Dialogue Option]  Do I have to do this?
Baizhi: Based on the samples collected, the Tacet Discord you defeated was at least an Overlord Class. After defeating it, you seemingly absorbed its frequency energy with your bare hands.
[Dialogue Option]  An Overlord Class?
Baizhi: Tacet Discords are classified according to the concentration levels of their characteristic frequencies. Generally, Tacet Discords with higher concentration levels are considered to pose greater threats.
Baizhi: The current classification levels, from lowest to highest, are Common, Elite, Overlord, and Calamity. Additionally, there is a special type of Tacet Discord, and we call them the Threnodians.
[Dialogue Option]  Will there be any kind of side effects?
Baizhi: You have absorbed a very powerful Echo with your body. You may seem fine now, but there could be internal changes that are too subtle to see or detect with my resonance ability.
Baizhi: Based on all the records I can find, humans need a Pangu Terminal in order to record or replicate an Echo's frequency.
Baizhi: That's why I'm quite curious how you could do that.
[Dialogue Option]  What is an "Echo" again?
Baizhi: When a Tacet Discord is eliminated, its frequency energy may linger in the form of an incorporeal manifestation, which is known as a "Reverberation".
Baizhi: A Resonator's Terminal collects and records said Reverberations, turning them into "Echoes" that can be directed as desired.
Baizhi: The combat abilities of these Echoes can then be replicated through the Terminal's Data Bank module, enabling Resonators to use them in battles.
Baizhi: Additionally, some Echoes' abilities allow Resonators to briefly transform into their shapes.
[Dialogue Option]  So you can turn into an "Echo"?
Baizhi: Yes, to some extent.
[Dialogue Option]  Have you ever come across other similar cases?
Baizhi: Apart from the ancient legend Yangyang mentioned earlier, I've never heard of anything like this...
Baizhi: But if we look at it another way, we might finally be able to verify said legend once we figure out what really happened with your body.
[Dialogue Option]  I'm ready.
[Dialogue Option]  Let's begin.
Baizhi: Can you try to manifest the Crownless' frequency without using your Terminal?
[Dialogue Option]  Unfortunately, I can't.
[Dialogue Option]  Hnngghh—! (try your best)
Baizhi: ...
[Dialogue Option]  Sorry. It seems I can't do that.
Baizhi: Hmm... I am not seeing the Crownless' data in your Terminal. So it was indeed absorbed into your body...
Baizhi: The Crownless' frequency energy was "consumed" by your body, leaving no trace behind.
Baizhi: But how did you manage to do that? It's as though there's another mechanism within your body capable of absorbing frequency energy...
[Dialogue Option]  Will I turn into a monster?
Baizhi: How do you define "monster"? For Resonators like you, such abnormal fluctuations in frequency typically lead to Overclocking.
[Dialogue Option]  What is Overclocking?
Baizhi: When a Resonator's mental capacity is overwhelmed, they may lose control of their Forte (power), causing an overflow of Resonance energy.
[Dialogue Option]  What happens when someone Overclocks?
Baizhi: This is known as "Overclocking" and is categorized into three levels based on severity. The excess Resonance energy harms both the Resonator and their surroundings.
Baizhi: In extreme cases, the excess energy can even manifest as destructive Tacet Fields.
Baizhi: We have established a comprehensive Overclock diagnosis process to accurately predict potential risks of Overclocking.
Baizhi: Your waveform graph shows a remarkable level of stability, surpassing any Resonator I've encountered. Your risk of Overclocking should be minimal.
Baizhi: You don't need to worry about that for the time being.
[Dialogue Option]  What kind of impact will it have on me?
Baizhi: I can't say without sufficient data.
[Dialogue Option]  Does this have anything to do with my amnesia?
Baizhi: Your test results don't indicate any trauma, so your amnesia may not be linked to traumatic events.
Baizhi: As for your ability to absorb Echoes, I can't make a connection between that and your amnesia based on the current data.
Baizhi: To put it simply, it seems there is another dimension or... a creature, hiding inside your body.
[Dialogue Option]  ...
[Dialogue Option]  Sounds like a cool terrarium idea.
Baizhi: I used that as a metaphor to express my speculation. If such a thing existed within you, scientists would be eagerly seeking to understand it.
Baizhi: There are so many mysteries about you worth exploring.
[Dialogue Option]  Sounds like I have a little universe within me.
Baizhi: A universe. That's a poetic and intriguing comparison.
Baizhi: It seems we need a simulated combat to figure out what happened in your body.
Baizhi: Please hold your Terminal tight and stay still.

Baizhi: Your arrival may have revived the "abnormal frequencies" we accidentally captured.

Yangyang: Mr. Mortefi, can we have the test results?
Mortefi:Simply put, it's hollow. Here, try tapping on it. It sounds different from a solid object.
Mortefi: It's not just a timekeeping took; it's an intricate mortise-and-tenon puzzle box.
Mortefi: This sundial is hollow with an inner compartment. We've scanned it, and there is a small paper scroll inside.
Mortefi: However, it's missing a crucial component.
Mortefi: We should be able to spin the wheels on this sundial once the right component is installed.
[Dialogue Option]  Impressive analysis.
Mortefi: Automata Mechanics isn't my field of study. I specialize in developing Tacetite Weapons, but the foundational theories behind these applied technologies are quite similar.
[Dialogue Option]  You're quite the expert!
Mortefi: I have some basic knowledge, but there is someone else who is more knowledgeable in Automata Mechanics than I am.
Mortefi: It wouldn't have taken me this long if we were dealing with Tacetite Weapons.
Mortefi: Install the missing part, then rotate the wheels to their correct positions, and you should be able to solve the puzzle and access the paper scroll.
Mortefi: However, I still have no idea what the missing component should look like.
[Dialogue Option]  Maybe we can brute-force it.
Mortefi: Well that's a no-brainer indeed.
Mortefi: We can certainly give it a try. If you're fine with the paper scroll being destroyed by its protective mechanism, that is.

Mortefi: No need to ask him. I can help you with this.
