title: Ominous Star
subsection: (After defeating the second batch of enemies)
content:
[Objective: (After defeating the second batch of enemies)]
Scar: Such speed, such brutality... Aah, can't you see? We are kindred spirits, after all...
Scar: Shh... Don't be so quick to deny it. Now that I have you here, standing before me, I'd love to hear your answers...

metadata.subsection: (After defeating the second batch of enemies)

title: Ominous Star
content:
[Objective: (Defeat Scar)]
Scar: Tell me. Do you want to be the rule-setting shepherd, or the rule-breaking black lamb?
Scar: If a sane person manages to survive in a realm of lunatics, would you call them the last one of reason... or the sole apostle?
Scar: Think about it. The shepherd is not the preordained embodiment of truth. Once he is gone for good, the black lamb can reclaim the trust of its herd...
Scar: Then... eventually, there will be none left to be "victims" or "oppressors"!

title: Ominous Star
content:
[Objective: (Scar at low health)]
Yangyang: ...Rover!
Scar: Ugh, such a pesky girl.

title: Ominous Star
content:
Yangyang: Rover... Rover!
[Dialogue Option]  ...Yangyang.
Yangyang: I shattered Scar's illusion. That should've injured him.
Scar: Hehe, should I thank you for showing me mercy?
Yangyang: Stay away from him/her!
Scar: Ugh. Didn't you promise to leave me some alone time with Rover?
Mysterious Woman in Red: With one condition. I do hope you haven't let that slip from your mind.
Mysterious Woman in Red: Don't let your improvisation trouble others.
Scar: Ugh... Look at you, rushing in to protect your precious "Perfect Movement".
Scar: No worries. I know all the dos and don'ts. I don't need you to tell me what to do.
Scar: Rover, it seems our happy little date... must come to an end.
Scar: But don't forget my sincere reminders.
Scar: Let me know what you'll choose: an unexpected gift, an honest and open exchange, or a highly risky gamble...
Scar: The choice is yours. I know how smart you are. You won't make a hasty decision.
Scar: We'll meet again... in the not-too-distant future.
Yangyang: They are gone. Should we go after them?
[Dialogue Option]  ...Let's skip it for now.
Yangyang: ...
[Dialogue Option]  Nevermind. Are you alright?
Yangyang: Oh... Don't worry. I'm okay.
Yangyang: Scar's Resonance Abilities appear to involve teleportation and the manipulation of space. He trapped me in confinement, and I could only sense that it wasn't far from here.
Yangyang: It took me some time to break that barrier. Sorry, Rover, if only I could've reached you sooner...
[Dialogue Option]  You are safe now, and that's all I care.
[Dialogue Option]  I broke free from it all thanks to you.
Strange Tacet Discord: B-brother... Brother...
Yangyang: Eh? Why are you here, little one?
[Dialogue Option]  It probably hid out of fear.
Yangyang: I've never seen any Tacet Discord display such vivid emotions...
Yangyang: The 'brother' it mentioned... Could it be...
[Dialogue Option]  Scar...?
Yangyang: Yes, that is a possibility, since Scar had been here before...
Yangyang: Let's talk about it later. Rover, can you fill me in on what happened?
You tell Yangyang about what just happened and the leads you gathered.
Yangyang: It seems all the tragedies in Qichi Village were linked to that "ritual"...
[Dialogue Option]  ...And Scar was feeding me bits of info.
Yangyang: Making up stories based on real life to support his twisted beliefs... That does sound like something he might do...
Yangyang: We cannot take his words for granted. Now we must locate where the "ritual" took place and see for ourselves.
[Dialogue Option]  Yes, we should give it a check.
Yangyang: Hmm? What's the matter?
[Dialogue Option]  ...Nothing.
Yangyang: Two distinct frequencies of Tacet Discords... I see.
Yangyang: I can feel it in the Streams... Over there. Follow me.
Rover: (In the south....)
Sanhua: They are unharmed. Please rest assured.
Sanhua: As you anticipated, Scar did not try to kill them... Yes, I stayed out of it like you asked.
Sanhua: Is everything alright on your end?
Sanhua: ...Please be sure to stay safe, My Lady.

title: Ominous Star
content:
Sanhua: Is everything alright on your end?
Sanhua: ...Please be sure to stay safe, My Lady.



Yangyang: Rover, do you still have the plaque we found earlier? The one broken in half.
Yangyang: Yes, as I thought... I just felt a similar vibration from that direction. Please follow me.

content:
[Objective: (Head to the designated location)]
Rover: It's the missing half. We can piece them together now.

content:

You place the wooden plaque on the stone. Soon after, you hear the roaring of flowing water.
Yangyang: Look, the water is going down!

title: Ominous Star
content:
[Objective: (Enter the cavern)]
Yangyang: I can't believe it... There's such a big opening down here....

Yangyang: How odd... This place should have been soaked in water, but everything is dry here. Even the vegetation is thriving.
Yangyang: Did Scar do this? Given his powers, it doesn't seem too hard for him.

title: Ominous Star
content:
[Objective: (Head to the designated location)]
Yangyang: That tree... It's stunning. It's almost eerily enchanting.
Strange Tacet Discord: Please... Save us...
Yangyang: Are you trying to tell us about... something hidden here?

title: Ominous Star
content:
[Objective: (Follow the mysterious TD)]
Yangyang: Where did it go..?!

title: Ominous Star
content:
[Objective: (Head to the designated location)]
Yangyang: Is that a... diary?

title: Ominous Star
content:
[Objective: (Talk to Yangyang)]
[Dialogue Option]  Talk
Yangyang: That girl just wanted to save her village...
Yangyang: But those sacrifices didn't lead to redemption.
Yangyang: I guess the Tacet Discord we saw stayed here to convey her last wishes...
Yangyang: ...Please excuse me.
Yangyang: It's getting a bit too cold here... Can we head back now?

title: Ominous Star
content:
Yangyang: ...Please excuse me.
Yangyang: It's getting a bit too cold here... Can we head back now?



Yangyang: Sorry, Rover, I didn't feel comfortable down there.
Yangyang: The air was heavy in that place, without any wind to speak of, but I could still feel so many emotions and desperate cries for help... I... I couldn't handle it.
Yangyang: The villagers were a complex mix of emotions... hope, resentment, and despair. And as I read the diary, I could feel the intense sorrow and longing of its owner.
Yangyang: What was the diary's owner longing for? Was it the peaceful life she once had, or did she miss her only family—the person who pushed her towards such tragic end?
Yangyang: ...My apologies. I got lost in thoughts again.
[Dialogue Option]  It's okay.
[Dialogue Option]  I understand.
Yangyang: I wish I could say such tragedies won't happen again...
Yangyang: ...But I still lack the confidence to make that claim.
Yangyang: It was tragedies like this that made me want to become an Outrider... to become someone with the strength to stop them from ever happening again.
Yangyang: I cannot stop the Lament, but at least I should do everything in my power to help those affected by it.
[Dialogue Option]  I trust you.
[Dialogue Option]  I'm with you.
Yangyang: Really? Thank you... Rover.
Yangyang: Dwelling on it won't do us any good... Let's go. I'll compile a report on what had happened here, and send it in along with the clues we've gathered.
Yangyang: Yes. Let's go back... together.

title: Clashing Blades
content: Quest Objective: The purposes and directions of the three tokens have all been found. All the answers of the riddles seem to be hidden behind the mysterious gate that the sundial hints at.

title: Clashing Blades
subsection: Go back to Jinzhou and meet with Chixia
content:
[Objective: Go back to Jinzhou and meet with Chixia]
Chixia: How did it go? Anyone hurt? Lemme check on you!
Chixia: Phew! You're still in one piece.
[Dialogue Option]  Course I am. You're overreacting.
Chixia: Okay okay. Anything new about the tokens?
You tell Chixia of your findings in the Desorock Highlands and Qichi Village.
Chixia: So those Fractsidus goons are here in Jinzhou now. Things are more serious than I thought.
[Dialogue Option]  I wonder what they are up to.
Chixia: Beats me. I've only ran into some bozos before.
Chixia: Those wackos are hellbent on making their own Resonators. Said there's no right or wrong when it comes to Resonance powers and everyone should have the right to them.
Yangyang: They use mechanical manipulation to integrate parts of Tacet Discords into human bodies.
Yangyang: Seeking power with such gruesome acts... I cannot bring myself to understand them.
Chixia: That Scar guy you mentioned sounds like he's on a whole other level. How did the fight go?
Yangyang: He... It seems he didn't intend to kill us. I would say he was even pulling his punches.
Yangyang: I don't know what he wants from us. But Madam Magistrate may have intended to hint something by letting us run into him.
Chixia: I still can't wrap my head around what happened in that village...
Chixia: I went over the files. That case is ancient. It was dealt with and archived way before our current Magistrate took office.
Yangyang: What happened to the village in the end?
Chixia: Don't worry, the crooks were brought to justice, and most of the villagers were relocated to new settlements.
Chixia: But I didn't find anything in the files about that little girl you mentioned.
Yangyang: So Scar really did take her away.
[Dialogue Option]  And it seems he did not hurt her.
Yangyang: I agree.
[Dialogue Option]  Maybe the Fractsidus had plans to use her for something.
Yangyang: ...
Yangyang: If only we could capture him...
Chixia: Ugh... I'm so lost. Why did Madam Magistrate point you to Qichi Village anyway? What did she want to tell you with that?
Yangyang: And then Scar went there to tamper with the site and mislead you with fake clues...
[Dialogue Option]  Or maybe it's the other way around.
Yangyang: You mean...?
Yangyang: The Fractsidus was planning to tell you something about what had happened in that village. Then our Magistrate intercepted by leading you there before they could?
[Dialogue Option]  Scar wanted to preach his ideas to me.
[Dialogue Option]  I suppose she just made use of the occasion.
[Dialogue Option]  She knew what was going to happen.
Yangyang: ...
Yangyang: Madam Magistrate knew they were going to lure you to the village. And she knew they weren't planning to kill you.
Yangyang: Her token was a warning that the Fractsidus had their eyes on you...
[Dialogue Option]  Plus, even if Scar really tried to kill us...
[Dialogue Option]  We wouldn't be in real danger.
Chixia: How so?
[Dialogue Option]  Jinzhou's way of hospitality, remember?
Chixia: You mean she's got someone looking out for you?
Yangyang: Or maybe she prepared other means of protection.
[Dialogue Option]  In a game of Weiqi, when the Black moves, White is sure to follow.
Yangyang: Yes, I agree. Knowing their plans, Madam Magistrate would have prepared countermeasures for the worst scenario.

metadata.subsection: Go back to Jinzhou and meet with Chixia

title: Clashing Blades
subsection: Go back to Jinzhou and meet with Chixia
content:
Yangyang: Yes, I agree. Knowing their plans, Madam Magistrate would have prepared countermeasures for the worst scenario.



[Dialogue Option]  ...
Yangyang: What's the matter, Rover?
[Dialogue Option]  And vice versa. Since the White has made her move...
Chixia: Uh, I don't think I follow.
[Dialogue Option]  Nothing in particular.
Yangyang: The legendary figure who changed Jinzhou's history, a looming war with the resurrecting Threnodian, and the Fractsidus acting in the shadows...
Yangyang: If all of these have something to do with your true identity. Then... who exactly are you?
[Dialogue Option]  I'm hoping Madam Magistrate has the answer.
[Dialogue Option]  I am your friend, the one you know as Rover.
Yangyang: Yes... You will always be the Rover we know, no matter what.
Chixia: That same old TD eating, Echo munching Rover all right!
Chixia: Come to think of it, the sundial's the last token we need to work out.
Yangyang: Mr. Mortefi said it's an intricate puzzle box. Madam Magistrate might have hid her real message inside.
[Dialogue Option]  We learned about the time at the Academy.
Yangyang: Yes. It's the 12th Shichen (Time Period) of the day, represented by the symbol Wei.
[Dialogue Option]  We learned about the direction in Qichi Village.
Yangyang: Yes. It's the South, represented by the Vermillion Bird, one of the Four Symbols.
Yangyang: Now we have the Shichen of Wei and Vermillion Bird. We should be able to solve the puzzle.

metadata.subsection: Go back to Jinzhou and meet with Chixia

title: Clashing Blades
content:
[Objective: Solve the sundial puzzle box]
Chixia: So, Rover, you're gonna try it now?
Yangyang: Symbols on the larger disk represent time, and we need to align the correct symbol with this pointer. It should be....
[Dialogue Option]  The Shichen of Yoh.
Yangyang: It's not working. So we can rule out the Shichen (Time Period) of Yoh now... The correct time we learned at the Academy should be....
[Dialogue Option]  The Shichen of Wei.
Yangyang: It's working. And now...
Yangyang: Symbols on the smaller disk represent direction, and we need to align the correct symbol with this pointer. It should be....
Yangyang: We have Teal Loong of the East, White Tiger of the West, Vermilion Bird of the South, and Black Tortoise of the North. According to the clues we've gathered, it should be...
[Dialogue Option]  White Tiger of the West.
Yangyang: It's not working. I guess it's not the White Tiger.
[Dialogue Option]  Vermilion Bird of the South.
Chixia: Wow, you really solved it!
(So this is the last message the Magistrate has for me. This is... the location of Jinzhou's Grand Library.)
Chixia: Wait, I don't think it's something we're allowed to see.
Chixia: Quick, Yangyang. We should turn around!
[Dialogue Option]  Why should you?
Chixia: It's gotta be some super confidential stuff Madam Magistrate's written for Rover's eyes only!
Chixia: As public servants... Well, even though we're both just reservists. We know there are rules to follow!
Yangyang: Chixia has a point.
[Dialogue Option]  It's nothing you can't see.
Yangyang: Maybe you should read it first, Rover?
[Dialogue Option]  We solved this together.
Chixia: Come on, just go ahead and see what's written inside!

title: Clashing Blades
content:
[Dialogue Option]  We solved this together.
Chixia: Come on, just go ahead and see what's written inside!



[Dialogue Option]  It's about the Grand Library...
Yangyang: I see. The Grand Libraries in Huanglong are renowned for their vast databases, holding valuable information about the regions they represent. Their exact locations are kept confidential, but it is believed they hold answers to all questions one could ask.
Yangyang: The Grand Libraries are vital for Huanglong's data security, managed by the regional Sentinels, accessible only to the Magistrates. They are rarely open to the public.
Chixia: Kinda like a big piggy bank inside the City Hall. Data-wise!
Yangyang: Yes. You will find the most comprehensive and accurate information there.
Yangyang: Rover, if you'll need to visit the Grand Library in Jinzhou to find out who you are, I think it suggests two things....
Yangyang: First, there is a strong link between your past and Jinzhou's history.
Yangyang: Second, you must be a really significant person.
Chixia: So you're super important to Jinzhou, maybe even all of Huanglong...
Chixia: Wow, I think we stumbled upon a real big shot when we didn't even know it!
Yangyang: What's that matter, Rover? Something wrong with the sundial?
[Dialogue Option]  Is the City Hall at the center of Jinzhou?
Yangyang: It is Jinzhou's political center. And it's also located at the city's center, if that's what you mean.
Yangyang: The City Hall was built first when Jinzhou was established. It's a popular landmark for locals giving directions.
Yangyang: Why do you ask, Rover?
[Dialogue Option]  Nothing in particular.
[Dialogue Option]  Madam Magistrate wishes to meet me alone.
[Dialogue Option]  I'll need to go somewhere on my own.
Chixia: See? What did I say! Covert ops, real confidential stuff going on!
Yangyang: ...
Chixia: C'mon, Yangyang. It's just an one-on-one meeting with Madam Magistrate. What's the worst that could happen?
Chixia: Relax, relax!
[Dialogue Option]  I wouldn't be so sure about that.
Chixia: Hey! Are you really trying to stress her out?
[Dialogue Option]  Indeed.
Yangyang: I guess you're right. Still, please be careful.
Yangyang: We'll be waiting for you.

title: Clashing Blades
content:
[Objective: (Move the vases to incorrect positions)]
The vase didn't budge at all. Not this one. I should go check on the other vases...

title: Clashing Blades
content:

I think I heard a low, grumbling noise...

content:

Rover: A part of the building is submerged... I should be able to find the hidden path underwater.
Rover: It seems I have a puzzle to solve. Guess I will check on the mechanism in the middle first.
Rover: "...Gather five tones to align in tune. The Bells shall guide your path."
Rover: "...Find keynotes to determine tone. The Archive shall be unmasked."
Rover: I see. The control panel here does look like a musical instrument, but five music notes seem to be missing.
Rover: So to gain access to the Database, I will need to recover the five missing notes stored in those Sonodisks...
Rover: What is that sound coming from behind the Symphodai (control panel)?

Rover: No, they are not real... They must be some kind of digital simulation. It seems they are the guards here. Interesting how I'm not hearing sirens, despite having destroyed every one of them.
Rover: Apart from the simulated Tacet Discords, it's unusually quiet in this place...

Rover: I suppose it's telling me where I can find the next Sonodisk... I think it mentioned a direction. What does that last sentence mean, though...
Rover: That sound... It's coming from the west.

Rover: I am being fed just enough information to work out the puzzle. This does look like Miss Magistrate's doing.

[Objective: (Take the elevator up)]

content:
[Objective: (Defeat the Guards)]
Rover: Here it is. Time to deal with the guards.
Rover: (Jinzhou's City Hall is the political hub, while the Grand Library holds vital data. Considering how I just took out all those guards, this place is oddly under-protected. If my guess is correct, the Magistrate may have other plans for me...)
Rover: ...Anyway. I'll keep going.

Rover: Must be another Sonodisk.

content:
[Objective: (Pick up Sonodisk: Zhi)]
Rover: This is the fourth missing note.
Rover: Almost there.

title: Clashing Blades
content:
[Objective: (Investigate the Lower Platform)]
Rover: Now the water is all gone.
Rover: One last note to go.

title: Clashing Blades
content:
[Objective: (Defeat the Guards)]
Rover: This is the last one. They've prepared quite the welcome for me.

title: Clashing Blades
content:
[Objective: (Pick up Sonodisk: Gong)]
Rover: I have the last Sonodisk ready. Time to go back to the Symphodai.

content:
[Objective: (Head to the Database)]
Rover: Now I should have access to the Database...

title: Clashing Blades
subsection: Check the database for more information
content:
[Objective: Check the database for more information]
Rover: So this is the "Grand Library". It's said to hold the answers to every question imaginable...
Rover: I'm not seeing anyone here. I guess the Magistrate is yet to arrive.
Rover: Well. It wouldn't hurt to browse the archives for a bit as I wait for her to show up.
(Cutscene: Scar walks in.)
Scar: Thank you for leading the way, Rover.
Scar: ...What a magnificent place to set foot in. Extensive. Exhaustive.
Scar: Oh... How I want to carve the place inside-out... And blow it all to shreds!
Scar: Hmm? Thought you'd seem a bit more surprised.
Scar: I wonder... Why?

metadata.subsection: Check the database for more information

title: Clashing Blades
subsection: Check the database for more information
content:
Scar: Hmm? Thought you'd seem a bit more surprised.
Scar: I wonder... Why?



(Cutscene: Rover jumps back as Sanhua's ice attack hits Scar, immobilizing him. Sanhua and Jinhsi walk in.)
Scar: Heh. So you've laid a trap for me.
(Cutscene: Scar frees himself and defends against Jinhsi's attack.)
Scar: Hehe... Hahahaha!
Scar: Interesting... Do you really think you can trap me here?
Jinhsi: You will not escape.
(Cutscene: Scar summons his Elysium.)
Scar: What a shame I can't stay and play with you a bit longer...
Scar: Til we meet again, dear friends.
Rover: You're not going anywhere!
(Cutscene: Rover jumps into the closing Elysium.)

metadata.subsection: Check the database for more information

title: Clashing Blades
content:
[Objective: (Defeat Scar: Aberrant Nightmare)]
Scar: Did you just offer yourself up to be my prey? Hehe...
Scar: Now... It's just the two of us.
Scar: Stow away that irrational anger of yours.
Scar: I just have a friendly reminder for you...
Scar: Seeing is not always believing. Why are you so sure they told you the truth? Don't jump to conclusions so soon.
Scar: Why are you so stubborn? Why can't you place some of that trust in me?
Scar: Or... Do I have to crush you to make you behave for once!

title: Clashing Blades
content:
[Objective: (Cutscene: Scar is now handcuffed.)]
Scar: So you knew I was following you all along.
Scar: My Elysium only breaks under coordinated attacks from both sides. I can never get rid of all these pesky little helpers around you, can I?
Scar: So you've joined hands against me with Miss Magistrate here. It does hurt my feelings, you know.
Scar: You're always so, so popular...
Jinhsi: Are you all right, Rover?
[Dialogue Option]  I'm fine.
Scar: Of course he/she is. How could I ever have the heart to hurt him/her?
Scar: Consider my moment of failure a gift of sincerity, Rover. I trust you haven't forgotten our conversation earlier.
Scar: Choose me. I'll tell you everything you want.
[Dialogue Option]  I already know everything.
Scar: Heh. I see... So she made the move before I could, and told you all of it already.
Scar: Then, as the winners... Would you be so kind as to tell me how you set me up?

title: Clashing Blades
content:
[Objective: (Flashback starts.)]
Rover: (Now I have retrieved the Magistrate's message for me from the puzzle box.)
Rover: (But it only points me to where the Grand Library is. There is not a meeting time... Something is still missing.)
Rover: (I've solved the puzzle, the disks have been rotated, and the two symbols are now glowing.)
Rover: (With this glowing light, a shadow is cast on two other symbols.)
Rover: (The Black Tortoise of the North... North to the City Hall)
Rover: (And the time reads... The Shichen (Time Period) of Chou, in the Wei hours of the morning.)

title: Clashing Blades
content:
Rover: (And the time reads... The Shichen (Time Period) of Chou, in the Wei hours of the morning.)



Jinhsi: It's been three days.
Jinhsi: We've both made it on time.
Jinhsi: Allow me to formally introduce myself. I am Jinhsi. It brings me great joy to see you, Rover.
[Dialogue Option]  Hello.
[Dialogue Option]  Why wait three days to meet me in person?
[Dialogue Option]  Did something happen?
[Dialogue Option]  I hope I'm not talking to another projection.
Jinhsi: To show up as a projection again would be ill-mannered of me. Please rest assured, it is a real human in the flesh you're speaking to. Despite Huanglong's advanced technology, such a realistic projection is still impossible.
Jinhsi: Or perhaps you would like to verify it?
Jinhsi smiles genuinely and offers her hand to you, radiating calmness and sincerity.
[Dialogue Option]  (Shake her hand.)

title: Clashing Blades
content:
Jinhsi smiles genuinely and offers her hand to you, radiating calmness and sincerity.
[Dialogue Option]  (Shake her hand.)



[Dialogue Option]  Are you injured?
Jinhsi: ...It is nothing to be concerned about.
Jinhsi: An emergency forced me to leave, and I only had the time to prepare some tokens for you. Please pardon my lack of hospitality.
[Dialogue Option]  Does that emergency have something to do with the Fractsidus?
[Dialogue Option]  Does that emergency have something to do with your Sentinel?
Jinhsi: ...Yes. The Sentinel of Jinzhou is currently absent.
[Dialogue Option]  Aren't they supposed to stay in their domains?
Jinhsi: Correct.
Jinhsi: The Sentinels guide and guard humanity as a symbol of our civilization.
Jinhsi: When a region's Sentinel goes absent, chaos is bound to ensue. As this news could lead to civil unrest, please keep it a secret.
Jinhsi: Jinzhou's Sentinel, "Jué," is being held captive by the Fractsidus. I had to postpone our meeting and put all my effort into finding its whereabouts.
[Dialogue Option]  I heard you can resonate with the Sentinel?
Jinhsi: Yes, our thoughts are connected to a certain degree. I can sense its memories, feelings, and surroundings, though not very clearly.
[Dialogue Option]  Have you found it yet?
Jinhsi: Unfortunately, I haven't. I can feel Jué is in danger. The good news is, I have figured out the culprit behind all of this.
[Dialogue Option]  Is it Scar?
Jinhsi: Precisely.
Jinhsi: The Fractsidus plans to advance another Lament and cause disasters worldwide.
Jinhsi: Overseer Scar had several objectives upon infiltrating Jinzhou.
Jinhsi: To track you down, to test your strengths, and to make you join their cause. To abduct Jué and to resurrect the Threnodian in advance.
[Dialogue Option]  Why me?
Jinhsi: They must have discovered your value, likely from one of Jué's prophecies. If you join them, they'll gain significant power.
Jinhsi: Should you refuse to join, the Fractsidus will likely want to eliminate you so you don't get in their way.
[Dialogue Option]  ...
Jinhsi: I have a plan to apprehend Scar. Once we capture him, the Fractsidus won't be that much of a threat to you for the time being.
Jinhsi: If you are willing to lend us a hand, I will ensure your safety during our cooperation.
[Dialogue Option]  Count me in.
Jinhsi: Thank you for your trust, Rover.
[Dialogue Option]  Can I have some time to think?
Jinhsi: Of course. Your decision is valued, Rover.
Jinhsi: Speaking of which, you seem to have already gathered a lot from the tokens.
[Dialogue Option]  The mangosteen points to how people lived through the wars in Jinzhou.
[Dialogue Option]  The sugar pearl points to past epidemics and disasters.
[Dialogue Option]  The leaf points to the Fractsidus.
[Dialogue Option]  The sundial points to when and where we are meeting.
Jinhsi: Impressive, Rover.
[Dialogue Option]  And I learned more about my identity as I deciphered the tokens.
Jinhsi: The threat Jinzhou is facing is far worse than meets the eye.
Jinhsi: One of the Threnodians will soon be reawakened...
[Dialogue Option]  What are the Threnodians?
Jinhsi: They are the enemies of human civilizations, born from the dark side of our collective consciousness. We must defeat them to protect all of humanity.
Jinhsi: We have been doing our best to prevent the disaster, but the Fractsidus is accelerating the Threnodian's revival.
[Dialogue Option]  And it has something to do with me, yes?
Jinhsi: Correct.
Jinhsi: You have defeated the Crownless and absorbed its Echo with your bare hands. It is the Tacet Discord that embodies the concept of warfare.
Jinhsi: —Resentment of the fallen, fright of the ignoble... Those are the emotions that laid grounds for its birth.
Jinhsi: The Crownless is a Tacet Discord that possesses powers from the reviving Threnodian.
Jinhsi: Jinzhou is a border city with an unbreakable will and strong spirit of resistance. However, we also fear the constant wars and loss of life, and the Threnodian can prey on that.
Jinhsi: You, however... You were able to defeat and absorb a Threnodian-related Tacet Discord with your bare hands, and resonate with other TDs.
Jinhsi: Meanwhile, Huanglong's records mention a hero with similar powers who saved our nation during the Threnodian War. He/She is also mentioned in literature dating back to Jinzhou's establishment.
Jinhsi: To uncover your true identity, this could be a helpful lead to pursue.
[Dialogue Option]  You believe that person and I could be related in some way?
Jinhsi: Yes. Based on my own deduction, and the prophecies of Jué.
[Dialogue Option]  Jué... In the Gorges of Spirits..
Jinhsi: You mean... The unfinished statue of Jué?
[Dialogue Option]  I remembered something when I saw it.
[Dialogue Option]  But I'm not sure if that really happened.
Jinhsi: I see. Do you mind letting me know what you remembered? Since it's related to our Sentinel, I might be able to help.
You told Jinhsi about all the bits and pieces of memories you could remember.
Jinhsi: Rover, the memories of which you speak...
[Dialogue Option]  Yes? Anything worth noting about them?
Jinhsi: As I mentioned earlier, I can resonate with Jué, our Sentinel. Your recollections... They align with what I've witnessed in Jué's memories.
Jinhsi: Yes, I do remember seeing something similar... I believe it had truly happened in the past.
[Dialogue Option]  In other words...
Jinhsi: In other words, you may be the person mentioned in our records.
Jinhsi: The unwavering presence by our Sentinel's side, bonded by unbreakable trust.
[Dialogue Option]  I don't reckon Resonators can live that long.
Jinhsi: Resonators tend to have a longer lifespan, but it is indeed unprecedented to live hundreds of years without any sign of aging.
Jinhsi: So many mysteries about you remain unsolved, and your age is just one of the unknowns.
[Dialogue Option]  If this is true, who was I all that time ago?
[Dialogue Option]  And how did I end up losing my memories?
Jinhsi: Sorry, but I don't know. Jué's last piece of information pointed to the Norfall Barrens, where you should find the Threnodian.
Jinhsi: I pray you will find your answers there.
Jinhsi: A Threnodian is resurrecting, and our nation is in grave danger. This reminds me of the Threnodian War all too much. Perhaps... This has something to do with your mysterious appearance near Jinzhou?
[Dialogue Option]  You mean I showed up to protect Jinzhou like the historical hero did?
Jinhsi: Not really. I don't plan to believe in a hero showing up out of nowhere and protecting us.
Jinhsi: I am just presenting whatever lead I have about your past, as I know it is troubling you. I want to help you, and that is all to it.
Jinhsi: Thank you for considering lending us a hand. Your help is much appreciated, but please do not feel obligated because of the information I shared.
Jinhsi: They are my people, and the responsibility to keep them safe should fall on no one else but my own shoulders.
Jinhsi: I am saying this because I have faith in my abilities, and even more so in the bravery of Jinzhou's soldiers and our people.
Jinhsi: You deserve to make your own decision about this after uncovering your true identity.
Jinhsi: I appreciate everything you've done for us, during the past few days, or perhaps even much longer ago.
Jinhsi: Once it all settles, I am ready to accommodate and assist in whatever future decision you make. You can leave Jinzhou, or the entire Huanglong if you wish.
Jinhsi: If you ever need me again, you need only ask.
Jinhsi: Let's keep this a secret between the two of us. How does that sound?
(Flashback ends.)

title: Clashing Blades
content:
Jinhsi: If you ever need me again, you need only ask.
Jinhsi: Let's keep this a secret between the two of us. How does that sound?
(Flashback ends.)



Jinhsi: Scar, you are now under arrest for committing multiple felonies in Huanglong. Do you have anything to say?
Scar: What do I want to say, huh? While I'd love to tell you another story... I guess that's not what you want to hear.
Scar: Let's cut to the chase, "Madam Magistrate". I'm getting bored already.
Jinhsi: Very well. You will answer only our questions from now on.
(Cutscene: Rover walks forward to stand in front of Scar.)
Scar: Sure, why not. What do you want to know?
[Dialogue Option]  Why did you kidnap Jué?
Scar: A Sentinel (Oracle Engine) such as Jué can predict and "correct" future events. It gets in our way of achieving our sublime vision.
Scar: We merely wanted to topple the set future built on lies, and take control of our own destiny.
[Dialogue Option]  Scar: Sure, why not. What do you want to know?
[Dialogue Option]  Why are you obsessed with reviving the Threnodian?
Scar: The Threnodians... They hold the key to our ideal.
Scar: Together they will bring us the promised "true Lament", and we will embrace the new world that is bound to come.
[Dialogue Option]  Scar: Sure, why not. What do you want to know?
[Dialogue Option]  What on earth is the Lament?
Scar: What is the Lament? Disaster? Curse? Some kind of punishment? Ha! People only see the surface...
Scar: The Lament brings death, destruction, and countless Reverberations.
Scar: Reverberations that will be reflected, overlapped, and interwoven during the Lament... They will be our salvation, the only path to a new lifeform and a new civilization.
[Dialogue Option]  Scar: Sure, why not. What do you want to know?
[Dialogue Option]  Why were you following me?
Scar: Our goal has always been the same... We want you. Need you to join us.
[Dialogue Option]  Why me?
Scar: Forces battle over you, causing all this strife, and yet you remain unaware of your own worth... Are you really that naive, or are you just dense?
Scar: But whatever. Our interest in you isn't affected by such trivial matters.
[Dialogue Option]  And if I say no?
Scar: Too bad. We will then be forced to kill you, by any means necessary...
Scar: But I'm sure you'll willingly come to us. When the time arrives.
[Dialogue Option]  Scar: Sure, why not. What do you want to know?
[Dialogue Option]  I'm done with him.
Jinhsi: You kidnapped Jué and revived the Threnodian, accelerating the next Lament... This is proof enough that you are the enemy of Jinzhou, and all humanity.
Jinhsi: Stop dreaming you can force Rover to join you. He/She is our honored guest, and I will not allow any harm to come his/her way.
Scar: Ha! How confident you sound. As the Threnodian's resurrection approaches, Jinzhou is barely holding on. How much longer do you think you can keep up this facade?
Jinhsi: Thank you for your concern. We have crushed your schemes once, and we can do it again.
Jinhsi: I have one last question for you. Abducting "Jué", stalking Rover, and setting up an ambush in Qichi Village... You couldn't have accomplished that all on your own.
Jinhsi: Unless...
Scar: Unless I'm not the only Overseer in Jinzhou, right? Hahaha....
Scar: I have answered all your questions with full honesty. I don't mind you knowing, because it won't make any difference.
Scar: You can try to stop us with all you have... But it's too late to change the course of history.
Scar: Now, I have one question for you...
Scar: You seem convinced we caused the disappearance of Jué... What if I told you there was more to it? Would you be curious?
Jinhsi: About Jué... What else do you know?
Scar: Come closer and I'll tell you, Madam Magistrate... It's a secret for your ears only...
Sanhua: How dare you! Madam Magistrate, I...
(Cutscene: Jinhsi nods to Sanhua, then walks up to Scar. He whispers something to her.)
Jinhsi: No, it can't be...
(Cutscene: Jinhsi quickly steps back.)
Scar: Shocked, aren't you? But there's more...
Scar: What if I told you... Your Sentinel had made this prophecy a long, long time ago?
Scar: Your all-seeing Sentinel abandons you now of all times. Need I say more?
Scar: We're merely adding a touch of extra fuel to the fire that will soon consume all.
Scar: Rover, care for a wager? I know you've been searching for answers about your past, and I've got news for you—
(Cutscene: Scar grins and summons a card to his hand.)
Sanhua: Watch out!
(Cutscene: Sanhua tries to block the card with ice spikes. The card slips between them.)
Scar: You are one of us, the "black lambs", and you have been chosen to join us ushering in the new world...
Scar: Once you discover what you really are, you will come to us with no hesitation.
Scar: The Fractsidus awaits your arrival with open arms.
Scar: And I look forward to that day in sincere anticipation...
(Cutscene: The card lands near Rover's feet, getting stuck in the floor. Sanhua rushes forward.)
Scar: Hehehehehe.... AHAHAHAHAHA!
Scar is put in jail...

title: Clashing Blades
content:
Scar: Hehehehehe.... AHAHAHAHAHA!
Scar is put in jail...



Jinhsi: ...
[Dialogue Option]  What did Scar tell you?
Jinhsi: ...Sorry, Rover. What he mentioned about our Sentinel is... highly sensitive. I cannot disclose it yet, not before verifying it myself.
Jinhsi: Is it a ploy to create distrust among us, or... I must first find our Sentinel to uncover the truth.
[Dialogue Option]  How important is Jué to Jinzhou?
Jinhsi: Jué is the Guardian Sentinel of Jinzhou. It is responsible of assisting Jinzhou's Magistrate in administrative affairs.
Jinhsi: While I am the final decision maker... Without the assistance of Jué, I cannot guarantee I'm always making the best choices for my people.
[Dialogue Option]  You seem to be doing well enough on your own.
Jinhsi: T-Thank you. I am glad you think so.
[Dialogue Option]  Why are you so sure Jué is always right?
Jinhsi: Jué can predict the future, and up to this point, every one of its prophecies have been proven true.
Jinhsi: While justice may not be universally agreed upon, its decisions have consistently served the best interests of Huanglong.
[Dialogue Option]  Perhaps it left to set Jinzhou's future right.
[Dialogue Option]  Perhaps it intended to let you make your own decisions.
Jinhsi: For that... I suppose we will have to talk to it in person to find out.
Jinhsi: In addition, Rover, Jué once told me to deliver a message to you.
Jinhsi: "To the Awakened One: When raindrops fall upstream, please head to the Norfall Barrens, and seek General Jiyan of the Midnight Rangers."
[Dialogue Option]  So I'll need to find this General Jiyan?
[Dialogue Option]  So I'll need to go to the Norfall Barrens?
Jinhsi: I suppose so. General Jiyan is currently battling another TD Outbreak in the Norfall Barrens, which will also serve as our frontline against the Threnodian.
Jinhsi: But the ongoing war has made it a very dangerous place to go.
Jinhsi: Since you won't need to go there right now, not until when the "raindrops fall upstream"...
Jinhsi: I know you're here for clues about your true identity, and I don't want you to leave the city empty-handed.
Jinhsi: Have you heard about the Black Shores, Rover?
Jinhsi: It's an organization shrouded in mystery, with a secretive membership process and members who usually keep their identities hidden.
Jinhsi: Upon your awakening, one of their members discreetly contacted me to gather information about you.
Jinhsi: But please don't worry. The Black Shores developed a special Lament prediction system, and has established partnerships with countries worldwide.
Jinhsi: While operating in secrecy, they are not an extremist group like the Fractsidus.
Jinhsi: They have been monitoring the situation in Jinzhou to provide assistance when needed.
Jinhsi: Thanks to their extra help, my meeting with you went smoothly.
Jinhsi: This Blake Bloom is their symbol. The Black Shores members usually wear it on their person.
[Dialogue Option]  What do they want to achieve in Jinzhou?
Jinhsi: The Black Shores once provided us significant insights into the relationship between the moon and Threnodians.
Jinhsi: This time, they've come to inform us a Threnodian is about to resurrect near Jinzhou.
Jinhsi: Apart from that, I am not sure what else they may be hoping to achieve.
[Dialogue Option]  There sure are a lot of people keeping an eye on me.
Jinhsi: Rover, after the recent series of events, I trust you have gained a general idea of who you might have been.
Jinhsi: Before you fell into that deep slumber, you likely played a significant role in important historical events, shaping the course of history in some way.
Jinhsi: Ultimately... I suppose it is up to you to discover the final definitive answer for yourself.
[Dialogue Option]  Wouldn't that make them easy to spot?
Jinhsi: Yes, I suppose it does make them stand out. On the other hand, they presumably possess extraordinary abilities to stay anonymous.
Jinhsi: This photo is yours to keep. I will return with Jué shortly, and the Black Shores may be worth your try during this time.
(Cutscene: )
Jinhsi: Rover! Are you all right?
[Dialogue Option]  I saw something... I was wearing the Blake Bloom...
Jinhsi: I see... The Black Shores must have a deep connection to your past.
Jinhsi: Since you are likely being closely monitored by the Fractsidus now...
Jinhsi: I suggest keeping an eye out for the Black Shore members. They could prove to be your valuable allies.
Jinhsi: I'll do my best to find Jué, and tell you everything I learned from it once I return.
Jinhsi: This is my promise.
[Dialogue Option]  I'm counting on you.
Jinhsi: Yes. Please leave it to me.
(Cutscene: Rover walks out.)

title: Clashing Blades
content:
Jinhsi: This is my promise.
[Dialogue Option]  I'm counting on you.
Jinhsi: Yes. Please leave it to me.
(Cutscene: Rover walks out.)



Jinhsi: Sanhua.
Sanhua: Yes, Madam Magistrate.
Jinhsi: I will be going on a temporary leave. During my absence, please help me handle my responsibilities in Jinzhou.
Sanhua: Understood. Should I continue protecting that Rover?
Jinhsi: No need. Both Changli and I will be away, and there'll be more paperwork for you to handle.
Sanhua: Is Lady Changli leaving for the capital?
Sanhua: Please pardon my intrusion, but he/she just faced an ambush in the Central Plains. What if...
Jinhsi: Regarding that incident... We tried to warn him/her about the Fractsidus, but they were more cunning than we thought.
Jinhsi: If he/she runs into another powerful enemy like Scar, he/she'll eventually have to confront them on his/her own.
Jinhsi: Sanhua, you can place more trust in Rover and me.
Sanhua: Understood. I will.
Sanhua: My lady... No matter what happens, my sword is always yours.
(Cutscene: Sanhua leaves. Jinhsi's terminal rings. She picks up the call.)
Jinhsi: Both the interrogation and my appointed meeting with Rover have already finished.
???: Scar only needed the two of you as his audience. We already knew what he wanted, and we let him have as much.
Jinhsi: He/she decrypted every message we intended to convey. It's only proper you meet him/her in person, as the one who crafted those puzzles.
Jinhsi: Such intricate puzzles... I guess only Rover has the patience to solve them all.
???: No detail is too small. I'm sure he/she understands. Besides... Not seeing the opponent heightens the thrill of the game.
???: If everything goes according to the prophecies of Jué, I will meet him/her in person eventually.
???: So... What did our captive from the Fractsidus tell you about Jué?
Jinhsi: ...That Jué had predicted I will have to fight it one day. A fight that will shape Jinzhou's future.
???: Well, that is... unexpected. But you don't seem all that surprised, do you?
Jinhsi: Can't say I am. I had suspected as much from our previous conversations, and the message it left me... His words only confirmed it.
???: Where was it when you last sensed its presence?
Jinhsi: It was... In Mt. Firmament. Unlike Jinzhou city, that mountain is still resting in "stillness".
???: The place where the first people of Jinzhou lived, and where Jué first manifested before us humans... I see.
Jinhsi: I'll find Jué and bring it back as soon as possible.
???: Our enemies could have planned it as a trap. We have a bigger goal to focus on, remember?
Jinhsi: I understand. I will not let anything or anyone disrupt the peace in Jinzhou.
???: Would you let what you heard from Scar sway your determination?
Jinhsi: No, he cannot ever turn me against Jué. If anything, his words only confirmed my theory.
Jinhsi: I am the Magistrate of Jinzhou, appointed by the Sentinel itself.
Jinhsi: The prophecy speaks of a decisive incident for Jinzhou's future, where I will be a key player. The fight between me and Jué is only a precursor.
Jinhsi: My job remains unchanged. I will fulfill my duty as Jinzhou's Magistrate with my own judgment.
???: And that's your final answer?
Jinhsi: A single strand's neglect births mountainous upheaval. You taught me that, remember?
Jinhsi: The safest option is for me to go in person.
Changli: ...Very well.
Changli: Since we are already mid-game, I will let you decide our next move.
Changli: This time, I shall be a pawn in your hand.
Changli: Remember I will always stand by your side, in this crisis or any other.
(Cutscene: The call ends.)
Jinhsi: ...Am I a player or a mere pawn? I suppose there is no difference at this point.
Jinhsi: No matter what, I will do what I must.

title: Rewinding Raindrops
content: Quest Objective: The previous puzzle's answers has been revealed, but it only leads to another one. With a storm on the horizon, you follow the Magistrate's advice and search for clues about "the Black Shores".

title: Rewinding Raindrops
content:
Yangyang: ...I see.
Yangyang: Yes... I can feel the tension in the Streams.
Yangyang: I'm worried something bad is going to happen...
Chixia: There you are, Rover!
[Dialogue Option]  Sorry for keeping you waiting.
[Dialogue Option]  Did something happen?
Baizhi: The Academy has noted a concerning rise of Tacet Field activities. Please use caution when exiting the city.
[Dialogue Option]  Thanks for the warning.
[Dialogue Option]  How's your research going?
Baizhi: Remember to check your Terminal signals, and wear the Academy's protective suit correctly.
Baizhi: ...And don't forget to stay hydrated. Now, I have experiments to run. Take care.
[Dialogue Option]  Was that a voicemail message...
[Dialogue Option]  Is she sending the same thing to everyone...
Chixia: It's just Baizhi being Baizhi. She's a little awkward with showing care, but I think it's cute!
Chixia: Anyway! Rover, quick, tell us what happened!
After a brief moment of thinking, you gave them a brief run down of your meeting with Jinhsi, but didn't mention Jué's disappearance...
Chixia: The Fractsidus again? Ugh, those jerks!
[Dialogue Option]  About Jiyan...
Rover: Jiyan the General, Jinhsi the Magistrate, and Jué, Jinzhou's Sentinel... Is there any kind of connection between them?
Chixia: Connection? ...No idea, but I did hear General Jiyan used to be a military doctor...
Yangyang: Hmm... Speaking of that, I think we'll need to start with a bit of Jinzhou's past.
Yangyang: A storyteller near the theater once told us something like this...

title: Rewinding Raindrops
content:
[Objective: (Cutscene plays)]
Narrator: The honorable Madam Jinhsi, our great magistrate of Jinzhou, was handpicked by Sentinel Jué. Her status as the Sentinel's Appointed Resonator is rare among all past magistrates.
Narrator: Our Jinzhou was leaderless for years until Jué finally chose her to be the next Magistrate, and she answered the call.
Narrator: To further elaborate, we must start with the "Battle Beneath the Crescent".
Narrator: The Norfall Barrens, scarred by countless wars... Discarded weapons scattered like bones.
Narrator: Our soldiers had fought to reclaim the lands for years, to no avail.
Narrator: Ovathrax, the dreadful Threnodian monster, fed on the frequencies of "weapons" turning our fallen soldiers into deadly Tacet Discords...
Narrator: General of the Midnight Rangers, Geshu Lin, bravely rose to confront the threat.
Narrator: As twin moons aligned, General Geshu Lin vowed to vanquish evil, raising his blade against the blood-red crescent that foretold destruction.
Narrator: His sword blazed with black flames, laying waste to all who dared stand in his way. Victory seemed certain...
Narrator: ...Until the Retroact Rain began to fall.
Narrator: Raindrops fell upwards as in the past. Monsters raged, loyal souls fell to blood-soaked sands... Infernal carnage!
Narrator: Issuing his last command, Geshu Lin demanded all soldiers stand firm, no matter what happened.
Narrator: Sacrificing his body to the black flames for power, Geshu Lin charged at the Overthrax with all his might... And he was never seen again.
Narrator: After the fall of their leader, the remaining soldiers despaired... Until a deafening roar of the Qingloong (Teal Dragon) struck like lightning. A lone youth bravely stood up to lead. A hard-won retreat!
Narrator: After the battle, that young man who tamed the wind ascended to fame, becoming the new General of Midnight Rangers, selected by Sentinel Jué.
Narrator: On the other hand, General Geshu was blamed for massive losses that occurred under his command, earning him a notorious reputation in Huanglong...
Narrator: That battle struck us hard, but our Sentinel rose from its long slumber to select a new Magistrate who guide us into the future.
Narrator: Despite the previous disaster, Jinzhou was off to a promising start under our Sentinel and the new Magistrate's guidance. The people held hope for a better tomorrow.

title: Rewinding Raindrops
content:
Chixia: Woah. First time hearing about all that...
[Dialogue Option]  Why did Jué choose Jinhsi to be Magistrate?
Chixia: Uhhh... Maybe the Sentinel had its own special ways of picking candidates?
Yangyang: Or maybe it is their incomprehensible ways that set these divine beings apart from us? Their thinking tends to be elusive to the average person.
Chixia: Yeah, true. Wouldn't be surprised if Jué decided to make me the Magistrate one day, not gonna lie!
[Dialogue Option]  Does it ever ask the opinion of the person selected?
Yangyang: I understand your concern, Rover.
Yangyang: Madam Jinhsi was only a teenager, and she was suddenly selected to be the Magistrate. It must have been so difficult for her...
Yangyang: I remember people were skeptical when she first took office.
Yangyang: Despite her achievements, many believed she lacked the necessary experience and authority in the political realm.
Yangyang: People only showed their respect to Madam Jinhsi because they trusted Jué's judgement.
Chixia: Seriously, Lord Jué knows how to choose 'em. Our previous Magistrates were all top-notch at running the show.
Chixia: And Madam Jinhsi? She's already made this city a well-oiled machine in no time.
Chixia: I'd have a mental Overclock just trying to keep up with all that paperwork... She was made for this!
Chixia: Uh, what is that saying again? Real gold never loses its shine!
Yangyang: Rover, since you are asking about this... Did you get clues about your past from Jinhsi?
[Dialogue Option]  Jué asked me to find Jiyan in the Norfall Barrens at a specific time.
Chixia: The Norfall Barrens?! It's been a battlefield since ancient times...
Yangyang: Rover, it's dangerous there. The Norfall Barrens is the frontline in our defense against the Threnodian. We must be careful about going there.
[Dialogue Option]  There's another "Overseer" of the Fractsidus lurking in Jinzhou.
Yangyang: They sent two Overseers at once... Their scheme must be far more expansive than we thought.
Yangyang: Though the Fractsidus do seem to know a lot about you... Their ideology and actions are too dangerous.
Yangyang: And right now, the odds are in their favor. if we rush into a confrontation, it could lead us into their traps.
[Dialogue Option]  An organization called the Black Shores has been watching me.
Chixia: The Black Shores? Doesn't ring a bell... Sounds like a name of a place, but I've never seen it on any map.
Yangyang: This flower... It's only a photo, and I can't tell where it came from with my ability.
[Dialogue Option]  The Black Shores is an organization that studies the Lament.
[Dialogue Option]  Every Black Shores member wears a flower like this.
Yangyang: Hmm... We're still in the dark about Fractsidus' plans, and the Norfall Barrens is too risky. The Black Shores seems to be our only option now.
Yangyang: But if we are to look for them with only a photo of this flower... It's going to be difficult.
Chixia: Since it's about flowers... We should go ask Grandma Lin!
Yangyang: Yes! Grandma Lin runs a flower shop. I'm sure she can give us some tips.
Chixia: Hehe... You're making me blush a litte.
Chixia: Grandma Lin loves listening to storytellers. I think I saw her earlier... Let's go look for her.

title: Rewinding Raindrops
content:
[Objective: (Optional - Talk to Storyteller)]
Storyteller: There is still some time before the next session. Here are some book to keep you entertained before that, dear listeners.
[Dialogue Option]  (Ask him about the "Battle Beneath the Crescent".)
Storyteller: So you want to learn more about that battle?
Storyteller: They say that storytelling inevitably carries some subjective bias, all to enhance the ebb and flow of the narrative.
Storyteller: But when it comes to the "Battle Beneath the Crescent," we typically avoid adding any of our personal commentary, focusing instead on accurately retelling history.
Storyteller: But even just telling the story carries a heavy emotional weight.
Storyteller: Was Geshu Lin truly an unforgivable sinner? Was General Jiyan the perfect hero?
Storyteller: The sudden onset of the Retroact Rain, the decision of our Sentinel, and the timing behind this series of events...
Storyteller: I guess it will be up to future generations to figure it all out, haha.

title: Rewinding Raindrops
content:
[Objective: (Optional - Talk to Elder Listener)]
Elder Listener: Tough break... It's just plain bad luck.
[Dialogue Option]  (Ask him about the "Battle Beneath the Crescent".)
Elder Listener: So you want to learn more about that battle? Not many youngsters care these days! I'm happy to talk about it with you!
Elder Listener: People blamed Geshu Lin for his decision to push for an attack during the Retroact Rain.
Elder Listener: But he's ultimately jut a human like the rest of us. Him having a powerful Resonance Ability doesn't change that.
Elder Listener: Fate can be a funny thing... Nobody could've predicted that weird rain happening.
Elder Listener: If our soldiers hadn't held onto the defense lines in the Norfall Barrens to the last minute, Jinzhou might have fallen too.
Elder Listener: Anyone, even someone like me, would've probably given a similar order in that situation.
Elder Listener: So I don't think Geshu Lin should be painted as an unforgivable criminal.
Elder Listener: General Jiyan is a capable leader no doubt, but let's be real, he only rose to fame for showing up at the right time.
Elder Listener: Sigh, that's just how fate works sometimes...

title: Rewinding Raindrops
content:
[Objective: (Optional - Talk to Middle-aged Listener)]
Middle-aged Listener: Maybe he's got his own personality to blame...
[Dialogue Option]  (Ask him about the "Battle Beneath the Crescent".)
Middle-aged Listener: Oh? You want my take on it?

Young Listener: We were all confident and determined to defeat the Threnodian (Ovathrax) before. But after that crushing defeat, everyone's confidence took a hit.
Young Listener: We still wanted to win, to eliminate that dreadful monster once and for all, but... we became more cautious.
Young Listener: Interestingly, the newly appointed General and Magistrate both seem to be the calm and cautious type.
Young Listener: Perhaps the Sentinel chooses our leaders based on the public consensus at the time.

Aalto: Haha! I knew you'd be into this like I am! But stories aside, we do have an important mission on our hands.
[Dialogue Option]  I'm leaving now...
Aalto: Wait, don't go! We really do have an important mission on our hands!
Aalto: I suppose the Magistrate of Jinzhou has already told you what we do.
Aalto: We've set up Resonance Beacons worldwide to monitor the Lament, collecting data in real-time. This is how we predict when the next Lament is happening.
Aalto: As the saying goes, one miss is as good as a mile. Every single one of the Resonance Beacons is crucial.
Aalto: After the Court of Savantae researchers disappeared, all of our Resonance Beacons near the facilities were damaged to varying degrees.
Aalto: Recently, something went wrong with our Lament detection system, and we suspected it had something to do with a damaged Beacon around the area.
Aalto: That's why we've been sent here, to investigate the case.
Aalto: While our main goal is to retrieve the lost Resonance Beacon, we also might find some treasures.
Encore: Aalto, even Encore can tell what you're up to...
Aalto: It's called seize the opportunity while I can! You're just too young to get it! Come on, let's go!

title: Rewinding Raindrops
content:
Aalto: It's called seize the opportunity while I can! You're just too young to get it! Come on, let's go!



Aalto: Huh? Is my TD Detector working? How come it didn't warn us of so many Tacet Discords ahead?
Encore: Cause they all just appeared outta nowhere!
Aalto: That's weird... Anyway, let's deal with them.

title: Rewinding Raindrops
subsection: (As player reaches the nearby Resonance Beacon)
content:
[Objective: (As player reaches the nearby Resonance Beacon)]
Aalto: This is the place.
Aalto: Ugh, those savants really love their puzzles, don't they...
Aalto: No wonder folks never managed to get inside after all these years. Their security is top-notch.
Encore: That's because Aalto set off the security alarm! And now the gate's closed, hmph!
Aalto: Ahem... Anyway! We've got to figure out how to open it up again.

metadata.subsection: (As player reaches the nearby Resonance Beacon)

title: Rewinding Raindrops
subsection: (Talking to Aalto before entering the Court of Savantae Facility)
content:
[Objective: (Talking to Aalto before entering the Court of Savantae Facility)]
Aalto: It looks like a sundial, don't you think?
Aalto: Maybe if we spin the dials to align every pointer in the same direction...

metadata.subsection: (Talking to Aalto before entering the Court of Savantae Facility)

title: Rewinding Raindrops
subsection: (Talking to Aalto before entering the Court of Savantae Facility)
content:
Aalto: It looks like a sundial, don't you think?
Aalto: Maybe if we spin the dials to align every pointer in the same direction...



Aalto: This is... No wonder...
Aalto: Those crazy savants... They were trying to recreate the Retroact Rain...
Aalto: Never thought they could pull off something like this... Incredible...
[Dialogue Option]  What on earth is the Retroact Rain?
Aalto: The Retroact Rain is essentially a form of condensed Remnant Energy from the Etheric Sea.
Aalto: Various events across space and time from every dimension are recorded in the form of Remnant Energy. The Retroact Rain conjures illusions of past events for those exposed to it.
Aalto: That rain curtain we saw earlier was probably the results of their experiments.
Aalto: Before the Retroact Rain forms, it goes through three stages. In the first stage, it looks just like any regular rain.
Aalto: And what we're seeing now should be the second stage: Water droplets floating in midair, being absolutely still.
Aalto: I've heard of plenty independent studies on the Retroact Rain.
Aalto: Most of the researchers were driven by their obsessions. Some wanted to relive a particular experience, while others yearned to reunite with their loved ones...
Aalto: But look at all these devices here... The sheer scale of this research is really something.
Aalto: It really makes one wonder... What on earth were they trying to bring back with such a massive Retroact Rain?

metadata.subsection: (Talking to Aalto before entering the Court of Savantae Facility)

title: Rewinding Raindrops
subsection: (Talking to Aalto before entering the Court of Savantae Facility)
content:
Aalto: It really makes one wonder... What on earth were they trying to bring back with such a massive Retroact Rain?



Aalto: The power system here might still work... Let's split up and find it.
Encore: Hurray! Woolies, thataway!

metadata.subsection: (Talking to Aalto before entering the Court of Savantae Facility)

title: Rewinding Raindrops
content:
[Objective: (Talk to Aalto in the lobby)]
Aalto: Cystal potion, glass barometer, instant noodles, packets of nuts... Hmm, nothing too fancy...
Aalto: Oh wow! A game card that went out of sale decades ago! Aha, lucky me!
Aalto: Hey, Rover. How's it going on your end? Found anything good? I've collected some things, but not much.
Aalto: It didn't take us long to solve that puzzle mechanic, thank to your help.
[Dialogue Option]  Brute force works wonders.
Aalto: Haha... You didn't seem to be brute-forcing it, though. Do you happen to know someone from the Court of Savantae?
[Dialogue Option]  I saw something similar before.
Aalto: Oh? Do you happen to know someone from the Court of Savantae?
Aalto: I'm really looking forward to making more deals with you.

title: Rewinding Raindrops
subsection: (Talk to Encore near the induction cell)
content:
[Objective: (Talk to Encore near the induction cell)]
Encore: Cosmos! Cloudy! You saw anything fun?
Cosmos (Encore): Reporting in! Cosmos saw nothing!
Cloudy (Encore): Cloudy saw nothing either, Baa.
Encore: What?! Go! Go look again!

metadata.subsection: (Talk to Encore near the induction cell)

title: Rewinding Raindrops
content:
[Objective: (Investigate the hologram researchers)]
Hologram of a Male Researcher: That Fractsidus Overseer has been really generous with his sponsorship... It would have taken us much longer to build this place without him.
Hologram of a Male Researcher: Though he loves to meddle with our experiments a bit too much... Well, he's our patron, can't do anything about that.
Hologram of a Male Researcher: This lab's location is a bit too remote for me, but I'm okay with it as long as we can keep doing our research.
Hologram of a Female Researcher: Yeah... Where else could us "maniacs" possibly go?
Hologram of a Male Researcher: The Committee kicked us out like trash... They'll never understand...
Hologram of a Male Researcher: As Professor Heisen stated, we are embarking on a monumental endeavor with the power to redefine humanity's future.
Hologram of a Male Researcher: This time, we will make the "divine miracle" we saw happen again for all of humanity to behold!

title: Rewinding Raindrops
subsection: (Investigate the hologram researcher on the side of the room)
content:
[Objective: (Investigate the hologram researcher on the side of the room)]
Hologram of a Male Researcher: The experiments have been going smoothly, but we still can't get the desired outcome... Why?
Hologram of a Male Researcher: The "Artificial Retroactive Rain" project has advanced to its second phase... We have various evidence that this ancient civilization was the Whining Aix's Mire at some point.
Hologram of a Male Researcher: We believed we could recreate that "divine miracle" with the artificial Retroact Rain... have we been mistaken?
Hologram of a Male Researcher: We have no time left. The "Artificial Controllable Tacet Field" should be complete by now... We'll have to rely on our backup plan.

metadata.subsection: (Investigate the hologram researcher on the side of the room)

title: Rewinding Raindrops
subsection: (Investigate the hologram researchers in the room with the chest puzzle)
content:
[Objective: (Investigate the hologram researchers in the room with the chest puzzle)]
Hologram of a Male Researcher: How's Subject A038 doing lately?
Hologram of a Female Researcher: It has yet to assume a concrete form or exhibit vocalization behavior. In most cases, it remains motionless.
Hologram of a Female Researcher: However, we've noticed some behavior discrepancies from our initial expectations, and further observation and research would be necessary.
Hologram of a Male Researcher: It's merely a "replica", after all. It's far from the true form of those "god"...
Hologram of a Male Researcher: By the way, things have been mysteriously disappearing lately. Any idea?
Hologram of a Female Researcher: You noticed it too? Thought I was imagining things... And there's weird noises at the lab late at night.
Hologram of a Female Researcher: I suspect it has something to do with Subject A038... Lately its frequencies have always signs of "hunger".
Hologram of a Female Researcher: But it's been under strict surveillance. That couldn't possibly be A038... Right?
Hologram of a Male Researcher: ...I'll go check the security cameras once more.
Hologram of a Male Researcher: Let's increase its rations. We can't afford to let it go hungry.
Hologram of a Male Researcher: After all, it's our last hope now...

metadata.subsection: (Investigate the hologram researchers in the room with the chest puzzle)

title: Rewinding Raindrops
content:
[Objective: (Enter the last room)]
Aalto: Now, this is the last room...
Encore: Aalto, Rover! Encore spotted something!

title: Rewinding Raindrops
content:
Elder Male Voice: ...It's getting closer. These will be my final words, haha... If only I had more time...
Elder Male Voice: I thought my enemies were misconceptions, waning passion, and my own ignorance.
Elder Male Voice: Only in the end I did realize... time is my ultimate foe.
Elder Male Voice: I became blindsided by my fear of death and insatiable thirst for truth, eventually derailing our research...
Elder Male Voice: It was too late when I finally came back to my senses... We... We had already walked into that false "Gate"...
Elder Male Voice: Now, I'm leaving my last realization behind...
Elder Male Voice: They are our "past"... but they are also our "future"... Had I realized it sooner, there might have been a chance to get things back on track...
Elder Male Voice: The future being hailing from our past... Please save us.. once again...
Elder Male Voice: Please, keep pushing forward... until you reach... the real Gate that can change the world...
Blurry Female Hologram: ...
Encore: Wow... She's so pretty...
Aalto: Rover, about this person...
[Dialogue Option]  I think I know her...
[Dialogue Option]  But I can't remember why...
Aalto: Heh, knew it...
Aalto: Great, now that power's been restored, that elevator should work.
Aalto: The Beacon's signal is coming from below. Let's go.

title: Rewinding Raindrops
content:
Aalto: Great, now that power's been restored, that elevator should work.
Aalto: The Beacon's signal is coming from below. Let's go.



Encore: Wow! A big clunky monster!
Aalto: Damn... Those savants never run out of new surprises for us...
Aalto: The signal's coming from it. Did it swallow our Resonance Beacon?

title: Rewinding Raindrops
content:
[Objective: (Cutscene plays) (Cutscene ends)]
Aalto: Looks like peace isn't an option. Guys, brace yourself. We'll need to take it down!
Encore: Aalto, we doing it like we usually do?
Aalto: Of course.
Encore: Hehe, then this big guy is Encore's to tackle!
Encore: Cosmos, Cloudy, ATTACK!
Aalto: Let me figure out its weakness...
Aalto: I see! It's cobbled together from these metal parts!
Aalto: We should target its joints, use the fallen parts to counter its attacks and destroy its unstable structure.

title: Rewinding Raindrops
content:
Aalto: We should target its joints, use the fallen parts to counter its attacks and destroy its unstable structure.



Aalto: Phew, job done!
Encore: Hehe, Encore is strong! Told ya!
Encore: But why did they keep that big guy here?
Aalto: According to our findings earlier, researchers who worked here were probably only a small fraction of the Court of Savantae Committee.
Aalto: They were likely studying an ancient civilization they deemed to be "divine beings", but later got denounced from the CSC due to their extreme methods.
Aalto: Somehow, they believed this ancient civilization had once visited the Mire, which led to their attempts at recreating those past events with artificial Retroact Rain.
Aalto: And when they failed to recreate the Retroact Rain, they resorted to making a "replica" of the lost civilization instead.
Aalto: To get their desired results faster, they started feeding this "replica" various frequencies, datasets, and mechanical constructs...
Aalto: And we've seen what that ended up with. It turned into a monster driven by the frequencies of "hunger," devouring everything in its path.
Aalto: It was probably the culprit behind the disappearance of those folks.
Aalto: And, I suspect, the Fractsidus Overseer mentioned in that log may have something to do with it all.
Aalto: Those researchers... They were too obsessed with validating the "divine miracle", they eventually got lured in by that monster's frequencies of hunger and willingly walked into its maw...
Aalto: The monster devoured them, but not with its teeth... Their own delusions and fear were their undoing in the end.
Aalto: What a crazy bunch...
Aalto: So Rover, now it's time for me to fulfill my promise.
Aalto: What do you want to know about the Black Shores?
[Dialogue Option]  What on earth does the Black Shores do?
Aalto: As you already know, we monitor and research the Lament, and we've got Resonance Beacons set up in every nation worldwide.
Aalto: The island our headquarters are built on is in fact a massive piece of Tacetite ore, which powers our various energy-intensive operations.
Aalto: This Blake Bloom is a product of that overflowing energy on the island.
Aalto: Our island is located in the perfect spot to accurately monitor the Lament, ensuring precise predictions.
Aalto: ...That being said, the Lament's behavior is constantly changing and we are still studying to understand its true nature.
Aalto: All we can do for now is to observe the Lament, study its patterns, and provide early warnings to countries worldwide.
[Dialogue Option]  Have you been stalking me?
Aalto: Alright, alright, no more beating around the bush. Yeah, we've had our eyes on you, but please trust me, we don't mean anything bad.
Aalto: We just wanted to make sure you're a dependable ally.
Aalto: The Black Shores members all work together to save the world from the Lament crisis. We've got talents from all walks of life, including skilled hackers, explosive experts, and even Fengshui masters... You name it, we have it.
Aalto: We like your skills and methods. So, what do you say? Ready to jump on board?
[Dialogue Option]  Do you know a person named Camellya?
Aalto: Camellya? Course we do!
Aalto: Yeah, she can be kinda unhinged, but she's indeed one of ours.
Aalto: Just so you know, she only took up this mission because of you! Quite the charmer, aren't you?
[Dialogue Option]  So she wasn't lying.
Aalto: So you've met her already? Nice, saves me time introducing.
[Dialogue Option]  She almost killed me!
Aalto: I know she can be a bit too... straightforward, in how she expresses herself, but... Don't worry. She won't do anything bad to you, really.
[Dialogue Option]  What are you doing in Jinzhou?
Aalto: We just received a warning from our Lament detection system. Another Threnodian is about to revive near Jinzhou city.
Aalto: So we came here to inform Jinzhou's Magistrate about it.
[Dialogue Option]  Another?
[Dialogue Option]  Did similar things happen in the past?
Aalto: Yes. Entire countries had been destroyed... We're not letting such tragedies happen again...
[Dialogue Option]  What is the relationship between me and the Black Shores?
Aalto: I'm just an insignificant Consultant at the Black Shores, so I don't know that much about all its hidden secrets.
Aalto: But I believe the piece of intel I'm about to share with you will make this trip worth your effort.
Aalto: This is not the first time you've been reawakened. Last time... You woke up at the Black Shores.
Aalto: Rover, we share the same goal.
Aalto: We're both aiming to fight against the Threnodians and prevent the Lament crisis.
Encore: Yep! Encore can prove it! The Threnodian is a bad, bad guy, and Encore and Aalto are the heroes of justice, so we're gonna stop the bad guys!
Aalto: I understand. Trust isn't something you can afford to give out that easily.
Aalto: Remember the Blake Bloom I gave you earlier?
Aalto: It is more than just a symbol. It also holds the key to our headquarters. I'm sure it will come in handy for you.
Aalto: Phew! Anyway, mission accomplished! We've got the Resonance Beacon secured, plus a sweet bonus of Court of Savantae's big secrets!
Aalto: Glad I got you on board, Rover. Looking forward to our future collaborations.
Aalto: Oops, almost forgot! Gotta check that Resonance Beacon again, just in case.
Aalto: Wait... This is...
Aalto: No, it can't be...
Encore: Hey, Aalto! WAAITT!

title: Rewinding Raindrops
content:
Aalto: Wait... This is...
Aalto: No, it can't be...
Encore: Hey, Aalto! WAAITT!



Encore: Encore heard lightning! When there's lightning, it's gonna rain, and when it's gonna rain, Encore should bring an umbrella...
Encore: ...Uh, no, no no no... Aalto said when it rains like this, we hide!
[Dialogue Option]  It's just ordinary rain, isn't it?
[Dialogue Option]  Is this part of the Court of Savantae's experiment?
Aalto: No... This is...
Aalto: ...It's the real Retroact Rain.
Yangyang (Contacting): Rover, Jinzhou...
Yangyang (Contacting): Jinzhou is under attack! It's a TD outbreak!

title: Rewinding Raindrops
content:
[Objective: (Quest complete)]

The Retroact Rain is falling. Dark clouds are gathering above Desorock Highland...
Jiyan: This rain... It's finally happening.
Midnight Ranger: General.
Jiyan: Yes. How's it going?
Midnight Ranger: We have five hundred remaining soldiers prepared and medically cleared for combat. After receiving the antidote for Retroact Rain, they have reported minimal hallucinations and no adverse effects.
Midnight Ranger: However, a few veterans still reported sporadic sightings of Phantoms in the rain...
Jiyan: I see. Stay alert, we will continue as planned. Report any signs of potential TD Outbreaks immediately.
Jiyan: We march on to the Norfall Barrens as soon as the rain stops.
Midnight Ranger: Aye, sir!

title: Rewinding Raindrops
content:
Jiyan: We march on to the Norfall Barrens as soon as the rain stops.
Midnight Ranger: Aye, sir!



Jiyan: "Stronger emotional connection to the affected area leads to more intense hallucinations"... That's what they said.
Jiyan: I should go for another round of inspection. Make sure everything is going as planned.
