title: Grand Warstorm
subsection: (Talk to the Midnight Rangers near the crates to the left)
content:
[Objective: (Talk to the Midnight Rangers near the crates to the left)]
Prepared Midnight Ranger: How's the weapons?
Midnight Ranger: We're all set!
Prepared Midnight Ranger: Good. Can't be careless in this battle.

metadata.subsection: (Talk to the Midnight Rangers near the crates to the left)

title: Grand Warstorm
subsection: (Talk to the Midnight Rangers near the crates to the left)
content:
Prepared Midnight Ranger: How's the weapons?
Midnight Ranger: We're all set!
Prepared Midnight Ranger: Good. Can't be careless in this battle.



Jianxin: Greetings, General.
Yangyang: Master Jianxin? Didn't know I'd be seeing you here...
Jiyan: Jianxin recently arrived at our base with one of the supply delivery teams. She has been a great help.
Jianxin: General, you flatter me.
Jianxin: I've heard people comparing the Norfall Barrens to a massive graveyard. Whenever it rains, cries and moans can be heard, as if many ghosts are weeping.
Jianxin: Master once told me life and death should follow a natural course. The heavens and earth form a vast chamber, where spirits freely depart and return.
Jianxin: Countless brave souls have been trapped here by the evil powers of Ovathrax. I want to help set them free.
Jiyan: Please follow me.
Jiyan: Our main goal is to contain the reviving Threnodian, but we must beware of the Tacet Discords too. They have shown unpredictability in every past battle.
Jiyan: The Academy determined they were not native to the Norfall Barrens, and instead had been conjured by a mysterious power.
Jiyan: After analyzing their behavior, I believe the source of said power is none other than that statue.
Jiyan: While the Ovathrax is still weakened, we must seize the opportunity to act.
Jiyan: With looming danger from the continued onsets of TD Outbreaks, and many of our units injured and unable to fight, it is crucial to plan our attack wisely.
Jiyan: Please, join me in mapping out the strategic plans.

metadata.subsection: (Talk to the Midnight Rangers near the crates to the left)

title: Grand Warstorm
subsection: (Talk to the Midnight Rangers on the right)
content:
[Objective: (Talk to the Midnight Rangers on the right)]
Worried Midnight Ranger: How's your injury?
Excited Midnight Ranger: Fully healed. I'm ready to go!
Worried Midnight Ranger: Don't push yourself too much. Stay safe in the upcoming fights.

metadata.subsection: (Talk to the Midnight Rangers on the right)

title: Grand Warstorm
subsection: (Talk to the Midnight Rangers across from the command center)
content:
[Objective: (Talk to the Midnight Rangers across from the command center)]
Frustrated Midnight Ranger: Something's wrong. This TD Outbreak seems different, unlike the previous ones caused by Retroact Rain.
Frustrated Midnight Ranger: According to the Academy people, we should see converging energy trails.
Frustrated Midnight Ranger: But no energy trails this time, the Tacet Discords are appearing out of thin air, as if summoned...
Calm Midnight Ranger: You mean... It is the Threnodian's work?
Frustrated Midnight Ranger: Likely so. We have to find and stop it before it's too late.

metadata.subsection: (Talk to the Midnight Rangers across from the command center)

title: Grand Warstorm
content:
[Objective: (Talk to the Soldier outside)]
Soldier: The battle is upon us. Are you ready?
Soldier: We must defend Jinzhou and all we hold dear. Victory will be ours!
Soldiers: Victory will be ours!
Soldier: We will prevail the lasting night!

title: Grand Warstorm
content:
Soldiers: Victory will be ours!
Soldier: We will prevail the lasting night!



Jiyan: I have split all combat units into three factions:
Jiyan: The ranged team will provide fire support from afar while the infantry team engages in close combat. Lastly...
Jiyan: We have the special task force of Rover, Yangyang, Jianxin, and me.
Jiyan: Allow me to introduce Konglin, leader of the ranged units team.
Jiyan: And this is Yuehui. He's in charge of the infantry team.
Jiyan: This is topographic map of the Norfall Barrens.
Jiyan: The Ovathrax's power limits our reach. Outrider scouts can't go beyond the Norfall Barrens and Valley junction.
Jiyan: The deepest we ventured was three years ago, when we discovered the Suspended Ruins in its hinterland.
Jiyan: But the terrain is treacherous; narrow and flanked by high cliffs on both sides, leaving only one path for our troops to travel.
Jiyan: On the other hand, our enemies must take the same route if they want to attack us.
Jiyan: With the Ovathrax reorganizing their frequencies and bringing them back, we will face endless waves of attacks.
Jiyan: Every time we cut down an enemy, it gains more power.
Jiyan: Time is of the essence. We cannot afford a prolonged battle.
Jiyan: We must swiftly and safely get our strongest units in the heart of the battlefield, reach that statue, and take down Ovathrax in time.
Jiyan: Rover, let's plan carefully and use each team's strengths to our advantage.
Jiyan: First, our ranged units. Armed with long-range weapons, they can strike from a distance.
Jiyan: But we need to strategize based on the terrain, topography, and enemy forces.
Jiyan: If we manipulate the terrain to our advantage, their strikes will be more effective and cover a larger range.
Jiyan: Where should we deploy the ranged units?
[Dialogue Option]  On the cliffs, from the sides of the valley.
[Dialogue Option]  Behind infantry units, at the valley's bottom.
Rover: (Our main battlefield will be at the valley's bottom, where space and vision are limited.)
Rover: (Placing ranged units behind infantry can slow their aim, making it counterproductive... This may not be the best strategy.)
[Dialogue Option]
[Dialogue Option]  Among infantry units, they will charge as one.
Rover: (Mixing ranged and infantry units may seem versatile, but it wastes the advantage of ranged units... This may not be the best strategy.)
[Dialogue Option]
Jiyan: Deploying our ranged units high above the valleys in advance...
Jiyan: This way, they'll provide cover for our close-combat forces while staying safe themselves. We'll use their range advantage to the fullest. It's a smart move.
Jiyan: Next, the infantry. They have been trained and equipped for close combat.
Jiyan: The heart of Norfall Valley is our main battleground, where we'll fight our enemies head-on. We need to plan our attack wisely.
Jiyan: How should the infantry engage enemy targets?
[Dialogue Option]  From the front.
[Dialogue Option]  From the flank.
Rover: (We could divert some forces to flank the enemy, disrupting their formation and gaining an edge...)
Rover: (However, a successful outflank requires a wide battlefield, but the small passage of Norfall Barrens limits our options for movement.)
Rover: (And we can't predict everything that will happen on the battlefield... Our diversion could leave our frontline vulnerable. It may not be the best strategy.
[Dialogue Option]
[Dialogue Option]  From the rear.
Rover: (To infiltrate enemy lines, a small group of our forces will enter through gaps in their formation and attack from the rear.)
Rover: (This maneuver takes time and requires caution to avoid detection, particularly in a valley where evasion is difficult.)
Rover: (Small infiltration forces may stay hidden but risk being overwhelmed by enemy attacks. Alternatively, diverting forces could lead to losing on the main front.)
Rover: (We have little knowledge of what's happening behind enemy lines... Better not act rashly. This may not be the best strategy.)
[Dialogue Option]
Jiyan: Now that the narrow terrain has dictated an inevitable confrontation...
Jiyan: The infantry will attack head-on, breaking their line. Then our task force can strike when they're vulnerable... A reasonable choice.
Jiyan: Lastly, the special task force, all Resonators with powerful abilities. They have superior mobility and combat skills.
Jiyan: If the chance arises, they will be responsible for taking down the Ovathrax.
Jiyan: What should the special task force do?
[Dialogue Option]  Target the weak point in their formation.
[Dialogue Option]  Use flank tactics.
Rover: (Hmm... flank tactics aim to avoid direct confrontation and exploit enemy weaknesses to take them down slowly.)
Rover: (However, our combat power could be drained by the endless enemy assaults if we don't eliminate the Ovathrax in time.)
Rover: (We can't afford to prolong engagement... There may be more effective tactics available.)
[Dialogue Option]
[Dialogue Option]  Split up and cover each other.
Rover: (We could split into two groups to cover each other during our mission. It could increase safety and efficiency.)
Rover: (But if we further split up our small team of four, we risk getting outmatched in extreme situations.)
Rover: (Also finding cover for everyone may prove difficult during an intense fight.)
Rover: (Perhaps we should consider other options... There may be more effective tactics available.)
[Dialogue Option]
Jiyan: We'll join our effort to break through their defenses and crush their source of power. This is the only way to completely rout the enemies.
Jiyan: It's risky but necessary move under our current circumstances.
Jiyan: Thank you, Rover. The battle plan is clear.
Jiyan: I will now recap our plan:
Jiyan: Konglin, your team will take the cliffs for fire support.
Jiyan: Yuehui, your team will charge enemy lines to pave way for the special task force.
Konglin and Yuehui: Aye, sir!
Jiyan: And I'll join Rover, Yangyang, and Jianxin to create an opening for our main forces to take down the Threnodian.
Jiyan: Good. Are we all clear on what to do?
Jiyan: Our next move is to reclaim the Disruptor and break through the Groundwave Barrier.
[Dialogue Option]  The Disruptor?
[Dialogue Option]  The Groundwave Barrier?
[Dialogue Option]  More unfamiliar terms...
Jiyan: Rover, do you see that iridescent vail?
Jiyan: That's the Groundwave Barrier. Ovathrax set it up to absorb weapon frequencies in the Norfall Barrens without interruption.
Jiyan: One of our top priorities now is to protect the Disruptor from Tacet Discord attacks.
Jiyan: It's a powerful anti-Threnodian weapon from when Jinzhou was founded. We need it to break through this barrier.
Jiyan: I'll leave it to the professional to explain in details.
Mortefi (Contacting): Greetings, General Jiyan, Rover.
Jiyan: How's the preparation going on your side?
Mortefi (Contacting): We've got good news and bad news. Good news is, we've established connection to the Disruptor and we're ready to go.
Mortefi (Contacting): Bad news is, the Disruptor's electric capacitor is damaged.
Mortefi (Contacting): Simply put, it's out of power.
Mortefi (Contacting): Fortunately, there should be a backup power outlet.
Mortefi (Contacting): To use the Disruptor, we'll have to repair that outlet first, then wait for a full charge.
Mortefi (Contacting): Any questions?
[Dialogue Option]  Can we blow up the Threnodian with this?
Mortefi (Contacting): In theory, we could. In practice, it's difficult.
Mortefi (Contacting): First, it could dodge our attack. Not even a perfect hit can kill it. It will be gravely injured, but not dead.
Mortefi (Contacting): Threnodians have been proven to be way stronger than we imagined. Our Disruptor can't handle the Ovathrax, but it can certainly break through that Barrier.
[Dialogue Option]
[Dialogue Option]  Why is it still powered by pre-Lament energy?
Mortefi (Contacting): That's because this ancient Disruptor dates back at least to the founding of Jinzhou.
Mortefi (Contacting): Creating such a powerful weapon with limited technology back then... whoever did it was truly a genius, I must say.
Mortefi (Contacting): If we were to unleash its full power on Jinzhou city, it might launch the entire place into the air.
[Dialogue Option]
[Dialogue Option]  Can you make some more Disruptors?
Mortefi (Contacting): ...I can, but it takes time.
Mortefi (Contacting): No matter how fast I build it... Jinzhou won't be able to hold out that long.
[Dialogue Option]
[Dialogue Option]  I don't have more questions.
Mortefi (Contacting): By the way, this is a weapon of mass destruction... The Capital would want strict control over its use, I assume?
Mortefi (Contacting): Will they really approve our application?
Jiyan: The Magistrate and I have it covered. Trust me.
Mortefi (Contacting): Alright, we'll be waiting for the green light.
Mortefi (Contacting): Lastly, we've got more bad news... Baizhi, please fill us in.
Baizhi (Contacting): Yes.
Baizhi (Contacting): Rover, I am currently monitoring the Tacet Discord attacks from the Academy to design a safer route for you.
Baizhi (Contacting): We just received word from our soldiers at the emplacement. A large number of Tacet Discords are targeting the Disruptor, and our troops are doing their best to defend it.
Baizhi (Contacting): The Disruptor has been surrounded by the Tacet Discords, with more of them slowly closing in.
Baizhi (Contacting): After we recapture the nearby emplacement, it will take some more time for the Disruptor to recharge. You may need to hold out a little longer.
Baizhi (Contacting): I'll send you the coordinates of the Disruptor and its backup energy port. We wish you the best of luck.
Jiyan: I trust we all understand the situation now.
Jiyan: Rover, Yangyang, please go secure the Disruptor and fix its backup energy outlet.
Jiyan: Jianxin, please stay and guard the base. I'll draw those Tacet Discords away.
Jiyan: Let's get moving.

title: Grand Warstorm
content:
[Objective: (Talk to Yuehui)]
Yuehui: Greetings, Rover! I've heard about you!
Yuehui: I'm Yuehui, in charge of our infantry. This is Konglin, our ranged units leader. We're making battle plans.
Yuehui: You see, the valley's got a tricky terrain. We'll need a way to maximize firepower.
Yuehui: Any suggestions? Please do share.
Yuehui: We must consider all options and brace for the worst.

title: Grand Warstorm
content:
[Objective: (Talk to Jianxin outside)]
Jianxin: Rover, I'll defend our base. General Jiyan has set off with his team to distract those Tacet Discords.
Jianxin: We'll leave the Disruptor to you.

Guard of the Rangers: You must be...
Yangyang: Yangyang, an Outrider, General Jiyan sent us here to help. How are things going?
Guard of the Rangers: Those monsters have occupied the emplacement with a surprise attack, but a few brave troops are still holding on.
Guard of the Rangers: We've blocked off access to protect our base, but I'm opening it up for you.
Guard of the Rangers: Please, they need your help. We're counting on you!

Yangyang: The Tacet Discords are everywhere... They've cornered a soldier! Over there! He needs our help!

Yangyang: We should be safe now. I hope he's alright... Let's go check on him.

title: Grand Warstorm
content:
Yangyang: We should be safe now. I hope he's alright... Let's go check on him.



Heavily-injured Midnight Ranger: General... is that you...
[Dialogue Option]  General Jiyan sent me here.
Heavily-injured Midnight Ranger: Is that so... Great...
Heavily-injured Midnight Ranger: We know how important... This cannon is...
Heavily-injured Midnight Ranger: We kept it safe... Never let them have it...
Despite Yangyang's efforts to help the soldier, it seems that the soldier's condition is no longer showing any signs of improvement.
Heavily-injured Midnight Ranger: This... Reparation Key... Take it...
Heavily-injured Midnight Ranger: I may not see our victory in person...
Heavily-injured Midnight Ranger: Please... please defeat that monster... for us...
[Dialogue Option]  You are a brave warrior.
[Dialogue Option]  We will prevail.
Heavily-injured Midnight Ranger: Thank... you...
Yangyang: ...Yes, we will win. Please... rest in peace.

title: Grand Warstorm
content:
[Dialogue Option]  We will prevail.
Heavily-injured Midnight Ranger: Thank... you...
Yangyang: ...Yes, we will win. Please... rest in peace.



Yangyang: Disruptor 50% charged... Enemies ahead. Watch out, Rover!

Yangyang: Diruptor's at 80%! Their offense is weakening. Hold on just a little longer, Rover!

Yangyang: Disruptor's fully charged! Rover, let's take out the remaining Tacet Discords together!

title: Grand Warstorm
content:
Yangyang: Disruptor's fully charged! Rover, let's take out the remaining Tacet Discords together!



Yangyang: It's him, General Jiyan!
Jiyan: Well done.
Jiyan: ...The rain has stopped.
Baizhi (Contacting): General, the Retroact Rain's effects are subsiding. We are observing a sharp decline in the number of Tacet Discords in the Norfall Barrens.
Mortefi (Contacting): The Disruptor is fully charged and ready to fire. But...
Mortefi (Contacting): It takes a lot of energy to fire the Disruptor. If we missed...
Jiyan: ...This is our only chance.
Jinhsi (Contacting): Greetings. Can you hear me?
Jinhsi (Contacting): As the Magistrate of Jinzhou, I have obtained the approval to use the Disruptor in combat.
Jinhsi (Contacting): The enormous energy consumption, the risk of a misfire, and the weight of this decision... I will bear the responsibility.
Jinhsi (Contacting): I alone will be accountable for the outcome of this battle, whatever it may be.
Jinhsi (Contacting): General, Rover, please march on.
Jinhsi (Contacting): May victory prevail the lasting night. I pray for your safe return.
Jiyan: ...Thank you for your trust, Madam Magistrate.
Jinhsi (Contacting): No need for that, General. We've always shared the same goal, you and I.
Jinhsi (Contacting): Attention, all units. Do everything you can to assist. You are authorized to use the Disruptor.
Jiyan: Target, the Norfall Barrens.
Jiyan & Jinhsi: Defend Jinzhou at all costs!

title: Grand Warstorm
content:
[Objective: (Cutscene ends)]

Jiyan: Rocks! One o'clock!
Yangyang: Watch out! Tacet Discords incoming!

Yangyang: There's more of them!
Jiyan: Move! We're running out of time!

Jiyan: We'll shake them off. Use your Grapple now!

Yangyang: Master Jianxin!
Jianxin: There's too many of them. Someone must stay behind to keep them at bay.
Jianxin: Carry on with your mission. You can leave the rest to me.

Jiyan: Yangyang, Rover... Follow me! We're going down from here!
Jiyan: Mind the cliff!

Yangyang: Rover, are you alright?
Jiyan: Stay sharp. More Tacet Discords incoming.

title: Grand Warstorm
content:
Jiyan: Mind the cliff!

Yangyang: Rover, are you alright?
Jiyan: Stay sharp. More Tacet Discords incoming.



Jiyan: The Suspended Ruins are ahead of us.
Jiyan: The Resonance Beacon here is still functioning, and the defense feature is intact too. We can catch our breath here.
Jiyan: The Ovathrax assault has been brutal, as expected. We've been cut off from our main forces.
Jiyan: It's the three of us against them all from here.
Yangyang: Master Jianxin... I hope she is okay...
Jiyan: I tried to contact her and our base, but nothing came back. The Threnodian's power is possibly interfering with Terminal signals.
Jiyan: We have no choice but to trust them now. Let's press on.
Jiyan: We're bound to face a vicious fight.
Jiyan: We've reached the Suspended Ruins. We'll get going once you're ready.

title: Grand Warstorm
content:
Jiyan: We're bound to face a vicious fight.
Jiyan: We've reached the Suspended Ruins. We'll get going once you're ready.



Jiyan: It's unusually quiet inside. Tread with caution.
Jiyan: This wall... We should be able to  it away with our Grapple.

Jiyan: Every path ahead has been cut off...
Jiyan: We're not seeing anything at the moment... Rover, be careful. Something bigger might be waiting for us ahead.

Jiyan: Creating a Tacet Discord of this level... But it won't stop us!

title: Grand Warstorm
content:
Jiyan: Creating a Tacet Discord of this level... But it won't stop us!



Jiyan: As expected, the enemies are increasingly strong as we approach the statue.
Jiyan: Have you been injured, Rover, Yangyang?
Yangyang: I'm okay, but Rover, he/she...
[Dialogue Option]  I'm fine.
[Dialogue Option]  It's nothing.
Jiyan: ...Give me your hand.
Jiyan: Hmm... Knew it. The battle has left you with a few scratches.
Jiyan: I still have some first-aid with me. Please use them.
Jiyan: The upcoming battles will be even more dangerous. Should you get injured, you must let me know in time.
Jiyan: Let's keep moving.

Jiyan: There are several floating platforms ahead... Perhaps we can make use of them.

Yangyang: Watch out! I can feel Tacet Discords ahead.

title: Grand Warstorm
content:
Jiyan: There are several floating platforms ahead... Perhaps we can make use of them.

Yangyang: Watch out! I can feel Tacet Discords ahead.



Jiyan: These rocks are blocking our way. We'll need to get rid of them.
Mortefi (Contacting): Finally... Rover, you hear me?
Mortefi (Contacting): Our signals got blocked off by the Threnodian's power. Took us a lot of effort to make this call get through.
Mortefi (Contacting): I have to say your Terminal has a very intriguing design. We'd love to thoroughly investigate it once we have the chance...
Mortefi (Contacting): Now back to business. We are aware of your situation.
Mortefi (Contacting): Luckily, your current location is still within the Disruptor's range. We can provide fire support.
Mortefi (Contacting): You're seen what the Disruptor is capable of. We can turn down the output power, but I strongly advise finding cover far away.
Jiyan: The structure of this building is almost entirely destroyed... We'll need to create a safe space where we can take cover.
Yangyang: There is a floating platform over there... Perhaps we can make use of it.

title: Grand Warstorm
content:
Yangyang: There is a floating platform over there... Perhaps we can make use of it.



Jiyan: Aim at that wall. We can pull ourselves over!

Jiyan: Mortefi, it's time!
Mortefi (Contacting): Understood. Watch out, everyone!

Yangyang: We did it!
Mortefi (Contacting): The Disruptor's power is down to one third. We can only fire it one more time. After that, it needs to recharge.
Mortefi (Contacting): Take care, everyone. I'm on standby to help you anytime.
Jiyan: Let's try pulling the floating boulders together. This should make our path ahead.

Jiyan: One moment, Rover.
Jiyan: We can work the terrain to our advantage here. Let's try pull that wall down on them, and they'll be trapped underneath.

Jiyan: Well done.

Jiyan: Same situation. Let's do it again.

Jiyan: An Impermanence Heron? In this place? Rover, let's approach it with care.

title: Grand Warstorm
content:
Jiyan: Well done.

Jiyan: Same situation. Let's do it again.

Jiyan: An Impermanence Heron? In this place? Rover, let's approach it with care.



Jiyan: So many enemies along the way... I couldn't have made it past them so fast without you.
Jiyan: We're almost there... The statue's power is getting stronger. I can feel it.
Jiyan: We don't have much time left. Let's move on.

Yangyang: There are some more floor up there... but how are we going to climb up?
Jiyan: I can see a Gravity Stream up ahead. It's currently blocked off. We'll pull the rocks away first, then let it carry us up there.

Jiyan: More rocks... Let's remove them once we find a foothold.

Yangyang: We have almost reached the top. That giant rock... We've got to remove it somehow.

Jiyan: It moved a little. Let's give it a couple more go.

Yangyang: Almost there...

Yangyang: Phew... We did it!

title: Grand Warstorm
content:
Jiyan: It moved a little. Let's give it a couple more go.

Yangyang: Almost there...

Yangyang: Phew... We did it!



Jiyan: We'll reach the top soon...

Jiyan: The road ahead is completely blocked off.
Jiyan: You choose where the Disruptor's last blast hits. Make it count, Rover.
Jiyan: May it cleave out a path for us.

title: Grand Warstorm
content:
[Objective: (Cutscene ends)]
Jiyan: This amount of enemies... We cannot fire the Disruptor again...
Jiyan: Yangyang, you...
Yangyang: The Threnodian is only going to summon more of them as we go. We need someone to keep them away and escort the others into the statue.
Yangyang: I understand you're planning to do it yourself, General, but I think I am better suited for this task.
Yangyang: We all want to beat the Threnodian once and for all.
Yangyang: I understand you don't want to leave anyone behind. But we all know you and Rover have the best chance against that monster.
Yangyang: Now that our shared goal is within hand's reach, I... I do not want to let it slip away.
Jiyan: ...Indeed, Yangyang. Turns out I was the one being indecisive.
[Dialogue Option]  ...I see.
[Dialogue Option]  Yangyang...
Yangyang: I've witnessed the faith and fortitude of so many on our way here. It's time I fulfill their trust.
Yangyang: Rover, please leave it to me. I'll have your back
Jiyan: Now, Rover...
Jiyan: Please make the call.
Yangyang: I will stand guard here. The Threnodian will not be able to draw more power from the monsters here.
Yangyang: I'll leave the rest to you.
[Dialogue Option]  Right there!
[Dialogue Option]  Fire!

title: Grand Warstorm
content:
[Objective: (Cutscene ends)]

Jiyan: It seems the culprit is hidden deep within this statue.
Jiyan: This will be our final battle with the Threnodian. Rover, are you ready?
[Dialogue Option]  Ready to kick some Threnodian arse!
Jiyan: That's the spirit.
[Dialogue Option]  There's no turning back.
Jiyan: Indeed. We've come too far to turn back now.
[Dialogue Option]  We must answer their expectations.
Jiyan: Yes, so many put their faith in us.
[Dialogue Option]  I'd be lying to say I'm not nervous.
Jiyan: Being nervous is not necessarily detrimental; sometimes it helps you focus. Take a deep breath, and then...
Jiyan: Let's bring an end to this war, once and for all.

Jiyan: That's... another "moon"... What on earth is happening...
Jiyan: The Crownless... The Threnodian has reconstructed its frequencies.

Crownless: FIGHT... ABSORB... EVOLVE...

title: Grand Warstorm
content:
Jiyan: The Crownless... The Threnodian has reconstructed its frequencies.

Crownless: FIGHT... ABSORB... EVOLVE...



Jiyan: It's been immobilized. Time to strike!

Jiyan: Those frequencies we just crashed... The "moon" is drawing them in?

title: Grand Warstorm
content:
[Objective: (Cutscene ends)]

Jiyan: That "moon" has cannibalized the Crownless's remaining frequencies to create another monster.
Jiyan: I remember... I saw it during the Battle Beneath the Crescent...
???: DON'T YOU DARE... COME CLOSE...

Jiyan: This is the swordsmanship we teach our new recruits... How dare you!

title: Grand Warstorm
content:
[Objective: (Cutscene ends)]

Jiyan: Watch out for its ranged attacks!
Jiyan: Rover, have you noticed?
Jiyan: It avoids attacking the "moon" behind. That "moon" must be the core of our enemy.
Jiyan: This thing is weakening. I'll shield you from its attacks!
Jiyan: Rover, find a chance to strike its core!

Jiyan: ...Copied my weapon already, huh?

title: Grand Warstorm
content:
[Objective: (Cutscene ends)]

Dreamless: Blade of Extinction: MOTHER... NEEDS WEAPONS...
Dreamless: Blade of Extinction: MORE WEAPONS... STRONGER... WEAPONS...
Jiyan: Careful!

Dreamless: Blade of Extinction: You will meet... the same fate...

Dreamless: Blade of Extinction: Pay for your insurrection... in blood...
Dreamless: Blade of Extinction: The war... never cease... We... will return...

title: Grand Warstorm
content:
[Objective: (Cutscene ends)]

Jiyan: As the conceptualization of war... Somehow it opted to flee, instead of fighting us properly.
[Dialogue Option]  It seemed weak.
[Dialogue Option]  It's intentionally avoiding us.
??: Zzz... zzz...
Jiyan: Rover, is that...
Jiyan: This place is collapsing soon... Let's get out of here first.

title: Grand Warstorm
content:
[Objective: (Cutscene plays)]
Narrator: Gather 'round, I have a tale to spin! Our feather-haired maiden faces a horde of beasts...
Narrator: And just in time, a ray of light!
Narrator: Sunbeams burst through the clouds, banishing darkness out of sight.
Narrator: From the statue emerged two... Guess who we have?
Narrator: None other than General Jiyan and the legendary Rover!
Narrator: And lo! Ruins fells, a colossus shattered. The Ovathrax meets its defeat.
Narrator: Mountains and rivers exulted in glee, as the war's finale came to be.
Narrator: As they say, why fear when fate is ours to take?
Narrator: Amidst setbacks, heroes will rise to conquer. Their determination fuels the fire of hope in the darkest hour.
Narrator: Under starlit skies we battled, divine Loong roaring above.
Narrator: Now victorious, our songs of triumph shall shake the clouds!
Narrator: And our story goes on...

title: A New Companion
content: A New Companion is an interlude in Chapter I of the Main Quests.

title: A New Companion
content: Quest Objective: After the battle of Norfall Barren, everything came to an end. Your friends are calling you for a meet-up with snacks at Panhua's Restaurant. It seems they like to know more about that "little one" from within your body...

title: A New Companion
content:
Chixia: Over here! Been waiting for ya!
Chixia: I thought Yangyang said you had a super cool lil' buddy to show us. Where is it?
Rover: Uh, I don't know...
Chixia: Did it just... pop out of your Tacet Mark...?
"Little One": Mmm... smells good!
Chixia: So... Is this how it first showed up when you guys were in the Norfall Barrens?
Yangyang: Yes, back then, we...
Yangyang: As I fought off those Tacet Discords, a burst of energy erupted from that statue...
Yangyang: Two forces clashed and collided, and later one of them emerged victorious, vanquishing the other in a violent clash.
Yangyang: General Jiyan and Rover later told me it was this little thing coming out of Rover's body. It was blocking, or even "consuming" the overflow of Threnodian power.
Yangyang: It reminded me of how Rover once absorbed frequency energy with his body in a similar fashion. So we took him to the Academy for a check-up with Baizhi.
Yangyang: Apparently... this little one is what we had detected before. It’s the speculated "Space" or "Organism" hidden inside your body. Now we finally know.
Yangyang: It shares similar frequencies with Tacet Discords' Reverberations. It resembles an Echo processed by the Data Bank, stored inside your body instead of a Terminal.
Yangyang: In other words, it's your own Echo, captured or absorbed at some point. Without you, it can't manifest.
Yangyang: That's why Baizhi couldn't confirm just how you absorbed that Echo back then. Was it you? Was it the little one? Or maybe, the two of you together?
Yangyang: And Baizhi discovered more after analyzing your spectrums.
Yangyang: She found a new power source within you, similar to the Crownless but even stronger. This power comes from the Tacet Discord you defeated in Norfall Barrens.
Yangyang: So, the excess energy this little thing had "consumed" somehow ended up in your body, available at your disposal. In other words, there's a deeper connection between the two of you. Or, according to Baizhi, it’s a Convergent Codependency.
[Dialogue Option]  Convergent Codependency?
[Dialogue Option]  That's new. What does that mean?
Yangyang: Uh, to put it simply... you are connected. While you are two separate individuals, your energies and vitals can affect each other, for better or for worse. You may even feel each other's emotions.
Yangyang: The bond between you and this creature is symbiotic. As it strengthens, so do you. However, if one is harmed, the other suffers.
Yangyang: Fortunately, since it can't ever leave your side, it's not an easy target for attackers. And if they do strike, it can seek shelter inside your body for safety.
[Dialogue Option]  I... think I understand.
[Dialogue Option]  Sounds complicated. Let's talk about it later.
Yangyang: Okay, now that's... pretty much it. Baizhi was going to explain it to you herself, but she has to go check on a newly appeared Sonoro Sphere in Zhaozhou...
Chixia: Wait, wait! This is too much information for me to process! Let me get this straight. So, it helped Rover fight off the Threnodian?
Chixia: Seriously? This teeny tiny thing could do that? Hmm. Seems unlikely...

title: A New Companion
content:
Chixia: Seriously? This teeny tiny thing could do that? Hmm. Seems unlikely...



"Little One": Hmph! Don't look down on me.
"Little One": You'll regret it when you learn what I'm capable of!
"Little One": That poker-faced researcher was absolutely shocked when she examined me! Said I'm not just any Echo, I'm a super duper cool one. Rarest of them all! Heh heh!
[Dialogue Option]  You sure you didn't add anything extra?
[Dialogue Option]  That doesn't sound like the Baizhi I know...
Chixia: Yeah, no way Baizhi talks like that. She's more of a data dump kind of person. "Super duper cool"? Nah, too extra for her.
Chixia: Seems like you're trying to boost your ego a bit!
Yangyang: Oh, actually... While those aren't Baizhi's exact words, that is what she meant.
Yangyang: She mentioned highly intelligent Echoes that can act on their own in other countries. Said they are involved in every aspect of human life, with unique abilities beyond our imagination.
Yangyang: Those Echoes are rare though. Neither I nor Baizhi, an Ecoacoustics expert, have ever seen one in person. But this little thing here... It could be one of those foreign Echoes.
Chixia: Yeah, makes sense! Now we just gotta figure out where it came from. Who knows, we may find other cool Echoes in that place!
[Dialogue Option]  Are you seriously buying all of this already?
Chixia: Well, both General Jiyan and Baizhi have confirmed it. No way they're lying.
Chixia: I'll admit, the thought of someone else having an Echo inside them sounds pretty crazy to me. But with you, anything's possible.
Chixia: You can absorb Reverberations with just your hands, like the legend says. So maybe one day you just stumbled upon this little thing and soaked it up like a sponge. Sounds feasible, I guess?
[Dialogue Option]  Sure, sounds doable.
Chixia: Sooo...
Chixia: Do you know where exactly he absorbed you?
"Little One": Huh? How am I supposed to know... Why don't you just ask him?
[Dialogue Option]  Because they know I don't remember.
Chixia: Yeah. It happened before he lost all memories, so we have to ask you.
[Dialogue Option]  Sure, she can ask. It's not like I have the answer.
"Little One": Tsk tsk... Don't take that tone with me.
Yangyang: But... even if Echoes can have memories, they probably wouldn’t remember things earlier than their first manifestation. I wonder if that's the case with this little one, too?
"Little One": Aha, finally someone with common sense.
"Little One": That green-haired serious guy asked me a similar question. Sorry to disappoint, but I really don't remember anything before I showed up.
"Little One": Hmm. Maybe... maybe I was just sleeping inside him this whole time, so of course I don't remember!
Chixia: Sleeping? Seriously? It's been so long! All those happenings, all that fighting, and you didn't hear anything? Well that's... Your sleeping quality is really something.
[Dialogue Option]  I'd prefer it to NOT stay awake all the time.
[Dialogue Option]  Uh, please no. There are things I don't want it to hear...
"Little One": Oh, so you've got privacy to be respected.
"Little One": Don't worry! Your body's sound insulation is amazing. Dive into it and everything goes quiet.
"Little One": The only problem is, I never know when I'll wake up again. And when I do wake up, I get tired, hungry fast, so I have to crawl back in for more rest.
"Little One": Hmm... I know! It's all because I'm not eating enough!
Yangyang: That's why you kept disappearing. You went back to sleep from lack of energy. Makes sense. Regular Echoes need to be powered by the Terminal too.
Chixia: Hmm, I thought you'd be really different from the usual ones we see. Turns out you share a lot in common.
Chixia: So you probably don't know your denomination, or a nick name? No wonder everyone's been calling you the "little one"...
"Little One": Denomination? What's that?
Yangyang: The universally agreed terms for special Echoes, like names for humans. They are named based on their characteristics, abilities, and places of origin.
"Little One": My denomination... It's... It's... I don't know. Do I not have a name at all?
"Little One": No way! Nooo way! That's not fair! If all the special Echoes have names, how can I not have one?
"Little One": I don't wanna be called the "little one" all the time. It doesn't sound cool at all!
"Little One": How about this: you help me come up with a name, and I will let you have some of the food...
"Little One": There's nothing left...

title: A New Companion
content:
"Little One": How about this: you help me come up with a name, and I will let you have some of the food...
"Little One": There's nothing left...



"Little One": Erm... Next time! Next time I'll definitely save some for you! Just... give me a name! Please!
Chixia: A name? Now?
"Little One": Yes, I want it now! Look, your name's Chixia, your name's Yangyang, and you... Uhhh, your name is...
[Dialogue Option]  Rover.
"Little One": Rover? ...That sounds interesting. Wait, didn't you forget everything? How do you still remember...
[Dialogue Option]  I just came up with it. It's my new name now.
Yangyang: With your old name and memories all gone, it's a good idea to go with a new one. It makes everything more convenient and represents a fresh start.
"Little One": Yeah, exactly like she said! Every one of you has a name, and I want one for myself too! Really not asking much.
"Little One": I just want a name that sounds a little cool, a little special and epic and super smokin'!
[Dialogue Option]  That's a long list of descriptors...
"Little One": Names are a big deal, you know? Like, once you have one, it's stuck with you for life. Gotta make sure it's a good one!
"Little One": Can't have people not scared of me when they hear it. No time for regrets here!
[Dialogue Option]  Yeah, you having a name should make things easier.
Chixia: That's true.
Chixia: Let's see... You want a cool one... What about "Echo the Invincible"? What do you say?
"Little One": Nah, nuh-uh, absolutely no! That's too straightforward. It's-It's no better than calling me the "little one"!
Chixia: Hey, it makes every difference in the world! "I am Echo the Invincible!" That's what a Hero Play character would say as their transformation call!
Chixia: Or maybe... Since you can fly and you've got those long ears... why don’t you call yourself... "Righteous Raptor"? Or "Valor Hawk"? "Flying Fury"?
"Little One": No, absolutely no. Why do they all sound so... cringy...
Chixia: Why? I love it when people call me the Jinzhou Speedster. Doesn't that sound awesome?
"Little One": Uh... Haha, sure, if you say so... Anyway, they all sound like anything but my name. ABSOLUTELY NO!
[Dialogue Option]  Absolutely no this, absolutely no that. What do you want?
[Dialogue Option]  Let’s make it simple. Why don't you just call yourself Abby.
"Little One": Aha! I knew Rover would come up with a good... Wait. Why does it sound so random?
"Little One": You didn't just pick two random syllables, did you?
[Dialogue Option]  Why not? Simplicity works wonders.
"Little One": I mean... Yeah, it's simple, easy to remember. l can imagine myself yelling it out loud, and at least it sounds better than Chixia’s cringy titles... But you know, it doesn’t feel quite majestic enough...
[Dialogue Option]  Abby means joy. It's what you bring to us.
"Little One": So... Is it because I've been saying "Absolutely no" a lot...?
"Little One": ...
"Little One": ...
[Dialogue Option]  (Why, isn't that a nice name..)
Rover: (Hmm... Why is it suddenly so quiet? Is it not happy with the name? Why though... Can't think of anything better that's catchy, impactful, and clever all at once.)
[Dialogue Option]  (Maybe I should come up with a better one...)
Rover: (Uh, I meant to tease it as a joke, but I can tell it's upset now. On second thought, a name is indeed very important. Maybe I'll have to come up with a different one...)
[Dialogue Option]  Let’s just think of another...
"Little One": Hmm... Abby... Abra... Abraxas?
Chixia: What's wrong? What are you muttering about? Abra... what? Sounds like you're reading a spell.
"Little One": ...Erm, I don't know, but... I just have this feeling that... this is what my name should be. Okay, ready?
"Little One": Abby! I like the sound of that. That's my name!
[Dialogue Option]  I thought you didn't like it.
[Dialogue Option]  Good. Saves us time thinking of another one.
"Little One": Of course I like it! You came up with it for me! I was just... trying to get used to it, that's all! Besides, I feel attached to this name now.
"Little One": My name is Abby. You will NOT call me the "little one" again!
Chixia: Sure, we won't. Got it.
Chixia: Well, that didn't work out. I was hoping we could get some answers from the little... I mean, from Abby, but now we're back at square one.
Chixia: I really thought we could figure out where Abby came from. It might not lead us to other special Echoes, but it's at least a starting point to uncover Rover's past. Then we'll have something to do before asking Madam Magistrate and our Sentinel about it again.
Yangyang: Maybe we can start with Abby's special abilities instead?
Yangyang: Each special Echo has a unique ability. We can compare what Abby does with our records of other Echoes to see where they came from. Besides... It was Abby’s power that helped Rover defeat the Threnodian, I suppose?
[Dialogue Option]  Likely so.
Chixia: Why do you sound so unsure? Didn't you see it all with your own eyes?
[Dialogue Option]  It happened too fast. I didn't get a clear look.
[Dialogue Option]  I'd be more sure if I can see it again.
Chixia: Hmm... Abby, can you show us again? I'm super curious how you did that. Who knows, we might learn something.
Abby: Well, since you asked, I'll show you how it's done! But... this place is too crowded. Let's move to that open spot over there.

title: A New Companion
content:
Abby: Well, since you asked, I'll show you how it's done! But... this place is too crowded. Let's move to that open spot over there.



Abby: Alright. Ahem! All eyes on me!
Abby: W-what's going on? I... I'll try again! Just you see!
Chixia: Uh... What? Did something happen?
Abby: J-Just a little slip, that's all! I can do it! You gotta trust me!
Abby: Back then, I just stood in front of him, and that big bad Threnodian monster thing just... just... left.
Chixia: So... you didn't really do anything?
Abby: Huh? No, I... I definitely did something!
Abby: Like I said, I was asleep, and then all of a sudden, I smelled something really yummy coming closer and closer... It was like nothing I ever smelled before!
Abby: I didn't have time to think. I just had to show up and reach out for it.
Yangyang: So... maybe Abby's power activates automatically under certain circumstances? Perhaps Abby can’t control it yet.
Chixia: Yeah, it looks that way. You can't even hold your shape for very long yet...
Abby: Hey, hey! Stop looking down on me! Like I said, it was just a little slip, really!
Abby: But think about it! I just stood there and did nothing and ended up beating a THRENODIAN! Imagine what I could do if I actually tried!
Abby: Hey, Rover! Get behind me next time we run into anything, 'kay? I'll keep you safe, promise!
Chixia: You're so real for that, Abby.
Abby: You bet! I said I'm super strong. I'll protect him!
Yangyang: That's very reassuring to hear. But... it seems we're stuck again. I can't think of anything else to check out.
[Dialogue Option]  Let’s take our time. There's no hurry.
Chixia: Knew it. Nothing about Rover's ever gonna be easy to figure out... Hmm. Maybe we should bring Baizhi, Mr. Xiangli Yao, and all the researchers in Jinzhou... No, in the entire Huanglong together. They'll do a nice and thorough examination on Abby, and then...
Abby: ABSOLUTELY NO!
Abby: I said NO! Told that poker-face researcher already!
Abby: I'll make it clear. I am to stay with Rover.
Yangyang: I agree. Abby cannot leave Rover's side, but we can't just trap him here for research.
[Dialogue Option]  We'll still need to figure out my past first.
Yangyang: Where did you absorb Abby, what are Abby's powers, and what exactly happened between you two... There are so many questions we can't figure out yet.
Yangyang: Our Sentinel Jué can look into the future. Nothing ever deviates from its predictions. It has already sort of guided you to the Norfall Barrens through Madam Magistrate's messages, right?
Yangyang: Now that the Threnodian crisis is over, perhaps you can consult our Magistrate and our Sentinel again. I’m sure they can offer you some more useful guidance.
[Dialogue Option]  I'll pay Jinhsi another visit once she returns.
[Dialogue Option]  We'll have to wait for now.
Abby: Relax, relax! You have me now, remember? Meeting up with that Jinhsi person? Getting your memories back? I've got you!
Abby: Speaking of that, so this Sentinel can predict the future? That sounds cool. The name "Jué" sounds pretty cool too. It's almost as cool as mine!
Abby: What does it look like? Where is it? Since we're paying it a visit, this Sentinel should treat us with food, right? I wonder how the food's gonna taste...
Chixia: Our Sentinel protects every one of us. Of course it's cool!
Chixia: But... why are you talking about food again. Didn't you just stuff your face? What? Is your stomach a black hole?
Abby: I can't help it. I'm always starving...
After parting ways with Yangyang and Chixia, you travel around Jinzhou with Abby while waiting for replies from Jinhsi, trying to look for more clues about your past.
Several days later...

title: Thaw of Eons
content: Thaw of Eons is the seventh act in Chapter I of the Main Quests.

title: Thaw of Eons
content:
Dreamweaver's Ascent
To Mt. Firmament
Truthseeker's Pass
Road of Pilgrimage
Mianloong Chamber
The Commander of Time
Dawn of Snowstorm

title: Dreamweaver's Ascent
content:
At Gourmet Street, you discuss your dream involving the Sentinel and Mt. Firmament. A fellow diner shares insights about the mountain, and Abby senses a strange aura emanating from the southeast. Together, you resolve to seek information about the Sentinel at the City Hall.

In City Hall, Sanhua reveals that the Magistrate ventured to Mt. Firmament days ago, concerned for the Sentinel's safety. You express your intent to follow and Sanhua offers to contact a guide for the treacherous journey. She arranges a meeting with the Wayfinder at Whining Aix's Mire.

title: Dreamweaver's Ascent
content:
Head to the Gourmet Street
Head to City Hall
Head to the Meeting Room
Leave City Hall

title: Dreamweaver's Ascent
content: Quest Objective: Your forgotten past, hazy memories, and a strange dream... So many questions linger about your identity, and who you used to be. Meanwhile, a mysterious pull guides you to a hidden place on the distant sea...

title: Dreamweaver's Ascent
content:
[Objective: (Upon obtaining quest)]
Abby: Rover, did you hear that? My stomach is growling.
Abby: Ugh... I'm sooo hungry...
Abby: How about we go to that place we went to last time with Yangyang and Chixia?
Abby: I love their food so much!

title: Dreamweaver's Ascent
content:
Abby: Ugh... I'm sooo hungry...
Abby: How about we go to that place we went to last time with Yangyang and Chixia?
Abby: I love their food so much!



Abby: Mmm... Yummy, yummy!
Abby: Hello? Are you with me? Rover, you seem a bit distracted.
Abby: With so much delicious food right in front of you, aren't you gonna try any? Well if you're not interested, I'll gobble it all up!
Abby: You've been absent-minded the whole day. Still bothered by that dream from last night?
Abby: Wait, so you had a dream about the Sentinel? Like the one from your flashback when we saw the Sentinel statue after you lost your memory?
[Dialogue Option]  This time, I saw more.
[Dialogue Option]  This time, I saw something different.
Abby: Hang on, let me get this straight... The Sentinel swooshed you off to a mountain shaped like a dragon...
Abby: And then there were all these bad things going on with lots and lots of Tacet Discords, but the Sentinel saved the day!
Abby: How exactly did it protect everyone again... Oh, in your dream it made the time different there?
Rover: Yeah... The time in the mountains seemed to have slowed down from the outside, away from the Tacet Discords.
Rover: The Sentinel must have created a barrier by manipulating the flow of time, keeping those monsters out.
Rover: It was a safe haven from all the disturbances caused by the Tacet Discords, where people lived peacefully...
Rover: Also... In my dream, I wasn't affected by the slowed time and could freely move in and out of the barrier.
Abby: It's no shock that you have awesome powers, being friends with me.
Abby: Hmm... What was that place you dreamed about called?
Rover: I'm not entirely sure I heard it correctly, but in my dream, the Sentinel mentioned a place called Mt. Firmament.
Abby: Mt. Firmament? Never heard of it...
Jiusi: You never heard of Mt. Firmament? Then I'm sure you're not from around here.
Abby: Hold on! Did you just say Mt. Firmament?!
Jiusi: Oh my! Did that Echo just... talk?
[Dialogue Option]  It's a good friend of mine.
[Dialogue Option]  Relax. It won't hurt you.
Qingxiang: Come on, man, relax. You don't hear an Echo talking every day, but it's not that uncommon either!
Qingxiang: I heard there's a country called Ri... Rinas... What? Anyway, the Echoes there are next level.
[Dialogue Option]  What's up with this Mt. Firmament?
Qingxiang: Oh, you're not from around here? Well, that explains why you don't know about Mt. Firmament.
Qingxiang: Legends say Mt. Firmament is where the first people of Jinzhou lived. It looks like a giant statue of our Sentinel Jué.
Qingxiang: I've never heard of anyone going to that place. They say those who try either get lost in the sea mist or never come back.
Qingxiang: If you're curious, just head southeast. Mt. Firmament is on the east side of Whining Aix's Mire, and you can see it from a distance.
Abby: The southeast...
Abby: The past few days, especially this morning, I caught this unique smell from the southeast. From that mountain they just mentioned.
[Dialogue Option]  A unique smell... What do you mean?
Abby: It's like a strong energy pulsing through the air, but I can't quite put my finger on it. It feels kind of weird though, doesn't smell natural...
Abby: Could it have anything to do with what you said? A place where time passes slowly?
Abby: Hmm... Do you wanna go check it out?
Rover: I had a flashback about seeing their Sentinel... Perhaps that happened on Mt. Firmament...
Rover: I can feel an unknown force guiding me, urging me to go there and find something...
Rover: Jinhsi said she'll go search for the Sentinel and update me on its whereabouts.
Rover: But so far, I have not heard anything from the City Hall yet...
Abby: Then... Shall we go check it out together? It feels really suspicious.
[Dialogue Option]  Let's go ask Jinhsi about it.

title: Dreamweaver's Ascent
content:
Abby: Then... Shall we go check it out together? It feels really suspicious.
[Dialogue Option]  Let's go ask Jinhsi about it.



Rover: Abby, are you getting sleepy again?
Abby: Let me... take a quick nap, all right? I've got keen ears. If anything goes down, just give me a holler, and I'll be... I'll be up in a jiffy... I swear...

title: Dreamweaver's Ascent
content:
Sanhua: Greetings, Rover.
Sanhua: What can I help you with today?
[Dialogue Option]  I'm here for Jinhsi. I have questions about the Sentinel.
Sanhua: I regret to inform you that Madam Magistrate is not in the City Hall. She has left for Mt. Firmament.
Sanhua: In fact... We have not heard back from her for days.
[Dialogue Option]  So you don't know what she is up to?
Sanhua: Unfortunately, no... Please keep this confidential. The situation in Jinzhou is still unstable after our battle with the Threnodian. We must limit discussion of the Magistrate's whereabouts to a select few.
[Dialogue Option]  What's going on?
Sanhua: When we captured Scar, he claimed that the Fractsidus had imprisoned our Sentinel.
Sanhua: It was around the same time that Madam Magistrate lost track of Sentinel Jué.
Sanhua: If our Sentinel is truly in danger... Or if someone with malicious intent obtains this information, the potential consequences could be as catastrophic as the previous Threnodian invasion.
Sanhua: In order to investigate the Sentinel's whereabouts, Madam Magistrate has left for Mt. Firmament, its last recorded location.
[Dialogue Option]  Did Jinhsi bring anyone with her? Bodyguards? Can you get in touch with them?
Sanhua: Madam Magistrate traveled to Mt. Firmament alone.
Sanhua: The looming threat of the Threnodian discouraged any additional diversion of human resources. Furthermore, when it comes to the Sentinel... Force is not a viable solution.
[Dialogue Option]  I need to go to Mt. Firmament to meet with the Sentinel.
[Dialogue Option]  Jinhsi might be in trouble, and I want to help.
Sanhua: Madam Magistrate trusts you. It is beyond my authorization to meddle in your decisions.
Sanhua: However, the landscape around Mt. Firmament is complex. One must be accompanied by a special "Wayfinder" to navigate safely. That's all I know.
[Dialogue Option]  Where can I find this Wayfinder, then?
Sanhua: Currently... She's likely at the ferry terminal in Whining Aix's Mire. I'll reach out to her.
Sanhua: To learn more about Mt. Firmament, you can meet her at the ferry. I lack the same level of understanding of the situation there as she does.
[Dialogue Option]  All right.
Sanhua: I trust Madam Magistrate's decisions. I will do my utmost to handle the public matters on her behalf while she is away.
Sanhua: I just... This worry about her safety won't leave me.
Sanhua: In her last video message, I could tell she seemed weaker than usual, despite her efforts to maintain composure.
Sanhua: Madam Magistrate's situation might not be optimistic...
Sanhua: Rover, Mt. Firmament is a dangerous place. Please take care.
Sanhua: I have sent the coordinates to your terminal. Thank you for your kind help... I pray you will both return safely.
[Dialogue Option]  (Abby.)
[Dialogue Option]  (Abby, are you there?)
Abby: I'm here.
Abby: Hey, did you notice how the mountain has a strangely pleasant smell? It doesn't look edible though...
[Dialogue Option]  Are you hungry again?
Abby: Not that I'm hungry or anything. I just tend to doze off easily. Feels like my body can only process what I consume while sleeping.
[Dialogue Option]  I'm suddenly unsure whether I can count on you.
Abby: Well of course I'm reliable! Even if I do happen to fall asleep and can't hear you...
[Dialogue Option]  Go get some rest. I can handle it.
Abby: Of course you can! When I'm already so cool. you must be pretty amazing too!
Abby: And don't worry, if there's any danger coming your way, I'll wake up like clockwork, just like last time.
Abby: Well, unless there's nothing that can even remotely challenge you.
Abby: In that case, I probably won't... wake... up...

title: Dreamweaver's Ascent
content:
Abby: Well, unless there's nothing that can even remotely challenge you.
Abby: In that case, I probably won't... wake... up...



Rover: Let's head to the ferry.
Rover: Hmm... Mt. Firmament... Our Wayfinder should have plenty information to share.

title: To Mt. Firmament
content:
In the pouring rain, you encounter Changli, the Wayfinder, at the ferry. She describes the peculiar nature of time at Mt. Firmament, where it flows erratically. She notes your resemblance to a historic visitor who was immune to this temporal distortion and offers to accompany you into this dangerous realm.

You and Changli come to a damaged bridge that leads to Mt. Firmament. You find a Chronosorter in the vicinity, a Court of Savantae creation believed to have the power to restore objects by rewinding time. Perhaps it can be used to repair the bridge?

Upon entering Mt. Firmament, you find that the flow of time has spiraled out of control, with many creatures falling victim to it. Leaving the mountain now could lead to unpredictable aging. Changli finds her Terminal is not working and suggests hurrying to Hongzhen, a town that Jinhsi must pass through in her search for the Sentinel.

title: To Mt. Firmament
content:
Hongzhen resembles a place from your dreams. Changli speculates that your dreams might be a glimpse into your past and a light guiding you into the future. Here, you meet the Fractsidus and discover traces of Jinhsi's Resonance Ability, and you decide to follow them.

You and Changli enter a hidden chamber. Xinyi greets you. She is an old acquaintance of Changli's and once held a prominent position in City Hall before retiring to Hongzhen. She asks you to follow her.

You learn that the Sentinel may be trapped in its resting place—the Mianloong Chamber. The Fractsidus invasion has activated the defenses built by the Court of Savantae, sealing the chamber. Jinhsi left shortly before to go to Truthseeker's Pass to retrieve the Cipher Key needed to unseal it. You and Changli continue to trace her steps.

title: To Mt. Firmament
content: Quest Objective: Jinhsi has gone missing, and you just had an enigmatic dream.... That Wayfinder at the ferry may hold answers to these mysteries.

title: To Mt. Firmament
content:
??: Are you trapped here by the rain?
[Dialogue Option]  No, I'm waiting for someone.
??: I happen to be waiting for someone, too.
[Dialogue Option]  Thank you.
??: No need for thanks. We're about to embark on a journey together, Rover.
[Dialogue Option]  Who are you?
[Dialogue Option]  Are you the "Wayfinder"?
??: I am Changli, your "Wayfinder".
Changli: Don't worry. The rain won't last much longer. Our destination lies just beyond it.
Changli: Rover, what do you know about Mt. Firmament?
[Dialogue Option]  Not much.
[Dialogue Option]  It's the place where Jinzhou was founded?
[Dialogue Option]  What on earth is going on in that place?
Changli: There is... a certain folk tale. Have you heard of it?
Changli: While hiking in the mountains, a woodcutter came upon two people playing Weiqi and became enthralled with their game.
Changli: Upon his return home, he found a world transformed. Everything was different, as if in a new reality.
Changli: That mountain was a secret realm where time worked differently. The woodcutter only spent half a day inside, but outside, a century had passed.
Changli: Mt. Firmament is such a place.
Changli: But unlike this folk tale, there is a price to pay for entering and exiting its grounds.
Changli: If I spend a full day in the mountains, ten days will be taken off my lifespan upon my leaving, reflecting the actual time that has passed outside.
Changli: Not to mention... the situation on Mt. Firmament right now is probably even more complex than before.
[Dialogue Option]  What happened?
Changli: The strange time patterns of Mt. Firmament are tied to the Sentinel's Temporal Mandate. Time ebbs and flows at its will.
Changli: If the Fractsidus really has imprisoned our Sentinel, causing it to lose control of its powers, that could explain the Temporal Disruptions... which means Mt. Firmament is basically a dead end with no way out.
[Dialogue Option]  And you are heading straight into that dead end.
Changli: Lifespan is not the top of my concerns. If you've decided to venture there... I'll join you as your Wayfinder.
Changli: Jinhsi has stayed on Mt. Firmament for too long.
[Dialogue Option]  Sanhua said she might be in danger.
Changli: She doesn't miss a thing, does she?
Changli: Before Jinhsi left for Mt. Firmament, scales began appearing on her body, and her Resonance Ability was weakening.
Changli: Those signs pointed to a dire situation for the Sentinel as well.
Changli: That's why I must lead you there. You might have the key to solving our dilemma.
[Dialogue Option]  What do you mean?
Changli: You're here because I invited you. Sanhua was instructed to disclose my whereabouts if you ever went to City Hall and asked about Jinhsi.
[Dialogue Option]  Why would you tell me?
Changli: From what I understand, there is a strong link between you and the Sentinel. More importantly, you've been the primary target of the Fractsidus.
[Dialogue Option]  How did you know I'd go to the City Hall?
Changli: It's no surprise that you went to City Hall for answers, considering your memory loss and Jinhsi's prolonged absence.
Changli: I need to tell you the truth... Because you've been the top priority—No, the sole concern of our enemy. The Fractsidus.
Changli: That Overseer tried everything to sway you and make you join their side before our battle with the reviving Threnodian.
Changli: It's a clear sign that your involvement could disrupt their plans, especially at Mt. Firmament.
[Dialogue Option]  Why do they care so much about me?
[Dialogue Option]  It seems everyone's interested in me...
Changli: Records at the Grand Library tell a tale of someone who dared to enter Mt. Firmament after the Sentinel's descent. And they emerged unscathed, as if time had no hold on them.
Changli: They were also said to have "stood alongside the Sentinel".
Changli: And here before me stands someone who bears an uncanny resemblance to that very individual.
[Dialogue Option]  You think that person is me?
Changli: Is it you? If not you, who else could it be?
Changli: It took me some effort to finally reach this conclusion.
Changli: Rover, the journey ahead is filled with danger at every turn. Once we venture into the mountains, there's no turning back. Are you sure you still want to join me?
[Dialogue Option]  Yes. The strange time pattern can't hurt me.
[Dialogue Option]  I am the key to solving your dilemma. Then why ask?
Changli: As your Wayfinder, I'll lead you to your destination. What you do after that is entirely up to you.
Changli: The rain is subsiding, and the sky will soon clear.
Changli: Rover, it's time for us to head out.

title: To Mt. Firmament
content:
[Objective: (Cutscene Ends)]

Changli: We're at the base of Mt. Firmament, but we won't enter the Temporal Barrier until we cross the Luminous Shore.
Changli: Shall we proceed? The storm is coming... Some people must be itching to pounce.

title: To Mt. Firmament
content:
Changli: Shall we proceed? The storm is coming... Some people must be itching to pounce.



Changli: The bridge has broken...
[Dialogue Option]  What's this?
Changli: Judging by its design and intricate details, it must be a creation of the Court of Savantae.
Changli: This is what they call a Chronosorter...
[Dialogue Option]  What is that?
Changli: It mimics the Sentinel's Temporal Mandate (Ability to control time), able to reverse small-scale events and restore objects to their previous state.
Changli: My master once told me about the Court of Savantae and their fearless quest to unravel the mysteries of Mt. Firmament, risking all in their pursuit of understanding the strange flow of time.
Changli: Their dedication bore fruit in the form of fascinating inventions, such as this Chronosorter.
Changli: But it doesn't add up...
[Dialogue Option]  What's wrong?
Changli: Why hasn't this brilliant invention spread beyond Mt. Firmament?
Changli: This Chronosorter was built beyond the Temporal Barrier, so its creator must have already paid the price for leaving.
Changli: But even if they died, there are countless other CSC members (Court of Savantae Committee) who could replicate it. How did such advanced technology become lost?
Changli: Or... do these Chronosorters stop functioning once they are removed from Mt. Firmament?
[Dialogue Option]  What should we do now?
Changli: This Chronosorter, weathered though it may appear, bears no signs of neglect. Someone has tended to it diligently.
Changli: Let's give it a try.

title: To Mt. Firmament
content:
[Objective: (After crossing the bridge)]
Rover: Weren't they concerned about losing lifespan?
Changli: For those fanatics, nothing mattered more than the truth.
Changli: To live every moment with overwhelming passion... How many can claim such a tenacious drive and unshakable determination?

Changli: Rover, it's the Fractsidus!

title: To Mt. Firmament
content:
[Objective: (After defeating the Fractsidus)]
Rover: The Fractsidus... It's them again.
Changli: They've set traps all around the Luminous Shore...
Changli: They must have anticipated your arrival.

Rover: The entrance is sealed.
Changli: It's the Photon Barrier. Another invention from the Court of Savantae.
Changli: Specific steps must be followed to undo the barrier. Rover, I'll guide you.

title: To Mt. Firmament
content:
[Objective: (Photonvault & Photon Barrier tutorial instruction)]
Changli: Use long-range weapons on the Photonvaults to cut off its energy.

title: To Mt. Firmament
content:
[Objective: (After shooting both Photonvaults)]
Changli: Once we reach the cave's end, we'll enter the domain of Mt. Firmament. Proceed with caution.

title: To Mt. Firmament
content:
Rover: So it can't hurt me...
Changli: ...
[Dialogue Option]  Is this the effect of that strange time pattern you mentioned?
Changli: Time on Mt. Firmament used to simply flow slower than in the outside world. Visitors were safe as long as they remained within the Temporal Barrier.
Changli: But what we're seeing now is different. The flow of time has gone haywire. This is what we call the Temporal Disruptions...
Changli: What was once slow and steady has become chaotic and turbulent. Some areas are frozen in time, while others speed up or slow down unpredictably.
Changli: No one knows how much they'll age after leaving Mt. Firmament, but aging from youth to old age may be a blessing compared to the unknown fate that awaits.
Changli: Leaving Mt. Firmament could turn any mortal to dust in just a moment. Such is the power of time within its walls.
Changli: These poor creatures, trapped in the Temporal Disruption, are the most pitiful of all... Their bodies and minds have been ravaged by the chaotic time, leaving them in unimaginable suffering...
Changli: So, it looks like the Fractsidus did manage to capture our Sentinel, leading to the Temporal Disruptions we are facing now.
Changli: I had wished that my theories would turn out wrong...
Changli: ...As expected, my Terminal isn't working. We can't reach Jinhsi.
Changli: The Temporal Disruption is preventing it from functioning.
[Dialogue Option]  Jinhsi...
Changli: We can't waste a moment. Jinhsi's fate isn't the only one at stake—all the inhabitants of Mt. Firmament are in danger.
Changli: We need to hurry to Hongzhen, a town nestled at the heart of Mt. Firmament. Jinhsi would likely pass through there on her search for the Sentinel.

title: To Mt. Firmament
content:
Rover: The Temporal Disruptions have spared nothing on our way here...
Rover: Changli, does that mean you're in danger too?
Changli: So far, nothing feels out of the ordinary. It seems the Sentinel contained the situation before being fully trapped.
Changli: But I don't know how long this stability will hold.
Changli: Rover, if I go down... please don't worry about me.
Changli: You need only focus on what you have to do.

title: To Mt. Firmament
content:
Changli: Rover, if I go down... please don't worry about me.
Changli: You need only focus on what you have to do.



Changli: What's the matter, Rover?
[Dialogue Option]  I dreamed of this place...
Changli: You dreamed of Hongzhen?
You describe your dream from last night.
Changli: It sounds like you did dream of this place.
[Dialogue Option]  I dreamed of Hongzhen being attacked by TDs.
[Dialogue Option]  I dreamed of the Sentinel protecting people here.
Changli: What you just described closely aligns with the accounts documented in our Grand Library.
Changli: Over a century ago, a vast horde of Tacet Discords invaded Huanglong. Hongzhen suffered greatly during that onslaught.
Changli: Thankfully, the Sentinel descended, manipulating time to erect a protective barrier, keeping those monsters at bay.
Changli: Rover, perhaps... That dream is more than just a dream.
Changli: It could be a glimpse into your own past, and... a guiding light for the future.

title: To Mt. Firmament
subsection: (Rover and Changli hide from The Fractsidus)
content:
[Objective: (Rover and Changli hide from The Fractsidus)]
[Dialogue Option]  It's the Fractsidus.
Changli: Hongzhen is a pivotal location, linking various parts of Mt. Firmament. With the Fractsidus now targeting us, they'll seize any opportunity to intercept our path.
[Dialogue Option]  They've laid a trap in Hongzhen.
Changli: But every trap has its weak points.
[Dialogue Option]  What's this?
Changli: Someone has used their Resonance Ability here, but it feels different from the Fractsidus' aggression... It's Jinhsi.
Changli: And it seems like she used it in a dire situation. Could it be related to the people of Hongzhen?
Changli: The traces lead deeper into the heart of Hongzhen.
Changli: Let's keep moving, Rover. Don't let your guard down.

Changli: Using her Resonance Ability too much would only worsen her condition...
Changli: But she must have had a reason... Was she helping the people of Hongzhen find refuge?

Rover: Changli, there are traces here.

title: To Mt. Firmament
content:
Cautious Guard: You two! Halt!
??: Hold on.
Cautious Guard: Lady Xinyi...
Xinyi: Relax, they're our honored guests. No need to be tense.
Xinyi: In a single day, we've greeted both the Magistrate of Jinzhou and her trusted Counselor in Hongzhen. I can only assume something significant happened.
Xinyi: It's been a while, Changli.
Changli: I heard you stepped down from your position and moved to the countryside.
Changli: And now here we are, meeting again after all this time, in such unfortunate circumstances...
Xinyi: For years I lived secluded, no longer concerning myself with the matters beyond Hongzhen.
Xinyi: But the current situation in Jinzhou is volatile... It has reunited us in an unpredictable moment.
Xinyi: And you, young sir... What shall I call you?
[Dialogue Option]  {PlayerName}.
[Dialogue Option]  Rover.
Xinyi: My name is Xinyi. Pleased to make your acquaintance.
Xinyi: Please follow me this way. It's not safe to talk here.

title: To Mt. Firmament

content:
[Objective: (When player chooses to talk to the Hongzhen resident)]
Bing'ge: ...Please pardon my rudeness earlier. I... I didn't know you  were here to help Madam Magistrate.
[Dialogue Option]  I don't mind.
[Dialogue Option]  You were just doing your job.
Bing'ge: ...Thank you for your understanding.
Bing'ge: First the Temporal Disruption, and now the Fractsidus. When will we ever get a break... If trouble finds us again, our people won't stand a chance.
Bing'ge: Anyway, I still want to make it up to you.
Bing'ge: Just give me a call if you need anything at Mt. Firmament.

[Objective: (When player chooses to talk to the Hongzhen resident)]
Uncle Fu: You there, young man. I bet you have more important things to do. Don't let an old man like me hold you back. Go and accomplish your tasks with purpose.
[Dialogue Option]  What makes you think so?
Uncle Fu: My eyes may be old and blurry, but my mind is sharp as ever.
Uncle Fu: I've lived my whole life in Mt. Firmament, but people are all the same no matter where you go. Our actions reveal our true character.
Uncle Fu: And now, at this crucial turning point for Mt. Firmament, your arrival... Yes... It is no mere coincidence.
Uncle Fu: In these troubled times, you may hold the key to bring about much-needed change.

title: To Mt. Firmament
content:
[Objective: (When player follows Xinyi)]
Xinyi: I believe you are here for Magistrate Jinhsi?
Xinyi: The Magistrate left Hongzhen about fifteen minutes ago. She should be at the Truthseeker's Pass now.
[Dialogue Option]  The Truthseeker's Pass?
Xinyi: That's what they call it in Hongzhen. You might know it better as the ruins of a Court of Savantae facility.
[Dialogue Option]  What is Jinhsi doing there?
Changli: Lady Xinyi, please elaborate.

title: To Mt. Firmament
content:
[Objective: (Flashback starts)]
Xinyi: Madam Magistrate, are you...
Jinhsi: I'm... fine...
Jinhsi: How's the situation? Have we evacuated all the civilians?
Xinyi: Yes. Remaining civilians have been counted and escorted to safety.
Jinhsi: Good. These hidden chambers should provide some much-needed shelter for them to rest a little...
Jinhsi: Despite being the Sentinel's Appointed Resonator, I haven't been able to sense its presence for some time now...
Jinhsi: I can feel my Resonance Ability waning, and I get my power from the Sentinel. This can only mean one thing: the Sentinel's condition is getting worse.
Jinhsi: Lady Xinyi, I need to know where the Sentinel was last seen.
Jinhsi: I can only fix the Temporal Disruption within a confined radius. It's already pushing my limits to keep this small pocket of space secure.
Jinhsi: Mt. Firmament is in serious trouble, and we can't waste any more time. We need our Sentinel to stabilize the time flow.
Xinyi: The Sentinel was last seen flying towards Mianloong Chamber, where it would normally rest. The Fractsidus likely swarmed it soon after.
Xinyi: But little did they know, we had a defense system in place, built with the help of the Court of Savantae. It was reactivated as soon as our Sentinel made it back inside.
Xinyi: This mechanism has allowed us to locate their troops, and we've already eliminated some of them outside the Mianloong Chamber.
Xinyi: To get inside Mianloong Chamber, we have to find the Cipher Key in Truthseeker's Pass and unseal it with the Keyforge.
Jinhsi: Understood. I will go bring back the Cipher Key.
Xinyi: You are injured... Please rest and leave it to me.
Jinhsi: The Fractsidus will most likely attack this place once I leave. You must stay here and guard it.
Jinhsi: I implore you, Xinyi. Help me keep our people safe.
Xinyi: ...Yes, I will, Madam Magistrate.
Jinhsi: ...Before I headed to Mt. Firmament, the Fractsidus revealed a prophecy from our Sentinel: a fateful clash between the Sentinel and myself that would shape the fate of our city.
Jinhsi: I never intended to believe their baseless claims, but I was not surprised to hear it.
Jinhsi: The Sentinel had told me long ago that there would come a day when I surpass it in power. A day when the humans of Jinzhou take control of their own destiny.
Jinhsi: ...Once we save the Sentinel from danger, I intend to have a serious conversation with it about this prophecy.

title: To Mt. Firmament
content:
[Objective: (Flashback ends)]
Xinyi: ...And then she left.
Changli: There's still one thing that doesn't add up—How did the Fractsidus kidnap our Sentinel?
Changli: The Mianloong Chamber was once renovated by the Court of Savantae. Do you think their research could be involved somehow?
Xinyi: I'll look into what you said, but once we have the Cipher Key, the Mianloong Chamber will be left vulnerable to the Fractsidus' potential retaliation.
Changli: We must keep them at bay...
Changli: Rover and I are headed to the Truthseeker's Pass to meet up with Jinhsi. We'll distract the Fractsidus main forces, giving you an opportunity to stage your ambush.
Xinyi: And the locals will handle the rest.
Xinyi: I will send some men to open up the side exit for you. Head south and keep walking a couple of minutes, and you will see the Truthseeker's Pass downstream.
Changli: Thank you, Lady Xinyi. Please leave it to us.
Xinyi: ...In this place she was born, and in this place she returns. Our Magistrate's fate is bound to Mt. Firmament...

title: To Mt. Firmament
content:
[Objective: (When player goes outside)]
Rover: Did Xinyi and Jinhsi know each other?
Changli: Jinhsi was chosen as a baby for her Resonance Ability, and raised in City Hall to become the Sentinel's Appointed Resonator.
Changli: All the government workers there helped care for and teach her at some point, including Lady Xinyi.
Changli: She grew up with immense responsibilities, forced to suppress her true nature from a young age. Thinking back, Jinhsi was only a teenage girl when she became the Magistrate...
Changli: She has been burdened with unimaginable weight that most cannot fathom.

title: To Mt. Firmament
content:
[Objective: (When player arrives at Truthseeker's Pass)]
Rover: I assume this is the Truthseeker's Pass Xinyi mentioned.
Changli: Yes.
Changli: This should be another Chronosorter. It should work in similar ways with the one we saw near the Luminous Shore.
Changli: The entrance is built on that cliff, and it's been blocked...
Changli: We will need to break the three Photonvaults with ranged attacks first.
Changli: ...
[Dialogue Option]  What is it, Changli?
Changli: Nothing. I was wondering, how did the Court of Savantae create such an advanced mechanism using the Sentinel's power? Mortals aren't supposed to be able to comprehend it.
Changli: I've never heard of any human civilization having the ability to manipulate time.
Changli: Unless the Sentinel willingly taught them... But why?
Changli: We need to focus on items related to the Court of Savantae in Truthseeker's Pass. Maybe we can find some clues there.

title: Truthseeker's Pass (Quest)
content: Truthseeker's Pass is the seventh act in Chapter I of the Main Quests.

title: Truthseeker's Pass (Quest)
content:
At Truthseeker's Pass, you find another Chronosorter alongside three Photonvaults. Changli marvels at how the Court of Savantae managed to manipulate time to create such sophisticated mechanisms, noting that no other civilization has been able to replicate this technology. She speculates that this knowledge must have originated from the Sentinel.

The documents show that the Court of Savantae used Chronosorters to test the Second Resonance Awakening hypothesis, which suggests that colliding frequencies can unlock greater potential within a Resonator. You theorize that the prophesied conflict between Jinhsi and the Sentinel is intended to allow Jinhsi to acquire the ability to manipulate time through this Second Resonance. However, the experiments indicate that the Resonator's Overlocking may be necessary to attain this power.

title: Truthseeker's Pass (Quest)
content: You finally find Jinhsi, who appears greatly weakened. She has learned from the Court of Savantae's records that the Sentinel was injured upon arriving at Mt. Firmament, and its worsening condition is causing the increasingly unstable flow of time. With Jinzhou endangered, Jinhsi intends to verify the Court's claims for herself. If necessary, she is prepared to engage the Sentinel in battle to trigger a Second Resonance, even if it means risking her life.

title: Truthseeker's Pass (Quest)

You theorize that the prophesied conflict between Jinhsi and the Sentinel is intended to allow Jinhsi to acquire the ability to manipulate time through this Second Resonance. However, the experiments indicate that the Resonator's Overlocking may be necessary to attain this power.
