title: By Moon's Fated Light
subsection: Find Iuno and take her hand
content:
[Objective: Find Iuno and take her hand]
Rover: Once again, I repeat Iuno's past choice.

metadata.subsection: Find Iuno and take her hand

title: By Moon's Fated Light
subsection: Observe the surroundings and walk around
content:
[Objective: Observe the surroundings and walk around]
"Iuno": Over there, it looks familiar... Perhaps we can stop to take a breath and rest, if only for a moment.
[Dialogue Option]  You think there are Lunarum Boughs?
"Iuno": I don't know, but something about it is different.
"Iuno": I must've been there before and done something... something important.
"Iuno": None of the other places felt like this.
"Iuno": But why is it so ruined, so silent? There should be people, and more light, like how it was when it all began...
[Dialogue Option]  Let's go find out why this place feels important to you.

metadata.subsection: Observe the surroundings and walk around

title: By Moon's Fated Light
content:
[Objective: Defeat the manifestations of Chaos]
"Iuno": Be careful, they're closing in.
"Iuno": Huh... it really insists that I stay.
"Iuno": It's Chaos. It found us.
"Iuno": Those things... are manifestations of Chaos.

"Iuno": I... I remember now.
"Iuno": This place is where it all began.
"Iuno": It's also where it ended...
"Iuno": It's okay... Run...
"Iuno": Go there...

title: By Moon's Fated Light
content:
[Objective: Defeat the manifestations of Chaos]
Rover: Is that another one of Chaos's tricks?
Rover: Don't get in my way.
Rover: Got to hurry. Running out of time.
Rover: Now!
Rover: That way!
Rover: Go there? The Dark Tide is starting to surge...
Rover: Have to get there before I'm swallowed too.

(Cutscene plays)

(Cutscene ends)

title: By Moon's Fated Light
content:
[Objective: Enter the ruins]
Rover: (Manifestations of Chaos... Where is it taking Iuno? How can I find her?)
Rover: (Iuno wanted to come here... What did she remember? What's different about this place? When she said it's where it ended... does that mean it's the way out?)
Rover: (Did Iuno leave these lights to guide me?)

title: By Moon's Fated Light
subsection: Investigate around and look for clues
content:
[Objective: Investigate around and look for clues]
Gladiator Ethan: "Those cursed creatures! If it weren't for the Dark Tide... we would've killed them all already!"
Gladiator Aurora: "We couldn't activate the Anchor Stone before they destroyed it. Now it's over, everything's ruined..."
Gladiator Ethan: "Harelius, we shouldn't have come here. We've lost everything. The Priestess saw it all... What in bloody skies made her insist on coming with us?"

metadata.subsection: Investigate around and look for clues

title: By Moon's Fated Light
subsection: Investigate around and look for more clues
content:
[Objective: Investigate around and look for more clues]
Rover: (This calcification is severe. Such corruption... the Dark Tide's surge just now wouldn't be enough to cause this.)
Rover: (Could this be connected to the important event Iuno mentioned before she was taken?)
Gladiator Harelius: "First David and Lilian, then Ari, Vincentius, Perla... Now even Anassa. Please, Iuno, weren't you able to help us before?"
Gladiator Harelius: "Just like when you told us to use a spear against the Tacet Discord, help us see something again! You must be able to see something..."
Gladiator Ethan: "All of us, doomed to die? If that's true, why did you come with us... just to watch us die?!"
Gladiator Aurora: "No, the Dark Tide's corruption is spread too wide. It's covering their retreat, we can't catch them. The moonlight offered us some illumination, but—"
Gladiator Aurora: "Now it too... is being swallowed by the Dark Tide!"
Rover: Looks familiar... A Priestess's candelabrum？
Rover: How did it get so damaged?

metadata.subsection: Investigate around and look for more clues

title: By Moon's Fated Light
subsection: Investigate around and look for more clues
content:
Rover: Looks familiar... A Priestess's candelabrum？
Rover: How did it get so damaged?



(Cutscene plays)

metadata.subsection: Investigate around and look for more clues

title: By Moon's Fated Light
subsection: Investigate around and look for more clues
content:
Iuno: Fate unveils itself to the Priestess.
Iuno: Following its guidance.
Iuno: She reaches the end, again and again.
Iuno: Foreseeing its conclusion.
Iuno: Heads fall.
Iuno: Whimpers fade.
Iuno: She sees no Hero of Heroes.
Iuno: Variables added.
Iuno: Visions expanded.
Iuno: She sees no Hero of Heroes.
Iuno: Beyond a doubt.
Iuno: No other choice.
Iuno: She sees no Hero of Heroes.
Iuno: The Priestess is never wrong.
Iuno: But she despises her own truth.
Iuno: For her success is Septimont's defeat.
Iuno: Why... is it always defeat?
Augusta: "If fate one day wills our annihilation..."
Augusta: "If we are nothing more than fate's puppets..."
Iuno: When that time comes...
Iuno: What good is a Priestess?
Iuno: Septimont will be no more.
Iuno: Nothing will remain.
Iuno: Only she who foresaw every death still lives.

(Cutscene ends)

metadata.subsection: Investigate around and look for more clues

title: By Moon's Fated Light
subsection: Investigate around and look for more clues
content:
Iuno: Septimont will be no more.
Iuno: Nothing will remain.
Iuno: Only she who foresaw every death still lives.

(Cutscene ends)



Iuno: Why? Why... why?!
Iuno: Hundreds of days and nights spent in fate's embrace, staring at the end.
Iuno: I tried to see everything, missing nothing... but not once did I see a single future where Septimont still stands.
Iuno: So, this is the answer you give me—
Iuno: To know our inevitable doom, then tell the people of Septimont to wait for it, accept it, and even be grateful?
Struggling Gladiator: Priestess, what more do you hope to achieve?
Infatuated Samara: Priestess, what more can you do?
Clever Nikolas: Haven't you... already seen it all, plain as day?
Confident Priestess: Haven't you seen it countless times already?
Disillusioned Maia: Haven't you already viewed the answer?
Iuno: Yes, I saw it. A clear, undeniable future. I know... all I need to do is convince myself this is the final answer...
Iuno: But... how could I ever accept it?
Iuno: How could I be content?
Iuno: With our very existence being denied like this?
Iuno: Who are you to decide Septimont's fate?
Iuno: Certainty... is just the narrow boundary fate sets for us. The immeasurable, the free... That is where our dignity lies!
Iuno: A mouthpiece, a silent witness... Heh, if this is what you expect of me...
Iuno: I'll raise my bow and turn fate into a storm of possibility!
Iuno: If, just once, I can prove you are not fixed, then will this so-called "end" even—
Gladiator Harelius: Wait, Priestess Iuno... Are you really going to stand with us against the Dark Tide?
Gladiator Harelius: You've already... seen how it ends, haven't you?
Iuno: Of course.
Iuno: I'm doing this because it's what I want.
Iuno: The answer I seek is one only I can give.

metadata.subsection: Investigate around and look for more clues

title: By Moon's Fated Light
content:
[Objective: Approach the Lunarum Bough]
Bow-Forging Blacksmith: The Lunarum Boughs have grown strong. You've done well with your Anchoring.
[Dialogue Option]  How did you know I was doing that?
[Dialogue Option]  Who are you, really?
Bow-Forging Blacksmith: Look at you, a mortal from the real world stumbling into Chaos. What else would you be here for, if not to take something back with you？
Bow-Forging Blacksmith: Also, with that thing on your wrist there... Isn't it clear? That's how she's been connected to you all this time. Only Anchoring explains that.
Bow-Forging Blacksmith: As for your second question, that's even stranger.
Bow-Forging Blacksmith: Along the way, you met the Priestesses, Gladiators, and many others chasing prophecies... Did you ever stop to wonder who they were?
[Dialogue Option]  You gave me a strange feeling, so I asked.
[Dialogue Option]  You're the only one who doesn't clearly belong to any past.
[Dialogue Option]  You seem to know a lot more than you're letting on.
Bow-Forging Blacksmith: What is it you expect to hear then, mmm?
Bow-Forging Blacksmith: I'm a blacksmith, long dead. Once a forger of weapons.
Bow-Forging Blacksmith: A father to a daughter.
Bow-Forging Blacksmith: A reflection of her past in the Chaos.
[Dialogue Option]  So you can tell that I'm not really Iuno.
Bow-Forging Blacksmith: Aye. But just like the question of who I am, that's not the point.
Bow-Forging Blacksmith: What matters isn't me, but you. Isn't that right?
Bow-Forging Blacksmith: You noticed, didn't you? The more you rested near the Lunarum Boughs, the more memories and connections manifested into reality. Iuno's specter became more real, and the Boughs grew.
Bow-Forging Blacksmith: But now, Chaos has that specter. After all, it was never truly Iuno, was it? But the Lunarum Bough, that's what the two of you built along the way.
Bow-Forging Blacksmith: There'll be no more doors to choose from. You can keep the Bough and take it back with you. Find a new specter to follow. As long as you have it with you, that should be enough.
Bow-Forging Blacksmith: Or... do you still want to forge it into a bow?
[Dialogue Option]  Heh, still choices to make, but more intangible.
[Dialogue Option]  Aren't you asking me to make a choice now?
Rover: We were gathering Lunarum Boughs to forge the bow.
Rover: Just like... I came here only to Anchor her and bring her back.
Bow-Forging Blacksmith: If you cut it here, all your previous Anchoring will be for nothing. You might have to start over many times, with things going even less smoothly. Are you willing?
Bow-Forging Blacksmith: Not to mention, being trapped in Chaos for so long... There's a chance she's already forgotten her will to fight.
Bow-Forging Blacksmith: Are you sure you want to throw away all the certainty you've built, just to gamble on a possibility?
[Dialogue Option]  Isn't that what I've done from the start?
[Dialogue Option]  If I start over, maybe I'll do it better next time.
[Dialogue Option]  I'm sure. I have to try.
Rover: Forgotten... to fight? I don't know who you think she is, but the Iuno I know is not someone to give in so easily.
Rover: She promised we'd meet at the end. As long as Iuno needs a bow, I'll be the one to carry it for her.
Bow-Forging Blacksmith: Ha, I always thought you followed the light's guidance. Now I see, you reached this point because the light followed you.
Bow-Forging Blacksmith: How could I forget? The greatest archery isn't about hitting the target every time. It's about letting the arrow choose the mark. Wherever it lands, that's where destiny awaits.
Bow-Forging Blacksmith: I've said it before. I forge weapons. If you still want it, I'll forge the bow for you.
Bow-Forging Blacksmith: Come then. Let's do it.
Iuno: This is...
Iuno: Cough...
???: Iuno... Priestess Iuno...
Iuno: This again... My head's spinning, my arms and legs... It's like I'm underwater. So heavy...
Iuno: I saw Rover... at the divination altar at the agora... And then...
???: Go back, Priestess Iuno.
Iuno: Harelius? What are you doing here? Didn't Chaos just take me?
Iuno: This place must be... where I gave my last prophecy three years ago. At the end of the spring basin, where the Dark Tide surged!
Gladiator Harelius: Priestess Iuno, we're already indebted to you for accompanying us on this journey.
Gladiator Harelius: But you've seen how it ends. Our squad is doomed... The others and I are fated to fall here. There's no need for you to risk your own life any longer.
Gladiator Harelius: Return to Tetragon Temple. That's where you should be. I too... will go where I should be.
Iuno: ...Words fit for the abyss. Don't you dare underestimate me.
Iuno: Where to go, what path to take... That's something only I decide!

title: By Moon's Fated Light
content:
[Objective: Defeat the Dark Tide creations]
Weak Gladiator: Are you... the Priestess Harelius spoke of?
Exhausted Gladiator: Thank you... Back there, closer to the surge... They need...
Iuno: Don't push yourself. After what you've just been through, it's enough that you're still on your feet.
Iuno: Treat your wounds first. Leave the backup to me.

title: By Moon's Fated Light
subsection: Support the Gladiators in the depths of the Dark Tide
content:
[Objective: Support the Gladiators in the depths of the Dark Tide]
Injured Gladiator: Th-thank you... I feel much better. I can still—
Iuno: Definitely not. You're too wounded. Before worrying about them, make sure they don't need to worry about you.
Iuno: I know what you're planning. I'll go in your stead.

metadata.subsection: Support the Gladiators in the depths of the Dark Tide

title: By Moon's Fated Light
subsection: Reach the end of the battlefield
content:
[Objective: Reach the end of the battlefield]
Iuno: Cowardly, blighted bastards! Always hiding in the Dark Tide...
Iuno: Then I'll send you right back into it!

metadata.subsection: Reach the end of the battlefield

title: By Moon's Fated Light
subsection: Protect the Gladiators on the field
content:
[Objective: Protect the Gladiators on the field]
Gladiator Harelius: Ugh... Cough, cough... Priestess Iuno, thank you...
Gladiator Harelius: You... And all of us... Have done well...
Iuno: I will not let you fall!
Iuno: This is pure torture... How can I let it end like this again...

(Cutscene plays)
(Asset: M0296)
Again, as always...
But why... Would I just stand by and watch you, accept you, complete you?!
No. Even if the end is here, unavoidable, I still have the right to refuse.
The Lunarum Bough has grown strong...
From now on, I need no one's guidance—
Because wherever I choose to aim is my true destiny!
(Cutscene ends)

metadata.subsection: Protect the Gladiators on the field

title: By Moon's Fated Light
content:
[Objective: Eliminate the Dark Tide creations]
Iuno: Look closely. Before you isn't a moon the Dark Tide can devour...
Iuno: It is a moon I command!
Iuno: I made myself the arrow so you will answer to me! No escape. No retreat. No way out!

(Cutscene plays)

I told you I'd rewrite the ending you changed!
(Cutscene ends)

title: By Moon's Fated Light
content:
[Objective: Talk to Iuno]
[Dialogue Option]  You look... completely restored.
Iuno: Yes. We've come out of the Chaos between life and death, between existence and non-existence.
Iuno: There aren't any guiding traces, no visions of fate's hand. It's just you and me and... our own grasp of what's to come.
Iuno: Compared to before, now what we see is...
[Dialogue Option]  An unwritten void.
Iuno: Yes. Stretching as far as the eye can see, an infinite... void. More vast than what I saw within you, or anything I glimpsed in the future.
Iuno: So this is what our changed ending looks like?
Iuno: No longer an indeterminate chaos, or a singular answer given by someone... but an infinite sea of possibility awaiting choice.
Iuno: It seems like there's nothing, but in truth, there's everything. So this is the true meaning of a void.
Iuno: Now... it's time to leave this place.

title: By Moon's Fated Light
subsection: Leave the Chaos and return to the real world
content:
[Objective: Leave the Chaos and return to the real world]
(Triggered upon reaching the designated location.)
Rover: Wait... Why is it only me?
Rover: Where's Iuno?!
Rover: (The way into Chaos has closed. Lillibet's not here either. Did the Anchoring fail? Or is it not over yet?)
Rover: (But Iuno and I made it to the very end. Does this mean... this is the new ending I created?)

metadata.subsection: Leave the Chaos and return to the real world

title: By Moon's Fated Light
subsection: Ride the Wingray and return to the Hunter's Den
content:
[Objective: Ride the Wingray and return to the Hunter's Den]
For a moment, you can't quite tell...
Were those times with Iuno real... or just a dream?

metadata.subsection: Ride the Wingray and return to the Hunter's Den

title: By Moon's Fated Light
content:
[Objective: Find Grandmother Lillibet]
Rover: (I don't see Lillibet anywhere. I'll ask those Priestesses over there.)

title: By Moon's Fated Light
subsection: Talk to the Priestess and ask about the situation
content: [Objective: Talk to the Priestess and ask about the situation]

metadata.subsection: Talk to the Priestess and ask about the situation

title: By Moon's Fated Light
content:
[Objective: (Idle)]
Doubtful Priestess: Don't you think it's odd...
Surprised Priestess: Grandmother Lillibet also said...
Doubtful Priestess: Don't you think it's odd? Even if we can't see the next part of Septimont's Auguries, it still shouldn't be such a white blank?
Surprised Priestess: Grandmother Lillibet also said that for the first time, some of her records in Septimont's Auguries were rewritten...
[Dialogue Option]  Seems like some things changed, after all.
Surprised Priestess: Yes, it's like there's a whole new part to the story... Huh? Wait, aren't you who they call the Unwritten One?
Doubtful Priestess: This is our first time meeting you in person.
[Dialogue Option]  I'm looking for Grandmother Lillibet.
[Dialogue Option]  Do you know where Grandmother Lillibet went?
Doubtful Priestess: She returned not long ago. She was here just now... Oh, I think I know where she went. Underground.
Doubtful Priestess: I don't know why, but things just keep happening today.
Doubtful Priestess: Apparently, that Avidius locked up below overheard the Priestesses talking about some prophecy and escaped, just like that.
Doubtful Priestess: I think Lillibet must've gone to handle the situation.
Surprised Priestess: No, that's not it. Avidius wasn't being locked up. He chose to stay here. If he wanted to leave, Lillibet wouldn't worry about him.
Surprised Priestess: I think she was called away to the celebration?
Surprised Priestess: Ah yes, I saw a girl with two blue... or was it black, ponytails. Grandmother Lillibet went to the celebration with her.
Doubtful Priestess: That makes sense. It must've started by now then! Before the oration ends, Lillibet would definitely need to be there.
[Dialogue Option]  (Ponytails...)
[Dialogue Option]  (Did Iuno make it back?)
Rover: Do you know... who Iuno is?
Surprised Priestess: Iuno? I don't think I've heard that name before. Do you mean that's the girl we're talking about?
Surprised Priestess: Apologies, I didn't have a good look at her...
Doubtful Priestess: We've only just become Priestesses. There is much we still don't know about this land. Maybe she was Iuno?
Doubtful Priestess: If it's important, perhaps you might try looking for her at the celebration?

title: By Moon's Fated Light
subsection: Ask about what happened to Iuno
content:
[Objective: Ask about what happened to Iuno]
Ceremonial Officer Bruno: Drinks, fine food, orations... The Rosebearers milling about... Yes, everything is just perfect! Hm, Rover?
Ceremonial Officer Bruno: I was just saying how the celebration is nearing its most glorious part. You've come here... for more petals to hand out?
Ceremonial Officer Bruno: Or would you like me to recommend another interesting part of the ceremony?
[Dialogue Option]  Neither, actually. I'm looking for someone...
[Dialogue Option]  Do you know a girl called Iuno?
Ceremonial Officer Bruno: Ah... the name has a lovely ring to it, but I'm afraid I don't.
Ceremonial Officer Bruno: In a celebration this grand, it's easy to get separated... I'll keep an eye out for her for you.
[Dialogue Option]  Have you seen a girl with dark blue ponytails?
Ceremonial Officer Bruno: Ponytails, dark blue... My apologies, but I don't think I have.
[Dialogue Option]  I see. Thanks, I'll try my luck elsewhere.

metadata.subsection: Ask about what happened to Iuno

title: By Moon's Fated Light
subsection: Ask about what happened to Iuno
content:
[Objective: Ask about what happened to Iuno]
Veteran Elder: Oh, it's Rover, eh? How've you been holding up?
Veteran Elder: Since you've kept your distance from the Dark Tide, how're things? The bow, the girl... those daydreams of yours get any better?
[Dialogue Option]  Kept my distance? I even went right back into it.
[Dialogue Option]  Daydreams? You still don't seem to remember Iuno.
[Dialogue Option]  Have you seen a girl with dark blue ponytails?
Veteran Elder: Hmm, let me think. Plenty of fresh faces here. But dark blue ponytails... Ah, I think I saw a girl like that!
Veteran Elder: She walked like a cat, as nimble as they come... Seems she was looking for someone, too? She was just over there...
[Dialogue Option]  I'll head there now!

metadata.subsection: Ask about what happened to Iuno

title: By Moon's Fated Light
content:
[Objective: Reunite with Iuno]
Valiant Gladiator: Come on over! Toast!
Outspoken Gladiator: Let's drink till we drop!
Worried Noble: We should just live in the moment and enjoy what we have now...
Helpful Noble: That's more like it!
Ceremonial Officer Bruno: Come, triumphant rain of petals...
Ceremonial Officer Bruno: Make it even grander...
Rover: (Didn't you tell me we would meet at the very end? Then why can't I find you...)
Iuno: I could hear your voice from a distance, "Iuno, Iuno!" Wasn't that it?
Iuno: Seems like you're in an awful hurry to find someone.
[Dialogue Option]  You little... Do you know how worried I was?
Iuno: I thought you'd like this, us slipping back into our old, familiar rhythm... Now you know I'm still me. And yes, I really am back.
[Dialogue Option]  Back to cracking jokes. Guess we're good now.
Iuno: Exactly. See? I come right away and stand before you, in the flesh.
[Dialogue Option]  Okay, now's the time to talk.
Iuno: It's just like you saw at the end of the Chaos. Three years ago, at the end of the spring basin swallowed by the Dark Tide, I, as a Priestess, made my choice.
Iuno: I was so done with just being dragged along by the moon's whims... So I defied fate, severed the path, and became the arrow that struck at destiny itself.
Iuno: After that, I lost the ability to see clear visions of the future, but in return, I gained the power to anchor the Dark Tide's creations.
Iuno: With that, the last prophecy I saw changed slightly. In a squad doomed to fall, one survived—Harelius.
Iuno: If I can do it once, then I can do it a second time, then a third... Perhaps one day, I can overturn more destined futures.
Iuno: Since fate didn't prepare a Hero of Heroes, we decided to eliminate the need for one by taking on the disaster at its source—the Sovereign and the Paradise.
Iuno: This is the plan Augusta and I made, though I did hide the teeny tiny cost.
[Dialogue Option]  Your disappearance.
Iuno: Anyway, all the Septimontians who were supposed to die are still alive. The end I once foresaw has changed. The meaning of this has already transcended my own existence.
Iuno: So then, even if every trace of my "existence" was erased, who can say that the altered fate I left behind isn't proof of my existence?
Iuno: More importantly, I had the privilege of standing by your side to witness what lies beyond the end. The void. An unwritten... void. Perhaps it signifies the unimaginable possibilities yet to come.
Iuno: Just like you, bringing unknown possibilities to Septimont... and to me.
[Dialogue Option]  Let's make sure there's no next time.
Iuno: Why, sacrificing myself? Or just trying something I'm not sure about?
Iuno: Come now, you know me... I follow my whims. And the more I trust someone, the harder it is to keep my impulses in check.
Iuno: I'm not one to make promises I can't keep, but I'll promise you this... if there is a next time, you'll be the first to know.
Iuno: And when I do, you'll get the full story. No holding back.
[Dialogue Option]  Do the people remember you now?
Iuno: I've run into a few friends since being back. Not one of them recognized me.
Iuno: Guess the memory of the Iuno they once knew is just... the price we had to pay.
Iuno: But, at least... you still remember me. You pulled me from the Chaos and brought me back to existence. That's enough.
Iuno: Oh, I'm certain Augusta and I, along with the rest of them, will be thick as thieves again, this time creating new futures. You really shouldn't underestimate my charm!
Iuno: Oh yes, and this bracelet...
Iuno: This is the second time I've given this to you. Never mind the first time, but I wouldn't refuse a second time, if I were you.
Iuno: Being the second time means there's been a change... Now, it's a testament to our secret little interactions. I've Anchored the world, and you, you've Anchored me.
[Dialogue Option]  (Accept the bracelet and put it on.)
[Dialogue Option]  (Accept the bracelet and put it away.)
Iuno: As for any matter pertaining to me... What you saw in the Chaos and what transpired, do not breathe a word of it to another soul. Understand?
[Dialogue Option]  Feeling bashful all of a sudden?
Iuno: Hmph, bashful? Hardly! If you blurt it out, it would cause quite a stir. All that explaining would be too much hassle.
Iuno: Besides, to them, I am... quite the anomaly. If the truth came out, the first reaction would be shock.
[Dialogue Option]  It will be our little secret then.
Iuno: You think so too? Okay. Good. I'm most relieved.
[Dialogue Option]  That so? I'll keep it in mind.
Iuno: You think so too? Okay. Good. I'm most relieved.
Iuno: Well, then again, this is a perfect opportunity to start anew.

title: By Moon's Fated Light
content:
Iuno: You think so too? Okay. Good. I'm most relieved.
Iuno: Well, then again, this is a perfect opportunity to start anew.



Iuno: In Septimont, it would be a crime to miss the height of the celebration.
Iuno: After fighting side by side, we share honey and wine under a rain of petals, drinking to our hearts' content... Surely you've heard of this little tradition of ours, haven't you, Unwritten One?
Iuno: Come on, let's go. Together... to be drenched in those rose petals that smell of glory and triumph.
(Quest complete: By Moon's Fated Light)

title: By Moon's Fated Light
subsection: Located at the lake with the blue tree in Asphodel Barrens, where Iuno disappeared
content:
[Objective: Located at the lake with the blue tree in Asphodel Barrens, where Iuno disappeared]
Iuno: We meet again, Unwritten... Hmm, yes.  Unwritten .
Iuno: So? Did you come all this way just to gaze at the moon, or to steal a glimpse at Septimont's most brilliant Priestess... me?
[Dialogue Option]  You always seem to follow the moonlight.
Iuno: Who's to say it isn't the moonlight that follows me?
[Dialogue Option]  I had a feeling I'd find you here.
Iuno: Where one thing ends, another begins... Clever of you to find me here.
[Dialogue Option]  Unwritten... It's been a while since anyone called me that.
Iuno: Do you not like it? Aw, how tragic! Unwritten, Unwritten. Oh, Unwritten...
Iuno: Well, I'm the only one who calls you that, so.. too bad for you! You'll just have to grin and bear it, won't you?
[Dialogue Option]  You seem to enjoy this place.
Iuno: Enjoy it? Perhaps a little.
Iuno: Before I faded away completely, I fired Moon Arrows across the wilds, anchoring the Dark Tide's creations wherever I could. Each time, I felt more of myself slip away.
Iuno: People's impressions of me blurred, too. They started forgetting where they'd seen me last. Over time, rumors spread that I never left Tetragon Temple.
Iuno: But I've always hated rules. All that order, that dull obedience... suffocating. So whenever it became too much, I'd come here. To watch the moon.
[Dialogue Option]  So what makes this place different?
Iuno: There's more than one moon here. There's one above… and the one in the water. Tell me, which one do you think is harder to reach?
Iuno: I know it's impossible. But still... I try. Again and again.
Iuno: Can't help it. I  am  a genius, after all. Refusing to lose just comes with the territory… so does winning.
Iuno: As for this moment... Stay and watch the moon with me. I'll share a little of its light. Consider it my gift to you.
[Dialogue Option]  Another one...? I thought that was what the bracelet was for.
Iuno: I told you, I'm quite generous. Especially with you. One gift? Hah. That would hardly be enough.
[Dialogue Option]  If you're the one requesting, how could I say no?
Iuno: ...Eh? What are you talking about? I absolutely wasn't  requesting  anything! You... do you even understand what... Ugh, never mind!
Iuno: Anyway... the moon is especially beautiful tonight, don't you think?

title: By Moon's Fated Light
content:
[Objective: (At Hunter's Den)]
;Little Chiani Mother, there's something I want to tell you...
;Little Chiani I found the person I want to be with forever!
Still Infatuated Samara: Oh, another one? Let me guess... Benny from next door?
Still Infatuated Samara: Or is it that pretty Sigurd boy you couldn't stop talking about?
Still Infatuated Samara: If my math's correct, this makes the sixth one this month.
Little Chiana: Hmm... I think you're right. But they are all very nice!
Little Chiana: Benny always shares his candy, Certus helps us with math, and Markus... he's super strong!
Little Chiana: And the most important thing is, they all say it was wrong for Father to leave us! They'd never do what he did!
Still Infatuated Samara: So that's what this is about?
Still Infatuated Samara: Oh, come here, let me hold you!
Still Infatuated Samara: I'm sure your friends are all wonderful, but forever is a long, long time, and you're still young... It's still too early for you to understand what love really is.
Still Infatuated Samara: Still, I love that you see the best in people. No matter what happened between your father and me, I just want you to be happy!

title: By Moon's Fated Light
content: The line "So, Sibylla's Iuno, am I correct?" is incorrectly translated. The original text is 「你可是……西比尔家的尤诺。」, which translates to "You are... Iuno of the Sibylla family." This could imply Sibylla is Iuno's surname or stating that Sibylla is Iuno's family.

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content: The Bygone Shall Always Return is the Tenth Act in Chapter II of the Main Quest.

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content: Rover returns to Ragunna City to investigate strange disturbances tied to the Dark Tide. They confront powerful Tidespawn, explore the mysterious Civilization Capsule and uncover deeper hints about the rising threat of The  Threnodian Leviathan, and face off against a corrupted Gladiator known as the Mad King: Caligula (Avidius). Along the way, allies and enemies alike wrestle with memories, fate, and the shadows of their past as the story pushes toward the larger looming crisis in Rinascita.

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content: Quest Objective: To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content:
[Objective: Return to Ragunna City]
Abby: Long time no see, Ragunna!
Abby: Mmm—mmm—! Can you smell that? Sweet o' Margherita's Restaurant. C'mon, c'mon, let's go stuff our faces already!
Rover: Let's take care of important matters first. You'll eat well soon, I promise.
Abby: Yeah, yeah, I know. We're here to find Cartethyia!
Abby: I still can't believe Tethys couldn't unlock the Sentinel's Relic we found in Septimont...
Rover: At least now we know it's called the "Civilization Capsule." It probably holds key legacy data left behind by the Sentinel.
Abby: Like some ancient data recorder, right? But Tethys said to unlock it we'll need... the Leviathan's power.
Abby: If it's really from the Sentinel, why do we need the Threnodian's power for that?
Rover: Maybe because they fused together at some point...
Abby: Oh well, guess that's why we need to find Cartethyia. Maybe she'll know a workaround...
Abby: The Black Shores warned that the waters in Ragunna are acting weird again. Gotta be extra careful.
Abby: And you know... something feels off in the city too. It's not as cheerful as when we left it.
[Dialogue Option]  I think things do feel more tense.
Abby: Yeah, and they just threw a huge Carnevale not long ago too...
[Dialogue Option]  Might just be the weather.
Abby: Hmm... you might be onto something.
[Dialogue Option]  There is a sorrow in the air...
Abby: Uh... since when did you get all poetic?
Roccia: Amid howling winds, rising storms, and ghosts adrift, I heard the captain's call—
Abby: Look! Over there! Isn't that Brant and Roccia? Wow, the Troupe of Fools is putting on a show!
Brant: Hoist the sails, O humanity! The abyss and the summit have entwined. Your only path now is forward, bold and uncharted!
Brant: You stand on the precipice. Now is the hour to decide your fate—to plant the seed of your highest hope and watch it bloom into tomorrow.
Roccia: Captain, why do you burn alone in your own flames?
Brant: If you do not first become ashes, how will you rebuild?
Brant: Embrace your fire. Embrace your grief. Go into your solitude! I love those who dare to create, who strive to transcend, for in doing so, their old selves are destroyed. Yes, so they might reach the shores of a new life!
Roccia: To journey onward is perilous. To stand still is perilous. To look back is also perilous. To tremble and falter... is perilous.
Roccia: Now, I begin to understand what truly makes a hero great. It is to stand before humanity's deepest sorrow and its highest hope.
Brant: Oh, how I love those whose souls remain rich and vast, even when wounded. Even when the smallest risk could spell doom, they leap without hesitation into the unknown.
Brant: Should you stand alone, suffering in the endless dark... Today, may you hold fast to every last ember of courage and hope!
Onlookers: Bravo! Bravo!
???: Life... is but a walking shadow.
???: A poor player, who struts and frets his hour upon the stage... and then is heard no more.
???: It is a tale told by fools, full of sound and fury... Signifying nothing.

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content:
[Objective: Explore ahead]
Rover: Where... am I?
Rover: That was Cristoforo's voice just now... Is this another one of his illusions?
Rover: Buling's bronze mirror isn't responding... Abby?
Rover: ...No answer. This isn't like what happened in Septimont. Guess I can only keep moving and find out why.

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content:
[Objective: Explore ahead]
[Dialogue Option]  Carlotta?
Cristoforo?: Mistaking rebellion and recklessness for glory, like an inferior gem made precious only by how it glitters. Yes, even the castoffs of lesser branches can earn admiration if they shine bright enough.
Cristoforo?: She couldn't control the monstrous family legacy, so she turned to bravado. An armor crafted to hide her naivety and fear.
Cristoforo?: Fragile. False. But oh, how brilliantly a gem shines... in the instant it shatters.

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content:
Cristoforo?: Fragile. False. But oh, how brilliantly a gem shines... in the instant it shatters.



[Dialogue Option]  Brant?
Cristoforo?: Ah... He plays the role of captain. I have a theory. Tell me, do you think a performer will ever realize that he is part of a grander play?
Cristoforo?: He mistook his role for his true self, blind to danger and death alike. In the end, he led his crew... straight into the abyss.
Cristoforo?: Burning passion is but a beautiful kind of madness. When the curtain falls, he'll stand trial before the flames of his own arrogance.

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content:
Cristoforo?: Burning passion is but a beautiful kind of madness. When the curtain falls, he'll stand trial before the flames of his own arrogance.



[Dialogue Option]  Cantarella?
Cristoforo?: Gentleness born of delusion. A beautiful, sorrowful fantasy. She tried to confront an ancient curse with blind devotion and silence...
Cristoforo?: But fear has eaten away at her soul. Illusion stripped her of freedom. And her tears have long since left her nowhere to hide.
Cristoforo?: What she needs is not light, but a long, dreamless sleep.

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content:
Cristoforo?: What she needs is not light, but a long, dreamless sleep.



[Dialogue Option]  Augusta?
Cristoforo?: A valiant and determined ruler... On the battlefield where life and death collide, a faint ember lingers. Flickering, barely alive.
Cristoforo?: Conquest and slaughter walk hand in hand. Sooner or later, she will be consumed by the very sun that nurtured her.
Cristoforo?: Beyond her throne lies nothing but withered bones. If she cannot endure such loneliness, then she must learn to descend her own steps and enter "their world."

[Dialogue Option]  Iuno?
Cristoforo?: The phases of the moon wove her luminous gaze, yet she insists on using that light to peer into fate's menacing face.
Cristoforo?: Her eyes were destined to be burned. All who overstep cannot escape its wrath.
Cristoforo?: Now, neither she nor her moon will ever be whole again.

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content:
Cristoforo?: Now, neither she nor her moon will ever be whole again.



[Dialogue Option]  Phoebe?
Cristoforo?: A pure heart blindly devoted to a deity on the verge of extinction...
Cristoforo?: Yet the true eternal Divinity embraces all. It washes away everything, be it joy or sorrow or hope or obsession.
Cristoforo?: She realigned her faltering faith, and in doing so, claimed her "redemption."

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content:
[Objective: Explore ahead]

Cristoforo?: Amid the endless cycle of surging tides, she plunges into fate's swirling maelstrom once more.
Cristoforo?: Soon, she will wear a new crown—one ordained by fate, never to be defied.
Cristoforo?: Her fate was written long ago. What remains is but a fleeting moment of stolen peace.
Cristoforo?: What you see before you... is fate itself.
Cristoforo?: And now, with every step you take, you stir the tides into motion.
Cristoforo?: Is it fate that rules over man, or man who commands fate?
Cristoforo?: I await your answer to this question...

Rover: Cristoforo... He won't sway me. I've got to keep going.

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content:
[Objective: Explore ahead]
Rover: What is this place?
Inscribed Words: Through me, walk the Path of Glorious Ascension... Through me, enter the City of Eternal Bliss... All who enter... must first forsake all Hope.
Rover: (These Tacet Discords... why aren't they attacking?)
Devotees: Harbinger... Open... The gates of Paradise for us...
???: You'd better leave. This place... isn't leading to any "salvation."
???: Leviathan, I will deliver you... "her death."

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content:
???: You'd better leave. This place... isn't leading to any "salvation."
???: Leviathan, I will deliver you... "her death."



Brant: Rover... Rover!
Roccia: We could try this... "Nightmare Awakener"—
[Dialogue Option]  I'm up, I'm up!
[Dialogue Option]  Good, you're all okay...
[Dialogue Option]  I think I saw Paradise...
Abby: You're finally awake, Rover! One second I'm fine, the next my head's spinning and you're face-down on the ground...
Rover: I'm fine. What I saw, though…
[Dialogue Option]  (Recount what you saw)
Brant: Hmm... Sounds like the same thing happening to the people here.
Brant: From what I've heard, many Ragunnesi have been having peculiar dreams lately. Even some of our Troupe members too.
Brant: The details vary, but they all end the same way... the fall of Rinascita.
Brant: And it's not just in dreamland either... Rover, I'm not sure if you've heard, but there have been strange rumors appearing across Rinascita lately.
Brant: Even in Septimont, folks claim they've seen Tacet Discords not of this land in the wilds, or the ghosts of their ancestors.
Roccia: Thanks to all these oddities, the mood in Ragunna has gone sour.
Roccia: The Troupe performed today because Brant thought a new play to lighten the mood might give the people some hope.
Brant: But here's the odd part. Only Rinascitans seem to be having these dreams. Visitors are spared... the same should be true of you.
...
[Dialogue Option]  Have any of you had similar dreams?
Roccia: Well... Not Brant or me. But someone in the Troupe has. They said they dreamed of sinking into an enormous, black ocean...
[Dialogue Option]  Have you seen other anomalies like this?
Brant: The Tacet Discords in the Stormy Sea have been more restless lately. And the "siren's" songs? Well, they've started sounding an awful lot like the Order's hymns...
[Dialogue Option]  I'll get to the bottom of what's happening.
Brant: We'll keep gathering intel on our end. Might be worth asking around the city to see who else has been experiencing this.
Brant: Rinascita's tides don't lie. Watch your back, Rover.
Rover: (What were those Tacet Discords whispering about? Gates of Paradise... and the word "Harbinger." Could they mean the "Harbinger of the Dark Tide"?)
Rover: (The only "Harbinger of the Dark Tide" is Fenrico. But he should still be sealing the Dark Tide at the Order's Fabricatorium...)
Rover: (That figure I saw... and Cartethyia's murder...)
Rover: (I came back to find her, so I should look for her first. She might know what's at the root of all this.)

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content:
[Objective: Talk to Ciaccona and Amedeo]
Amedeo: "Slowly they join the crowd pilgriming toward the kingdom rising in the dark waves… Those blessed by the sea are ever doomed to bear its curse."
Amedeo: He cursed the Ragunnesi with a broken sonnet. No, more than that... He cursed all of Rinascita! Now, his curse is coming true...
[Dialogue Option]  Is he alright...?
Ciaccona: Hello, Rover! Haven't you heard? Lately, the Ragunnesi have started having "nightmares." That's probably what he's referring to...
Amedeo: In my dreams I saw things... monsters I've never seen before...
Amedeo: Maybe it's because I've had my nose buried in that "mysterious playwright's unfinished draft"... those hobgoblins, banshees, and beasties are all carved into my mind now...
Amedeo: I thought it was just a dream. Just… imagination. But then… one day, in the wilds… By the Sentinel, I saw one. Every infernal detail exactly as I dreamt it!
Amedeo: The playwright conjured illusions with words. Summoned ghosts, stitched nightmares into verses, turned phantasm into flesh! These are HIS verses... HIS CURSES!
Amedeo: Think about it! Monstrous fiends once trapped in myth and sonnet are now strutting on stage! He planted the seeds... centuries ago...
[Dialogue Option]  That mysterious playwright...
Ciaccona: Mmm… sounds like a perfect premise for a ballad. I wouldn't mind meeting some of these storybook monsters myself.
Amedeo: Miss Ciaccona… you… you're not afraid of them?
Ciaccona: Our souls are as eternal as theirs. How could they possibly harm us?
Ciaccona: Besides, if the play is still unfinished, then the ending is ours to write, isn't it?

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content:
[Objective: Talk to Zani and Nevana]
(Triggered by the "Talk" interaction.)
Nevana: Miss Zani… I'm so sorry. I'll head back right away…
Zani: No worries. If you're feeling low, it's good to step out and get some air.
Zani: Ah, buongiorno, Rover. If you're here for banking... you'll have to wait.
[Dialogue Option]  Did something happen to her?
Nevana: Thank you for your concern... I just had a vivid dream... about my grandmother who passed away some time ago.
Nevana: When I woke up, I could still SEE her, sitting right beside me. Her smile was gentle... just like when I was little. She used to sing me to sleep with lullabies…
Nevana: I told her how much I missed her, and she listened quietly, just like always. Then she stood up and said goodbye.
Nevana: I saw her walk through a door. I tried to follow, but she stopped me. She said, "Don't follow me. And don't go gently through those gates." Then I woke up... again.
Nevana: Was it a dream within a dream? Or was it a vision pulled from a memory? But her face, her voice... it all felt so real...
Zani: .... I get it. I'll handle your desk. Go home. Take the day to rest.
Nevana: Thank you, Miss Zani. But I think... my grandmother was trying to tell me something. That I can't stay trapped in grief and the past.
Nevana: So I'll keep going with today's work. Sorry to worry you all.

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content:
[Objective: Talk to Phoebe and Vivian]
Vivian: Acolyte Phoebe, "Paradise"... It really exists...
Phoebe: But...
Vivian: I saw it in my dreams. It was a revelation from the Sentinel...
[Dialogue Option]  A revelation from the Sentinel...?
Phoebe: Oh, hello there Rover. May the Sentinel's grace be upon you.
Vivian: Rover... you're the Laureate of the Carnevale! That means you've heard the Sentinel's voice too! You can help me prove it, can't you?
Vivian: My dreams must be divine revelations! I saw it all, the "City of Eternal Bliss" and "Path of Glorious Ascension." It was so clear...
Vivian: That kingdom is the afterlife. They told me that to gain entry, one needs only forsake all hope and call Their name...
[Dialogue Option]  But surely not everyone can enter the "true Paradise"...?
Vivian: …You're right to remind me. We mustn't forget the Sentinel's teachings to live righteously here in the mortal world.
Vivian: Acolyte Phoebe, let's hold fast to that. We will reach that "Kingdom of Eternal Bliss."
Phoebe: I've always believed "Paradise" was real, but...
Phoebe: If it is truly sacred and beautiful... why ask us to "forsake all hope" to enter?

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
subsection: Ride the Wingray to the Inverted Tower
content:
[Objective: Ride the Wingray to the Inverted Tower]
Rover: Is that... Cantarella up ahead?
