title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content:
[Objective: Talk to Cantarella]
Cantarella: Rover? What brings you back to the Inverted Tower so suddenly?
Rover: Something's come up. I need Cartethyia's help to deal with it.
Rover: Did something unusual happen here?
Cantarella: I've only just arrived. For now, everything appears to be in order. I didn't come because of any disturbance.
Cantarella: There are matters I, too, need to discuss with Cartethyia...
BANG—!

(Cutscene plays)
(Asset: DA_M0304)
(Cutscene ends)

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content:
Cantarella: There are matters I, too, need to discuss with Cartethyia...
BANG—!

(Cutscene plays)
(Asset: DA_M0304)
(Cutscene ends)



Rover: Cantarella...?
Abby: How could this happen...
[Dialogue Option]  ...It all happened so fast.
[Dialogue Option]  ...I'll make her pay. Blood for blood!
Rover: That woman...
???: Leviathan, I will deliver you... "her death."
Rover: (Why… Why does this scene match what I saw in that dreamland?)
Rover: Her Tacet Mark... Look, it's flickering! Cantarella, she's...
Cantarella: ...No. Something's wrong. It's strange... I can't sense any frequency from her, and yet...
Cantarella: She is still resonating with... something.
Abby: A Resonator's frequency is usually gone when they die, right? This doesn't make any sense.
Rover: There's something even stranger...
[Dialogue Option]  Cartethyia's sword.
Rover: Cartethyia had her sword in hand... With her strength, how could she fall to an intruder like that? And... it doesn't look like she even tried to resist.
Cantarella: The Sword of Divinity, sealed with a portion of the Sentinel's power... Could what we're seeing be a result of that power of separation being awakened?
[Dialogue Option]  The shattered stained glass.
Rover: …The Inverted Tower itself is a sealed Sonoro. Only the Fisalias know it exists. So how did she find it?
Rover: And she broke through the stained glass from the outside. Physically, not by tearing through the Sonoro Sphere. But Cartethyia has complete control over the Tower. If someone had intruded, would she really not have noticed?
[Dialogue Option]  The shell casings on the floor.
Rover: Spent casings... These traces, could they be from the Dark Tide?
Abby: You bet they are! I'd know that stench anywhere. And I caught the same frequency on that freak who jumped out earlier.
[Dialogue Option]  None of this is adding up.
Rover: ...Cantarella, you never did get to say what brought you here.
Cantarella: Cartethyia reached out to me with an urgent matter to discuss. She gave no details, only insisting that I come at once.
Cantarella: With the strange phenomena stirring across Ragunna, I feared it might be linked to the Dark Tide. Or Leviathan.
Rover: (Was what I saw... really just an illusion? I saw this... her death, exactly as it's happening now.)
Rover: (That woman... she was using Dark Tide energy. Could she be another Harbinger?)
Rover: ...Whatever the case, we need to find the one who did this. I want answers.
Cantarella: Leave Cartethyia to me. I'll bring her back to the Fisalia estate and keep her safe. The rest… I entrust to you.
[Dialogue Option]  Abby, can you track the killer's frequency?
[Dialogue Option]  Abby, can you track the Dark Tide's frequency?
Abby: Heh, this nose? I could track the Dark Tide blindfolded! Let's follow the stench and hunt down this killer!
Abby: That's weird. The trail ends here, but... Ugh... My head's starting to spin again...
Rover: It's the Dark Tide's energy messing with you again. You can rest, I'll search the area.
Rover: Abby? Asleep already... That drowsiness should've worn off by now. Another side effect of the Dark Tide?
Rover: Since leaving the Inverted Tower, Ragunna's sky... what happened to it?
???: Spear of Glory... pierce through!
???: Slipped away again.
Avidius: By this spear, I vow to protect my allies and crush the hearts of the evil.
Rover: Avidius? What are you doing out here?
Avidius: What any Gladiator of Septimont is born to do—hunting.
Avidius: But you, Your Grace… You vanished without a word. What brings you back in such a hurry?
[Dialogue Option]  After what happened before...
[Dialogue Option]  Tell me what you're doing here first.
Avidius: That's a long story. Let's speak of more pressing matters. Are you after the Thundering Mephis as well?
Rover: No. I'm tracking someone else.
[Dialogue Option]  (Describe Cartethyia's killer.)
Avidius: Silver hair and violet eyes... cloaked in cursed, shadowlit flame. So you seek the one they call "Discord Slayer (TD Hunter)."
Rover: Discord Slayer? Sounds like you know something about her.
Avidius: Yes, she's on my radar. I suspect the recent Tacet Discord outbreak in Ragunna City is tied to her presence.
[Dialogue Option]  Wait, Ragunna City was attacked by a TD Outbreak?
Avidius: Your Grace hasn't heard? It struck not long ago.
Avidius: I had gone there in search of the "Quillbearer." While gathering information, the city was suddenly overrun... To be precise, they looked more like "spawn of the Dark Tide."
Avidius: The outbreak has since been contained, but the Genesis Nexus was damaged. Without it, Common Echoes can't be used, and Ragunna is no longer secure.
Avidius: The Montellis and the Order agreed to evacuate all civilians to Averardo Vault, where Private Echoes can still be deployed. It's the only way to protect them.
Rover: (A TD Outbreak, right after I left... But while I was there, I didn't even sense a ripple.)
Avidius: The Thundering Mephis has fled! The path ahead is safe!
Resident of Egla Town: Thank you for your help, Gladiator! Averardo Vault isn't far from here. We can handle the rest of the journey!
Avidius: Now, about the Discord Slayer you seek. The townsfolk shared some troubling whispers.
Avidius: She may call herself that, but witnesses have seen her alongside swarms of Tacet Discords, leading them like troops into battle.
Avidius: What's more, many have confirmed that the unrest across Ragunna coincides exactly with her appearances. The time and place match perfectly.
Avidius: I even crossed paths with her on the road to Ragunna. I sensed a malicious frequency we both know well—the Dark Tide.
[Dialogue Option]  That very frequency is what led me here.
Avidius: Of course. Even if she didn't cause the outbreak in Ragunna City, the connection is undeniable.
Avidius: The Dark Tide is Rinascita's ancient enemy. If you're hunting her, allow me to join you and lend my aid.
Rover: Do you have any leads on her whereabouts now?
Avidius: If I'm correct, the Thundering Mephis we encountered is also a Dark Tide creation. This frequency it left behind…
Avidius: We can track it, and from there, draw out the Discord Slayer herself. To that end, we'll need this.
Rover: An Anchor Stone? You brought that all the way from Septimont?
Avidius: Ha... A habit picked up on the hunt. You're no stranger to its use either, Your Grace.
Avidius: Looks like I'm fortunate to be hunting alongside you again, Rover.

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content:
[Objective: Defeat the Tidespawn]
Avidius: Take note. Enemies ahead.
Avidius: ...Dark Tide creations. Grant them the oblivion they deserve.

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content:
[Objective: Investigate the Dark Tide's traces]
Avidius: What a hollow existence. Who "scripted" your delusions?
Rover: You mentioned you left Tetragon Temple to search for the "Quillbearer" here in Ragunna, right?
Avidius: I grew weary of waiting. When I heard rumors of his presence in Ragunna, I came to find him myself.
Avidius: No trace of him yet, but I've learned this much—Here, no verses were ever penned about me.
Avidius: The Ragunnesi know not my name, past, nor the prophecy I once carried. Here... I am a completely blank page.
Avidius: If my former "existence" was just a fabrication, an idea of some Hero of Heroes crafted to "Septimont's expectations"...
Avidius: Then perhaps here in Ragunna, I am free to write my own story. Free to define my own "existence." Free to create a reality of my own.
Avidius: This... this matters more than finding him. I will break free from his narrative and become the master of my own destiny.
[Dialogue Option]  Well said.
[Dialogue Option]  Now you're starting to sound like a true ruler.
[Dialogue Option]  I prefer you like this, honestly.
Rover: Your fate is what you want it to be. No one else gets to decide who you are.
Rover: No one has the right to dismiss your efforts and dreams with some absurd idea of destiny. You'll find your own Truth. I know it.
Avidius: You honor me. I hope to prove worthy of that belief.

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content:
[Objective: Track the Dark Tide's frequency]
Avidius: The Anchor Stone is holding strong. Let's push forward.
Avidius: Our destination is up ahead...
Avidius: Is that an entrance to a Paradimensional Tacet Field?
Avidius: Ragunna's geographical records haven't documented this...
Avidius: Do you feel that? That ominous energy... the Anchor Stone confirms the Thundering Mephis is hiding here.
[Dialogue Option]  Let's prepare to enter it.
[Dialogue Option]  That's our best lead right now.
Avidius: Very well. I stand with you. Whatever comes, you have my sword.

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content:
[Objective: Defeat the Tidespawn]
Rover: What happened? Where's Avidius? We crossed inside at the same time.
Rover: It's the Thundering Mephis.
Tidespawn: Thundering Mephis: ...Open... the gates...
???: So you just barrel in without thinking...
Rover: That voice... the Discord Slayer? Is this her trap?
Rover: Another illusion...
???: Focus. You are in an illusion. It's weaponizing your combat instincts.
???: Steady your resolve. Do not let its whispers sway you.
Rover: The pain and hallucinations are fading... Is she helping me?
???: Good. See that Cocoon in the center? The Thundering Mephis is just bait. That right there is the core of this domain.
???: Destroy it. Then the monster and this illusion will unravel together.
Rover: It worked... But—
Rover: Who are you?! And what did you do to Cartethyia?
???: ...Now is not the time for stories.
???: But I'll tell you this. I'm here to kill the Harbinger of the Dark Tide. To stop a greater calamity.
Rover: I can't hear her voice anymore... Time to leave this place.

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content:
[Objective: Talk to Avidius]
Avidius: Rover! Are you unharmed? You vanished the moment we entered the Tacet Field.
Rover: I'm fine... So, it's gone? Avidius, did you see anything after we got separated?
Avidius: The Thundering Mephis was nowhere in sight. But I did observe a peculiar figure.
Avidius: I couldn't see his face clearly, but I heard him call himself... Caligula.
[Dialogue Option]  Caligula...?
Avidius: Caligula was a tyrant feared throughout Septimont's history. Notorious for his cruelty that defied reason, the world remembers him as the "Mad King."
Avidius: Legends say he wielded a vile black Resonance energy, and the worst calamities ever stirred by the Dark Tide all began with him.
Avidius: He didn't fight it. He embraced it. Commanded its abominations. Bent them to his will. In the end, the people rose against him... and struck him down.
Avidius: But not before he left a curse: "I shall become the very history and memory of Septimont. So long as fear lingers in your hearts, I shall return."
Rover: (The power to command the Dark Tide's creations... Only a Harbinger could do that.)
Rover: (That Discord Slayer said she's hunting a Harbinger to stop a greater calamity. If that's true, then everything happening across Ragunna might be tied to the Harbinger.)
Rover: (She pulled me from the illusion. If she's the cause of this chaos, why help me?)
Rover: (This isn't making sense. Harbinger... who are you, really?)
Avidius: Rover, traces of the Dark Tide's frequency still linger where the Paradimensional Tacet Field collapsed.
Avidius: The Anchor Stone is useless now. The signal is blocked by some sort of spatial layer.
Rover: Augusta said the Dark Tide spoke to her when it swallowed her whole. Maybe... I can learn something that way.
Rover: My telepathic ability should give me a way in.
Avidius: Telepathy? Your Grace is versed in many arts. I don't doubt your abilities, but this is the Dark Tide. Reckless contact could—
Avidius: I don't want to see... another tragedy like what befell Septimont.
[Dialogue Option]  Let me at least try.
[Dialogue Option]  It's just a meeting of minds.
[Dialogue Option]  I won't make direct contact.
Rover: We're falling behind. The Discord Slayer knows far more than we do. We need to find her, and fast.
Rover: I'm not letting any leads slip past us.

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
subsection: Use telepathy on the Dark Tide
content:
[Objective: Use telepathy on the Dark Tide]
Distorted Whispers: ......
Rover: I can't see anything... I'm only getting jumbled voices.
Rover: Focus. I should be able to hear something.
???: Okay, everybody listen. Don't panic. Take the lift. It will bring you to safety...
???: The prototype Echoes in the depositories... Activate them all...
Rover: Those voices... Zani and Carlotta?
Rover: They're in Averardo Vault. The Dark Tide creations could be appearing there.
Avidius: It's currently sheltering a large number of civilians...
Rover: Let's not waste time. We leave now.

metadata.subsection: Use telepathy on the Dark Tide

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content:
[Objective: Talk to Carlotta]
Carlotta: Zani, status of the evacuation?
Zani: Eighty percent of Ragunna's residents have been relocated.
Zani: But... the Troupe of Fools hit a storm while ferrying people from the Riccioli Islands. Rough seas out there.
Carlotta: Trust them to see it through.
Montelli Member: Miss Carlotta! We've cleared the depositories as ordered. Ready to receive incoming supplies.
Carlotta: Good. Rinascita's greatest treasure has always been the people who built it. The next Cloudpuffer Express is due at any moment. Be ready to offload.
Montelli Member: Understood, ma'am!
Carlotta: Rover.
[Dialogue Option]  Anything unusual happening here?
Carlotta: If you mean the incident in Ragunna... You've likely already heard. A horde of Tacet Discords has overrun the city, and Common Echoes are out of control...
Zani: Evacuation here is still on track. No anomalies detected in Averardo Vault… yet.
Zani: Your assistance is appreciated, Sir Avidius. The residents from Egla Town have all been accounted for.
Avidius: I am simply fulfilling my duty.
Rover: (Strange... I clearly sensed the Dark Tide's presence around here. So why does everything seem normal?)
BANG—!
Zani: Gunfire. We've got intruders.
???: These Tidespawn... They've evolved fast. Mutation? Or...
???: And sure enough...
Zani: Entering a restricted zone armed, without triggering a single alarm...
Carlotta: Be careful. Her abilities... are not normal.
Avidius: ...All this? By her hand?
[Dialogue Option]  All this in broad daylight? Brazen.
[Dialogue Option]  Let's not jump to conclusions just yet.
???: Fiction and reality are starting to blur. Don't put your faith in appearances.
???: That... is what they really are.
Avidius: The Dark Tide can corrupt, and you carry its power. What proof do we have this isn't your doing?
???: You don't. Believe whatever you want.
???: By the sacred statues of the Divinity, evil shall know no peace. Only the righteous may taste eternity. Wickedness shall be purged by the blade, and those who consort with calamity shall fall...
Fenrico: Galbrena, demon wrought from ruin! You are not welcome here.
Rover: (Fenrico...? Why would he be here?)
Fenrico: You have slaughtered my flock and ushered in ruin. The Sentinel's wrath is already upon you. I will cast you back into damnation myself before your carnage spreads any further.
Fenrico: You should be howling in the Styx's depths, your soul aflame in the pit's cruelest fire... forever.
Galbrena: If you're offering me a shortcut back to hell, I'd honestly appreciate the favor.
Fenrico: Your heart holds no reverence for the Divine. Only... desecration and scorn.
Fenrico: Demon, your sins are ripe for judgment. By the Highest Will's command, I shall strike down all that you have wrought. Justice shall be done!
Rover: (She could've dodged that... but she took the hit to shield a civilian?)
Rover: (And Fenrico... he knew innocents were here, but didn't hold back at all...)
Fenrico: Righteous One, I come to cleanse Rinascita of a traitorous demon and avenge the blood debts of my people. Why raise your blade against me?
Fenrico: Rinascita teeters on the edge of collapse. Now, more than ever, we must uphold the tenets of Unity and Salvation.
Fenrico: The path to deliverance lies within the Civilization Capsule. Entrust it to me. By the authority bestowed upon me, I will open... the gates to the divine Paradise.
[Dialogue Option]  You shouldn't be here, Fenrico.
[Dialogue Option]  I never told you about the Civilization Capsule.
[Dialogue Option]  They might not know, but I do. You're the Harbinger.
Rover: Unless... You're not Fenrico at all. You... Who are you? What do you want?
Fenrico: ...Bloodshed cannot be avoided. Blood must pay for blood. The path born of injustice must be fortified with further transgressions.
Fenrico: My goal is pure. Singular. All I've done, I've done so Rinascita survives the Divine reckoning and rises as a land free from sorrow.
Fenrico: No understanding is needed. Only faith. When all hope seems lost, I... no, we are the beginning and the end. The absolution. And the grace.
Fenrico: Hand over the Civilization Capsule.
Galbrena: ...So the Civilization Capsule is your goal after all. Lost your patience, have you?
Fenrico: Death is the fruit of transgression. To resist it is to defy the will of the Divinity.
Galbrena: You? You and your Divinity cannot end me...
Galbrena: And these Dark Tide shams... Today, you face your reckoning.
Fenrico: I am the Enlightened One, anointed by the Divinity and crowned by Fate itself.
Galbrena: Huh, so you're the "core" of these abominations. Took long enough to hunt you down. Still pretending that mask isn't cracked?
Fenrico: Mocked by fate, whispering poison, a demon reviled by all! You wield the Dark Tide's power, yet you dare judge me?
Galbrena: It's too bad I'm not the one judging. If the Dark Tide's power isn't enough to convince... How about we try this?
Galbrena: "The Envoys declare the guilt, but Imperator is the only true judge…"
Galbrena: By the Light of Imperator... REPENT!
Avidius: It's... the Light of Genesis?
Galbrena: Looks like the judgment is clear.
Galbrena: These hollow existences (Tidespawn) don't need your mercy.
Galbrena: Protect the Civilization Capsule. That's what they're really after.

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content:
[Objective: Defeat the Tidespawn]
Zani: How were they able to disguise themselves as humans?
Avidius: I've never heard of any possessing such abilities...
Carlotta: Their fangs are bared now. Don't hesitate. Let's end them all.
Galbrena: The one mimicking the Primus is the heart. Take it down, and the rest will collapse with it.
Zani: It's calling in more of them... We'll need to clear the rabble while waiting for our shot.
Alpha Tidespawn: That which cometh from the sea... Shall walk upon the land...
Alpha Tidespawn: It shall work great wonders and mark the flesh of Its faithful...
Alpha Tidespawn: All who have ears to hear... Let them hear...

??? (False Sovereign): Avidius, you have received the blessing of my Master. Serve... your true Divinity.
Avidius: I shall never...
Avidius: Back down!
Avidius: Rover, now!

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content:
[Objective: Explore the Civilization Capsule]
Rover: Another dimension... within the Civilization Capsule.
Rover: But why does it open up now? Was it when Avidius and I made contact?
???: Arbiter...
Rover: Is that Imperator's voice? Imperator... do you have more to tell me?
Imperator: Permissions detected—Arbiter.
Imperator: Lifting imposed restrictions...
Imperator: Arbiter. This moment was always foreseen. Now, it comes to pass...
[Dialogue Option]  Imperator... is that really you?
Imperator: Arbiter, I grieve to say... I am but a message, set to activate in response to the presence of an Initiator.
Imperator: Time, in this place, flows near still. A moment remains for us to speak.
Imperator: When I merged with Leviathan, It seized a fragment of my mind... and with it, a trace of my power to separate.
Imperator: I knew not the fullness of Its design. As a safeguard, I split elements of my core data into this space... the Civilization Capsule.
Imperator: It records the origin and birth of the Rinascitan civilization, preserving their most ancient memories.
Imperator: Once, we drafted the first Blueprint (fate) for these seaborne kin. Now, I have entombed it here.
Imperator: First Instance initiated. All probabilistic futures now revealed...
Imperator: Outcome verified. Blueprint compiled. Advancing to Phase Two.
Imperator: Commencing simulation. Attempting civilization fit: Rinascita...
Imperator: Arbiter, heed me now... let me unveil... Rinascita's beginnings...
Imperator: In the beginning...
Imperator: Life rose and fell with the tide
Imperator: The displaced and wandering
Imperator: did follow My guidance
Imperator: They journeyed unto the archipelago
Imperator: There, I did leave Knowledge and Technology (Genesis Nexus)
Imperator: that they might walk the path to freedom
Devout Citizen: Your light blesses us...
Praying Villager: We follow Your will...
Admiring Villager: To build our republic...
Imperator: "Unity"
Imperator: became the bedrock of civilization
Imperator: But Leviathan seized upon mankind's "longing for Unity"
Imperator: to manifest the civilization's shadow
Imperator: It spoke in My name
Imperator: Wrought false miracles
Imperator: Forged hollow grace
Imperator: Feeding on stagnant, obedient minds
Confused Villager: We are blessed by the sea...
Deranged Villager: By You, we are "unified"
Deranged Villager: By You, we are "born"
Delirious Villager: From the sea we came
Delirious Villager: and to the sea we shall return
Imperator: From the founding of civilization
Imperator: It had invaded their spirit and beliefs
Imperator: I rose against it
Imperator: Only to unleash the Dark Tide
Imperator: It scarred Rinascita beyond measure
Imperator: I... began to question
Imperator: all I had done
Imperator: The Threnodian doth steer Rinascita's fate
Imperator: and I too, once guided Rinascita's course
Imperator: In truth... We were no different
Imperator: We both sought to mold civilization after Our own will
Imperator: Those who truly walked the land
Imperator: were never granted the right to choose
Imperator: Civilizations are bound with Threnodians
Imperator: No eternal solution doth exist
Imperator: Have I the right...
Imperator: to choose their fate?
Imperator: The shaping of a civilization
Imperator: must belong to its people

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content:
Imperator: Have I the right...
Imperator: to choose their fate?
Imperator: The shaping of a civilization
Imperator: must belong to its people



Imperator: Only the people can decide where their future must lead.
Imperator: What followed, thou already knowest. I allowed the Threnodian to exist. I chose coexistence, using Myself to shackle It. I partook of Its blight, that I might comprehend It.
Imperator: Once, I did seek thy counsel. Thou granted me... the freedom to choose.
[Dialogue Option]  I would do the same thing again.
[Dialogue Option]  You've done more than enough. Let me handle the rest.
Rover: I just have one question... Why did the Civilization Capsule need the Threnodian's power to open?
Imperator: When Leviathan and I were one, I split a sliver of Its frequency... a "memory." That memory I sealed here.
Imperator: The Capsule was ever meant for thy hands. My design was that it should open only in the presence of thou and the Resonator bearing both My power and that of Leviathan.
Rover: What if... that Resonator became the Threnodian's puppet?
Imperator: If that came to pass, then Rinascita hath already fallen. And the truth within this Capsule would cease to matter.
Imperator: But if she standeth with humanity, then this truth is hers to know. And thine.
Imperator: Leviathan was born from the dark side of mankind's "longing for Unity." Their fear of the sea shaped Its likeness as a great sea creature.
Imperator: Even at civilization's dawn, It had already tainted mankind's hearts. A primeval shadow lurking within the soul.
Imperator: The opening of the Capsule shall stir the Rinascitans' oldest memories. Leviathan shall seek, through the Blueprint we created, to lay claim to Rinascita's fate anew.
Imperator: If the Rinascitans... wouldst walk a path "free of Divinity," they must face their past and "the most primeval fear." They must overcome the "shadow born of civilization."
Imperator: Arbiter... the hour of farewell hath come. Go now. Gather every last hope... If all unfoldeth as it should, Rinascita shall be free of Divinity henceforth.
Imperator: When the shadows of the soul are at last dispelled, Rinascita shall welcome a true dawn. And humanity... shall have a future beyond any I could foresee.
???: The true faithful believed in Imperator. So too did Imperator believe in humanity.
[Dialogue Option]  (Draw your sword.)
Rover: You killed the Blessed Maiden before my eyes. Ragunna's disasters are tied to your actions... Now, tell me what I need to know.
Galbrena: ...If I told you I acted to save Cartethyia, would you believe me?
Galbrena: This place is protected by Imperator. For now, Leviathan can't hear us. This... is for you.
[Dialogue Option]  (Keep your sword sheathed.)
Rover: You killed the Blessed Maiden before my eyes. Ragunna's disasters are tied to your actions... Now, tell me what I need to know.
Galbrena: ...If I told you I acted to save Cartethyia, would you believe me?
Galbrena: This place is protected by Imperator. For now, Leviathan can't hear us. This... is for you.
Cartethyia's Frequency: Rover, trust her. And trust me... Everything we've done... is to... defeat... Leviathan...
Rover: That is her frequency...
Galbrena: I need you to accept this. Cartethyia is "dead," but she may still "return." For that to happen... we need to kill Leviathan.
Rover: Kill Leviathan? Didn't she absorb It when they merged?
Galbrena: Now... Leviathan is on the verge of "rebirth."
Galbrena: It stole some of the Sentinel's power. During your battle with the Blessed Maiden, It split off a trace of Its frequency and hid it in a Gem. I'm sure you've seen it.
Galbrena: That Gem ended up in the Fractsidus's hands. Their whole play in Rinascita? Use it to bring back Leviathan.
[Dialogue Option]  It's always that group of lunatics...
[Dialogue Option]  I didn't think Leviathan would be that insidious...
Rover: So the Fractsidus has been incubating the Threnodian... How long has this been going on?
Galbrena: Perhaps longer than we can imagine. Even your clash with Cartethyia may have been scripted. A setup to give Leviathan a shot at slipping the Sentinel.
Rover: You know about that? Just who are you, Discord Slayer? I can't imagine Cartethyia keeping something that important from me.
Galbrena: Think of me as what I am... an avenger hunting Leviathan. As for the rest...
Galbrena: The next Harbinger of the Dark Tide has surfaced. Until we find him or her... we keep this quiet to avoid the worst-case scenario.
Galbrena: Our first priority is to find them. If we don't, the Dark Tide can overwhelm Ragunna again at any moment.
Rover: You're saying this Harbinger is behind all the Dark Tide creations we're seeing?
Galbrena: Not all. The Harbinger resonates with Rinascita's darkest emotions. Those emotions act as Anchors, pulling horror into form and speeding the tidespawn.
Galbrena: If the emotion is strong enough, and the Harbinger is near... Those things "evolve." They feed off the Harbinger's thoughts and memories to become more real. Some even start to look... human.
Galbrena: You've noticed it. The Tidespawn in Ragunna are starting to mimic us. Which means...
[Dialogue Option]  The Harbinger is in Ragunna.
[Dialogue Option]  We may be close to the Harbinger.
Galbrena: Exactly. I've always hunted the Dark Tide's creations—each one shares slivers of thought and memory. I kill them, and I take what they know.
Galbrena: They've been watching you. They want the Civilization Capsule. So... I followed you. Tracked your movements, figured if I stayed close, sooner or later I'd find the Tidespawn's "core." Maybe even the Harbinger.
Galbrena: The Capsule only unlocks with both the Sentinel and Threnodian's power, and it opened the moment you and that Gladiator touched it, so...
Rover: You think it's Avidius? But you carry the Dark Tide's power too...
Galbrena: Caution is a virtue in a hunter. You're right. The Dark Tide is in me... But Leviathan stopped counting me among the living a long time ago.
Galbrena: And this power... It's mine now. Who I turn it against is my choice.
Galbrena: You're welcome to try and stop me. But me? I'm not stopping this hunt any time soon.
Galbrena: When calamity strikes, I trust... you'll know exactly where to point your blade.
[Dialogue Option]  I'll trust you. For now.
[Dialogue Option]  I trust Cartethyia's judgement.
Galbrena: Heh... good. Then hunt with me. Until we give Leviathan a death worth talking about. Loud, messy, unforgettable.
Galbrena: The Sentinel's frequency is gone. I guess the time for talking is over. Leviathan's power is spreading, and this space is about to collapse. We need to find a way out.

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content:
[Objective: Defeat the Tidespawn]
Rover: These things... They're all Tidespawn.
Galbrena: The Civilization Capsule was tainted by the Dark Tide. That's how I got in... followed the corruption straight through.
Rover: So you can enter the Dark Tide. No wonder we couldn't find you.
Galbrena: Yes, but the frequencies there are chaotic. I locked onto yours and followed it through the storm.
Galbrena: You have access to core data. But Avidius, he might've been swept into the frequency vortex. Hard to say where he's landed.
Galbrena: We need to move fast to find him. Figure out who he really is before the next wave of Tidespawn hits.

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content:
[Objective: Escape the Civilization Capsule]
Galbrena: The exit is at the end of this wind trail. Stay on it.

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content:
[Objective: Escape the Civilization Capsule]
Galbrena: The collapse is accelerating. Our way out is closing fast...
Galbrena: Faster. We're almost there...
Carlotta: Rover! Good... looks like you haven't run into too much trouble.
[Dialogue Option]  How long was I gone?
[Dialogue Option]  What happened when I was gone?
Carlotta: It hasn't been long since you disappeared into the rift. Once that thing masquerading as Fenrico was slain, the other Tidespawn didn't last.
Zani: That was the last one. With the family's Private Echo arsenal backing us up, we held the line just fine.
Carlotta: Surely you didn't think we'd fall apart without you? We Ragunnesi are made of sterner stuff than that. We handled those creatures just fine.
Galbrena: This Feilian Beringal... When the "core" was destroyed, the other Tidespawn lost their form. For now, the Vault is secure. At least until the next wave spawns.
Galbrena: I'd set up Order Terminals around the perimeter though. They'll detect humanoid mimics and prevent new Tidespawn from forming here.
Carlotta: Might I ask...
[Dialogue Option]  She's an ally for now.
[Dialogue Option]  You can trust her.
Galbrena: Where's that Gladiator from Septimont?
Zani: Sir Avidius made it out of the rift before you.
Zani: But... he didn't look great. Kept muttering about needing to "stop the crisis," then off he went, like a man on fire.
[Dialogue Option]  We need to track him down.
[Dialogue Option]  That one really knows how to pick his moments...
Galbrena: ...Give me your hand.
Galbrena: I left a mark on Avidius during our fight earlier. With Balor's (the Tacet Discord "Beholder") power, I can tap into his sight. We'll find his trail.
Avidius: I must... move quickly...
Avidius: Silence, you maddening whispers!
Avidius: No... I'll be damned before I accept a fate like that...
Avidius: There must be something left I can still do...
Avidius: I won't let the same tragedy... happen twice...
Rover: ...He's headed for Thessaleo Fells.
Carlotta: We've lost contact with Cantarella. The Beacon on her end appears to have been destroyed.
Zani: Dark clouds are gathering over Thessaleo Fells... Something is definitely wrong.
[Dialogue Option]  The two of us will go reinforce her.
[Dialogue Option]  You stay and protect the civilians here.
Carlotta: ...Very well. We'll hold the line. Zani, call in the family's transport Echoes. We'll assist Rover where we can.
Galbrena: Don't complicate things. Put those Echoes toward supply runs instead.
Galbrena: Stay close. We're taking the sky route.

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content:
[Objective: Head to Thessaleo Fells]
Rover: Manipulating the air to form a wind trail... Is that your Resonance Ability?
Galbrena: One of them. I have the Tacet Discord Harpyia (half-bird half-woman) within me.
Rover: Not an Echo, but a Tacet Discord itself... So you can absorb them directly?
Galbrena: You can say that. Balor is one of many.
Rover: One of many... Now I'm really curious about you and your abilities.
Galbrena: If we live through this, maybe I'll tell you. But right now...
Rover: We need to find the Harbinger. Do you know how we can identify them?
Galbrena: First things first, they'll be corrupted by the Dark Tide. But the signs aren't always so visible.
Galbrena: We'll have to look for associated side effects, and prepare for what they might bring.
Galbrena: We've entered Thessaleo Fells. I can already sense the Tidespawn up ahead...

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content:
[Objective: Head to Thessaleo Fells]
(Triggered upon reaching the designated location.)
Rover: That's... a Fisalia member! We need to help him!

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content:
[Objective: Defeat the Tidespawn]
Fisalia Member: Ah, it's Rover! Thank the Sentinel!
Rover: What happened here?
Fisalia Member: Dark Tide creations swarmed without warning. We were overrun before we could—
Galbrena: Move aside. We'll clean up.
Fisalia Member: Thank you! Lady Cantarella is still on the frontlines fighting. Would you please help to reinforce her position?

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content:
[Objective: Find Cantarella]
Gilberto: It's too late, my Lady... My mind... can't be fixed. Save your potions for those who still have hope...
Gilberto: I only beg... don't let me die a monster. Don't let me become Leviathan's puppet...
Gilberto: GhhhaaAAAAGH—! I see it... The End Times... Paradise... descending at last! AHAHAHAHA!
Cantarella: Rover... She is... Why are you with her?
[Dialogue Option]  Trust me. I'll explain later.
[Dialogue Option]  Let's handle the crisis first, and I'll explain later.
Galbrena: ...The Fisalia bloodline's ties with Leviathan run too deep. Their ancient fears were the first to be awakened.
Galbrena: This is the true horror of the evolved Dark Tide. It feeds on human despair, warping that frequency to form Tidespawn.
Galbrena: Your family's "antidote" can still cure those lightly infected. But for those whose corruption runs deep, like him... Their frequencies cannot be reversed.
Galbrena: All we can offer is the dignity of dying as a human.
Gilberto: My Lady... don't let me burden... those who still have hope...
Galbrena: Matriarch of Fisalia, I understand the cruelty of such a choice. If you cannot strike the final blow... allow me.
Cantarella: ...Fisalia blood must be ended by Fisalia hands.
Gilberto: Thank you... May glory return to the Fisalias...
[Dialogue Option]  Gilberto...
[Dialogue Option]  Cantarella...
Cantarella: The dead rest. The living march forward... The Fisalia will never forget its fallen sons and daughters.
Cantarella: Cartethyia remains secure in the Fisalia estate. But the Divinity's statue began whispering in our minds... Then came the Tidespawn soon after.
Cantarella: It was Leviathan's voice. Something has... awakened It.
Galbrena: It's very likely Avidius. Right now, everything is riding on us finding him.
Cantarella: That Septimontian Gladiator... Our scouts saw him advancing into the depths of Thessaleo Fells.
Phoebe: Lady Cantarella! Rover! Reinforcements have arrived!
Phoebe: Thessaleo Fells... It's already... Attention! Deploy all Acolytes to set up temporary Resonance Beacons. Scattering the Light of Genesis will hold back the Tidespawn!
Resolute Acolyte: Acolyte Phoebe! A cluster of Tidespawn is marching toward the depths of Thessaleo Fells！
Galbrena: Rover, Avidius is our mission.
Cantarella: I'll use my Forte to diffuse the family's antidote. It should help to mitigate the Dark Tide's influence.
Phoebe: We'll triage the wounded and fortify this position. The Order's Acolytes will clear a path for you. Please, you have to stop this!
Resolute Acolyte: Whether the Sentinel comes or not, we are Their will made flesh! We protect Rinascita!
Fearless Acolyte: O Light of Genesis, shield us! As we were at the dawn, so we stand today as the Sentinel's soldiers!

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content:
[Objective: Find Avidius]
Galbrena: The Order's Acolytes are holding off the other Tidespawn. This is our chance to go straight for the source.

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content:
[Objective: Talk to Despondant Fisalia Member]
Despondant Fisalia Member: Damn it... Is this all I can do? Just stand here... and watch my friends die in front of me?
Despondant Fisalia Member: ...Rover, thank you. Truly. But... if I may, can I ask you something?
Despondant Fisalia Member: I understand why they chose to resist the Threnodian, even if it meant death. But after everything I've seen... Tell me, how do you carry on in the face of so much loss?
Despondant Fisalia Member: What keeps you going? What is it that... What is it that you hold onto?
[Dialogue Option]  I mourn their sacrifice too, but...
[Dialogue Option]  To honor their sacrifice, we have to keep fighting.
[Dialogue Option]  To build a world without sacrifice, we have to keep fighting.
Despondant Fisalia Member: So that's what you believe... Thank you for sharing that...
Despondant Fisalia Member: You're right... My friends wouldn't want to see me like this, so hopeless and defeated...
Despondant Fisalia Member: Even if I'm dragged into the Dark Tide itself... I'll make damn sure I tear a piece out of the Threnodian first!

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content:
[Objective: Talk to Despairing Fisalia Member]
Despairing Fisalia Member: It has returned... Just as before...
Despairing Fisalia Member: We can't... we can't defeat It...
[Dialogue Option]  Believe in the strength of humanity.
[Dialogue Option]  There's nothing we can't overcome in this world.
[Dialogue Option]  That's what Leviathan wants you to think.
Despairing Fisalia Member: You are... I know you... Yes, you've defeated It before!
Despairing Fisalia Member: The whispers... the whispers disappeared once. I heard what you did in Jinzhou. You helped them drive away the Threnodian there...
Despairing Fisalia Member: Yes, Threnodians are powerful, terrifying even... B-but not invincible.
Despairing Fisalia Member: You're right. Now is not the time to give up...

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content:
Despairing Fisalia Member: You're right. Now is not the time to give up...



Avidius: Ah... it's you...
Avidius: Forgive me... that you have to see me like this...
[Dialogue Option]  What happened to you, Avidius?
[Dialogue Option]  Why has Thessaleo Fells become like this?
Avidius: When the Civilization Capsule opened, I was dragged inside. A black frequency took hold of me. Swallowed me whole.
Avidius: I saw Rinascita's beginnings, and the memories of... so many of its people.
Avidius: I saw him too—Caligula. His face was like mine... He was my past, and the future I am meant to inherit...
Galbrena: ...Leviathan used the Dark Tide's frequency to force those memories into him.
[Dialogue Option]  You said you'd become the master of your own destiny!
[Dialogue Option]  No one gets to decide who you are!
Avidius: Yes, I once said... that I would write my own story... define my own "existence"...
Avidius: But after I left that space, I suddenly felt the Tidespawn's movements. They were converging on Thessaleo Fells. I still wanted... to do something, anything, to stop the devastation.
Avidius: But once again, I stepped blindly into the churning river of Chaos (Fate). The Fisalia's oldest memories awoke ahead of time. Because of me...
Avidius: Countless Tidespawn emerged in my wake. I tried to drive them back, but I... overestimated myself... and was corrupted by them.
Avidius: My hopes and dreams... all of it was real. So why? Why did it all come to this?
Avidius: From Septimont to Ragunna, the blame lies with me. Perhaps this is the fate I could never outrun. Caligula's fate... It's calling to me!
Galbrena: Damn it. His mind is being consumed by Caligula's memories.
Avidius: This is the role Fate wrote for me. Fate decrees I become the Mad King. So why... why should I reject its crown?
Avidius: I am the one who glimpsed "Fate" itself... And now, I will reveal it to the world...
Avidius: But who can truly know the mind of Fate... That is why I will become it. I will wear its face... that foolish, divine mask no mortal can comprehend.
The Mad King: Caligula (Avidius): I am the King... bearer of extraordinary power, risen from the dark tides. I shall quiet the waters and still the tempest...
The Mad King: Caligula (Avidius): I shall be crowned in glory... with the blood of the old king.

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content:
[Objective: Defeat the Mad King: Caligula]
Rover: Avidius...
The Mad King: Caligula (Avidius): Unwritten One, I have no need for your pity.
The Mad King: Caligula (Avidius): From the deepest dark, I rise against your purest light. Let us see which is worthy of a true ruler.
Galbrena: If you believe he was once an honorable Gladiator...
Galbrena: Then fight him. Make him remember who he truly is.
The Mad King: Caligula (Avidius): I can write my own fate. And rewrite theirs.
The Mad King: Caligula (Avidius): I can quench their hunger... Or ignite their fury.
The Mad King: Caligula (Avidius): I will tear down this wretched, false world... and ride the only Truth that endures for eternity... Death.
The Mad King: Caligula (Avidius): I once scorned the weakness of others. Now I see... My own heart trembles just the same. How pitiful...
Rover: …His attacks are slowing!
Galbrena: His will is stirring within the Dark Tide. Don't let up!
Galbrena: Your memories. Your emotions... They weren't all lies. Reach for them. Find what was your Truth.
Rover: Avidius! Remember who you are. Remember the man you wanted to become!
The Mad King: Caligula (Avidius): I am... human. Not one of these monsters...
The Mad King: Caligula (Avidius): This will be... my final glory...
Rover: Avidius! Remember who you are. Remember the man you wanted to become...
The Dark Tide's "Whispers": Fate lies within the Dark Tide. No one escapes the net it casts.
The Dark Tide's "Whispers": Wield the Dark Tide's power... And it will consume you in turn.
The Dark Tide's "Whispers": Come back... Come back to us.
Avidius: I am... nothing like you...
The Dark Tide's "Whispers": Heh. You... How do you plan to resist us?
Avidius: There must be a way...
Avidius: That girl... Was she devoured by the Tide too?
Avidius: Wait! If you keep going, the Dark Tide will swallow you completely!
Girl Who Fell Into The Dark TIde: I know... the Dark Tide devours everything. Assimilates everything. If I can't escape it... then I'll use it...
Girl Who Fell Into The Dark TIde: It's already flowing inside of me... So why can't I turn it against them? Why can't I... be the one who devours them?
Girl Who Fell Into The Dark TIde: These "false frequencies" need me to "survive." If this power... doesn't want to listen to me...
Girl Who Fell Into The Dark TIde: Then I'll show it who's the real boss.
Girl Who Fell Into The Dark TIde: Fate... It may be loud, but I don't think it's that strong. I... don't believe in it.
Avidius: A memory left behind in the Dark Tide...?
Avidius: She's right... In this war against Fate...
Avidius: I still have a move to make.
speakers: Girl Who Fell Into The Dark TIde
Girl Who Fell Into The Dark TIde

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content:
Avidius: A memory left behind in the Dark Tide...?
Avidius: She's right... In this war against Fate...
Avidius: I still have a move to make.



(Cutscene plays)
Avidius: I want it to be a story that gives people hope.
Avidius: By my spear, I vow to protect my allies...
Avidius: And crush... the hearts of the evil.
Avidius: I will absorb all of the Tidespawn...
Avidius: Kill me, and the calamity ends here.
Rover: Avidius!
Avidius: There's no time, Rover.
Avidius: Discord Slayer, I saw your past in the Tide. I know what you seek to do...
Avidius: Take my power... And finish it.
Avidius: That too is my wish.
Galbrena: I promise I will.
Galbrena: Give me all your bitterness.
Galbrena: We will... make them pay.
??? (Cristoforo): Pathetic as he was, in his final moments...
??? (Cristoforo): He outran his fate.
??? (Cristoforo): Now, why greet our reunion with animosity?
??? (Cristoforo): Before the tides of fate, we are all but… players on a stage.
(Cutscene ends)

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content:
[Objective: Talk to Cristoforo]
Cristoforo: A truly moving scene. A pitiful, doomed soul struggling to reclaim his fate in the final hour.
Cristoforo: ...Alas, his script was written long ago. In this scene, he was always fated to exit.
[Dialogue Option]  The Quillbearer finally takes the stage.
[Dialogue Option]  Avidius was your creation.
Cristoforo: A lie told often enough becomes the truth. Weave memory, history, experience, and you can craft a man who "exists in the minds of others."
Cristoforo: But to become truly "real"... that path was still far off. I merely gave him form, a mask of flesh and blood, fit to walk the world.
Cristoforo: In the end, the breath that could give him life... was his alone.
Cristoforo: Oh, a being born of lies, grasping for meaning in a world that offers none! Such a pursuit demands the courage to question the meaning of one's existence. Yes, it demands pain...
[Dialogue Option]  As creators go, you're rather heartless.
[Dialogue Option]  Have you no compassion for your own creation？
Cristoforo: Did you not see? I did. His intentions, his ambitions, his darkness, his weakness... To lay a soul bare is not always an act of cruelty.
Cristoforo: Humanity is Fate's plaything. I simply showed them the strings. I lit the fire, the hunger that might ignite their free will.
Cristoforo: Through contradictions and conflicts, pain brings metamorphosis. Tragedy breeds transcendence. Only then may a soul rise beyond itself... and touch the gates of "immortality."
Cristoforo: Should you still insist on my cruelty... well, high praise indeed. At the very least, it proves this story has stirred your pity and fervor. That alone earns you the right to read through to the final act.
Cristoforo: Go then. To Septimont. The curtain is drawing. There, I shall rewrite Rinascita's fate... with the Dark Tide as my ink.
Cristoforo: Will you suffer in silence beneath Fate's poisoned arrows, or rise to defy this world's endless trials? I, too, await your final answer.
Galbrena: You brought ruin to Rinascita. You think you're just walking away?
Cristoforo: My stage lies elsewhere. In this scene, I am but a herald.
Cristoforo: But since you're so eager, I'll leave you with one final clue. I've never had much fondness for overwrought dramatic irony.
Cristoforo: The Dark Tide has already tainted the Civilization Capsule. It no longer requires the Threnodian's authority to be opened… Just a single drop of the Tide's nectar will suffice.
Cristoforo: So tell me, how could an existence born of the Dark Tide ever serve as its "Anchor of Reality"?
Cristoforo: Be forewarned. When dark waters recede, the truth beneath the surface... shall come to light.
[Dialogue Option]  I hope you understood what he meant.
[Dialogue Option]  Wait, so Avidius wasn't the Harbinger?
Galbrena: The Harbinger of the Dark Tide is the Anchor of Reality of all Tidespawn. That means it must be a real, existing person.
Galbrena: When I was absorbing the Tidespawn, I felt it. Avidius was also born of the Dark Tide.
Rover: Then why didn't the "Light of Imperator" reveal his true form?
Galbrena: Because his intentions and words were real. He may not have shone as brightly as the sun, but in walking beneath its light, he still caught its glow.
Galbrena: And that unshakable resolve not to become a pawn of the darkness, even unto death... That created his own Truth.
Galbrena: That's why he played right into the Quillbearer's hands. A scapegoat, the perfect "sacrifice" to bury the truth. All his noble wishes were twisted. Such cruel irony can rot for all I care...
[Dialogue Option]  He still stopped Ragunna from falling to the Dark Tide.
[Dialogue Option]  He still succeeded in changing his fate.
[Dialogue Option]  That playwright is the true culprit.
Rover: Avidius shouldn't have had to bear such a fate... I will carry on his fight. I'll keep writing the story he believed in, the story that gives people hope.
Galbrena: Yes. As he wished... we must stop the greater tragedy that's coming.
Galbrena: Let's return to Cantarella and check on the wounded. If Avidius wasn't the Harbinger, that means we missed something...

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
content:
[Objective: Find Cantarella]
Galbrena: The Tidespawn have fully retreated. The situation around Thessaleo Fells is improving.
Galbrena: Seems like the Order has already transported most of the wounded to Averardo Vault.
Galbrena: But... as for the rest... the scars Leviathan left on their minds still need time to heal.

title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
subsection: Talk to the scared little girl
content:
[Objective: Talk to the scared little girl]
Scared Girl: I... I'm so scared...
[Dialogue Option]  Everything's okay, don't worry.
Scared Girl: Ah, it's you, the great hero Rover!
Scared Girl: Cantarella told me stories about you. She said you're just like the heroes in the adventure tales. Brave and determined...
Scared Girl: ...But... You can't save everyone...
Cartethyia?: Don't go... Don't leave... Don't abandon us...
Rover: ...Cartethyia?
Cartethyia?: Mortals need salvation... Mortals need unity...
Cartethyia?: Righteous One... open the ascendant gates for me...
Galbrena: This world doesn't belong to you, Leviathan.
Galbrena: Chimera!
Galbrena: How are you feeling, Rover?
Cantarella: Stand down.
Cantarella: I said, stand down. Fall back.
Panicked Fisalia Member: But, Lady Cantarella, we all saw it… just now—
Cantarella: Enough. I told you to stand down. You've withstood the "whispers" before. Will you forget your loyalty to your comrades in the face of fear?
Panicked Fisalia Member: I'm sorry, Lady Cantarella... and Rover. We... We lost our composure...
Cantarella: Leviathan is a master at finding the cracks in one's spirit to tear it asunder. Go do what you must. I'll handle this.
[Dialogue Option]  What just happened...?
Galbrena: Certain emotions between you and the others resonated. Your Tacet Mark opened a "portal," pulling you into another illusion.
Galbrena: That "portal" fed on your presence to spread malice and fear... But before it could fully take shape, I broke into your illusion and shut it down.
Rover: I saw Fenrico, Mya, and Cartethyia... They all passed through that gate. What exactly lies beyond it?
Galbrena: That's the realm Leviathan created. The Journeying Paradise.
[Dialogue Option]  If those gates opened because of me...
[Dialogue Option]  Then does that mean—
Galbrena: Avidius was Cristoforo's decoy. He planted that decoy in Septimont for years... When the waters recede, the truth shall come to light...
Galbrena: Rover... you are the new Harbinger of the Dark Tide.
(Quest complete: The Bygone Shall Always Return)
(Obtained Trophy: Night is Coming)

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Find Cantarella)]
Rover:  Cantarella went inside to prepare that "antidote"... She should be finished now. Time to find her.
Cantarella:  This is the family "antidote," made to suppress Leviathan's spiritual corruption. Take it now.
Cantarella:  As long as we can identify the problem, there's a way to fight back. You carry the Sentinel's power within you. That's keeping the corruption at bay for now. What's left... are the hallucinations and whispers.
Cantarella:  I've learned about Leviathan's current state from Galbrena. The Fisalias have resisted the Threnodian for a century. Its whispers aren't undefeatable. We will defeat It.
[Dialogue Option]  So this is the worst-case scenario you warned me about.
[Dialogue Option]  You must have suspected something for a while now.
[Dialogue Option]  I still find this hard to accept.
Galbrena:  Leviathan needs a Harbinger with enough influence to spread Its "gospel." You're the Laureate of Ragunna and the Hero of Heroes in Septimont. That's more than enough to be Its first choice.
Galbrena:  Your path overlaps with Avidius. The Tidespawn are shaped by the Harbinger's thoughts and memories. Neither the Thundering Mephis nor the Feilian Beringal are native to Rinascita. So...
Rover:  You once said the Harbinger had to be corrupted by the Dark Tide. But I still don't show any signs of corruption...
Galbrena:  I suspect... the one corrupted might not be "you."
Abby:  Phew... the Dark Tide, huh? I ate some back at the hunting grounds. It tasted kinda funky... made me super sleepy. Ever since then, I've been having the weirdest nightmares...
Cantarella:  Abby does... carry the Dark Tide's frequency...
Galbrena:  Abby must have absorbed many other frequencies. So while the Dark Tide's frequency lay in wait... it was masked by the others.
Galbrena:  It makes sense. You two share life and energy. As the primary in this bond, your frequency has been overriding Abby's... Leviathan planned for this.
Abby:  Rover, did I... did I do something wrong?
[Dialogue Option]  You've always done great, Abby.
[Dialogue Option]  It's not your fault, Abby.
Rover:  We made a call when it mattered. I asked you to absorb the Dark Tide. We couldn't have known what it would become. You didn't do anything wrong.
Abby:  I see... I-I can go hungry if I have to, but you, Rover, you better not get hurt...
Galbrena:  The real threat is Leviathan. If we want to end this for good, we kill It and destroy Its Paradise.
Rover:  ...From what I know, Leviathan manifests Its kingdom by flooding Rinascita with the Dark Tide. That's how it turns the real world into the Journeying Paradise.
Rover:  But we've already secured Ragunna and Septimont. The Fabricatorium and the hunting grounds are both stabilized... So why is this Paradise still there?
Galbrena:  Everything you've done has slowed down or maybe even sealed off some of Its pathways. That's why Leviathan is resorting to Its "final plan."
Galbrena:  This so-called divinity is more devious than humanity realizes... The Paradise you saw is not of this world. It stands... within the Dark Tide.
Galbrena:  Matriarch of Fisalia, you have guarded this truth for over a century. Now... we need your insight.
Cantarella:  I couldn't see the truth until the Threnodian's whispers finally quieted. Only then did those ancient records, once twisted beyond recognition, begin to make sense again.
Cantarella:  Leviathan... was born from the shadows in our hearts. From our longing to connect and belong. It took the shape of a sea creature, because nothing frightens us more than the deep.
Cantarella:  It used faith to spread a spiritual plague. All the while, it has been feeding on our pains. Fear, despair, sorrow...
Cantarella:  Our ancestors believed Leviathan survived by absorbing these emotions. Little by little, it burrowed into Rinascita's collective unconscious.
Cantarella:  They said the Dark Tide is that subconscious made real, an ocean of shared trauma. That's why... they called Leviathan the "Master of the Deep."
Rover:  I heard them. All those voices in the Dark Tide. And before I touched the gate... I felt it. Fear. Sorrow. Like it was pouring out of the people.
Galbrena:  The stronger the conflict, the deeper the emotion it stirs. That's what shapes our memories and subconscious...
Galbrena:  That's why the Playwright kept forcing Rinascita into conflict. Every tragedy, every struggle... it wasn't random. It was all to keep feeding Leviathan.
Galbrena:  The End Times are drawing near. The Ragunnesi cling to hopes of a blissful afterlife. Septimontians have long believed in "another world" that begins after death...
Galbrena:  Leviathan may have drawn from these subconscious beliefs, "aligning" with those desires to fabricate a false future and afterlife within the Dark Tide-the illusion of the Journeying Paradise.
Cantarella:  If that's true... once the people's belief in the End Times reaches its zenith, their consciousness will align entirely with Leviathan's vision. Like Gilberto, and the others who were fully corrupted...
Galbrena:  Its power of assimilation will grow stronger, until the line between imagination and reality vanishes. The Journeying Paradise will descend upon the world, just as before.
Galbrena:  ... When it does, every soul in Rinascita will be unified under Its control. No thoughts. No will. Just blind devotion... No different from the Tidespawn.
[Dialogue Option] ...So how do we fight Leviathan?
Galbrena:  You saw it in the illusion. It cast aside the Sentinel's form and took on Cartethyia's. That means... The first step in her plan is complete.
Galbrena:  Leviathan is still watching the real world. Because of the "Mark of the Dark Tide," It can read your thoughts. So for now... we can't share the full plan with you.
Galbrena:  But you must have sensed it by now. Your connection with Rinascita runs deeper than I, or even you, ever imagined...
Galbrena:  You're not just the Harbinger of Despair... You've become a vessel of Rinascita's hope.
Galbrena:  So go. Gather every last flicker of it. This is a "hunt," yes. But it's also more than that. It's a war of spirit. Of light against shadow. Hope against despair.
Galbrena:  To take Leviathan down, our belief has to be unshakable. If there's doubt in your heart... then stop. A new path won't reveal itself unless you're ready to walk it.
Galbrena:  For now, the Dark Tide in Ragunna is under control. And I think... I've figured out what It plans to do next...
Galbrena:  Before the bells of Paradise ring, I'll buy you time. When you're ready, head to Septimont.
Galbrena:  Just like the Playwright said, when the moment comes, everything—fiction and reality, past and future—will converge there.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content: [Objective: (Optional - Exchange more information with Cantarella)]

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Talk to Cantarella)]
Cantarella: Members of Fisalia will relocate to Averardo Vault. When I meet with Carlotta and the others, I'll relay what we've learned about Leviathan.
Cantarella: From what I understand of Leviathan... It chose you not because It can control you, but to hinder your progress.
Cantarella: But looking into your eyes, I see... no matter the obstacle, you won't stop moving forward.
[Dialogue Option]  I have some questions I wanted to ask you.
Cantarella: Mmm. There are still some ancient records I have yet to fully decipher. If you're interested, I'll share what I can.
[Dialogue Option]  About Leviathan...
Cantarella: The records say that since the dawn of civilization, Leviathan, under the guise of Imperator, wormed Its way into the Rinascitans' faith and thought.
Cantarella: In that battle, the Sentinel was assimilated by the Threnodian. But in doing so, Imperator bound Leviathan, entrusting the First Relic to the (the "lantern" filled with Their power) First Primus.
Cantarella: The calamity was quelled by Napoli the Second, but Leviathan's "poison" left deep scars on Ragunna and Septimont.
Cantarella: Since then, every Primus has upheld the "Oath of Silence" to hide the truth-the people once worshipped the Threnodian.
Cantarella: And yet... even in chains, Leviathan used "twisted faith" to spur conflict. Suffering, turmoil, and struggle that followed all continued to feed It...
[Dialogue Option]  About the Dark Tide...
Cantarella:: The "Dark Tide of this world" was a calamity wrought by Leviathan's hand. But the heads of our family have long suspected that Rinascitans have always harbored a "spiritual Dark Tide."
Cantarella: It takes root in the shadows, deep in the valleys of our fears. When the Threnodian draws forth enough anguish, It may call a Dark Tide into being. And in the terror of calamity... It feasts.
Cantarella: The "whispers" once planted an idea in our minds: the Dark Tide is fate, and Leviathan its keeper. In hindsight... perhaps it was not so far from the truth.
Cantarella: Our collective subconscious flows endlessly through the Dark Tide, by day and by night. Leviathan lies hidden in its depths, weaving unseen changes, delivered to us through our dreams.
Cantarella: When those altered bits of us rise to the surface, they slip into the waking mind. Our choices and actions were then guided by a will without form.
Cantarella: I fear Leviathan has reclaimed full control over the Dark Tide. Our every thought and feeling... may now fall beneath Its gaze... and bend to Its will.
Cantarella: Galbrena and Cartethyia hesitated to reveal their full plan... and perhaps this is why. As she said, only an unshakable will can stand against Leviathan.
[Dialogue Option]  About the Harbinger of the Dark Tide...
Cantarella: The Harbinger of the Dark Tide is chosen by Leviathan, an Anchor of Reality that summons the Tidespawn. A vessel, too, for spreading Its "gospel"... and gathering Its "sustenance."
Cantarella: The Harbinger is condemned to wander the Dark Tide's illusions. And as the corruption seeps deeper, the boundary between dream and reality begins to unravel.
Cantarella: In time, they may mistake the living for monsters... or even strike down those dearest to them in illusion. Tragedies born of confusion...
Cantarella: To others, and even to themselves, they may come to embody "malice and fear" itself. If they surrender to that fate, the Dark Tide will devour them whole... leaving behind nothing but a puppet.
Cantarella: The records speak of Harbingers who resisted until the end. To spare others from greater harm, they each made the same choice... To take their own lives.
Cantarella: Rover, you... No, there must be another way. We must bring an end to Leviathan.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
Cantarella: Rover, you... No, there must be another way. We must bring an end to Leviathan.



[Dialogue Option]  About Cartethyia and Galbrena...
Cantarella: Cartethyia's condition... can only be described as "death." For now, we must accept that truth.
Cantarella: Galbrena confided in me, though only in veiled strokes, her intentions. In truth, I know no more of her than you do.
Cantarella: I only know she bears the rare ability to move between this world and the Dark Tide's illusions. It was through that gift she was able to pull you back.
Cantarella: What I saw in her eyes... was unwavering focus. The kind of resolve found only in those who have truly stood against the Dark Tide.
Cantarella: But in those depths, I also saw a blackened will... Absolute, heedless of means or cost. I wonder... what crucible of blood and fire shaped it.
Cantarella: Thankfully, those flames are not aimed at us. Her sights are clear. She simply waits for the moment to pull the trigger.
Cantarella: To us, she is an ally worthy of trust. Should danger arise... you may trust her with your back.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
Cantarella: To us, she is an ally worthy of trust. Should danger arise... you may trust her with your back.



[Dialogue Option]  I'm preparing to leave for Septimont.
[Dialogue Option]  I still have some matters to attend to.
Cantarella: I understand Septimont calls for your aid even now.
Cantarella: As Galbrena said, we must gather every last flicker of hope. We will stand with the Montellis and the Order to face the crisis in Ragunna. This front is ours to hold.
Cantarella: If your strength wanes... do not overburden yourself. Safe travels, Rover.

Shanoir: I trust my fiancé will return to me, crowned in glory.

content:

Lutas: The civilians in the city will soon be evacuated.
Illaya: I heard the fighting has already begun in the Plateaus―
Lutas: Stop thinking about it.
Illaya:...But I want to fight at the Ephor's side, on the front!
Lutas: Our duty is to guard Septimont and its people. We will hold fast here, until they return in triumph.
Lutas: The battle here matters just as much as the one at the Three Heroes' Crest.
Illaya:...Alright.
Lutas: Then let's do our part.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Optional - Listen in to Gladiators)]
Carlow: Marion! Thank goodness, you're still alive!
Marion: Haha, surprised? I didn't think I'd survive that monster siege either... but a Discord Slayer saved me.
Carlow: A Discord Slayer? Where is she now?
Marion: She's headed for the Plateaus. No one could stop her... I need to report to the Ephor at once.
Carlow: Leave that to me. You should get your wounds treated.
Marion: No. I'm still on my feet, and that can only mean one thing... my duty isn't finished.
Marion: I'll fight to my last breath here in Septimont.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
Marion: No. I'm still on my feet, and that can only mean one thing... my duty isn't finished.
Marion: I'll fight to my last breath here in Septimont.



Iuno:  Keep moving! Stay in line and follow instructions. No dawdling. I promise... we will return soon.
Iuno:  Well, well. Is that you, Unwritten One? So you did decide to grace us after all. Thought maybe you'd forgotten about us.
Iuno:  Did you come straight from Ragunna?
Rover:  I did. Has it begun here too? I see you're starting evacuations.
Iuno:  An unannounced High Tide. But that term doesn't even begin to cover it.
Iuno:  No signs. No patterns. The Dark Tide's spawn are surfacing at random... even outside the City of Septimont.
Iuno:  It doesn't make sense. The Earthrend Wedge is still holding back the Dark Tide at its depths... At any rate, Augusta's already led a team to the Sanguis Plateaus to investigate.
Iuno:  As for me, I'm helping out here. Someone has to stop the panic from turning into a stampede.
Rover:  It's not just Septimont. Ragunna has been hit too...
Iuno:  I see, Ragunna too... And Avidius... He never bent the knee, never played by the rules. Why is it that fate always strikes hardest at those who dare to defy it?
[Dialogue Option]  People still don't remember you?
Iuno:  I'm just a helpful, ordinary person now, helping the Temple with the evacuation. No more restraints from the Tetragon. No prophecies... I admit, I've never felt freer. It's just...
[Dialogue Option]  You still can't give new prophecies?
Iuno:  It's not just me. No Priestess can see Septimont's Auguries anymore. In our visions, it's all gone. Just blank.
Iuno:  The last prophecy ended with, "The Dark Tide will erupt and engulf all of Septimont." After that... nothing. And with this abnormal Dark Tide behavior, people are starting to fear the end is upon us.
[Dialogue Option]  But maybe... that doesn't mean the end is near.
[Dialogue Option]  A blank future could mean a new beginning.
Iuno:  Nice thought. If only more people shared your hope.
Iuno:  But in the face of something this vast and unknown, fear is only human. We can't blame them for trembling.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Iuno Griffex appears)]
Iuno:  Aquila, any word?
Iuno:  ...The Dark Tide has been spotted at the Three Heroes' Crest.
[Dialogue Option]  How bad is it?
Iuno:  Bad. It's the highest point in the Sanguis Plateaus, well beyond the Blightcloud's reach. The Dark Tide has never touched it before.
Iuno:  They call it the Three Heroes' Crest for the three Heroes of Heroes who once stood there. Many believe their blessing has kept it one of the few sacred places the Dark Tide cannot reach.
Iuno:  If even that place isn't safe... We need to see it with our own eyes.
Iuno:  But Septimont still needs us too...
Resolute Senator:  Worry not, Honored One. The Senate will oversee the evacuation. Please, go assist the Ephor.
Resolute Senator:  We may lack your strength, but we will not stand idle. We will do everything we can to hold the line!
Elder Senator:  We were born in Septimont. Resistance runs in our blood, and we were raised beneath the shining legacy of heroes. You think we'll sit back and let ruin claim us?
Resolute Senator:  We're counting on you, Honored One!
[Dialogue Option]  That's why I'm here.
[Dialogue Option]  For Rinascita!
[Dialogue Option]  I won't shame the title of Hero of Heroes.
Iuno:  I hate to admit it, but the current Senate's grown a backbone. Cowards wouldn't last long working under Augusta, anyway.
Iuno:  Come on, Rover. Let's find her.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
Iuno:  Come on, Rover. Let's find her.



Iuno:  The Tidespawn always shows up where we least expect them and never slow down. Our warriors are stretched thin just trying to hold the lines.
Iuno:  Even though the Common Echoes here don't depend on the Genesis Nexus, they're still breaking down due to the Dark Tide's corruption.
Iuno:  Don't wear that face. These are Septimont's warriors. They don't fall easy.
Iuno:  Let's pick up the pace. You fought beside Augusta before, and you once led the battle to defeat the Sovereign. Your presence will rally them.
Weary Gladiator:  Look! It's Rover, the Honorable One!
Lupa:  My fellow warrior! You came!
[Dialogue Option]  It's been a while, Lupa.
[Dialogue Option]  My fellow warrior! It's been a while.
[Dialogue Option]  May applause greet you!
Lupa:  Feels like just yesterday we were fighting side by side in the Colosseum. And now look at you, "Hero of Heroes" and all. Didn't see that coming!
Augusta:  Rover, your arrival is appreciated.
Rover:  Oh, let me introduce you. Augusta, this is...
Augusta:  Iuno. We know each other.
[Dialogue Option]  What? When?
Iuno:  Å lot happened while you were off adventuring. You missed some fun.
[Dialogue Option]  Did... everyone's memories recover?
Augusta:  Recover...?
Iuno:  Ahem, never mind that. Didn't I say before? Never underestimate my charm.
Augusta:  It is strange... From the moment we met, it felt like we were cut from the same cloth. Like we'd known each other before. She might seem unmoored, but when the storm hits, she holds fast.
Iuno:  Alright then, Augusta. What's the situation?
Augusta:  Theoretically, the Dark Tide flows here from the Blightcloud above the Plateaus. High Tides have always followed its movements.
Augusta:  But this time, nothing. No Blightcloud anomalies. No frequency fluctuations near the Three Heroes' Crest.
Augusta:  We always knew the Earthrend Wedge was a stopgap as we continued to search for a permanent solution. But this... eruption without warning defies everything we thought we understood.
Augusta:  We repelled the first wave and set up an Anti-Corrosion Ward using Anchor Obelisks.
Augusta:  Have you discovered anything?
[Dialogue Option]  The Fractsidus is incubating the Threnodian...
[Dialogue Option]  The Threnodian is on the verge of rebirth...
Iuno:  What ?! But... I thought the Sovereign's death would sever the root cause of the Paradise's descent. But Leviathan's rebirth... This is a whole new thread of fate...
Augusta:  The Fractsidus, always scheming in shadow. Its wicked ambitions know no end.
Gladiator Messenger:  Your Excellency! Another outbreak! Tidespawn heading straight for the camp!
Augusta:  Heh, Leviathan won't spare us any time to breathe.
[Dialogue Option]  Let's go. My sword is ready.
[Dialogue Option]  I wouldn't miss this fight.
Augusta:  It's been too long since we stood shoulder to shoulder in battle.
Augusta:  Warriors! The battle horns sound once again. Let those who defy Septimont tremble at our fury and fall before our valor!

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Head to the Sanguis Plateaus]
Lupa:  Tidespawn, dead ahead! Let's cut 'em down in one clean sweep!

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Defeat the TDs)]
Lupa:  Hah! It's always a blast fighting beside you, my fellow warrior!

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
subsection: (Head to the hunting grounds with your companions)
content:
[Objective: (Head to the hunting grounds with your companions)]
Augusta:  Another horde inbound. They're not letting up.
Iuno:  They're heading straight for the Anchor Obelisks!
Augusta:  We will stop them.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Defeat first wave)]
Lupa:  ...Is it just me, or have they slowed down a little?
Gladiator Messenger:  Your Excellency! They're targeting the remaining Anchor Obelisks now!
Iuno:  But the Gladiators guarding them... They haven't recovered from the last wave...
Rover:  Leave them to me.
Augusta:  Good. We'll split up and reinforce the rest. Stay sharp.
