title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
subsection: (Defeat the Tidespawn and protect the Anchor Obelisk)
content:
Augusta:  Rover, how is the situation there?
Rover:  Just cleaned them up.
Augusta:  We've cleared our sector too. Regrouping now.



Unyielding Gladiator:  More Tidespawn at the southwest basepoint!
Lupa:  Ugh. Trying to wear us down one flank at a time, huh?
Resolute Gladiator:  They're closing in on the Obelisks on our side!
Iuno:  Wait... something's off. They're striking at weak spots in the formation... Since when did they fight with strategy?
Augusta:  Leviathan. It's directing them. It saw we were spread too thin and scattered their assault on purpose.
Gladiator Fighting to the Death:  T-the north flank... Hold the Obelisks at all costs!
Augusta:  If I release this attack... the whole Obelisk array may fall.
Augusta:  It's testing me. Seeing if I'll trade lives for victory...
[Dialogue Option]  We can't be everywhere all at once...
[Dialogue Option]  It's driving us into a corner.
[Dialogue Option]  If only we had more fighters...

metadata.subsection: (Defeat the Tidespawn and protect the Anchor Obelisk)

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Cutscene Play)]
Brant:  ―So! This is where we're needed, right? Time to help reclaim those Obelisks!
Brant:  The north flank's ours! Let's give 'em a grand show!
Carlotta:  The Montellis greet you. We will secure this side.
Cantarella:  The poison Levianthan leaves behind... Allow the Fisalias to cleanse it.
Ciaccona:  Whew, made it this time! I've got this side covered!
Phoebe:  By the name of Imperator! We'll protect the Obelisks here!

[Dialogue Option]  How are you all here?
[Dialogue Option]  That teleportation circle...
Brant:  Let's deal with the mess first! Plenty of time to catch up after!
Iuno:  One Obelisk remains on the northeast...
Galbrena:  I'll take that one.
Augusta:  You have my thanks, heroes from afar. May your names be etched in eternity!
Augusta:  This battle is not over yet. Let's end this, together!

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
Augusta:  This battle is not over yet. Let's end this, together!



Stalwart Gladiator:  I never thought I'd see the day... fighting side by side with the Order of the Deep.
Gladiator Fighting to the Death:  ...Onward, comrades! We're not about to shame Septimont now!
Resolute Gladiator:  I've heard of the Montellis' "Sentry Constructs," but seeing that kind of firepower up close is something else...
Unyielding Gladiator:  That "poison"... it healed me? Maybe the Fisalias aren't as monstrous as they say...
Amazed Gladiator:  S-she's absorbing the Tidespawn ?! What kind of power is that ?!

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
Amazed Gladiator:  S-she's absorbing the Tidespawn ?! What kind of power is that ?!



Lupa:  What is that in the center? An opening? Something inside is sending them frequencies to recover!
Iuno:  The Tidespawn are still hiding in there, ready to strike again... Damn it. There's no end to this...
Augusta:  We won't last much longer at this rate...
Galbrena:  The entrance is open. Now's the time...
Augusta:  ...What are you doing?
Galbrena:  What I always planned to do―hunt the Threnodian.
Galbrena:  The moment I jump into the Dark Tide, the Tidespawn will retreat to defend. That's when you seal the Anti-Corrosion Ward. Trap them in one stroke.
Augusta:  Jump into the Dark Tide? Are you out of your mind ?!
Galbrena:  More precisely, into the Journeying Paradise. This suffocating despair you see... It's a gateway. And Leviathan's sanctuary.
Augusta:  You're saying Leviathan built the Paradise inside the Dark Tide?
Galbrena:  That grand city you glimpsed within it... It wasn't a hallucination. It was real. The Paradise's first form.
Galbrena:  Everything It plotted fell apart. With no other choice, It began spreading the gospel of its "Paradise" by force... And that gives us a chance to "kill" It.
Galbrena:  Right now, It's trying to break the Earthrend Wedge's seal and drown all of Rinascita in the Dark Tide.
Galbrena:  But that's not Its true goal. It feeds on our terror. On "despairing frequencies." That's what fuels Its rebirth and Its "Paradise."
Galbrena:  We must strike at the root. Kill Leviathan. Tear down the Paradise It's built. If not, it will descend upon Rinascita. Just as it did here, at the Three Heroes' Crest.
Iuno:  The Paradise won't fall unless we can reach it. How exactly do we do that?
Galbrena:  The living can only enter the Journeying Paradise once they've been corrupted by the Dark Tide. Even then... one of you must go in first to open the way for the rest.
Galbrena:  Inside, there's a "spatial anomaly." Whoever goes first must use the Sentinel's power to break through it, then find a "Waystone" to create a "connection" for the others to follow.
Galbrena:  Augusta, you buried the "Waystone" yourself. But it's been corrupted. Only the Sentinel's power can purifv it.
Galbrena:  Take it. Leviathan's eye is still on this place, so I'll say no more. I trust you'll understand what's left unsaid.
Galbrena:  Once I'm inside, I'll draw Its attention. That'll buy you enough time to prepare.
Galbrena:  Good, all locked and loaded. Now if you'll excuse me... Someone's got to teach the Dark Tide some manners.
Iuno:  Huh? No... Hold on now―
Galbrena:  And you, Rover... If your resolve is true, be ready. When the time comes, I'll guide you to Paradise.
Galbrena:  See you all in "Hell."
Iuno:  The Tidespawn are retreating to the center! They're all inside the Ward's perimeter! Augusta!
Augusta:  Now! Activate the Anchor Obelisks!

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
Iuno:  The Tidespawn are retreating to the center! They're all inside the Ward's perimeter! Augusta!
Augusta:  Now! Activate the Anchor Obelisks!



Iuno:  We did it...
Iuno:  But... what good is that ?! She just rattles on, doesn't even check if anyone's really listening, and then dives headfirst into the Dark Tide!
Augusta:  The Journeying Paradise lies within the Dark Tide... I do not think she was lying. That "grand city" she spoke of... I saw it myself.
Augusta:  Rover, we've set up camp near the Three Heroes' Crest to keep watch. Let's head back and rest for now.
Augusta:  There must be a way forward. Once we're back, we'll gather all of Ragunna's heroes and plan our next move together.
Augusta:  The nature of the Dark Tide and Leviathan... I see where we are now.
Brant:  Rover! You're here.
[Dialogue Option]  Now will you tell how you made it here?
[Dialogue Option]  How did you know we needed reinforcements?
Carlotta:  Regarding that... I think it's best you hear it from "them" directly.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Cutscene Play)]
Aalto:  Yo! Loud and clear, Rover?
Aalto:  So, all available Bloom Bearers have arrived in Rinascita. We're standing guard at Averardo Vault, and Buling is already en route to reinforce Septimont.
Aalto:  When the Threnodian blindsided us in Jinzhou, we ate some dust. But this time? The Black Shores will show the world who we really are.
Aalto:  We've already synced intel with Ragunna, and time's short, so I'll make this a quickie. We've drawn some key conclusions about the Threnodian in Rinascita.
Aalto:  The Threnodian is the shadow of civilization, formless and immortal. According to Imperator's judgment, It can't be erased entirely… only shackled.
Aalto:  But the one you're about to face is different. The Fractsidus used the Threnodian's Gem to resurrect it, and that created a crack in the shell.
Aalto:  Tethys believes that with Imperator's power, you might be able to split the Gem from the Threnodian and stop Leviathan from fully reviving.
Aalto:  If you can extract the Gem, Tethys can tap into a Sonoro's infinite expansion to lock that thing down for good.
Aalto:  One more thing. Back in Jinzhou, Abby proved capable of absorbing the Threnodian's frequencies. This means, in theory, it could act as a temporary host for the Gem.
Aalto:  Heh. But know this, the Threnodian Leviathan is rooted deeply in the minds and souls of Rinascita's people. Only they can truly face It.
Aalto:  At Ragunna's request, we've teleported some of our strongest Resonators to reinforce the frontlines at the Three Heroes' Crest.
Aalto:  So leave the civilians to us. We'll keep them safe. As for combat power? I called in some... insurance. Never hurts to play it safe.
Aalto:  Don't worry, we...
Encore:  Into Woolies' belly you go!
Camellya:  Feed my blossoms, self-deceivers!
Aalto:  So you don't have...
Calcharo:  Unleash the fangs!

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
Encore:  Into Woolies' belly you go!
Camellya:  Feed my blossoms, self-deceivers!
Aalto:  So you don't have...
Calcharo:  Unleash the fangs!



[Dialogue Option] :...Right. Looks like I don't need to worry about your end.
[Dialogue Option]  Just try not to bring down their Vault in the process.
Aalto:  Ahem! In any case, you just focus on driving your blade straight into Leviathan's heart. We'll be Rinascita's last line of defense, and we'll be right here waiting for your safe return!

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
Carlotta:  If not for the Black Shores' aid, we would not have arrived so swiftly, or with such peace of mind.
Carlotta:  This disaster has swept across all of Rinascita. We Ragunnesi won't cower behind Septimont's walls, nor will we sit idle while the Dark Tide ravages your lands.
Carlotta:  Septimont has long stood as the vanguard against the Tidespawn. This is your battleground. We'll follow your lead, Your Excellency. Just say the word.
Augusta:  Thank you for your trust. Though Septimont and Ragunna have drifted apart over the years, in the face of such calamity, we stand together as one for Rinascita. There's no need for formality between us.
Augusta:  Leviathan is the source of this chaos. If the Black Shores' plan can truly seal It away, then perhaps the storm It unleashed may yet be stilled.
Iuno:  That Discord Slayer spoke of a "connection" between the "Waystones." She must've meant the Anchor Stones' ability to resonate and link with another.
Iuno:  If there's another Anchor Stone inside the Dark Tide... that connection could open up a path for us.
Augusta:  When the Dark Tide swallowed me, I did leave an Anchor Stone behind... But how did you know that?
Iuno:  Not important right now. The real issue is that the Anchor has been heavily corroded. To reactivate it, we'll need to purify it using the Sentinel's power.
Augusta:  Even if we take another Anchor Stone with us, its power alone won't be enough to pierce the spatial anomaly inside the Dark Tide... and open up a path...
???:  You'll need this.
[Dialogue Option]  The lantern of Napoli the Second...?
[Dialogue Option]  How did this end up with you?
???:  A dying martyr entrusted it to me.
Cantarella:  The First Relic, infused with Imperator's pure, original power. That light once drove back the darkness across Rinascita.
???:  Most of its strength was spent purging the Dark Tide beneath Ragunna. What's left can only shield one person.
Brant:  Someone will need to carry it in first, to reach the Anchor Stone and reactivate it.... I'll do it. As a captain, navigating through uncharted waters is second nature.
Lupa:  I'll go.
[Dialogue Option]  Friends, this is not up for discussion.
[Dialogue Option]  I'm the one best suited for this task.
Rover:  I know how to resist the Dark Tide's corruption.
Cantarella:  The Fisalia family potion grants resistance. And I've endured Its whispersfor long enough. I know Its tactics. Let me face this...
Rover:  We don't even know where this Anchor Stone is. Finding it may take time, and your potion might wear off before you reach it.
Rover:  But I still carry the Sentinel's power. I can hold out longer than anyone. I have to be the one.
???:  This relic holds all that Primus once felt. His fury, sorrow, obsession... and resolve. I see that same resolve in you.
???:  Take it.
Carlotta:  ...
[Dialogue Option]  Trust me.
[Dialogue Option]  The defenses here need all of you.
[Dialogue Option] ...Hey, don't go making this too dramatic.
Augusta:  Lady Cantarella, how many of your family's potions remain?
Cantarella:  You're asking if I can brew enough to carry all of us into the Journeying Paradise... If we're ready to face Leviathan.
Lupa:  So once that Anchor Stone is activated, the path should be clear, right? Great, then would you do us the honor, brilliant Lady of Potions, and get us there.
[Dialogue Option]  You...
Carlotta:  Rover, this is Rinascita's fight. It is neither your duty to shoulder it alone, nor our desire to see you do so. We will not have you face the Threnodian alone.
Carlotta:  If facing Leviathan means being corrupted by the Dark Tide, then so be it.
Augusta:  The Priestesses foresaw this, "The Dark Tide will erupt and engulf all of Septimont." If that is our fate, we must meet it head-on.
[Dialogue Option]  I understand...
[Dialogue Option]  Then here's the plan.
Rover:  I'll go first. I'll enter the Dark Tide, activate the Anchor Stones' connections, and hold the path open for the rest of you.
Carlotta:  Meanwhile, we'll hold the line at the Three Heroes' Crest. The Tidespawn aren't the only threat. The Fractsidus might still have their hand to play.
Augusta:  Once the Anchors are active, we'll take the potions and follow.
Iuno:  Rinascita will not falter just because a few of its leaders are gone. Its people will rise.
Iuno:  We'll meet again in the Paradise and end this together... Leviathan will fall
Augusta:  Rover, we all understand the burden you carry. We are grateful.
Augusta:  We'll continue to monitor the Dark Tide. When the moment comes, we'll move. Until then, prepare and rest.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
Augusta:  We'll continue to monitor the Dark Tide. When the moment comes, we'll move. Until then, prepare and rest.



Rover:  (That visitor from Huanglong... He must know something about Fenrico.)
Rover:  (If the lantern came from the Fabricatorium, then what's happened to the Dark Tide sealed beneath Ragunna's seas... )
Rover:  (There's still time before I go. I need to find him and learn what happened down there.)

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Optional - Talk to Ciaccona)]
Ciaccona: Rover! It's been a while!
[Dialogue Option]  It has. I haven't seen you around lately.
Ciaccona: As a wandering bard, I couldn't just sit idle while everyone else played their part.
Ciaccona: So I did what I do best: played the loudest tune Ragunna's ever heard! With it, I called back every last soul still lost out there.
Ciaccona: But now, just as we reunite... you're setting off again.
Ciaccona: Music can be a weapon too. So take my song with you!
Ciaccona: Winds blow, rains weep, but light will always follow. Look up, and you'll see the stars. Their quiet twinkling is proof you'll never be alone.
Ciaccona: This entire world listens when you sing. Every bold, bright note will follow in your wake... And so will I.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Optional - Talk to Cantarella)]
Cantarella:...
Cantarella: It's not a matter of "knowing how to resist" the Dark Tide's corruption, is it? You've already been corrupted.
[Dialogue Option]  Sorry, but under the circumstances, I think this is the most rational choice.
[Dialogue Option]  You know how I am.
[Dialogue Option]  Are you mad at me?
Cantarella:...What ever the case, I respect your decision. But even so, let me say this one more time―
Cantarella: Do not overburden yourself. Do not carry this weight alone. We are here. Always.
Cantarella: Take these potions. My people and I will begin crafting the full batch. Once you activate the Anchor Stone, we will follow into the Dark Tide and meet you there.
[Dialogue Option]  Thank you, Cantarella.
[Dialogue Option]  Thank you all for your effort.
Cantarella: You, above all, have borne the most. Be safe, Rover.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Optional - Talk to Augusta)]
Gladiator Messenger: Your Excellency, fortifications are advancing ahead of schedule.
Gladiator Messenger: Most warriors, thanks to the healing efforts of the Orders and the Fisalia, have been restored to fighting strength and are already deployed at their posts.
Gladiator Messenger: Additionally, with the Montellis' technical support, the damaged Common Echoes are fully operational again. They've also contributed a significant number of Private Echoes, greatly boosting our forces...
Augusta: A timely reinforcement indeed... Understood. Continue to watch enemy movements in our vicinity.
[Dialogue Option]  What's the Dark Tide's current status?
Augusta: Its fluctuations remain unstable, but so far, the Tidespawn have yet to show any signs of offensive action.
Augusta: I believe that "Discord Slayer" is holding Levianthan's moves in check within the Dark Tide. What do you know of her?
[Dialogue Option]  Only that she slays Tacet Discords.
[Dialogue Option]  I only know she's on our side.
Augusta: Is that so... She stirs a curious sense of familiarity in me. And she's knowledgable about Septimont's affairs, almost as if... She's lived here before.
Augusta: Regardless, our priority now is to concentrate our forces, hold the line stead, and capitalize on the time she's buying us.
Augusta: The Fractsidus lurks in the shadows. We must remain vigilant against them.
Augusta: Before the moment comes for you to brave the Dark Tide, rest well, Rover. The battle ahead will demand everything of you. I trust these will serve you well.
Augusta: And know this, you do not fight alone. Wherever you turn, you will find us standing with you.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Optional - Talk to Phoebe)]
Phoebe: Ah... Rover. I'm sorry, I didn't see you there.
Phoebe: Many of these warriors fell under the Dark Tide's corruption in battle. The Sentinel's light can help to purify their wounds... but the scars on their hearts are much harder to heal.
Phoebe: I know Septimontians don't believe in the Sentinel, so... I wanted to try, in my own way, to comfort those who've suffered...
[Dialogue Option]  You've changed, Phoebe.
[Dialogue Option]  Your faith shines brighter than ever.
Phoebe: Thank you... Rover.
Phoebe: The Sentinel's form of Unity is one of shared faith, without stripping away individual freedom. It's nothing like Levianthan's... force "oneness."
Phoebe: I heard you... you're going into the Dark Tide. To lead the way for the others.
Phoebe: I know blessings alone won't be enought to protect you. What matters now is action. Real tangible aid.
Phoebe: Please, take this protective gear with you.
Phoebe: "Though you walk in the valley of the shadow of death, fear no evil... for we are always with you."
Phoebe: Whent he time comes... I'll follow the others to find you and fight by your side.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Optional - Talk to Lupa)]
Lupa:
[Dialogue Option]  You seem confident, Lupa.
[Dialogue Option]  You seem almost hungry for it, Lupa.
Lupa: Septimont's Gladiators live for the challenge. The bigger the threat, the fiercer we fight!
Lupa: But I know this Levianthan we're facing is tougher and more complete than what we faced at the Gladiator's Agon. I will be cautious.
Lupa: But I won't lie... I am worried about you going into the Dark Tide all alone.
Lupa: Still, when the heat's on, better to slap your back and shout "You've got this!" than to doubt.
Lupa: We've overcome a lot together. The Dark Tide... Pft, just another beast to break.
Lupa: You've got your fight, we've got ours. While you open up a path, we'll hold down the fort here.
Lupa: I'm with you all the way. Roll with the punches, right? And here, I got this for you. Hope it helps.
Lupa: We all believe in you, my fellow warrior. Now it's time you believe in us. Soon enough, we'll storm the battlefield right by your side!

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Optional - Talk to Carlotta and Zani)]
Carlotta: Hmm... So this is how Septimont's Common Echoes operate. But I see some similarities with our Sentry Constructs...
[Dialogue Option]  How are things holding up at Averardo Vault?
[Dialogue Option]  You actually brought this many echoes along...
Carlotta: Grandfater is overseeing Averardo Vault, and the Black Shores are holding the line there as well. No need for concern. Besides, the Montellis' cache of Echoes is nothing to underestimate.
Carlotta: But really, such "technology" is our family's prodest "asset." Naturally, we brought what we could with us.
Zani: Septimont's Common Echoes use a different configuration than Ragunna's, but the underlying logic is compatible. Our tuning technique will still serve us well here.
[Dialogue Option]  Just don't forget to take breaks.
Zani:...If working a little longer means you'll carry a little less, then I'll stay up as long as it takes.
[Dialogue Option]  Looks like you'll be working late again.
Zani: I don't care about overtime in this case... If working a little longer means you'll carry a little less, then I'll stay up as long as it takes.
Zani: Besides, Ms. Carlotta hasn't rested properly in days.
Carlotta: In times like these, we cannot afford even a sliver of carelessness. We must do everything within our power... so that you can focus on what lies ahead in the Dark Tide without distractions.
Carlotta: These items will strengthen your Echoes. Even without us by your side, they'll be reliable allies.
Carlotta:...We won't let you walk this path alone for long.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Optional - Talk to Brant and Roccia)]
Roccia: Oh, it's Rover...
[Dialogue Option]  I heard you ran into a rough storm at sea...
Brant: We did right by the trust they placed in us. We got all the folks from Riccioli Islands to safety.
Roccia: Compared to what you're about to face, that s torm was nothing.
Brant: Sailing into the unknown is never easy. Sailing through the Dark Tide? Even worse.
Roccia: Pero stocked up on gadgets. You can take whatever you like!
[Dialogue Option]  I like gadgets!
[Dialogue Option]  Bring me a few more Training Swords!
Roccia: This is all we can do for you right now... Please come back safe, Rover.
Pero: Pero, Pero...
Brant: Oh! Take these Shell Credits too. They're lucky charms, or so the old sailors say. Take as much as you like. A little luck never hurts.
Brant: To us, Rover, you've always been the protagonist. Never forget that.
Brant:...It's not being the protagonist that makes you brave. It's your courage that gave you that role to begin with.
Brant: We trust you, so trust us. No matter how dark things get, we'll always be here when you need us.
