title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Cutscene plays)]
Phrolova: We carry the Dark Tide's memories.
Scar: We command both light and shadow.
Scar: Did you really think you could stand against us alone?
Galbrena: Steel yourself...
Galbrena: Defy the prophecy. Rise above fate again.
Galbrena: If the road ahead is dark, then let this soul—
Rover: —Be the spark that lights the night.
???: Well said!
Augusta: You're not alone.
Augusta: Because we are here. With you.
Augusta:  Where the dark night ends lies the blazing sun. We all made it, Rover.
[Dialogue Option]  I'm back!
[Dialogue Option]  Is everything alright on your side?
[Dialogue Option]  Has anyone seen Galbrena?
Echoes of Hope - Dragon of Dirge:  Worry not, Herald of Hope. "We" have shielded them from the Dark Tide.
Galbrena:  ... Don't worry, it's just a scratch. Glad to see you're alright.
Galbrena:  As for that Grand Architect, heh... The spirits will guide him to the other shore.
[Dialogue Option]  Are you really alright...
[Dialogue Option]  But you don't look well...
Chimera:  She burned her own life force to help you. Only by Overclocking was she able to break through the Dark Tide's illusion.
Chimera:  Her true Forte has always been inside her. As her blazing will became Overclocked flames, that seared away the corruption of the Tacet Discords and the Dark Tide. It awakened her Forte.
Chimera:  I took on some of the cost of her Overclocking... I admit her insolent gamble paid off again.
Rover:  She saved me, but you saved her.
Galbrena:  Maybe it wasn't really a gamble this time. I knew you wouldn't stand by and let me die.
Chimera:  ... Hmph. Then slay Leviathan and prove I was right about you.
speakers: Echoes of Hope - Dragon of Dirge
Echoes of Hope - Dragon of Dirge

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Cutscene plays)]
Galbrena:  Finally recognize me, Augusta?
Augusta:  I almost didn't. You've changed a lot. but the warmth in that Resonance ability... That, I could never forget.
Galbrena:  Glad to see we both stayed true to who we were. But we can catch up later. For now... How did you all make it here?
Augusta:  Just as we were about to take the potion and enter the Dark Tide, the Fractsidus triggered its surge. Leviathan pulled us into Its illusion.
Phoebe:  But... the Echoes swallowed by the Dark Tide protected us. They brought us the time we needed to drink it.
Dragon of Dirge:  Leviathan can mimic our form but never our "soul."
Dragon of Dirge:  We heard your call, strong and full of resolve. So we came, every one of us, to stand by your side.
Roccia:  The Echoes of Rinascita can sense human frequencies. When we reach out in hope, they answer us with hope.
Zani:  But even with their help and the potion, we're still far from our goal... We fought through the illusions, but we still need an Anchor to open a path to the Journeying Paradise.
Ciaccona:  I have an idea! If Leviathan found Its Anchor of Reality (Harbringer) to summon the Tidespawn into our world...
Brant:  We follow suit and find an Anchor of Hope to find a way out of the world of the Dark Tide!
Carlotta:  And who better for that... than you, Rover.
Augusta:  Even in the depths of despair, you held on to hope... That unwavering faith makes you worthy of being our Anchor of Hope.
Lupa:  And the unbreakable (bond) tether we share is what led us to you.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
Lupa:  And the unbreakable (bond) tether we share is what led us to you.



[Dialogue Option]  I won't let you down.
[Dialogue Option]  I'm here because of all of you, too.
Augusta:  The Dark Tide showed us your memories... We know that Cartethyia planned her own "death" to plant humanity into Leviathan...
Galbrena:  Her mind is asleep inside Leviathan's anchored body. If we can wake her, our chances of beating the Threnodian will grow.
Galbrena:  Let Abby rest for now. When the Threnodian falls, use your power to "split" Its essence from the Gem. And I'll use my "devouring" ability to seal It inside me.
Rover:  ... So that's the real reason the Fractsidus was targeting you.
Galbrena:  Yes. But now, I've got backup. Neither they nor the Threnodian can stop us.
Galbrena:  Cristoforo thought his script was flawless, but he missed one thing. Even the faintest spark of hope can ignite a blaze when we stand together.
Augusta:  Defeating the Threnodian is what we all seek. That is what unites us here!
Cantarella:  Leviathan twisted our memories and emotions into this fake Paradise, hoping we'd surrender to Its will, and let It harvest our civilization...
Iuno:  But now, the fate It's forced upon us is ours to shatter!
[Dialogue Option]  Together, we'll bring Leviathan down.
[Dialogue Option]  Everyone, with me to battle!
[Dialogue Option]  No throne lasts forever. Even Divinity can fall.
Augusta:  As long as we hold on to our shared faith and hope, Leviathan will never win.
Galbrena:  It's time to break open the gate... and burn this false Paradise to the ground.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
Galbrena:  It's time to break open the gate... and burn this false Paradise to the ground.



Galbrena:  ...That's the Threnodian's Chrysalis, Leviathan's gestation pod. It's expanding the rift bleeding into our world.
Galbrena:  Temporal distortions! Watch out!

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Clear the cocoons)]
Galbrena:  It thought dividing us would make us easy prey.
Rover:  Then It thought wrong.
Galbrena:  Everyone, pay attention to those Cocoons summoning monsters.
Galbrena:  They are linked to the Chrysalis above. Destroying them will weaken the Threnodian's hold.
Zani:  Copy that!
Brant:  Leave them to us!

Rover:  All Cocoons cleared on my side. How's it looking for you?
Brant:  Mission accomplished, Captain!
Carlotta:  Quickly and swiftly.
Iuno:  That? Pfft, child's play. We handled it ages ago, obviously.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
Brant:  Mission accomplished, Captain!
Carlotta:  Quickly and swiftly.
Iuno:  That? Pfft, child's play. We handled it ages ago, obviously.



Galbrena:  Careful! The platform is collapsing now that the Cocoons are gone!
Rover:  ...Lorelei?
Galbrena:  She just stabilized the distortion. Let's move.
Rover:  What about the others?
Ciaccona (Contacting):  We're good! The Lioness of Glory caught us! What a sight to behold!
Cantarella (Contacting):  The Dragon of Dirge lent its aid as well.
Rover:  Alright. Let's all meet up ahead.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Cutscene plays)]
Dragon of Dirge:  We will finish the remaining threats.
Dragon of Dirge:  Go and fulfil your mission. Defeat Leviathan.
Fleurdelys?:  Mortals must seek salvation... Mortals must follow a uniform creed...
Fleurdelys?:  Now... Righteous One... open the gate to ascension.
Rover:  ...You are not her.
Rover:  Reveal yourself, Leviathan!
Levianthan:  I am the Beginning, and the End; the First Breath and the Final Sigh... I have ever been Rinascita's sole Divinity.
Levianthan:  By my Gospel alone didst thou arise, United and Reborn. And now thou dare lift thy hand against me?
Levianthan:  Fleurdelys... once more, the crown is thine. Return to my embrace.
Levianthan:  Now, faithless heretics... Kneel and receive thy judgement.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Defeat Threnodian :  Leviathan)]
Threnodian: Levianthan:  Imperator's power is mine to command.

;Cantarella  This... is Imperator's power of separation?
;Phoebe  How can this be...?
;Galbrena  This vessel carries the frequencies Leviathan split from Its body. Every blow we land here wounds Leviathan itself.

;Phoebe  Careful! Stop... right there!
;Brant  So long as we stand, we can still bring Cartethyia back.

;Cantarella  Worry not. You are safe with me.

;Iuno  Your turn, Augusta!
;Augusta  My blade calls.

;Brant  Well, that's unexpected...
;Cantarella  Heh. Is this supposed to be a mockery?
;Iuno  Ugh, ridiculous imitation! Disgraceful!
;Lupa  The Ephor's swordplay... and even my flames?! Oh, you filthy thief!

;Zani  No passing!

;Brant  Stand tall! Your captain's got your back!

;Carlotta  Not while I'm watching!

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
;Zani  No passing!

;Brant  Stand tall! Your captain's got your back!

;Carlotta  Not while I'm watching!



Threnodian: Levianthan:  Hear my decree...
Threnodian: Levianthan:  Fleurdelys?! You... dare...

;Galbrena  Now, Rover!

Galbrena:  ...It's reaching for the Chrysalis to restore Its frequencies!
Rover: I'll handle it!

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Cutscene play)]
Cartethyia: Thank you, everyone...
Cartethyia: It worked...
Cartethyia: I'm back!
Leviathan: Fleurdelys... wilt thou cast aside thy godhood once more?
Cartethyia: I stand here in the name of "humanity."
Cartethyia: If my "humanity" alone can't sway you...
Cartethyia: Then we will defeat you together!
Leviathan: Thou dare pit mortal will against the divine?
Leviathan: Then behold...
Leviathan: The deepest abyss of despair!
Cartethyia: People of Rinascita, please hear my call...
Cartethyia: Unite... with all your will and hope!
Leviathan: Feeble resistance...
Leviathan: The fate of Rinascita is mine to decree!

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Defeat Threnodian :  Leviathan)]
;Augusta  Even the Threnodian's Chrysalis, turned into a weapon. So you're ready to take a final stand. Too bad... that won't bring us down!
;Cartethyia (frequency)  The light of hope has pierced the Dark Tide. Leviathan, your doom is inevitable!
Threnodian: Levianthan:  ...My Gospel shall resound across the tides for eternity!

;Cantarella  Still trying to corrupt us with your "whispers?"
;Ciaccona  Wait... it's the people of Rinascita! They're singing for us!
;Ciaccona  Even in the depths of despair, the song of hope echoes. Hear it well, Leviathan! This is your requiem!
;Brant  No matter the suffering, our courage carries us onward! This is the hymn of humanity!
Threnodian: Levianthan:  Insolence! My will suffereth no defiance!
Threnodian: Levianthan:  This is my kingdom!

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
Threnodian: Levianthan:  Insolence! My will suffereth no defiance!
Threnodian: Levianthan:  This is my kingdom!



;Zani  Every crime you've committed will be answered in full.
;Roccia  Our tommorrow isn't yours to shape.
;Carlotta  No matter how great your power, do no presume to claim our future!
;Lupa  False Divinity, we will tear your delusions and drag you down from your hollow throne!
;Phoebe  In the name of Imperator, be gone!
Threnodian: Levianthan:  My power... my strength...

;Cartethyia (frequency)  Your form is shattering, and your fate is sealed.
;Iuno  This time... fate will flow to the future we have Anchored!
;Augusta  Watch closely, Leviathan! This is the will of humanity!

Abby:  Count me in too, Rover!
Abby:  Let's knock It's lights out for good!

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
;Augusta  Watch closely, Leviathan! This is the will of humanity!

Abby:  Count me in too, Rover!
Abby:  Let's knock It's lights out for good!



;Galbrena  Time to end this once and for all.
;Cartethyia (frequency)  Leviathan, prepare for your final reckoning!
Everyone:  Brave the tide, Rover!

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (♂/♀ Cutscene play)]
Cartethyia: Leviathan, may you now be bound...
Cartethyia: By the weight, of humanity's hopes!
Levianthan: Abra... Abraxas! Why hast thou betrayed us?
Galbrena: ...It's trying to absorb the Dark Tide!
Rover: I'll split the Gem from Its physical form.
Galbrena: Time to finish this.
Kharon (Schwarzloch): Our paths were never truly opposed... One day, they shall cross again.
Kharon (Schwarzloch): Remember this... We were once your "Waystones."
???: Righteous One... Raise the lantern in your hand...
???: Within it lies the will of every Primus of the Order, from Napoli the Second.
Fenrico: To my own resolve and atonement...
Fenrico: Let its light banish this final darkness.
Fenrico: Rinascita will surely know... a lasting dawn.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
Fenrico: To my own resolve and atonement...
Fenrico: Let its light banish this final darkness.
Fenrico: Rinascita will surely know... a lasting dawn.



Augusta:  This calamity... ends here. For good.
Qiuyuan:  That Primus got what he wanted. He fulfilled the fate he desired for Rinascita.
Qiuyuan:  The Threnodian's creatures have been defeated. They never broke through our defenses. With the Dark Tide now receding, it seems that all is resolved.
[Dialogue Option]  Thank you.
Qiuyuan:  I only played a small part. It was the courage of these warriors that truly held the line.
Qiuyuan:  Now that you have returned safely, I'll continue with my mission.
Cantarella:  Scar from the Fractsidus... Did he escape again?
Qiuyuan:  Unfortunately, yes. I see you didn't catch the mastermind either.
Galbrena:  That Cristoforo got away… But don't worry, I will hunt him down.
Augusta:  That Fractsidus... The calamity has passed, but our city-states are weakened. We must rebuild. Recover. We cannot join this hunt.
Qiuyuan:  Survivors deserve more attention than criminals who deserve to die.
Iuno:  Rest assured, we're not forgetting this transgression.
Cartethyia: Thank you... heroes of Rinascita...
Lupa: Is that Cartethyia's voice?
Lupa: Hey—Cartethyia! You're welcome!
[Dialogue Option]  How do you feel, Cartethyia?
Cartethyia:  Oh, I'm back to myself now. Let's meet in Ragunna City, (Righteous One).
Carlotta:  Defeating Leviathan was just the start of Rinascita's "new era." There is plenty of cleanup work ahead for everyone.
Cantarella:  Each day to come holds more hope than the last.
Augusta:  Septimont will have many matters demanding our attention. Ragunna will be no different.
Iuno:  Leave Septimont to us. Ragunna's problems... Well, they're looking a lot more complicated than ours.
Augusta:  Once everything is settled, will you come home to Septimont City?
Galbrena:  I will.
Augusta:  We will meet again, heroes.
Rover:  Phoebe?
Phoebe:  Ahh?!
Rover:  Is everything alright? You looked like you were somewhere else just now.
Phoebe:  Oh... I was just thinking how the Blessed Maiden's voice sounded just like the heavenly voice during the Carnevale...
Phoebe:  So I was wondering... about the Sentinel's messages we heard before... Was it... Do you think Their advice... "Consume healthy food, such as the Laurus Salad..."
[Dialogue Option]  Yup, that's her.
[Dialogue Option]  That's... a long story...
Phoebe:  Huh?

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
Rover:   (This calamity has passed, but now Ragunna must face a harsh truth. Primus Fenrico gave his life to stop the Dark Tide, and the Sentinel is gone.)
Rover:   (For the Ragunnesi, what fills their hearts now… is likely sorrow and uncertainty.)
Rover:   (But at the same time...)
Zani:  Lady Carlotta, we've finished tallying all our losses. Here's the full report for your review.
Carlotta:  Thank you. Secure all salvageable relief supplies first. The remaining personnel should assist the Fisalias in treating the wounded.
Cantarella:  Rosemary has already dispersed the family's medicine in mist form. Thanks to that, treatment has been smoother than expected. The injured will be tended to shortly.
Phoebe:  Repairs on the Genesis Nexus are still underway, but some damaged Common Echoes are already operational again.
Galbrena:  Leave the residual Dark Tide frequencies to me.
Brant:  Alright, crew! Come lend a hand!
Roccia:  Pero's got a whole mountain of tools over here... Like this rapid adhesive gun!
Ciaccona:  If you're having trouble restoring the damaged buildings, Mr. Fulmine and I can help using our Fortes!
Abby:  If Imperator were here, They'd be happy to see this...

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
Abby:  If Imperator were here, They'd be happy to see this...



Cartethyia:  Imperator once said: "Let the winds of the past depart. The ships of this new era no longer need their guidance. No longer shall scroll and prophecy bind, but by humanity's will shall a new era be forged."
[Dialogue Option]  We made it... Cartethiya...
Cartethyia:  I've now truly returned from the "dead."
Phoebe:  B-blessed Maiden!
Cartethyia:  Please, just call me Cartethyia. Rinascita's Divinity is no more, and with it, the "Blessed Maiden chosen by the Divine."
Cartethyia:  Phoebe, your faith in the Sentinel has never wavered, nor has it been blind. It stems not from obedience, but from a deep belief in Their deeds and ideals.
Cartethyia:  Imperator once led the displaced to these isles, yet what allowed the Ragunnesi to stand firm upon the sea was not Divine favor, but their own efforts.
Cartethyia:  The statue in the city was built in Their likeness, but it was the people who gave shape to the faith it stands for.
Cartethyia:  Faith once united us. It was also what drove us to seek liberation... The path of civilization is never fixed. It shifts with what's being demanded at present.
Rover:  And it's the people of a civilization who decide what they demand.
Phoebe:  ... As it was in the beginning, and ever shall be.
Phoebe:  Everyone has their tasks to do now... But in the future...
Rover:  I want you to have this, Phoebe.
Rover:  Imperator entrusted me with this relic. Within it is Rinascita's past, and... its future.
Phoebe:  Rinascita's future...
Phoebe:  Eh... but it's empty. Where is the recorded future?
Rover:  The future... is already in your hands.
Phoebe:  ... I see. Thank you, Rover!
Cartethyia:  From now on, perhaps I no longer need to hide who I really am.
Cartethyia:  So... I'll join in rebuilding Ragunna too!
Rover:  Sign me up.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Credit play)]

Phoebe:  Disaster recovery in Ragunna City is nearly complete. Thank you so much for your help, Rover.
Rover:  You're welcome. By the way, Phoebe, have you seen Galbrena?
Phoebe:  Miss Galbrena? When she finished up here, I think I saw her heading to Margherita's Restaurant...

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides

content:
[Objective: (Optional - Listen to Ciaccona by the City Square Fountain)]
Ciaccona: Though Death may boast you fade in shade, in deathless verse your name is laid.
Ciaccona: While lungs still breathe and eyes still shine, this poem, and you, shall stand through time.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
subsection: (Optional - Listen in on Cartethyia and Phoebe by the streets toward Trattoria Margherita)
content:
[Objective: (Optional - Listen in on Cartethyia and Phoebe by the streets toward Trattoria Margherita)]
Cartethyia: It's been a long time since Ilast sat down with the Order's doctrines... I didn't expect this many changes while I was "gone."
Phoebe: The Codex has been revised serveral times over the past decade...
Cartethyia: Wait, "Flying Ragunnesi" was banned? That play is a masterpiece! And civilians aren't allowed to perform at the Carnevale anymore?
Cartethyia: ...Such harsh decrees should all be struck down!
Phoebe: O-okay, I've noted it down. Actually, I think this one should go too...
Cartethyia: And this—"Acolytes must avoid close contact with Common Echoes"? That's beyond absurd!
Phoebe: There are... hundreds more like it.
Cartethyia: Hundreds?! Most of these had to be written under Levianthan's influence. Even sealed away, It refuses to leave us in peace...
Cartethyia: I'll call the Order together soon to carefully review these matters. Oh, right... Who sits on the Counsil of Ten now?
Phoebe: Council of Ten was disbanded years ago. After that, all decisions went straight to Primus Fenrico.
Cartethyia: Fenrico... in the end, he broke free of the Threnodian's control and found his own redemption.
Cartethyia: Looks like we'll have to move up the election for Primus...
Phoebe: Are you considering running, Cartethyia?
Cartethyia: Given my current position, I don't think I am suited for that role.
Cartethyia: Honestly, I've never had the patience for civic duties. There are certainly others better qualified within the Order.
Cartethyia: But I will do everything in my power to correct the Order's past mistakes.
Cartethyia: Now that Ino longer need to hide, it's time to shoulder greater responsibility.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
subsection: (Optional - Listen in on Brant and Roccia behind Trattoria Margherita)
content:
[Objective: (Optional - Listen in on Brant and Roccia behind Trattoria Margherita)]
Brant: Everything's nearly wrapped up on my end, First Mate!
Roccia: Good work, Brant. And thank you, everyone.
Brant: Oh, by the way, while we were  deep in the Dark Tide, Icaught sight of an old brewing recipe.
Brant: It dates all the way back to when Rinascita was founded. The brew was called Rebirth.
Roccia: Back then, people were fighting the sea just like we are now. They built seawalls, linked the scattered isles... It was only through countless sacrifices that they finally held their ground on this archipelago.
Roccia: Hmmm... what would Rebirth taste like...
Brant: Piqued the First Mate's curiosity, eh? Well, I got my hands on Pero's magic tools and gave it a try myself!
Pero: Pero, Pero!
Roccia: ...
Brant: But you're a bit too young for this, Roccia. The crew and I will handle the taste test!
Brant: Hmm... It's bitter, and sweet...
Brant: As for the meaning it holds... well...
Brant: To the fallen, and to tomorrow!
Everyone: To the fallen, and to tomorrow!

metadata.subsection: (Optional - Listen in on Brant and Roccia behind Trattoria Margherita)

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content: [Objective: (Wiki Footnote; Everyone except Roccia cheered)]

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
subsection: (Optional - Listen in on Carlotta, Zani and Cantarella by the Gondola Market)
content:
[Objective: (Optional - Listen in on Carlotta, Zani and Cantarella by the Gondola Market)]
Zani: Lady Carlotta, we still face a significant shortage of supplies. The Black Shores have met some urgent demands, but moving forward...
Carlotta: In the future, we must rely on ourselves. It seems prudent to begin sourcing from elsewhere. The pace of our transports ship construction cannot falter.
Zani: The Echo ships are still undergoing repairs. The family's shipyard is also operating beyond capacity and cannot free up berths for new ships anytime soon...
Cantarella: Perhaps the lower decks of Porto-Veno Castle could alleviate this issue.
Zani: I have heard the Fisalias first secured their standing through deep-sea fishing...
Cantarella: Quite right. That was once the family's shipyard, though long idle due to certain historical circumstances. If needed, we can grant the Montellis access.
Carlotta: Well then, Lady Cantatrella. What are your terms...?
Cantarella: As expected, your insight is as sharp as ever, Miss Carlotta. Terms... naturally, there are some.
Cantarella: The family has an ancient blueprint for a ship. I wish to see it brought to life with your expertise.
Cantarella: Once completed, it may serve your transport needs. It was once the "ark" carrying our ancestors from disasters. Now, I hope... it will carry the future.
Carlotta: That's truly... an offer one can hardly refuse. In that case, we will cover the funding and materials needed for construction.
Carlotta: But I believe the final ownership of this "ark" should remain with the Fisalia family.
Cantarella: Heh... so be it. We will also supply the requisite personnel.
Cantarella: The Fisalias are all eager to witness a "vessel of the old era" be reborn with our own eyes.
Cantarella: By the way, we have a list of medicinal herbs we wish to purchase...
Zani: Just send me the list, and I will see to it.
Carlotta: Very well... I look forward to our cooperation, Head of the Fisalias.
Cantarella: A pleasant one, to be sure... Montelli's newly anointed leader.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Find Galbrena)]
Galbrena:  Hello, I'll have one Forte-astic Fizz & Freeze gelato. Extra large. Thanks.
[Dialogue Option] ...Seriously, what kind of name is that?
Galbrena:  They say if you mix mint, Viscum Berries, Mastic Nuvola, and cream in just the right proportion, you get a gelato that's not only packed with flavor, but sharp and cool enough to clear your head.
[Dialogue Option]  Can't believe you actually said it out loud.
Galbrena:  Oh, and the ad said if you say the name in one go, you get 30% off.
Rover:  Okay... But how are you feeling with "that thing" in you? We've wrapped everything up here. Best we get to the Black Shores soon.
Galbrena:  Everything's fine, Chimera's keeping it stable. Nothing to worry about for now.
Galbrena:  Though ever since I absorbed that essence, Chimera has been grumbling nonstop about craving something cold...
Chimera:  Well I said nothing.
[Dialogue Option]  You're talking about yourself, right?
[Dialogue Option]  Chimera leaving you out to dry, eh?
Galbrena:  Hey, I'm human too, you know. I'm allowed to want good food. Ugh... never mind, let's go.
[Dialogue Option]  Wait
Rover:  Abby, time to dig in!
Abby:  Mmm—I've been dying for this!
Rover:  Miss Margherita, one extra large Forte-astic Fizz & Freeze gelato, please. Thank you.
Margherita:  Right away! You helped Rinascita through its darkest hour. Now it's my turn to make sure our heroes eat and drink like royalty!
Margherita:  Here you go! Double the scoop, on the house! Unlimited refills!
Galbrena:  I can't manage this on my own. Want to split it?
[Dialogue Option]  Wow. Something even you can't handle?
Galbrena:  "You don't have to carry it all yourself. Sometimes, it's okay to lean on someone else." Wasn't that your line?
Galbrena:  So, one side each?
Abby:  Ahhh, finally full... Hic... I think it's time for a nap.
Galbrena:  One wish fulfilled... Alright, time to head to the Black Shores.
Rover:  Yes, their ship should have docked by now.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
Galbrena:  One wish fulfilled... Alright, time to head to the Black Shores.
Rover:  Yes, their ship should have docked by now.



[Dialogue Option]  That man...
[Dialogue Option]  Calcharo?
Galbrena:  He's the leader of the Ghost Hounds. Strong, ruthless, not someone to cross lightly. I teamed up with him once while hunting in the New Federation.
Galbrena:  He tried to recruit me, but I'm used to working alone, so I turned him down.
Galbrena:  They've got quite the network. I got that lamp Terminal through their channels.
Rover:  He seems intimidating, but... I think he's alright. He did join the fight to protect Rinascita, after all.
Galbrena:  If you ever find yourself in the New Federation, you'll probably get to know him better.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
subsection: (Head to the harbor in Ragunna City)
content:
[Objective: (Head to the harbor in Ragunna City)]
Aalto:  Well now, Rover... looks like Rinascita's been tied up with a neat little bow.
Aalto:  The other Bloombearers have already headed back to rest. They burned through every drop of strength out there. Once we've handed off the Threnodian's Gem to Tethys... I might even allow myself a few hours of real sleep!
[Dialogue Option]  Thank you all.
Cartethyia:  If it weren't for the Black Shores, we'd have been completely ensnared by Leviathan's schemes. On behalf of the people of Rinascita, please accept our deepest gratitude.
Aalto:  This is what the Black Shores does. We're just glad we earned our keep.
Cartethyia:  This might be the first real conversation we've had since everything ended. Thank you very much, Galbrena.
Cartethyia:  It's a shame I'm not able to absorb the Threnodian's Gem, not in my current state.
Galbrena:  It would throw your power completely out of balance. Better to leave it with me.
Galbrena:  And really, I couldn't have done all this alone. Everyone played their part.
Cartethyia:  Still, if you hadn't come to "kill" me, we never could've pulled it off.
Galbrena:  Honestly, pulling off a fake assassination in front of two powerful Resonators, without flinching or getting caught... Yes, not exactly a walk in the park.
Galbrena:  ' Luckily, with a clear target, there's always a way to make the shot land. I didn't need to take you on, just sell the scene. "Blessed Maiden, down in one." Easy enough.
[Dialogue Option]  You're a real professional
Cartethyia:  What? No praise for my performance? I was planning to use this whole affair as a play for next year's Carnevale...
[Dialogue Option]  Promise me you two won't pull that kind of stunt again, okay?
Cartethyia:  Well, we had to make it convincing, didn't we? Looks like I've still got it. Hmm… perhaps it could be a play in the next Carnevale...
Cartethyia:  Would you like to join us, Galbrena?
Cartethyia:  The Sentinel once said They didn't want the people to mourn Their passing with sorrow. What They truly wished to hear were songs and laughter.
Cartethyia:  We'll be inviting our friends from Septimont, too. I do hope you'll all come, including you, Rover.
[Dialogue Option]  Hooray! Carnevale!
[Dialogue Option]  I'm ready to wear that mask again.
[Dialogue Option]  I'll win the Laurel again.
Cartethyia:  Then it's settled! If you dare skip it, I'll drag you there myself!

metadata.subsection: (Head to the harbor in Ragunna City)

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Cutscene play)]
Cartethyia:  But for now... it looks like it's time for goodbyes. At least for now.
Phoebe:  The Order will soon select a new Primus. From now on, Ragunna's affairs will no longer be decided by the Order alone. Instead, the Montelli and Fisalia families will help to guide decisions, together with the voice of the people.
Cartethyia:  We will begin addressing the wrongs the Order has committed. Ragunna's future belongs in the hands of its people. It will be led by their shared will.
Carlotta:  Our family will also continue expanding Rinascita's overseas trade routes. Perhaps one day, we'll cross paths again in a distant land.
Cantarella:  And should you ever return to Rinascita, know this. You will always be our most honored guest and dearest friend.
Roccia:  Not just us, but these little Echoes too. We'll hold this bond close, always.
Ciaccona:  If you ever visit any fascinating places, promise you'll tel me all about it! I'll turn your adventures into verse and have them sung across Rinascita.
Zani:  Rover, remember not to overdo it. Eat when you're supposed to, and don't forget... Life is meant to be enjoyed.
Phoebe:  To meet and part... is a part of life. So please, accept this blessing I offer in my own name: May your eyes always shine bright with clarity, and may love and light guide you on every step of your journey.
Brant:  This wide, free world has always been your stage. Wherever you go, I believe you'll always shine as its brightest star.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
Brant:  This wide, free world has always been your stage. Wherever you go, I believe you'll always shine as its brightest star.



Iuno:  Aha! See, Augusta? Told you we'd make it in time!
[Dialogue Option]  Iuno... you...
Iuno:  Septimont's mess is mostly sorted now. The Senate can deal with the rest. We don't do rushed goodbyes around here. No matter how far, we had to come send you off.
Lupa:  You, my fellow warrior, are someone worth chasing. Yes, we've been chasing victory all along, but with you, it feels like victory itself was itching to catch up.
Lupa:  Next time we meet, you'll be even stronger, as will I. I'll be a Gladiator who can stand toe-to-toe with you!
Augusta:  Your strength comes from deep in your heart, unshakable and selfless. It shines above Septimont and reminds everyone what being a hero truly means.
Augusta:  Fighting by your side has been an honor. By the eternal blazing sun, your name will be remembered in Septimont forever.
Augusta:  This world will never forget what you've done for us, Rover.
Iuno:  And don't go forgetting us either, got it ?! We're throwing a huge celebration in Septimont for this victory, and the Ragunnesi will be there too. So you'd better show up!
Cetus the Tidebreaker: Woooooo—
Brant:  It's Cetus The Tidebreaker! Are you here to see our Rover off too? Haha, I remember the moment we met him like it was yesterday.
Cartethyia:  Maybe it's more than just a farewell. I think the Tidebreaker wants to escort you on your journey.
[Dialogue Option]  We'll meet again. I'm sure of it.
[Dialogue Option]  I'll never forget the memories we've shared.
Rover:  So... till we meet again.
Everyone:  Till we meet again, Rover!

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (At Black Shores Archipelago)]
Rover:  How's everything going?
Aalto:  Good news and bad.
Aalto:  The Threnodian's Gem has been successfully contained. Tethys is already running a full-power analysis as we speak.
Aalto:  However... the Gem we've recovered was incomplete.
[Dialogue Option]  What the—... the Fractsidus again?
[Dialogue Option]  Could we have damaged it by accident...?
[Dialogue Option]  Could Chimera have eaten a part of it?
Aalto:  We're still investigating the cause. But look, successfully containing a Gem infused with the Threnodian's power? No small feat. It's already a huge step forward in our fight against the Threnodian and the Lament.
Aalto:  If the Threnodian is truly bound to civilization, who's to say another one won't return to Rinascita in some new form...
Aalto:  Still, even if that happens, It won't be reclaiming this piece of Its power. That gives us a window to prepare.
Aalto:  Rinascita... the Land of Echoes... If Tacet Discords can be manually converted into Echoes and become tools to fight the Lament...
Aalto:  Then maybe the Threnodian might also be something we could transform. Heck, maybe even utilize.
Aalto:  But that's all theorizing best kept to caffeinated hours. For now, we'll need to wait until Tethys completes its analysis before drawing any conclusions.
Galbrena:  Well, I'm glad it helped. I'll be on my way then.
Aalto:  Hey, Rover... She's got real skill. Moves like she's already part of our rhythm. This kind of synergy doesn't come knocking twice. What do you say...?
Rover:  Everyone in the Black Shores has made it their mission to stand against the Lament. Our goals are the same, and we've been walking the same path from the start.
Rover:  I know you're not the type who likes being tied down by titles. But just remember this... You're not fighting it alone. So...
[Dialogue Option]  Take your time to consider this offer.
[Dialogue Option]  Just think of this as a keepsake.
Galbrena:  ...
Rover:  This flower marks you as one of us. Whether you join us or not, if you ever run into trouble out there, the Black Shores will have your back.
Galbrena:  I see... I'll take it then.
Galbrena:  Oh, one more thing. My last Terminal gave out after I... "used" it too much. Think the Black Shores could lend me a new one?
[Dialogue Option]  You heard her, Aalto.
Aalto:  "Lend"? Please. You break it, you come get a new one.
[Dialogue Option]  So, does that mean you're joining us?
Aalto:  Sure thing! Now, I better head to the Greenhouse. Gotta reserve a plot for our new "Sprout."
[Dialogue Option]  If you want it, then you'll have to take it.
Aalto:  Oh, come on, Rover! Just give the lady what she wants!
Galbrena:  Thanks. Well then... till next time.
[Dialogue Option]  Did you forget that promise we made?
[Dialogue Option]  You still haven't told me your real name.
Galbrena:  ... Angel. That's my real name.
Aalto:  Angel... Such a beautiful name... Hm? Hold on a sec! You're not planning to jump into the sea, are you? I could get you a boat—!
[Dialogue Option]  That would be the least of her concerns.
[Dialogue Option]  That's how she is. Let her be.
[Dialogue Option]  Your boat is... well, not very durable.
Rover:  Don't worry about her. Nothing's stopping that one. No storm, and no raging sea.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Dialogue Option]  Your boat is... well, not very durable.
Rover:  Don't worry about her. Nothing's stopping that one. No storm, and no raging sea.



Scar:  Yawn... You do love to make a person wait, don't you?
Scar:  Still, breaking me out right under Mingting's nose without setting off a single alarm... Delicious. Tell me, how did you come up with that little idea?
Cristoforo:  Let's just say it was inspired by the Somnoire. Imagination, after all, remains humanity's sharpest blade.
Scar:  As the Dark Tide spread and I was pulled in deeper, the mark of the Dark Tide you left in me allowed my frequency to merge with it...
Cristoforo:  Of course. And through Leviathan's power, I was able to "read" that frequency and "depict" you back into reality.
Cristoforo:  Leviathan's power of assimilation blurs the line between imagination and existence, turning fiction into fact.
Cristoforo:  But of course, none of it would have worked until Leviathan slipped the Sentinel's leash and reclaimed the reins of the Dark Tide.
Scar:  It cost more time than I'd have liked, but everything unfolded exactly as you scripted. Such precision. Such devotion... Bravo.
Cristoforo:  A trial, nothing less.
Cristoforo:  Civilization's infancy must come to an end. So long as humanity remains cradled in the Sentinel's arms, it will never walk, let alone evolve. That is why I wrote this final act.
Cristoforo:  And those who cannot transcend their limits and overcome their lesser natures, who remain imprisoned by their own making... Well, such souls deserve no salvation.
Scar:  No souls deserve salvation. Why even try? This world was born from Chaos and exists in disorder. The only winning move... is to be worse. Wilder. To out-chaos the Chaos.
Scar:  Every noble act of salvation only makes Chaos hungrier. You want to destroy to save, but me... Ha, I want to save to destroy.
Cristoforo:  You sound disappointed in how this story ends.
Scar:  Did I say that? Your stories have always been a treat. Screaming crowds drowning in despair, a world tearing at the seams... Every collapse, every unraveling... Chefs kiss.
Scar:  If they cannot overcome the pain, then let them fall straight into the ending I want: an eternity of chaos and suffering. That's why I chose to work with you, dear playwright.
Scar:  Speaking of which, Quillbearer who toys with hearts, your sins weigh as heavy as mine. Tell me... where will your ending play out?
Cristoforo:  It has already been written into the script.
Cristoforo:  But until I reach it, as long as breath remains in me, I will haunt the stage like a phantom. A reminder... that one must always look forward, sharpen thy self, and temper thy soul.
Scar:  Oh, Rover wasn't wrong about you. You really are a cruel, extreme man. Sometimes I think you might be even more insane than I am.
Cristoforo:  Insanity, reason... or something in between... All are choices born of free will. And only through free will can we defy the surging tides of fate.
Cristoforo:  That is why we both seek to change it. For beneath such tides... no one is content to remain merely a humble servant.
Phrolova:  You lost the Gem I entrusted to you, Cristoforo.
Cristoforo:  Forgive me. But haven't we already seized what we truly desired?
Cristoforo:  You see, even the Beyond forged from Lev (Journeying Paradise)iathan's power couldn't endure. It fell short of the perfection you long for.
Cristoforo:  But if you wish to try again, I remain at your service.
Phrolova:  Tell me, how much of It re (Leviathan)mains within you?
Cristoforo:  Not much, but enough to make use of.
Phrolova:  ... I've fulfilled my promise to complete your finale. Let this be the last note of our symphony.
Cristoforo:  As you wish. My sincerest gratitude for your wonderful performance, Lady Phrolova. May you find the strength to create the Beyond you once envisioned.
Phrolova:  ...
Phrolova:  If this world truly cannot change, perhaps I will seek a new path for myself.
Scar:  Huh... who'd've thought someone as stubborn as she would learn to adapt.
Scar:  But, Grand Architect, are you really going to let her walk off and do as she pleases?
Cristoforo:  Of all of us, you are the last one with any right to judge her for following her whims.
Scar:  Judge? You wound me. I'm far more faithful to my indulgences than she ever was. No, no, no, no, I just want to tag along... and add a few more flourishes to her symphony.
Kharon (Schwarzloch):  There are still greater matters that demand your attention. Though our roads diverge, our ideals remain as one. In the end, they all lead to the same place. Separation is but the prelude to possibility.
Kharon (Schwarzloch):  All so that humanity may cross... that final gateway into eternity.
Kharon (Schwarzloch):  Our goals in Jinzhou and Rinascita have been fulfilled. A Threnodian's Resonator, an artificial Threnodian, and a Second Resonance Awakening. We now possess both the knowledge and the means.
Kharon (Schwarzloch):  Next... it is time we turn our gaze to our accomplishments in Lahai-Roi.

title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
content:
[Objective: (Optional - Talk to Aalto)]
Aalto: Fine work, Rover! With Rinascita safe for now, we've earned a proper breather.
[Dialogue Option]  There's still something I'd like to know.
Aalto: If there's anything you want to know, ask away!
[Dialogue Option]  About the Journeying Paradise...
Aalto: Ah, the Paradise. A realm created by Threnodian Leviathan and the destination of the Dark Tide...
Aalto: But judging by its nature, its reach, and the havoc it could bring… its "descent" is nothing less than what we define as the Lament.
Aalto: Still, without question, your actions, Rover, kept that from becoming a true Lament.
Aalto: Rinascita... what a journey it's been. Truly one for the epics...
[Dialogue Option]  About the Threnodian's Gem...
Aalto: You mean the missing frequency, right? We've already cross-checked it against Chimera and Cartethyia's frequency samples left here at the Black Shores…
Aalto: Not a single one aligned. Not even close.
Aalto: Which means… we can't dismiss the chance that the missing frequency has already been seized by the Fractsidus.
Aalto: But don't worry. We've sped up the Gem's analysis. Even if the Fractsidus is scheming, we'll have countermeasures ready.
[Dialogue Option]  About Abby...
Aalto: Abby? It's a curious case. Even in the deepest databanks of the Black Shores, we found no relevant data...
Rover: (But in that battle against the Journeying Paradise… Leviathan spoke Abby's name.)
Rover: (Yet no one else seemed to react. Was it only Abby and I who heard it?)
Rover: (Abby's true identity… Perhaps I'll only uncover it on the road ahead.)
[Dialogue Option]  That's all. Get some rest.
[Dialogue Option]  You've worked hard too. Get some rest.

content: Quest Objective: In this battle that sealed the fate of Rinascita, its people rose in defiance. And among them stood another, a swordsman of Huanglong, guided across the seas by Huanglong Mingting to lend you his strength. He fought as one among the countless souls drawn to this hour, but the story of his own journey, and the shadows of his past, remain known to few...

title: A Stranger in a Strange Land
subsection: Head to Ragunna City and find Ciaccona
content:
[Objective: Head to Ragunna City and find Ciaccona]
Ciaccona: 'Twas a battle fierce and dire. The Laureate fell, consumed by mire.
Ciaccona: Into the Dark Tide he's gone, vanished. Our minds shattered, hope now banished
Ciaccona: O' woeful hearts! O' helpless hands! Was this the end of all our plans?
Ciaccona: Then soared the dark slayer, wings aflame. Striking down foes, breaking the chain.
Ciaccona: Our Laureate rose in radiant swell, outshining the Threnodian's spell.
Ciaccona: Though shadows vast did crowd the night, the light of unity shone ever bright.
Ciaccona: With lantern held high, he banished the Dark Tide. Rinascita's long night, hereby cast aside!
Ciaccona: And while the dark hero has sadly gone, our Laureate is here for us to cheer on!
Rover: Ahem...
Ciaccona: Well, it was such an epic fight. If I can spin it into a song, maybe it'll live on in the hearts of Ragunna and Septimont, and all of Rinascita.
Ciaccona: Through this song, the land will rise anew, and the names of all the fallen will never fade...
[Dialogue Option]  So this is what a bard does...
[Dialogue Option]  Oh, I really am quite the legend.
Ciaccona: Heh, but there's another player in this tale...
Ciaccona: He was neither Ragunnesi nor Septimontian. Have you heard the story of this outlander?
Ciaccona: No? Then listen close. My melody will bring the story to life before your eyes...

Ciaccona: Welcome back. Shall we continue the story?

Leon: Um... hello? Sir?
Leon: Are you... a neighbor in need?
Leon: By the Sentinel, the Order of the Deep will assist you with all that we have.
Qiuyuan: I need to see Fenrico.
Leon: You wish to confess to our Primus? Alas, Lord Fenrico is currently away on a journey to spread the Sentinel's teachings.
Leon: But if you need assistance, simply let someone know you seek the Order's aid. They'll take you to the Cathedral of Mercury.
Leon: You can always find me in the Cathedral, brother. My name is Leon.
Leon: May Imperator be with you.
Qiuyuan: Confess ... to a Primus colluding with a Threnodian?
Qiuyuan: But if he's not here, then I'll seek out the "Blessed Maiden"... or Rover.
Ciaccona: Hello there! You are...
Ciaccona: From Huanglong, right? I assume from the style of your clothing. Are you travelling? Rinascita does offer some marvelous views...
Qiuyuan: ...
Resident of Ragunna: Ah !!!

title: A Stranger in a Strange Land
content:
[Objective: Find Acolyte of the Order]
Leon: It's you...
Qiuyuan: Get to safety.
Leon: But there are still people trapped in the square!
Leon: Carlotta Montelli.
Carlotta: Sir Leon? And this is...?
Qiuyuan: Qiuyuan.
Leon: I might not have survived if not for this kind soul from Huanglong.
Carlotta: My deepest gratitude for your aid.
Carlotta: Tacet Discords have appeared in the city without the slightest forewarning—
Leon: Ms. Carlotta, what of the Montelli Quarter? Have the civilians there been safely evacuated?
Carlotta: They're en route to the Cathedral as we speak. You may rest easy on that front.
Qiuyuan: The Threnodian's shadow already hangs over this city...
Qiuyuan: I can actually see  through the Dark Tide?
Qiuyuan: Could it be...?
Leon: Are you leaving, sir?
Qiuyuan: This place is no longer safe. You must all retreat.
Leon: ... May Imperator be with you, friend.
Carlotta: Quite the mysterious man to vanish in such a fashion.
Leon: I sense no ill intent. He appeared... to be searching for something.
Carlotta: An old acquaintance of yours, Sir Leon?
Leon: Not quite. Just crossed paths earlier on Bank Street.
Leon: Leviathan's whispers hold no sway over outlanders. May Imperator's grace guide him to what he seeks and keep him steadfast on his path.
Ciaccona: Carlotta!
Ciaccona: Everyone from the square should be inside the Cathedral by now. I went door by door to make sure! The children here are the last ones left.
Leon: You ... you're a ...
Ciaccona: This city and her people are crying out to us. We will weather this storm together!
Leon: Divine Envoys, Ragunna hangs by a thread! Fulfill your sacred duty! Defend the city and her people!
Carlotta: Brace yourselves!

title: A Stranger in a Strange Land
content:
[Objective: Talk to Cantarella]
Cantarella: An agent from ? Wait, I know you.
Cantarella: You serve under Lord Liang... Qiuyuan, if memory serves?
Qiuyuan: ...You know Grandmaster Liang?
Cantarella: I had the privilege of meeting many distinguished officials in Mingting. The  once introduced me to your 's workings.
Cantarella: I would never confuse the man behind Lord Liang. The one without sight yet seeing all... the Blind Watcher.
Qiuyuan: I see what others cannot. That's all.
Qiuyuan: This bullet ended Cartethyia... yet I sense no malice from it.
Qiuyuan: Born of light, yet flying amidst shadow.
Qiuyuan: What kind of flame... are you seeking?
Qiuyuan: Cartethyia, Resonator of both Sentinel and Threnodian.
Qiuyuan: Even in "death," you remain the vessel of both.
Qiuyuan: As for you...
Qiuyuan: There's no record of you in Mingting's archives.
Qiuyuan: All your frequencies are tied to the Threnodian.
Qiuyuan: Chaotic, ever devouring, assimilating... That is Tacet Discord. A power not fully your own.
Qiuyuan: You seek vengeance, but she is not your true target... it's the Divinity.
Qiuyuan: But you kept this from Rover. That is why it all unfolded so suddenly.
Qiuyuan: Besides spark and firewood, you needed another person to stoke the fire-
Qiuyuan: So it is you, Rover.
Qiuyuan: You match what Magistrate Jinhsi's bodyguard described. However...
Qiuyuan: The mark of Leviathan's Dark Tide clings to you.
Qiuyuan: That was why I sensed you through the Dark Tide in the city.
Qiuyuan: Anyone tainted by a Threnodian is fated for destruction.
Qiuyuan: Even if a cleansing fire could burn away that darkness, when the moment of choice comes...
Qiuyuan: Will you turn the blade on yourself?
Qiuyuan: That woman did shoot Cartethyia. Rover is after her now.
Qiuyuan: But that's not the whole story.
Cantarella: How do you know that?
Qiuyuan: I can sense lingering frequencies in a place.
Cantarella: The Sentinel is no more, the Blessed Maiden is gone, and now the Dark Tide descends...
Qiuyuan: You are outnumbered.
Qiuyuan: You said you met with Mingting's officials. That means you had an audience not just with Grandmaster Liang, but with the , too.
Qiuyuan: She asked me to execute a Fractsidus Overseer named Scar in Rinascita, and help Rover in the process.
Cantarella: So Mingting had foreseen all this?
Qiuyuan: That's not my concern.
Qiuyuan: "Thou shalt wield the torch of the usurper to drive away the darkness."
Qiuyuan: That's all the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs gave me. Any clue what this "torch" might be?
Cantarella: Usurper... Torch...
Cantarella: That may be referring to Primus Fenrico and the "First Relic" he holds.
Qiuyuan: Then that relic might be the help Rover needs.
Cantarella: Fenrico should still be in the experiment site he secretly built.
Cantarella: It lies beneath the waters to the southwest of Thessaleo Fells. I'm afraid you'll need to pinpoint the precise location yourself.
Qiuyuan: I see.
Qiuyuan: One more thing. Don't tell anyone I was here.
Qiuyuan: Do I have your word?
Cantarella: And why is that? Are you not a Mingting official?
Qiuyuan: I was. Not anymore.
Qiuyuan: Mingting... is not the place you once visited.
Qiuyuan: Secure Cartethyia's body and get to a safer place.

title: A Stranger in a Strange Land
subsection: Your Nemesis stands before you. Defeat the "Fractsidus Member"
content:
[Objective: Your Nemesis stands before you. Defeat the "Fractsidus Member"]
???: Oh?
Leon?: This place is marred by the Dark Tide's filth. Why risk yourself, brother?
Qiuyuan: It's you... the Fractsidus I sensed.
Qiuyuan: Playing dress-up again... Is this your twisted idea of fun?
Leon?: By the Sentinel, do you not recognize me?
Qiuyuan: Your disguise means nothing to me. I recognize your frequency.
Leon?: Hehe... What truly separates us, brother?
Leon?: A face alone is a sorry veneer. I am an Acolyte...
Leon?: Just as you are a fugitive clinging to an official's uniform.
Leon?: What a shame you couldn't end "him" in Mingting... and now, you still can't.
Qiuyuan: Why are you here?
Leon?: A grim stage has been set for Rover in this land.
Leon?: And I, at the invitation of another, am merely a supporting character in this grand performance.
Leon?: And my role is to stop you here.
Leon?: As an Acolyte, my faith in "Imperator" is indestructible, though my flesh remains so very fragile.
Qiuyuan: You killed that Acolyte.
Leon?: Oh, he's quite hale and hearty. Right now, he should be tending to the wounded in that vault.
Leon?: Besides, it's beneath me to move against such an... ordinary character.
Leon?: Such brutality. And here I stand, an unarmed Acolyte.
Leon?: A pale shadow compared to Lord Liang Dongyuan, the mighty master of both pen and sword.
Qiuyuan: You will pay for murdering Grandmaster Liang with your blood.
Leon?: Oh really? Isn't that debt yours to answer for?
Leon?: A wanted criminal of Mingting, and yet the Ministry of War sent you all the way to Rinascita to hunt down Scar in secret.
Leon?: Who would've thought... Mingting places such importance on him.
Qiuyuan: If you know that, it means you still have eyes and ears in Mingting.
Leon?: Without a doubt. I am... "everywhere."
Leon?: Speaking of which, Scar should be in Septimont now.
Leon?: He did a patchy job in Jinzhou and needs to answer for his own missteps. I will not interfere with how you handle him.
Leon?: As for our dear Primus here, a ruling hand clinging tightly to a cruel fate, a martyr yet to earn a name...
Leon?: You are here for him, no?
Leon ?: "Thou shalt wield the torch of the usurper to drive away the darkness."
Leon?: A Huanglong prophecy, yes? But isn't it just another verse in Divinity's script?
Qiuyuan: What have you done to him?
Leon?: Me? Nothing.
Leon?: What you see is simply the consequence of him fulfilling his destiny.
Leon?: A remnant of his consciousness still lingers, right inside that lantern.
Qiuyuan: Step aside.
Leon?: Why of course. What could an unarmed Acolyte possibly do against Huanglong's blade?
Leon?: Still, allow me a parting word...
Leon?: Fenrico ... he's not so different from you.
Leon?: You have killed without hesitation, and your one mistake was a single act of mercy.
Leon?: For that moment of weakness, you've paid no less than he did.
Leon?: How can a lone, flickering torch hope to banish shadow upon shadow?
Leon?: Ruthless soul, your end awaits you!
Qiuyuan: This is...
Qiuyuan: The Fractsidus.

title: A Stranger in a Strange Land
subsection: Put Fenrico the First to rest
content:
[Objective: Put Fenrico the First to rest]
Fenrico: Be gone... Be gone...
Fenrico: You short-lived glimmer of a candle...
Fenrico: Just as the tale of the fool...
Fenrico: Vociferous, but hollow.
Qiuyuan: The Dark Tide. Seems like he's still connected with the Threnodian...
Fenrico: My... cathedral.
Fenrico: This is...
Qiuyuan: A corner in the realm of my mind. It shifts with the person I meet.
Qiuyuan: This cathedral shows your obsession.
Fenrico: A soul from Huanglong...
Fenrico: Here, you shall find neither the gospel you can accept, nor the judgment you are meant to endure.
Qiuyuan: The Threnodian has taken everything from you.
Qiuyuan: Your Blessed Maiden is dead, your city crumbles.
Qiuyuan: The Dark Tide will soon swallow it whole. Your tie with the Threnodian should have shown you what's already happened.
Qiuyuan: Give me the lantern.
Fenrico: Tell me, by what right do you demand what is ours?
Fenrico: "The path born of injustice must be fortified with further transgressions..."
Fenrico: No. Our path was built upon a foundation of righteousness.
Fenrico: Here, one Primus after another offered up their battered flesh... in defiance of Leviathan.
Fenrico: And ... be it Leviathan, Cartethyia, or the Fractsidus, none shall steal Ragunna from my keeping.
Fenrico: Under the hands of the Primuses, Ragunna flourished. By our light, the people were shielded from the Threnodian's corruption and led toward a true Blessed Land.
Fenrico: People need unity of belief. That is why a Primus must rule. That is the heart of our creed.
Fenrico: It is what sustained me across twenty years of struggle against the Threnodian. I sought to bend Its power toward a higher purpose.
Fenrico: But in the end... that creed consumed me. I believed I could use Leviathan as a hammer to forge a true Blessed Land against Its hollow "Paradise." But I was the one used.
Fenrico: Such is my appointed fate. I accept it without challenge.
Fenrico: What still binds me here ... is naught but fury and hatred for the betrayal.
Qiuyuan: You are only mortal. Mortals don't stand a chance against a Threnodian.
Fenrico: Night and day, Its whispers echoed in our heads. A torment no soul can endure.
Fenrico: And despite Imperator's fading light granting us only fleeting moments of clarity, generations of Primuses have willingly walked this path.
Qiuyuan: And you still thought you could control Its power?
Qiuyuan: Ambition and obsession fueled your fight against the Threnodian. But in the end, they're the very things that brought you down.
Qiuyuan: Yours is a scripture of righteousness. Yet evil and atrocity are written all over your deeds.
Fenrico: I stand knee-deep in a river of blood. What is spilled cannot be unspilled.
Qiuyuan: There was a time I could have killed a man before he waded into a river of blood.
Qiuyuan: Now, that chance stands before me once more.
Fenrico: "No mortal shall inflict upon you even the slightest harm."
Fenrico: It is this prophecy and fate that lead me onward...
Fenrico: Pleasure born of violence shall end in violence.
Fenrico: You that are heavy laden by guilt, come and confess.

title: A Stranger in a Strange Land
subsection: Qiuyuan once faced a difficult choice. Ordered by the Mingting Censorate to kill Geshu Lin, Qiuyuan hesitated, seeing that the man had not yet fallen to darkness. He saw the raging fire churning in the man's heart, but just as his own teacher once cautioned him, he urged Geshu Lin to wield his power with restraint. In defying the Censorate's command, he spared Geshu Lin's life.

title: A Stranger in a Strange Land
subsection: Qiuyuan once faced a difficult choice. Ordered by the Mingting Censorate to kill Geshu Lin, Qiuyuan hesitated, seeing that the man had not yet fallen to darkness. He saw the raging fire churning in the man's heart, but just as his own teacher once cautioned him, he urged Geshu Lin to wield his power with restraint. In defying the Censorate's command, he spared Geshu Lin's life.
content:
Geshu Lin: Tell me why.
Qiuyuan: By the order of the , you are to be executed by the Internal Security Agency.
Geshu Lin: Me?
Qiuyuan: They accuse you of... colluding with Tacet Discords and wreaking havoc across Jinzhou.
Geshu Lin: What a joke...
Geshu Lin: Killing them isn't enough.
Qiuyuan: You killed these Tacet Discords. These people owe you their lives.
Geshu Lin: Yes. So what?
Geshu Lin: The border is in chaos, and all your Agency does is lick the boots of corrupt officials.
Geshu Lin: Might as well... kill me here.
Geshu Lin: Do it.
Geshu Lin: If you let me live today. I swear... Every one of the ISA's dogs...
Geshu Lin: And every last Tacet Discord... I'll turn these lands white with your bones.
Qiuyuan: Grandmaster Liang from the Agency spoke in your defense.
Geshu Lin: Then why are you here?
Qiuyuan: ... I've read your case files in Jinzhou these past few days.
Qiuyuan: Those Censors failed in their duties and deceived us...
Qiuyuan: How could a single squad captain possibly conspire with Tacet Discords to kill and raid?
Qiuyuan: You're just an ordinary man.
Geshu Lin: Those things are killing our people. I... won't let that stand.
Geshu Lin: Tacet Discords don't get to live. No matter the cost, I won't stop until... they're all annihilated.
Qiuyuan: Jinzhou's survival depends on stopping the Tacet Discords.
Qiuyuan: You wield incredible might, but such strength demands restraint.
Qiuyuan: A sword exists to deter, not kill. Draw too quickly, and you'll die by your own blade.
Qiuyuan: Your sword can cut down Tacet Discords. Or save lives.
Qiuyuan: If your resolve to protect this land stands firm, you will forge a legacy.

metadata.page_title: A Stranger in a Strange Land
metadata.subsection: Qiuyuan once faced a difficult choice. Ordered by the Mingting Censorate to kill Geshu Lin, Qiuyuan hesitated, seeing that the man had not yet fallen to darkness. He saw the raging fire churning in the man's heart, but just as his own teacher once cautioned him, he urged Geshu Lin to wield his power with restraint. In defying the Censorate's command, he spared Geshu Lin's life.

title: A Stranger in a Strange Land
subsection: Through the Dark Tide, Fenrico glimpses these memories. Because Geshu Lin did eventually fall to darkness, guilt has haunted Qiuyuan ever since. But history grants no second chances. All that remains for both Fenrico and Qiuyuan is to fulfill their missions. Choosing to trust Qiuyuan, Fenrico hands the First Relic and the task of defeating Leviathan to him. With that, his soul vanishes into the depths of the Fabricatorium.

title: A Stranger in a Strange Land
subsection: Through the Dark Tide, Fenrico glimpses these memories. Because Geshu Lin did eventually fall to darkness, guilt has haunted Qiuyuan ever since. But history grants no second chances. All that remains for both Fenrico and Qiuyuan is to fulfill their missions. Choosing to trust Qiuyuan, Fenrico hands the First Relic and the task of defeating Leviathan to him. With that, his soul vanishes into the depths of the Fabricatorium.
content:
Fenrico: I... I see it now. What haunts you, the memories you carry...
Fenrico: I see that rainy night. That battle. And the Threnodian... feeding on it all.
Fenrico: I see the plain drenched in blood. The man standing atop it all, burning in black flames...
Fenrico: What happened to him?
Qiuyuan: He fell into Ovathrax's abyss.
Fenrico: And shared my fate...
Qiuyuan: Maybe when we first met, he still held on to a shred of goodness. But even so, it didn't stop his end from coming.
Fenrico: You should have killed him when you had the chance.
Qiuyuan: History grants no second chances. And the dead do not return.
Qiuyuan: I've lost everything, but it still doesn't cover the debt I owe the dead of that battlefield.
Qiuyuan: There's only one thing I can do. Next we meet, I'll end him, quick and clean.
Qiuyuan: If given the choice again, would you still become Primus?
Fenrico: I would.
Fenrico: Usurper they may deem me, but never shall they deny the fruit of my toil.
Fenrico: Well do I know my iniquities, and clear is the end of my path.
Fenrico: So, were I to choose anew, I would tread this path once more... though it spurns the wisdom of every Primus before me, though nothing but trials and terrors lie ahead.
Fenrico: Now... take this.
Qiuyuan: "Thou shalt wield the torch of the usurper to drive away the darkness."
Qiuyuan: So this is the "First Relic"?
Fenrico: Napoli the Second wielded it to purge Ragunna of the Dark Tide. And at that moment of triumph, the Order earned the Threnodian's full attention.
Fenrico: This lantern... carry it forth. Should the Journeying Paradise come, it will emerge from Septimont, where the Righteous One shall surely be.
Qiuyuan: Rover has also been tainted by the Dark Tide, like you.
Fenrico: The Dark Tide binds us all. I did feel his presence.
Fenrico: He now stands as the new Harbinger, walking a path that... was never meant to be his.
Fenrico: That is why he needs this lantern far more than I do.
Qiuyuan: Is this your penance?
Fenrico: I do not repent. But a dying Primus has no right to hold onto this relic.
Fenrico: This is... my destiny.
Fenrico: Upon deception had I built my reign and legacy. And no mortal could inflict upon me even the slightest harm.
Fenrico: The wandering Righteous One... is no mere mortal.
Fenrico: Take this lantern!
Qiuyuan: The flame of ambition and obsession has died. Only the lantern's glow remains.
Qiuyuan: So... do you seek vengeance?
Fenrico: In violence shall I end the pleasure born of violence...
Qiuyuan: A Threnodian is no easy kill.
Fenrico: My flock, the faithful of the Order, and the wandering Righteous One... they shall prevail.
Fenrico: Even though I should fall into hell, Leviathan too shall burn beside me.
Fenrico: Become my knight. Take this and go.
Fenrico: In this way... shall I fulfill my destiny...
Fenrico: ...I am Fenrico Macbeth...
Fenrico: Though I may never stand among the greatest Primuses...
Fenrico: History shall remember me... as Fenrico the First.
Qiuyuan: History's truth is inscribed in stone. May those who come after render their verdict on you.
Qiuyuan: So ends the path of , of the Order of the Deep.
Qiuyuan: Your wish is well received.

subsection: Listen to Ciaccona to recount the melodies
content:
[Objective: Listen to Ciaccona to recount the melodies]
Ciaccona: …As for what happened after, that we already know!
Ciaccona: The mysterious swordsman stood alone and held back the Dark Tide at the fiercest frontline!
Ciaccona: Not to mention, he made quick work of Scar, the Fractsidus Overseer.
[Dialogue Option]  I know those parts well...
[Dialogue Option]  How do you know about all of that?
Ciaccona: Some of it came straight from the folks in Ragunna, and some from a certain Fisalia, who prefers to remain unnamed.
[Dialogue Option]  What about the Fabricatorium part?
Rover: Why did I see some things you weren't even recounting?
Ciaccona: It's similar to what happened when I helped you see Cartethyia.
Ciaccona: Perhaps it's the lantern. It holds the last flickers of Fenrico's will. It could have revealed a glimpse of what happened in the Fabricatorium.
Ciaccona: A swordsman from distant shores aiding a disgraced Primus in taking vengeance against the Threnodian Leviathan…
Ciaccona: Astonishing, isn't it? But it's all true...
Ciaccona: That mysterious swordsman also mentioned someone else. A man burning in black flames...
Rover: Geshu Lin...
Rover: There's more to him than they want us to see. And more buried between Jinzhou and Mingting than they'll ever admit.
Rover: The order to hunt down Scar in Rinascita came straight from Mingting. Even Jinhsi was left in the dark.
Rover: Whatever he's carrying... could shake Mingting to its core.
Ciaccona: Guess you'll have to wait until you're in Huanglong for answers.
Ciaccona: Or... Perhaps we could go ask our mysterious swordsman himself?
Ciaccona: If he brought you the First Relic, then he's one of the heroes who saved Rinascita.
Ciaccona: We still owe him our thanks, but no one saw him after the final battle...
Ciaccona: Locating a visitor from Huanglong in Ragunna shouldn't be a hassle, not with the Montellis, the Fisalias, the Order, and our Septimontian friends all out there preparing to rebuild Rinascita.
Ciaccona: Let's go! I bet we can find him!

Augusta: Ragunna is indeed nothing like Septimont.
Augusta: A harbor like this suits sea trade far better...
[Dialogue Option]  Is this your first visit to Ragunna, Augusta?
Augusta: It is. After all, Ragunna was closed to outsiders.
Augusta: But we'll be heading back to Septimont after trade negotiations with the Montellis and the Order are concluded.
[Dialogue Option]  About that Huanglong warrior who aided in Septimont's frontline defense...
[Dialogue Option]  Have you seen the Huanglong warrior?
Augusta: The swordsman named Qiuyuan?
Augusta: I ran into him earlier by the docks. We spoke briefly. He looked ready to board a ship home.
Augusta: The Gladiators who stood their ground during the attack spoke of him. They said it was he who held the fiercest frontline alone when the Fractsidus unleashed the Dark Tide.
Augusta: I don't dare imagine the casualties without his aid...
[Dialogue Option]  I want to thank him in person as well.

title: A Stranger in a Strange Land
content:
[Objective: Find Qiuyuan at the harbor]
Qiuyuan: Sir, how long before the ship departs?
Old Merchant: The captain says once these goods from Septimont are loaded, we prepare to set sail.
Qiuyuan: I see no Acolytes supervising.
Old Merchant: Thought you couldn't see! So you can, eh?
Qiuyuan: No ... I just sense no one is causing you trouble.
Old Merchant: Ragunna and Septimont have been through a lot. Really was those heroes who carried us through this disaster.
Old Merchant: And Lord Fenrico and his predecessors... Under Sentinel Imperator's guidance, they held the lantern high and drove away the darkness surrounding us.
Old Merchant: Still gives me chills when I think about it...
Qiuyuan: That's all behind us, sir.
Old Merchant: Right you are...
Qiuyuan: You board first. I'll be ready soon.
Old Merchant: Aye. Thank you, lad.
Qiuyuan: You have come.
Rover: Leaving so soon?
Qiuyuan: I've lingered long enough. My work isn't done.
Rover: Scar and the other Fractsidus operatives got away...
Qiuyuan: Our Grand Marshal likely expected as much. They always have a way out.
Qiuyuan: Pity. Would have liked to see if I could sever that goat head in one strike.
Rover: I still haven't properly thanked you for your help in Septimont.
Qiuyuan: Leviathan's influence was aimed at Rinascita. Outsiders like me were spared.
Qiuyuan: Besides, it was the Grand Marshal who asked me to help you here.
Qiuyuan: You should save your gratitude for her when you visit Mingting someday. She takes great interest in you.
Rover: Mingting... I've only been to Jinzhou so far.
Qiuyuan: The world is wide. Rove far enough, and you'll find your way there.
Rover: Wait, about Geshu Lin...
Qiuyuan: You know Jiyan. You fought in Norfall Barrens. You must also know what really happened in Jinzhou three years ago.
Qiuyuan: And what becomes of those who fall to the Threnodian. Not everyone has the strength to resist Its persuasions, not like the people here.
Rover: Are you still after him?
Qiuyuan: Back then, corrupt officials lied to the Internal Security Agency, to Grandmaster Liang, and to me. I went to Jinzhou to execute him.
Qiuyuan: But at the time... he wasn't what they claimed. It was only later that he fell to the Threnodian's influence.
Qiuyuan: For the lives lost in that battle because of him, death is too light a punishment.
Qiuyuan: But it's what I can give him, and what I must.
Old Merchant: Come now, lad! Ye' miss this ship to Mengzhou, and you're waiting till morning!
Qiuyuan: They call you Rover, but you're not without a home. You are a blade with a sheath.
Qiuyuan: Those who stand by you are your home. Your sheath. They will fight for you. And you, for them.
Qiuyuan: Maybe one day...
Rover: You will.
Qiuyuan: You are what they say.
Qiuyuan: May our paths cross again.

title: A Stranger in a Strange Land
content:
Mingting - The capital of Huanglong. The nation's political, economic, and cultural center.

Ministry of Sentinel Affairs - A special agency responsible for monitoring Sentinels, astronomy, and calendars across Huanglong's various cities. Led by the Minister of Sentinel Affairs in Mingting, it has subordinate bureaus in the other six cities, each headed by a Supervisor. While they hold independent authority on Sentinel-related matters, they are limited to advising and supervising the administrative bodies of each city and Mingting.

metadata.page_title: A Stranger in a Strange Land

title: A Stranger in a Strange Land
content:
Internal Security Agency - An institution that operates independently of the administrative, judicial, and military branches of Huanglong, with the highest official titled "Chief Commander." Reporting directly to the Emperor of Huanglong, it holds the authority to investigate any case, official, or criminal without approval from other agencies, with the power to "act first, report later." Tasked with handling intricate cases year-round, the agency has developed specialized expertise in managing Resonators.

Grand Marshal - As the highest official in Huanglong's Ministry of War, the Minister oversees all military affairs for the six cities in Huanglong. The honorific title "Grand Marshal" is used to signify the rank and authority of this position.

metadata.page_title: A Stranger in a Strange Land

title: A Stranger in a Strange Land
content:
Censorate - One of Huanglong's three judicial bodies. It holds the authority to jointly try major cases and wields significant supervisory power, a duty summarized as "to probe evil and maintain discipline." Its officials are generally titled Censors, while those stationed or assigned temporarily in the six cities are called Investigating Censors.

Fenrico the First - Just as the name enjoyed by Napoli the Second, it is a title Primus Fenrico should have rightfully possessed. However, due to unknown reasons, Fenrico forbade Acolytes from referring to him as such, until he met his end at the bottom of the sea. In the history of the Order of the Deep, he is the only one who bears the name "Fenrico."

title: Stagnant Dawn on Wastelands
content:
[Objective: (Talk to Valentina)]
Valentina: Group A, begin data preprocessing. Group B, deploy ground interference neutralizers... Oh, Rover, you're here.
[Dialogue Option]  Why is there such a large gathering today?
Valentina: The Black Shores recovered the Threnodian's Gem not long ago... I mean, Leviathan's essence. The Tethys System ran a deep analysis and expanded its frequency feature library. This enhancement allows us to detect previously unidentifiable special frequencies.
Valentina: Fortunately, not all these frequencies are Leviathan-related, so there's no immediate risk of Its revival. That said, the closest anomaly is right offshore.
Valentina: Bloom Bearers not assigned to critical duties have been dispatched to investigate. The Shorekeeper is also dedicating part of her computations to tracking it. The Black Shores has classified this as a high-priority operation and is committing additional resources to track and replicate the signal.
[Dialogue Option]  That explains the crowd.
Valentina: Exactly. None of us can identify this abnormal frequency, so it might lead to new discoveries.
Valentina: The Shorekeeper is in the Error Cell. You can go there to speak with her.

title: Stagnant Dawn on Wastelands
subsection: (Talk to Shorekeeper in the Error Cell)
content:
[Objective: (Talk to Shorekeeper in the Error Cell)]
Shorekeeper: You have come.
[Dialogue Option]  How's it going?
[Dialogue Option]  Any luck tracking the frequency?
Shorekeeper: This marks the Tethys System's first large-scale expansion of its frequency feature library. We needed to deploy it while it's still under validation. The data stream is immense, and I need more time. However...
Shorekeeper: ...Within the chaos, I found a fragmented message.
[Dialogue Option]  A fragmented message?
Shorekeeper: Yes. The source identity is unclear, but we have isolated a set of constantly shifting spatial coordinates.
Shorekeeper: One points to an unknown location. The other... points here, to the Black Shores.
Rover: Whoever left that message knew exactly where to find the Black Shores. And if they do...
Rover: I'll check it out.
Shorekeeper: Understood. I will send the coordinates to your Terminal. I must remain here to continue isolating and tracing embedded messages in the surrounding frequencies. I entrust this to you, my star.

title: Stagnant Dawn on Wastelands
subsection: (Head to the source of the commotion and talk to them)
content:
[Objective: (Head to the source of the commotion and talk to them)]
Buling: This is bad, really bad! Just look at my Casket of Fate! It's been rattling nonstop all day! All day! I haven't seen it this jumpy in years!
Ria: Ms. Buling, we understand your concern. But the Tethys System hasn't completed its analysis yet, and your talisman divination isn't always—Ahem, what I mean is, without proper clearance, we can't initiate a high-level response...
Buling: You trust those wires over me? I dreamed last night of three upside-down houses right outside my window. That's a horrible omen! And I felt Yin energy. That means something living is behind it. It's not an ordinary frequency, okay ?!
Ria: It's not that we don't trust you, Ms. Buling. It's just... last time, when you dreamed of a black cat dancing ritualistically, it turned out your Casket just had water in it.
Ria: We'll begin parallel observation once Tethys completes its full spectrum diagnostics. It's for everyone's safety here in the Black Shores...
Buling: Aiya... by the time you're done crunching the data, even the immortals will be too old to—Oh! Boss! Didn't see you there!
[Dialogue Option]  Didn't expect to run into you here.
Buling: I know, right? Thought I'd come back to do some quick biz... You know, fix up the feng shui, zing up some romance luck for the lonely hearts... But wah, this one is a big, big problem.
Buling: The voices won't stop pouring in. Feels like a whole swarm of abnormal frequencies gathering up. And look! My Pendant of Shifting Yao's so hot, I could fry an egg on it!
[Dialogue Option]  You've sensed that abnormal frequency too?
Buling: Delicate threads, twisted webs. A deadlock. It's trapped in a formation... It shouldn't even exist in this world.
Buling: Got any leads, Boss? Maybe I can help crack this one too.
Rover: Actually... I've got a pair of shifting spatial coordinates.
Buling: Oh really? Show me! I can try to track them down.

title: Stagnant Dawn on Wastelands
content:
[Objective: (Talk to Ria)]
Ria: Great, Rover, you're here!
[Dialogue Option]  Here I am.
Ria: Good. Let me give you a quick briefing on what we've learned so far. This spatial rift leads to an unknown Sonoro Sphere.

[Dialogue Option]  How's everything going?

Mysterious Capybara: Oh, a Passenger. Welcome aboard.
[Dialogue Option]  Thank you.

Mysterious Capybara: Ah Chisa, so formal, as usual. I think he looks like a good person.
Chisa: ...Then you can handle the introductions.
Namipon: Greetings, Passenger. My name is Namipon, the guardian (Mascot) of Honami. I'm also the one who showed you the way... Mmm, I can tell you're a good soul.
[Dialogue Option]  Hello, Namipon. You're a cute one!

[Dialogue Option]  This capybara has a name?
Namipon: No, no. I'm not the kind of animal you think I am. I am this city's guardian (Mascot).
Namipon: So of course I have a name. It was given by all who live here.
Namipon: And this is Chisa. A strong, mysterious...
Chisa: An ordinary student.
Chisa: Sorry again. Things were chaotic when we first met, and I couldn't tell whether or not you were one of the Left Behind... I didn't have time to explain.
Chisa: But now, I'm sure. You're just another person pulled into this.
[Dialogue Option]  You mean...

[Dialogue Option]  (Answer honestly)
