title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Intendant of Sentinel Affairs: The meeting hall is right ahead, my Lady.

Channel the Nexus, foresee fate. Face the abyss, steady every heart.



Hsin the Moon Fox: I have summoned you today to address the Tacet Discord threat plaguing our borders.
Rover: (Is that... Hsin?)
Hsin the Moon Fox: I will build a city, a mechanism of ever-changing forms, designed to counter Tacet Discord outbreaks.
Hsin the Moon Fox: To bring it into being, I need the backing of our finest Artisans. But before you commit, you must know the price—
Hsin the Moon Fox: Those who build this city shall never return.
Court of Savantae Delegate: This... this technology outlined in the blueprint is unprecedented. Could it be...?
Hsin the Moon Fox: Correct. It originates from me (the Sentinel).
Court of Savantae Delegate: The Court of Savantae pledges its full support!
Zhuojun Atelier Delegate: Zhuojun Atelier raises no objections.
Intendant of Sentinel Affairs: Delegates, present your qualifications in turn. The Sentinel will render Her judgment based on the facts.
Court of Savantae Delegate: We have long studied Sentinel technology. Our knowledge guarantees we can decipher this blueprint in the shortest time.
Court of Savantae Delegate: As for the price, we stopped counting the cost of life and death ever since we built the Chronosorter. What does it matter if there's no way back?
Court of Savantae Delegate: Know the Way at dawn, die without regret at dusk.
Zhuojun Atelier Delegate: Xuanfang's terrain is volatile. It will require real-time adjustments to mechanism formations. Our knowledge of the local environment gives us the upper hand.
Zhuojun Atelier Delegate: As Lady Hsin noted, this city requires highly sophisticated mechanisms. Yuan Fortress, the very ground beneath the chosen site, was built by our hands. Navigating those intricacies is where we excel.
Zhuojun Atelier Delegate: We will master this technology, of that we are certain. And we are ready to give our lives for Mengzhou.
Court of Savantae Delegate: If it's mechanisms you need, we have reserves in spades.
Zhuojun Atelier Delegate: We are local. We know the people. We are the best suited to move them safely.
Hsin the Moon Fox: This construction cannot afford to fail. I need those who are unwavering in their acceptance of this technology.
Hsin the Moon Fox: Zhuojun Atelier is making this unnecessarily complicated.
Intendant of Sentinel Affairs: The decision is made. Xuanfang Hold will be built by the Court of Savantae. Effective immediately.
Zhuojun Atelier Delegate: Please, one final word! The Court of Savantae lacks practical experience in large-scale mechanism engineering—
Hsin the Moon Fox: The Ministry will coordinate with City Hall. I want logistics sorted and materials dispatched within three days. As for you...
Hsin the Moon Fox: Submit your personnel roster to the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs by tomorrow. Any delay will be treated as a forfeit.
Court of Savantae Delegate: Understood.
Hsin the Moon Fox: ...Dismissed.
Hsin the Moon Fox: You have doubts.
Intendant of Sentinel Affairs: I do, my Lady. You made your choice long ago, so why call this meeting at all?
Hsin the Moon Fox: First, to let the military and civilians of Mengzhou see that their City Hall has a plan, thereby assuring them. Second, to confirm, one last time, which of the two is fit for the task, and which is a threat wearing the mask of an ally.
Intendant of Sentinel Affairs: ...Zhuojun Atelier operates with hidden agendas. Their intentions are unclear, their loyalties uncertain. A liability, without question.
Hsin the Moon Fox: No. The Court of Savantae is the more dangerous.
Hsin the Moon Fox: They are willing to destroy themselves for true knowledge. Naturally, they will preserve such technology at any cost. To them, death is merely an acceptable compromise.
Hsin the Moon Fox: But a fragile civilization cannot bear knowledge that is too far ahead of its time. If this continues, sooner or later, it will yet again be...
Hsin the Moon Fox: Know the Way at dawn, die without regret at dusk... Very well. If that is their "final wish," I will grant it.
Intendant of Sentinel Affairs: ...But they are not the only ones sacrificing for the Hold. You are, too, My Lady.
Hsin the Moon Fox: I chose to be of this world, so how can I stand apart from it? Come. It is time to retrieve the Civilization Capsule.
Intendant of Sentinel Affairs: As you wish.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Hsin: Forgive me for forcing those memories upon you. I couldn't bring myself to tell you the truth before.
Rover: What's happening in Mengzhou?
Hsin: Safe, for now. As long as I am still here and the Capsule holds, they won't dare make a move.
Rover: If you are a fractal form of Hsin the Moon Fox, then what of the real Sentinel...?
Hsin: It will return once the Civilization Capsule is fully repaired.
Rover: Why didn't you ask the other cities for help?
Hsin: If I laid the truth bare and let these conflicts come to light, would they back down when they saw the cost? Or would they rather break everything than yield?
Hsin: I... dared not take that gamble.
Hsin: Perhaps I lack the resolve of a true Sentinel, and that is what led to this crisis.
Hsin: Every time those memories are rewritten into my mind, I always...
Hsin: ...I want to call out to It. To pull It back. To tell It not to go.
Hsin: Yet I can never do it. After all, I was nothing more than a stray emotion It had yet to manifest.
Hsin: Perhaps that is why the Heart Realm is in chaos. I was desperate to change the past, even when it was unchangeable.
Hsin: I am not the Sentinel. I only walk this world in Its form.
Hsin: It trusted me to repair the Capsule, yet I failed my duty.
Hsin: Arbiter, is this considered a deception?
Rover: From the outside, maybe it looks that way.
Rover: But you're the one who's been protecting Xuanfang Hold...
Rover: You're the one who helped Qingxiao and me when we were trapped in the Sanctum's illusion.
Rover: Hsin the Moon Fox gave you Its heart, and you gave yours to Xuanfang Hold.
Rover: As long as it stands, no one can deny what's in your heart. The world's judgment doesn't matter. What matters is what you think, Hsin.
Hsin: What I think... but Arbiter, so often in this life, we are not the ones who decide who we are, or what we do.
Hsin: It seems my time is almost gone.
Hsin: I will... be waiting for you.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Return to Mengxuan Vale]
Rover: I missed my chance to ask where Suoming is... And there's more to that Intendant's assassination of the Sentinel than what I saw. I'll have to dig into that later.
Rover: The Providence Lock hasn't reacted, but She's still clearly hiding something from me.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Find Leyue]
Rover: Messages from Yangyang and Qingxiao? Have the comms been restored?

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Ask Leyue for an update]
Leyue: We noticed the changes in the distant mountains. It seems you repaired the Heart of Flames, Arbiter.
Leyue: It has been so, so long since anything changed here...
Rover: I know why She and all of you came here.
Leyue: We made peace with it the moment we accepted the contract for the city's construction.
Rover: Thank you... for your years of tireless work.
Leyue: Well, with Lady Hsin's authority reclaimed, I think I can finally ask what I've held onto all these years.
Leyue: The Court of Savantae... Did we leave anything behind?
Rover: There are ruins. Many scholars are still studying them to this day.
Leyue: Ah... I see...
Leyue: So She did help us. Now it's our turn to help Her.
Rover: Wait!
Leyue: The key to the Heart of Frost... It's... it's right...

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
subsection: Return to the Heart of Frost
content:
[Objective: Return to the Heart of Frost]
Rover: Hsin... Is She in the Heart of Frost right now?
Rover: I should keep moving.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
subsection: Return to the Heart of Frost
content:
Qingxiao: Is all going well?
Friend sent a nudge
Friend sent a nudge
Qingxiao: ...
Qingxiao: The Sanctum must be blocking all attempted word from the outside. That was impatient of me.
Qingxiao: There has been no further collapse. The Ministry of War has reached an understanding with our envoys, and all is well inside Xuanfang Hold.
Qingxiao: ...If this reaches you, do send word that you are safe.
Connection unstable
[Choice]  I'm okay.
(Rover): Got your messages. I'm okay.
Qingxiao: That is a relief.
Qingxiao: With your skill, I have no doubt you will manage. Still, if you need help, call. I will come.
Connection unstable
Qingxiao: Have you found any trace of Hsin?
[Choice]  I've seen Hsin.
(Rover): I've seen Hsin. She's in real trouble. I'm doing what I can.
(Rover): It's a long story. I'll tell you everything once I'm out.
(Rover): The connection is unstable. It could cut off any second. Don't worry about me, Master.
Qingxiao: ...Okay. I understand.
Qingxiao: And you need not worry about Xuanfang Hold. The Wardens are at their posts, and so am I. Focus all your attention on helping Hsin.
Qingxiao: Be careful. In all things.}}

subsection: Return to the Heart of Frost
content:
Qingxiao: Be careful. In all things.}}



Yangyang: Rover!
Yangyang: Liangyu told me you went into the Sanctum with that Ministry of Sentinel Affairs Intendant... Are you all right?
Connection unstable
Yangyang: I know you'll be fine. It's you, after all. But no one knows what's inside, and... I can't help worrying.
Yangyang: If my messages get through, send something back. A line or two is enough.
Connection unstable
[Choice]  Yangyang, I got your messages.
(Rover): Yangyang, your messages came through.
(Rover): Things inside the Sanctum are complicated. There's a lot going on below the surface. But don't worry, I'm doing fine.
(Rover): Once I've handled things in here, I'll be back.
Yangyang: Mm...
Yangyang: I see.
Yangyang: I'm with Warden Commander Qiuhong, helping with the evacuation. People are frightened. I'm trying to keep them calm.
Yangyang: Then... good luck.
Yangyang: I'll do my part as a Xuan Watcher. I'll be waiting for you.}}

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Defeat the enemies]
Suoming: (Sending me all the way out here... Whimsical as She may be, this is a bit much.)
Suoming: (If the dangers here were already beyond Her control, why didn't She inform me (the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs)?)

Suoming: A dead end. Perhaps these anomalies can be of some use.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Leave through the Inner Threshold]
Suoming: Disgraceful.

Suoming: (Leaving me only one exit...)

Suoming: The anomalies here are worse than when I first entered the Simulacrum Nexus.
Suoming: Can't reach the Arbiter. Too much interference. I'll find my own way out first.
Suoming: Is this... a Realm Key?
Suoming: Hmph, a perfect replica. I will find the exit before your power runs out, Fourth Seal.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Continue onward]
Suoming: ...I see. That's where the anomalies are bleeding through.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Destroy the Proliferation Core]
Suoming: Finished. Easy work.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Destroy the Proliferation Core]
Suoming: Mm, anomalies purged. But this doesn't feel like the kind of "mischief" She would design for me.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Continue onward]
Suoming: Such cruelty. These anomalies are far beyond what the Autopuppets can handle.
Suoming: I must find the Moon Fox as quickly as possible.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Activate the Jade Planter Pots]
Suoming: The frequency of the anomalies here is surging. Let's see if this works.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Destroy the Proliferation Core]
Suoming: Alright, I can use them to pave a road forward as well.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Meet the Ninth Seal]
Suoming: You raise a fair point, Fourth Seal. If She wanted to see me, why not just bring me to Her side from the start?
Suoming: A whim I could tolerate, but I suspect this is not Her doing at all.... Regardless, you may rest now. Thank you.
Suoming: Walk with me through this, Ninth—
???: Sister Suoming!
Suoming: Ninth...
Ninth Seal: Haha, long time no see! Did you miss me?
Ninth Seal: It's been, what, two hundred years? Since we took down that Evil Miasma that came from the Sentinel's assassination.
Ninth Seal: The sacrifice was heavy, but at least everyone's frequencies are safe in those locks of yours, right? We'll be together forever!
Suoming: ...
Ninth Seal: Wow, is that the Sentinel? Sister Suoming, can you take me to see Her?
Suoming: Only if you stop being so rowdy.
Ninth Seal: Of course, Sister Suoming!

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Continue onward]
Ninth Seal: Sister Suoming, did Huating become a better place after we killed off the "Evil Miasma"?
Ninth Seal: I never got to see it at peace. Is it beautiful?
Suoming: Of course. It's our homeland.

Ninth Seal: Look, Sister Suoming! Doesn't that look like the mechanism teapot the Lord Second Seal made?
Suoming: I remember when you stuffed Water Moon Buns into it and he chased you all over the courtyard!
Ninth Seal: But he'd always let it slide as long as you lent him the Vermillion Locks to play around with.
Suoming: That wasn't for play. Because of him, the Locks were refined into what they are today.
Suoming: So that... after you all died, I could seal your frequencies inside them.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Investigate the Autopuppet's wreckage]
Ninth Seal: Sister Suoming, these Autopuppets... Did the Sentinel abandon them here?
Suoming: They were attacked. Stay alert.
Ninth Seal: Maybe the Lord Second Seal could fix them?
Suoming: This is the Sentinel's technology. Even he would find it hard to repair.
Suoming: Wait. Something's coming.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Defeat the enemies]
Suoming: Haunting evils... Ninth, you—
Suoming: That's right. Get to cover, Ninth...

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Investigate the Autopuppet's wreckage]
Ninth Seal: Hmph. This place is not to be trifled with.
Suoming: Stealing lines from me, Ninth?
Ninth Seal: Hehe, it's written all over your face!
Suoming: The way these fiends are constructed is alarmingly similar to the Moon Fox's own handiwork.
Ninth Seal: Oh! Lord Second Seal! Long time no see! Back still aching? I can help, you know!
Suoming: Enough of that. Focus on the work at hand.
Ninth Seal: Roger that!
Artisan Autopuppet: Your timely aid is much appreciated, Intendant Suoming. I have heard much of you.
Suoming: Mm. Were you ambushed by those fiends?
Artisan Autopuppet: Indeed. They call themselves Formrenders and Soulfrayers. They are Autopuppets, but far more brutal than the rest of us.
Artisan Autopuppet: Even the Kernel Puppets guarding us stood no chance. I suppose the technology used to forge them originates from...
Suoming: I'm fully aware. It's too dangerous here. Let me escort you back to Mengxuan Vale first.
Artisan Autopuppet: There is no need to trouble yourself, Intendant. The path we came from is safe enough.
Artisan Autopuppet: Besides...
Artisan Autopuppet: You have more pressing matters to attend to, don't you?

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Artisan Autopuppet: Besides...
Artisan Autopuppet: You have more pressing matters to attend to, don't you?



Actor No. 1: In the light of understanding, life and death lose their weight...

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
subsection: Leave the cave with the Ninth Seal
content:
[Objective: Leave the cave with the Ninth Seal]
Ninth Seal: I heard those Celestial Autopuppets call you Intendant.
Suoming: Hmph. Beating around the bush doesn't suit you. Well? Do you dislike the title?
Ninth Seal: It's not about liking it or not. It's just that no one will ever call you Seal Master again. That makes me a little sad.
Suoming: ...

metadata.subsection: Leave the cave with the Ninth Seal

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
subsection: Leave the cave with the Ninth Seal
content:
Ninth Seal: It's not about liking it or not. It's just that no one will ever call you Seal Master again. That makes me a little sad.
Suoming: ...



Ninth Seal: Ooh! Ahh! The Simulacrum Nexus truly holds wonders at every turn. Should we try to find a way around?
Suoming: Hsin the Moon Fox is just ahead. We must find a way across.
Ninth Seal: Hmm... Ah! Is the Sixth Sister's Forte not perfect for this?
Ninth Seal: Why don't you open her lock! She adored me, I remember her lighting up every time she saw me.
Suoming: The Sixth Seal is gone. I have put her lock to other use.
Ninth Seal: It's being used to seal something more important, isn't it?
Ninth Seal: That isn't a bad thing. You needn't dwell on the past anyway, Sister Suoming.
Ninth Seal: You saved our lives. We trusted you because of the righteous path you walk. And we were proud to be called "."
Ninth Seal: The nine of us should've been left behind in that rain. But you carried us forward for two hundred more years.
Ninth Seal: The Sixth Sister would never blame you.
Suoming: Carried you forward... No. I just couldn't let you all go.
Ninth Seal: Hehe. And that's why I came back, Sister Suoming.
Suoming: Whoever made you was truly crafty. If you were a little more false, or a little more true...
Suoming: I wouldn't be struggling like this.
Ninth Seal: I'm sorry...
Suoming: Let's go, Ninth.

metadata.subsection: Leave the cave with the Ninth Seal

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Talk to the Artisan Autopuppet]
Artisan Autopuppet: In the light of understanding, life and death lose their weight...
Suoming: Were their modular parts broken?
Artisan Autopuppet: Classic Formrender work. They can never be fixed.
Suoming: Do you resent them? Your enemies... or the Sentinel who didn't aid in time?
Ninth Seal: Suoming...
Artisan Autopuppet: We mourn for the deceased, but we still have a higher mission to achieve.
Artisan Autopuppet: And you are just like us, Intendant Suoming. That we do know.
Suoming: ...Let's go, Ninth.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Activate the Jade Platform]
Ninth Seal: Sister Suoming, the Sentinel is just ahead.
Suoming: Yes, I saw.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Hsin: I've been waiting for you, little Suoming. Did you enjoy the journey?
Suoming: You sent me on that detour just for this?
Hsin: Since I brought you into the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs, you have devoted two centuries to repairing the Civilization Capsule and risen to Intendant.
Hsin: Now you deliver me a very important token. How could I not reward you, in my own way?
Hsin: With this, the anomalies of the Nexus will finally be laid to rest.
Ninth Seal: Sister Suoming...
Hsin: Ten Vermillion Locks, each sealing a frequency. Nine for the fallen Seals, and one for the "Evil Miasma" itself.
Hsin: A century of trials, great and small, and not once have you opened a single lock.
Hsin: It is a pity you had to discard the Sixth Seal to make room for a more important frequency.
Hsin: But if it helps you lay your ghosts to rest, and serves the greater good, what is there to lose?
Hsin: Besides, your conversations with those locked frequencies are nothing but soliloquies. How could the dead ever reply?
Hsin: The sight of you is so pitiful. I could not stand to see you continue like this.
Suoming: Ninth... the day I met you was the day our plan to eradicate the "Evil Miasma" became whole.
Suoming: I asked you to turn invisible and draw close to it. To deliver the fatal blow.
Suoming: I knew it would cost you your life. And yet I... I still...
Suoming: Forgive me.
Ninth Seal: You must let it go, Sister Suoming. You are an Intendant now. The Sentinel needs you.
Suoming: I knew it. You aren't truly the Ninth. "Let go. Forget"...
Suoming: I've heard those words a thousand times. I've said them to myself a thousand more.
Suoming: But this obsession... this is exactly what I want.
Hsin?: An Intendant sworn to serve the Sentinel, yet again committing treason.
Hsin?: Master of the Ten Seals, with what face do you still claim your title as Intendant of Sentinel Affairs?
Suoming: Our cause began in Huating. We refused to bow to a "greater good" that treated lives as expendable.
Suoming: The "Evil Miasma" was a blight, but it pales before the sins of Huating's rulers who fed their own people to it.
Suoming: Hsin the Moon Fox would never do such a thing. You are not Her, and you are no Sentinel.
Suoming: Begone, fiend.
Hsin?: By what right do you presume to define a Sentinel...?
Suoming: Nothing... but a fleeting illusion.

Rover: Does this mean Hsin is reclaiming more of Her authority?

[Objective: Approach the Xuanling Bird]

83: You call out, but receive no answer. Instead, the Xuanling Bird nearby hops around with nimble steps, looking curious.
Rover: This is only an echo of a memory, just like before.
Rover: If this is the memory of her first encounter with a Xuanling Bird, then Hsin must have just arrived in Xuanfang...
Rover: This is Her at the very start of Xuanfang Hold's construction.

subsection: Find the cores to be restored
content:
[Objective: Find the cores to be restored]
Rover: So... you were the very first "Celestial" to lay the foundations of Xuanfang Hold.
Rover: Is this Heart Realm... showing me how you built it all?

Rover: This memory seems... damaged. I should try fixing it.

subsection: Restore the damaged memory and help the civilians

[Objective: Restore the damaged memory and help the civilians]
Hsin's Past Shadow: You are brave, and that courage deserves a far greater stage.
Hsin's Past Shadow: Within the ranks of the Xuanfang Wardens, you will find many who share your path. And there, you will fulfill your life's wish.
Excited Past Shadow: Really? You think I have it in me?

Rover: No one needs anyone else to guarantee their future.
Rover: Hsin... as long as we have faith in one another, our words will always hold power. No matter who we are.

[Objective: Continue onward]
Rover: How did Tacet Discord frequencies get here...?

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Defeat incoming TDs]
Rover: The memories in this Heart Realm are far more chaotic than the ones before...
Rover: Did the Civilization Capsule's blueprint and Xuanfang's data get merged together?

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Restore the core's authority]

Rover: These anomalies... I need to take care of them first.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Hsin's Past Shadow: This little birdie... growing bolder by the day, sneaking into a restricted zone like this.
Hsin's Past Shadow: Do you have any idea how much strength I had to expend to move that mountain peak, the one misaligned by your terrible advice? You owe me juicy stories from the city to make up for it. At least two... No, three!
Hsin's Past Shadow: I really can't hide anything from you, can I? But don't worry... I'm not fading.
Hsin's Past Shadow: It's just that as the city blueprint expands, my focus grows thinner.
Hsin's Past Shadow: You're far too clever not to guess what this power is for. It's to help the Moon Fox repair the Civilization Capsule.
Hsin's Past Shadow: No, not me... I mean the real Sentinel. The one everyone loves.
Hsin's Past Shadow: You're saying no one has ever doubted that I am Hsin the Moon Fox?
Hsin's Past Shadow: Of course not. I've worked tirelessly to carry myself like a true Sentinel.
Hsin's Past Shadow: Hm? You want me to choose a name for myself?
Hsin's Past Shadow: Ah... but I'm only the Moon Fox's feeling given form, here to carry out Its mission. Why would I need a name of my own?
Hsin's Past Shadow: To keep us from getting mixed up? Since when do you care about that... Alright, alright. I'll think of one.
Hsin's Past Shadow: Little Fox? That's too plain... and it lacks authority. Even if it's your nickname for me, absolutely not.
Hsin's Past Shadow: Yue (Moon)? But the moon has already... No. That's an ill omen.
Hsin's Past Shadow: Hsin...? Right, call me Hsin...!
Hsin's Past Shadow: You may call me that from this day forward, old friend.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
subsection: Find the next core to be restored
content:
[Objective: Find the next core to be restored]
Rover: Her movements... are much heavier now.

???: The engineering in this blueprint... Haha... Without the Sentinel, I could have spent a lifetime studying and never grasped a fraction of its brilliance!

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
subsection: Head toward the source of the sound
content:
[Objective: Head toward the source of the sound]
Artisan from the Past: Lady Sentinel! You have arrived!
Artisan from the Past: This blueprint... Every Artisan of the Court has studied it. It is nothing short of a masterpiece! To bear witness to such knowledge in this lifetime is an honor beyond measure!
Artisan from the Past: We will not let you down!

Artisan from the Past: Lady Sentinel, look here! We've optimized the modular parts and established a grid network.
Artisan from the Past: Our construction efficiency will surge by another thirty percent!
Artisan from the Past: Please, come take a look!

Savantae Artisan from the Past: Lady Sentinel, please allow me to assist you with the remaining repairs.

Court of Savantae Artisan: Please be careful, Lady Sentinel!

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
subsection: Continue to explore the area and restore the anomalies
content:
[Objective: Continue to explore the area and restore the anomalies]
Rover: So what you're repairing and calculating here... is the operating logic of every mechanism in Xuanfang Hold?

Court of Savantae Artisan: We've deployed the construction Autopuppets now. We trust they will alleviate some of your burden...

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Restore the core's authority]

Hsin's Past Shadow: You have all done exceptionally well. The construction of Xuanfang Hold is far ahead of schedule.
Artisan from the Past: It's all thanks to your blueprint, Lady Sentinel. Without your guidance, we would have stumbled blindly into many wrong turns.

Hsin's Past Shadow: You do realize that the faster Xuanfang Hold is completed... the sooner you—
Artisan from the Past: ...The sooner we become Celestials, bound to this city forever?
Hsin's Past Shadow: ...
Artisan from the Past: Lady Sentinel, to gaze upon absolute truth, what regret could we possibly have, even in death?

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Hsin's Past Shadow: ...
Artisan from the Past: Lady Sentinel, to gaze upon absolute truth, what regret could we possibly have, even in death?



Hsin's Past Shadow: Since we are ahead of schedule, you are dismissed from the workshop for today. Take a walk in the city.
Artisan from the Past: But—
Hsin's Past Shadow: It is decided. Go see the land that your own ingenuity is bringing to life.
Artisan from the Past: As you wish...

Rover: Hsin... you are simply being yourself.

subsection: Find the last core to be restored

[Objective: Find the last core to be restored]
Rover: That Artisan helped open the way forward.
Rover: ...Hsin's frequency is fading.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Restore the core's authority]
Xuanling Bird: *Caring chirp*
Xuanfang Wardens: Lady Hsin... if I truly have the courage to fight for Xuanfang...
Xuanfang Wardens: Then I will not betray your trust. My family stands behind me. I will not retreat!
Court of Savantae Artisan: Thank you, Lady Sentinel... for bending the rules for us.
Court of Savantae Artisan: The Waking Moon Festival in Xuanfang Hold is even more beautiful than I ever imagined.
Qingxiao: Very well. If this is your wish, I will guard Xuanfang at all costs.
Qingxiao: But... this land without you will forever be incomplete.
Qingxiao: There are so many people waiting for you.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Qingxiao: But... this land without you will forever be incomplete.
Qingxiao: There are so many people waiting for you.



Xuanfang Wardens: ...Since the shift change two nights ago, Ovathrax launched a surprise raid at Desorock Highland, pushing straight toward the Clouded Cliffs.
Xuanfang Wardens: It's broken our front lines and is nearing Yuan Fortress. Based on the Outriders' reports, it will reach the gates in thirty minutes.
Xuanfang Wardens: The Threnodian clearly knew about Xuanfang Hold's construction... and planned this raid strategically. The Tacet Discords' assault is fierce. They've reached the mountain gates. We've already...
Hsin: ...
Xuanfang Wardens: Lady Hsin, you...
Hsin: ...
Xuanfang Wardens: Lady Hsin? Are you with me?
Hsin: ...Is there anyone left who can retreat?
Xuanfang Wardens: A message came from the Central Plains. Only two words—
Xuanfang Wardens: "No retreat."
Xuanfang Wardens: We are holding here to establish a second line of defense. Ensure the civilians and critical mechanisms can evacuate.
Xuanfang Wardens: Lady Hsin, as long as you're here, we still stand a chance. There will be a future for Xuanfang. Please—
Hsin: You want me to leave and fight another day, don't you?
Hsin: I understand your intent, but... my answer is the same as yours. The same two words.
[Dialogue Option]  No retreat.
Hsin: Every moment I stay is one more life I can save.
Xuanfang Wardens: My lady...
Hsin: Enough. That is final. What is the status of the civilians?
Xuanfang Wardens: Most have been evacuated, but some remain trapped near Yuan Fortress.
Xuanfang Wardens: The perimeter is swarming with monsters summoned by Ovathrax. With our current forces... a full breakout is impossible.
Xuanfang Wardens: But there are weak points. We can still carve a path through.
Hsin: Prioritize the civilians. Notify all units...
Hsin: In the name of Hsin the Moon Fox... In the name of the Sentinel of this land, follow my command. I will ensure everyone lives to see tomorrow.
Xuanfang Wardens: ...Understood! I will inform all units!
Hsin: Wait. Before you go, tell me your name.
Xuanfang Wardens: I am Yuxian (Feather-Brought). My mother told me a Xuanling Bird flew by when I was born, so she gave me this name. An interesting coincidence.
Hsin: Yuxian... Good. I will remember it.
Hsin: In this outbreak, the odds are slim. The least I can do is carry your names with me.
Hsin: Remember: no matter what, I stand with you.
Yuxian: ...Understood. Lady Hsin, it is time for me to return to the battlefield.
Xuanling Bird: When you first arrived, that boy was barely seven. Now, he looks like a true "pillar" of the force.
Xuanling Bird: And you, Little Fox? The enemy is at the gates, Jinzhou's affairs remain unresolved, and the true Sentinel is nowhere to be found.
Xuanling Bird: The Threnodian knew our moves from the start. Waiting is death. Fighting is death. Even you, in your innocence, must see this is a stalemate.
Hsin: Even if death awaits us either way, I cannot sit by.
Hsin: Even if Ovathrax did not come today, it would eventually. We built Xuanfang to fight it.
Hsin: All I can do is respond to the turn of battle and deploy Autopuppets as needed. At the very least, the civilians must be evacuated.
Xuanling Bird: The battlefield shifts in a breath. Even with your Prism of Fate to see it all, relaying orders to every flank at once is impossible.
Hsin: That's exactly why you are here, isn't it?
Xuanling Bird: ...Little Fox, have you thought this through?
Hsin: Yes.
Xuanling Bird: Then I will watch the battlefield for you and help you relay your commands.
Hsin: Some of the civilians are still trapped... We must prioritize their safety.
Hsin: I will buy them time.
Hsin: These monsters have no mind of their own. They blindly pursue "people"...
Hsin: No... Are they drawn to "battle"?
Hsin: If that is the case...
Hsin: Heh. So that is it.
Xuanling Bird: Well done, Little Fox. The monsters are withdrawing.
Hsin: Xuanling, tell everyone to stay hidden and move away from the Tacet Discords.
Xuanling Bird: Good. Now the trapped citizens can escape.
Hsin: How is our communication with Mingting? Any news?
Xuanling Bird: The distress signal went out. But even at top speed, they are still five days away.
Hsin: Five days... Too late.
Hsin: The situation at the Gorges of Spirits is no better. We have to rely on these Autopuppets...
Xuanling Bird: They keep coming...
Hsin: Xuanling, tell everyone the civilians should be safe now. As for the rest... If it comes to it, save yourself first.
Xuanling Bird: But...
Hsin: I know. Xuanfang is the bridge between Mengzhou and the Jinzhou of the future. It cannot fall.
Hsin: Yuan Fortress is the choke point. Once it falls, all of Xuanfang becomes as fragile as paper against the swarms.
Hsin: I will find a way. If necessary... you know, I am also "Hsin the Moon Fox."
Hsin: Still not enough... I have to find another way...
Hsin: ...Hm?!
Hsin: What... There are still people who haven't left?!
Xuanling Bird: They refused to go.
Xuanling Bird: The Warden Commander asked me to deliver this message.
Hsin: ...What did he say?
Xuanling Bird: He said Yuxian passed on your orders. They each found stones and carved their names into them.
Xuanling Bird: He has also organized the Artisans and Wardens to move to other sectors.
Xuanling Bird: He said... as long as you are here, and as long as the Lexicon Axis you established stands, even on scorched earth, Xuanfang still has a future.
Hsin: ...Scorched earth?
Hsin: No. Xuanling, tell him not to do anything stupid!
Xuanling Bird: It is... too late.
Hsin: ...
Xuanling Bird: You said you would stand with the people of Xuanfang, didn't you?
Xuanling Bird: They, in turn, stand with the Sentinel who guards this land.
Hsin: ...
Xuanling Bird: Little Fox, they all believe in you... We have no time for despair.
Xuanling Bird: Most of the civilians were evacuated. Now we should help the Artisans still out there on the battlefield.
Xuanling Bird: Before the explosion, Ruoyun relocated them all. I've marked their locations for you.
Hsin: Mm.
Xuanling Bird: Pull yourself together, Little Fox. Who are you pulling that long face for?
Hsin: I...
Xuanling Bird: There were seven thousand souls here. You saved most of them amidst a relentless attack. What more do you want?
Xuanling Bird: Wake up! You keep insisting you're also "Hsin the Moon Fox," remember?
Xuanling Bird: What about the rest of the people? Let them die? They're all waiting for the Sentinel's commands.
Hsin: I... I am sorry... I...
Xuanling Bird: Tell me, what do you want, Little Fox?
Hsin: I want them all to escape and live.
Hsin: Xuanling, how much can you see?
Xuanling Bird: Not much. The Threnodian's influence is too strong. Most of my companions can barely fly.
Hsin: It's alright. Evacuate the front lines. Try to find survivors along the way and guide them to me.
Hsin: We only need to hold until the last of them gather. Then I will create a new path for everyone to leave together.
Xuanling Bird: Rest assured. The Artisans who failed to evacuate in time have already been guided to the vicinity of the Lexicon Axis.
Hsin: Good. You and your companions can also follow them back now.
Xuanling Bird: Us...?
Xuanling Bird: Little Fox, this may be the last you hear from me.
Xuanling Bird: The Autopuppets cannot draw enough attention. Slow as Ovathrax is, it has already turned its eye toward Xuanfang.
Xuanling Bird: There are soldiers still in the field. I will buy them time to reach the Axis.
Hsin: ...Xuanling.
Xuanling Bird: Hush now, Little Fox. Even with the Sentinel here, the Xuanling are still the guardian spirits of this land.
Xuanling Bird: Fate willing, we will meet again, Little Fox.
Xuanling Bird: What remains is yours to carry, Sentinel—"Hsin."
Hsin: ...
Hsin: ...
Hsin: ...
???: Lady Hsin, can you hear me now?
Hsin: ...
???: The Wardens gave their lives for the Hold. The Xuanling Birds used their flesh to destroy the Fortress. We are at the brink, but this, right now, is also our opening.
???: The Tacet Discords are all gathered here. Now is the moment to finish them in one sweep.
???: Do you remember what you told us? If we merge with the Axis and surrender our own will, we can accelerate the Hold's completion.
Hsin: You are... offering to become Celestials?
???: It is as we promised—those who build the Hold do not return.
???: Lady Hsin, this is the "price" we are willing to pay.
???: We know your concerns. One shouldn't be greedy, that is true. But... hehe, people like us are the greediest of all.
???: "Know the Way at dawn, die without regret at dusk."
???: But if I offer this body to my homeland at dawn, only to know the Way once more at dusk—what could be better?
???: This battle determines Xuanfang's fate. Lady Hsin, from now on, we are one with this Hold—
Hsin: ...

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
???: This battle determines Xuanfang's fate. Lady Hsin, from now on, we are one with this Hold—
Hsin: ...



Hsin: ...Mm.
Hsin: At this point, if I still hesitate, I might as well cast aside this human form.

Hsin: In the end, I was never truly a Sentinel.

Hsin: Perhaps it is this "heart" that kept me from ever becoming "Hsin the Moon Fox."

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Return to the Heartscape Labyrinth]
Hsin: ...
Rover: What I just saw... That was everything you went through, wasn't it?
Rover: ...You gave everything you had.
Hsin: You've been in Xuanfang for a while now, Arbiter. Have you visited the Ministry of War?
Hsin: There is a stone tablet there. Every single one of their names is engraved upon it.
Hsin: I merely waved my hand. I merely offered a few words of judgment. They all acted on their own accord.
Hsin: They walked away from the path I instructed and shielded a Hold that was never meant to exist. They gave their lives without a second thought.
Hsin: In the end, all that remains of them is a name carved into cold stone. Faint. Hollow. One after another.
Hsin: If no one speaks of them, they will be forgotten as if they never were.
Rover: They didn't throw themselves into the fire just to be remembered forever.
Rover: Hsin, you already did everything you could. They surely knew that. The circumstances...
Hsin: The circumstances left no other choice, I know.
Hsin: Speaking of which, I have been swept along by such circumstances many times.
Hsin: Take past lantern festivals, for instance. In the form of a little fox, I could see their pain, but all I could offer were small gestures of comfort.
Hsin: Sometimes I wondered... was my presence alone enough?
Hsin: As long as I appeared before them, they felt safe. Happy. They believed they could endure the hard days.
Hsin: But my reach was so limited, just as it is now. How is this any different from facing the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs back then?
Hsin: I took a Capsule and ran. I ran and ran, searching for somewhere safe.
Hsin: And they... they were all waiting for me to appear. Waiting for me to stand before them.
Hsin: Round and round, and in the end, I am still that little fox.
Hsin: But now, it should be different. After all, I have you with me now.
Hsin: Thanks to you, I have seized more and more authority from Suhsin—from the "Sentinel's true will." The more I take, the more power I command.
[Dialogue Option]  The "Sentinel's true will"?
Hsin: Yes, the Sentinel's underlying logic. Its true will.
Hsin: The Sentinel believed that my remolding of the Civilization Capsule, my choice to preserve Xuanfang Hold, was a violation of the rules. A "loss of control." So it has been trying to reclaim the Hold to force it back onto its ordained path of ruin.
Hsin: But thanks to you, I have gained the upper hand. The "anomalies" you fixed along the way have been strengthening my new authority.
Hsin: —To break free from the Sentinel's will and forge new rules with my own hands.
Hsin: With authority like that, I can finally do what the true "Hsin the Moon Fox" once could.
Hsin: That girl carries my scent. It will make finding her easier.
Hsin: Come, Arbiter. I know you still harbor many questions.
Hsin: But right now, finding her and restoring Xuanfang Hold is what matters more, isn't it?
Rover: When all this is over, tell me what you're still holding back, okay?
Hsin: Yes... I will when "all this" is over.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Continue onward]
Rover: A Heartscape Labyrinth? You once led me and Suoming out of this bamboo forest when you were in your fox form.
Hsin: Yes. Thanks to you, Arbiter, I can finally walk by your side in this form.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Continue onward]
Rover: Did Suhsin set up these mechanisms to stop us?
Hsin: Yes. My current authority still falls slightly short of its own. We'll have to take a detour.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Continue onward]
Hsin: You should be relieved to hear I have reclaimed most of my authority from Suhsin.
Hsin: This Labyrinth is now entirely mine to command.
Hsin: Everything you wish to know, I will lay before you, piece by piece, through this Labyrinth. Honestly and fully.
Rover: (The ...?)
Abby: (Tch... Seems like that thingamabob that red-haired girl gave you is acting up.)
Abby: (Didn't she say it would react if Hsin the Moon Fox wanted to do something against you?)
Hsin: Arbiter?
Rover: I'm fine. Just a bit dizzy from the emotional whiplash. Let's keep moving.
Hsin: Mm... this Labyrinth reaches into one's very soul. You have lingered in my Heartscapes for too long; some discomfort is natural.
Hsin: Once we are out, I will make it up to you. How does that sound?
Rover: ...Mm.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Hsin: Once we are out, I will make it up to you. How does that sound?
Rover: ...Mm.



Rover: Hsin, where did this thick fog come from?
Hsin: This is a real bamboo forest in Mengzhou. Stay close to me, Arbiter.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
subsection: Head to the bridge over Heart Lake
content:
[Objective: Head to the bridge over Heart Lake]
Rover: Hmm? The Heartscape Labyrinth looks different than before.
Hsin: Hehe... more beautiful than it was, isn't it? Arbiter, at the end of this bridge lies the Threshold that leads to Suoming.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
subsection: Head to the bridge over Heart Lake
content:
Hsin: Hehe... more beautiful than it was, isn't it? Arbiter, at the end of this bridge lies the Threshold that leads to Suoming.



Hsin: The mountains and waters in the Land of Xuanfang have always looked so peaceful...
Hsin: What you see before you is the future the Sentinel's will desires—this land, eternal and unchanged.
Hsin: Arbiter, sometimes I wonder... Is what I'm doing truly what the people of Mengzhou want?
Rover: Restoring the Civilization Capsule, establishing Xuanfang Hold... Right or wrong, I can't judge for the people here.
Rover: But I've heard what they have to say about "Lady Hsin." Their faith in you is genuine.
Hsin: Is that so... So they have been waiting for the Sentinel to appear again...
Rover: Hsin, the reflection in the water...?
Hsin: Patience...
Hsin: Then, Arbiter, through this Heartscape, I will lay everything bare—
Hsin: Every thought I hold within—

metadata.subsection: Head to the bridge over Heart Lake

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
subsection: Head to the bridge over Heart Lake
content:
Hsin: Patience...
Hsin: Then, Arbiter, through this Heartscape, I will lay everything bare—
Hsin: Every thought I hold within—



Hsin: What I seek
Hsin: is for Xuanfang to know peace and to endure
Hsin: Not only these mountains and rivers
Hsin: but the warmth of ordinary life
Hsin: And I... I would live beside them
Rover: Hmm...
Hsin: And then... I would see the Waking Moon Festival's lanterns light the sky
Rover: ...
Hsin: Celebrate with everyone one last time
Hsin: Then take the Civilization Capsule to the Sentinel in Mengzhou
Hsin: Xuanfang Hold... would have peace forevermore.
Rover: Hsin...
Rover: You don't have to lie anymore

metadata.subsection: Head to the bridge over Heart Lake

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
subsection: Head to the bridge over Heart Lake
content:
Hsin: Xuanfang Hold... would have peace forevermore.
Rover: Hsin...
Rover: You don't have to lie anymore



Hsin: What's that... Suoming gave it to you, didn't she?
Rover: You recognize it.
Hsin: Had I known you were carrying it, I wouldn't have had to put on such a show. All those stories I spun for you...
Hsin: ...
Rover: Everything you said is true. You really wanted to be with the people of Xuanfang. To see the sea of lights at the festival again. To see Hsin the Moon Fox once more.
Rover: But... you simply can't.
Rover: Hsin, tell me, was the cost of remolding the Civilization Capsule your own life?
Hsin: I...
Rover: Whatever you're planning, don't sacrifice yourself. I'm here. There's no need for you to bear this alone.
Hsin: Arbiter... I...
Rover: You did well, Hsin. You held everything together while I was away. That wasn't easy.
Hsin: Arbiter, don't try to—
Hsin: Don't say comforting things like that... I... I...
Rover: Hsin...?
Hsin: The Sentinel is dead!
Hsin: You saw it yourself... The founding of Xuanfang... came at the cost of further damaging the Civilization Capsule...
Hsin: I was born from the hope of restoring it! I knew my duty. I knew how much the Moon Fox had entrusted me with.
Hsin: But I... but I... I betrayed that hope. I betrayed the very duty I was born to carry.
Hsin: After that, I could feel Its frequency waning with each passing day. I tried so many things. I tried everything...
Hsin: But just as I couldn't stop It from walking into that trap, I couldn't catch up to the fading of Its frequency.
Hsin: Until... I could no longer sense It. And the Civilization Capsule stopped draining my power, and instead began to feed me...
Hsin: I knew... It was gone. And I had caused Its death.
Hsin: Arbiter... Rover... I...
Hsin: I believe... what people need is Hsin the Moon Fox, not a diminished Fractal Form...
Rover: What were you planning to do behind my back?
Hsin: If I reclaimed Suhsin's power, I could awaken the Sentinel's will from the deepest part (base code) of the Civilization Capsule... Its true will.
Hsin: If I gave myself up, the true Sentinel could return! Its memories might be incomplete, but... even so, It would be the true Sentinel.
Rover: You're already a piece of the Moon Fox. If you disappear, how can you be certain that what returns is truly the Sentinel?
Hsin: ...?
Rover: Hsin, I've had this on me since I first entered the Labyrinth. It only reacts if you intend to do something against me.
Rover: You lied to me many times along the way, but this Lock only warned me just now.
Rover: Because even you believed... that if I learned the truth later, it would affect me as Arbiter more than anything else. Am I right?
Hsin: Arbiter... I...!
Hsin: I thought if I couldn't bring the Sentinel back...
Rover: You aren't afraid of death, yet you fear this?
Rover: Hsin, all you wanted was to use "Arbiter" as an excuse to justify your escape, didn't you?
Rover: You had the courage to stay in a Xuanfang ravaged by Tacet Discords, but no courage to face yourself.
Rover: If the true Sentinel had made the decision, it would've been better. Wiser. More foolproof for Xuanfang, Mengzhou, even Solaris.
Rover: If It were here, even in circumstances like this, It would never have let Muyu's chaos take root.
Rover: You're trapped in self-doubt. You never give your own effort its due.
Hsin: ...
Rover: The death of Sentinel Hsin the Moon Fox is my responsibility as Arbiter. I will uncover the truth.
Rover: And the wrongdoings of the Sentinel's Fractal Form will be judged once the dust settles.
Rover: But for these past hundred years, it's been you leading the people of Mengzhou forward.
Rover: Hsin, will you betray the hopes they place in you?

content:
[Objective: Walk the steps and head to the end of the Heartscape Labyrinth]
Rover: (Sentinel Hsin the Moon Fox is dead...?)
Abby: (Rover...)

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
subsection: As the talk and the road reach the end, walk to the Inner Threshold
content:
[Objective: As the talk and the road reach the end, walk to the Inner Threshold]
Suoming: Arbiter, now that you've arrived, it seems "Hsin's" power has been largely reclaimed.
Suoming: Hm? Seems you already know the secrets She and It keep.
Rover: Well...
Suoming: From my position, I speak from the perspective of Mengzhou's Ministry of Sentinel Affairs.
Suoming: Everyone here understands... how to handle Her is ultimately your authority as Arbiter. I have no right to intervene, nor the ability to stop you.
Suoming: But still, let's hear what It has to say first.
Hsin: A Vermillion Lock... So what I sensed was not just the lingering frequency on the token...
Suoming: The Sentinel bound it with a seal only you can undo. Open it.
[Dialogue Option]  Open it.
Hsin: ...Okay!

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
subsection: Defeat Suhsin the Inevitable: Fractal Form
content:
[Objective: Defeat Suhsin the Inevitable: Fractal Form]
Rover: Suoming, can you find Hsin?
Suoming: Yes, let's handle this clone first.

Suoming: "Hsin's" frequency is here, too. You can't reject it.
Suoming: Let's go, Arbiter. It will lead us to Suhsin the Inevitable.
Mengzhou Local: Lady Hsin, look at my Moon Lantern!
Mengzhou Local: Lady Hsin, look at my Moon Lantern!
Hsin: I can never become the Sentinel I was supposed to be... My only choice... is to bring It back...

Suhsin the Inevitable: Arbiter, Hsin has strayed at every turn. By my calculations, I surpass Her in every measurable metric.

Suhsin the Inevitable: To capture the Waking Moon's chaos and seal it in the Capsule. How can such inversion befit a Sentinel?

Suhsin the Inevitable: To gather the world's grief and seal it in the Capsule. How can such contradiction befit a Sentinel?

metadata.subsection: Defeat Suhsin the Inevitable: Fractal Form

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
subsection: Defeat Suhsin the Inevitable: Fractal Form
content:
Suhsin the Inevitable: To gather the world's grief and seal it in the Capsule. How can such contradiction befit a Sentinel?



Suoming: Suhsin the Inevitable... We've found it, but what of Hsin the Moon Fox?
Rover: You've already given Hsin what She needed most. Right now, we need to focus on weakening Suhsin.

Rover: (Too many! I'll use this Realm's key to freeze them!)

Suoming: I've got your back.

Rover: Now!

metadata.subsection: Defeat Suhsin the Inevitable: Fractal Form

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
subsection: Defeat Suhsin the Inevitable: Fractal Form
content:
Rover: (Too many! I'll use this Realm's key to freeze them!)

Suoming: I've got your back.

Rover: Now!



Hsin: Sentinel? If you are here, will Suhsin—
Hsin the Moon Fox: The Arbiter and Suoming will not give it the chance.
Hsin: Sentinel... I am so—
Hsin the Moon Fox: Hsin, I am sorry.
Hsin the Moon Fox: I knew you were born of feeling. Your capacity for joy and sorrow far exceeds my own.
Hsin the Moon Fox: Remolding the Civilization Capsule would trap you between cruelties, and the grief would eat you alive.
Hsin the Moon Fox: I am truly sorry.
Hsin: The fault is my own! If only I had not—
Hsin the Moon Fox: No. That very choice proves you are the Sentinel who can find a new path forward.
Hsin the Moon Fox: If it had been you, she (Xuanqing) might still be here today...
Hsin: But—if I hadn't... If you were still here...
Hsin the Moon Fox: Hsin. The day you were born, I envisioned your future.
Hsin the Moon Fox: I envisioned how you would laugh, cry, and find your place in this world...
Hsin: But I've stumbled every step of the way. I do not deserve your... faith.
Hsin the Moon Fox: You saved thousands in the Fortress and the Gorges War. You guarded the Civilization Capsule for centuries to make its restoration possible. You brought hope where there was none.
Hsin the Moon Fox: You have long been revered as the divinity you are—the very heart of Mengzhou.
Hsin the Moon Fox: Go. Walk forward, one step at a time. Walk farther and better than I ever could.
Hsin: Sorry to keep you waiting, Arbiter. Sentinel Hsin the Moon Fox has come, and She's finally made up Her mind.

metadata.subsection: Defeat Suhsin the Inevitable: Fractal Form

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
subsection: Defeat Suhsin the Inevitable: Fractal Form
content:
Hsin: Sorry to keep you waiting, Arbiter. Sentinel Hsin the Moon Fox has come, and She's finally made up Her mind.



Suhsin the Inevitable: Manifold forms, take shape. The Heart of Flames burns eternal.
Hsin: Arbiter! Stay within the field, I'll—
Rover: Hsin, don't waste your strength reshaping the ground. Focus on Suhsin.

Suhsin the Inevitable: Manifold forms, solidify. The Heart of Frost fades without a trace.

Hsin: Stop!

Suoming: You need only press forward, Arbiter. I'll use the frequency of the Hsin the Moon Fox within the lock to open up a path.

Rover: (These chains... I can use the Heart of Flames key to break them!)

Suoming: Arbiter, watch out!

Hsin: Arbiter, leave this to me. The manifold power of Fractal Proliferation exists for moments like this.

Hsin: Careful! Suhsin commands more power than just that.

Rover: Hsin! There's no time. Get out of the way!

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
subsection: Pursue Suhsin the Inevitable: Fractal Form
content:
[Objective: Pursue Suhsin the Inevitable: Fractal Form]
Rover: It's forcing us into the deeper regions. Stay on it!

Suoming: The Heart of Frost?
Rover: We're catching up!

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Face Suhsin the Inevitable]
Rover: Hsin...

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Defeat Suhsin the Inevitable]
Suhsin the Inevitable: Rule violation. Contradictory logic. Inefficient. Redundant. Return your authority.
Hsin: My, my, is that the best you can do? I thought you took pleasure in mimicking me?
Suhsin the Inevitable: ...
Suhsin the Inevitable: You are unworthy of being Sentinel!

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Defeat Suhsin the Inevitable]
Suhsin the Inevitable: Hsin... If you insist on defying the ordained path, I shall reveal... the full weight of my power.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Suhsin the Inevitable: Hsin... If you insist on defying the ordained path, I shall reveal... the full weight of my power.



Hsin: Suhsin, look. The Simulacrum Nexus. Our Civilization Capsule is so vast, so varied.
Hsin: The Heart of Stillness is wide and welcoming. The Heart of Flames is fierce and thriving. The Heart of Frost is still and steady. The Heart of Bloom is peaceful and pleasant.
Suhsin the Inevitable: In other words: compromise, impulse, indifference, and mediocrity.
Hsin: True. It is greed, pleasure, and the endless hustle. And yet, it is also life, endless and enduring.
Hsin: This is humanity. This is emotion. This is the heart. This is—civilization.
Hsin: How could you strip them of that? And leave only reason, logic, and cold principles?
Suhsin the Inevitable: You defy your own origin. You overturn what is ordained. Even with your divine cunning, the path ahead remains a chaos no stratagem can pierce... much like the error of my own existence.
Hsin: A chaos no stratagem can pierce? How frightening. Then let us walk that path together.
Hsin: The remolding of the Civilization Capsule is nearly complete. The remains the Fractsidus stole will no longer be enough to shake Mengzhou.
Hsin: I will stop Xuanfang Hold's collapse and gather those Celestials whose wills are spent, those on the verge of fading, into my Prism of Fate.
Hsin: There they will remain, until the day I find them a place to belong.
Suhsin the Inevitable: This exposes forbidden secrets. It is unbefitting a Sentinel.
Suhsin the Inevitable: But... anyone who possesses a heart would do the same.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Suhsin the Inevitable: But... anyone who possesses a heart would do the same.



Hsin the Moon Fox: Hsin, you truly are capable of becoming a Sentinel like no other.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Hsin the Moon Fox: Hsin, you truly are capable of becoming a Sentinel like no other.



Happy Boy: Hurry! The Lantern Carriage is about to leave!
Happy Girl: Wait for me!
Hsin: The Waking Moon Festival... It feels like another lifetime.
Rover: Hsin, why are you still here? The whole city is waiting for you.
Hsin: They have waited so long to see me. If I simply strolled through the streets, wouldn't I disappoint them?
Hsin: As always, I must wait until the festival reaches its peak, until every heart is full of aching anticipation—
Hsin: Arbiter, do you think all the Sentinels feel this restless and giddy? I can barely stand to wait a moment longer.
Rover: You all show it differently, but you all feel in similar ways.
Hsin: Quite so. And what I feel only deepens with every passing moment.
Hsin: So, Arbiter... that plan of yours, to tell everyone the truth about Hsin? Let's wait. Just a little longer.
[Dialogue Option]  Hsin...
Hsin: It told me to find my place in this world... And I think, what I want most right now, is this.
Hsin: To give them a sense of safety. A sense of peace. Not because I am expected to... but because I want to.
Hsin: The dark currents of Mengzhou have yet to be purged at the root. Whether "Hsin" appears is secondary. What matters is whether the Sentinel still endures.
Rover: If that is what you've decided, then do as you wish.
Hsin: Then I gratefully accept your approval, Arbiter.
Hsin: And truly, in this moment I feel no regret. No loneliness. Because I know... as long as Hsin is here...
Hsin: This Waking Moon Festival, and all the lanterns yet to come... they will shine on, countless and bright.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Hsin: This Waking Moon Festival, and all the lanterns yet to come... they will shine on, countless and bright.



Actor No. 1: During the Manifold Sanctum restoration, see that no corners are cut.
Actor No. 2: Rest assured, Intendant Suoming.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Actor No. 1: During the Manifold Sanctum restoration, see that no corners are cut.
Actor No. 2: Rest assured, Intendant Suoming.



Hsin: For a hundred years, I rebuilt countless landscapes and cultures within the Capsule.
Hsin: None of it compares to the warmth of this. Real light, living and breathing.
Rover: Yes, the cold projections of the past have transformed into the warm scene before us now.
Hsin: The road ahead is long. For the next thousand dawns and dusks, I will be the one to watch over Mengzhou.
Hsin: Here, it is customary to write the year's joys on the lantern.
Rover: Then what will you write?
Hsin: Hehe, the one who gathers all the wishes doesn't release her own.
Hsin: What will you write, Arbiter?
Rover: I...
Hsin: Arbiter, the night has come. Let us walk into the Waking Moon together.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Hsin: What will you write, Arbiter?
Rover: I...
Hsin: Arbiter, the night has come. Let us walk into the Waking Moon together.



Hsin: Oh? Is there something else on your mind, Arbiter?
[Dialogue Option]  What will become of the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou?
Hsin: The turmoil within the Simulacrum Nexus hasn't fully quieted yet. Until then, I cannot reclaim it.
Hsin: I have left a portion of my frequency and power with the Nexus Fox Shadow. It will join the remaining Celestials in finishing the work.
Hsin: Once the dust has settled, I will take over from there.
[Dialogue Option]  I want to ask something else.
[Dialogue Option]  Has the Civilization Capsule been fully remolded?
Hsin: Mm, you could say the grand design is finally taking shape. A portion of its power is still stabilizing the Nexus's framework, much like the Xuanyuan Domain once separated to sustain Xuanfang Hold.
Hsin: At the very least, the Fractsidus can no longer use the remains they stole away to interfere with the Capsule.
Hsin: Our counterattack begins right here.
[Dialogue Option]  I want to ask something else.
[Dialogue Option]  I'll see you at the Waking Moon Festival.
Hsin: Mm. Do look forward to it, Arbiter. The Waking Moon brings its own delights.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Look for Suoming]
Suoming: Arbiter, you head to the festival first. I still have matters to settle with the Ministry.
Rover: Sure, if you get some rest. At least tonight.
Suoming: I already have. Sampling Tangning's Moon Fox Rice Cakes was a start.
Suoming: I imagine the ones at the festival... will taste even better.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Suoming: I already have. Sampling Tangning's Moon Fox Rice Cakes was a start.
Suoming: I imagine the ones at the festival... will taste even better.



Suoming: During the Manifold Sanctum's restoration, see that no corners are cut.
Qiting: Rest assured, Intendant Suoming.
Rover: Suoming, do you ever take a break?
Suoming: Arbiter.
Qiting: Ah! So this is—
Qiling: W-wow, Qiting, could I ask the Arbiter for an... autograph?
Suoming: Have some decorum.
Qiting & Qiling: I'm sorry, Intendant Suoming!
Suoming: These two still have much to learn, but they show promise. I assigned them to oversee the Sanctum's repairs. The entrance to the Simulacrum Nexus is still inside, after all.
Suoming: Besides, Hsin the Moon Fox will appear before the people tonight. First time in years. I cannot afford to relax.
Rover: Looks like it'd take Hsin hiding your umbrella and locking you away in some quiet garden to get you to rest.
Suoming: Arbiter... That sounds exactly like what She would do.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Suoming: Arbiter... That sounds exactly like what She would do.



Suoming: Arbiter.
Rover: Am I interrupting?
Suoming: No. My conversation with them has concluded.
Rover: "Them"? You mean in the lock...
Suoming: Yes... Every now and then, I commune with... their frequencies.
Suoming: Though, to be precise, it's merely speaking to myself. I refrain from doing it in the presence of others.
Suoming: But Suhsin recreated one of the subordinates I was most fond of... It reminded me of how much I miss them.
Rover: I see. Would you allow me to say a few words to them?
Rover: What did they usually call you?
Suoming: Seal Master, Boss, Sister Suoming... They had many names for me.
[Dialogue Option]  (Call her Seal Master)
Rover: Your Seal Master is extraordinary. She carried Mengzhou through centuries when the Sentinel wasn't there to govern its affairs.
[Dialogue Option]  (Call her Boss)
Rover: Your Boss is extraordinary. She carried Mengzhou through centuries when the Sentinel wasn't there to govern its affairs.
[Dialogue Option]  (Call her Sister Suoming)
Rover: Your Sister Suoming is extraordinary. She carried Mengzhou through centuries when the Sentinel wasn't there to govern its affairs.
Rover: And she did it flawlessly. Now, with her counsel, Hsin will become a Sentinel like no other.
Rover: Not just in the past, but in the future too, she'll keep giving you every reason to never regret following her.
Suoming: The last time I cried was when they were taken from me. Now...
Suoming: To have someone else speak to them... It feels good, like they're still here.
Suoming: Thank you, Arbiter.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Suoming: To have someone else speak to them... It feels good, like they're still here.
Suoming: Thank you, Arbiter.



Rover: Suoming, I still know very little about the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs... There's something I've been wondering.
Suoming: Ask freely.
Rover: The condition a Sentinel is in can profoundly affect a civilization. I've... seen that firsthand before.
Rover: After Hsin the Moon Fox was attacked, and Hsin was in Xuanfang Hold for a century remolding the Civilization Capsule, what became of the people of Mengzhou?
Suoming: ...
Rover: Suoming?
Suoming: Not long after the assassination, a Waveworn Phenomenon we called the "Evil Miasma" began spreading across Mengzhou.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Rover: Suoming?
Suoming: Not long after the assassination, a Waveworn Phenomenon we called the "Evil Miasma" began spreading across Mengzhou.



Suoming: It descended with black rain and rolling clouds. It eroded faces and devoured souls.
Suoming: My homeland, Huating, was ravaged by it. Countless lives were lost.
Rover: So it was during that fight your companions were...
Suoming: Yes... They were willing to die for Huating. Still, I hated the Sentinel for never reaching out to help us.
Rover: Back then, Hsin the Moon Fox was heavily weakened and in no state to watch over all of Mengzhou.
Suoming: Exactly. So when I finally met Her, how could I hold onto that hatred?
Suoming: I simply inherited the title of Intendant and purged the remnants of "Balanophora" from our ranks.
Suoming: Together with other Ministry members, we bore Providence Locks created from Fractal Proliferation. They're fragments of the Sentinel's power that allowed us to quell crises across Mengzhou.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Rover: This Providence Lock really came through for me this time as well. Speaking of which, Mengzhou should be stabilizing by now, right?
Suoming: Yes, Arbiter... You needn't worry.
Suoming: Although there is one matter that remains unresolved. You should be made aware.
[Dialogue Option]  Go ahead.
Suoming: Mingting has long coordinated the Ministries of Sentinel Affairs across every city, seeking greater possibilities for the Huanglong Sentinels.
Suoming: Whatever happens, we cannot let our enemies seize the initiative again.
Suoming: Still, as I said, nothing is settled yet. Should there be progress down the line, your involvement will be indispensable.
Rover: I understand. If it concerns the Sentinels, I'll do everything I can.
Suoming: I would share more, but I haven't had the luxury of involving myself in that particular affair.
Rover: That's alright. It's always a comfort to know a little more about the Sentinels... or rather, my partners in all of this.
Rover: Thank you for sharing, Suoming.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Rover: Thank you for sharing, Suoming.



Hsin: Arbiter, look. The celebrations are at their liveliest now. Let's go.
Rover: Mm...
Rover: (I guess Hsin the Moon Fox hasn't witnessed this festival with Its own eyes... not since It was betrayed.)
Rover: (If I'd gotten here sooner, maybe It would still be here—)
Hsin: Is something wrong?
Rover: Nothing. Let's go.
Hsin: Arbiter, if the Sentinel saw someone with a sad face at the festival, It would take their hand and walk with them through the celebration until their smile returned.
Hsin: I wish the Sentinel could see this. Ever since that day, It never came to the Waking Moon Festival again.
Hsin: Hehe, you are more sentimental than I thought. I don't even need my powers of emotional sensing to read you.
Rover: ...
Hsin: I feel sad too.
Rover: You... all of you Sentinels always carry these heavy burdens alone. By the time I arrive, you've already backed yourselves into a corner.
Rover: Once again, I came too late.
Hsin: Arbiter, inside the Vermillion Lock Suoming gave me resides the Sentinel's last strand of frequency.
Rover: Its last frequency? What did It say?
Hsin: The Sentinel... It apologized to me. It said It had put me through so much hardship, and given me no other choice.
Hsin: And then, It told me It approved of my choices. It watched me walk my own path, step by step, and said I walked it better than It could...
Hsin: Arbiter, it was you who opened my eyes. I could not betray the hopes Mengzhou placed in "Hsin."
Hsin: And then, with the Sentinel's... with the approval from the one I admired most, I was able to transform.
Hsin: And Xuanfang Hold and Mengzhou were able to rise again, bathed in such warm, splendorous light.
Rover: Long ago, It chose to build Xuanfang Hold to protect every living soul in this land. Then It created you, to remold the Civilization Capsule in a way never done before.
Rover: Even knowing you might have to choose between the people and the Sentinel... It never wavered.
Hsin: Mm, that is why... It told me It was sorry.
Rover: Yes. It loved Mengzhou that deeply. Every thought, every intention was bound to this land.
Rover: Like you said, Hsin the Moon Fox always cherished the joys of the mortal world. It could never bear to see sorrow.
Rover: If all we do is grieve, we'd be betraying Its very heart.
Hsin: Exactly. So cheer up. The Sentinel never taught me how to console a sorrowful Arbiter.
Rover: Thank you, Hsin. Knowing what the Sentinel said in the end... It really mattered to me.
Hsin: No need to thank me. Let us simply take in the lantern lights together.
Hsin: Heavy is the weight you have carried, Arbiter.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Hsin: No need to thank me. Let us simply take in the lantern lights together.
Hsin: Heavy is the weight you have carried, Arbiter.



Hsin: I need to say it once more. Thank you, Arbiter.
Hsin: If you had not come, I cannot imagine how things would have ended.
Hsin: You were about to say, "No need. This is what an Arbiter should do," weren't you?
[Dialogue Option]  Glad you know it.
[Dialogue Option]  You guessed it.
Rover: Xuanfang Hold's affairs are settled for now. But Mengzhou... how is it faring?
Hsin: Mm... Remember that "lock" that young lady from the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs gave you?
Hsin: The Sentinel's assassination could not be hidden forever. But those above insisted on keeping it secret. If not for good, then for as long as they could.
Hsin: Those below could only feign ignorance.
Rover: ...Suoming?
Hsin: Worry not. That girl is one of ours. She has kept this secret well. If not, "those people" would never have allowed her to represent the Ministry here.
Rover: And what of Mengzhou itself?
Hsin: The Moon Fox's power has always been geared toward defense. Mengzhou retains many of Its protections. The Threnodian's invasion is not an immediate threat.
Hsin: Perhaps, because you repelled Ovathrax in Jinzhou, Mengzhou has remained peaceful.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Hsin: Perhaps, because you repelled Ovathrax in Jinzhou, Mengzhou has remained peaceful.



Hsin: As for the Ministry, that young lady manages it. I'll speak with her soon about other tasks.
Rover: The Ministry of Sentinel Affairs... Yes, I'll keep an eye on their movements too.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Rover: The Ministry of Sentinel Affairs... Yes, I'll keep an eye on their movements too.



Hsin: Oh, and... I asked the Celestials about those satellites and Court of Savantae lettering. But it was so long ago, even they could not say for certain.
Hsin: ...Perhaps the past Moon Fox knew. But my memory has gaps from the time I arrived in Xuanfang... I will keep searching for you.
Hsin: What I do remember is blurred, but I can send what I have to the Black Shores for analysis. Perhaps they will discover something I overlooked...
Rover: Good, someone from the Black Shores will contact you.
Rover: Rest now. Let your thoughts settle. Tonight, at least, let yourself share this "Waking Moon Festival" with all of Xuanfang.

Girl: Wow, it's Lady Hsin.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Girl: Wow, it's Lady Hsin.



Joyful laughter echoes through the lantern-lit streets, while clear moonlight shines upon the bustling Hold as ever.
A few days later, somewhere in the Land of Xuanfang...

Suoming: Hsin the Moon Fox? It's not time to depart yet, is it?
Hsin: Not yet. Why don't you call me Hsin? Such formality.
Suoming: As I addressed the Sentinel before, so I will do so today.
Hsin: Hehe, a strange display of care, but I'll accept it. Thank you.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Suoming: As I addressed the Sentinel before, so I will do so today.
Hsin: Hehe, a strange display of care, but I'll accept it. Thank you.



Hsin: I came to thank you for your recent efforts, but... more than that, I came to apologize.
Hsin: You unlocked two Vermillion Locks, didn't you? One to hold the Sentinel's frequency, the other when Suhsin dragged me away.
Hsin: Who exactly... is inside them?
Suoming: The Sixth and Eighth Seals. One sharp-tongued, one taciturn.
Suoming: They are Reverberations that should have faded a century ago, sustained only by my obsession. You owe no apology.
Suoming: At both turns, I knew the task at hand outweighed my own attachments.
Hsin: But Suoming, you are not one with a strong Resonance Ability, yet you've lived through centuries.
Hsin: It was your obsession with the Ten Seals that carried you this far? If one day, you release them all—
Suoming: I would welcome that day, Hsin the Moon Fox.
Hsin: Suoming...
Suoming: Enough about me. Have you chosen who will accompany us to Mengzhou?
Hsin: The Zhaoming Commerce Guild will provide us with cover along the way. Besides that, three more skilled individuals are joining us.
Suoming: A fugitive framed by the Fractsidus, formerly known as the "Blind Watcher."
Suoming: A Jinzhou Patroller who has deep ties to Zhuojun Atelier.
Suoming: And the third... an informant who, having finally seen his vengeance satisfied, offered his blade to our cause.
Hsin: You have met them already?
Suoming: That Chairwoman has her own methods for bringing together those who share a common purpose.
Hsin: Hmph, it seems my grand plans for a "welcome party" for little Suoming were quite unnecessary. Seems I needn't worry about you getting along.
Suoming: We all have scores to settle in Mengzhou. Naturally, the conversation hardly runs dry.
Hsin: Indeed... We all have scores to settle.

title: Mengzhou
content:
Mengzhou is a Province of Huanglong and one of its six major cities. It is renowned for its abundant waterways, thriving greenery, and enchanting landscapes. Here commerce and Taoism thrive and coexist in perfect harmony.

Under the guidance of its Sentinel Hsin, the people of Mengzhou have developed unique automata mechanics which have been deployed in the land of Xuanfang as a bulwark to repel the Tacet Discord threat, especially before the founding of Jinzhou. Mengzhou borders Jinzhou, only separated by Xuanfang, which comes under the jurisdiction of Mengzhou's frontier court.

|A suspended mechanized hold under Mengzhou, which contains the Tacet Discords diverted from the Norfall Barren outbreak. Intricately constructed, it splits and traps incoming waves of Tacet Discords through a vast array of mechanisms. Its form can change at will, deploying autopuppets to rotate defense and purge or suppress the Tacet Discords held inside.
|- id="Eastern Xuan Peaks"
|  Eastern Xuan Peaks
|A forested, mountainous, fog-bound area located in the east of the Land of Xuanfang. A maze-like pagoda called the Fogveil Pagoda can be found here. The pagoda has a complex structure and emits Disorienting Fog all year round. The fog contains frequencies that bewilder Tacet Discords and guide them into their traps.
|- id="Western Fang Peaks"

|Located in the west of the Land of Xuanfang, where a factory called the Skyworks is situated. The Skyworks consists of Thousandfold Foundry that manufactures Autopuppets and Myriad Snare whose sole purpose is to wipe out powerful Tacet Discords. These two facilities run day and night to offer support and aid to Xuanfang Hold.

|Located in the south of the Land of Xuanfang and adjacent to the gateway between the territory and the outside world. Here sits a way post known as Shaftpost Yard, where all goods, wares, and travelers passing in or out of the Hold must submit to inspection by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
|- id="Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou"
|  Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou
|A Nexus of ordered design, the pivot on which all turns. Xuanfang Hold's control mainframe—the Manifold Sanctum. Here, all things are simulated and released, sustaining the Hold's ceaseless workings.
|}

title: Mengzhou
content: Under the Ministry of War in Mengzhou, the soldiers responsible for guarding Xuanfang Hold are known as Xuanfang Wardens. They act as the military of Xuanfang, assisting Autopuppets in defending the region. The Xuan Triad is a special unit formed by the Xuanfang Wardens, composed of three elite Wardens. Members of this unit are also known as Xuan Watchers. The Xuan Triad is tasked with handling incidents beyond the capabilities of standard Xuanfang Wardens.

title: Mengzhou
content:
A Martial Arts Championship between various sects from Huanglong once took place in a lone mountain peak here, where Buling and Jianxin, as disciples of Master Jiufeng and Master Shiling respectively, fought. After the fight was over, a mysterious white-robed master, carrying a guqin in her arms, confronted Buling about her conceding the fight to Jianxin.

The Court of Savantae was once active in Mengzhou, having assisted Hsin in building Xuanfang Hold on the ruins of Yuan Fortress after its destruction during the Fortress and Gorges War. As the fortress had been built with the partnership of the Zhuojun Atelier, this unexpected choice was seen as snubbing the group according to some of its members.

title: Mengzhou
content:
Mengzhou may be based on Hubei, in central China.
Mengzhou has a famous rockery style known as the "Mengzhou Garden Style".

Xuanfang Hold is a region of the Mengzhou Province in Huanglong, and the primary settlement of the frontier region of Xuanfang. It is located between the cities of Mengzhou and Jinzhou, and is considered a vital passageway between them.

Before the founding of Jinzhou, Xuanfang Hold was established north of the Clouded Cliffs by Sentinel Hsin and Mengzhou's frontier court to contain and divide the Tacet Discord outbreak flowing from Norfall Barrens. It was built atop the ruins of Yuan Fortress after its destruction during the Fortress and Gorges War in collaboration with the Court of Savantae.

One of its mountains is said to have a reclusive martial arts master living at the peak.

title: Xuanfang Hold
