title: Somnoire
content: In Ragunna City, the Rover discovers that despite the realm connecting to other dreams, the White Cat reveals that other locations, such as Rinascita, are blocked off from the Somnoire due to restrictions placed upon admin privileges and the Resonance Nexus. Only when the dream nodes are active can other locations be connected with the dreams shared in the determined area linking with the Somnoire. Though the Somnoire can be granted access from an outside force, with the White Cat claiming that Ragunna could now be accessed, with certain exceptions due to unknown energy blocking off Fagaceae Peninsula and Penitent's End, up until the Rover dealt with the obstructions and allowing Ragunna to be established properly.

title: Somnoire
content: One problem did occur however where, due to the involvement of Leviathan and it's spiritual plague in the region, caused numerous impurities to enter the Somnoire as the Threnodian has infected Rinascita's people which in turn tainted their dreams. The Ebony Gatekeeper was forced to create a gateway in Rinascita and seal the impurities behind it and the Memory Zones within.

title: Somnoire
content: During the events of Lucy’s arrival on Solaris-3, she caused the formation of a Dream Band. The Ivory Gatekeeper describes it as a manifestation of frequency in the flesh, only appearing in the Somnore under the rarest of conditions. Through it, the Dream Band and the Nightmare Tacet Discord that makes up Adam Smasher are considered two types of the same coin, being perfect inversions of one another. By harnessing the Dream Band, it can counteract the corruption spread by Adam Smasher and even damage him.

title: Somnoire
content:
Though the Dream Band shattered into three shards when it should be whole, requiring the pieces to be gathered and made whole again while protected from Adam Smasher’s forces who wished to prevent the shards union. Upon reuniting as one, it allowed the embodiment of Lucy’s happiness, David, to reappear again and counter Adam Smasher. Upon Adam Smasher’s defeat, the damage he wrought retracted and vanished away.

The Dream Band is considered to be very rare, as even the Ivory Gatekeeper never saw one before up until the events of Lucy's arrival.

title: Somnoire
content: At times the Somnoire may be invaded by outside forces, be it those who are alive or dead.  While it is unknown how they appear within the Somnoire, intrusive beings such as Scar or Dreamless may also cause interference in the Somnoire, which in turn mixes dreamscapes together. The result being that certain people may look at the same item/entity at the same time, yet each see something else in their perspective.  These anomalies in Somnoire are considered disruptive to the usual laws and order of the realm's space.

title: Somnoire
content: Depending on the danger, this may allow Tacet Discords to form and potentially escape the Somnoire, and depending on the situation - transformed and becoming Phantom or Nightmare variants. One which has occurred in Ragunna, as an unknown threat - identified later as the Threnodian Leviathan - that resides somewhere, even after clearing the dream nodes, with the White Cat claiming that this hidden force is subconsciously manipulating people's dreams in Ragunna. This has caused the release of the Nightmare variants to now exist across different areas in Ragunna. The Ebony Gatekeeper also aiding in maintaining and preventing what this hidden force, as he calls it, a "spiritual plague", from infecting the rest of the Somnoire with the Rover's assistance.

title: Somnoire
content: Another example of intrusions comes from those who have perished. After the halt of the Somnoire Expansion, the dreams of those who died from the Black Shores began gathering and took the form of Fallacy of No Return, which endangered the realm and required the Shorekeepers' assistance. Another took the form of an incident where the Ivory Gatekeeper accidentally opened a gate which unleashing deadly nightmares, nightmares that only existed due to the interference of Leviathan itself who had placed a spiritual plague on Rinascita's people.

title: Somnoire
content: Depending on the circumstances, the Somnoire could be altered by outside forces. During Chromatic Fantasy, a gateway that acts as both the entrance and exit to the Somnore appeared in Lahai-Roi, except it became linked with Honami City and mixed them together, which forced Namipon to aid in the events. Namipon explains that this was caused by the Left Behind in Honami City, whose dreams manifested in a corner of Lahai-Roi which caused fantasy and reality to overlap into a chaotic disorder within the Somnoire which Namipon calls “Lost Dreams”.

title: Somnoire
content: However, Namipon claims the Left Behind alone couldn’t have caused this with “Dorothy” confirming this as she reveals that a frequency not of Solaris-3 found it’s way into the Somnoire somehow, triggering the realm’s defense mechanisms without the Gatekeepers noticing. This resulted in the dreamscape layers piling atop one another and “accidently” bridging the Left Behind’s dreams with Lahai-Roi, with the breach unable to be patched anytime soon but was stabilized thanks to Rover’s assistance.

title: Somnoire
content: This intrusion however would lead to the events of At Dream's Edge. The incident was unintentionally caused by Lucy, who’s dream connected with the Somnoire despite being from another reality altogether and caused the birth of, Rebecca, Adam Smasher, the Somnoire: Night City, and the Dream Band to appear. This formed a gateway connecting Solaris-3 and Lucy's native universe that remained in the deepest layer of the Somnoire. The Ivory Gatekeeper states the fact that two universes connecting through the Somnoire was a first for him.

title: Somnoire
content: The fallout of Lucy's arrival caused a gateway within the Somnore to materialize at Startorch Academy, which began contaminating both the surrounding area through an abnormal frequency at the academy and the Somnoire itself, forcing the Ebony Gatekeeper to handle the contaminated sectors in the background. Similar to the Ebony Gatekeeper’s plans, the Ivory Gatekeeper states if the gateway in Lahai-Roi were allowed to spread the abnormal frequencies, everyone would be pulled into the Somnoire and never awaken again. Lucy's arrival also caused unique Nightmare Tacet Discords to form from her fears who began an invasion across reality and would persist unless Lucy overcame her past traumas or continue spreading themselves and the contamination without stop. After the events in Adam Smasher’s defeat, the source of the contamination, Lucy could return back to her native universe which would stabilize the two worlds at the price of the events fading away like a dream with none, not even Lucy, recalling the adventure beyond a few like Rover. The Ivory Gatekeeper claimed Lucy could have potentially stayed in the Somnoire through an unknown method, but she refused, however and returned home.

title: Somnoire
content: During the events of Lucy's arrival in At Dream's Edge, a unique form of Nightmare Tacet Discords manifested in the Somnoire that came to be from Lucy's fears. Being more self-aware and intelligence, they were led by the Nightmare Tacet Discord Adam Smasher, who sought to haunt Lucy and spread his contamination across Lahai-Roi alongside the Somnoire through assimilation.

title: Somnoire
content: They were able to manifest outside the Somnoire and invade reality, which Abby states should be impossible as there was no gateway to allow their exit. Due to their unique frequencies, attacks that didn’t come from Lucy, Rebecca, and Rover’s power of Seperation were ineffective towards them, as Lynae noted when attacking them and could do little damage. Moryne states that their frequencies can somehow weaken and neutralize Lahai-Roi’s weapons’ attacks, thus the requirement to study Lucy and Rebecca’s weapon frequency to apply onto the region’s weapons.

title: Somnoire
content:
Though willing to harm others, they were primarily targeting Lucy. This is due to Adam Smasher’s connection to her as one born of her fears of his original-self, and sought to target her weakness in what’s suggested to be an attempt to ensure she never mentally recovered from her fears of the original as he could only exist so long as she never moves past her nightmares. Thus the requirement of the Dream Band, which could counteract his powers. Though the Ivory Gatekeeper admitted that as a last resort, killing Lucy would also help as it would cause the numerous Nightmare TD’s to vanish without their source. This is primarily because Adam Smasher was considered immortal and invulnerable so long as Lucy continued to fear him.

Upon his defeat, the damage wrought by him and his forced cleared away with the contamination returning to normal.

title: Somnoire
content: A strange layer within the Somnoire from the deeper layers which has only recently opened where a set amount of inhabitants, a crew of seven, have made "films" based on the dreams and frequencies within the Somnoire. These films utilize familiar faces which may in turn give them similar personalities based on those they were based on. The source and potential hosts of the layer is also powerful enough to ensure none but those invited can enter. Being powerful enough to manifest an invitation into the real world, breaking the boundary of dreams and reality itself.

title: Somnoire
content: The Rover is allowed entry and is the only one that can be accepted within it, denying even the Ivory and Ebony Gatekeepers themselves. In turn, the Rover can view but also interact within the observed films while gaining newly enhanced abilities within while working alongside the "actors" of the film itself during the interaction.

title: Somnoire
content:
The Somnoire is home to certain beings which include:
Illusia: The primary inhabitants are known as Illusias.  They are described as virtual entities, a conglomeration of the countless consciousnesses within the Gate. They are stated by the Ebony Gatekeeper to be those who dream, though don't truly exist and have formed due to the gate that leads into the realm. They may give Tokens and other items to those who enter the realm.
Dreamers: Those who dream and thus are recorded by the Somnoire. Onlookers who enter may find themselves observe another person's dream, allowing them to gain the aid of said dreamer by having an aspect of them, or Metaphor as it's called, for support. During the expansion of the Somnoire, the Rover could enter these dreams while said Dreamers were more aware due to a piece of their original-selves becoming trapped in the Somnoire until they were released.
Gatekeepers: The two Gatekeepers that keep watch over the Somnoire. While the role of the Ivory Gatekeeper remains unknown, the Ebony Gatekeeper's duty is to erase useless dreams that won't help in vanquishing the Lament. They both, however, are tasked with protecting the realm from disruptive elements known to enter the Somnoire, as per their duty, ensuring the stability of its dream capacity. As such, both hold certain control over the Somnoire for their duties.
Tacet Discords: Due to the Somnoire containing traits similar to the Tacet Fields, Tacet Discords are capable of being born in the Somnoire. Though they are considered dangerous elements in the realm that shouldn't belong and are capable of exiting it if a gateway exists, which may cause a TD Outbreak.
Dorothy and friends: An unknown figure who posed as "Cosmo", claims that she and her friends reside in the Somnoire itself.  However, she also states that at some point they had lived in Solaris-3 before entering through the Gate like Rover had, though refused to explain further. Later revealed to be the Ebony Gatekeeper himself, tricking the Rover for his plans during "When the Night Knocks", only to be rebutted when it was just him taking her form. Unlike her friends, Dorothy is also capable of leaving the Somnoire, but only for small periods before it becomes deadly while her friends are incapable of leaving. They claim to know the Rover with Dorothy having a relationship with the Ebony Gatekeeper, implied to be friendly as he aids her at times.  She also has a hidden location to play in.
“Dorothy”: Despite looking exactly like the original Dorothy, numerous comments coming from her suggest she either looks like the original or takes over Dorothy’s body. She claims to know Rover but is cryptic about it and states she was created by someone she called "Mom", who she has not seen in a while.
Solaris Film Festival Crew and Guests: Other inhabitants of the Somnoire, those who come from a layer that make films, utilizing the memories and frequencies of the Somnoire itself to create them. The Rover can interact within these films, made by about seven people which can be seen by other inhabitants within other layers of the Somnoire.
D: One of the visitors and viewers of the films made in the Somnoire.

title: Sonoro Sphere
content:
Sonoro Spheres, "Field of Sound," are instances in Wuthering Waves.

Completing the challenges within Sonoro Spheres rewards various items and materials such as Weapon and Skill Materials, Weapon & Skill Materials, Union EXP, Intimacy, and Shell Credits in return for some Waveplate.

title: Sonoro Sphere
content: Sonoro Spheres are spaces of dense abundant Remnant Energy, capable of preserving transdimensional information. They are important sources of information for humanity to understand the history and civilization of The Lament, and are a part of the field of Ecoacoustic research. While generally a naturally occurring phenomenon, artificial Sonoro Spheres exist, such as the Simulation Training that Midnight Rangers use, with the Nimbus Sanctum being a unique Sonoro Sphere that can be interacted in the physical plane.

title: Sonoro Sphere
content:
However, upon entering a Sonoro Sphere, information may become distorted and it becomes difficult to remove the interference from the original contents. There is also the possibility that when recording information, if the conditions are met, a person dying within the vicinity of the Sonoro Sphere will cause the copy of the original to be fully self-aware instead of being a recorded illusion. There is risk then of the version trapped within to become infected with maligned frequencies, such as  Pascar who had been warped into a Tacet Discord from corruption. The Lament itself could also consume and imprison locations, such as Honami City, which has since become the Chronorift Metropolis.

Sonance Caskets are the product of the natural decay and collapse of Sonoro Spheres, and thus hold high archaeological value.

The Shorekeeper is a Remnant Creature made up of Sonoro Spheres herself.

title: Sonoro Sphere
content:
The Shorekeeper is a Remnant Creature made up of Sonoro Spheres herself.



Among natural and artificial occurring Sonoro Sphere, there are also Resonators who wield the ability to create a Sonoro Sphere themselves. As they are creating the Sonoro Sphere through their Resonance Ability, the Sonoro Sphere will form and reflect under the user's own traits, ideals, and beliefs. One example would be the Fractsidus Overseer Phrolova who has access to a mysterious Sonoro Sphere known as "The Beyond" in which all decaying frequencies converge and in which she summons the powerful Tacet Discord Hecate from but also created the Lost Beyond for her lost home. Others such as Cristoforo and Ciaccona also wield their own Sonoro's with their own unique effects and abilities. It's possible for a Resonator to have their Sonoro Sphere exist for a certain lenth of time, as seen by the Forever Fest created by Cobb Copo lasting for years, or Cristoforo entrapping Septimont for an unknown amount of time. However, this varies as eventually they will fade away in due time alongside anything within it.

title: Sonoro Sphere
content: At the same time, certain Sonoro Spheres can be formed from a rise in emotions from a collective group. Similar to Resonators creating Sonoro Spheres, these specific Sonoro's can take form and shape by the unconscious thoughts that create the space itself. The Academy's Dark Side and the Sea of Ghosts of the Fisalia Family were both created by unconscious thoughts, making a reflective plane in the area they are created in with their own rules that must be followed. While not impossible to confine and shape them, it's difficult where these Sonoro Sphere's are usually permanent in duration unless one deals with the emotions that linger and gave birth to these areas.

title: Special Response Force
content: The Special Response Force is an emergency response team unit formed by the Spacetrek Collective.

title: Special Response Force

The unit had a high casualty rate that increased annually and reached an all-time high of 85% until an operation resulted in all members of the Special Response Force being confirmed KIA.

title: Startorch Academy
content:
Startorch Academy is a multinational school built by the Spacetrek Collective specifically for Resonators in Lahai-Roi.

It is known to contain the Exo Genesis Labs, Voidwatch Tower, Tactical Proving Grounds, and Simulator Cockpit. Its name comes from the phrase "Let Knowledge Be Your Guiding Star, Raise High the Torch of Tomorrow".

All students (except Synchronists admitted to Rabelle College) begin with a cross-disciplinary curriculum, which covers foundational sciences, humanities, and essential survival skills for life in Lahai-Roi. Students' specialized department placement is determined at the end of Year 2, based on their stated interest and academic performance.

Professor Maeva: She is a young professor who had traveled to New Federation before for research. He had created multiple brilliant instruments. Sevi is also a memory-type resonator with a forte that helps him track past memories. He has a reputation of treating students like his own kids. Despite his great pride and rigor in scientific research he had also shown to have good morals against the Fractsidus's temptations. Sevi, like Professor Karl, dislikes Lucilla and is against her being the President of the Academy.

Professor Warren (former): He was the previous head of the Research Institute and a member of the Academy's Council. He was shown to have expertise in various fields from Exostrider Engineering to Voidmatters to Synchronization. However, he was expelled after he was to have been colluding with the Fractsidus. title: Startorch Academy
content: A department dedicated to the study and research of the giant humanoid mech known as Exostrider. Known for its radical approach, the department's research efforts have seen translational applications in fields such as vehicle and humanoid mech engineering, Tacetite weaponry, and strategic equipment development. The department has two major divisions: the Division of Resonator-Mech Synchronization and the Division of Tactical Development.

title: Startorch Academy
content: Also known as Synchronist College, the Rabelle College is named after Mr. Rabelle, the pioneer of Rabelle's Curve - the now-standardised scale for characterising a Resonator's frequency pattern. With a pedagogy rooted in empirical data and quantitative research, the College is dedicated to discovering and cultivating future Synchronists. In addition to general education, the College runs the Synchronist Development Program, operating independently of all departments and disciplines. All quasi-Synchronists are granted unrestricted access to the campus's facilities.

section: {{Icon|Light Energy Sciences}} Department of Light Energy Sciences
content: This department focuses on the conversion of the light energy from the Reactor Drive for industrial production and biological cycling. The department has two academic divisions: the Division of Light Array Engineering and the Division of Ecology Conservation. Here houses the Academy's largest solis lens and largest Resonance Nexus - Telesto Lens. From the centre of the department, the Telesto Lens incessantly converts the light energy emanating from the Reactor Drive to energy supply and powers the operation of all facilities on the campus.

title: Startorch Academy
content: An academic organisation established strategically in response to the threat of Void Storms, this department is tasked with their monitoring and prevention. Its main building is the Academy's tallest signal tower, at the top of which the central observatory can be found. Researchers here carry the vital mission of investigating the origins and mechanisms of Void Storms, while developing advanced communication and spatial anchoring technologies designed for the extreme environments within a Void Storm and beyond the Stridergate. These innovations enable the transdimensional localisation of the Exostrider and real-time monitoring of Synchronists' vitals.

title: Startorch Academy
content: Startorch Food, Utilities & Energy Lounge (FUEL) is open 24h to all students and staff, providing fully-automatic, intelligent, customisable catering services. Powered by intelligent solutions such as the "Human Energy Assessment and Replenishment System," FUEL offers finely curated menus that balance nutrition and flavour. No matter your dietary options, they make sure every dish on the menu meets both nutritional and personal needs. No more worrying about what to eat - FUEL has you covered.

title: Startorch Academy
content:
Resonator Nursing Unit (ReNU) is the Academy's infirmary, operating as an affiliate of Rabelle College. It is renowned for its specialisation in Frequency Theraputics. ReNU combines cutting edge medical facilities with frontrunning expertise in treating a wide range of medical conditions. For Startorch students, who undergo intensive training from enrollment through graduation, ReNU offers not only medical support but also a space for stress relief. Resident physician Dr. Luuk Herssen makes sure every student receives close medical attention for their physical and mental wellbeing. The unit members include:

Dr. Luuk Herssen - Doctor and head of the ReNU
N.A.N.A. - Nightingale Autonomous Nursing Assistant
Arman

title: Startorch Academy
content: The Startorch Academy dorms offer every student their own private space to relax and recharge. Every space in the building is thoughtfully designed to meet a variety of needs. The resting area creates a calming environment that helps even insomniacs rest with ease. Soundproofed walls minimise noise complaints, ensuring peace of mind. Students are also free to rearrange or decorate their rooms as they like - so long as it's within school regulations.

title: Startorch Academy
content: Auto-Clean Pods are the Academy's intelligent modules that offer highly efficient, fully automated laundromat services that integrate garment cleaning with nano-repair technology. It automatically identifies fabric types and applies tailored care programs, effectively repairing damage and extending garment lifespan. The academy encourages faculty and students to make active use of this facility.

title: Startorch Academy
content: UNICODE is the Academy's uniform store, where students and staff visit for bespoke uniform tailoring services. The store's intelligent fitting systems ensure each uniform is measured and tailored to the customer. The measurement data is encrypted and accessible only with authorisation, ensuring full protection of customer privacy.

title: Startorch Academy
content: RPGs are modular entertainment units found around the residential quarter of the Academy where the "tenth art" is on full display. According to Rabelle College studies, when combined with Frequency Modulation technologies, video games can help students relieve stress, regulate mood, and restore cognitive wellbeing. The Academy encourages students to balance their academic effort with entertainment to achieve better results.

title: Startorch Academy
content: The Academy's official convenience store branch that brings grocery shopping right to students and staff's doorstep. From snacks to stationery, the stores carry everything you need for daily life. Every item is handpicked and carefully stocked to ensure consistent quality. "Startorch Can & Tin - bringing you joyful surprises, just like opening a can." It is also where the Gastro-Alchemist Fan Club hangs.

title: Startorch Academy
content: Auto Parking & Engineering Xpertise (APEX) is a comprehensive space that offers parking and vehicle modification services. Here, students and staff can access not only comprehensive facilities that meet diverse demands but also professional maintenance and vehicle customisation support.

title: Startorch Academy
content: The public auditorium in Startorch Academy that serves as the primary venue for large-scale indoor events. It is available for student activities. To host an event here, student societies or fan clubs must submit a proposal and application to the Student Council at least three working days in advance. Upon approval, the event will be officially registered and circulated.

Curious about Resonator-weapon-making craftsmanship? Come to Argus Workshop, where everything you need can be found. Note: This fan club meets the Academy's Crafting Bay. For more details, please contact the Fan Club leader, Garris." Argus Workshop is described as a weapon crafting (specifically classical arsenal like swords and broadblades) club inspired by 'Septimonian traditions' but unlike those which use furnaces and anvils, they use the Crafting Bay. Its club members: Garris and Katarina.

content: Gastro-Alchemist Fan Club is considered to be the 'wierdest' but 'most practical' fan club. Their club's 'grand mission' is to improve Academy Food, not through food engineering or nutrition research, but through methods of combining food you can buy on campus to make it 'taste better'. That is why they hang around Startorch Can & Tin. Its club members include an unknown leader who's in the infirmary for stomach ache and Felicia. They wish to recruit Luuk Hersson to their club.

Fight thrilling duels, use bold all-or-nothing tactics to defeat powerful foes, and be honored as a true duelist." Peaks of Prestige fan club is a dueling card game club. Mr. Furious of Septiment is its creator and leader. Anita is the division manager of Lahai Roi Ranked Tournament. It's considered the most popular fan club. title: Stellar Matrices
content:
Stellar Matrices are, based on the computational protocols of the Black Shores' Tethys System, a data package format that functions similarly to a highly compressed file. They have the capacity to store immense amounts of information and can even simulate a Lament.

Certain individuals can access these matrices under specific circumstances, making them an integral part of the Tethys System's operational framework.

title: Stellar Matrices
content: The first member to define a Stellar Matrix noted that standards of observing and evaluating one are similar to the astronomical standards of Solaris-3. Properly functioning Stellar Matrices are projected into the subterranean galaxy of the Black Shores, allowing members to study, observe, and Modulate them. However, as these celestial bodies collide, merge, and collapse, the code evolves through countless iterations. Occasionally, this process spawns errant code within some Stellar Matrices. To avoid contamination, the Black Shores contains these Stellar Matrices in special Tacetite vessels in the Error Cell. The Error Cell then analyzes the aberrant data, deploying specialized probes to isolate the rogue code segments.

title: Stellar Matrices
content: The Modulation Hall is where "Modulator" of the past and people of the present observe and guide the course of stars in the vast underground sky. Through here all beings are reborn as stars, which, in turn, reflect brief moments of reality. With the power of the Tethys System, Star Matrices brought to this place can reveal glimpses of the past, whether of destruction or renewal.

title: Stellar Matrices
content: The Data Torrent connecting all the Nexus on this planet continuously transfers information about abnormal fluctuations caused by the Lament and Waveworn back to the Stellar Matrix. The Stellar Matrix then constructs models to predict the location and time of the next Lament.

title: Stellar Matrices
content:
A Necrostar is a type of Stellar Matrix that swallows the faulty data in its wake, a black hole where forsaken Stellar Matrices find their end. Even the newfound science of Tacetite could not provide explanations for its fundamental nature, as all are subject to the gravity within it. A Necrostar marks the beginning and the end of destruction.

Necrostars were once known as "black holes" in ancient astronomy. All of Solaris-3's data is converted into stars for observation by the Tethys System, while the discarded data is cast into the Necrostar. Due to its nature, Necrostar's frequencies are incredibly complex.

title: Tacet Discord
content:
Tacet Discords (abbreviated as TDs) are sentient beings formed by the residual chaotic frequency energy under the Waveworn Phenomenon with ever-changing, amorphous forms. They possess , also known by the academic community as  and instinctively feed on other frequencies to maintain stability and evolve.

These creatures mimic the abilities, shapes, and behaviors of others and are influenced by the types of frequency they consume.

title: Tacet Discord
content:
Ever since the emergence of the Waveworn Phenomenon, humanity has been fixated on researching the enigma known as the Tacet Discords.

These entities are seen as sources of destruction and embodiments of chaotic energy. Despite extensive study, our understanding remains incomplete due to a lack of information on their composition.

As time passes, this gap in knowledge will only widen, resulting in the gradual decay and eventual annihilation of these discords. To sustain itself, the Tacet Discords possess an instinctual drive to consume and merge with other frequencies, in a constant battle to maintain its existence.

title: Tacet Discord
content:
Upon its demise, the frequencies of a Tacet Discord will not immediately vanish. Instead, they will slowly decay over time, allowing for their capture and utilization.

Once enough frequencies have been stored, they can be harnessed to replicate the abilities of the original Tacet Discord.

This remaining energy, capable of emulating the defeated entity's power, is known as an Echo - a valuable asset that must be carefully collected and preserved in our laboratory archives.

title: Tacet Discord
content: These Tacet Discords consume the frequencies of earth and sometimes other natural inorganic matter (non-man-made). They often mimic rocks and crystal formations but sometimes appear plant-like.

title: Tacet Discord
content: These Tacet Discords attach themselves to man-made objects and are sometimes described as parasites of the objects they're attached to.

No description of this class has been given in the current version of Wuthering Waves.

title: Tacet Discord
content:
Dreamless - A Tacet Discord directly birthed by Ovathrax for its protection, created by cannibalizing the frequencies of the Crownless.
Crownless - Harbinger of the Scourge of War (Threnodian Ovathrax).
Tempest Mephis - Vanguard of the Crownless
Thundering Mephis - Vanguard of the Crownless

title: Tacet Discord
content: According to the allegorical story of Qichi Village that Scar made for Rover, the "white lambs" might represent the Tacet Discords. It is also implied that the TDs are originally sapient humans, but turned into monsters by the mysterious shepherd.

title: Tacet Field
content:
Tacet Fields are a form of Waveworn Phenomenon, and are widely believed to be where all Tacet Discords originate. Reverberations fill the air in these locations, linking the world to an unknown space through a white Resonance Cord.
__NOTOC__

title: Tacet Field
content:
Tacet Fields are easily identifiable locations, featuring a sky of inverted seas and a deep cross-shaped Tacet Mark on the ground. Meanwhile, Paradimensional Tacet Fields are accessed through a Tacet Mark shaped door way that sit diagonally from the ground.

The convergence of the Etheric Sea results in the formation of new Tacet Fields, which initially go through a Dormant period, during which the area is relatively safe. A faster formation generally results in a longer Dormant period, as well as stronger Tacet Discords.

title: Tacet Field
content:
A former researcher from Huaxu Academy and childhood friend of Xiangli Yao, Pascar identified the special frequency of the Tacet Field, and developed a prototype detector that can predict where they are forming. After Pascar and the prototype were devoured by Waveworn, his notes were recovered and the theory restored, named the 'Pascar Spectrum' theory. While the prototype has yet to be successfully recreated, the theory has gained global recognition as well as attracted the attention of the Black Shores.

As part of their efforts in researching an ancient civilization, a group of scientists exiled from the Court of Savantae performed an experiment into creating an Artificial Controllable Tacet Field.

title: Tacet Field
content: While Tacet Fields kill the plants in their environment, they are also a source of unique plants and minerals, such as Floramber that forms from the remains of the dead plants, and Erodorchids that grow on the edges of Tacet Fields.

title: Tacet Mark
content: A Tacet Mark is a symbol that appears on every Resonator's body at the time of their Awakening.

title: Tacet Mark
content:
Bearing a strong resemblance to the cross-shaped marks seen in Tacet Fields, the exact shape of a Resonator's Tacet Mark seems to be related to their Rabelle's Curve, with the exception of Jiyan, who bears a unique mark. The placement of the mark on one's body seems entirely random, however, family members can occasionally share the same placements, as demonstrated with Yangyang and Suisui.

Tacet Marks are not static feature on the body, like a scar or tattoo, but instead constantly changing in size and thrumming in relation to the amount of Resonance Energy the Resonator currently has. Upon utilizing their Resonance Liberation, a Resonator's Tacet Mark will glow.

title: Tacetite
content: In studying the Waveworn Phenomenon, scientists discovered Tacetite - a substance that can permanently hold Remnant Energy.

title: Tacetite
content:
When modified, Tacetite can become a potent energy weapon for Resonators, capable of harming the Tacet Discords.

The core modules of these weapons are charged with Energy Cores, supplements storing Tacetite Energy. Resonators are advised to perform routine maintenance on their weapons to ensure they currently are retaining charge, and experienced Resonators often preassemble and preheat Energy Cores to prevent weapon malfunctions during intense battles.

In Jinzhou, the Ministry of Development once developed Tacetite Weapons to allow non-Resonator units in the Midnight Rangers fight against Tacet Discord. However, since they did not possess Forte and prolonged exposure posed health risks, the output of the weapons was limited for safety.

title: Tacetite
content: The Black Shores headquarters is built upon a mass of Tacetite ore. This is what causes Blake Blooms to lose their color.

title: Ten Seals Covenant
content:
The Ten Seals Covenant  is an organization founded by Suoming to combat the Evil Miasma in her hometown of Huating.

Suoming is the only surviving member of the Ten Seals Covenant. By using her Resonance Ability, she sealed the frequencies of her nine subordinates within her Vermillion Lock.

title: Ten Seals Covenant
content: The organization was formed after the calamity, Evil Miasma, brought disaster and suffering to Huating. Once Suoming's childhood ended, she gathered nine others who lost their homes and created the Ten Seals Covenant.

title: Terminal
content: Terminal is a device used by Resonators. Each Terminal has various functions that aid Resonators in exploration, navigation and collection in Solaris-3. Terminals vary in appearance and function depending on the nation, as can be visually seen in the difference between the Terminals of Resonators from Huanglong, Rinascita, The Black Shores and the Fractsidus. The Rover carries a unique version of the Terminal that can be upgraded.

title: Terminal
content:
The primary function of the Terminal is to collect and record Reverberations. These Reverberations are turned into Echoes by the Terminal, which can then be directed as needed. The Data Bank module of the Terminal allows Resonators to replicate the combat abilities of these Echoes in battle. Additionally, some Echoes enable Resonators to briefly transform into the shapes of the Tacet Discords that are stored.

It also has a Utility module, with features such as Grapple, Sensor, and Levitator.

Each Terminal carries a unique Terminal ID which allows the Rover to unlock portions of the Map via Huanglong's Nexus Towers and Rinascita's Genesis Nexus.

title: Terminal
content:

The Pangu Terminal is unique to the nation of Huanglong and is studied by the Huaxu Academy of Jinzhou. The Rover's Terminal is currently configured to the upgrades from this iteration of the Terminal.

This terminal features a gourd-shaped design with a chrome finish. Its body is adorned with various design elements in gold, including concentric waves at its base and a singular white motif reminiscent of a loong.

In Jinzhou, the Utility Function of the Terminal has upgraded modules with regards to security and communication. An example of such module is used for Access Pass Authorization, upgraded by Sanhua. This contains the contact information for all public services, such as Patrol Stations, and provides unlimited access to all regions in Jinzhou.

title: Terminal
content:

The Montelli Family earned recognition for their pursuit of Echoes beyond Rinascita’s borders—Echoes not bound by the Genesis Nexus, which was provided by the Sentinel Imperator. This led to the development of Reserved Terminals, which evolved from a basic Terminal discovered in the Montellis' early trade dealings. Their investment in this technology was driven by the need for Echoes independent of the Genesis Nexus, capable of seafaring and defending against Tacet Discord encounters in open waters—an area where Common Echoes falter due to their inability to travel beyond the Genesis Nexus' range.

title: Terminal
content:
In the early years, the family patriarch, Francesco Montelli, learned to modify Terminals during his ventures in the New Federation. Unlike other regions where Terminals were freely traded, Rinascita’s Terminals were strictly controlled by the Order. The Montellis, however, developed a modified lantern-type Terminal that appeared ornamental but contained advanced tech modules. These modifications allowed the family to supply Terminals to Resonators at fair prices, effectively breaking the Order's monopoly.

Only a select few Resonators are permitted to carry a Reserved Terminal and while it is still a sensitive subject in public, at least the people are free to explore in the wild and gather Echoes as they please. Guests of the Montelli family are granted permission to bring their Reserved Terminal into Rinascita.

title: Terminal
content:
The Frequency Cassette Recorder is unique to the nation of Lahai-Roi and is used by members of the Spacetrek Collective, storing a Rabelle Cassette. The owner must have their Frequency burned into their Rabelle Cassette via the Burning Room of the Spacetrek Collective.

According to their description, the materials used to make them date back to the Exostrider, granting the owner partial resistance to Void Storms. ]]

title: Tethys System
content:
The Tethys System (also known as the "Civilization Sand Table") is the central terminal of the Black Shores. It predates the Lament. The Black Shores relies on its calculations to observe, forewarn, and solve anything related to the Lament as it can hold nearly infinite data, and is akin to a collection of Sonoro Spheres. It relies on emotions from the Lament to fuel its calculations, where Lament data is visualized as stars in the system, while discarded data is cast into the Necrostar. Only the Tethys System understands the true nature of the Lament.

It was first introduced in Rewinding Raindrops.

title: Tethys System
content: By inputting Lament frequency data-collected both manually and via beacon access-into the system, the Black Shores can issue Lament warnings for locations worldwide within a 24 to 48-hour time range. This capability is the cornerstone of the Black Shores' extensive collaborations with countries across the globe. Its coding language is extremely complex, and it is only known that its terminals take the form of various autonomous robots.

title: Tethys System
content:
Based on the computational protocols of the Tethys System, the Stellar Matrix is a data package format that functions similarly to a highly compressed file. It has the capacity to store immense amounts of information and even simulate a Lament. Certain individuals can access these matrices under specific circumstances, making them an integral part of the Tethys System's operational framework.

Properly functioning Stellar Matrices are projected into the subterranean galaxy of the Black Shores, allowing members to study and observe them. Malfunctioning matrices, however, are collected and isolated in designated areas to prevent data overflow.

The first member to define a Stellar Matrix noted that standards of observing and evaluating one are similar to the astronomical standards of Solaris-3.

title: Tethys System
section: Post-Lament Anthropocene: Comprehensive Mirror for Historians - The Black Shores
content: The Tethys System is a supercomputer unique to the Black Shores that has no discernible energy source, physical infrastructure, or processing core. Its coding language is extremely complex, and it is only known that its terminals take the form of various autonomous robots. In essence, the Tethys System is almost akin to a natural phenomenon, with an origin that remains entirely mysterious. It serves as a civilization calculator and forms the foundation upon which the Black Shores stand. The results generated by the Tethys System are projected as a starry sky within the underground of the Black Shores, made possible by multiple Anchors and underground Data Hubs. This has earned the underground region the title "City of Eternal Night".

title: Tethys System
content:
A type of Stellar Matrix. Inside the Tethys System, a celestial body called Necrostar swallows the faulty data in its wake, a black hole where forsaken Matrices find their end.

Even the newfound science of Tacetite could not provide explanations for its fundamental nature, as all are subject to the gravity within it.

The Necrostar marks the beginning and the end of destruction. It also holds the key to salvation...

Or perhaps, merely a lie.

title: Tethys System
content: The Fallacy of No Return is the last line of defense built by the Tethys System, roaming between the boundaries of reality and data space. The absolute safety and stability of this system must be preserved at all costs, even if it means exhausting the computing power of the stars, or seizing the power to modulate. This is the core logic of the system, the foundation to continue the observation, and the unwavering protocol of Tethys.

title: Tethys System
content: The KU-robots found all over the island are directly linked to the Tethys System. The Tethys system gives them all their own personalities and voice frequencies are encoded into languages that humans can understand. The robots can be considered a living race of their own.

title: The Lament
content: "The Lament" (Chinese: 悲鸣,  "lament" or "wail of sorrow") is a term used to describe a series of catastrophic mass-extinction phenomena that have affected the planet, Solaris-3, and is one of the primary driving narratives in Wuthering Waves. It serves as the general classification for all major disaster trends and Waveworn Phenomena observed on the planet. Over the past 10,000 years, five global Lament events and more than 300,000 regional instances have been recorded, indicating a recurring and persistent pattern of large-scale disruption. These events have led to the emergence of individuals known as Resonators—those who have adapted to, or been shaped by, the residual energy of the Lament.

title: The Lament
content:
The Black Shores is a covert organization responsible for safeguarding humanity and overseeing the surveillance and mitigation of the Lament through the Tethys System. They have developed a predictive system for Lament activity and have established cooperative partnerships with nations across Solaris-3. Resonance Beacons have been deployed to continuously monitor the Lament, enabling real-time data collection. Additionally, the organization utilizes monitoring registers positioned worldwide to track and analyze Sentinels - entities that serve as guardians of the remaining civilization.

The Fractsidus aims to accelerate the next instance of the Lament - dubbed as the "True Lament" - by resurrecting the Threnodians, formidable creatures born from the Laments, with the power to destroy the human spirit and feed off of their collapsed will.

title: The Lament
content: As revealed in Chapter I: Act VIII - To the Shore's End, The Lament disrupts the fundamental laws of physics, with gravity remaining the only consistent force. This destabilization causes reality to fracture unpredictably, giving rise to anomalies that affect both the natural world and human infrastructure. These phenomena range from warped terrains to time-displaced echoes of past lives, driven by accumulated Remnant Energy—data-like residues of memory and emotion.

title: The Lament
content:
During the quest, Legacy of the Lasting Night, the emotional manifestation of the Lament involves psychological disruptions in affected individuals. It induces symptoms such as obsessive behavior, hallucinations, and emotional instability—particularly despair, grief, and fixation on past traumas. These effects are believed to stem from Remnant Energy interacting with human consciousness, creating feedback loops of unresolved emotion.

Following the onset of the Lament, all forms of exploration beyond Solaris-3 were suspended. The destabilization of physical laws—leaving gravity as the only constant—rendered long-range travel and advanced technologies unreliable. Interstellar expansion, once a symbol of human ambition, came to a complete halt as foundational systems failed under unpredictable conditions.

title: The Lament
content: Despite these limitations, certain scholars and explorers continued their research, driven by lingering curiosity and a desire to return to the skies. While official efforts ceased, isolated attempts persist in hopes of understanding the Lament’s origins and reclaiming what was lost.

title: The Lament
content: During the exploration across Honami City in the questline, Stagnant Dawn on Wastelands, observation shows how the Lament caused a mass chaotic effect across Honami City's reality. Space itself had been sliced through the effects of the Iridglow, capable of cutting through and confusing space, making it difficult to reach the source of it, Neon Tower, where the Lament resides. Through Chisa and Sumika’s time in the city, they explain that the Lament had consumed the entire location (starting from Neon Tower) and entrapped the city in a mass Sonoro Sphere which subjected the region onto a unusual time loop. Time itself has also been affected greatly where those inside experience a time dilation; months could pass within the interior while years pass outside of it.  Over time, the Lament is stated to have weakened and is no longer the real thing, it's power fading, though Chisa attests that it's still dangerous. More so when the Fractsidus begun experimenting on the land since the space in Honami City was considered to be like shattered glass, where anything too forceful could make it collapse.

title: The Lament
content: While Honami City had been originally sealed, through the combination of Sumika cracking it open by sending out a message from the gathered Longings, it causes the restraints around the Sonoro to weaken, allowing the Black Shores and Abby to slowly cause the connection between the city and the outside world to become stronger. After the defeat of the Chronorift Yakujin, the loops ended with the Black Shores making a full connection with the city, allowing time flow to stabilize within the Sonoro itself. Though hazard zones and dangers do still remain in spite of the situation being settled.

title: The Lament
content: When reading Sumika's Notes, who catalogued some of the effects the Lament had on Honami, she wrote down that everything two-dimensional, three dimensional, is equally sliced by the Lament like it does with people, buildings, and everything else within the space, where Namipon adds their own existence was torn apart from it. Plants themselves aren’t bound by the “reset” though, unaffected by the way time moves forward and backward within the fixed range of the temporal loops. Food became compressed Remnant Energy with living things no longer feeling hunger. One fortunate consequence of the unusual timeflow in Honami City is that in spite of Chisa being in danger of Overclocking, the Sonoro Sphere stalled Chisa’s condition and prevented her from endangering herself. Neon Tower, as it is the source and center of the Lament in Honami City, and is the one place where if the right path is found, can allow one to escape the city. To reach the source of it, however, one needs filtered Longings to make way or risk finding themself lost from the rearranged space where time moves slower the closer one gets to the tower. This is because time is completely out of sync, causing Sumika to see time fragments of her past itself. Only through the Longings can one find the right path as they resonate with the source of the Lament.

title: The Lament
content: While the Lament cannot be controlled or manipulated in normal circumstances, Stranger Things in Honami shows how the Left Behind known as Miki’s father managed to utilize the Lament’s powers due to being devoured and becoming a part of the phenomenon. Namipon explains that Longings are frequencies that persist within the Lament, not disappearing even when devoured, which could in turn affect the Lament’s residual power in Honami if the Longings are strong enough. Though Miki’s father was unable to properly control the power of the Lament, which in turn twisted the wishes and was only stopped when he found satisfaction that Shashou Cafe was doing alright.

title: The Lament
content:
The third storyline reveals that gravity was the one law that was unaltered.
The term "The Lament" is officially translated across multiple languages with words that convey cries, screams, or expressions of mourning, emphasizing its identity as both a world-ending catastrophe and a resonant sound event. In Simplified and Traditional Chinese, it appears as 悲鸣 / 悲鳴; in Japanese, as 悲鳴 (himei); in Korean, as 비명 (bimyeong); in French, as La Lamentation; in German, as Lamento; and in Spanish, as Lamento. This linguistic consistency aligns with Wuthering Waves’ broader use of sound-centric terminology underscoring a thematic framework where sonic and emotional frequencies shape the metaphysics of the world.
The Shorekeeper describes the Lament as “the death knell for humanity, leaving billions upon billions of lives lost to its wail.” The phrase death knell refers not only to a metaphorical warning of imminent demise, but also to an actual tolling of a bell traditionally used to signal death in many cultures.

title: The Moon
content: The Moon is a Waveworn Phenomenon in the sky of Solaris-3, likely some kind of reflection of the Etheric Sea akin to Retroact Rain's ability to conjure up the memories of those caught in it. In this sense, the Moon that can be observed on Solaris today is likely a sort of mass-civilisational memory passed from generation to generation, explaining why its appearance is different from culture to culture and why it never appears during the day.

title: The Moon
content: The exact history of the Moon remains unclear. Its appearance in all cultures on Solaris demonstrates that at one point, the Moon was a real physical object orbiting the planet. While its destruction is a fact, when exactly this occurred is not clear, although presumably the inhabitants of Solaris would not be able to confirm this destruction if it occurred after the fall of SkyArk Space Station and the envelopment of the Etheric Sea. Events in Dreaming Deep, which may or may not be tales based on reality, imply that the Moon once visible from the surface was artificially placed in orbit. Some aspects of Jinzhou culture and the dual moons seen in the Sanguis Plateaus and Roya Frostlands suggest that Solaris may have even had two moons at one point.

title: The Moon
content:
The Moon plays an important role in many cultures in Solaris. Both Jinzhou and Septimont use the moon's reflection for fortune-telling, while the Moon-Chasing Festival of Huanglong remains one of its most important traditional festivals. The Sentinel Hsin is also related to the moon, being given the title "Moon Fox."

The moon both visible and visited during At Dream's Edge is not Solaris' moon, and instead is a Somnoire-induced recreation of Earth's moon from Lucy's memories of the  universe.

title: The White Tower
content: The White Tower is a Threnodian sealed deep within the Somnoire. Little is known about its nature and true origins, beyond what is relayed in the lore of Dreaming Deep.

title: The White Tower
content: Described as a Threnodian that was instinctually drawn to the "brilliance" of an ancient civilization on Solaris-3 from afar, it brought upon this society's total destruction, leading to the Ivory Gatekeeper and Ebony Gatekeeper taking initiative to preserve the remnants of their civilization within the Somnoire. The White Tower would notice this, and take to chasing after their preserved remains. To stop its incessant destruction, the Gatekeepers worked together to seal the White Tower in the Somnoire by splitting it into a myriad of layers across dream realms, leaving the White Tower stranded at the bottom of its deepest layer.

title: The White Tower
content: The White Tower would later make attempts to stir from the depths of its prison. However, this would be countered by the emergence of D- who formed either as a residual frequency of the Threnodian in opposition to it that severed itself and became influenced by human emotion, or as a result of a manifestation of the civilization's will itself. D began reconstituting her memories and records through the creation of films, while also battling the Threnodian's nightmare creations.

title: The White Tower
content: D, from Dreaming Deep, is theorized to be a manifestation of it.

title: The White Tower
content: The White Tower is strongly implied to be the second known alien Threnodian, similar to Aleph-1. Much like the latter, it became attracted to Solaris-3 from the abyss of space, and attempted to wreak mass destruction upon its arrival. Both were sealed for centuries by forces that arose in opposition, such as the twin Gatekeepers of the Somnoire in the case of the White Tower, and the Exostrider in Aleph-1's case.

title: Threnodian
content:
Threnodians are formidable creatures born from the Laments, with the power to destroy human spirit and feed off of their collapsed will.

If civilizations represent mankind's collective will, they are the embodiment of the hidden fears and inner turmoil of humanity, manifesting as destructive disasters known as Tacet Discord that spread across different parts of the world.

title: Threnodian
content: Threnodians are a reflection of the collective fears of humanity condensed into physical form, born from the dark side of collective consciousnesses. Each Threnodian embodies a certain fear of struggle, which has a deep connection to the area that faces them, such as Ovathrax, the Threnodian of War, in Jinzhou, a land that has been a battleground for centuries.

title: Threnodian
content:
Threnodians are incredibly powerful creatures, and are capable of vastly strengthening the effects of Waveworn Phenomenon on their surrounding environment. Just as a Sentinel has their own appointed Resonator whom they have resonated with, so too do Threnodians. However, the exact process of becoming a Threnodian's Resonator, and whether all Threnodians are capable of obtaining a Resonator, is not known—as Leviathan only gained this ability after its assimilation with the Sentinel Imperator, and Aleph-1's Resonator was artificially induced.

A single Threnodian's revival is never an independent occurrence, as they can sense each other through some form of telepathic link and can trigger catastrophic events across Solaris-3.

title: Threnodian
content: After fusing with Leviathan, Sentinel Imperator gained knowledge that as long as there is human civilization, Threnodians will always exist, and Threnodians cannot be truly killed as even Leviathan itself does not know the means to do it. The only way to defeat a Threnodian is to shackle it to a Resonator. Aalto explains that due to their nature as shadows of civilization, they are both formless and immortal, thus cannot entirely be erased. Therefore, sealing it inside the Resonator's body is the next best method in defeating a Threnodian by giving them form. This was proven to be true as Leviathan was successfully sealed. For now, the threat of Threnodian is over in Rinascita and it will take some time before a new Threnodian will appear to replace the sealed Leviathan.

title: Threnodian
content:
Due to their unique nature, Cristoforo reveals that a Threnodian’s power and essence is one and the same, and he claims that if Leviathan were to possess Abby through the Dark Tide, they could merge themselves with Ovathrax and gain a complete rebirth as Abby contains the dormant powers of Ovathrax within them.

Aemeath and Luuk Herssen reveal that Aleph-1 does not originate from Solaris-3 and is in fact a Threnodian from space. This suggests other Threnodians exist beyond the planet, with implications that the Lament may in fact not be a local phenomenon confined to Solaris-3, but across the universe. This is backed by the existence of The White Tower, another ancient Threnodian sealed within the Somnoire that is implied to have arrived on Solaris-3 from space.

title: Threnodian
content:
During the Jinzhou crisis, Ovathrax's revival begins unexpectedly. After the defeat of its vanguards, Crownless and Dreamless, by Rover and Jiyan with the support of the Midnight Rangers and other Resonators in Jinzhou, it opted to flee, and its current location is unknown.

According to Black Shores' systems, Ovathrax's revival has triggered similar reactions in other countries, with Rinascita being the only exception, where no frequencies fluctuations related to Threnodians have been detected.

title: Threnodian
content: Aleph-1 is an extraterrestrial Threnodian that was drifting between the space of the Homeland Civilization and Solaris-3, before intercepting the Exostrider Baldur. The two behemoths engaged in battle, with Baldur (after resonating with Aemeath) sealing Aleph-1 above Solaris-3 past the Stridergate, a rare opening in the Etheric Sea that allows access to outer space. Baldur landed in the Roya Frostlands, providing warmth and guidance to the Royan people before becoming dormant.

title: Threnodian
content: During Rover's arrival in Lahai-Roi, Aleph-1 attempted to break past the Stridergate and devour Solaris. After Aemeath sacrificed herself to travel back in time through Voidspace in order to pilot the Exostrider and seal it underneath Sundermere as part of a closed loop, it was pursued and defeated by Rover and the combined efforts of Startorch Academy, the Spacetrek Collective, and the newly-awakened Exostrider. After being defeated by the Exostrider, it was cast out to the edge of the known universe, majorly stalling its return. Further, Denia would sacrifice herself afterwards in order to destroy its last frequency tether to Solaris-3, depriving it of any remaining connections to the planet.

Ashinohara has a Threnodian whose power comes and goes in predictable cycles. It caused Honami City to vanish with a then-new power, and thus is implicated in the recent disappearance of Ashinohara as a whole.

Chongzhou is known to have a Threnodian.

title: Threnodian
content:
Chongzhou is known to have a Threnodian.



The White Tower remains a particularly unique case among Threnodians, implied to be another alien Threnodian similar to Aleph-1. It was preserved in the Somnoire by the ancient civilization that it destroyed, as it slipped inside and eventually caused the fracturing of the Somnoire into its present day layers. As this Threnodian attempted to reconstruct both itself and the shattered memories of the civilisation, it has possibly gained a "soul" in the form of D, master of the cinema layer - though this remains ambiguous, and the original Threnodian may still be sealed inside.

title: Threnodian
content: 'Threnodian' is an adjective that refers to something that is mournful or related to a threnody, which is a song, poem, or speech expressing sorrow, especially for someone who has died. It often describes artistic expression that embodies themes of grief or lamentation.

title: Timeline
content:
This Timeline is a rough estimation of the universe of Wuthering Waves. LD (Landing Date) refers to the year that Rover lands in Solaris-3 and starts the game's events.

References are provided as much as possible.

title: Timeline
content:
? — The Farwatcher and eight other interstellar probes are launched by the Pre-Lament Civilization.
? — The Tethys Institute proposes, approves, and executes Resolution K626 as the Lament begins.

title: Timeline
content:
10,000 years before LD — There have been five global Laments and more than 300,000 regional Laments since 10,000 years before LD until LD.. The first Global Lament hit Solaris, rewriting the foundational of matter of the universe into frequencies. Gravity is the only pre-Lament law of physics that still applies.
? — The Fractsidus is founded
? — Rover arrives from the Homeland Civilization with the mission to stop the Lament on Solaris-3. The SkyArk space station, a Court of Savantae satellite, witnesses Rover falling through the Etheric Sea. The Etheric Sea is an atmospheric Waveworn Phenomena that blankets the globe and prevents humans from reaching outer space. Weiying, one of the researchers aboard the SkyArk station, is the earliest confirmed identity of the Grand Architect.
? — The Roya Frostlands becomes Solaris's new pole following the first Lament ever recorded, when its once-lush forests were transformed into an endless ice sheet.. The Roya live on this

title: Timeline
content: When the second recorded Lament strikes the Roya Frostlands, Threnodian Aleph-1  - having arrived alongside the Exostrider from outer space- unleashes the Void Storm. The Exostrider resonates with Aemeath and seals Aleph-1 above Solaris-3, behind the Stridergate. This is the only remaining connection to outer space after the descent of the Etheric Sea. To counter the devastation caused by the overflow of Voidmatter, the Exostrider shed its own components and transformed them into the Exoswarm, restoring Lahai-Roi's damaged ecology. It also guided the Roya tribe to relocate their settlements in Lahai-Roi, beneath the frozen expanse.

title: Timeline
content:
? — Rover makes enemies out of many organizations. One of said organizations creates Camellya to assassinate Rover. It is likely that this organization is behind her Resonance Awakening, as she is an Artificial Resonator.
? — The Somnoire is created to store and analyze peoples' dreams and search them for potential solutions to the Lament. The Ivory Gatekeeper and Ebony Gatekeeper are created as the Somnoire's guardians, and Rover is granted the authority of "Dreamwalker" within its system.

title: Timeline
content:
? — The Tethys System is created by an unknown civilization, likely the Homeland Civilization.
? — The Shorekeeper is created in a piece of light blue crystal made of remnant energy, gathered from the "Anchor" on the Black Shores Archipelago. Rover touches the crystal, and their frequency resonates with the crystal, awakening the Shorekeeper and allowing her to take a human form.
? — Rover founds the Black Shores organization as a way to gather people to solve the Lament. Tethys selects the people that Rover recruits. The organization provides evacuation and support relief for locations devastated by the Lament, and brings back the Reverberation data for Shorekeeper to analyze.

title: Timeline
content:
Platya is born in Honami City and leaves before its Lament.
Honami City is struck by the Lament and turned into a Sonoro Sphere.
It is implied that Gyokuro is killed in this incident (due to her reverberation being found in Honami), and Hiyuki takes up the mantle of Miko of the Flaming Sakura after this.
~50 years before LD
Sumika is sucked into the Honami City Sonoro Sphere.

title: Timeline
content: ~38 years before LD - Luuk Herssen is stationed at Startorch Academy by Rover to monitor Fractsidus activities.

title: Timeline
content:
20 years before LD
The Astral Modulator, Rover, steps down as the leader of the Black Shores to "abandon their memories", placing the Tethys System in charge of governing, and passing their duties as the leader on to the Shorekeeper.
Camellya abandons her memory and leaves the Black Shores, hoping to reunite with Rover in the future.
The "Rover" of the Past leaves a message for the current Rover, given only if current Rover resolved the Tethys System Crisis.

title: Timeline
content:
~19 years before LD
Mornye receives an acceptance letter to Startorch at 16 years old.Mornye/Backstory#Admission Letter She visits the infirmary often and is cared for by Dr. Luuk.Mornye/Voicelines#About Luuk Herssen
She is considered a genius and becomes the youngest teaching assistant in the department of Exostrider Engineering. Mornye grades one of Chisa's papers before Chisa's disappearance into the Void Storm.
Mornye is taken under Rover's wing while she is a student. They invite her to on an expedition to the Frostlands despite her being wheelchair-bound. This expedition is what ignites Mornye's desire for space exploration.
Rover cares for Aemeath during this period of time.
19 years before LD
Kuchiba Chisa is sucked into the Honami City Sonoro Sphere. This is an accident related to the Void Storm Waveworn Phenomena of Lahai-Roi.
19 years before LD, after Rover's departure from Lahai-Roi
Mornye graduates, and her senior thesis becomes the basis of the New Solar Ceremony.
Mornye becomes a professor in the Department of Exostrider Engineering.
Her first assignment after joining the Research Institute is to recreate a night sky over Lahai-Roi. The signal tower for the project is built, but the site is struck by a Voidstorm. Mornye overclocks to prevent the tower from failing and is successful, but is struck by a piece of falling debris. Her legs are irreparably injured by the debris, so she becomes the inaugural test subject for an experimental prosthetic technology. The operation succeeds, and she continues to have surgeries to refine her prosthetics. She can now walk without aid, although her prosthetics do require frequent recharging.
9 years before LD
Aemeath overclocks in order to resonate with the Exostrider and prevent Aleph-1 from breaking through the Stridergate. This kills her in the process, with her body vanishing from the simulation pod and turning her frequency into a "digital ghost".
The Fractsidus had a hand in weakening the Stridergate, leading to Aemeath's death.

title: Troupe of Fools
Troupe of Fools
content: As the Primus of the Order of the Deep, Fenrico has used the Pilgrim's Sail as a way to banish those he sees as a threat to the Order's goal of achieving unity. Anyone who disobeys or questions the Order and its doctrine are branded 'Fools', and forced to board a ship to Penitent's End, once a sacred spot for pilgrims before being corrupted by the Dark Tide. Although Fools are told they can find redemption and a place beside the Sentinel through this voyage, they are instead subject to the dangers of the Remnant Clouds, a mist that traps Reverberations that turn into Tacet Discord, and the Dragon of Dirge, whom has been altered by the Order with the help of the Fractsidus to attack all living creatures on sight.

title: Troupe of Fools
content:
As a young boy, Brant curiously questioned the appearance of the Sentinel's statue inside the Cathedral of Mercury, and was immediately branded a Fool and sent on the Pilgrim's Sail. While the other Fools on his ship did their best to shield the child from the reality of their fate, he ultimately watched them die one by one. However, they were able to fight against the Tacet Discord and scavenge enough from their shipwreck to build Fool's Elysium, thus beginning the Troupe of Fools.

In addition to establishing a refuge for themselves and patrolling the coast of Penitent's End island in search of new survivors, they have dedicated themselves to performing as they await the return of the Carnevale. There, they hope to expose the Order's lies through a grand performance, and claim the Laurel for the chance to commune with the Sentinel.

title: Troupe of Fools
content: During What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing, the Troupe of Fools fulfill their goal by performing at the Carnevale with Rover, who claims the Laurel. Following the festival, Fenrico grants the troupe permanent rights within Ragunna.

title: Waveworn Phenomenon
content:
}}

Waveworn Phenomenon (Chinese: 海蚀现象, "Coastal Erosion Phenomenon") is a collective term used to describe anomalies caused directly by the influence of The Lament in Solaris-3.  These phenomena can vary in scope from minor distortions to widespread ecological and psychic collapse. They are distinguished by their chaotic nature and the presence of Tacet Discords.

title: Waveworn Phenomenon
content: As noted in Post-Lament Anthropocene: Comprehensive Mirror for Historians, The Lament unleashed waves of destruction that had an "erosive" effect upon Solaris-3. This anomalous "erosion" is not only physical but metaphysical, distorting memory, structure, and causality itself.

title: Waveworn Phenomenon
content: These are the generally identified types of Waveworn Phenomenon in Solaris-3:

title: Waveworn Phenomenon
content: Tacet Discord Outbreak (commonly referred to as a TD Outbreak )  is the sudden emergence of Tacet Discords—sentient beings formed from residual chaotic frequency energy under the Waveworn Phenomenon. During an outbreak, Tacet Discords proliferate in areas with intense frequency distortion, instinctively feeding on surrounding frequencies to evolve. Their amorphous forms and behaviors are shaped by the types of frequencies they consume, often leading to unpredictable mimicry and regional disruption.

title: Waveworn Phenomenon
content: Tacet Fields are a form of geographical Waveworn Phenomenon, and are widely believed to be where all Tacet Discords originate. Reverberations fill the air in these locations, linking the world to an unknown space through a white Resonance Cord. They are identifiable geographic anomalies, marked by the visibility of the Etheric Sea and a large, cross-shaped Tacet Mark stamped into the terrain. Tacetite formations erupt from the ground around the mark, and the area exhibits localized gravitational distortions—ranging from floating debris to warped terrain as depicted in Qichi Village. These zones are typically surrounded by Tacet Discords, which linger near the field's perimeter even during periods of inactivity. In some cases, Retroact Rain can also occur in such areas thus creating Phantoms within the vicinity.

title: Waveworn Phenomenon
content: Tacet Fields form through the convergence of the Etheric Sea and enter an initial Dormant phase of relative stability. Rapid formation often results in a longer Dormant period and the eventual emergence of more powerful Tacet Discords.

title: Waveworn Phenomenon
content: Tacetite is a rare substance discovered during the study of Waveworn Phenomena, known for its ability to permanently contain Remnant Energy. This property makes Tacetite a valuable material for crafting weapons used by Resonators against Tacet Discords. It is most commonly found within transdimensional zones rich in Remnant Energy, known as Sonoro Spheres. They are also occasionally found in clusters around Tacet Fields.

title: Waveworn Phenomenon
content: Gravitational anomalies have been consistently observed in regions affected by Waveworn Phenomena, with notable instances recorded across Solaris-3. Prominent examples include areas within Qichi Village, the Port City of Guixu, Norfall Barrens and the vicinity of Avinoleum.

title: Waveworn Phenomenon
content: First depicted in Chapter I Act V: Rewinding Raindrops, Retroact Rain is a documented Waveworn Phenomenon composed of condensed Remnant Energy originating from the Etheric Sea. Due to the inherent property of Remnant Energy of recording events across time and space, exposure to the rain often triggers vivid illusions of past events. Individuals with strong emotional ties to the affected location are more susceptible to intense hallucinations. While generally non-lethal, Retroact Rain acts as a potent attractor for Tacet Discords due to its high Remnant Energy concentration. The presence of a Threnodian can further amplify the phenomenon’s effects as seen during the Battle Beneath the Crescent with the Threnodian, Ovathrax. Notably, the frequencies of individuals who perish within the Retroact Rain become permanently embedded in the rain itself.
