title: Black Shores
content:
The Black Shores cannot be accessed from any known lands. Only those recognized by the Black Shores or who have received an invitation and guidance can navigate their way to this hidden place. The frequencies from the Tacetite and of the mist distorts human perception and jams all forms of communication, making the archipelago inaccessible to most. Communication with the outside world is only possible via the Black Shores' Beacon relay system.

Members of the Black Shores who operate abroad, frequently traversing various lands, are known as "Consultants". Those stationed at the headquarters are referred to as "Bloom Bearers". Apart from these fundamental duties, the Black Shores also accommodates a plethora of other specialized roles.

title: Black Shores
content:
With a mission to combat the destructive Lament, the Black Shores has fostered strong partnerships with nations across Solaris-3. Though the Black Shores openly shares its advanced technologies with its partners, even its own members remain unaware of the true origins of these innovations.

The organization has a secretive membership process and most members of the organization keep their identities hidden. Their symbol is a Blake Bloom, a Remnant plant with energy from the island and each member wears it on their person. Only those who wear it can step on their soil.

title: Black Shores
content: Talents with sight and knowledge from worldwide, invited to join the Black Shores. They operate abroad, frequently traversing various lands. Though excelling in different expertise, they act with a consensus to counter the threat of the Lament.

title: Black Shores
content: Stationed at the headquarters, Bloom Bearers carry their duties mostly within the territory of the Black Shores. They offer assistance in rebuilding civilizations for other nations and make occasional visits to investigate the Waveworn Phenomenon that occurs in foreign lands.

title: Black Shores
content: In charge of administrative duties such as organizing the information of new candidates.

title: Black Shores
content: A mysterious lifeform that rests beneath the Black Shores' subterranean galaxy. Her physical structure and age are shrouded in mystery. In the complicated coding language of the Tethys System, the name "Shorekeeper" also means "Guardian of Secrets". She chose to call herself "Shorekeeper" to symbolize her role in watching over those who venture away from the shores into faraway lands.

title: Black Shores
content: They have developed a Lament prediction system and have established mutual partnerships with nations worldwide. The Resonance Beacons are set up to monitor the Lament, collecting data in real-time. They use monitoring registers that they had placed around the world to monitor the Sentinels. The TD observatory is used to monitor Tacet Discords across Solaris, it handles collection, storage and transmission of anything related to TDs.

title: Black Shores
content: The Tethys System, also known as the Civilization Simulation Sand Table, is a supercomputer unique to the Black Shores. The Tethys System has no discernible energy source, physical infrastructure, or processing core, but is instead powered entirely by the Tacetite land mass upon which the Black Shores Archipelago was built upon. Its coding language is extremely complex, and it is only known that its terminals take the form of various autonomous robots. In essence, the Tethys System is almost akin to a natural phenomenon, with an origin that remains entirely mysterious. The results generated by the Tethys System are projected as a starry sky within the underground of the Black Shores, made possible by multiple Anchors and underground Data Hubs. This has earned the underground region the title "City of Eternal Night".

title: Black Shores
content:
These unique robots, found throughout the Black Shores, serve as the physical terminals of the Tethys System. Their construction and performance capabilities remain largely unknown, yet they possess direct access to the system, second only to its administrator. Within the Black Shores, these robots function both as assistants and tools in the daily activities of its members.

Each terminal has a distinct personality, and the study of these robots has advanced the field of cognitive psychology.

The KU-robots found all over the island are directly linked to the Tethys System. The Tethys system gives them all their own personalities and voice frequencies are encoded into languages that humans can understand. The robots can be considered a living race of their own.

title: Black Shores
content:
Based on the computational protocols of the Tethys System, the Stellar Matrix is a data package format that functions similarly to a highly compressed file. It has the capacity to store immense amounts of information and even simulate a Lament.

Certain individuals can access these matrices under specific circumstances, making them an integral part of the Tethys System's operational framework. The first member to define a Stellar Matrix noted that standards of observing and evaluating one are similar to the astronomical standards of Solaris-3.

title: Black Shores
content: A type of Stellar Matrix. Inside the Tethys System, a celestial body called Necrostar swallows the faulty data in its wake, a black hole where forsaken Matrices find their end. Even the newfound science of Tacetite could not provide explanations for its fundamental nature, as all are subject to the gravity within it.

title: Black Shores
content: Stabilizing devices called Anchors are strategically positioned throughout the above and underground parts of the Black Shores. Their primary function is to calibrate and stabilize the frequencies of the giant Tacetite that makes up the island, effectively isolating the Tethys System's virtual layer from reality. Additionally, these Anchors facilitate communication and carry the responsibility of observing the Etheric Sea, eliminating the need for building a Nexus Tower in the Black Shores. The Anchors are independently developed and designed by the Black Shores, drawing inspiration from the reactor control rods used in pre-Lament reactor engineering. They are considered exemplary models of the Black Shores' minimalist engineering design.

title: Black Shores
content: Modulation is the process of adjusting frequencies. In Solaris-3, frequencies serve as a crucial tool for uncovering the truth about reality. By altering these frequencies, one can delve into the very core of existence. At the Black Shores, modulating Stellar Matrices, collection of stars, is crucial for tracing and analyzing the Lament. Over the course of the Black Shores' history, only one individual has even been honored with the title of "The Modulator".

title: Brant
Brant/Backstory
content: Brant has a boundless passion and theatrical flair, embodying both the performer and the dreamer in equal measure. As the captain of Rinascita’s Troupe of Fools, he thrives in chaos, reveling in the unpredictable nature of both the stage and life itself. His charisma is effortless; larger than life yet never insincere. He is a free spirit who dances between the whimsical and the profound, unafraid to embrace the absurd yet always carrying a quiet depth beneath his exuberance.

title: Brant/Backstory
content: Brant’s romantic nature extends beyond love; he is enamored with the world itself, seeing beauty in every fleeting moment. He believes that life, like a performance, should be embraced fully: boldly, passionately, and without restraint. He slips effortlessly into roles, crafting illusions with his words and presence, yet when the curtain falls, he is remarkably genuine. His loyalty to his troupe and those he cares for is steadfast, and while he may jest and tease, his warmth is undeniable. Though he appears carefree, he is a man who carries his own burdens in silence, choosing to shoulder them with a smile rather than darken the spirits of those around him.

His shoulders are adorned in black and gold pauldrons with many layers beneath them including a light blue layer with a bright fuchsia pattern repeating 3 times. Under that is a white layer with golden anchor shaped pins on both his left and right with jewelry strung in between them along with being adorned with frilly white and pale blue sleeves adorn with golden patterning and engravings and various belts and extensions. He wears long black fingerless with red straps near the wrists that cover up his forearms along with a red and black cape. Brant also white trousers with a double crossed belt and black boots with golden laces.

title: Buling
Buling
content:
In Chinese voice-overs in the main story, a part of Buling's line are spoken in .
(Chinese: 卜 bǔ) is a Chinese surname. When used as a noun, it means "prophecy or prediction."  When used as a verb, it means "to divine, to predict."
During the Shang and Zhou dynasties, the Chinese referred to divination using tortoise shells as "卜" Later, this term became a general term for various forms of divination, although tortoise shells are not always necessary for divination.
(Simplified Chinese: 灵 líng) is the simplified form of (Traditional Chinese: 靈 líng) meaning "supernatural beings, roughly equivalent to gods or spirits."
Because "卜" and "不" (meaning "not") are homophones in Chinese, the name "Buling" has a wordplay in Chinese, which can be humorously expressed as "不灵" (bù líng), meaning that the diviner's divination did not work, or it can be extended to mean that a specific thing is ineffective. This is related to the setting in the game where her ability sometimes causes her to be struck by lightning.

title: Buling/Backstory
content:
City's Main Street, a stall owner was still scrolling through forums when a girl with fiery red hair stopped at her stand. She glanced up over her slipping glasses and smiled.  "Hey there, boss. Want to try something? Exorcisms, talisman readings, fortune-telling… You name it, I 'bling'—wait, you're a ?"  "That's right! Chixia, !" Chixia straightened with pride at being recognized, then quickly regained her serious tone. "I've had reports about you setting up a stall without permission, offering readings to anyone who walks by. It's almost like—"  "A scam?" Buling's grin didn't waver.  "…I wouldn't go that far. But I'd appreciate it if you came by the  to give a statement about your… business."  "Aiya, Boss, it's all honest work, building good bonds lah. Take that young fellow from  who came yesterday morning. He asked me to divine his research project. By now, I'd wager he's on his way here to thank me."  "Seriously?" Chixia began to question, but before she could finish, a young man in a lab coat came hurrying up the street and stopped at the stall.  "Thank you, Master! My experiment finally succeeded—the data fit perfectly! I can finally publish a paper!"  "No need to thank me," Buling said, waving him off. "That was all your hard work and persistence paying off."  Under Chixia's astonished gaze, the researcher bowed his thanks several more times before hurrying away.  "He just needed a little more confidence in his research, that's all," Buling said, nudging her round glasses back into place.  All afternoon, Chixia tailed this suspicious stall owner as she guided a  courier anxious about the career, sold a prosperity talisman to a travelling merchant, and read a local's palm for signs of love. Each request was different, Buling's answers just as varied, yet every customer left looking satisfied.  By sunset, Buling began packing up her stall. She glanced toward the shade of a nearby tree and called out, "Relax. I've earned enough for now, so no more stalls for a while. And I'm starving. How about dinner at your auntie's place? My treat. But just so you know that I'm not ordering anything spicy."  "Wait—how do you even know Mrs. Panhua is my… Did you divine that too?" Chixia stepped out of the shadows.  "Oh, that?" Buling grinned. "She told me herself. Over lunch."  Not long after, 's wandering Taoist Buling and Jinzhou's famed Speedster Chixia would team up to tackle a so-called haunting event on Main Street. But that, of course, is another story.

|title2   = The Way of Flexibility
|text2    = Thick clouds smothered the moonlight that night, plunging the world into darkness.  "It's right there, Master!"  At his young disciple's cry, the aged Taoist shaped a quick mudra with one hand and leveled his peachwood sword with the other. Golden light leapt from the blade, streaking toward the corner of a wall. It struck something unseen, flared outward, and flooded the alley with daylight-bright radiance—revealing a Whisperin  crouched in the shadows.  His eyes flicked to his disciple. She had already drawn a talisman and begun her chant: "Body and seal align, thunder at command… All evils, repelled!"  The words had barely left her lips when a bolt of lightning split the sky, crashing down upon the Tacet Discord. Wrapped in thunderlight, the creature began to fade. Though her talisman was already spent, the girl stayed on guard, fishing a copper coin from her pocket as she stepped closer.  "…Finally… home…"  The broken whisper froze her in place.  "Pull yourself together, Buling," came her master's deep, steady voice. "A Tacet Discord is nothing but a monster. It's no ghost, and certainly nothing human." She nodded, flicked the coin into the air, and another flash of lightning cleaved the darkness. The Tacet Discord vanished completely. The old Taoist's furrowed brow eased as he turned toward the house, whose gates were tightly shut.  Three measured knocks. The door creaked open, and a silver-haired elder stepped out.  "Master, was it really… my son who returned?"  It was Buling's first time following her master down the mountain to "exorcise a ghost." On their way back to the sect, she couldn't help but ask, "Master, you always say there are no such things as ghosts. So why tell that lady her son's spirit came home to see her? And even pass along a message for her to live well?" "…That's called the Way of Flexibility. Someday, you'll understand." "Mm… Seems the world beyond the mountain really does hold a lot to see." "Heh… when you're strong enough to stand on your own and want to travel alone, then go," he said, grinning up at the endless stars. "Cultivation isn't confined to our temple's four walls. Your world should be far wider than this."  At that, Buling's clear eyes filled with the same bright starlight.  "…But if you ever stir up trouble out there," Master Jiufeng added quickly, "don't speak of my name."
|mention2 = Jiufeng

|title3   = Peers of Different Sects
|text3    = That year's Martial Arts Championship took place on a lone peak straddling the border of  and . The nearest edge of the  was still a hundred miles away or so, yet martial art sects from across the world flocked to the mountain. Rumor had it that even a reclusive master from Xuanfang might descend to watch.  "Hehe, my disciple's a straightforward child, only knows how to throw punches. So please, tell yours to go easy on her," Master Shiling stroked his long beard and smiled. "Ah, I heard that the Fengyiquan Sect is full of talent, and Jianxin is undoubtedly unmatched. My own disciple just toys with coins and talismans, hardly worth anyone's attention," Master Jiufeng wasn't about to be outdone.  On the ring, Buling and Jianxin faced each other.  "Did you hear that, Jianxin? They're basically dueling through us," Buling whispered. "Maybe we should just qui—" "Understood," Jianxin was already in Fengyiquan's Calming Air stance. "Let's face this match with the respect it deserves. After you."  Buling sighed and formed her hand mudras. Against Jianxin's flawless technique, she would only get one shot. Her Casket of Fate burst open—talismans whirled like a storm, lightning split the sky, and the Five Thunders Spell Array snapped shut around Jianxin. A breath later, Jianxin surged forward. Wind and cloud followed her fists. In the next instant, talismans shattered and the array crumbled. By the third breath, her fist hovered at Buling's side.  "Well fought, Buling. Another round?" Jianxin said, bowing as she stepped back. "No need. I quit." Buling raised her hand in surrender.  Later, Buling found a good spot in the stands, munching on New Federation popcorn as she watched the young martial artists clash. Jianxin tore through her opponents like a gale, already closing in on the reigning champion.  "Why did you hold back?"  The voice was cool and clear. Buling jumped, as she hadn't even heard anyone approach. A white-robed woman sat nearby, a guqin in her arms, her expression serene and detached, nothing like an ordinary martial artist.  "If you triggered the talismans behind her, the match might have gone differently."  "I wasn't thinking that far ahead at the time… Master," Buling answered with an awkward laugh.  The woman simply nodded. She said nothing more, only stayed beside Buling and watched the rest of the matches in silence.
|mention3 = Shiling, Jiufeng, Jianxin

|title4   = Earthly Immortal, Heavenly Sheep
|text4    = Buling made friends with Encore on an unexpected occasion.  Back then, she had just passed Camellya's test and arrived at  archipelago for the first time as a Consultant. The Gardener who welcomed her mentioned a bit of gossip: people in the Haven of Sprouts had been whispering about faint, sorrowful female cries haunting the dorm at midnight.  It wasn't serious enough to count as an emergency that required proper investigation, probably just a stray Reverberation rambling around. Still, on an island carved from a massive Tacetite, even a random Reverberation could twist into a dangerous . Someone had to check it out. Buling, known for her sharp ear for these things, volunteered.  That night, she waited in the dorm corridor, scrolling forums to pass the time as she heard soft footsteps. When she looked up, she nearly dropped her device: two "Wooly Ghost Guards" of black and white stood before her with ferocious looks.  "Hooray! The brave Wooly Warriors have found a new team member," a cheerful voice said. Encore poked her head out from behind the plush toys, grinning.  The truth turned out to be simple: a  Terminal in the Haven had picked up an old cassette of ghost stories. A faulty signal module accidentally broadcast it over the dorm speakers, and thus the "haunting" event.  By morning, a post went viral on the Black Shores' internal forum with its eye-catching title: "Turns out, the creepy midnight cries coming from the Haven of Sprouts are actually..."  The poster ID was "Earthly Immortal," and the first enthusiastic reply came from "Heavenly Sheep."  That was the day the now-famous mystery-busting duo was born. From the Black Shores to  and , "Earthly Immortal" and "Heavenly Sheep" became legends by exposing hoaxes, chasing rumors, and unraveling every supposed haunting that crossed their path.  Whenever people ask Buling why she chose to join the Black Shores, she just laughs it off. Her bestie Encore, however, always gives the same teasing answer: "She thinks if the Black Shores can clear all the 'ghosts' in the world, then she'll finally be free to roam wherever she wants!"
|mention4 = Encore, Camellya

title: Calaris
content: Calaris is an open-world NPC who appears inside the Order of the Deep's Cathedral of Mercury, Ragunna. She's a novice Acolyte and currecntly she's studying Order doctrines.<!--

title: Calaris
content: Calaris: O water... O ocean, you are all water...

title: Calaris
content:
[Objective: (First Interaction)]
Calaris: O water... O ocean, you are all water...
[Dialogue Option]  What are you reciting?
Calaris: It's from the Order scripture, Codex of the Deep. Though, that verse I quoted just now... I made it up; it's not in the codex...
[Dialogue Option]  O Sentinel, O Sentinel, you—
Calaris: Wait! I made up that verse! It's not actually in Codex of the Deep.
Calaris: My name is Calaris. I recently joined the Order as a novice Acolyte and am studying Order doctrines...
Calaris: The doctrines hold that our world was once an immense ocean, separated by the Sentinel to provide a dwelling for humanity.
Calaris: The earthly world was once an immensely deep, boundless ocean where we drifted. Guided by the Sentinel's will, we strive to ascend... hence, the Order's name, Order of the Deep.
Calaris: Look, the teachings of the Order are mostly related to water—this is quite understandable.
Calaris: The people of Ragunna City live alongside the water, resting upon it as they sleep, yet often needing to confront the threat of the tides.
Calaris: Therefore, whether out of love or fear, the people of Ragunna ultimately hold an attitude of reverence towards water.
Calaris: But this The Final Tide... what does it mean, exactly...
Calaris: People performed rituals, praying to the Sentinel—not only to calm the raging tides but to lead humanity across The Final Tide...
Calaris: And some of the stories about the Blessed Maiden... They don't match what I've heard from older folks...
Calaris: Oh, so much to learn. I must not have trained enough...

title: Calcharo/Backstory
content: Due to the many betrayals, hardships, loss, competition that has plagued him since his early years, Calcharo is an aloof, serious, but determined man who displays experiences through his speech and fights. His fierce reputation as a mercenary has garnered attention from many people from internationally and also generated absurd and exaggerated rumors about him. Calcharo's is a committed mercenary who tries to ensure satisfaction for both parties, in exchange for what he deems a fair price.

title: Calcharo/Backstory
content: His past also makes him resentful towards any form of betrayal and promises that he will come back to the ones who initiates the act, providing any potential threats he could do to any of them. He is also untrusting and bitter as a result of his experiences as well, he was initially cautious of Jiyan during their first interaction and is very hostile towards nobles of the New Federation as seen on his "About Mortefi" dialogue saying that they are pretentious, arrogant and snooty like the former. However, overall, Calcharo has shown to be able to be a kind man, shown where he only charges 1 Shell Credit whenever the dealer is poor, he also cares for his group as he secretly watches them to ensure they are safe upon leaving, and giving rare seeds to Verina, demonstrating that despite his hostile background, Calcharo is still capable of merits.

title: Camellya
Camellya
content:
Camellia is a genus of flowering plants native to Asia.
In Japan, the Japanese camellia's blooming in early spring is said to symbolize resilience. On the other hand, flowers falling off is likened to a "beheaded samurai's head".
Due to Camellya's unique Rabelle's Curve pattern, she is currently speculated to be an Artificial Resonator, as indicated in her Forte Examination Report.
The name Camellya belonged to a separate character during pre-release. While the name now belongs to this character, the visual appearance of the pre-release Camellya seems to have been instead given to Carlotta.

title: Camellya/Backstory
content: At Camellya's core, she is someone who seeks entertainment and fun for her own amusement. In contrast to her fellow Black Shore members, Camellya views her employment as an obligation and little else. She is a hedonist that has a great joy for finding those she considers "promising seeds", and hunts them down to sate her pleasure in battle. She extends this interest in not just recruits the Tethys System considers as candidates, but also civilians and criminals. Being willing to attack them in an attempt to see if they hold the potential to catch her eye, being extremely joyful if they hold promise and laughs at their potential strength when challenging her back. Though if they are lacking in a specific trait, she considers them a lost cause and loses interest through boredom. At the same time, if her expectations are shot when they show fear, she ruthlessly kills them with no regret - although this seems to extend primarily towards criminals she fights.

title: Camellya/Backstory
content: As such, for those she does find an interest in, like the Rover, Camellya feels joyful and satisfied at the thought of someone she considers a worthy opponent. Ignoring personal space while at the same time observes from a distance, with Camellya admitting she can only trust the Rover and nobody else, including herself. Becoming joyful when she and the Rover discover that they're always fated to meet. However, this causes Camellya to hold great expectations towards them, where should she defeat the Rover, whom she sees as stronger than her, it produces a mental breakdown that she considers a nightmare until she's snapped out of it.

title: Camellya/Backstory
content: Camellya also has a great displeasure towards those she deem weak, which includes herself whenever she falls ill to her Overclock symptoms. She is also confused by those such as the Shorekeeper or Jinhsi, who are constantly dedicated towards their duties, feeling they are burdening themselves over such complications. Finding responsibilities and ideals as a false high that are all lies, and that one should live in the present in order to live. With Camellya even describing her actions as nothing more but instincts as animals and plants possess. Even so, despite Camellya's dislike towards any form of responsibility, as all things die in the end, she holds respect towards the Shorekeeper who helped her many times in the past, thus continues her duties as a Bloom Bearer for the Black Shores.

title: Camellya/Backstory
content: As Lady Flora, Camellya's past-self, she holds almost the exact same traits as her present-self including her interest in the Rover, considering them a friend, and shadowed them wherever they went. Though while Lady Flora may have similar traits as her present-day self, such as holding a disdain for the weak, and enjoying battle with those who hold promise, Lady Flora is described as being more sentimental by the present Camellya, as Lady Flora was hurt when the Rover decided to erase their memories of everything. Lady Flora also held an attachment to her adopted home, Petalfall Village. While she had seen them as weak crybabies, Lady Flora did her best to save the villagers when they were under threat as a favor for taking her in when she had lost all memories.  And despite claiming she didn't care for them after the event, different timeline junctures reveal that depending on the outcome of her former home's fate, Lady Flora's personality could have changed greatly.

title: Camellya/Backstory
content: After the Rover left, realizing she would not get better from her Overclocking symptoms, Lady Flora declared that she'd rather die than becoming a helpless weakling, and feared the idea of gaining the Rover's affection and love from pity in such a state. As such, she chose to seal her own memory to stabilize her health, something her present-day self, Camellya, agrees with and claims that she won't bother searching for Lady Flora's memories unless they reappear naturally.

title: Camellya/Backstory
content: Camellya is a short young woman with white hair with black streaks worn in twintails. Her eyes are dark gray with red diamond-shaped pupils. She wears a short ruffled dress, which is mostly white, with red, gold, and black accents. Camellya has asymmetrical white stockings, with her left leg being almost completely covered, while her right leg only has what looks like a string of flower-shaped fabric wrapped around it. She has black flowers (the Blake Blooms) all over her design, symbolizing the connection with Black Shores. Her Tacet Mark is centered on her chest and surrounded by four petal-like protuberances which are one of the mutations resulting from her Forte. Other mutations include long curly vines with small buds and blossoms, growing from Camellya's head (roughly from the bases of her pigtails), and a bracelet-like ring of vines growing from and around her wrist. During her combat animations, these mutations expand and grow additional vines and blossoms, which Camellya uses to attack enemies or suspend herself in the air.

title: Camellya/Backstory
content: When using her Forte, her hair and eyes turns red, and she has white flower-shaped pupils.

title: Cameron
content: Cameron is a male NPC who appears in  at 18:00-05:59. It's implied he may be a Resonator that can peer into and "craft" dreams for others.

title: Cameron
content:
[Objective: (From the people sleeping nearby)]
;Knox I love you... but I can only see you in my dreams...
;Knox Look at our daughter... how adorable s he is... Marina
;Knox Can I see her one last time, please... Why... Why can't I see her face clearly...
;Knox Marina... Marina...?

;Gideon I get what you're saying... but I want a No. 65 Tubpup with Nuvola Pasta...
;Gideon It's so deep... It's all Troupe Strength in the Tubpup... I can't drink anymore...
;Gideon Too much Tubpup... bad for your health...

;Todd Ragunna... the false Righteous One... cloaked in divinity, divinity... hmm...
;Todd Father... Mother... It's me, Todd... Did you like my performance...?
;Todd Don't cry... I'm here... I'm home...

title: Cameron
content:
Cameron: Can't sleep either?
[Dialogue Option]  What's keeping you up?
Cameron: As you can see, it's only when I'm fully awake that I can "craft" their dreams.
[Dialogue Option]  What kind of dreams do you craft?
Cameron: Hmm… it varies, really. Most of the time, I create beautiful visions to heal the regrets that weigh on their hearts.
Cameron: But, from what I've seen, the fear of "boarding the Fool's Sail" appears to be so deeply rooted that the dreams don't always turn out as they hoped.
[Dialogue Option]  What are their regrets?
Cameron: Todd, hailing from an underground theater troupe, was banished merely for using comedy to satirize the Order's tax policies...
Cameron: Gideon's family was framed by the Acolytes. At his lowest, he could only find solace with a Tubpup. It became his shelter, his only home in the storm.
Cameron: Knox was sent aboard the Fool's Sail before his newborn child even had a chance to open their eyes. And as kin of a "heretic," the future doesn't look kind.
[Dialogue Option]  So that's how it is...
Cameron: During this Carnevale, we all have to hide our identities and take on roles in the Fool's Troupe as we return to Ragunna City, after so long.
Cameron: We must suppress our desire to reconnect with old friends while trying to complete the Montelli family's mission. It's... complicated. So insomnia, I suppose, is inevitable.
Cameron: That's why I need to create dreams for them, to help them get some rest.
[Dialogue Option]  Why do you hide your true identities?
Cameron: Well, the Order doesn't know... but most of the Fool's Troupe are survivors from the Pilgrim's Sail.
Cameron: The moment the Order uncovers the truth, our Fool's Elysium will burn to the ground. We have to keep our silence, no matter the cost.
Cameron: In our plays, we sing to condemn the oppression, to shed light on the bloodshed… One day, all of Rinascita will know what Fenrico has done.
[Dialogue Option]  Take a break when you feel ready.
Cameron: Thank you… for taking the time to understand us, for wanting to know the Fools' story.

title: Cameron
content:
Cameron: You're here again.
[Dialogue Option]  Crafting dreams again?
Cameron: More and more people can't fall asleep these days.
Cameron: It's already a struggle to accept being sent to the Pilgrim's Sail... and just when they finally made peace with it, the Dark Tide rose.
Cameron: Those who thought they could live in the present—accepting what fate dealt them—found their regrets surging back to the surface.
Cameron: I can't do much for them. But at the very least, I can give them one good night's sleep.
[Dialogue Option]  But that means you'll sleep less yourself.
Cameron: Fenrico's vanished. The Blessed Maiden has returned. And we're staring down an entirely new chapter.
Cameron: With so much happening, people are drowning in news and uncertainty, unsure where their lives are headed.
Cameron: I'm no different. So, to live in the present with a clear mind... That, to me, is a blessing in itself.

title: Cantarella
Cantarella
content: Her name may be derived from the term cantarella, a poison allegedly used by a Spanish royal family during the Italian Renaissance.

title: Cantarella/Backstory
content:
Cantarella is a tall woman with a fair skin tone. She has vibrant blue eyes and lavender hair with light blue accents.

Her tacet mark is located on the top side of her tongue.

title: Cantarella/Backstory
content: Cantarella's personality is a tapestry of contradictory threads. Her bearing is poised and elegant, her unruffled calm unbroken even when discussing unsettling topics. She is mysterious and alluring, her beauty "captivating as it is dangerous", and her eyes "as deep as the ocean". Her skill and intellect are evident in her sophisticated command of her Forte and her ability to make complex elixirs, with the knowledge that "any situation can be resolved with the proper steps at the proper time". Her philosophical and reflective insight is constantly examining the nature of dreams, reality, and the human spirit.

title: Cantarella/Backstory
content:
Beneath this, Cantarella has a nurturing and protective instinct, albeit expressed through her own unique filter of poisons and illusions. She offers solutions to others and wants them to be at peace, albeit in unusual ways. This nurturing is offered to Rover, who she sees as an "immortal jellyfish" banishing shadows with a "gentle light", a grounding force giving her "peace and happiness".

She can also be teasing and playful, with a morbid sense of humor, as seen in her gruesome suggestions for creating elixirs or her challenge to "touch" the jellyfish, but this playful façade has a tendency to conceal an inner vulnerability and traumatic history, as suggested by her "irreparable damage" and the "whispers" that tormented her family. Her desire for "a breath of fresh air above the surface" speaks of a deep longing to be free from her stifling past.

Fisalia Apothecary Rosemary's Examination Record: Special Edition Approved by the Family Head

It is clear that the current head of the Fisalia family, Lady Cantarella, represents the pinnacle of the family's poison-related Forte. It is a great honor to have been invited to the castle to conduct her checkup, as well as to have been granted unrestricted access to the garden of Porto-Veno Castle for research purposes.

title: Cantarella/Backstory
content:
Lady Cantarella's ability is a rare form of hallucinogenic toxin, distinct from the more commonly seen lethal poisons found within the family. Unlike typical poisons, this toxin does not cause immediate death. When swarms of jellyfish emerge from her parasol, an exquisite sea of illusions forms around her. The poisoned individual will first experience hallucinations, perhaps of their deepest desires or crafted illusions. Should they linger too long within this sea, paralysis will set in, followed by unconsciousness, and ultimately, if the effects persist, death.

Lady Cantarella's control over her ability is nothing short of masterful. At its most refined, she can induce hallucinations without causing any physical harm.

title: Cantarella/Backstory
content:
Although such power is a double-edged sword, often causing harm to the user as well, Lady Cantarella's graceful and composed manner suggests she is not overly affected by the "Dreams." Or so it seems… perhaps?

Note: Lady Cantarella is well aware of her abilities. It's a rare exception that she allowed me to examine her. To be honest, that makes me a little nervous… I hope I didn't make any mistakes.

title: Carlotta
Carlotta/Backstory
content: Carlotta is an independent and ambitious girl, who won't stop until she achieves what she has her sights set on. On the outside, she is mysterious and may seem merciless, but in reality, she is quite kind. The girl is also adaptable, acting and behaving on the accord of her surroundings. Carlotta is a bold strategist, and efficient worker, always calculating and pragmatic before acting. The Montelli's daughter perfectly balances poise and power.

title: Carlotta/Backstory
content: Carlotta is a young woman who has long, flowing silver-white hair that cascades past her shoulders. Her eyes are a vibrant mix of pink and teal. Carlotta wears a striking and elaborate outfit that blends elegance with a touch of edge. She wears a short, white, sleeveless dress with a high neckline, embellished with lace and delicate patterns, creating a soft, flowing silhouette. Over this, she has a vibrant, magenta-colored cape with intricate designs, trimmed with blue on the inside, and it flows behind her, adding drama to her appearance. The outfit is accentuated with a fitted black corset-style bodice that enhances her figure and introduces a gothic flair. Her legs are clad in thigh-high black boots with bold pink stockings, that feature blue and magenta details, combining femininity with a hint of toughness and underneath her dress is a short black shorts. She accessorizes with black gloves, ornate jewelry, and a magenta head band with ribbons adorned on it.

|vo_02_02_tx                 = Long ago, I witnessed a storm that I will never forget. The air was suffocating, damp, and tinged with a faint, rusty odor. I stood there in silence, feeling utterly helpless. Since that day, I've faced many more storms. Instead of retreating, I choose to walk into the rain, seeking justice before it can wash away all the blood and pain. Now that I think about it, perhaps it wasn't the rain itself I loathed, but what it brought with it. After all, it's difficult to hold onto one's dignity in a downpour, and in those moments, we all reveal parts of ourselves we'd rather keep hidden.

Fleur-de-lys (more commonly spelt fleur-de-lis) is a common type of stylized heraldic charge shaped like a lily flower, described as "at one and the same time, religious, political, dynastic, artistic, emblematic, and symbolic".

title: Cartethyia/Backstory
content: Deep inside, Cartethyia used to be a "rambunctious girl" from the countryside Egla Town, characterized by a free and mischievous spirit. Behind this fanciful exterior, however, was a "heart of pure nobility," as evidenced in her childhood aspiration of a knight fighting a giant windmill, envisioning not fantasy but a noble quest. This naive indignation and spontaneous urge to right wrongs set the stage for her later, more profound, commitments. Her life motto, "The truth is a beacon in the maelstrom of my life", encapsulates her unwavering search for clarity and authenticity amidst turmoil. Chosen by God, a role which many questioned since she had neither noble blood nor discipline, she was compelled to daunting responsibility with her rise to Fleurdelys, the "Blessed Maiden." As Fleurdelys, she was a source of hope and protection for Rinascita, zealously studying scriptures, training in martial arts, and listening to the lamentations of the people, actively endeavoring to bring about what they wished for, though this was an internal conflict for her because she believed all should be somber and tranquil, and she had witnessed the Order's failings and the self-serving of the nobility, which planted doubt, disruption, and disillusionment. This enforced seriousness and disillusionment with the system she served showcase her struggle to reconcile her actual, vibrant personality with the solemn expectations piled upon her.

title: Cartethyia/Backstory
content: Cartethyia's torn nature is traced to her origins: she was formed through the Threnodian's curse and malice, a "malicious creation" which ironically had her wear the crown of the Blessed Maiden. This natural connection to both the destructive Threnodian and the protective Sentinel indicates she possesses great, volatile power. This combination is not a weakness but a unique strength, permitting her "Second Awakening" to change at will between two forms, a reflection of her precise mastery of these opposing powers. Her journey in becoming a wandering knight is one of self-reclamation and profound acceptance; Following a long period of being lost and confused in the Inverted Tower, she began stitching dolls and inventing stories, piecing together her fragmented memories and identity bit by bit. Cartethyia realized that the essential thing was "what had to be done at that specific moment," not in regrets for a lost past, and this realization led her to embrace her current self as Cartethyia, a "free and unfettered wandering knight", no longer bound to the name of Fleurdelys. She actively dreams of being a "nameless guardian", living her childhood dream of a justice knight who rides away anonymously after fighting injustice. Cartethyia's relationships also reveal her personality.

title: Cartethyia/Backstory
content: She shares a deep bond with the Rover, considering them a "Swordbearer" and a "Godkiller" who gave her the chance of a different ending to her story. She reads their mutual frequencies as the formation of a powerful bond, promising to be Rover's "sword and faithful companion", and her empathy is extended to others as well, seen in her feeling of indebtedness to Cantarella for the future she "took away" and in her appreciation of Phoebe's kind heart, which makes it difficult to expose foreboding realities. She is reverent of Carlotta's fresh thought and possesses unquestioning acceptance in Lupa, an older sister attitude despite physical stature. Cartethyia's personality is an active equilibrium of her inherent spiritedness, the profound burdens she encountered, and her ultimate triumph at forging her own path. She is resilient, having survived the "maelstrom" of her life and the "turmoil in Rinascita" with unbending determination, and is shown to be fiercely compassionate, always choosing "to save", even when her origins might otherwise dictate.

title: Cartethyia/Backstory

Thinner black straps fasten the front and back of the dress as well as around her upper chest, and small blue vines are wrapped around her back and chest. Cartethyia wears open, frilled sleeves attached by blue strings draped around her elbows, whose ends transition from white to bright blue and feature golden, double-helix vine patterns.

title: Celestials
content:
The Celestials  are a conclave of Court of Savantae architects, artisans, and engineers who serve Sentinel Hsin by servicing, maintaining, and protecting Xuanfang Hold's modular mechanisms in secrecy.

Overseen by Hsin herself, they work and live in isolated sub-divisions across the multivarious regions of the Hold's Manifold Sanctum, with a prominent group based in the village of Mengxuan Vale in the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou.

Within the Simulacrum Nexus, their daily duties often consist of engineering work on its internal mechanisms and Inner Thresholds through the use of piloting Artisan Autopuppets.

title: Celestials
content: Existing as living, disembodied frequencies embedded in Xuanfang Hold's core by Sentinel Hsin, the Celestials are members of the Court of Savantae who sacrificed their physical bodies as part of a contract with Hsin during the Fortress and Gorges War, intended as a way for Hsin to maintain the secrets of the Hold's technology from Solaris-3, due to Hsin fearing the dangers of advanced Sentinel technology being left in the hands of human civilization.

title: Celestials
content: The Celestials are eternally preserved frequencies whose origins date back to the Fortress and Gorges War in Huanglong, over 200 years ago. In response to the growing threat of the Threnodian Ovathrax's assault on the border, Hsin called a meeting at the Mengzhou City Hall between Zhuojun Atelier and the Mengzhou sect of the Court of Savantae in order to determine which of the two were best fit to lead the construction of Xuanfang Hold, which was conceptualized as a bastion for Xuanfang civilians to establish both a shelter and base of operations for the war effort. Hsin organized the meeting with Balanophora, disguised as the then-Intendant of Sentinel Affairs, and overheard arguments from delegates of each group's congregation.

title: Celestials
content: After hearing from each faction, with the Atelier staging their argument on the basis that they were most fit to construct the Hold due to their knowledge of the local region, and the Court arguing that they were most equipped to closely study the advanced machinoform technologies of the Sentinel, Hsin ultimately chose the Court to lead the construction, and formed a contract with their organization.

title: Celestials
content: In truth, Hsin had already made her decision prior to the meeting, and was questioned by Balanophora regarding why she held the meeting despite this. Hsin explained that her goals were twofold; The first being that it was a public gesture of good faith meant to show the public that Mengzhou City Hall had a plan for the war, and the second being to confirm her fears of the Court being the true underlying threat out of the two factions. This was due to their dangerous thirst for knowledge potentially begetting an ulterior motive, which she sought to reign in ahead of time. The meeting with the Court's delegation was used to confirm her theory that that they would agree to sacrifice themselves in order to uphold the secrets of Hold from mortal eyes in exchange for being able to study the Sentinel's blueprint for the Hold, laying the foundations for what later became the Celestials.

title: Celestials
content: However, tragically, Balanophora followed Hsin to her quarters at the City Hall later that evening and attempted to assassinate Hsin, seizing the moment after years of lying in wait to conspire to kill her and sabotage Mengzhou's Civilization Capsule. The assassination would prove unsuccessful in the short-term, but left Hsin fatally wounded, with her energy destitute, weakened, and unable to recover, jeopardizing Xuanfang Hold's plans at its onset. Using a portion of her remaining energy, Hsin, the Moon Fox split herself into two fractal forms to uphold different aspects of her goals for Xuanfang Hold; Hsin and Suhsin.

title: Celestials
content: Hsin acted as an embodiment of the Moon Fox's humanity and emotions, entrusted with carrying out the Hold's construction with the Court of Savantae, while converting them into Celestials, while Suhsin was born as a logic algorithm who was entrusted with the duty of carrying out Xuanfang Hold's eventual collapse following the war. Hsin was also bade to ensure the repair of the Mengzhou Civilization Capsule, as a result of the damage it sustained from the Fractsidus's attacks following their attempt on the Moon Fox's life.

title: Celestials
content: Hsin initially dutifully carried out the Hold's construction alongside the Court's teams of architects, while also purging the Fractsidus's corruption from the Civilization Capsule that caused Tacet Discords to attempt to sabotage the project. However, as a result of Hsin inadvertently draining the Moon Fox's last vestiges of energy to restore the Civilization Capsule and preserve it beyond its intended expiration date, the Moon Fox eventually succumbed to her injuries from the assassination.

title: Celestials
content: In response to the growing construction of Xuanfang Hold, however, Ovathrax began a strategic intensification of the war that destructively ravaged the entire region in an attempt to destabilize the construction of the Hold. This would force Hsin's hand, as she rallied a war effort across the region consisting of forces from the newly established Jinzhou, Autopuppets, Court of Savantae artisans, and Xuanfang Wardens, who attempted to stave off the Threnodian's forces through a combination of counterattacks, humanitarian efforts, and wartime strategy. However, Ovathrax's forces resisted, overwhelming Xuanfang as Tacet Discord hordes began closing in on greater Mengzhou.

title: Celestials
content: Finally answering their call of action, a team of Court of Savantae artisans and troops partnered together in order to sacrifice themselves to trigger the self-destruction of Yuan Fortress' core, including Ruoyun, driving out the bulk of Ovathrax's forces in the region. Many Court artisans lost their life in this detonation, leading to Hsin personally carrying out the work of elevating each member's frequency into a Celestial- even visiting Court artisans like Ruoyun in their dying moments to console them.

title: Celestials
content: The Celestials, like Xuanfang Hold itself, survived the war in spirit, with their frequencies bound to the Hold as part of their contract to ensure its continued operations. Due to Hsin defying the Moon Fox's orders to collapse Xuanfang Hold, she would engage in a clandestine tug-of-war over her authority with her counterpart for the remaining two centuries. Gradually, she lost her authority and strength as she split her energy to preserve the Celestials' collective individuality across each of its members, while fending off Suhsin's growing coup, who severed herself from Hsin's authority outright.

title: Celestials
content: Suhsin violently besieged the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou, in an effort to use the Nexus Fox Shadow to carry out her original protocols, terrorizing many Celestials and remnant memories alike across the Simulacrum Nexus and its branching Heart Realms with a hostile army of rogue Autopuppets created by her; including units such as Formrenders, Soulfrayers, Skywatch Lancers, Bloomburst Puppets, and Jade Nether Serpents. Many Celestials lost their sanity to Suhsin's attacks across the Simulacrum Nexus destabilizing their essence, leading to them becoming Anomalies.

title: Celestials
content: This chaos eventually ended with the arrival of Rover and Suoming, who worked together to locate and free Hsin, before overthrowing Suhsin and reclaiming both Hsin's authority, along with her control over the Nexus Fox Shadow. Hsin made peace with Suhsin after defeating her alongside Rover and Suoming, and Suhsin found herself moved by Hsin's plea for her to let go of her misanthropic outlook towards the Celestials and humanity's preservation in the Sanctum, instead encouraging her to trust in her faith that the endurance and perseverance of the human condition exhibited by the Celestials was proof enough to maintain their existence.

title: Changli
Changli/Backstory
content:
Changli appears to be a woman of warm taste, she is a patient, and deeply calculated strategist who presents a gentle, warm exterior while hiding a piercingly sharp mind. As the former Secretary-General of the capital and current Counselor to Jinhsi, she acts as a master coordinator who operates like a grandmaster playing a game of chess, using her understanding of human nature to outmaneuver what she does.

Besides her soft demeanor, she lies a chilling level of perception, treating Jinzhou generals and ordinary citizens with equal kindness, always maintaining a gentle smile. while creating traps to any threat. She also possesses an absolute sense of integrity regarding her word in forms of bringing justice after having quite a hard life.

title: Changli/Backstory
content:
Changli is a tall and pale woman with yellow ringed eyes and salmon pink hair kept with golden tassel earrings pulled into a long ponytail by a dark grey and white ribbon styled at the ends to mimic phoenix feathers and golden rings that holds its braids that fades into white. The skin of her left arm is covered in feather-shaped burn marks that glows as a result of her awakening and overclocking during childhood.

Her tacet mark is located just beneath her chest.

When channeling her forte, a flame engulfed feather of "True Sight" appears on Changli's forehead, between her eyebrows.

title: Changli/Backstory
content:
Changli wears a short white gown atop a black gown with a black and gold neck piece. Her arms are adorned with long black sleeves with a red diamond patterned interior, she also has a coattail tied at her waist with the same pattern. Her outfit is topped off with various extensions that has fiery patterns, gold accents, and writing along with different jewelry.

When channeling her forte, the outer layer of Changli's outfit will catch fire and burn away as she receives more stacks on her Forte. At the maximum amount of stacks (four stacks) the outer layer of her outfit will have been completely burnt away, and a black blinfold is wrapped around her eyes.

content: Chantelle is a female NPC who appears in . She was rescued by Anastasia during her pilgrimage.

title: Chantelle
content:
;Federico: Who... who are you? How did you suddenly appear at sea? Why are you rescuing us?
;Federico: I just want to return to Ragunna City… My belongings are still there, left behind in the rush.
;Chantelle: Fede... we can't go back.
;Anastasia: I understand your panic, Mr. Fede. But remember this—
;Anastasia: In the eyes of The Order, a pilgrimage is no different from an execution...
Federico: Is there really no hope? If we head to Lilyland or Septimont... surely there's somewhere that will take us in...
Anastasia: I... I don't know...
Chantelle: Wake up, Fid. No city-state will take in outcasts without identity, unable to prove their very existence. We've lost our status as citizens of Ragunna.
Chantelle: Even our papers... they've turned to nothing but scraps of useless parchment.
Federico: Is there really no one who'll take us in? I still have a few friends... I...
Chantelle: Your friends? Do you truly think they'd welcome "heretics" like us?
Federico: What would you have me do, Chantelle? The Order's just left us to die out here, haven't they? How could they do this to us...?
Anastasia: Mr. Federico, please... stay calm. You can stay here while you plan your next steps.
Chantelle: Thank you so much Ahem... Fid?
Federico: Y-yes, thank you. I... we don't know how to thank you enough...

title: Chantelle
content:
;Federico: So, can we go back to Ragunna now? My property, my family... They might still be there.
;Chantelle: Lord Fenrico's missing, and the Order's attitude is... unsettling. I fear we'd be killed the moment we set foot back there.
;Federico: I don't care! I'm going back now!
;Anastasia: Mr. Fede, the Order's silence in times like these is anything but normal. For your own safety, please don't act on impulse.
Federico: I heard something big has happened in Ragunna... If we return now, maybe we can find our place again.
Chantelle: ...Though our status as citizens has been erased, if our acquaintances are willing to vouch for us, we might actually have a chance.
Federico: I've already sent letters to the friends who still live there. Perhaps hope is finally within reach...
Chantelle: Me too! I want to reach out to my friends! I'd do anything just to return to my homeland.
Chantelle: This time, I'll follow the Order's rules strictly and live a simple life.
Federico: O Sentinel above... Wait, can we still say that?
Anastasia: Are you...
Federico: No, no, no, we're not complaining that this place isn't good enough. Please, don't misunderstand.
Anastasia: It's alright. I understand. Missing home is only natural. I miss mine too.
Chantelle: But... should I really go home? Miss Anastasia and everyone here mean so much to me...
Anastasia: If you want, you can always stay here.
Chantelle: That would be wonderful...

title: Chengshi
content: Chengshi is an NPC in the Bank of Life, The Black Shores. She is a plant breeder at the Black Shores.

title: Chengshi
content:
[Objective: (Talk to Chengsi)]
Chengsi: Hello, what brought you here? Did something happen to the biological tanks?
[Dialogue Option]  What is a biological tank?
Chengsi: You don't know that? Oh, you must be the new Bloom Bearer! I'm Chengsi, the plant breeder here at the Black Shores.
Chengsi: In those tanks, we're cultivating a special plant called "Mambo grass." It's closely connected to the Tethys' Space Anchors.
Chengsi: You've probably seen the four giant Anchors that help neutralize the Tacetite's frequencies.
Chengsi: If something goes wrong with the Anchors, the frequencies can become unstable.
Chengsi: That's where the Mambo Grass comes in. It's super sensitive to even the slightest changes in frequencies and reacts by moving its leaves, almost like it's dancing.
Chengsi: The tanks are set up to detect these movements and send alerts to the nearest engineers and KU-Roros.
[Dialogue Option]  What if there are noises nearby...
Chengsi: Don't worry. The tanks filter out any random disturbances, so the Mambo Grass won't react to just any noise.
Chengsi: Wait, is that why you're lowering your voice?
Chengsi: No need for that! You can speak at a normal volume.

content:

Chenyue: Despite upgrading the safety equipment, some students have become even more careless.
Chenyue: There's a saying in Huanglong: "The strongest swimmers can still be weak." I really worry that something might happen to them out in the frostlands.
Next time there's an expedition, let them join my team. I'll make sure to train them right.

title: Chenyue
content:
[Objective: At  02:00-05:59]
Chenyue: It's late. Why aren't you in bed? Go back to the dormitory. Youngsters shouldn't all be night owls.
[Dialogue Option]  Are the frostlands really that dangerous?
[Dialogue Option]  What should you look out for in the frostlands?
Chenyue: The key is to follow all the Safety Protocols and listen to your expedition leader and the other pros. They know the safe routes inside and out and won't lead you anywhere risky.
Chenyue: As for the Void Storms, the protective suits will help keep contamination at bay, and every research team is geared up with top-notch monitors. They usually catch the warning signs early.
Chenyue: Other than that... If you want my two cents, I always say never skip a meal. You need calories if you want to keep a clear head out there.
Chenyue: Anyway, as long as you're following the survival protocols, there's really no need to worry too much.
Chenyue: And if you run into any trouble, the Roya are your best bet for help. They're the real locals.
[Dialogue Option]  I have no further questions.
Chenyue: Alright, it's getting late. The only hazard now is you running low on sleep. Go get some rest.

title: Chisa/Backstory
content:
37 years before LD
Kuchiba Chisa is born in Ashinohara.
31 years before LD
Chisa attends a summer festival with her parents at 6 years old. This becomes one of her most cherished memories.
25 years before LD
Chisa is left alone at home often as her parents are busy with work. She is 12 years old.
22 years before LD
Chisa awakens as a mutant Resonator after being bullied. She is 15 years old.
21 years before LD
Chisa is fitted with a Resonator suppression collar at 16 years old. She helps a young boy recover his kite from a tree, and is not shunned due her Resonance ability for the first time.
19 years before LD
Chisa attends Startorch Academy for a few months before being caught in a Voidstorm and becoming trapped in the Honami City Sonoro Sphere. She experiences time dilation within the Sonoro Sphere, with only 2 months passing for her while 2 decades pass on the outside. She meets Sumika in the Sonoro. Sumika is a Black Shores Bloom Bearer who was also sucked into the Sonoro. She and Chisa become fast friends and work to escape the Sonoro Sphere.
1 year after LD
The Honami City Sonoro Sphere surfaces near the Black Shores and Rover is pulled into the Sonoro by Sumika, who wants Rover to save Chisa. Sumika dies in the process. Chisa and Rover escape the Sonoro together.
Chisa and Rover depart to Startorch together.

|vo_01_01_tx                 = This nickel-plated pair of scissors weighs about 152 grams. Its max opening angle is roughly 60 degrees. Just enough to cut through thick wool, even with quilted fleece hidden in the seam. I've always been able to estimate numbers like that, even as a little girl. But after that strange and terrifying power descended upon me, I started seeing more. Now, even a single inch feels like an entire world.

title: Chisa/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_02_title              = Thoughts: II
|vo_01_02_intimacy           = 1
|vo_01_02_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg
|vo_01_02_tx                 = When I was little, I'd sit on the porch of our house, listening to cicadas while cutting colored paper into goldfish and lucky stars. My mother would be nearby, stitching a yukata. The electric fan creaked as it turned, and slow midday dramas played on the TV... Now that I think about it, summers like that were kind of a luxury.

title: Chisa/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_03_title              = Thoughts: III
|vo_01_03_intimacy           = 2
|vo_01_03_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg
|vo_01_03_tx                 = In Honami, summer never ends. But there are no cicadas. No evening wind chimes. Only the endless loop of the Lament... Sometimes, I find old boxes of sugar candy in abandoned convenience stores. Normally, living beings shouldn't feel hunger inside a Sonoro Sphere. But that sugary taste always brings back memories of festivals back home, candy in hand... Sorry, I guess none of that really matters.

title: Chisa/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_04_title              = Thoughts: IV
|vo_01_04_intimacy           = 3
|vo_01_04_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg
|vo_01_04_tx                 = I... I'm not good with faces. When I was little, people always said I got stuck on the details. But ever since faces started blurring in front of me, I've had to rely on that instead. In this Sonoro, "death" is only temporary. Those who disappear always show up again like nothing happened. So I take notes. The grease stain on the shopkeeper's sleeve across the road. The shape of the clerk's hair clip in the convenience store. That way, even if their faces are a blur, I still know who they are.

title: Chisa/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_05_title              = Thoughts: V
|vo_01_05_intimacy           = 4
|vo_01_05_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg
|vo_01_05_tx                 = Since grade school, I was what people called a "straight-A student." Steady grades. Perfect attendance. Neat handwriting. Homework always early. Not a single crease in my textbooks. For most people, that's enough... and I don't mind that. People have always trusted me for those reasons, without ever really knowing me. But with you, it's different. You didn't come to me because you saw "I was performing well." You didn't stay because I seemed "reliable." We've stood together on the edge of this city's collapse, again and again.  That's why I wanted to say this. Like you said... we're partners. So of course I trust you, too.

title: Chisa/Voicelines
content:
|vo_02_01_title              = Chisa's Hobby
|vo_02_01_file               = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg
|vo_02_01_tx                 = Handcrafting, tailoring, plus... mathematics. Yes, I'd say I'm quite good at these.

|vo_02_02_title              = Chisa's Trouble
|vo_02_02_file               = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg
|vo_02_02_tx                 = It's probably my lack of facial expressions. A lot of people think I'm "difficult to approach." It's not that I dislike anyone. I just don't know... how to approach people in a natural way.

title: Chisa/Voicelines
content:
|vo_02_03_title              = Favorite Food
|vo_02_03_file               = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg
|vo_02_03_tx                 = Chocolate bars... A former classmate gave me one once and said something like, "Keep frowning like that and your blood sugar's gonna crash." Didn't really get the science behind it. But after trying one... I started keeping a few boxes on hand. They're good for a quick energy boost, and they keep my head clear. That's the main reason I have them. ...But I do have to admit that chocolate is better than strawberry.

title: Chisa/Voicelines
content:
|vo_02_04_title              = Disliked Food
|vo_02_04_file               = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg
|vo_02_04_tx                 = Spicy food. I tasted some  cuisines while I was at the Black Shores, and they were... unique. It was the first time I was annoyed by my lack of tolerance for spice. But maybe this could change with enough practice? I'll have to try more.

|vo_02_05_title              = Ideals
|vo_02_05_file               = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg
|vo_02_05_tx                 = ...I don't have any grand ideals. I just know that if I see something happening, I can't pretend I didn't. If my abilities can help, even a little, then I'll keep using them.

title: Chisa/Voicelines
content:
|vo_03_01_title              = Chat: I
|vo_03_01_file               = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg
|vo_03_01_tx                 = These small scissors I carry with me were a present from my mother. She used them her entire career as a seamstress. Later, I used them to alter my new school uniform I wore to orientation. It didn't quite fit, so I adjusted it myself. They feel like an invisible thread my parents stitched into me. Silent, yet always pulling me forward.

|vo_03_02_title              = Chat: II
|vo_03_02_file               = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg
|vo_03_02_tx                 = The day they put this collar on me, it happened to rain in my hometown. I watched the downpour and rolling stormclouds through the window, and oddly enough, I felt a sense of relief. My Resonance Ability had been restrained. And I told myself, "Now they won't hate you anymore."

title: Chisa/Voicelines
content:
|vo_04_01_title              = About Sumika
|vo_04_01_intimacy           = 1
|vo_04_01_file               = {character}{language} About Sumika.ogg
|vo_04_01_tx                 = Sumika was the first to uncover the "loop pattern" of the . We used to pull all-nighters at the safe house, crunching data. I needed coffee to stay focused, but she always stayed sharp. Honestly, even borderline manic. But I knew how deeply she wanted to understand the truth behind the city's Lament. Maybe that's just the nature of a true researcher. Like she said, even the most dangerous equation still needs someone willing to solve it.
|vo_04_01_mention            = Sumika

|vo_04_02_tx                 = Born of love. Always kind and dependable... That's the Guardian of Honami City. Or at least, that's how it likes to introduce itself. Being around Namipon feels peaceful. Hard to explain. Sometimes it follows me, quietly. I won't notice until it brushes up against me, soft fur against my arm, asking if I want coffee. But there's something more beneath that face. Something vast. Maybe it's just... trying to return the love people once gave it.
|vo_04_02_mention            = Namipon

title: Chiwen
content: '  is an NPC who helps collect Unclaimed Rafter Kite for Qiuhong during the day.

title: Chiwen
content:
Chiwen: I heard you found a Rafter Kite with quite a bit of history behind it?

Chiwen: Rafter Kites wanted! Unclaimed ones especially. Fair rates, no haggling!

title: Chiwen
content:
[Objective: Night, switching with Qiuhong]
Chiwen: Commander... Err... Mr. Qiuhong! I have the Rafter Kites from today right here, sir.
Qiuhong: I appreciate your hard work, Chiwen. I'll take it from here.

title: Chiwen
content:
[Objective: Morning, switching with Qiuhong]
Chiwen: You've been up all night, and still look all spruced and nice. Now wondering whose shift it's supposed to be...
Qiuhong: It's normal for older folks to sleep less. What's there to be surprised about?
Chiwen: The shift's yours. I'm gonna have a look around and come back later.

title: Chiwen
content:
[Objective: Morning, switching with Qiuhong]
Qiuhong: You're here early. Had anything to eat yet? Why don't we head to Yuan's Flavors for some noodles?
Chiwen: I've already eaten. No need to trouble yourself over me... Commander. I mean. Mr. Qiuhong.
Chiwen: I'll have the Rafter Kites taken care of, you may focus on your task at hand.

title: Chiwen

title: Chong
content:
Chong: Here for medicine or a consult? For a consult, see Doctor Fuchang at the triage desk. For medicine, you can give me your prescription.

[Dialogue Option]  Eh? Are you new here?

[Dialogue Option]  Isn't it Doctor Chi during the day?

Chong: Oh, you're looking for Chi. I'm in charge of meds during the night shift. If you're looking for him, come back during the day.

[Dialogue Option]  So you work shifts.

Chong: Can't be helped. It's too much work for one person to handle alone.

[Dialogue Option]  Night shifts must be rough.

Chong: Not at all. I actually prefer it. Fewer patients, and it's much slower than daytime hours.

Chong: He takes the day, I take the night. The two of us splitting the load works out well enough.

Chong: Of course, if we could have a day with no patients, that'd be even better...

title: Ciaccona
Ciaccona
content:
A chaconne (ciaccona in Italian) is a style of musical composition popular during the Baroque Era (1600-1750 A.D.).
Toccata (from Italian toccare, literally, "to touch", with "toccata" being the action of touching) is a virtuoso piece of music typically for a keyboard or plucked string instrument featuring fast-moving, lightly fingered or otherwise virtuosic passages or sections, generally emphasizing the dexterity of the performer's fingers.

title: Ciaccona/Backstory
content:
Ragunna
|power = Woven Melodies
|evaluation = Journal Entry of Veron Toccata—Head of Toccata Family  I do not know if this is a blessing or a curse that has befallen my child.  The child has mastered numerous instruments with ease. She tells me that the melodies in the music sheets appear not just as notes to her, but also as a series of scenes: they are stories of the instruments and their performers... She took my hand and shared this perception with me, and that is when I discovered that Ciaccona can recreate aspects of the world through melodies. It is a realm of her own making.  As long as she can sense these melodies, Ciaccona can transform her poetry and music into anything. The child has an innate curiosity about everything, making it easy for her to empathize with the stories and experiences of others. I fear this gift may bring her misfortune. That she will hear the echoes that hide within the darkness of shadows.

title: Ciaccona/Backstory
content:
|overclock = Journal Entry of Veron Toccata—Head of Toccata Family  The Order was inevitably made aware of Ciaccona's ability. They deemed her destined to become the Toccata Family's most radiant chorister. Per protocol, they conducted a Forte examination on her. These were the results:  This member's waveform graph shows elliptical fluctuations with a stable Time Domain. No signs of abnormal fluctuations were observed. The test results are assessed as being within the normal phase.  Resonant Criticality: High. This member possesses high stability with minimal risk of Overclocking.  Records indicate no history of Overclocking.  There is no current need for psychological counseling.  All data appears to be normal, likely due to her perception of melodies being filled with wonder and hope. As she grows older, I sometimes wish she could be happy like this forever... Yet I know that became impossible the moment she took that key.
}}

|vo_02_04_tx                 = Food names can be misleading sometimes. I once met a merchant who taught me how to make a "gourmet treat" called "Deer Crackers." Right as the merchant noticed and snatched the crackers from my hand, a deer popped out of the bushes and started enjoying them. So, as the name suggests, "Deer Crackers" are really just crackers for deers.

title: Cilania
content: ' is a hot-headed, female NPC Gladiator located in Capitoline Hill City. She is seen arguing with her adoptive father, Publius Odle or an ex-Gladiator, Catalino.

title: Cilania
content:
[Objective: (Day)]
Cilania: I'm not that little crybaby you remember now, Father. The weak girl I once was... is long gone.
[Dialogue Option]  Silently watch the girl and her father argue.
Publius: You are missing the point, Cilania. Yes, trees will grow tall and shoots will grow lush, and one day, my daughter, you'll have a happier life, far from this home. But not yet. Not now.
Cilania: I... don't need your protection anymore. I'm strong now. I've grown up. I can stand on my own as a gladiator!
Publius: No, you don't understand. I swore an oath to the esteemed one in Septimont that as long as I draw breath, I will not let you set foot on that battlefield again.
Publius: A daughter of the Odle Family is meant to embrace love and family, not clutch a weapon among the dead and dying. Cilania, you don't need to burn so fiercely, like the sun. Why not simply... shine gently as one of Septimont's little stars?
Cilania: I understand how you feel, but I didn't become a Gladiator to find happiness, Father.
Cilania: That rainy night, you carried me in your arms and carved a way through the TD Outbreak in the Sanguis Plateaus. To this day, people still talk about how the Odle Family stole an orphan right back from death's grip.
Cilania: All that we are is forged by our own honor and our victories in battle. The sons and daughters of the Odle Family are born to be as radiant as the sun.
Cilania: So, I'm not here to argue with you today. Father, I've come to say goodbye.
Cilania: All because I am your daughter. I want to be your daughter. I am Cilania of the Odle Family. I am Cilania the Gladiator, who bears our honor.
Publius: No... Cilania, my daughter...
[Dialogue Option]  Leave

title: Cilania
content:
[Objective: (Night)]
Cilania: Catalino, I challenge you to an Honor Duel!
[Dialogue Option]  Quietly observe.
Catalino: Oh come on, young lady, have mercy! Why won't you let go of a washed-up nobody like me?
Catalino: If you're itching for a fight, there are plenty of star contenders in this city. Why not go challenge one of them to an all-or-nothing duel?
Cilania: You, a Hunting Group hero, now cower before a woman's sword? You've brought shame upon the name of Septimont, Catalino!
Catalino: All this talk of heroes and honor... My lady, aren't you one of the few who made it out of that place alive? Don't you get it? Honor means nothing when you face the Dark Tide. So why rush back just to throw your life away?
Cilania: Cut the crap and face me in the duel!
Catalino: I'm done with fighting... If you really can't let go of that battle, do it.
Cilania: You miserable coward.
[Dialogue Option]  Leave

Cobalt blue and deep purple are the classical colors for deep sea, but is it truly the right choice for Fisalia?

title: Claudia
content:
[Objective: (First time interaction)]
Claudia: Nice to meet you, traveler from afar. I'm Claudia V. Fisalia, a traveling painter currently working on my landscape paintings.
Claudia: I hope your time in Ragunna leaves you with beautiful memories.
[Dialogue Option] : Thank you.
Claudia: Your eyes shine with a brilliance akin to the Sentinel's radiance... If you don't mind, would you accept this painting?
[Dialogue Option] :Oh, thank you. But maybe it's a bit too much...
Claudia: No worries, it's just my personal creation and not something for sale.
Claudia: I wish to paint the history within my heart and share it with those I feel are destined to connect with the Sentinel.

title: Claudia
content:
Claudia: I wish to paint the history within my heart and share it with those I feel are destined to connect with the Sentinel.



Claudia: I'm curious, though it's a bit embarrassing to ask... What do you think of my artwork, Rover?
[Dialogue Option] : I'm curious about the towers in the painting.
Claudia: Are you referring to the Thorncrown Rises? Once engraved with the history of Fisalia, they are now merely three abandoned structures on the sea ridge.
Claudia: In my childhood, I heard stories that the hidden main tower was the resting place for my family's first honors.
Claudia: What does that truly mean? Does the Fisalia family really have any honor left to speak now?
[Dialogue Option] : The use of color is truly distinctive.
Claudia: Distinctive use of color, you say? They're actually my attempts to depict the legacy of the Fisalia family through color.
Claudia: Why has the Fisalia family become like this? As someone not of the senior line, I can only speculate in this way now.

title: Claudia
content:
[Objective: (After )]

Claudia: I'm curious, though it's a bit embarrassing to ask... What do you think of my artwork, Rover?
[Dialogue Option] : Is that the Thorncrown Rises in the painting?
Claudia: Indeed. The Thorncrown Rises that bear the history of Fisalia.
Claudia: Though they are now merely three abandoned structures on the sea ridge, they carry the Fisalias' true honor.
Claudia: As a member of the Fisalia family, I've heard the truth from our head... I want to capture the glory we once had with my brush.
[Dialogue Option] : The use of color is truly distinctive.
Claudia: Distinctive use of color, you say? They're actually my attempts to depict the legacy of the Fisalia family through color.
Claudia: Our history is marred and stained by the Dark Tide. Perhaps that's why these colors feel so fitting.

title: Claudia
content:
;Claudia These magical morph paintings... Are they really created with just brushes and paints?
;Claudia If so, what was going through the creators' minds when they painted them?
Claudia: That color... I want to learn more about it, no matter what... Thank you for the help.

title: Claudio
content: Claudio is a Troupe of Fools member who can be found speaking with Patricia about their next performance.

title: Claudio
content:
[Objective: (When talking with Patricia)]
Patricia: I suspect we'll head for Lilyland next.
Claudio: I'd wager that Septimont is more likely.
[Dialogue Option] : What are you doing?
Claudio: We're debating our next destination. We're still on a Pan-Ragunna Tour, after all.
Claudio: The Captain often says, "Wherever the applause calls, there we'll go to 'capture laughter.' With our craft, our wit, and a touch of our own flair, we'll claim what's rightfully ours."
Patricia: True enough. But each island has its own tastes when it comes to theater. We'll need to tailor our efforts to make sure everyone feels the journey was worthwhile!
Claudio: But, whether we head to the Lilyland's Sea of Flowers or the exhilarating spectacles of Septimont, it's up to the captain to decide!

title: Claudio
subsection: (Where Tulio was last seen in Fool's Elysium)

[Objective: (Where Tulio was last seen in Fool's Elysium)]

[Dialogue Option] : Acolyte Tulio, what are you doing here?
Claudio: A member witnessed the Acolyte secretly sailing away from the stronghold alone at night.
Claudio: We can understand why Order members don't recognize us... it's understandable if they leave.
Claudio: But... ah, with this weather... fog all around, and the storm is closing in.
Claudio: I hope the Sentinel's blessings see him safely ashore...
