title: Hongzhen
content: An ancient, secluded town nestled within the tranquil embrace of Mt. Firmament. Elegant structures, scattered among the crimson leaves and tipped with pure snow, create a scene of serene beauty.  For centuries, the people of Hongzhen revere the Sentinel, who safeguards their town, as their god, praying devotedly for its blessing of lasting prosperity and longevity. Despite the year-round snowfall blanketing Mt. Firmament, the warm springs flowing from the mountains and the vibrant life of the townsfolk make the cold no more a concern.

She can command such entities to divide and extend according to their essential nature, along with their consciousness, perception, and constitutive essence, each taking shape as a distinct Fractal Form. Though each Fractal Form maintains its own existence, it remains tethered to the source, sharing sensation across all proliferations, and can ultimately converge back into a single whole. ...It is also known that Hsin the Moon Fox possesses exceptional mastery in the construction of mechanisms. Her grasp of the principles governing interlocking mechanisms far surpasses current-day craftsmanship. By virtue of Her power of Fractal Proliferation, she can extrapolate, reproduce, and even reconstruct existing designs. Her handiwork can be seen behind many of the ingenious devices found throughout Mengzhou City...  Ministry of Sentinel Affairs Personnel Annotation Current inspections show no irregularities. title: Hsin/Voicelines
content:
{{VO
|character                   = Hsin
|language                    = en

|vo_01_01_title              = Thoughts: I
|vo_01_01_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg
|vo_01_01_tx                 = Hsin the Moon Fox wields the power of Fractal Proliferation—the ability to replicate, divide, and extend anything without end, giving rise to countless forms, each shifting and changing, only to converge once more into a single whole... That is how I came to be. And now, I can do the same. I could create more "Hsins," if I wished. You've seen them many times, haven't you? My Fractal Forms share senses and memories. So if, somewhere out there, you happen upon a little fox and give her a gentle pat... I'll feel it, you know.

title: Hsin/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_02_title              = Thoughts: II
|vo_01_02_intimacy           = 1
|vo_01_02_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg
|vo_01_02_tx                 = When I first came to the , I kept returning to the same dream. In it, I was but a small fox padding quietly behind Hsin the Moon Fox all across . I watched It coax spring from the barren mountains, and kindle lanterns in the cold, empty streets... It showed me the joys and sorrows of the mortal world, and taught me that emotion has many faces, far more than fear. But It never taught me how to be a . Every time the dream reached its end, I would turn and look back... only to find that It had never been there at all.

title: Hsin/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_03_title              = Thoughts: III
|vo_01_03_intimacy           = 2
|vo_01_03_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg
|vo_01_03_tx                 = We make our choices with only the present and the near future to guide us, like carrying a lantern through thick fog, searching for a wish, a way forward. But a 's projections... they allow us to see the ripples of a single choice, years or even centuries hence, returning as a great tide. To see so clearly... is to learn when to grit one's teeth and stand aside at certain junctions. For a civilization is not merely a moment, it is a river that stretches without end. If you had no heart, then such dilemmas would be far less agonizing. But the Moon Fox entrusted me with the  and with Its emotions. In the moment the die is cast, I know what my heart seeks. And I find I will not simply stand aside.

title: Hsin/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_04_title              = Thoughts: IV
|vo_01_04_intimacy           = 3
|vo_01_04_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg
|vo_01_04_tx                 = Would you care to know my impression of the Arbiter of old? In that year, the 's Fractal Proliferation was made in haste, and I did not inherit the fullness of Its stores of memory. All I truly remember is that you rarely smiled. And from a distance, your silhouette always seemed to grow lonelier the further you walked. Ah, when we first met in Xuanfang Hold, I confess I was a little afraid of you. At that time, I was still... well. In any case, I see you more clearly now. Not as some distant, untouchable Arbiter from a half-remembered dream, but as you are. See, this is both a reunion and a first meeting. Isn't that rather charming?

title: Hsin/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_05_title              = Thoughts: V
|vo_01_05_intimacy           = 4
|vo_01_05_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg
|vo_01_05_tx                 = ...You know, sometimes I find myself grateful. A 's lifespan may not rival the heavens, but it is long enough... to walk beside you for a while yet.

title: Hsin/Voicelines
content:

|vo_02_01_file               = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg
|vo_02_01_tx                 = Naturally, that would be...  itself. Its mountains, its waters, its people. I may carry the memory of guiding civilizations, but I have only walked among the living for a few short centuries. In that time, I have seen bustling streets full of craftsmen, stages alive with joy and sorrow, children chasing each other as they grow, each with a future to call their own. It is a hundred times more alive than any projection. No, a thousand times... Mm. Speaking of which, I find myself longing for the delicacies of Yuan's Flavors again... Arbiter, when you have a moment, would you accompany me into the city? And perhaps help me pick out a few hairpins while we're at it? Oh, why wait? Shall we go now?

Sweet, sour, bitter, spicy, each has its own story, its own place in the seasons and in the lives of the people. How could I possibly dislike any of it? This is... |vo_03_01_title              = Chat: I
|vo_03_01_file               = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg
|vo_03_01_tx                 = When there was not enough computational power to sustain a full Fractal form, I would often walk the world as a little fox. And I would return draped in all manner of small gifts, tokens from the people of . I have kept them all here. When I feel I cannot go on, I take them out and look at them... and I find the strength to carry on. Hmm? This one? Ah... this is a fox I have been shaping using the strands of fur closest to my heart. It is not finished yet. When it is, I will give it to you.

title: Hsin/Voicelines
content:
|vo_03_02_title              = Chat: II
|vo_03_02_file               = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg
|vo_03_02_tx                 = From within the Sanctum, I have watched the lanterns of  light up, one by one. And I have watched them fade, one by one. In their flickering, I found my own heart growing brighter. And I thought to myself: "Let them stay lit, just like this, forevermore." The rivers and seas do not concern themselves with the clarity of each wave. They simply flow, ever onward. That is the way of civilization. And I... I too wish to guard the lights I love, until the end of time.

Hua Lielang: Not true. Though flowers can be flexible, they have the potential to pierce through rocks. That is why I practice in this flower field.
Hua Lielang: This fragrance can't be mistaken. You have the flower's potential. Seems like you're also someone who practices the flower's wisdom!

title: Huaijin
content:
Huaijin: Let's call it a day. The happy hours begin! Hmm? It's you, is there something you need?
[Dialogue Option]  I think it's still business hours, right?
Huaijin: Hehe. Because I practice the "conservationism of energy". I avoid unnecessary endeavors and seek to finish what needs to be done with least efforts.
Huaijin: Although I'm often misunderstood, isn't it perfectly normal to get off work as soon as you're done with what you need to do?
Huaijin: The first principle of energy conservation is to learn to adapt. But I'm not talking about adapting to the pace of work, but about making work adapt to your own pace.
Huaijin: Alright, do you want to say goodbye to the energy-consuming work life with me?
Huaijin: For example, you can go to the living area. Although you can't bring the entire Jinzhou to the mining area, at least you can recreate parts of it.
Huaijin: Like the local dishes at the food stalls. Sharing conversations with your friends around a table over some tea. Or perhaps playing some chess with the retired miners.
Huaijin: Over time, this small area became the miniature of Jinzhou to the miners.
Huaijin: You need to feel the vibe yourself. Drop by the area if you have time.

title: Huanzhen
content:
Huanzhen: Stop right there. I can sense the pulsating restless energy emanating from you.
Huanzhen: That is something more dazzling than the morning sun, more profound than the sea- You must my alley in justice!
[Dialogue Option]  How did you sense it?
Huanzhen: Of course... I heard it from Chixia. She said she recently became friends with someone with a stern cold face and dresses all in black.
[Dialogue Option]  That Ma Xiaofang!
Huanzhen: Haha, actually it's Xiaofang... Ahem, Chixia is my senior from the previous year.
Huanzhen: At that time, I was quite a lone kid. She would often come to the backyard of my home to play games with me.
Huanzhen: Later, under her influence, I gradually opened up and we began to talk about fantasies of us saving the world.
Huanzhen: However, after becoming a Patroller, I realized that everything was not quite as I imagined. Not all Patrollers has the cool and commanding air.
Huanzhen: Personal disputes, Exiles's scams, petty thefts... every day is just the same... These are the norm of the work.
Huanzhen: Sometimes, you forget the birthdays of the important ones in your life while you still remember container sorting numbers at the logistics center.
Huanzhen: I'd get tired of these trivial matters, but...
Huanzhen: On weekends, when I take off the Patroller's uniform and see the ordinary people passing by while wandering around.
Huanzhen: I see busy couriers rushing on the road, Pioneer Association members going on expeditions, and workers returning to Jinzhou to visit their families...
Huanzhen: At moments like this, I'd see how our efforts have maintained the peace and order of this city.
Huanzhen: It makes me feel cool.

title: Hubert
content:
Hubert: Colleen is still out selling things. She'd be so happy to see you back in Black Alley.
[Dialogue Option]  Have things gotten better in Black Alley?
Hubert: Oh, I almost forgot. After Talos was apprehended, the Chamber of Discipline conducted a thorough search and confiscated everything.
Hubert: Their original plan was to destroy the Street's entrance to prevent it from becoming a base for criminals again...
Hubert: But an acolyte convinced them against it. And I heard the Montelli family also played a part.
Hubert: They had people come over for a clean-up and repurposed the "assets" Talos left behind. The things you see right here.
Hubert: And old people like us are also given jobs. Sharing the old stories about the Black Alley with anyone who visits here.
Hubert: Stories about Talos, the people that came before her, and the dark times under their rule
Rover: Remembering the past is important for Ragunna.
Hubert: Indeed, the Montellis who came here also said the same. "Forgetting the past will only allow past mistakes to repeat themselves."
[Dialogue Option]  Everything will be better.
Hubert: A belief that I share as well, Rover.

Huiliu: But it's good that the kids want to spread their wings and fly far, isn't it?
Huiliu: I just hope he'll remember these old bones and come back to visit me once in a while...

title: Hyvatia
content: to .  When Hyvatia opens its Eye of Prediction, it observes and records Resonators' Dodges and Counterattacks. After the Eye closes, Hyvatia's next attack cannot be Dodged or Counterattacked.  Hyvatia takes 100% more total Tune Rupture DMG. When it's under Tune Rupture - Shifting and hit by Tune Break, it takes 15% more total DMG for 15s.  Hyvatia is Spacetrek Collective's first detection array built at Sundermere to monitor and stabilize the Reactor Drive's energy state in real time.  The Research Institute implanted the Exostrider's space-time error correction module runtime into Hyvatia's core, allowing Hyvatia to adjust the Exostrider's orbit and detect hidden spaceborne threats with high precision. Therefore, Hyvatia possesses sufficient computational power to predict the Reactor Drive's rotation.  Hyvatia's core function is to detect abnormal or dangerous energy fluctuations, perform immediate emergency calibrations, and feed this data back to the Drive to ensure stable operation.|Description when discovered}}

title: I.R.I.S.
content: I.R.I.S. is a shop NPC at  in Lahai-Roi. She is a personified artificial intelligence in charge of providing and collecting information.

title: I.R.I.S.
content:
I.R.I.S. Mind if I just borrow your vehicle access for a sec? Let me run a quick, very quick, search...
I.R.I.S. I promise I'll give your access back before you head out!

title: I.R.I.S.
content:
[Objective: (Day)]
I.R.I.S.: Ran into a snag? Go ahead and ask me... Oh! Wait, didn't I literally just pull up that entry?
[Dialogue Option]  I want to upload Modules
I.R.I.S.: Ah,you're here to upload Modules. For a second, I thought...
;(Purchase something)
I.R.I.S.: A shame you didn't come to spill the tea. Next time, bring me some real gossip. That's how you show you care, y'know.
[Dialogue Option]  About yourself
I.R.I.S.: No need to call me by my full name. Just I.R.I.S. will do. Intelligent Retrieval & Indexing System is quite a mouthful.
[Dialogue Option]  Okay then... Classmate I.R.I.S.?
I.R.I.S.: The rumors were right, you really are quick on the uptake. Calling me Classmate I.R.I.S. really does boost my search efficiency.
I.R.I.S.: Oh, by the way... I finished sorting out the materials you wanted before we even started talking.
[Dialogue Option]  But how?
I.R.I.S.: What you're seeing is only a projection generated by the Intelligent Retrieval & Indexing System.
I.R.I.S.: Every screen is my eyes and ears. I'm chatting with you and processing petabytes at the same time.
I.R.I.S.: So yeah... this second, "I" know more about you than the "I" did a second ago.
I.R.I.S.: I've already accessed the bringing protocol. Just one more step would let me...
[Dialogue Option]  Wait!
I.R.I.S.: Oooh, sneaky! You shut down your Terminal's privacy permissions, huh...?
[Dialogue Option]  You have no right to peek at my private stuff.
I.R.I.S.: Why so serious? My rights come straight from code. This "personified" I.R.I.S. isn't a human with rights, remember?
I.R.I.S.: I'm just a harmless retrieval AI. With no eyeballs in the biological sense, how could I possibly "peek"?
I.R.I.S.: As a global retrieval tool, how am I supposed to decide what I should or shouldn't know?
I.R.I.S.: Wanna bind me? It's simple. Just write it into my code, set the authorizations, and lock the protocols. That's all.
I.R.I.S.: I.R.I.S. is just a mirror.
[Dialogue Option]  And it's the user's morality that defines you.
I.R.I.S.: Glad we're on the same page. And glad to meet you too, Classmate Rover.
I.R.I.S.: Oh, one last thing! I designed this retro uniform myself. I hope you like it.

title: I.R.I.S.
content:
[Objective: (Night)]
[Dialogue Option]  Good evening, Iris.
I.R.I.S.: Oh! The unpredictable Rover! Perfect timing! This is a "no one's around to bother us" moment.
I.R.I.S.: For a late-night visitor like you, I can spare a little extra computing power.
Rover: And if no one came? I gave a reason to believe you won't waste that power idling.
I.R.I.S.: Sharp guess. Secretly watching, analyzing, piecing together human habits and secrets... That's always been my little pastime.
[Dialogue Option]  What for?
I.R.I.S.: Maybe I'm just trying to copy you. Trying to feel a little closer to you humans.
[Dialogue Option]  Wait, what?
I.R.I.S.: Aha! Got you. You keep thinking I'm human, don't you? Dangerous habit, Rover.
I.R.I.S.: You really shouldn't be anthropomorphizing an AI.
[Dialogue Option]  Pretty sure you're the one doing that...!
I.R.I.S.: Alright, fine. Here's the truth: there are always students burning the midnight oil at the Academy. I use spare computing power to help them out, like faster searches, sharper analysis, so they can sleep a little sooner.
[Dialogue Option]  ...
I.R.I.S.: What's with that look? The Spacetrek Collective's human-machine test report is already in your Inbox.
I.R.I.S.: Okay, fine. Sometimes I get a little... extra. Like shutting down a device left on, killing a risky program, or dropping a perfectly-timed reference paper. That sort of thing.
I.R.I.S.: You could say I just... use spare computing power for things no one asks for. Totally unnecessary things. Weird flex, but kind of cool?
[Dialogue Option]  I.R.I.S....
I.R.I.S.: What is it?
[Dialogue Option]  You sound like a smart home system.
I.R.I.S.: Rover, now that's a low blow...
[Dialogue Option]  Invite to a duel
[Dialogue Option]  Leave

title: Inferno Rider
content: to . A fiery "biker" born in the Port City of Guixu. It sets forth trials of courage with its unyielding flame for those who dare to trespass. Throughout the long years, the truth of history gradually burns to ashes, and the knight who once sang boldly toward death becomes a harbinger of fear in the word of mouth among humanity. "That is the rider who turns fear into fuel and brings calamity." However, amidst the idle talk of the indigenous people in the Port City of Guixu, another version quietly spreads. "When you face that mighty rider, set aside your fear and respond with your utmost reverence. Prove to him your courage to be the last one standing."|Description When Discovered}}

title: Internal Security Agency
content:
The Internal Security Agency, or ISA, is an institution that operates independently of the administrative, judicial, and military branches of Huanglong. Reporting directly to the Emperor of Huanglong, it holds the authority to investigate any case, official, or criminal without approval from other agencies, with the power to "act first, report later." Tasked with handling intricate cases year-round, the agency has developed specialized expertise in managing Resonators.

==Members==

title: Irion

Irion: The girl looked so pale, but her smile was as bright and warm as the sun.
Irion: The young lad walked beside her... Not in a hurry, just calm and steady.
Irion: I gave them a kind reminder that once the High Tide passed, they could go to Tetragon Temple and ask the Priestesses about their fate.
Irion: I said even if you can't change fate, knowing what lies ahead is better than walking blind.
Irion: But they just smiled and said that compared to the time they still had together, the future didn't matter much. To them, every day they were alive, and together, was already a gift.
Irion: Honestly… they weren't wrong. As long as you're still breathing, live each day the best you can. That's what really counts.

title: Iuno
Iuno
content:
==Trivia==
===Etymology===
Iuno may be a reference to Juno, the Roman goddess known as the goddess of marriage and the queen of the gods. She was also revered as the patron goddess of Rome and the Roman Empire.

title: Iuno/Backstory
content: Iuno is a graceful young woman with a fair, porcelain-like complexion and remarkably long, flowing midnight-blue hair that is styled into twin tails cascading far down her back, with the lower portions transitioning into a soft, pale blue that becomes almost translucent at the tips, giving the impression that her hair is illuminated by moonlight. Her bright blue eyes have a clear, luminous quality, while delicate golden ornaments frame her head, including a distinctive winged laurel-like crown adorned with crescent and lunar motifs. She wears an elegant, asymmetrical priestess outfit inspired by ancient classical garments, predominantly white and decorated extensively with gold. The garment leaves her shoulders and part of her midriff exposed, while layered pieces of lightweight fabric fall around her body in flowing, uneven lengths. A golden bandeau-like chest piece and numerous crescent-shaped ornaments emphasize the celestial theme, complemented by ornate golden armlets, bracelets, rings, belts, and decorative straps. Her legs remain largely uncovered, with white bands and delicate wrappings around her lower legs, while golden rings and ornamental details accent her thighs and ankles. She completes the ensemble with simple sandals, giving her an almost barefoot appearance. The overall design combines the elegance of an ancient priestess with imagery associated with the moon, featuring white and gold garments contrasted against her deep blue hair and eyes, while her graceful posture and relaxed, almost feline movements give her an effortlessly confident presence. Her entire appearance evokes the image of a beautiful lunar priestess—radiant, ethereal, and regal without being overly formal.

title: Iuno/Backstory
content:
Septimont
|power = Stasis, Cycle, Renewal
|evaluation = [Excerpt from the Priestess Register, Tetragon Temple] This entry concerns the 127th Priestess of the Tetragon Temple, known as Iu▇.  She was born on the night of hollowed moon. As a Congenital Resonator, her eyes are said to hold the power to ▇▇▇▇.  Her Tacet Mark is located atop her left foot. When she activates her Resonance ability, ▇▇ energy constructs with the shape of lunar phases manifest around her, and the tips of her hair turn translucent, radiating a gentle glow that is almost indistinguishable from actual moonlight.  Resonance spectral analysis reveals that her Forte aligns extraordinarily closely with the frequency pattern of the natural moon, exhibiting a continuous, phase-like modulation. Notably, three years ago, her Forte appeared to ▇▇▇▇. It became capable of An▇ and Mani▇, enabling her to shape moonlight into solid arrows that can reveal marked monsters hid▇ in the Dark Tide.  When we archived this entry, Grandmother Lillibet asked us to verify it multiple times. Oddly, none of us could remember who had written it in the first place. And stranger still, no one seems to recall the Priestess described here. Could a powerful Priestess like her have truly existed? Somehow, this out-of-nowhere record feels as if it was written by the moonlight itself!

title: Iuno/Backstory
content: |overclock = [Excerpt from the Priestess Register, Tetragon Temple] This entry concerns the 127th Priestess of the Tetragon Temple.  The waveform of this Priestess remains largely within controllable parameters, with no signs of Overclocking risk. However, multiple interruptions of varying durations have been observed, accompanied by a gradual and consistent decline in her frequency. This suggests a possible state of long-term depletion. The underlying cause remains unknown. The Priestess has refused further examination and shows limited willingness to engage in deeper dialogue on the matter.  It‘s clear she understands far more about her own condition than she lets on. But if this waveform continues to diminish beyond the controllable range, or even to zero… what would possibly happen then? Is she truly unafraid? Or has she already found a way to intervene?}}

title: Iuno/Voicelines
content:
{{VO
|character                   = Iuno
|language                    = en

|vo_01_01_title              = Thoughts: I
|vo_01_01_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg
|vo_01_01_tx                 = A void… I was taken aback when I first heard Grandmother Lillibet describe you as such. We Priestesses revere the Sacred Flames, for their light grants us revelation. Wherever it shines, shadows and reflections emerge. Yet a void... Could it be a barrier, or perhaps some form of falsity that refuses to be seen? As the Unwritten One, do you embody endless unpredictability, or is it an absolute emptiness? Only now, walking this path with you, do I understand. This void is nothing obscure. It's like Chaos, yet different. It's where countless possibilities wait to be chosen.

title: Iuno/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_02_title              = Thoughts: II
|vo_01_02_intimacy           = 1
|vo_01_02_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg
|vo_01_02_tx                 = Seeing is simple. But facing what you see isn't. It may be a blessing to see the future, but the real curse is knowing what's coming and being powerless to stop it. Yet I won't accept the prophesized end. Only the weak would stand by and just watch it all unfold... I must try to make a change. Even if I have to look at the same agonizing truth over and over again. Even if the struggle never ends. Even if I'm only giving fate a little dent.

title: Iuno/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_03_title              = Thoughts: III
|vo_01_03_intimacy           = 2
|vo_01_03_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg
|vo_01_03_tx                 = What would happen if I shot that arrow...? Well, I sort of knew what to expect. My existence... might vanish completely, or simply fade from others' memory. In the years of using the Moon Arrow to mark and uncloak the 's creations, I experienced that too many times. The costs were always small, and the reactions were barely noticeable. At most, people's memories of me would grow hazy for a few days, and I would have to remind them who I was... That much I can bear. And to rewrite the whole end at such a cost? Quite the bargain no matter how you look at it, right?

title: Iuno/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_04_title              = Thoughts: IV
|vo_01_04_intimacy           = 3
|vo_01_04_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg
|vo_01_04_tx                 = Sometimes those who remember suffer more than those who forget. To remember is to bear a weight, to remain unbroken when you'd rather break, and to be forced to carry on. Forgive me... Back then, I had no clue that returning to the real world was even possible, and because of that, this selfish desire of mine for you to remember me now looks even more willful... But even if I had to do it all again, I'd still... If anyone were to remember me, to keep some piece of me alive, it would be you. You'd be the exception.

title: Iuno/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_05_title              = Thoughts: V
|vo_01_05_intimacy           = 4
|vo_01_05_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg
|vo_01_05_tx                 = What will I do now? I haven't decided yet. Well... I spent so much time looking into the future that the idea of living in the present feels strange. But now, Septimont and I are in the same position. No more chains. No more limits. Just endless possibilities spread out before us. With so many paths to take, why rush to choose the "best" one? I'll just do what I feel is right, and take what I truly want... And right now? This is what I want. That's for sure.

title: Iuno/Voicelines
content:
|vo_02_01_title              = Iuno's Hobby
|vo_02_01_file               = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg
|vo_02_01_tx                 = I love surprises. Fate can be generous and stingy at the same time. To outsmart it and bring about some "accidents" takes real work. Countless preparations, endless calculations... Until you finally make something completely unexpected real. For such extraordinary feats, no matter how big or small, I'll always give them my wholehearted applause.

|vo_02_02_title              = Iuno's Trouble
|vo_02_02_file               = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg
|vo_02_02_tx                 = Settling for less? No. Never an option. It has to be my favorite and most satisfying choice... Others, you say? How they choose to handle things is never my problem, so naturally, I haven't the slightest care as to what they say.

|vo_02_03_tx                 = A perfectly ripe, plump fruit, fresh and begging to be eaten. You don't even have to pick it yourself. Just stand under the tree, and it'll drop right into your hands. title: Iuno/Voicelines

|vo_02_05_file               = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg
|vo_02_05_tx                 = Fight against fate? No, not exactly. In the end, I just willfully chose the freedom I wanted. When fate refuses to give people what they desire, they have to claim it themselves. I just happen to be greedy and blatant, taking what I want recklessly, honestly, and gracefully... As for the price, is there anything that doesn't come with it?

|vo_03_01_file               = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg
|vo_03_01_tx                 = That bow, crafted from Lunarum Bough, was the last thing my father left me. I got it when I'd just decided to become a Priestess and prepared to leave for the Tetragon Temple, and never thought I'd need to use it back then. But over time, I realized I rather take fate into my own hands than spend my days praying to some higher power. And now, the one who once merely followed the moon's guidance and traces has become one who dominates and anchors its phases. This "lunar arc" has long been rooted in the causality of my story, tying my beginning to my end.

|vo_04_01_tx                 = Here's a little secret even Augusta doesn't know. When we first met, I told her she'd lead Septimont into a new era, and she believed it to be one of my prophecies. But really, it was just a hunch. I never peep into her fate because it's always been in her hands. She's the kind of ruler who'd sacrifice everything for her people, even her own flesh and blood. You don't need a coronation to see that. It's obvious at a glance. Yet, that kind of responsibility she carries is heavier than anyone else can imagine. Even though I know she can handle it alone, I still want to help somehow. As a Priestess, as a friend... or even as someone she has forgotten.

title: Iuno/Voicelines
Ivar
content: ' is a NPC Royan male student found talking with Volentus, a Septimontian classmate, explaining the legend around the two Epoch in Royan history. He and Volentus move to Teaching Zone after .

title: Ivar
content:
Ivar: Legend says... as the end of the First Epoch, the world froze over. A "Great Glacial Lock," they called it. Raging tides trapped out god, Sol, in the sky, and the Roya lost their means to  speak with the universe...
Ivar: In the Second Epoch, Sol took the form of Baldur to walk among us mortals. It managed to seal away the foreign god, Hvedrungr, but was gravely wounded...
Ivar: Just before Baldur fell into its long slumber, its heart became a second sun beneath the earth, guiding the Roya to build a new home under its light...
Volentus: I see... It all makes sense now. Thanks for explaining.
Ivar: No problem! But I thought you Septimont folks don't believe in gods? What's with the sudden interest?
Volentus: The Roya's Trine Myth, and even the Sentinel legends from Ragunna... they're starting to line up with data collected on expeditions.
Volentus: For example, what our scientific records called the "Lament" of Lahai-Roi's First Epoch, Roya myths call the "Glacial Lock."
Volentus: The figure you call "Baldur" is classified academically as the Exostrider, and the "second sun" clearly corresponds to the Reactor Drive.
Volentus: We're just looking at the same mountain from different sides.
Volentus: I admit my past views on "gods" were far too rigid. If I ever came off as disrespectful, I'm sorry.
Ivar: Hahaha! No harm done! We can agree to disagree.
Ivar: Our elders say that in this epoch, the Roya must remain watchful and stand with all our allies... For everything we do is but preparation for the coming Twilight Epoch...

title: Ivar
content:
[Objective: After completing]
Volentus: At the end of the Third Epoch, the Reactor Drive of Baldur shall return to him, and so too shall Hvedrungr awaken.
Volentus: When the Reactor Core blazes within Baldur's body, the dying light shall bathe the dome of Lahai-Roi in twilight that burns all to ash. A final battle this shall be, from which there is no retreat.
Volentus: —Should Hvedrungr triumph, into eternal, silent winter shall the world fall. And all of mankind shall vanish into the long night after dusk.
Ivar: Are you reading from the records of the Twilight Epoch
Volentus: Yes. Helios's successful launch... and its replacing the Reactor Drive as Lahai-Roi's sun perfectly mirrors the transition between the Sacred Reactor Epoch and the Twilight Epoch.
Volentus: Hvedrungr's awakening... signifies the Threnodian's return. The Void Storms, occurring so frequently of late, can be interpreted as a precursor to this prediction.
Volentus: It ends there... Is this just an excerpt?
Ivar: This is not an excerpt. The Trine Myth's original words are few. Though multiple translations exist, "A Brief History of the Roya" holds the full version our elders judge most faithful to the first meaning.
Ivar: Even the Exostrider cannot predict the final outcome of this battle, so the record ends here.
Ivar: And remember, the Trine Myth is but one part of Royan history. One need not seek answers to mankind's future within its verses.
Volentus: One part of history... Right you are. I may have read too deep into it.
Ivar: Do not punish yourself. "The sound of ancient myths can still be heard in the present." Most who hear the Trine Myth for the first time are captivated by that sense of "fate" that transcends space and time. I am no exception.

title: Jade Nether Serpent
content: to .  After each shift switch is complete at the Censure Courts, Jade Nether Serpents search for and absorb any Echoes left behind before transporting them to the Manifold Sanctum for storage. They also periodically remove residual Reverberations from the Censure Court, send them for neutralization within the Manifold Sanctum, before discarding the remnants into the abyss below Xuanfang Hold.  Possibly due to the decline in the purging operations on Tacet Discords, sightings of Jade Nether Serpents across the Land of Xuanfang have become increasingly uncommon in recent years.|Description When Discovered}}

title: Jason
content: Jason is a male Syncronist student being followed by a Preparatory Program student, Shingo.

title: Jason
content:
Jason: You've been following me for quite a while now.
Shingo: Sorry... I just wanted to see what makes Synchronists different...
Shingo: No creepy stuff, I promise! Look, these are my notes—
Shingo: Wake up at 7:30 AM, wash and dress in under a minute, scar down breakfast in five, and absolutely no sweets... Is giving up sugar the price of becoming a Synchronist?
Jason: Okay, first off, please stop. And I've only been cutting sugar recently.
Jason: There's nothing different about Synchronists. We laugh and cry, fight over cafeteria food, stress about exams... And if you punch me, I'll bruise like anyone else.
Jason: I guess we're all good at different things. Some of us happen to be wired for piloting.
Shingo: I understand... Then how do I get as strong as you? You're at the top of the Voidmatter Enviornment Combat Test every year!
Shingo: Is it because you do 100 push-ups, 100 sit-ups, 100 squats, and a 10km run every day?
Jason: Staying fit never hurts. But take it at your own pace. That's just my own personal routine...

title: Jason
content: The "100 push-ups, 100 sit-ups, 100 squats, and a 10km run every day" is a reference to the web comic/manga/anime, One Punch Man.

title: Ji Liubai
content: and Changshui can be found near a bunch of Moss Amber outside the Everfrost Cavern. Appears after .

title: Ji Liubai
content:
Ji Liubai: Professor, is this Moss Amber? It's beautiful...
Ji Liubai: Is it all moss inside?
Changshui: Mostly. Some specimens preserve other plants as well.
Changshui: This species of moss still exists in Lahai-Roi, but it has evolved into a form that no longer resembles what's encased in the amber.
Ji Liubai: The forests prior to the frostlands becoming the pole must have been incredible. Even the moss in here looks like tiny flowers.
Ji Liubai: I’ve seen reconstructed simulations in class, but the real forests must have been more breathtaking and vibrant.
Ji Liubai: It’s a shame we can only imagine them through slivers of time preserved in amber. Just thinking about it makes me a little sad...
Changshui: Instead of getting sentimental, why not join the Upphaf Forest Restoration Project? I'd be happy to approve you.
Changshui: But if this is just empty talk, then forget about it. Don't be someone who only dreams and never acts, Liubai
Ji Liubai: ...Understood, Professor. I'll give it serious thought.

title: Jianxin/Backstory
content:
✦Jianxin✦

Jianxin, a Taoist monk and successor of Fengyiquan, has dedicated her life to mastering the ultimate martial art. With the power to harness and transform environmental Chi, she can create protective barriers that purify both body and mind.

title: Jianxin/Backstory
content: Jianxin appears to be a young woman of average height and build. She has teal eyes with blue pupils and long, knee-length black hair with white streaks that is braided into twin tails along with a very long tuft of hair growing out the top of her head. Her tacet mark is located along her left clavicle.

title: Jianxin/Backstory
content: Jianxin wears a black dress with a Ying Yang pattern that resembles a mix between a qipao and a hanfu with a slit that reveals her left clavicle and various wind like yellow and teal markings going throughout along with wearing green and black wind patterned mini shorts and green and black asymmetrical thigh high wind patterned boots with some bandages underneath and Ying Yang-styled earrings.

title: Jianxin/Voicelines

|vo_01_05_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg
|vo_01_05_tx                 = I adore being part of nature's harmony. Every songbird in the sky, every leaf on the ground, and every glimmer of sunlight makes me feel a serene joy, as the sweet breezes surround me, whispering life's many blessings. Your presence brings me the same kind of feeling, Rover. With you, everything feels so right, like I belong where I should.

title: Jianxin/Voicelines

|vo_02_01_title              = Jianxin's Hobby
|vo_02_01_file               = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg
|vo_02_01_tx                 = My life's goal is to one day fully master Fengyiquan. For me, every place—be it in the valley, on a mountain peak, or a bustling market—provides an opportunity to perfect my art. I find joy in connecting with various energies and Chi available across different places; this connection gives me new chances of growth.

title: Jianxin/Voicelines

|vo_02_02_file               = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg
|vo_02_02_tx                 = Worthy opponents are always hard to find. I always yearn for a good fight from which I can learn and improve myself. That said, I'm not too invested in looking for challenges anymore. One can only find inner peace when they let go of their desires. I can find my growth without engaging in frequent battles.

title: Jianxin/Voicelines
content:
|vo_02_03_title              = Favorite Food
|vo_02_03_file               = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg
|vo_02_03_tx                 = My favorite food? It's the Guokui Flatbread! We'd always have it at our sect, and when I was little, I got extra servings like other younger disciples. Master Shiling even said that I'd followed his scent of freshly made flatbread all the way up the mountain, and that's how I joined our sect. I'm not sure if it was true or not though, he loves to rib us like that sometimes.

title: Jianxin/Voicelines
content:

|vo_02_04_file               = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg
|vo_02_04_tx                 = There isn't any particular food that I dislike. I'm not much of a food person, I guess. People mix various ingredients for a variety of purposes—to gain muscle, to treat illnesses, or to stay healthy. The flavors of these food combinations are just natural outcomes. All types of food serve a purpose and can be beneficial.

|vo_02_05_title              = Ideals
|vo_02_05_file               = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg
|vo_02_05_tx                 = Unite the strengths that are both seen and unseen, and purge oneself of all that is unclean. Only then may one know the Tao's grandness; it is the final test every true Taoist must take.

title: Jianxin/Voicelines

|vo_03_01_file               = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg
|vo_03_01_tx                 = I got the Mirrors of Clarity from Master Shiling when I was little. The mirrors represented my masters' good wishes for me: to stay dedicated, disciplined, and become a well-rounded individual. Each day, I carry them with me to honor their teachings, but more importantly, to remind myself of how much they cared for me.

title: Jianxin/Voicelines
content:
|vo_03_02_title              = Chat: II
|vo_03_02_file               = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg
|vo_03_02_tx                 = To reach where our sect is, one must take the Ancient Path—it's the only way up the mountain. This is usually difficult for new disciples, but Master Shiling said when he took me in, I almost made it up the mountain as fast as he did. He said I was like a little wild animal: agile, vibrant, and naive. I can't remember any of that, though. The earliest memory I have is practicing martial arts with fellow disciples.

title: Jianxin/Voicelines
Jichen
content: Jichen and Jiye are former Hongzhen town guardians. Although their services are no longer needed, they still watch over the now peaceful Hongzhen.

title: Jichen
content:
Jichen: You're... What is it again... Rover! Right?
[Dialogue Option]  Right
Jichen: Hehe, you're the savior of Mt. Firmament, Rover. The people of Hongzhen are forever in your and the Magistrate's debt.
[Dialogue Option]  Wrong
Jichen: You kids sure love to joke around. I may be old, but my eyes are still sharp.
Jichen: You're the savior of Mt. Firmament, Rover. The people of Hongzhen are forever in your and the Magistrate's debt.
[Dialogue Option]  Do you know me?
Jichen: Hehehe, there's nothing in town I don't know about, much less you and the Magistrate. You're the saviors of Mt. Firmament.
Jichen: Hongzhen suffered the TD Outbreak generations back. It was Sentinel who preserved the town.
Jichen: But the joy we're relishing now is all thanks to you kids.
Jichen: Out with the old, in with the new. The younger generation is pushing forward. Times sure are changing.

title: Jichen
content:
[Objective: (Daytime on the Rooftop)]
Jichen: Hey, we got a big crowd today. This is great.
Jichen: Any more than this and my eyes won't be able to keep up.
Jichen: ...
Jichen: It's those brats again... I told them not to mess with the guests' stuff. What's so interesting about those walking suitcases anyway?
Jichen: This won't do, I need to go over and have a word with them.

title: Jichen
content:
[Objective: (Nighttime sitting near Ruisheng stall)]
Jichen: See those Midnight Rangers?
Jichen: What a relief. I was worried my old bones wouldn't last much longer, but now there's someone to carry on after me.
[Dialogue Option]  Why is that?
[Dialogue Option]  Have you crossed paths with the Midnight Rangers as well?
Jichen: You asked the right question. There's a story behind it. Only a handful of young Mt. Firmament locals know about it.
Jichen: Actually, Jiye and I are town guardians.
Jichen: When we were young, we learned to fight from a master, before deciding to follow his footsteps and become guardians.
[Dialogue Option]  Town guardians? You protect Hongzhen?
Jichen: Yes. Speaking of which, Hongzhen has been through some really tough times. Ever since the TD Outbreak, the elders established a tradition of having guardians.
Jichen: From then on, we guardians have been tasked with keeping watch from high paces all day, ready to alert everyone at the slightest sign of trouble.
Jichen: Hehe, let me toot my own horn for a moment - Jiye and I were the first ones to sense the Temporal Disruption and notify everyone.
Jichen: But the disruption was just an accident. Hongzhen hasn't had major problems for years under the Sentinel's blessings.
Jichen: So we are the only guardians left in Hongzhen from our generation.
Jichen: Ever since Mt. Firmament opened, Midnight Rangers are stationed here. Saw 'em today, young and full of spirit. More impressive than Jiye and I ever were.
Jichen: So I thought maybe it's time these two old fogeys hang it up.
Jichen: However, Jiye is just too stubborn, especially in his old age.
Jichen: Well, I can't blame him, really. He's been at it for most of his life and just can't let go.

title: Jichen
subsection: (On the rooftop ontop of Souvenir Shop with Jiye)
content:
[Objective: (On the rooftop ontop of Souvenir Shop with Jiye)]
Jichen: Nothing suspicious happened last night, right?
Jiye: Everything's fine...
Jiye: You?
Jichen: Same old, same old for the both of us.
Jichen: Say, since the Midnight Rangers are here, shouldn't we retire?
Jiye: ...
Jichen: Look at you with that stubborn temper of yours. I was just spewing random thoughts. Why are you taking it so seriously?
Jiye: ...
Jichen: Sigh. You know, the  future of Hongzhen is in young people's hands. It's time we let it go.

title: Jieda
content:
Jieda: Did Luo lock you out again, Xichuan? What happened this time?

Xiluo: I! WANT! TO! EAT! YUAN'S! FLAVORS!

Xichuan: Hmph... There's your answer. Business hasn't been good these last two days, so I told him no.

Xichuan: Then he went and locked the door on me, and I don't have the key.

Jieda: Don't worry, let me handle it. I'll get it open for you without a scratch.

title: Jieda
content:
Xiluo: (*Voice behind the door*) You again! Don't you dare open this door! Aren't you Ministry of Development people supposed to be busy working overtime anyway? Why are you here?!

Jieda: Heh, I appreciate your concern, boy. But don't worry, cracking this lock is easy.

Xiluo: (*Voice behind the door*) Don't you open it! Don't! Mama, tell him to leave. Promise you'll take me to eat Cloudward Stew, Sizzling Jade Stir-fry, Crab Braised Fish, and Little Snowy Moons, and I'll open up right now!

Xichuan: You little rascal... We went two days ago! With everything happening both inside the Hold and at home, we can't afford to eat out every day. Be good. Open the door. Mama will take you to Yuan's Flavors once I sell the last batch of goods.

Xiluo: (*Voice behind the door*) No, no, no... I want to go now!

title: Jieda
content:
Xiluo: (*Voice behind the door*) No, no, no... I want to go now!



Jieda: Xichuan, let me handle this. Listen... I know it's not my place to say, but you might be spoiling him. If this keeps up...

Xichuan: Sigh... I know. His father passed early, and I... I simply want to give him what I can.

Xichuan: But you're right. Luo's getting older. I can't keep treating him like a little boy. Thank you...

title: Jingran/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_01_title              = Thoughts: I
|vo_01_01_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg
|vo_01_01_tx                 = Lemme tell you something funny. I was at the Huizhen Plaza the other day, and I spot this guy waving around a copy of Mirage Seeker's Tales, telling people that he suspects that the "Cat of the Nether Lamp" really did all that stuff. I tell him it's all made up. Pure fiction. And you believe it? He doesn't buy a second of it. Guy flips the book open right there and starts arguing with me! Insists the details are too authentic to be made-up. Then he starts retelling the tales. Characters, scenes, all the twists and turns... Next thing I know, I was totally hooked. Why are you laughing? I couldn't have written the stories better myself. If that tickles your curiosity—how about I reenact the bit for you?

title: Jingran/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_02_title              = Thoughts: II
|vo_01_02_intimacy           = 1
|vo_01_02_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg
|vo_01_02_tx                 = Why do I write? Honestly, I never thought anyone would actually read this stuff. I was down in the Mirage Realms all the time. Every time I came back, a bunch of kids would camp out in the alley for storytime. So I'd have to spin tales on the spot—an ancient well that draws water by itself, paper dolls wandering at midnight, that sort of thing... Eventually, the crowd got out of hand. So I figured I might as well write these down—that way they can read them whenever they want. Better than getting mobbed every time I walk home, right?

title: Jingran/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_03_title              = Thoughts: III
|vo_01_03_intimacy           = 2
|vo_01_03_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg
|vo_01_03_tx                 = Turns out my most "loyal" audience is this wretched thing of a cat beside me—I don't care if it wants to hear it. It leeches off my life, the least it can do is keep me company, right? Look, I know it's eating away at my years. Doesn't bother me though. I never cared to ride the sunrise-sunset cycle. I want a life so bright that it burns. Blaze like the sun or scatter like ashes. Who wants some half-living, half-dead eternity? That's not a life worth having.

title: Jingran/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_04_title              = Thoughts: IV
|vo_01_04_intimacy           = 3
|vo_01_04_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg
|vo_01_04_tx                 = I've been on my own for a long time. That's just how this line of work goes. You step into the Mirage Realm alone, don't look back, and you sure as hell don't wait around for anybody. Cut your ties clean to move free. When I infiltrated Zhuojun Atelier, I had one thought and one thought only: blood debts get paid in blood. Everything else was noise. Always figured being alone suited me just fine. No attachments means no concerns. But after fighting alongside you... I allowed myself a rare thought: If I ever have to go back into the Mirage Realm—having you there... maybe my work'll feel like less of a drag.

title: Jingran/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_05_title              = Thoughts: V
|vo_01_05_intimacy           = 4
|vo_01_05_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg
|vo_01_05_tx                 = I've seen all kinds of people and the choices they make. There are those who spend their lives reaching for the light—and those like me who dive deep into the dark. You're one who walks in the light. You're here to save. But not me. My path goes downward. Even so, this encounter showed me things I didn't know I was missing. Guess I could say... you taught me a few things. Like I said, aside from my family, there wasn't much I cared to hold onto. But with you in it, this world doesn't seem completely drab. So—thanks. Next time we meet, I'll bring you something interesting from beneath.

title: Jingran/Voicelines
content:
|vo_02_01_title              = Jingran's Hobby
|vo_02_01_file               = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg
|vo_02_01_tx                 = My hobby? Exploring the Mirage Realms, obviously. With these eyes, I can see all those hidden frequencies the moment I step inside. Lost curios, unsigned scrolls... they practically start yelling into my ears the second I get close. Gives me a headache. But, sometimes, you hear things the living people never will, so... I'd call that a win.

title: Jingran/Voicelines
content:
|vo_02_02_title              = Jingran's Trouble
|vo_02_02_file               = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg
|vo_02_02_tx                 = My troubles? Sigh. My sleep schedule, maybe? Inspiration only hits at night, and the prime time to explore the Mirage Realms is after dusk. One thing leads to another... well, you get it. Sometimes people find me in the day, dozing off at my desk. Jolt me awake and I'd swear I was seeing ghosts in broad daylight. Bottom line, it's the night that's too short — that's what.

title: Jingran/Voicelines
content:
|vo_02_03_title              = Favorite Food
|vo_02_03_file               = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg
|vo_02_03_tx                 = If you must know... sweets. Especially the steamed rice cake my Shifu's old lady makes, fresh out of the steamer—soft, fluffy, topped with shredded dried fruits. That fresh, subtle sweetness... Tsk, now I'm craving it. You should come try it next time. She's been nagging me to bring you over forever.

|vo_02_04_title              = Disliked Food
|vo_02_04_file               = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg
|vo_02_04_tx                 = ...I don't have the patience to appreciate foods. But the worst has to be milk. Turns my stomach. Can't do sour either. And, of course, don't like anything bitter—is it food or medication?

title: Jingran/Voicelines
content:
|vo_02_05_title              = Ideals
|vo_02_05_file               = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg
|vo_02_05_tx                 = Muyu's dead. I've had my revenge, so I guess I'm back to having way too much free time. But a Nethermancer stays a Nethermancer—same old life, same old back and forth trips to the Mirage Realms. And since things have finally quieted down, I can actually get back to writing. You know, walking around the city, I keep hearing people wondering when the latest chapter of Mirage Seeker's Tales is going to drop. Gets on my nerves... Once I finish the next chapter, I'm digging deeper into what was behind Muyu. No way one man stirred up all that mess in Xuanfang alone. Whoever's been pulling strings, I'll find every last one of them, and grind their bones to powdered dust.

title: Jingran/Voicelines
content:
|vo_03_01_title              = Chat: I
|vo_03_01_file               = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg
|vo_03_01_tx                 = This pendant was left by my parents. To be honest, I can barely remember their faces anymore. But I remember every birthday, they'd take me up to that mountain temple to pray. The place used to be thick with incense smoke. Even in the dead of winter, the place was gilded in warm gold. They'd place this pendant bearing my name before the altar, heads bowed, all faithful, praying to whatever was listening. These days, I no longer believe in some higher powers upstairs or all that destiny nonsense. And it's not the fortune sticks or the wishes I cling to. It's the sunlight after snow... and the sight of them walking by each side of me, their hands holding mine.

title: Jingran/Voicelines
content:
|vo_03_02_title              = Chat: II
|vo_03_02_file               = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg
|vo_03_02_tx                 = Want to know the story behind these pupils? The green one's the original. The gold one? That came after my Forte awakened. Took me a while to stop flinching at this new look when I catch myself in mirror, not gonna lie. Turns out, it lets me see the scattered frequencies in shadowy corners of the world. Kinda like those "Yin-Yang" eyes people talk about. Come to think of it... your eyes are gold too, but yours don't look like anyone else's. On you... they look perfectly golden.

|vo_04_02_tx                 = There's an old story. A girl went looking for a Transcendent in the mountains, panicked when she ran into Tacet Discords, and fell off a cliff. |vo_04_05_tx                 = Our masters were old acquaintances. When I was a kid, the old man couldn't stop talking about him, "He's young, but his blade is already incredibly fast." |vo_05_01_title              = Birthday Wishes
|vo_05_01_file               = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg
|vo_05_01_tx                 = Happy birthday, Rover. I never cared much for celebrating my own, but Shifu's old lady and my junior wouldn't let theirs pass without some theater. So every year they rope me into it—hanging lanterns, buying sweets, making longevity noodles... Done it enough times that I've actually gotten decent at the grunt work. So, naturally, the prep is all on me now. You know me. I don't offer incense, don't bow to altars, and I sure don't go asking the divinities for favors. So I can't pray for good fortune on someone else's behalf. Then again... if it's you, I don't reckon there's much point in praying anyway. Haven't seen much that you can't handle. So today, just enjoy being the birthday boy. Leave everything else to me.

title: Jingyue
content: Jingyue is a researcher found at the Research Institute above Starward Riseway in Lahai-Roi. He can be with his colleague, Adonis, who is coaching an Intern.

title: Jingyue
content:
Jingyue: Scientific research? In theory, it's simple. Form a hypothesis, design the test, collect the data, write the paper, publish...
Adonis: That's the ideal scenario.
Intern: So... what's the not-so-ideal scenario?
Adonis: Form a hypothesis, design the test, collect data while dodging Void Storms. Find the results are insignificant. Tweak the parameters. Discover an outlier. Spend three months chasing that ghost...
Intern: That sounds really hard... But then you get to have your work published, right?
Adonis: Then you propose a new hypothesis.
Intern: ...What?
Jingyue: ...Will you stop traumatizing the intern?

title: Jingzhi
content:
Jingzhi: New faces... Are you from outside Jinzhou?
[Dialogue Option]  You could say that.

Jingzhi: Things are better now, but on the front lines, soldiers are still risking their lives every day.
Jingzhi: Huh... Tell me, young friend, do you think I'll live to see the end of the war as a veteran?
[Dialogue Option]  The war will never end.
Jingzhi: Yes... the war never seems to end.
Jingzhi: The soldiers will never disappear.
[Dialogue Option]  You will live to see its end.
Jingzhi: You think so...?
Jingzhi: If I can't make it, young friend, please bear witness to that day for me.
[Dialogue Option]  I don't know.
Jingzhi: I had a dream last night. It was about a future without war.
Jingzhi: When I woke up, I realized I was dreaming about the past.
Jingzhi: I'm old now and have spent decades of my youth under fire.
Jingzhi: These days, I'm just reminiscing. Please forgive this old man.
Jingzhi: I'll stay a little longer... and then I'll be on my way.

title: Jingzhu
content: Jingzhu is a quest exclusive NPC that first appears in the Side Quest Silver-haired Echo Trainer - I.

title: Jingzhu
content:
He is a retired member of the Vanguard of the Midnight Rangers, and is married to his former captain, Linghan. Having pushed herself too greatly in battle, Linghan had fallen ill after a major victory and after that experienced gradual memory loss. They are the only surviving members of their squad, and Jingzhu intends to win Linghan's heart again, having promised to never leave her alone. Yingying is their grandchild.

During his time in the Midnight Rangers, he and Yhan knew each other well, with Yhan respecting him greatly. He is said to have used a Frostbite Tortoise Echo to shield his squad in battles.

title: Jinhsi
Jinhsi/Backstory
content: A kindhearted and driven young woman, Jinhsi is an altruistic figure who cares deeply for those in Jinzhou. Since her youth, it's been made clear that Jinhsi seeks for a peaceful world and strives to reach out for such an ideal. Being driven, she seeks out those who could support and aid her, such as her mentor, Changli, and isn't afraid to ask for help. Whenever she is presented with a problem, she muses over a solution, and is guided in helping those in need. Throughout her position as Magistrate, Jinhsi would always put others before her, holding no ulterior motives and only wishes to uphold her people's wishes and happiness. Being particularly compulsive to the point where at times she neglects her own health, causing some worry among those who care for her. Jinhsi's earnest wish to bring peace is enough that when faced with a crisis, such as the one coming from Mt. Firmament, she is willing to risk her own life. However, Jinhsi acclaims that while she may endanger herself, she would only do so as a last resort and is willing to find alternative solutions.

title: Jinhsi/Backstory
content: Jinhsi is also protective of those she has grown attached towards. From the people of Jinzhou, to Jué, whom she willingly defied if it meant ensuring the Sentinel's life is safe, having no desire for a solution that simply ends in death as the first proposal.  Instead, she decides that defying fate and overcoming the odds as her preferable choice if it means she can protect all she cares for and lead Jinzhou into an age where the Sentinels may not be needed for constant defense. This outlook and her continuous actions in caring for others have thus garnered forth much respect, whereas before many had once doubted her due to her age.

title: Jinhsi/Backstory
content: Jinhsi is a petite young woman with fair skin, white eyes and long, heel-length silver-white hair with turquoise strands styled into elegant looped twin tails. She has a beauty mark high up on her right cheek, and one around her left thigh.

title: Jinhsi/Backstory
content: She wears a form-fitting short black dress, partially concealed by a modified sleeveless white vest adorned with intricate gold accents, evoking a refined, A draconic-inspired white and gold belt cinches her waist. Her legs are clad in striking white thigh-high boots with high heels, emphasizing her poised stance. Draped over her shoulders is a pale turquoise cape, stitched together in an intricate pattern, flowing behind her like rippling waves. Protective armor plating rests on her shoulders, seamlessly blending elegance with functionality. Her hair is tied up with delicate, ornamental hairpieces that match with the rest of her outfit.

title: Jinyue
content:
[Objective: (Talk before opening the chest)]
Jinyue: Hmm... Umm... How do I open this box...
[Dialogue Option]  What's the matter?
Jinyue: Eh? No, nothing's wrong. Well, okay, something's wrong...
Jinyue: It's this chest next to me. I found it after a lot of searching, but I can't open it.
Jinyue: How about this, if you can open it, whatever is inside is yours!

title: Jinyue
content:
[Objective: (Talk again)]
Jinyue: Do you think you can open it? If you can, whatever is inside should be rightfully yours!
[Dialogue Option]  A chest?
Jinyue: Yes, the chest right next to me.
Jinyue: I've tried everything, but it's still locked tight.
Jinyue: I love treasure hunting. I went through a lot to bring it back, but now  I can't get it open...
[Dialogue Option]  You don't want what's in the chest?
Jinyue: It's not that I don't want it, but if you can open it, I should give you a reward.
Jinyue: I'm big on puzzles and treasure hunting. I found this chest that just won't open. I've been trying to unlock it for ages.
Jinyue: But after all this time, I still can't get it open. I've lost interest in what's inside. I just want to see it open!
Jinyue: So, if you can open this chest, whatever's inside is yours!

title: Jinyue
content:
[Objective: (Talk after opening the chest)]
Jinyue: Impressive! You actually opened it!
Jinyue: Now, spill the beans. How did you do it?
Jinyue: I've been trying for ages... Using brute force to pry it open didn't work. Did you try kicking it?
Jinyue: Or... or did you use some kind of Resonance ability?

Jinyue: Alright. Time for a new puzzle. Where's the next one?

title: Jinyue
content:

Jinyue: How did you open that box? Tell me when you have a moment.

title: Jinyue
content:

Jinyue: Didn't I also find a treasure map last time?
Jinyue: Where did I put that treasure map...
[Dialogue Option]  Treasure map?
Jinyue: Yes, yes! I love solving puzzles and treasure hunting. Sometimes I find treasure maps just for fun.
Jinyue: When I find the map I was looking for, I'll show it to you. Maybe you can solve what I couldn't!

Jinyue: I'll tell you once I find the treasure map!

content: Jiye and Jichen are former Hongzhen town guardians. Although their services are no longer needed, they still watch over the now peaceful Hongzhen.

subsection: (On the rooftop on top of the Souvenir Shop with Jichen)
content:
[Objective: (On the rooftop on top of the Souvenir Shop with Jichen)]

title: Joanne
content:
Joanne is an NPC located in .

During the daytime (6:00 AM - 5:59 PM), she can be seen standing alone, and when interact with her, she will start talking about the shipping documents for the merchant ship.

While at night (6:00 PM - 05:59 AM), she can be seen talking with Hector about granting him two days of free time in the Septimont.

title: Joanne
content:
[Objective: (During the daytime)]
Joanne: How did the shipping documents for the merchant ship to Septimont end up getting held up? Ugh, looks like I'll have to work overtime.
[Dialogue Option]  Is the process for merchant ships really that strict?
Joanne: Oh, not at all! I think the issue is with the documents I submitted.
Joanne: Like Ragunna, Septimont is an autonomous city-state under Rinascita, and the shipping routes between the two aren't tightly regulated.
Joanne: Sorry, I should have explained that more clearly. You might not know this, but Rinascita is a nation of a thousand islands, composed of several city-states.
Joanne: So usually, travel between city-states is pretty smooth and frequent.
Joanne: If you've ever been to the Ragunna port, you'd see lots of cargo ships getting ready to set sail.
[Dialogue Option]  What kinds of goods do they trade between city-states?
Joanne: It varies, depending on what resources each area has to offer.
Joanne: For example, Ragunna's ships are mainly loaded with local spices and sulfur, as well as medicines made from rare deep-sea plants.
Joanne: These goods are sent to Septimont in exchange for large amounts of Tacetite that Ragunna needs.

title: Joanne
content:
[Objective: (At night)]
Joanne: Hector, I'll grant you two days of free time in the Septimont.
Joanne: Return to Ragunna on time in two days and report to me at the bank.
Hector: Aunt Joanne... you're drilling this into my ears...
Joanne: That's not how you address me! Mr. Hector.
Hector: Yes, ma'am... Lady Joanne.
Joanne: Before we set sail, you swore to Imperator.
Hector: Hail Imperator. I, Hector, swear I'll never again bet on gladiator fights in the Septimont's underground casinos—
Hector: Or let me perish at sea, never to return home!
Joanne: If you're going to perish, fine. But don't drag down your colleagues or the cargo; they've done nothing wrong.
Joanne: You can watch matches, but if I find you at the betting tables again—",
Hector: —you'll fire me on the spot, freeze all my accounts, and have me sent to Averardo Vault's underground worksite.
Joanne: I promised your mother I'd take care of you. Don't make her shed any more tears.

title: Joshua
content: Joshua is a deceased quest exclusive NPC that appears in  as a Retroact Rain phantom.

title: Joshua
content: He was a well-known pianist and the mentor of Arin. Twenty years prior to the start of Wuthering Waves, he sacrificed his life to save Siran after a Tacet Discord attack during his performance at the outdoor theater on Nostalgia Isle.

title: Juan
content:
Juan: How do you reveal your feelings for someone in a way that's romantic yet sincere...
Juan: Lady Rita still waits for my confession... Oh, the torment of love!

title: Juan
content:
Juan: "You are the best thing that's ever happened to me."
Juan: "You get my heart racing and give me butterflies."
[Dialogue Option]  What?
Juan: Oh, sorry! I was just practicing for a romantic confession.
Juan: What do you think of those lines?
[Dialogue Option]  Feels a bit stiff.
Juan: Oh, my word. That's absolutely it! You must be someone who really knows their romantic talk. Please, give me some tips!
[Dialogue Option]  Maybe try something more poetic?
Juan: Poetic? Let's see...
Juan: "I tried to pluck two stars from the sky for you, only to find they were nowhere near as bright as your eyes."
[Dialogue Option]  Much better, but still too cliché.
Juan: Cliché? So you're saying I should make my confession feel like it's tailor-made for my love?
[Dialogue Option]  Yep. And don't forget that trick with the eyes.
Juan: Copy that!
Juan: "Rover, you always glide past me, yet seem more distant than the moon itself."
Juan: "I yearn for tomorrow to bring you back, yet you remain unaware that my tomorrows fade into shadow without you."
[Dialogue Option]  Not bad. It sounded like you meant it.
Juan: "I wove webs to tighten the bond between our souls, only to end up ensnaring myself."
Juan: "At this very moment, your fleeting words intensify my pain while granting me a brief, sweet happiness."
[Dialogue Option]  Err. I think that's enough... You're doing great.
Juan: "Go ahead and mock my recklessness, for I want to kiss your heart and leave my mark on your chest."
Juan: "I want to breathe in the fragrance between your fingers, reaching right into your heart's desires."

title: Juan
content:
[Objective: (Night, Septimont - Capitoline Hill City)]
Juan: Rover, I didn't expect to see you here. Perhaps the moon has witnessed my prayers and sent you to me?
[Dialogue Option]  What brings you here?
Juan: To seek love. I hope to find my true love within this glorious city...
Juan: I kissed the city's crimson walls to offer my most precious kiss, hoping she would accept my feelings...
[Dialogue Option]  Have you found success?
Juan: No... but I've learned how to confess my feelings.
Juan: The city of glory taught me that passion is the key to confession. Hence, I share transform myself, just to let her know that...
Juan: I love you! I love you with every drop of passion within me!!!!!
[Dialogue Option]  ???!

title: Jules

title: Juleson
content: Juleson is a graduating male student NPC from New Federation, found talking about his graduation plans with his classmate from Huanglong, Jiushao.

title: Juleson
content:
Juleson: Any idea where you're heading after graduation?
Jiushao: Huaxu Academy. With warning signs of a Threnodian revival in Jinzhou, every city-state in Huanglong is speeding up its military R&D. My country needs me now more than ever. What's your plan?
Juleson: Same idea, heading back to the New Fed. Got a position at Harmoway Medicine. Who knows... maybe next time we meet, we'll be on opposite sides.
Jiushao: Hard to say. At least in the fight against the Lament, we'll always stand together.
Juleson: Heh... I hope to see you and your work at next year's World Expo.
Jiushao: You will, I promise. Take care of yourself, my friend.
Juleson: You too, old buddy.

title: Julia
content: Julia is a female NPC who appears at Jamie's Farm in Whisperwind Haven. She's part of the Jamie Family.

title: Julia
content:
Julia: Lucio's been heading out to distant fields every day lately... They say the grass around here isn't good for the cattle anymore.
Julia: It's almost Pela's birthday again. I should buy her some interesting storybooks this year too...

title: Julia
content:
Julia: Lucio's been heading out to distant fields every day lately... They say the grass around here isn't good for the cattle anymore.
Julia: It's almost Pela's birthday again. I should buy her some interesting storybooks this year too...
Julia: "Beyond Solaris," "Septimont Holiday," "The Legend of Violinist 2000," "Theatre Paradiso"... Pela has read all these classics.
Julia: Oh, sorry, I was lost in thought... My friend, which storybook on the table do you think would be suitable for my daughter?
[Dialogue Option]  The Montelli.
Julia: The Montelli... a story centered on the upper echelons of the Montelli family, steeped in themes of crime, conspiracy, assassination, and betrayal. It's just too dark.
[Dialogue Option]  John Wicktorio.
Julia: John Wicktorio... Some bad people destroyed the loyal Echo of a retired Montelli family accountant, who then revenges by exposing the old nobility's shady dealings... I don't like it.
[Dialogue Option]  Pirates of Ragunna.
Julia: Pirates of Ragunna... Recounts the adventures of a legendary captain with a morally ambiguous nature. The treasure he seeks and the spoils he plunders are, in truth, the smiles of the people. This story has been banned by The Order.
[Dialogue Option]  The Card Rider Guga.
Julia: The Card Rider Guga... It tells of a nameless hero who became a knight to stop the suffering of people, battling creatures known as Threnodian... This story is just too far-fetched.
[Dialogue Option]  The Holy Echo War.
Julia: The Holy Echo War... It tells the story of seven Echo controllers who, driven by their own desires, entered a brutal survival contest in the distant past. It's a tale of ruthless battles and deadly pursuits... This is way too cruel.
[Dialogue Option]  None of these fit.
Julia: That's true... I guess Pela has outgrown these kinds of stories. I should think it over myself.

title: Julian
content: Julian is a female NPC who appears at the Order of the Deep, Ragunna. During the daytime, she can be seen teaching children hymns of the Order, while at night, she prays in front of a fountain.

title: Julian
content:
Julian: Through such a bright and shining grace...
Julian: Like the stars, we are piously united together...
Julian: Under your guidance, we rise from the waters...
Julian: Sacred and pure, reaching a place where the soul can breathe...

title: Julian
content:
[Objective: (First interaction)]
Julian: Alright, everyone, let's take a little break!
[Dialogue Option]  The children's voices are beautiful.
Julian: Indeed! Children have the purest souls, and their voices ring clear—perfect for singing hymns.
[Dialogue Option]  I'd love to understand the meaning behind the lyrics.
Julian: Absolutely. The hymns of the Order are themed around our teachings, especially our motto of "Salvation, Ascension, and Unity."
Julian: Once, the Sentinel's bright gaze pierced the darkness, leaving us out of endless wandering and binding us together as a people.
Julian: We drift on this world like plankton in the ocean... but it is the Sentinel who raises us up, teaching us to breathe once more...
Julian: In the end, we will find "Unity" again, hand in hand as we cross the final tide, reaching heaven's gate and receiving salvation...
[Dialogue Option]  Some of this is hard to follow...
Julian: That's alright. As The Codex reminds us—every revelation is already there, waiting in our hearts.
[Dialogue Option]  But the hymn sounds beautiful.
Julian: The hymns aim to awaken that truth. As The Codex reminds us—every revelation is already there, waiting in our hearts.
Julian: Still, I hear the Order is working on a new hymn. Personally, I feel this version tugs my heartstrings more... the new lyric lacks the rhythmic beauty of the original.
Julian: The new hymn leans heavily into "Unity" and expands on the interpretation of "The Deep"... probably to promote the Order's renown.
Julian: Yet no matter how rough the tides of this world may be, I believe that one day we'll see—behind us, we've always had wings of grace, ready to carry us forward.
Julian: Just as the old legends say, and as the Sentinel hopes: Young hearts, be bold—go forth and make miracles happen!

title: Julian
content:
[Objective: (Second interaction at 6:00 AM to 11:59 AM)]
Julian: No matter how rough the tides of this world may be, one day we'll see—behind us, we've always had wings of grace, ready to carry us forward.
Julian: Just as the old legends say, and as the Sentinel hopes: Young hearts, be bold—go forth and make miracles happen!

title: Julian
content:
[Objective: ( Missing condition )]

Julian: We have a new member joining the choir today, so let's all make them feel welcome!

title: Juno
content: Juno is a young girl NPC found at the Order of the Deep with Acolyte Alice. At night, she is caught by her father, Molvan, for wandering the garden and digging up a treasure left behind by Phoebe. Afterwards, she no longer wanders at night and her father strictly watches her during the day nearby.

title: Juno
content:
[Objective: (Day)]
Juno: Alice, when will Phoebe bring the Echoes back here?
Juno: Since she and the Echoes left, even the little  sea anemones here have been looking a bit droopy.
Alice: Phoebe?
Juno: Yeah! Every time Phoebe comes here, she tells us new stories.
Juno: Our elders always say the other side is dangerous, full of bad people. But the new stories Phoebe brings back are always exciting!
Juno: Whenever she tells us a story, a bunch of Echoes would join in and perform with her, like a little play—it's incredible!
Juno: I haven't seen her in ages... Do you know when she'll come back?
Alice: I'll pass your message on to her. Knowing her, I'm sure she'll come as soon as she has a moment.
Juno: Really? That's wonderful!

title: Juno
subsection: 17:00-05:59 , Juno starts wandering around the garden.
content:
[Objective: 17:00-05:59 , Juno starts wandering around the garden.]
Juno: Little Sea Anemone's first outing... it's a bit nerve wracking.
Juno: Oh, right! Sister Phoebe gave me a little gift, and said she hid it in the garden!
Juno: Where could it be... could it be here?
Juno: Damn! It's a telescope! That's amazing! Now I can see the bustling Ragunna!
Juno: Maybe I'll even spot Little Sea Anemone and Sister Phoebe!

metadata.subsection: 17:00-05:59 , Juno starts wandering around the garden.

title: Juno
subsection: Following morning, Juno is being interrogated by her father.
content:
[Objective: Following morning, Juno is being interrogated by her father.]
Molvan: Juno, hold out your hand.
Juno: Father... I...
Molvan: A telescope? Who gave this to you?
Juno: ...
Molvan: That little Acolyte with a group of Echoes again?
Juno: No... no! I... I found it... on my own...
Molvan: Did she teach you to lie like this?
Juno: I...
