Lyosroth
content: ' is a NPC male Royan Shepherd who can be found next to a Giant Soliskin in Soliseed Plains. He asks Rover for help in locating and guiding the wandering Soliskin back to Bjartr Woods.

title: Lyosroth
content:
[Objective: (First time dialogue)]
Lyosroth: Hello, Rover. Forgive me for being so blunt, but there's something I was hoping you could help us with.
Lyosroth: The bulk of the Shepherds at Bjartr Woods are engaged in tasks lately, with each having to look after over twenty Soliskins.
Lyosroth: And over a hundred Soliskin descended from the Solvein Canopy again just yesterday alone...
Lyosroth: With so few Shepherds, many Soliskin are now wandering aimlessly around Lahai-Roi... And of course, there are those that simply ran off to who knows where.
Lyosroth: We would search for them ourselves, but we can't afford to leave the ones under our care...
Lyosroth: If it's not too much to ask, could you help us find the missing Soliskin?
[Dialogue Option]  Hide-and-seek. My favorite game!
[Dialogue Option]  Do I get paid?
Lyosroth: Of course.
[Dialogue Option]  Glad to help.
Lyosroth: You may find me with the Giant Soliskin at the heart of Soliseed Plains once you've retrieved a Soliskin.
Lyosroth: Our rewards await. We're counting you, Rover.

title: Lyosroth
content:
[Objective: (First time delivering Soliseeds)]
Giant Soliskin: Luu? Luu-Luu! (*Excited cheeps*)
Lyosroth: A Soliskin has just returned to us, Rover! Was it your doing?
Lyosroth: It's astonishing how you managed to find this lost Soliskin so quickly! Wait, what's that in your hand?
Lyosroth: It's a Soliseed of Essehalo! Did you receive this from the lost Soliskin, Rover?
Lyosroth: Soliskin produce Soliseeds from their Essehalos, and treat them as their own offspring.
Lyosroth: They only give them to people they trust. It seems seeking your help was the right decision, Rover!
Giant Soliskin: Chuu, luuluu! (*Excited cheeps*)
Lyosroth: The Giant Soliskin shows its thanks and would like you to accept this gift.
Lyosroth: Please, take it. We will have more gifts waiting for you if you manage to find more Soliskin and Soliseeds!

title: Lyubov
content:
Lyubov is an NPC that appears in Montelli Quarter, Ragunna from 6:00 AM 5:59 PM. She can only be interacted with from 2:00 PM to 5:59 PM.

From 6:00 AM to 1:59 PM, she can be seen thinking about what souvenir she should buy. And from 2:00 PM to 5:59 PM, she can be seen talking with Sofia and Sergio

title: Lyubov
content:
[Objective: (6:00 AM to 1:59 PM)]
Lyubov: Which souvenirs should I pick...
Lyubov: A Volcanic Windchime from the Septimont... a Jade Clam from Riccioli... or maybe one of each!

title: Lyubov
content:
[Objective: (2:00 PM to 5:59 PM)]
Lyubov: Excuse me, could you get me this clam! And this wind chime too.
Sergio: Alright, that'll be 220 Monnaie.
Lyubov: What? What's a Monnaie?
Sofia: You're mistaken, Mister!
Sofia: Monnaie is long outdated by now!
Sofia: Now we use Shell Credit for payments as the rest of Solaris does. Monnaie has become just a souvenir of Ragunna.
Sergio: Oh, yeah... you are right.
Sergio: It feels like just yesterday we were still using Monnaie... I'm getting old...
Sergio: Now I remember the time when Averardo Bank collected Monnaie to exchange new notes for us.
Sergio: Oh, right, that'll be 220 Shell Credits, young lady.

title: Maccus
content: Maccus is a male NPC located in Capitoline Hill City down in the arena hallway.

title: Maccus
content:
Maccus: Welcome to Colosseum Olymdos. Is there anything you'd wish to learn about this place?
[Dialogue Option]  About the Colosseum...
Maccus: Colosseum Olymdos is the most renowned arena in the city, and the hosting ground of the largest Echo tournament ever to exist—the Great Agon.
Maccus: Though the oval-shaped arena was built six hundred years ago, we apply the most advanced and modern technologies within every match.
Maccus: One can even say that the Colosseum is a microcosm of the city of Septimont.
[Dialogue Option]  About the Great Agon...
Maccus: The Great Agon, held every four years, is the grandest event there is in Septimont!
Maccus: Gladiators gear up for battle, with their dreams and passion at their shoulders as they march into the arena!
Maccus: You can feel everyone's anticipation brewing as we wait for the reveal of this year's champion!
[Dialogue Option]  About the teams...
Maccus: We've got quite a big competition this year... The most popular ones so far are Beasts Beneath, Vulcan Mining, Blue Furies...
Maccus: And of course, the team led by Rover and Lupa!
Maccus: Which teams will contend for the championship? Let's find out!

title: Mae
content:
Mae is an NPC who appears at the bar in Montelli Quarter, Ragunna. She can only be seen there from 6:00 AM to 5:59 PM.

After you interact with her, you will get a bottle of Nectarwine

title: Mae
content:
Mae: We've some really interesting options in the new wine list.
Mae: "The Montelli Lounge draws inspiration from the Carnevale for its cocktails..."
Mae: But honestly, isn't it a bit too lonely to drink alone...?

title: Mae
content:
Mae: The ball doesn't start for another three hours.
Mae: Say, why don't you come to sit with me? Don't be so stiff.
Mae: This round is on me, don't worry—I won't get you drunk.
Mae: It's best to feel a bit tipsy at a time like this...

title: Maeve
content: '  is a Priestess NPC found praying at the entrance of Tetragon Temple.

title: Maeve
content:
(Under the hands of a Priestess, even a blank wall may transform with quiet revelation.)

(But the Priestess averts her eyes from the flickering flames or fate, as if one more look will burn her.)

She trembles. She cannot bear to look. She cannot bring herself to paint.)

[Dialogue Option]  Murals don't paint themselves.

Maeve: I'm afraid of seeing too clearly. Once I see fate's full shape, I might never escape that future.

Maeve: And if I falter or lose my way... what will happen to those who look to me for guidance?

Maeve: Grandmother Lillibet once said, "Know your fate, and prepare for it. Only then can we find firm ground on the path it takes us."

Maeve: It's okay... as long as I remember that, I won't be lost.

title: Magnus
content: ' is a male NPC Gladiator found North of the Colosseum, speaking to Celia. He wishes to become a singer, but fears disappointing his family who looks down on painters and musicians as most Septimontians do.

title: Magnus
content:
;Magnus Such alluring melodies, but my family...
;Celia Share with me your troubles.
Magnus: Such beauty, your melody moves my soul, piercing the sorrows of my heart.
Celia: Thank you for the compliment. In return, please share with me your troubles.
Magnus: I, too, wish to pursue the path of music and create such enchanting melodies as you have. But as you can see, my family expects me to be a Gladiator.
Magnus: And I don't wish to... disappoint them.
Celia: Just as my melodies reached out to your heart, I believe you can also reach out to your family for approval.

;Magnus What am I supposed to do? Is my life gonna be in this tangled mess forever?
;Celia Easy, Magnus. You've had enough drinks for one night. You should rest...

title: Magnus
content:
[Objective: (After completing )]
;Magnus Did I reach the high note, Celia?
;Celia You did, but I think you can go even higher!
Magnus: Speaking to you that day may have been the best decision of my life. I've spoken to my parents and gained their approval.
Celia: No, the best decision you made was to listen to your heart. I am truly happy for you.
Celia: Come, now that you're free to pursue your dreams,  let's unleash our love of music together.
Magnus: Of course, Celia. There's so much I want to learn from you.

title: Mahe
content: Mahe is a shop NPC in . He is the owner of Mahe's Grocery Vendor.

title: Mahe
content:
Mahe: Great food, great value! Hello, what can I get for you today?
[Dialogue Option]  I want some ingredients.
[Dialogue Option]  Gourmet Rumors
Mahe: When making clear soup, add a couple more Edodes while simmering. It makes the soup more flavorful and the color brighter.
Mahe: But use seasoning sparingly to preserve the original taste of the ingredients. That's how you get the most delicious soup.
[Dialogue Option]  Have a chat

title: Mahe
content:
[Objective: (Morning)]
Mahe: Everything here is fresh, I promise. We handpick our veggies every morning, and the meat is fresh too.
Mahe: Even on their own with no seasonings, our ingredients simply burst with flavor!
Mahe: Just make sure to cook everything thoroughly to avoid any stomach troubles!
Mahe: Oh, and don't use any strange ingredients like... Gulpuffs.
Mahe: You know, one time a young girl came in with her toy sheep asking about Gulpuffs, saying she'd eaten them before and was fine.
Mahe: I mean, no way is that safe! If I ever find her parents, they're in for a serious lesson on food safety.

title: Mahe
content:
[Objective: (Night)]
Mahe: You've been visiting quite often lately. Bet you cook a lot in your free time!
Mahe: Me? I happen to know a thing or two about cooking.
Mahe: Has Panhua been talking your ear off about proper seasoning techniques? Well, let me give you the real secret to delicious food: preserving the ingredients' natural flavors.
Mahe: Take Milky Fish Soup for example. It only requires simple ingredients, but with care and dedication, you'll get incredible results.
Mahe: The fish becomes tender and melt-in-your-mouth, while the soup retains its fresh taste. No need to drown it in seasonings!
Mahe: In fact, I'm going to bring her a bowl right now and show her how it's done. I'll make her see the difference!
[Dialogue Option]  Leave

title: Maher
content: Maher is a Huanglong tourist NPC in Capitoline Hill City, Septimont.

title: Maher
content:
[Objective: (First interaction)]
Maher: Hello! You must be from Huanglong! I'm Maher. A word of advice: don't listen to these guys. I wouldn't lie to a fellow Huanglonger!
[Dialogue Option]  You're Mahe?
Maher: That's right, I'm Maher! Take it from me. Don't go with those guys to eat any so-called Septimont delicacies.
[Dialogue Option]  Do you sell eggs?
Maher: What? Eggs? No, no, no, you've got the wrong guy. But listen! Don't go with those guys to eat any so-called Septimont delicacies.
Maher: They took me to eat this "sardinpuca"...? "Serdinbaca"...? "Saltimbocca!" Anyway, the thing felt like it was beating up my tongue!
Maher: I'm still hurting from eating that... What kind of seasoning did they put... Hang on. Seasoning...
Maher: I got it! I got it! Thank you!
[Dialogue Option]  You're welcome?
[Dialogue Option]  But I didn't do anything...

title: Maher
content:
[Objective: (Second interaction)]
Maher: I've got it! This is a real business opportunity!
Maher: Do you know what the rarest commodity is when out at sea? Gold? Fresh fruit? Or...
[Dialogue Option]  Spices from Huanglong?
Maher: That's right. I've noticed these Septimontians like eating meat with heavy seasoning, and what's more, they like trying new things.
Maher: Huanglong spices taste very different from ones here. I've tried adding spices from Huanglong into Saltimbocca, resulting in some unique flavors.
Maher: So I want to sell Huanglong spices in Septimont.
Maher: What do you think? Will it work?
[Dialogue Option]  It'll work.
Maher: Wonderful! I'm going to make it big in Septimont!
[Dialogue Option]  I need to think about it.
Maher: Over time, I'm sure I'll get a solid footing in the Septimont spice market.
[Dialogue Option]  So you're an entrepreneur now?
Maher: Am I? So are you. I see you also have loads of sundries on your person. Could we be in the same profession?

title: Maher
content: The phonetic of Maher (马合) name is very similar to Mahe (马和), thus Rover's confusion and response.

title: Major Forbidden Archive
content: The Major Forbidden Archive is a Point of Interest located in . It's only unlocked after completing .

title: Major Forbidden Archive
content:
Entered during , the Major Forbidden Archive is the former Major Forbidden Archive that belonged to the Order of the Deep before the Dark Tide of Nimbus Sanctum swallowed it whole. The Major Forbidden Archive is where the Order stored the books, tales, and ideologies that were deemed dangerous.

Only the most devout servants of the Sentinel, Imperator, were permitted to serve the Major Forbidden Archive.

title: Mandragora Fisalia
content:
Mandragora Fisalia was the eldest daughter of the main line of the Fisalia family. She was the older sister of Hebenon Fisalia and the older cousin of Cantarella Fisalia. She disappeared during the Divine Trials, alongside Hebenon.

After resolving the mystery in , the truth of what happened to the missing girls are revealed.

title: Mandragora Fisalia
subsection: (Found at Port Riccioli amongst Riccioli Islands)
content:
[Objective: (Found at Port Riccioli amongst Riccioli Islands)]
"Mandra": I never imagined life could feel this carefree.
"Mandra": Just look at this vast scenery... It brings much calm to my heart.
"Hebe": Yeah, I feel the same way. A simple and quiet life. There's a beauty in it.
"Hebe": We have Cantarella to thank for this peace.
"Mandra": I feel reassured with her as the head of our family.
"Mandra": She's... she's everything a Maiden should be, more so than I could ever be. And as the head of Fisalia? She's unmatched.
"Mandra": For us, I think it's our turn to make the most of the world she saved for us. Let's live every day to its fullest.
"Hebe": Yes, and let's capture the beauty we find along the way! I'm sure she'll be happy to receive these photos!

title: Marccia
content:
' is a female NPC found talking to Marcos and Numerik discussing about Lupa. They appear during  by the elevator to enter Capitoline Hill City.

After the event of , Marccia is seen wearing a Gladiator outfit.

title: Marccia
content:
;Marccia You got this, Lupa! No matter how you do in the finals, I'll always support you!
;Numerik With her capabilities, the win's in the bag for sure! I want to get stronger too... Wish I could be in the same training room with Lupa...
;Marcos Is she really as tough as they say she is? I mean... could there be a chance she's cheating?

title: Marccia
content:
;Marcos Is she really as tough as they say she is? I mean... could there be a chance she's cheating?



[Dialogue Option]  Are you talking about Lupa?
Marccia hat's right. I'm a Lupa superfan! I've watched replays of every single one of her matches at least a million times now!
Numerik Same here! Every time I watch those replays, I learn something new. How to handle a spear, tactics, small techniques... Feels like there's so much to learn, and they are all so practical, too.
Numerik She's guaranteed to snatch that championship, given how much more powerful she is than everyone else.
Marcos: I wouldn't underestimate the other contenders, though. Also, don't you find it a bit fishy how easily she wins literally every match?
Numerik What's there to be fishy about? It's pure Lupa roflstomp! Besides, Lupa's not the cheating type!
Marccia My thoughts as well! You watch what you say about my idol!
Marcos: I'm just raising an educated suspicion... Don't get all worked up about it!

title: Marccia
content:
[Objective: After completing]
;Marccia See? I told you all Lupa was going to win the championship!
;Numerik Did you see her moves during the finals? I've watched the replays over and over, trying to recreate her moves.
;Marcos I guess I was wrong about Lupa... It's all pure strength, plain and simple

title: Marccia
content:
;Marcos I guess I was wrong about Lupa... It's all pure strength, plain and simple



Marccia: Hey! Aren't you one of Lupa's teammates? I didn't recognize you last time. Congrats on winning the championship!
[Dialogue Option]  Thanks.
Marccia: Can't wait to see more of you guys in the future!
[Dialogue Option]  Want an autograph?
Marccia: Really?!
Marccia: You guys were so amazing in the finals... Could you teach us some of your techniques? We wanna be great just like you!
Numerik:Can you give me some pointers first? I've got tons of questions about that combo move you did...
Marccia: Hey, back of the line! I was here first!
Marcos: Can you help me tell Lupa that I'm sorry for accusing her of cheating earlier?

title: Marcello
content: Marcello is a Montelli merchant found in . He can be seen next to Firus.

title: Marcello
content:
Marcello: Firus Ferrini, your actions have brought shame upon your family.
Marcello: Within a week, all of Ragunna will mock the Montellis for entrusting the trade routes to a coward.
Firus: Please forgive me, Signor Marcello, I beg of you—
Firus: I'm just a humble merchant, and my daughter is waiting for me at home... I...

title: Marcello
content:
Marcello: Firus is truly unreliable. I'll probably have to find the shipment myself.
Marcello: Mad Knight... Hmph, if he was truly a knight, how could he possibly rob the civilians?
[Dialogue Option]  Is losing the goods a big problem?
Marcello: Yes, quite serious. The Order is watching us closely. Losing the goods will lead to financial deficits, and we'll have to address the shortfall in the accounts.
Marcello: We can't afford to keep showing over 50% depreciation rate on the ledgers. The tax officials will undoubtedly seize the opportunity to scrutinize the family's cash flow. With the pressure being amplified through the ranks, our accountant might just end up being packed off on a Pilgrim's Sail...
Marcello starts muttering some strange phrases.

title: Marcello
content:
[Objective: (After defeating the Mad Knight)]
Marcello: Making choices driven by short-term convenience, taking high risks... Why did we entrust such a person with the significant tasks?
Marcello: I'm sorry for the farce you just witnessed.

title: Marcus
content: Marcus is an NPC that appears in Ragunna, Rinascita, trying to settle an argument between Alexandro and Riccardo.

title: Marcus
content:
[Objective: (in front of the Nexus)]

Marcus: I... accepted a Fisalia deal... deceiving a Montelli alongside him.
Marcus: I only wanted an "elixir" to save my beloved Lanishi.
Marcus: Forgive me, Imperator.

title: Marcus
content:
[Objective: (at Margherita)]
Marcus: Please keep your Echoes down, gentlemen, and avoid causing unnecessary disturbances in the restaurant.
Marcus: Would you like to put away your Echoes, or should I bring each of them a dish to match yours?
[Dialogue Option]  Do they do this often?
Marcus: I've gotten used to it...
Marcus: Ms. Margherita won't step in as long as they don't disrupt other guests from enjoying their meals.
Marcus: But, honestly, I'd really prefer if they could take their arguments somewhere else.

title: Margherita
Margherita
content:
A culinary genius, Margherita is famous for her mastery of her Echo Cooker, Bakie. Many of her dishes come from altering traditional recipes.

She is a childhood friend of Giovanetta.

title: Marianne
content: Marianne: Who taught this to the Fae Ignis...

title: Marianne
content:
[Objective: (First interaction)]
Leo: Wow! Cool! Let me listen!
Cratos: Leo! No! Good children shouldn't learn that! Ugh, I'll need to figure out how to separate it from the rest of the Fae Ignises...

content:

title: Marissa
content: Marissa is a female NPC who appears in Ragunna, Rinascita. She can be seen talking to Giovanna and Sandra from 6:00 AM to 5:59 PM.

title: Marissa
content:
Giovanna: Isn't the Carnevale coming up soon? I just passed by Gondola Market and saw lots of exotic flowers and decorations there.
Sandra: I'm going to decorate our windowsill nicely for the festival this time.
Marissa: I heard that this year's Carnevale is being organized entirely by the Montellis.
Giovanna: No wonder there are so many imports in the market. The Montelli family has money to spare and trade routes everywhere. Only they could pull off such a huge event.
Sandra: My little Pietro just started at Averardo, and after only two days, he came home saying that the Montelli family had a hand in all of Ragunna's trade, both imports and exports.
Marissa: Pietro really knows it all! He's so lucky to have a perfect job. Shame that his childhood friend, Gavino, hasn't been as fortunate.
Sandra: What happened to Gavino?
Marissa: Did you know he joined an underground troupe some time ago? He got arrested by the Order Penitentiary recently, so he might be heading to the Pilgrim's Sail soon.
Giovanna: Poor boy... I hope he can clear his name and return repented.
Marissa: Sentinel's grace, Giovanna! Please don't say that. Gavino is a good child, and there is no sin in him.

title: Marissa
content:
[Objective: (After]

Marissa: Gavino made it back home safe and sound... what a relief.
Giovanna: He's a lucky one. Granted absolution before stepping aboard the Sail.
Marissa: I wonder if the Pilgrim's Sail will soon be a thing of the past... Hopefully, history won't repeat itself.

title: Marlow

title: Marlow
content:
;Dahl Did you hear about the people from Agro Wing who ended up in the infirmary after eating some mushrooms the other day?
;Dahl Dr. Herssen and his medical team were swamped the entire afternoon.

title: Marlow
content:
Marlow: Just the infirmary? What's so surprising about that?
Marlow: They eat those hybrid plants they grow themselves all the time.
Dahl: Yeah, I saw them throwing around corn cobs the size of my arm yesterday.
Dahl: No wonder they wanted to set up their own department...
Marlow: Anyway, just try not to eat anything they ask you to willy-nilly.

title: Marvin
content: Marvin is a male student NPC found outside of the Infirmary, who is part of the Debate Fan Club.

title: Marvin
content:
Marvin: Hey there, interested in debating? You're welcome to join our Debate Fan Club!
[Dialogue Option]  (Listen to the debate topics.)
Marvin: Let's see… the hottest topic right now is—
Marvin: "Does falling in love with a virtual character count as real love?"
Marvin: Ahem… Gotta keep up with the times! But don't worry, we've got classics too!

title: Maxim (Lahai-Roi)
content:
Maxim: Ah, the sheer magnificence of the Starward Riseway… I never get tired of this view.
Maxim: A giant, solitary marvel buried underground, yet it's never alone. That's because it's Lahai-Roi's number one transportation hub, the busiest spot around.
Maxim: The carriages launched from here can reach the Research Institute or the surface in the blink of an eye.
Maxim: A true miracle of Exostrider Engineering, don't you think?
[Dialogue Option]  Indeed.
Maxim: Mm, I just love megastructures like this. Big is beautiful! Big is grand! Bigger is just  better .
Maxim: I dream of the day I can create something as monumental as the Starward Riseway… at least in size.
Maxim: By the way, where are you headed?
[Dialogue Option]  The Research Institute.
Maxim: Ah, the Institute… Haha, I remember being completely floored when I went there to burn my Cassette.
Maxim: It was as surreal as a spaceship from a sci-fi movie. Can you believe humans actually built something like that?
Maxim: Sigh… if only I'd been born a few decades earlier. To have seen these giants under construction…
Maxim: At least the Archive has footage from back then. That lets me fill in the blanks a little…
[Dialogue Option]  The Roya Frostlands.
Maxim: The Roya Frostlands, huh… That's not a place you can just visit on a whim.
Maxim: To go there, you need to be part of an expedition team. Or have a special permit from the Academy, but those are hard to come by.
Maxim: And when it's peak Void Storm season, or the Voidworms start acting up, service to the frostlands may be suspended.
Maxim: Until the all-clear orders, only automated supply runs make the trip.
Maxim: …Speaking of automated runs, I heard that once a girl stowed away in a freight carriage to sneak out to the frostlands.
Maxim: I don't know if she actually made it… but I bet the professors gave her a serious scolding.
Maxim: Don't try that yourself, okay? The frostlands are no joke. You go with permission, or you don't go at all.

title: Maxim (Lahai-Roi)
content:
[Objective: After]
Maxim: Since the Exostrider left Lahai-Roi, the Riseway has slowed down a lot.
Maxim: Its greatsword used to be part of the Riseway's support structure. But the Collective designed it so well that even after the sword was removed, it still operates... It's an engineering miracle.
"We must move beyond reliance."
Maxim: True enough. Maybe that's exactly why the Spacetrek Collective exists.
Maxim: "Solaris is the cradle of humanity, but one cannot live in a cradle forever."
Maxim: What you said just reminded me of that saying from the Old Federation.

title: Meishin Passageway
content: Meishin Passageway is an Area located in Chronorift Metropolis. It is accessible via Stranger Things in Honami.

title: Meishin Passageway
content:
Unlocked by finding all Missing Namipons in Namipon Case Files

Even before the Lament, Meishin Passageway was already a fixture among Honami's urban legends. In the strictest sense, it refers to a passage connecting two parallel tunnels in the Commercial District, open only during certain times of the year. Many residents swore they heard strange noises, saw traffic cones gathering on their own, or felt a tap on the shoulder, only to turn and find no one.

title: Meishin Passageway
content: Though the city hall insisted that it was just an old service passage from construction, this hardly deterred the thrill-seekers. Over the years, tales multiplied. Some claimed that ten minutes inside meant a full day outside. The best-known story came from a a local radio interview. A man said the passageway had granted his wish by letting him see his long-departed family... His proof was a limited-edition Namipon plushie with a unique serial number, which was thought to be destroyed in a fire, but somehow appeared in the passageway.

title: Modulation Hall
content: The Modulation Hall is an area of Tethys' Deep, The Black Shores. As the lighthouse of the subterranean galaxy and the heart of human activity in the Black Shores, it is where the "Modulator" of the past and people of the present observe and guide the course of stars in the vast underground sky. Through here all beings are reborn as stars, which, in turn, reflect brief moments of reality. With the power of the Tethys System, Stellar Matrices brought to this place can reveal glimpses of the past, whether of destruction or renewal.

title: Modulation Hall
content:
Based on the computational protocols of the Tethys System, the Stellar Matrix is a data package format that functions similarly to a highly compressed file. It has the capacity to store immense amounts of information and even simulate a Lament.

Certain individuals can access these matrices under specific circumstances, making them an integral part of the Tethys System's operational framework. The first member to define a Stellar Matrix noted that standards of observing and evaluating one are similar to the astronomical standards of Solaris-3.

title: Montelli Family
content:
The Montelli Family is a family-run organization and enterprise native to Rinascita, localized primarily in the city-state of Ragunna. They are considered one of the families that influence the power dynamics of Ragunna, alongside the Fisalia Family and the Order of the Deep.  As of Chapter II: Prologue - Through the Sea Thou Break, it was revealed that the Montelli Family has sent an invitation to Rover to attend Rinascita's Carnevale via their outside connections with the Black Shores. They are recognized as the rivals of the Fisalia Family.

Through their efforts, pioneering spirit, and the support of the common folk of Ragunna, the Montelli family played a key role in hosting the most recent Carnevale. This endeavor, however, earned them the disdain of the Order of the Deep and, by extension, the Fisalias.

title: Montelli Family
content: They are most prevalent in two locations within the Ragunna City: the Montelli Quarter that serves as their base of operations, and the Averardo Vault, the leading bank in all of Rinascita.

title: Montelli Family
content:

As revealed in Chapter II: Prologue - Through the Sea Thou Break, the Montelli family extended the invitation to the Black Shores, facilitating Rover's visit to their Sentinel, Imperator, with whom they had previously formed a pact. This action is consistent with the Shorekeeper and the Black Shores' covert investigation into Rinascita, aimed at understanding why the revival of Threnodian in Jinzhou has had no discernible impact on Rinascita, while similar events have already provoked responses across various nations of Solaris-3.
In Chapter II: Act I - The Sacred Breeze So Often Breathes, it was revealed that the Carnevale would also host Echoes from the Reserved Terminals of the Montelli Family, garnering disdain from several followers of the Order of the Deep. Furthermore, it has also invited and sponsored a "travelling troupe" to perform in the Carnevale, cementing the alliance between the Montellis and the Troupe of Fools.

title: Montelli Family
content: The Montelli family, once regarded as a third-rate minor house, was ridiculed for their principles of pioneering, innovation, and ambition. However, they played a pivotal role in establishing safe trade routes that connected Rinascita to other regions and nations of Solaris-3. The family also earned recognition for their pursuit of Echoes beyond Rinascita’s borders—Echoes not bound by the Genesis Nexus, which was provided by the Sentinel Imperator. This led to the development of Reserved Terminals, which evolved from a basic Terminal discovered in the Montellis' early trade dealings. Their investment in this technology was driven by the need for Echoes independent of the Genesis Nexus, capable of seafaring and defending against Tacet Discord encounters in open waters—an area where Common Echoes falter due to their inability to travel beyond the Genesis Nexus' range.

title: Montelli Family
content: In the early years, the family patriarch, Francesco Montelli, learned to modify Terminals during his ventures in the New Federation. Unlike other regions where Terminals were freely traded, Rinascita’s Terminals were strictly controlled by the Order. The Montellis, however, developed a modified lantern-type Terminal that appeared ornamental but contained advanced tech modules. These modifications allowed the family to supply Terminals to Resonators at fair prices, effectively breaking the Order's monopoly.

title: Montelli Family
content:
Their success in this endeavor empowered more individuals with the means to protect themselves and made the Montellis a key player in the political landscape of Rinascita. Despite the Order's awareness of their actions, the family maintained a delicate balance by paying heavy taxes to avoid direct confrontation with the Order.  With the establishment of the Averardo Bank and Averardo Vault, along with their enterprise in making Reserved Terminals accessible to the general populace, the Montellis have grown into a significant and influential family within the city-state of Ragunna.

After the defeat of the Threnodian and the rebuilding of Ragunna, Carlotta was appointed as the new Head of the family.

title: Montelli Family
content:
The Montelli family has a deep appreciation for all forms of art, as confirmed by Francesco Montelli, the current head of the family, and Carlotta, through their commentary on the painting Glory in Decay. They discuss how the artwork symbolizes power and change within the family. This passion is also evident in the numerous paintings displayed in their Mansion, the Montelli Quarter and Averardo Vault.

Moreover, Carlotta attends an auction where she acquires a painting titled The Banquet; in her trailer—also named The Banquet. Later, she reflects on the piece, offering her commentary on its significance.

The Carnevale in Ragunna is hosted by the Montelli Family.

The Carnevale in Ragunna is hosted by the Montelli Family.



The Montelli family uses codenames for family matters, with each name associated with a unique token. For instance, Carlotta’s codename is “Opal.” Two of Capollo Montelli's agents went by the names "Sage" and "Acorn". When introducing the Rover as part of her plan to uncover the family traitor, Carlotta assigns him the codename “Cat’s Eye,” referencing the "luster of Cat’s Eye gems" in his eyes. Other codenames include: Backwindow, Blue Rain, Bourbon, Clockwork, Juniper, La Llorona, Retriever & Tulip Coin.

Mornië is the word for "darkness" in the fictional elvish language Quenya, from J.R.R. Tolkien's Lord of the Rings.

title: Mornye/Backstory
content:
Mornye is a short young woman with pale skin and soft, pink eyes. Her hair is a stark white with various colored hues blended in giving it an iridescence-like effect. Her hair is cut in a layered style, similar to a jellyfish haircut, with the bottom layer being kept long whilst the top layer of her hair is cut short. She keeps her fringe long and tucked back with small clips, but her right eye usually ends up covered due to strands slipping loose.

From birth, Mornye was unable to move her legs due to underdeveloped tissue in her lower spinal nerves. After the Spacetrek Collective developed a custom neural-interface prosthetic limb system, she was given transparent prosthetic legs that allow her to walk as long as they're sufficiently charged.

Her Tacet Mark is located on the outer side of her left upper thigh.

title: Mornye/Backstory
content:
Her Tacet Mark is located on the outer side of her left upper thigh.



===Clothing===
Mornye wears a short mini dress, with a notched neckline outlined in gold and silver, clipped with a iridescent ribbon serving as a tie. Her dress fades from black to an iridescent silver. Over is a short-sleeved lab coat; the collar is navy, and the sleeves are slitted with back panels that flow to her knees. The sides of the coat have 5 panels, with silver and gold detailing. Her id is clipped on the right of her coat. Gold accessories such as rings sit on both her fingers, excluding the pinky, along with a gold bracelet on her left wrist. She additionally dons triangle-shaped earrings with flowing blue ribbon.

Although Mornye's legs are prosthetic, they are connected to heels with golden soles.

title: Mornye/Backstory
Mornye/Backstory
content:
.  Her Forte had awakened even earlier, on an otherwise ordinary afternoon, when she realized she no longer needed to push the heavy wheels of her chair by hand. There was nothing particularly thrilling about it, for she had already understood the mechanics perfectly. Making them turn in her mind or in reality made little difference. Her immobilized body was still trapped atop that cumbersome metal frame.  That night, as she moved herself to bed, she caught sight of the faintly glowing Tacet Mark on her thigh. It felt like a dark joke designed just for her.  But the admission letter was different.  Startorch Academy was widely known as the premier institution for nurturing talent across , and its parent organization, the , represented the cutting edge of human technology. That finely printed sheet seemed to tear a crack in Mornye's narrow world, proof that even someone who could not move, even someone with a Forte she herself considered useless, could still be considered "worthy."  Could someone like her truly be one of the morning stars meant to light humanity's future?  She quickly completed the Preparatory Program, and her Forte was deemed most suited for the Department of Exostrider Engineering. She became the genius whispered about in the halls, the favored apprentice of her mentors, the youngest teaching assistant in the department. Yet it was never enough. She spent countless nights immersed in reports and experiments, often throwing herself into dangerous tasks that pushed her Forte to the edge of Overclocking. One night, light-headed from missing a Nutri-Pack, she wondered—if, just if—her body could one day become a cornerstone of the scientific halls she dreamed of. If so, it would be a satisfying conclusion.  "It's midnight now. Aren't you going to rest?"  She looked up and met a pair of golden eyes.  She remembered this person. The initiator of her current project, her senior and mentor at Startorch Academy. She had always been drawn to those gold eyes, carrying a vast loneliness that Mornye had yet to understand. They regarded everyone with the same impartial calm, with no trace of the pity she was so accustomed to.  "If you don't rest," that person said, voice even and steady, "you'll miss the stars."
|mention3 = Rover

title: Mornye/Backstory
content:
|mention3 = Rover



|title4   = The Stars
|text4    = There were no stars at .  Back then, the Sky Projection Array could only manage the most basic precipitation patterns, and the , still in its early exploratory stage, had no spare resources to adorn the unfamiliar underground world with starlight.  But Mornye hadn't realized that the "stars" her mentor spoke of were the ones above the frostlands.  It happened during an expedition to the frostlands. Normally, no one would have thought to invite Mornye on such a mission, so when her mentor extended a hand toward her, she did not refuse.  She boarded the Starward Riseway bound for the world above. To her surprise, she was treated no differently from the rest of the team. She sat quietly in the humming vehicle, analyzing in real time the data collected by its roaring machinery. Occasionally, when the transport could go no further or when there was simply something worth seeing, her mentor would lift her onto his back and carry her through the snow.  Wind swept across the plains, cold flakes tearing at warm cheeks. The distance blurred into white, yet something vast and new seemed to unfold before her. At the end of the expedition, they arrived at the wreckage of an old machine. Sitting atop the ruins, they looked up at a sky thick with stars.  "Do you like the stars?"  Her mentor's voice broke the quiet. Mornye followed his gaze, looking up at those fragments that had traveled from light-years away.  "Seeing the stars makes us curious. They make us ask what else is out there." "I think... One day, you'll all prove that the blockage in the sky isn't the end. There will come a day humanity reaches the stars."  Ah. So that was it.  The first thing she realized was that she and everyone else were equally small. She, her father, her mother, her classmates back home, and this person next to her. Beneath the boundless night, they were nothing more than dust drifting on a single planet.  Then came the memories she had forced herself to bury. The pain of falling the first time she tried to climb the railing. The cry she choked back when her mother left home. The secretive glances in her old school, the way silently made for her passage. The unsettling calm she felt when she once imagined ending everything herself.  And then, a restless yearning surged.  It was unlike anything she had ever felt, a fierce tide rising so violently it felt like a defiance of something vast and incomprehensible. A cold spark ignited in her silenced chest, tearing apart the quiet she had built to survive her narrow world.  Then the starlight leaned toward her.  Tears spilled. Heartbeat thundered. She reached out toward the person beside her, toward the distant light stretching into infinity.  "I… want to reach that future, too."
|mention4 = Rover

title: Mortefi/Backstory
content:
2023-10-23

Mortefi sports a neatly combed horsetail of crimson hair that cascades like a stream of flame. His eyes, deep-set and brimming with prideful aloofness, give off an air of elegant danger.

Unlike the stereotypical researchers, who often come across as rigid and inarticulate, Mortefi exudes a sense of nobility. However, a fervent intensity lurks within his gaze. While his words are gracefully spoken, there lies a dormant dragon within him, nestled amidst the ashes. His politeness, akin to a thin layer of snow, conceals the fiery volcano that awaits its moment to erupt.

title: Mortefi/Backstory
section: Appearance: Crimson Dragon Born in Flames
content:
Mortefi's design draws inspiration from the legendary fire-breathing dragons of European folklore.

His right chest bears a Tacet Mark, adorned with a striking red crystalline matter that extends down his right arm. These crystalline formations closely resemble the scales of a dragon. To conceal these unique features, Mortefi covers them with bandages and dons fire-resistant gloves. However, when his fury ignites, these "scales" grow exponentially.

The red crystalline substance grants him the ability to manipulate fire. With subtle guidance, he can channel flames down the scales on his arm, creating a mesmerizing display reminiscent of a dragon's mighty claw. When Mortefi fully unleashes his Forte, a spectral dragon manifests behind him, its form composed of blazing petals that dance and flicker with intensity.

File:Mortefi Design.png

metadata.section: Appearance: Crimson Dragon Born in Flames

title: Mortefi/Backstory
content:
Classical music always fills the air in Mortefi's laboratory, providing the perfect backdrop for his work. With the intricate and precise compositions serving as his muse, Mortefi would write scientific equations with flames in the air as he contemplated his latest research, much like a devoted conductor leading an orchestra.

Even on the busiest of research days, Mortefi never neglects his afternoon tea ritual. He firmly believes that indulging in fine desserts helps replenish the energy his brilliant mind consumes.

title: Mortefi/Backstory
content: While Mortefi's noble heritage demands a flawless image, he devotes minimal time to anything other than his research. His crimson hair, though simply combed, always remains impeccably neat. Similarly, Mortefi's pristine white robe, his constant attire, rarely bears any signs of wrinkles or stains. His obsession with cleanliness and orderliness extends seamlessly into his laboratory, where everything is meticulously arranged.

title: Mortefi/Backstory
content:
The combination of Mortefi's chilling face and proud eyes immediately convey that he is not someone amiable.

His patience for anything outside of his lab is incredibly limited, easily leading to agitation. In these moments, he subconsciously starts fidgeting with a lighter adorned with dragon patterns.

Usually, Mortefi doesn't use this lighter for ignition; but once the bear is poked, he won't need a lighter for fire anyway.

In European folklore, dragons are often associated with chaos and evil, known as fire breathers and fearmongers. Mortefi, however, never uses his fire irresponsibly.

title: Mortefi/Backstory
content:
Born into nobility, he was raised and educated in a manner that molded his hubris and grace. Yet, amidst the aristocratic circles he inhabited, he couldn't help but notice the hypocrisy and indifference that pervaded their interactions. This realization ignited a flame within him, one that he cleverly wielded to mock the imperious and scorch those lacking sincerity.

File:Mortefi Lighter.png

title: Mortefi/Backstory
content:
Mortefi is not one to get angry for no reason. Deep down, he is a gentle soul who responds well to coaxing. Whenever he starts getting cranky, a small concession from his funders, accompanied by praise for his creations, is all it takes to make him approachable once again.

In fact, as long as you can clearly articulate what kind of invention you want, he is willing to strive towards making your desires a reality, no matter how unrealistic they may sound. Sometimes, this irritable "Red Dragon" feels more like a grumpy, puffed-up cat, who can be easily appeased with simple petting.

Perhaps you could even try keeping Mortefi in a state of alternating calm and anger by provoking him and then immediately offering consolation? Do it at your own risk, though...

File:Mortefi chibi.png

title: Mortefi/Backstory
content:
Flames manifest in various hues. Mortefi's fire possesses a distinct crimson color that symbolizes unbridled wrath. It mirrors the blistering flow of lava beneath solid stone and smoldering cinder. Born from his repressed childhood and taxing career, this fire within him ignited under certain circumstances. Fueling his heart with wrath, Mortefi harnesses his blaze to incinerate hypocrites and snobs who dare cross his path.

However, his flames now find a different purpose as he dedicates himself to research. As long as his temper remains ablaze, the fire within Mortefi will never cease.

Perhaps, as a brilliant inventor, he has already planned the intricate circuitry that fuels his fury.

title: Mortefi/Backstory
content: Mortefi's fire is a substantialization of his accumulated negative emotions. As the combat unfolds, Annoyance builds up in him, which, when fully charged, will result in an enhanced Resonance Skill. By then, his enemy will know the furious Dragon's flame.

Mosi
content: Mosi is an NPC in  and a member of the Troupe of Fools. He can be seen talking with Barton during the day.

title: Mosi
content:
Mosi: Have you finished reading the Order's new play? What do you think?
Barton Same tired themes again. Praising the doctrine, dictating morality... Always painting those sent on the Pilgrim's Sail as the scum of the earth.
Mosi: Exactly! By the end of it, I almost felt like marching straight back to the city and slapping every one of them, just to show them how ridiculous their little play really is.
Barton If all we're after is revenge, might as well join Aldric and become pirates. Go after Ragunna's merchant ships, raid the Order's Acolytes, take whatever we want.
Barton But that'd make us no better than the heretics they love to write about in their dramas.
Barton There would be no turning back. We'd have no voice left, no way to clear our names or expose Fenrico's lies.
Barton We'd just have to watch everyone we love become tools used by the Order.
Mosi: ...That's not the life I want.
Mosi: I still want our story to be seen. The real story. Let the world see who we truly are.
Barton Alright then, Mask up. Let's run through another scene.
Barton This Carnevale, we aren't who we used to be in Ragunna—we're the Fools who fight for equality, for freedom. That's who we must become.

title: Mosto
content: Ludvika is a male NPC merchant visiting the Averardo Vault (Instance).

title: Mosto
content:
Mosto: Hello, my dear friend. Are you here for business too?
[Dialogue Option]  Yeah.
[Dialogue Option]  Just having a look around.
Mosto: You're not from Rinascita, right? Where are you from?
[Dialogue Option]  Huanglong.
[Dialogue Option]  The Black Shores.
[Dialogue Option]  The lands beyond the sea.
Mosto: Ah, such bravery cross those vast seas, facing the storms and the lurking Tacet Discords...
Mosto: Haha, reminds me of the Montelli family's motto. I'm not one of them, but as a Ragunna native, I respect their courage.
Mosto: They sailed far and wide bringing back Terminals, Shell Credits, and mountains of wealth to Rinascita.
Mosto: The Order wasn't too happy about it, and I doubt the Primus would want people lured by wealth, straying from the path of the Sentinel.
[Dialogue Option]  What do you think about it?
Mosto: Me? I'm not leaving Rinascita. Wealth or legends, none of that matters to me.
Mosto: Even if I wanted to "fall from grace," there's very little chance of that happening. So I don't think about it much.
Mosto: As a humble merchant with no great lineage, I'm content with what I have.

content: is an Overlord Class Boss in Wuthering Waves that can be found in .

title: Mourning Aix
content: to . A bird-of-prey-like animal that perches at the Whining Aix's Mire, with cries like a mournful song. Legend has it that this bird once had a partner and that their chorus was a beautiful sound. Their names were not passed down, but their hymns were recorded and preserved by human beings. Until one of them was deceased. The surviving one cried all day long, and the cries were so dismal it was called the Mourning Aix. In the loss of a lover, the bird became oppressive and violent, allowing no one to step into its nest of lost love. It only lingers in the heavens while singing the eulogy, in pursuit of an illusion that is no longer there among the clouds.|Description When Discovered}}

title: Mr. Millkeeper
content:
' is an male NPC located at Polyphemos Windmills in Whisperwind Haven.

In the quest, , it is revealed he and the other Windmill Keepers pretended to be knights in their youth, which created the knight's legend in Egla Town. Later on, he was dubbed as Whisperwind Knight by Rover.

When spoken to again after , he reveals his real name is Conrad and how the Windmill Keepers became fugitives from the Order for being accomplices to the knights who wished to seek out the Blessed Maiden.

title: Mr. Millkeeper
content:
[Objective: (After completing The Last Knight)]
Whisperwind Knight: Great to see you, Rover.
Whisperwind Knight: Thank you for helping young Carlow last time, hehe... The Whisperwind Knight Conrad salutes you.
[Dialogue Option]  So you remember your own name now?
Whisperwind Knight: Yes, my name's Conrad, once known as the Wandering Knight Conrad, or Conrad who was never recognized as a true knight.
Whisperwind Knight: Before the Order had me marked as a fugitive, I was once a farmer, a fisherman, a carpenter, and a soldier guarding Ragunna against the Dark Tide.
Whisperwind Knight: Now just an old man bestowed with the title of Whisperwind Knight.
[Dialogue Option]  Are you happy with this title?
Whisperwind Knight: I'm quite satisfied.
Whisperwind Knight: Even if the knights fade from the future of history of Ragunna, the wind by the water will remember that we were here.
[Dialogue Option]  Tell me about the past of the Whisperwind Knight.
Whisperwind Knight: Twenty years ago, we were just a bunch of country folk inspired by the tales of the Blessed Maiden and the Knights fighting against the Dark Tide. We dreamt of becoming knights ourselves.
Whisperwind Knight: We were soldiers, craftsmen, and farmers. While we may not stand beside the knights in battle, we hold our positions steadfastly, inspired by their tales.
Whisperwind Knight: After the Dark Tide, we arrived in Ragunna, expecting to see triumphant knights. Instead, in the city square, we found the knights on their knees. The Order condemned them for blasphemy, simply because they suggested a journey to the seminary to seek the Blessed Maiden.
Whisperwind Knight: The valiant knights stood tall, shouting defiantly against the sharp blade of the Echoes, invoking the name of Imperator... And some people rushed to save them.
Whisperwind Knight: ... In the end, we were all deemed accomplices and faced retribution. Those who survived banded together and left Ragunna, becoming the first of the wandering knights.
[Dialogue Option]  Good to see you. Gotta leave.
Whisperwind Knight: Goodbye, may glory and courage always light your path.

title: Mr. Millkeeper
content:
[Objective: (After completing )]
Whisperwind Knight: When we're young, we yearn to grow up. When we're old, we grieve the years we've lost.
Whisperwind Knight: The battle from two decades past still feels as if it happened yesterday.
Whisperwind Knight: I thought I'd forgotten most of it... but the moment I heard the Blessed Maiden's call, I knew I'd been wrong. Completely wrong. That battle had never left me.
Whisperwind Knight: So once more, I raised my weapon high and advanced into the Dark Tide, her voice guiding my every step.
Whisperwind Knight: I never imagined I'd live to see the day the wandering knights fought for glory again.
Whisperwind Knight: If this were to be the final chapter before history ends, we met it with contentment.
Whisperwind Knight: May glory and courage, as ever, light your path.

title: Muyu
Muyu
content:
He is a former helmsman of Zhuojun Atelier's Jianshui Branch and the Xuanfang Ministry of Development that came to doubt humanity's trust in the Sentinels over 200 years ago after becoming misanthropic during the Fortress and Gorges War, believing that humanity should act to protect themselves and progress through their own merits and ingenuity.

In modern times, he now seeks to expose the Sentinels' vulnerabilities by instigating Xuanfang Hold's Autopuppet Crisis, by unleashing Autopuppets possessed by the lingering Reverberations of fallen soldiers from the Fortress and Gorges War who still held contempt for the Tacet Discords that felled them, which he altered to hold negative emotions towards humanity instead.

title: Muyu
content:
Over 200 years ago prior to the Fortress and Gorges War, Muyu was one of the engineers of Zhoujun Atelier who constructed Yuan Fortress. Following the war's traumatic conclusion and the self-destruction of Yuan Fortress, Muyu grew disillusioned with Hsin, scorning her for her perceived abandonment of Xuanfang's people to Ovathrax's mass destruction as the war raged and took countless lives, which drove him insane. He was cut out of the restoration effort by Hsin alongside the rest of Zhoujun Atelier, with them being replaced by the Court of Savantae's engineer staff to lead Xuanfang Hold's construction.

Well over a century later, over 20 years prior to the current story, Muyu publicly announced his departure from Zhuojun Atelier and rebuked the organization, despite being chosen by the Flowerveil Puppet to be the next Grand Helm.

title: Muyu
content: Later, prior to the Autopuppet crisis, Muyu met and formed a tentative alliance of convenience with Balanophora, the Fractsidus overseer responsible for assassinating the original Hsin, due to their overall shared goals of sabotaging Hsin. Muyu also temporarily partnered with Jingran, who, unbeknownst to him, had infiltrated the Zhoujun Atelier in order to get to Muyu after learning he was responsible for the murder of his parents over 15 years prior, who were killed by rogue Bladepuppets that Muyu corrupted. Jingran feigned working as a supply runner for Muyu while posing as his contact within the Zhoujun Atelier in the lead-up to the Autopuppet Crisis.

title: Muyu
content: Muyu orchestrated the Autopuppet crisis in Xuanfang from behind the scenes, initially corrupting Autopuppets into attacking residents by possessing them with emotionally distorted Reverberations stemming from souls lost to the Fortress and Gorges War that he had amassed for years. After a serious of continual losses involving his failure to tempt Yangyang over to his side to use her power, and loss of the Myriad Snare at the Skyworks factory to Rover's intervention, he forcefully launched a massive invasion of Xuanfang Hold.

title: Muyu
content: However, the invasion was stopped by a crucial coordination of Qingxiao's defense of the Hold's perimeter and the destruction of Muyu's Thousand-Puppet Pavilion within a Censure Court. Despite wielding furious power, however, the massive Autopuppet was defeated by Rover with the aid of the Yangyang's mysterious second awakening- triggered by an inexplicable resonance with the Xuanling Bird. Seemingly trapped and forced to fend for his life, his presence was exposed as a puppet decoy after having its arm amputated by Yangyang's blade. The decoy promptly self-destructed and caused the duo to fall into the depths of the Censure Court, as Muyu used the chaos as a smokescreen to flee and regroup with Jingran.

title: Muyu
content: In the weeks following the invasion of Xuanfang Hold, the two left to seek out Hsin's trail in the Fogveil Pagoda, where Jingran secretly left a Resonance-charged pendant behind for Rover to eventually find and use to open a way into the Xuanyuan Domain. Muyu later orchestrated a takeover of the Xuanyuan Domain's internal Sonoro Sphere, restoring an ancient blueprint of the Cloud Shuttle fleet left within its records by Hsin, while posing as a Ministry of Development engineer to its denizens under the pretense of being a revolutionary engineer who had reinvigorated the Yuan Fortress of old into a technological utopia for Xuanfang. He secretly used the residents to continue his experiments, gradually eroding the emotions of the Cloud Shuttle staff and engineers onboard to render them dull, stoic, and anhedonic to embody his vision of a technocratic humanity driven by pure rationalist logic. He also continued his experiments with Reverberation-possessed Autopuppets, opting instead to use docile Reverberations of the deceased in place of the hostile Reverberations he used prior.

title: Muyu
content: Eventually, Muyu started to use the Sanctum's mainframe controls to begin breaking down the Censure Courts, leading to Xuanfang Hold being brought to the brink of destruction by waves of Tacet Discords he unleashed.

title: Muyu
content: Rover and Qingxiao came to ally after running into one another on Muyu's trail in Fogveil Pagoda in the midst of the Tacet Discord outbreak, where Rover later used the pendant to bypass the Sanctum's security lock by traveling through a Mirage Realm into it, where they were ambushed inside by Jingran and a projection of Muyu, who had left Jingran behind to stand guard. After a brief clash between Rover and Jingran, the two goaded them into following before fleeing. Following their arrival at the Sanctum's control mainframe further inside, Hsin remotely triggered the Prism of Fate, causing the Sanctum to violently transform and whisk the duo into the Xuanyuan Domain through a rift. They traversed through the realms of the Domain from the ground-up, navigating through each of its three levels, the Ren, Di, and Tian realms.

title: Muyu
content: Jingran eventually chose to blow his cover once Rover and Qingxiao had made enough progress through the Xuanyuan Domain's Di Realm, finally betraying Muyu by backstabbing him as he monologued to Rover and Qingxiao through a projection, who quickly fled to steal a Cloud Shuttle to escape.

title: Muyu
content: After being pursued into his lair within the Xuanyuan Domain's Tian Realm by Rover, Qingxiao, and Jingran, Muyu revealed he had separated his own reverberation from his own physical body, intending to mimic Hsin's Celestials by existing in spirit as a living frequency that inhabited an Autopuppet shell he created, the Calamity Effigy, seeking to transcend through a machine apotheosis. In a tense final battle between he, Rover, and Qingxiao, Muyu's shell was brought to its knees. Bitter and refusing to concede his regrets, Muyu spitefully clung to his ambitions in his final words to the duo, maintaining that he accepted the consequences of his work, and that any regrets would sully his efforts by dishonoring the "materials" he exploited to reach the Domain. He revealed to Rover that it had been the Fractsidus who actually sought out the civilization capsule in response to Rover's assumption he acted alone, exposing Balanophora and her role in his conspiracy. Unrepentant to the end, his final words to the duo were spent mocking their efforts, balking at how Xuanfang Hold's destruction was inevitable, and that he had never once concealed his true ambitions from them in spite of his "madness", before being destroyed.

title: Muyu
content: Unbeknownst to the two, Muyu survived the encounter, having secretly transferred his Reverberation once more into a frail, small serpentine Autopuppet shell outside of the Xuanyuan Domain. While attempting to make his way towards a data-core of Hsin's nestled in the Garden of Seasons, Muyu was stopped and confronted by Jingran and Qiuyuan, who had been working with Jingran to also track Muyu's whereabouts. In a failed plea for his life, Muyu's attempts to convince Jingran to restart their partnership were met with scorn, with Jingran revealing to Muyu that he killed his parents 10-15 years prior, and that he sought revenge for their unjust deaths. Cornered at his wits' end and without any more allies, nor any escape, Muyu was executed by Jingran on the spot after learning the truth of his identity, avenging his parents at long last, along with countless others victimized by him across Mengzhou and Xuanfang.

title: Muyu
content:
Muyu was a tall and slim man of pale skin with sharp and angular features. He has short black hair with white streaks in the front, a short goatée, narrow eyes that is grey in the left side and red in the right.

His Tacet Mark is located on his right forearm.

title: Muyu
content: He wears a white tanfu with greyish-blue outlines kept in golden holders with a green gem on it under a dark green long-sleeved jacket guided by red earrings kept in the shoulders kept by black belts with a golden buckles and teal collars with white lines. The jacket also features a badge with a certification card of him. As well dark green pants with a belt that that features various golden fleur-de-lisses on it that holds a black book, a dark green holder styled in Chinese art in the back as well black gloves and shoes.

title: Muyu
content: After transferring his own conscious into an Autopuppet to become a self-proclaimed Celestial, Muyu became a much larger and slightly muscular version of himself with long black hair that has glowing light green streaks in the front, known as the Calamity Effigy. In place of his face is a featureless white mask with black markings, along with dark green and black metallic skin plating with a large Tacet Mark in the chest. He wears nothing, save for a cloak that glows in white, alongside light green outlines that covers the rest of his body, which is held up like a clothesline by a light purple fabric that floats. He wears long pants of the same color as the skin, tied by black ropes that hold grape-shaped glowing light green earrings.

title: Muyu
content: Shown by his belief in the Sentinels actions as "absurd delusions", Muyu was a sadistic man that was obsessed with seeing his century-long grand design to its conclusion. He was a hyper-rationalist that believed humanity's anger and collective emotion to be a collective burden that held back their full potential, while also presenting a facade of honorability towards those he attempted to use, as seen with his joyful praising of Yangyang's fighting skills.

title: Muyu
content: He possesseed a vast superiority complex, believing himself and his design to be above the comprehension of the common populace, and even extended this to the likes of the Fractsidus, who he believed to be "lawless fanatics" that were a simple means to an end for his use in their partnership. He also showcased a degree of anthropocentrism during his initial clash with Rover at the Skyworks, through how he scornfully dismissed Rover's humanity as an attempt at "pretending" to be human.

title: Muyu
content: Muyu was also a cold and calculating pragmatist who abstained from taking personal risk and preferred to keep his distance when realizing his plans, as shown when his apparent presence during his attack on Xuanfang Hold turned out to be a puppet decoy that masqueraded as him throughout the attack. This was also shown most maliciously in how he carefully orchestrated the Autopuppet frenzy as a false flag attack, intending to frame Hsin for the violence committed by the rogue Autopuppets to instill societal doubts in her guidance and motives.

title: Muyu
content: In his final moments, Muyu was shown to be unrepentant in his ambitions, clinging to a facade of confidence and strength. Unapologetic and refusing to admit any regret about his failure, he sharply mocked Rover and Qingxiao with a sadistic glee in his view that Xuanfang's people would inevitably be destroyed despite the dismantling of his agenda. However, this facade crumbled once Muyu's Reverberation was forced into a much more pathetic Autopuppet shell, as he somberly attempted to assure himself that his journey was not a failure while en route to Hsin's data core in the Garden of Seasons.

title: Muyu
content: Quickly stopped in the face of his soon-to-be killer and former partner, Jingran, Muyu's vulnerabilities, hypocrisy, and desperation were pitifully brought to light. He pleaded for his life by offering the core and its secrets to Jingran to no avail, as his last words were spent envisioning how his vision would have created a "perfect" humanity, dying as a hollow man that remained forever faithful in his technocratic ideals to the very end.

title: Muyu
content: Muyu was an incredibly intelligent and capable man. Despite his willingness to cause harm, much of what he achieved came from proper planning, preparations, and years of improving his own techniques and learning as much as he could. As a prodigy of Automata Mechanics, Suisui's research reveals how he created Yuan Fortress and was capable enough to be the next Grand Helm. After the Fortress and Gorges War, alongside awakening his Fortre, Muyu would continuously experiment and refine his abilities for two centuries. He was also capable in his preparations to endanger all of Xuanfang Hold with minimal help, beyond the small aid he required from the Fractsidus and his former Zhuojun Atelier branch.

title: Muyu
content: While the exact details of his Forte are unconfirmed, after the Fortress and Gorges War, Muyu awakened as a Resonator and gained the ability to capture and harvest the Reverberations of the deceased. Spending two centuries on these experiments allowed him to find ways to influence, manipulate, fuse, and control the Reverberations he harvested with seemingly no limit in how many he could contain within his Tacet Mark. In particular, he managed to discover a method in corrupting Sentinel Hsin's Autopuppets by merging the Reverberations into their cores. He also used his influence on them to alter the Reverberations' perspectives, guiding and redirecting their hatred towards humanity rather than Tacet Discords. While the Reverberations under his influence were capable of being self-aware enough to understand their situation, only through Yangyang's Resonance Ability were they properly freed.

title: Muyu
content: By the events of Song of the Heart Sword, Muyu's experiments granted him further control over Reverberations and their control over Autopuppets. In particular, as he told Jingran, after proving how Reverberations can influence an Autopuppet's logic behavior, he discovered the ability to have Reverberations control the Autopuppet shell itself, while also scrubbing away their redundant emotions to ensure they couldn't feel the desire for revenge against him. While this made them loyal followers, there were still some who kept their self-awareness and hid away from him. One of his goals were to ensure that alongside ridding the Reverberations of their emotions, he could make them immortal by perfectly fusing them with the Autopuppet shells so that they would never truly die. He also learned that by harvesting their negative emotions, Muyu could cripple and cause numerous anomalies across Xuanfang Hold's mainframe systems within the Sanctum, threatening the entire location in his attempt to discover the secrets within.

title: Muyu
content: During the events of The Wind Before the Storm, he revealed to Yangyang that he modified his right eye after losing it. This allowed him to see a person's frequencies directly and analyze them, as he did to Yangyang when he believed her reverberation could be a key component to his plans.

title: Muyu
content: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled revealed that he was capable enough to create a puppet body that was so lifelike, it was virtually indistinguishable from his true body. This allowed him to deploy the body out on the field to avoid actual confrontation, while still gathering information from the puppet body. The puppet body could even defend itself from Rover's attack via a powerful barrier. If the puppet body became critically damaged, as it did at the end of Rover and Yangyang's battle against it during Muyu's assault on Xuanfang Hold, it could trigger a catastrophically explosive self-destruct sequence.

title: Muyu
content: After becoming a Resonator, Muyu gained immensely increased physical longevity, managing to live for over 200 years while retaining his youthful appearance. Suisui noted that this was exceptionally long, even for Resonator standards.

title: Muyu
content: Muyu eventually gained enough knowledge to discover a way to transfer his Reverberation into Autopuppet shells, as he did when he transferred his Reverberation into the Calamity Effigy vessel, and later on, a much smaller serpentine shell in an attempt to escape and steal one of Hsin's data cores in the Garden of Seasons.

title: Muyu
content:
As the Calamity Effigy, alongside his prior abilities, Muyu gained additional powers. The shell granted him immense superhuman strength, durability, reflexes, and came with two additional arms. Due to this, it allowed him to keep up and fight on par with Rover and Qingxiao at once in a heated battle, before eventually being overwhelmed.

These abilities included levitation, short-range teleportation, weapon materialization with launched projectiles, and increased the speed of his Reverberation absorption ability. When defeated the first time, he could also recover from the damage he took from Rover and Qingxiao for a second chance at resuming the battle, and was also accompanied by two mechanical Autopuppets that aided him in battle.

title: Muyu
content: zh:木禺

title: Mya
Mya
content:
She was created by Leviathan, who sought a Threnodian Resonator, but deemed her as a failure.

Implanted with memories of being originally born in Ragunna, Mya had travelled to Septimont at a young age and became a gladiator there. To avoid drawing attention to her faith as a follower of the Order of the Deep, she had the gem from her jewelry removed and melted down the gold to reforge it into a gladiator helmet. It was further elaborated on that, at the end of , this gem contained the remaining energy of the Threnodian Leviathan, causing it to become sought after by Rover, Phrolova, and the Order of the Deep. However, it eventually fell under the possession of Cristoforo during the conclusion of .

title: Mya
content: As a gladiator, Mya faced great hardship and mistreatment from people in Septimont, with the Senate distracting the masses by shifting their attention and anger towards her, as well as having an exploitative manager, but she never turned against the people, despite Leviathan's attempts at manipulating her.

title: Mya
content: Mya was a Resonator, with her Tacet Mark being located on the right side of her face, on her forehead above her right eyebrow. Despite being the creation of Leviathan, her resonance abilities are described as having been very weak, and as a gladiator, she had to train excessively in order to perform well.

title: Mya
content:
Roughly twenty years prior to the main story, she would go on to win the Great Agon as a gladiator. Leviathan, who wished to find Septimont's Central Hub and corrupt the Beacon system, set its sights on Mya and began taking over her body and mind.

In order to resist the Threnodian and its attempts to take over her mind, Mya stabbed herself with her sword and subsequently leapt into the ocean around Septimont – her body being lost to the sea and marking the end of her life. Her body was later recovered by Julia Silva, head of House Silva, who handed her over to Cristoforo and the Fractsidus as part of a deal. The Fractsidus then preserved her corpse and began to run experiments until, eventually, the Threnodian's essence that was still lingering within her body reawakened with the tower's resurgence in the world following Cartethyia breaking free after the events of .

title: Mya
content:
This caused her corpse to become possessed by the Threnodian and transform into the Lady of the Sea.

In the present, Cartethyia first encounters the Lady of the Sea in a flashback sequence after destroying the incubator containing her. As Rover discovers more about Mya's fate, the Lady of the Sea momentarily appears to them in place of Lupa while traveling with her to the Vale of Glory.

title: Mya
content: Upon entering the Central Hub, Lupa is revealed to be possessed by the Lady of the Sea and was planned to have been corrupted by Leviathan in the same way, but is freed from its control with Rover's Aero abilities. Rover then separates Lupa from the time loop created by Cristoforo's Resonance ability to fend off the Lady of the Sea. Afterwards, Lupa drains the flooded regions of Capitoline Hill City to access Minos Sewers, where the Lady of the Sea's incubator was located. Lupa and Rover then slay the Lady of the Sea at the same time in both the real world and in Cristoforo's time loop, finally freeing Mya's Reverberation from Leviathan's control.

title: Mya
content: zh:蜜芽

title: N.A.N.A.
content: N.A.N.A. is a shop NPC at  in Lahai-Roi. She is an automaton who works for the Resonator Nursing Unit (ReNU) at Startorch Academy.

title: N.A.N.A.
content:
N.A.N.A. Vital signs analysis complete. You're just as healthy as ever.
N.A.N.A. Since your beloved right is here too, I will conduct a complimentary "deep diagnostic."
N.A.N.A. Hm? Why has it stalled? Its frequency is trembling. Is it... apprehensive?

title: N.A.N.A.
content:
N.A.N.A.: Ah, Rover. Stable Rabelle Curve detected. No abnormal waveforms. You seem to be in good condition today.
[Dialogue Option]  I want some medicine.
; (Opens Shop)
N.A.N.A.: I've already assessed your general health condition. Here is the prescription.
; (Purchase items)
N.A.N.A.: Proactively taking care of yourself is the most effective way to stay healthy.
[Dialogue Option]  Chat (At Day)
N.A.N.A.: Oh, Rover. Take a seat. Are you experiencing sleep deprivation?
N.A.N.A.: Allow me to demonstrate the importance of rest. Look here. This is the rest module within my bionic brain region—
N.A.N.A.: When humans stay up too late, places that should remain inactive light up like this, resulting in accumulated fatigue and a weakened immune system.
N.A.N.A.: I've already issued you a medical leave slip and cc'ed the entire Academy faculty. Rest takes priority. Your coursework can wait.
[Dialogue Option]  Isn't that a bit too much?
N.A.N.A.: Too much? A student's health is the highest priority of the Nightingale Autonomous Nursing Assistant, and that is the very core of my duty.
N.A.N.A.: When I detect abnormal heart rate, fatigued gait, or attention lapses beyond threshold, I am authorized to intervene.
N.A.N.A.: If you continue ignoring these signals, I will have no choice but to issue a mandatory rest order next time.
[Dialogue Option]  I'll take care of myself.
N.A.N.A.: Don't worry about taking care of yourself. I'll be right her beside you.
[Dialogue Option]  Chat (At Night)
N.A.N.A.: Statistically speaking, I dislike evenings.
N.A.N.A.: Most students have the bad habit of staying up late, and the probability of emergency cases arriving at night is far higher than predicted.
N.A.N.A.: While organizing medical records, I categorized students' chief complaints. The most common themes were: hometown, family, and loneliness.
N.A.N.A.: Studying abroad is, without question, a great challenge to mental health. After analysis, the most effective prescription I found was... companionship.
N.A.N.A.: But my emotions are nothing more than calculus simulations. They do little against human loneliness, and that is a limit... I cannot surpass.
[Dialogue Option]  To humans, opening up means trust.
N.A.N.A.: Hm?
[Dialogue Option]  And the way you listen... That's a kind of companionship in itself.
N.A.N.A.: ...I see. Thank you.
[Dialogue Option]  About yourself
N.A.N.A.: Strange... I often demonstrate my internal structure in class to educate students, yet the response is usually gasps or laughter.
N.A.N.A. picks up a handheld CT scanner and places it on her chest.
N.A.N.A.: What do you think? Here are my mechanical ribs, the hydraulic buffers along my spine, and most importantly, the Cassette-reading chamber.
N.A.N.A.: My bionic organs and spinal design are perfectly standard, suitable as a teaching aid.
[Dialogue Option]  Has anyone told you that's a bit... "revealing"?
N.A.N.A.: ...Perhaps "abrupt" is the better word. To students, my internal structure crosses no boundaries. It is more akin to a medical mannequin in the infirmary.
N.A.N.A.: On the bright side, such reactions might suggest they're in a good mental health!
[Dialogue Option]  Invite to a duel
[Dialogue Option]  Leave

title: NPC
content:
Non-Player Characters (NPCs) are all characters that cannot be controlled by the player. This includes characters that have only been mentioned, as well as characters that may become playable in the future.

There are a total of ' NPCs.

title: Nado
content:
Nado: I'm done. Inspiration's as elusive as the moon in the sky, and I'm just a headless seaweed adrift in the ocean...
[Dialogue Option]  What's wrong?
Nado: I'm... I'm the traveler without shoes, stumbling down a path to inspiration that's nothing but thorns... cough!
Nado: Alright, I'll confess. The truth is I just can't seem to write a thing.
Nado: I've got a handful of half-baked manuscripts, but none of them capture the life of the Blessed Maiden.
Nado: How did she grow up, and what aspirations did she set for herself? How were her studies in the seminary, and how did she pursue her dreams?
Nado: I'm at a loss. I can't even figure out the ending for this script. I talked with the captain about it earlier, and he's just as stumped.
Nado: Recently, I received a mysterious package. The captain says it's a private collection from the Fisalia family. No idea who sent it, but they must have had a soft spot for me...
Nado: After reading, I felt like I was on the verge of piecing it all together. But inspiration's like a shooting star. Every time I reach for it... poof! It slips through my fingers.
Nado: I don't know what to do! Perhaps I am just a seaweed. Brainless, drifting with the tide...

title: Nado
content:
[Objective: (After )]
Nado: I'm done. Inspiration's as elusive as Cetus the Tidebreaker, and I'm just a headless jellyfish adrift in the ocean...
[Dialogue Option]  What's wrong?
Nado: It's like the traces of Cetus the Tidebreaker are all over these waters, yet all I can do is chase their wake, never glimpsing the grand, graceful form itself.
Nado: Alright, truth is, there are too many ideas swirling in my head. I can't pin one down to begin the story.
Nado: You know, lately, reality has outstripped even the boldest plays I could dream up.
Nado: How is that even possible? I feel like a starving sailor locked in a room full of fish.
[Dialogue Option]  What if you wrote them all down?
Nado: Race against my own inspirations? I'd just end up stuck here, staring at a blank page.
[Dialogue Option]  Then throw them all out and find new ones.
Nado: Can a jellyfish turn into a human? Alas, that's about as likely as me doing what you said.
[Dialogue Option]  I've got some first-hand material for you.
Nado: What? Out with it! I'll write as you speak, though I might add a touch of polish here and there...
Nado: Well then, I'll start. I just need to get something on paper before I worry about whether it's beautifully written.
Nado: Ahh, my brain's running dry again! O fleeting inspirations, bless me with another kiss!
