title: Namipon
content: Namipon  is an NPC in Chronorift Metropolis and can be found in Shashou Cafe. Prior to its destruction, Namipon was the mascot of Honami City, and now declares itself the "guardian of Honami".

title: Namipon
content:
[Objective: (After completing]
Namipon: Hello again, Passenger!
[Dialogue Option]  How’s the cafe now?
Namipon: All good here! We’ve got everything covered. Don’t worry about a thing.
Namipon: Whenever you’ve got a moment, just drop by. I’ll have a fresh cup of coffee waiting for you. And I’ll even share my favorite Rice Dango with you…
Namipon: Oh, and if you can… bring Chisa too. I miss her. She used to carry me through the streets of Honami. Our walks were always so much fun…
Namipon: Passenger, the time we spent together… no matter how many times I think back on it, it always feels special. The kind of memory you want to hug close under your pillow forever.
[Dialogue Option]  How’s Honami City now?
Namipon: Still not totally normal. There’s some Lament energy hanging around. But thanks to all of you, the people’s leftover Longings all drifted up into the sky that night.
Namipon: Like tiny stars tucked into colorful bubbles, they blew away with the wind, carried to the edge of the sky where the light is.
Namipon: I think they made it to a better place… Back to the ones they loved most. No regrets left behind. Because every story deserves a gentle, wholesome ending.
[Dialogue Option]  How are you doing?
Namipon: I’m good. Really good, mhmm! Just the other day, I made a Rice Dango all by myself! The shape was… well, not good. But it was sweet and yummy!
Namipon: Chisa used to make them for me, but now I can do it too. You should try one next time!
[Dialogue Option]  Do you want to explore the outside world with me, Namipon?
Namipon: Aw, an invitation like that really makes me happy… But I can’t leave this city.
Namipon: I was born because of Honami, and I’ll stay here to the very end. This is my home. Even if it means reliving the same loop forever… I’d still  be happy.
Namipon: You can come back anytime, Passenger. I’ll keep the coffee warm and the Rice Dangos soft. This place will always welcome your arrival.

title: Napoli II
content: Napoli II is a deceased, mentioned only NPC from Rinascita history.

title: Napoli II
content:
The first time that the Dark Tide ravaged Rinascita, it was stopped by Napoli II, who went on to restore civilization and establish the Order of the Deep where he served as its first Primus and guided Ragunna. However, he died shortly after that. On his death bed, he gave the prophecy of the Blessed Maiden.

According to Order's current doctrine, Napoli II had received a prophecy from the Sentinel that in a distant future, a "Last Wave" shall engulf the earth.

title: Napoli II
content: The name Napoli is an Italian word derived from a Greek word that means "new city".

title: Nara
content: Nara is a female NPC who appears in Ragunna, Rinascita at night. She can be seen talking to Graham, Hamm, and Bill.

title: Nara
content:
Graham: ...Lollo Logistics' motto is "We Promise, We Deliver!"
Graham: No matter where, we'll be at your service, fully committed to guarding your shipments!
Graham: Look at these freeze dried jerkies—fresh from Rinascita to Huanglong. Kitties in Jinzhou love it!
Hamm: Huh? Isn't that a Hound? Why would a Hound be called "Kitty"?
Graham: Uh... well... that's not the point here!
Hamm: The point is, how can a Hound be called Kitty? Kitty is clearly a name for a cat—it must be a misdelivery.
Nara: Right! This goes against common sense. Is Lollo Logistics really reliable?
Bill: Exactly! By this logic, Lollo Logistics should be renamed to "Chichi Logistics."
Hamm: What do you mean?
Bill: See, the Lollo Logistics mascot is a hamster! Hamsters don't go "lo-lo-lo," they go "chi-chi-chi"!
Graham: Well... I can explain! Everyone, let me explain!
Graham: When a hamster's cheeks are full of food, it makes a "lo-lo" sound.
Graham: And do you see the deep pockets on our vests? They're super spacious, and super efficient!
Graham: No matter how oddly shaped the shipment, Lollo Logistics can "swallow it whole!"
Graham: So, in summary, if you need courier services, Lollo Logistics is the way to go!

title: Nethermancers
content: Nethermancers are a faction in Mengzhou. They are explorers who discover and cleanse Sonoro Spheres (known as Mirage Realms in their circles) to prevent Tacet Discord outbreaks, and sell the ownerless relics they find inside.

title: Nethermancers
section: Annals of Huanglong: Walking Between Yin and Yang — Nethermancer
content:
Mortals are born to cross this world but once, from birth to death. Yet Nethermancers tread the path between, moving through the shadows of yin and yang. Mirage Realms, brimming with secrets, are lands where few dare to wander. Even if you glimpse the ancient relics hidden within within, only the bold can claim them.

Whispers say Nethermancers are doomed by their glimpses of fate— Fated to grasp everything except fulfillment.  Those who choose this path become living vaults of uncanny talents, part seer, part ghost whisperer. No lock or mechanism is too strange; they unravel mysteries with a mere flick of the wrist.

metadata.section: Annals of Huanglong: Walking Between Yin and Yang — Nethermancer

title: Nethermancers
section: Annals of Huanglong: Walking Between Yin and Yang — Nethermancer
content: Yet, few realize their true mission: to purge the Mirage Realms of lurking dangers. If reverberations are left unchecked, Tacet Discords will fester and consume all. Among them, one stands out, bearing a lamp of ghostly flame, delving deep to sever lingering threats. Through his tales, the world learns of secrets long buried and the eerie denizens of the netherworld.  Should you ever find yourself lost in wonder, drawn by a glimmer of blue fire— Follow its glow. It may be your only hope of survival.

metadata.section: Annals of Huanglong: Walking Between Yin and Yang — Nethermancer

title: Nevana
content:

From 8.00 AM - 11:59 AM and 1:00 PM - 4:59 PM, she can be found talking with Beatrix in the middle of Bank Street.

title: Nevana

[Objective: (at 8:00 AM - 11:59 AM)]

title: Nevana
content:

Nevana: Two decaf Margheritas, a courtesy from Ms. Zani.

title: Nevana
content:
[Objective: (at 8:00 AM - 11:59 AM)]

Nevana: The more incompetent the boss, the more fragile their ego. I warned you not to go against him. He'll just make an example out of you.

Nevana: But I do agree with you on one thing.

title: Nevana
content:

Beatrix: Look, the empty coffee cups on my desk are stacked to the ceiling.
Beatrix: I swear, once I've downed my one-thousandth cup, I'm going to turn these empty cups into a piece of installation art!
Beatrix: I'll write a resignation letter and put it through paper shredder—

title: Niccolo
content: Niccolo is an NPC who appears in Montelli Quarter, Ragunna. He can be seen standing near a plant and waving to Professor Novelli from 6:00 AM to 5:59 PM.

title: Niccolo
content:
Novelli: Let me take a good look at you, the sword-wielding hatless one, and the promising Niccolo. Hmm, you've grown out of that naive boy and into a reliable adult.
Niccolo: Ahem, I was young and full of myself back then, coming up with all kinds of silly names... Please don't make fun of me for it, Professor Novelli.
Niccolo: Those who look out to sea often dream of setting sail, but after seeing it all, they long to ride the waves back home, where life truly takes root.
Niccolo: Please accept this, Professor Novelli. I bought it just for you.
Novelli: What a beautiful bundle of Sword Acorus... I didn't think you'd remember.
Niccolo: Of course, you once told me it was your favorite flower.
Niccolo: You used these flowers with their strong, straight stems to teach me how to fight opponents with a sword, long before I put my hands on a real one.
Novelli: Yes. Traditionally, we used them in swordsmanship lessons for young nobles. But there was one child whom I recall was the exception.
Niccolo: You mean that Montelli girl who bested me? I heard she has become an important figure in her family now.
Niccolo: Losing to someone so much younger really got to me. Then I noticed the calluses on her hands... Unlike other nobles her age, she'd been training with a heavy, sharp metal sword from the start.
Novelli: To her, fighting wasn't some noble virtue—it was a matter of life and death.
Novelli: Perhaps that's the price of becoming a true Montelli.
Niccolo: A hefty price, indeed... Now, those calluses mark my own hands, and I finally understand the look she gave me when she saw me with that Sword Acorus.

title: Novelli
content: Novelli is an NPC who appears in Montelli Quarter, Ragunna. She can be seen standing next to a plant with butterfly from 6:00 AM to 5:59 PM.

title: Novelli
content:
Novelli: The stem of this one isn't sturdy enough...
Novelli: And this one? Too dry, and lacks a solid grip.
Novelli: This one's too tender; it would snap with a simple flick.
Novelli: This Sword Acorus is perfect for demonstrating sword techniques... yes, it's just right.

title: Novelli
content:
Novelli: Let me take a good look at you, the sword-wielding hatless one, and the promising Niccolo. Hmm, you've grown out of that naive boy and into a reliable adult.
Niccolo: Ahem, I was young and full of myself back then, coming up with all kinds of silly names... Please don't make fun of me for it, Professor Novelli.
Niccolo: Those who look out to sea often dream of setting sail, but after seeing it all, they long to ride the waves back home, where life truly takes root.
Niccolo: Please accept this, Professor Novelli. I bought it just for you.
Novelli: What a beautiful bundle of Sword Acorus... I didn't think you'd remember.
Niccolo: Of course, you once told me it was your favorite flower.
Niccolo: You used these flowers with their strong, straight stems to teach me how to fight opponents with a sword, long before I put my hands on a real one.
Novelli: Yes. Traditionally, we used them in swordsmanship lessons for young nobles. But there was one child whom I recall was the exception.
Niccolo: You mean that Montelli girl who bested me? I heard she has become an important figure in her family now.
Niccolo: Losing to someone so much younger really got to me. Then I noticed the calluses on her hands... Unlike other nobles her age, she'd been training with a heavy, sharp metal sword from the start.
Novelli: To her, fighting wasn't some noble virtue—it was a matter of life and death.
Novelli: Perhaps that's the price of becoming a true Montelli.
Niccolo: A hefty price, indeed... Now, those calluses mark my own hands, and I finally understand the look she gave me when she saw me with that Sword Acorus.

title: Novialle Regenerative Group
content:
A special pharmaceutical substance developed for extremely rare diseases. However, its severe side effects make it intolerable for most, keeping it under ongoing research and validation. In its natural form, Ichor is a volatile golden liquid that radiates intense heat at room temperature. In rare cases, it can be controlled and stabilized into a solid form.

"The treatment plan that had consumed the conglomerate's lifetime of effort had failed to cure any rare disease patients except Luuk Herssen. In his final moments, Rhein didn't even die from his illness. The Ichor, once believed to be his salvation, had completely consumed him. Driven mad, he had injured several people and fled the ward, teetering on the edge of a total, violent breakdown."

content: Oakheart Highcourt is a large maze within Fagaceae Peninsula, Rinascita. At the center lies the The Lifer.

title: Oakheart Highcourt
content: Unlocking the north chamber will lead to a locked Treasure Chest, where players must answer the correct questions based on the enemy fought. Answering with the wrong answer will re-spawn the enemies.

title: Oakheart Highcourt
content:
Unfamiliar voices rise around you. By intuition, you realize that they belong to a past buried deep.
Serious Male Acolyte: How dare you bring these Echoes into the divine garden, without the Primus' or my permission! Do you grasp the weight of your transgression?
Devout Female Acolyte: By the Sentinel's grace, I swear I acted with pure intentions! These poor things... I just encountered them on my way to the garden! Please, I'm telling nothing but the truth!
Serious Male Acolyte: Reckless! Do you not see the danger you bring upon the Primus? Enough chicanery. A pilgrimage to the north awaits you—for true reflection and atonement.
Devout Female Acolyte: The north... to the Shores of Last Breath? No one has returned from there! Please, I need to see the Primus!
Serious Male Acolyte: Such an audience is beyond you now, for you have wandered too far from righteousness. Go forth. This is your last chance at salvation.
Devout Female Acolyte: No! Please, let me see the Primus! I'm begging you! O Sentinel above, have mercy on me...

title: Oakheart Highcourt
content:
Devout Female Acolyte: No! Please, let me see the Primus! I'm begging you! O Sentinel above, have mercy on me...



Have you ever tasted the Viscum Berry?

No, Primus… How could I do this to the divine embodiment of our Sentinel?,

Fear not, Acolyte. I am certain They will not be displeased.
The revered Quercus They have manifested leans upon the windows and domes, its blossoms and fruit both beautiful and divine.
Born from prophecy, the Viscum Berry is etched in the inscriptions. Consume it, and the gaze of our Divinity you've deeply yearned for shall rest upon you.

Primus… Are you saying you've granted those people's request?
They would make barrels from the Quercus, brew wine with the Viscum Berries… How can we allow such a desecration?

...Watch your mouth, Acolyte.
Tell me, have you had the Nectarwine this day?

What do you mean, Primus? I've never... Arrgh... No...

title: Oakheart Highcourt
content:
...Watch your mouth, Acolyte.
Tell me, have you had the Nectarwine this day?

What do you mean, Primus? I've never... Arrgh... No...



I see. You are too drunk to speak.
You shall reunite with the Sentinel in your dreams, good Acolyte. For one as faithful as you, Their sacred land surely awaits. May you find eternal rest in Their embrace.

Why do you still refuse to place your faith in our great Sentinel?

For we place our trust in blades, shields, and in the resolve to command our own fate.

Then hear me, and hear me well—Ragunna will never welcome the likes of you.

Fine by me! I'd sooner choke than breathe the same air as you, sniveling Ragunnesi!

Such profanity… Those who worship at the altar of worldly desires will find no blessings from Imperator!

Such profanity… Those who worship at the altar of worldly desires will find no blessings from Imperator!



Unfamiliar voices rise around you. By intuition, you realize that they belong to a past buried deep.

Deep Male Voice: They shall reveal the truth of this world to us.
Deep Male Voice: This one will serve as the black piece, embodying mortal desires and worldly needs.

The Lifer: Leave... here...

title: Ostina
content:
It is possible that the name "Ostina" is derived from the musical term ostinato, referring to a motif, phrase, or melody consistently repeated in a musical piece.
Outside of music, Italian ostinato (English: obstinate) refers to an intense level of stubbornness or persistence that may be viewed as irrational.
This would align with Phrolova's unshakeable attachment to the town and its residents, despite it having been destroyed centuries ago.
It is also possible that the name is inspired by the Roman port city of Ostia on the Tyrrhenian Sea.
It is worth noting that the town's architecture is similar to that of Ragunna; which is inspired by Venetian architecture in turn.
Phrolova mother, Betty, reverberation is nowhere to be found.

Ovidius: A man was so curious that he decided to walk into the water to find out what it was.
Ovidius: He slowly walked into the lake to get a better look. And then...
[Dialogue Option]  And then?
Ovidius: And then... he saw a strange creature. The combination of a lion and a snake, but it also had the wings of a bird. The moment the creature and the man met eye to eye, it pounced towards him!
Ovidius: The man ran with all his might, yet he was nowhere near the edge of the lake. That was when he realized that he had stepped into a darkened sea...

title: Panhua
content: Panhua is a shop NPC in Jinzhou. She is the owner of Panhua's Restaurant.

title: Panhua
content:
Panhua: You're here for some grub? Finally found the time to drop by today, huh?
[Dialogue Option]  Let me check the menu first
[Dialogue Option]  Gourmet Rumors
Panhua: Clear soup? Oh, you mean broth, right?
Panhua: You've asked the right person. The secret is just one thing: salt!
Panhua: Without salt, even the best ingredients won't make tasty broth.
Panhua: If the salt is right, the soup is perfect!
[Dialogue Option]  Chat
Panhua: Hmm, I've been trying out a new recipe lately. Well, somewhat new-ish.
Panhua: Life used to be tough for us before coming to Jinzhou. We had to do whatever we could to feed ourselves.
Panhua: Our Ma Xiaofang was just a child then, but she was always so kind and selfless. She gave as much of her food to the elderly as she could.
Panhua: It broke my heart to see her go hungry at times. But one day, I managed to catch a wild rabbit and made a stew with some fresh greens for her. I still remember that smile on her face to this day.
Panhua: And now, our Xiaofang... Should I call her Chixia now? She's all grown up and even works as a Patroller! She dropped by recently and told me how she missed that stew.
Panhua: So I thought it would be nice to recreate it and relive those flavors together.

title: Panhua
content:
Panhua: So I thought it would be nice to recreate it and relive those flavors together.



Panhua: How to make food taste better? Well, buckle up, you're in for a treat.
Panhua: Heat control, choice of spices, when you should turn up the heat for stir-fry, when to slow cook your stew... Every detail matters.
Panhua: Mahe would say it's important to get fresh ingredients, and he's right on that, but seasoning is even more important.
Panhua: At my restaurant, nothing less than perfection is acceptable. Seasoning is crucial for a good dish! Mahe... He just won't get it.
Panhua:Well, he does make some good fish soup, though...
[Dialogue Option]  Leave

title: Panoram
content: Panoram is an NPC at Energy Hub, The Black Shores. He's a Gardener from the Black Shores alongside with his sister, Paranora.

title: Panoram
content:
Panoram: Hello there. Can I help you with something?
[Dialogue Option]  You and that Gardener I just met…
[Dialogue Option]  Para... Pano...?
Panoram: Haha, that's my sister, Paranora. We're both Gardeners.
Panoram: People often mix up our names, so sometimes her documents end up with me.
Panoram: My sister handles the talent pool, and I focus on finding the right people from that pool to form the support teams.
[Dialogue Option]  Support teams?
Panoram: Exactly. The support teams monitor the Waveworn, issue alerts, and then dispatch pre-organized action teams to assist various countries in preventing potential disasters.
Panoram: Of course, this requires cooperation from those countries. We need to be granted the right to collect and analyze Reverberations in their local disaster zones.
Panoram: Good cooperation is crucial for our work's success and will be a huge benefit to them as well.
Panoram: After all, disaster prevention is just as important as disaster relief.

title: Panoram
content:
Panoram: After all, disaster prevention is just as important as disaster relief.



;(During the quest To the Shore's End; Advance toward the Future from Today)
Panoram: Are we really challenging Tethys when it's on locked down?
Panoram: It'll be a miracle if we can even pull it off, but...
Panoram: With the Shorekeeper helping us within Tethys and our comrades fighting bravely on the frontlines...
Panoram: It's a gamble, but losing isn't an option.

title: Paolo
content:
Paolo is an NPC who appears in Montelli Quarter, Ragunna at daytime. He sells Thief's Talon, which he claims can bring fortune to its owner. (You can buy it after interacting with him for 3000 Shell Credits).

After you buy his Thief's Talon, wait for 2 days, and then you can find him talking to talking to Alberto in City Square behind a bush. After you interact with him, you will get 30000 Shell Credits and an achievement, Justice Is Done.

title: Paolo
content:
Paolo: A merchant's lucky charm, your perfect business ally!
Paolo: It costs only a few Shell Credits and will bring you great fortune!

title: Paolo
content:
[Objective: (First interaction)]
Paolo: Excuse me, Sir! I can tell you're a distinguished guest of Ragunna!
Paolo: You're exactly the kind of person destined to make a mark in the vibrant Montelli Quarter.
Paolo: Alas, it's such a shame...
[Dialogue Option]  A shame?
Paolo: Many people want to connect with the Montelli family here, but few manage to strike it rich.
Paolo: Ultimately, they lack something essential, just like you. What a shame...
[Dialogue Option]  What special item do I need to do business here?
Paolo: You need the golden touch—an amulet that brings fortune, the Thief's Talon.
Paolo: Carry one of these, and soon enough, everyone will know your name in the Montelli Quarter.
Paolo: As luck would have it, I have one for sale. I'll let it go for three thousand. It's a treasured heirloom of mine...
[Dialogue Option]  Three thousand!?
Paolo: A fair price, I assure you!
Paolo: Wait! Don't go, Sir! I have other items too! If that's too much, I can give you a discount. Please, just take a look...

title: Paolo
content:
[Objective: (Buying Thief's Talon)]
Paolo: As we say in Ragunna, those who have a keen eye always find wealth.
Paolo: Have a wonderful day, lucky gentleman. May fortune be with you.

title: Paolo
content:
[Objective: (After buying Thief's Talon)]
Alberto: Oh, look, isn't it my old friend Paolo!
Paolo: Acolyte Germano from the Order Tribunal? What a coincidence!
Alberto: I've been watching your little transaction with this gentleman.
Alberto: So, what did you sell this time? Shh... don't say anything yet. Let me guess.
Paolo: Hehe, I was just...
Alberto: Shh—don't interrupt my thinking!
Alberto: Was it... the cure-all Mastic Nuvola?
Alberto: No way, this gentleman looks fit enough to take me down easily.
Alberto: Was it... the Sunflare Nectar that makes people glow?
Alberto: Well... he is already so handsome. I bet all the artists in Ragunna would jump at the chance to paint him.
Alberto: Oh my! I'm so forgetful! It was the Thief's Talon, am I right?
[Dialogue Option]  Do I look poor to you?
Alberto: That's not what I meant. Rich or poor, one can never have too many Shell Credits.
Alberto: So, are you planning to pay your customer back tenfold, or are you coming with me, Paolo?
[Dialogue Option]  You owe me 30,000 Shell Credits!
Alberto: Paolo, looks like your Thief's Talon finally worked for once.
[Dialogue Option]  It really worked!
Paolo: Wh-what? Damn my luck!

title: Paranora
content: Paranora is an NPC who appears in Energy Hub, Tethys' Deep. She's a Gardener from the Black Shores alongside her brother, Panoram.

title: Paranora
content:
Paranora: Greetings. I'm Paranora, the Bloom Bearer responsible for human resources at the Black Shores.
Paranora: Are you the new recruit? May I check your itinerary, please?
Paranora: It looks like you haven't been assigned a "germination test" yet.
[Dialogue Option]  A "germination test"?
Paranora: Sorry, that's a bit technical. It's just a general test we arrange for candidates who want to become Consultants or Bloom Bearers.
[Dialogue Option]  How do you gather their personal info?
Paranora: The Tethys System is linked to all Nexus on the planet, constantly monitoring for abnormal frequencies.
Paranora: The frequencies generated when a new resonator appears, uses their Forte, or gets Overclocked will be captured by the Nexus and uploaded to Tethys.
Paranora: Using the computing power of the Stellar Matrices, the data we extract from these frequencies is as detailed as DNA analysis.
Paranora: We build our candidates' profiles with this info and store them in our talent pool.
[Dialogue Option]  And how do you choose the right candidate?
Paranora: We Gardeners visit each candidate in person, check their background, and bring that information back to Tethys.
Paranora: Tethys then determines the test content for each individual.
Paranora: In other words, every test is tailor-made.
Paranora: Based on what I see in you, I think you'll make a great tester.

title: Paros
content: Paros is a male NPC noble of Septimont, found behind the Ephor's Palace. He can be found talking with other nobles, Amphion and Flaviola.

title: Paros
content:
;Paros I bet those Ragunna fools wouldn't last a minute in a fight. What do you think?
;Amphion Oh, for sure. That Order of theirs does nothing but pray to the Divinity.
;Flaviola How do you expect to protect your own people with just prayers?

title: Paros
content:
[Objective: (Talk to Paros)]
Paros: If the Sentinel truly watches over these lands, They would surely need warriors worthy of fighting at Their side.
Amphion: Hmph. Only those with strength of will deserve that honor. Blind faith will be the death of the Rinascitans. It's already caused Ragunna to grow stagnant.
Flaviola: The Ragunnesi leaders are hopelessly conservative. In strength, in vision, in presence—they can't hold a candle to our Ephor.
Paros:What are your thoughts on the matter, friend? Why can't they see it? That only someone as powerful as our Ephor has the right to lead?
[Dialogue Option]  The Ragunnesi bear a heavy burden.
Paros: We're all Rinascitans, and yet the divide between us runs so deep...
Paros: If The Order keeps tightening its grip, Ragunna will cut itself off entirely, and with it, the spirit of our people will wither.
[Dialogue Option]  Praise Septimont. Praise the Ephor!
Paros: Well said! You truly a person of wisdom! Praise Septimont! Praise the Ephor!
Paros: Strength and glory. These virtues must course through ever Rinascitan's veins! Only the strong can lead our people forward!
[Dialogue Option]  Me no understand. I not from here. (mumble gibberish)
Paros: An outlander? Then I must introduce you to the many tales of our great Ephor...

title: Pascar
content:
' is a quest-exclusive NPC that appeared during the By Moon's Grace event. He is the childhood friend of Xiangli Yao and a researcher on the Waveworn Phenomenon. Devoured by a Waveworn Phenomenon he was accused of triggering, his frequency of regrets and guilt lingered for not being able to share his findings, until it resonated with Xiangli Yao and the Wishing Tree during the Moon-Chasing Festival.

Unbeknownst to him, Pascar's classmates and Xiangli Yao were able to prove his innocence by piecing together his research and sharing his findings. In honor of his contribution and sacrifice, they named his theory after him; the Pascar Spectrum theory.

title: Pascar
content: A theory on identifying Waveworn Phenomenon frequencies and the prediction of Tacet Fields formation. It has gained global recognition and greatly advanced the studies on Tacet Fields. Research is on-going on recreating his prototype detector.

title: Patricia
content: Patricia is a Troupe of Fools member who can be found speaking with Claudio about their next performance.

title: Patricia
content:
Patricia: I suspect we'll head for Lilyland next.
Claudio: I'd wager that Septimont is more likely.
[Dialogue Option] : What are you doing?
Claudio: We're debating our next destination. We're still on a Pan-Ragunna Tour, after all.
Claudio: The Captain often says, "Wherever the applause calls, there we'll go to 'capture laughter.' With our craft, our wit, and a touch of our own flair, we'll claim what's rightfully ours."
Patricia: True enough. But each island has its own tastes when it comes to theater. We'll need to tailor our efforts to make sure everyone feels the journey was worthwhile!
Claudio: But, whether we head to the Lilyland's Sea of Flowers or the exhilarating spectacles of Septimont, it's up to the captain to decide!

title: Patrizia

title: Patrizia
content:
Patrizia: Fresh octopus clams! Just pulled from the water!
Patrizia: Care for a taste, hungry traveler?
[Dialogue Option]  Octopus clams?
Patrizia: Absolutely fresh! Look at this one's siphons, still glistening with seawater!
Patrizia: Just pop them open with a knife, squeeze on some lemon, and you're all set!
[Dialogue Option]  Eat them raw!?
Patrizia: Oh, they're delicious, you've got to try them!
Patrizia: If you're interested in buying, I've got the freshest stock around, no doubt about it.

title: Pauline
content: Pauline is a quest-exclusive NPC for , found speaking to Elisa by the Montelli Quarter's pool about Carlotta.

title: Pauline
content:
[Objective: (During )]
Pauline: If only I were Lady Carlotta! I'd love to have the power to create gems whenever I wanted!
Pauline: They're so dazzling and mesmerizing. If I were her... actually, just giving me the chance to pick them up would be enough, hehe.
Elisa: But... don't you know those aren't real gems?
Pauline: Wait, really? They're not?
Elisa: Nope. Someone who thought they could make a fortune from those "gems" tried, only to find out that they couldn't even sell them, let alone use them for anything useful.
Elisa: Those "gems" are actually a medium for deconstruction and reconstruction. They're capable of collapsing and disintegrating the target's frequency they hit before the target vanishes completely.
Elisa: So they just look like gems. When needed, they can transform into the shape of firearms or bullets.
Pauline: W-well... what happened to those who actually got their hands on them?
Elisa: Hard to say. Maybe they ended up as sparkling fragments... Haha.

title: Pela
content: Pela is a girl NPC who appears at Jamie's Farm in Whisperwind Haven. She's part of the Jamie Family.

title: Pela
content:
Pela: Hello, welcome to Jamie's Farm. If you're looking for Lucio, he should be herding near Egla Town.
[Dialogue Option]  Could you tell me about your family?
Pela: As you can see, the Jamie family is just an ordinary herding family living outside Egla Town. They lack noble status, background with The Order, or any accumulated wealth.
Pela: These are Lucio, Julia, and Pela. Their primary business partners are the merchants and the bakery in Egla Town.
[Dialogue Option]  Your way of speaking is quite particular.
Pela: Pela exhibits certain cognitive impairments, according to Acolyte Wicktorio's analysis.
Pela: Julia and Lucio suffered an incident twenty years ago that left a lasting impact on their minds.
Their offspring, Pela, possesses excellent logical abilities but lacks emotional understanding and self-awareness.
[Dialogue Option]  What's your birthday wish?
Pela: Every year on that day, Lucio and Julia would spend a fortune to prepare storybooks for Pela.
Pela: The works they are preparing are poised for commercial success. Thus, Pela surmises that Julia and Lucio expect her to write scripts that will generate profit.
Pela: Unfortunately, without empathy, Pela can't become a great author.
[Dialogue Option]  Thank you. See you then.
Pela: Goodbye.

content: ' is a NPC male researcher seen "arguing" with another researcher, Chellin at the Startorch Academy, Freight Zone. After speaking with them, they no longer appear there anymore.

title: Pelm
content:

Passing Roya: Wait, what? I don't like the way you put it!

title: Pelm
content:
[Objective: (First time interaction)]
Chellin: Talking about that "Exostrider Deconstruction" theory again? Can you finally piece together an Exoswarm with all its limbs working?
Passing Roya: Wait, what? I don't like the way you put it!
Pelm: Just save your breath. With all your talk of "Open the Stridergate" and "Return to the universe," what have you actually managed to build?
Pelm: Oh my... guess you're still struggling to reach the stratosphere.
Chellin: And the Exoswarm just scatter the moment they see you. I heard one even kicked you in the head last month. Still recovering, I suppose?
Chellin: Hah... do you even have a single propulsion unit that's not using components we reverse-engineered from the Exostrider? Forgetting where your tech comes from is no way to do research!
Josephson: Turn off the Starstack before you argue, will you? The students can hear every word you're saying.
Chellin: We aren't arguing, just having a discussion.
Pelm: Agreed.

title: Pelm
content:

title: Penitent's End
content:
This forsaken island, shrouded in dense sea mist, is dominated by steep cliffs with giant ringed structures. Ships caught in the currents often end up stranded on the island's treacherous shores. For those lucky enough to survive the wreck, even greater horrors await...

It is the destination of the Pilgrim's Sail, as well as the home of the Troupe of Fools.

title: Pepe

Rosselini: Thief! Pickpocket! You should be ashamed of what you did!

Dindo: Sir, please, calm down. The Pilgrim's Sail is for people of false faith to seek repentance.
Dindo: This child is no heretic, so she can't be banished.

title: Pepys
content: Pepys is a NPC female researcher, found teaching in Rabelle College classroom about Royan culture with Stanik. She can also be found help answer another student, Sloan, about Roya algorithms.

title: Pepys
content:
Pepys: The calender used by the Roya shares similarities with the solar calender.
Pepys: But the "sun" in their calender isn't the one in the sky. It's actually the Reactor Drive.
Pepys: The Sacred Reactor Calender has been used by the Roya for generations, with the Solisylum calculating and publishing a new version each year.
Pepys: Now, I'll hand it over to Stanik to walk us through how the calender has changed over the years...
Stanik: Before we begin this discussion, there's something I need to clarify.
Stanik: Roya customs devloped gradually around our mission here at Startorch.
Stanik: The sun gives us day, night, and seasons. The Void Storms eat away at the world.
Stanik: Shepherds help the Exoswarm migrate, and in doing so, gather data on the Reactor Drive and the Void Storms for the Solisylum.
Stanik: In that way, you can say the calender is a custom that grew directly from our mission to tend to the Exoswarm and monitor Void Storms.

title: Pepys
content:
[Objective: Sit Down]
Rover: I know this class...
[Dialogue Option]  (Pay close attention.)
Stanik: Before we begin this discussion, there's something I need to clarify.
Stanik: Roya customs devloped gradually around our mission here at Startorch.
Stanik: The sun gives us day, night, and seasons. The Void Storms eat away at the world.
Stanik: Shepherds help the Exoswarm migrate, and in doing so, gather data on the Reactor Drive and the Void Storms for the Solisylum.

title: Pepys
content:
[Objective: Afternoon]
Sloan: Professor Pepys, the textbook doesn't seem to cover the Reactor Drive algorithms the Solisylum uses.
Pepys: That's outside the scope of this Royan Culture course. But if you're curious, you could always take the Solis Lens Array Engineering elective.
Pepys: They get into the nitty-gritty of the Drive's operations. The Academy and the Solisylum use different algorithms, but they're both trying to solve the same puzzle.
Pepys: What a coincidence, I happened to have a physical copy of "Solis Method: An Introduction" with me...
Sloan: That thing's a brick! Are you sure this is just an introduction?
Pepys: Yes, it is. Royan calculation methods are really complex and precise.
Pepys: If you're interested, you could ask Stanik, or even visit the Roya settlements to learn more.

title: Peregrine
content:
' is a male NPC Startorch Academy staff assisting the Dimmr Plains survey team and Lumen Initiative.

His dialogue and location changes based on the players progression of the Base Camp.

title: Peregrine
content:
Level 1 Base Camp
;Set aside an additional 20% reserve for the Crystallized Energy Core... Water circulatory system... Normal.
;Comprehensive laboratory... Preliminary requirements for multi-disciplinary research met.
;Positioning reference station, seismographs... Calibrated.
[Dialogue Option]  What are you doing?
Peregrine: Oh, a student from Rabelle College... Hello there, I'm Peregrine, base station construction supervisor. You're with the expedition, right? Mind if I ask you a couple of questions?
Peregrine: How's the base station shaping up? Meeting your research needs? Anything we should improve?
[Dialogue Option]  Not bad. Things are really coming together.
Peregrine: That means a lot coming from you. Thank you for appreciating our work.
[Dialogue Option]  I'm a little disappointed in you, actually...
Peregrine: Uh, I'm sorry. Sucks to hear we didn't meet your expectations. We'll fix it, don't worry. Construction and logistics will be our top priority.
Peregrine: Frankly speaking, the Academy's throwing plenty of budget at this. But the timeline is insane. So we had to split the build to prioritize everyone's basic research needs first.
Peregrine: But we're already rushing to tally equipment and resource requests from all departments. I've already put in a request for more support staff and mechs to help with construction.
Peregrine: For the next phase, we'll definitely be making improvements to the research and accommodation experience.

title: Peregrine
content:
[Objective: Level 2 Base Camp]
;Thermal suits, 30 sets. Sterilized sampling kits, 128 sets...
;Scientific divination mechs... TWO?! Who in the void submitted this request??
[Dialogue Option]
[Dialogue Option]  What are you doing?
Peregrine: Oh, it's Rover! Hello, hello! Thank you for your contributions to the Lumen Initiative!
Peregrine: To better meet everyone's research needs, we opened another round of supply requests. I'm going through all the applications now.
Peregrine: But some of these are just nonsense. Check this one out—five boxes of Midnight Wonder Cup Noodles. "Hypothermia setting in at the Sealed Fissure. Requesting noodles to keep our research passion from freezing solid."
Peregrine: And this one: "Need to calculate the most auspicious startup time for ideal data results. Requesting two scientific divination mechs"... There's no way I'm approving that!

title: Peregrine
content:
[Objective: Level 3 Base Camp]
;5, 4, 3, 2, 1... Hahahaha! TWO HOURS!
;Two whole hours without any new equipment applications or feedback submissions!
;I can finally launch my autonomous optimization project!
[Dialogue Option]  You seem very happy.
Peregrine: Hahaha, you noticed! Today's been a fantastic day. After all the effort, we finally wrapped up equipment allocation and research area construction!
Peregrine: Now the base station and all the research teams in the field can work fully equipped and with full focus.
Peregrine: Experiments can start the moment they're ready. Data rolls in fast. No more waiting in line for equipment. No more hauling analysis samples all the way back to the Academy.
Peregrine: Before today, we could only prioritize the main control cabin's construction and keep things limping along at each research site. Manpower and resource limitations, you know? People were just making do. Not exactly inspiring...
Peregrine: Now everyone's research needs are met. Call me sappy, but that makes me happy! Next up, I'll be looking into improving the quality of life here at the base!
Peregrine: Midnight Wonder Cup Noodles, "Munchie-More" Noodle Buns, and new Squeezy Jelly flavors. I'm on it!

title: Peregrine
content:
[Objective: Level 4 Base Camp]
;Thank the heavens, I finally got this done before the deadline!
Peregrine: Oh, it's you, Rover. Haven't seen you in a while. Really nice to catch you before I head out.
[Dialogue Option]  Long time no see.
[Dialogue Option]  You're leaving?
Peregrine: Yep. Research equipment is in. Living quarters are set. Base station construction is wrapping up, too. My work here is almost done.
Peregrine: Don't get me wrong, watching this place go from nothing to fully operational in record time felt like one hell of an accomplishment. And seeing everyone's work and life finally on track...
Peregrine: But the project's timeline was ridiculous. They had us on the tightest schedule. Rush orders nonstop. I've even got gray hairs now... I think I've earned myself a proper vacation.
Peregrine: Once the inspection clears and I settle the remaining materials and funds, I'LL BE A FREE MAN BABY, OH YEAAAAH!

title: Peregrine
content:
[Objective: Leve 5 Base Camp]
;This layout. These circuit lines. The construction quality... God, I do good work. Best supervisor around.
[Dialogue Option]  What's up?
Peregrine: We meet again, Rover! Figured I'd take one last look around before I go, make sure nothing's missing. Also grabbing some inspiration. I plan to write up a project review during my vacation!
[Dialogue Option]  Wait, you're spending your vacation to do what?
Peregrine: Haha, I won't be spending all my time on the review. It'll just be a summary of some lessons learned and methodologies that can be reused for future projects.
[Dialogue Option]  You really do love your job, huh?
Peregrine: Of course! Doing construction in Lahai-Roi, especially in an extreme environment like the Dimmr Plains, is genuinely fascinating.
Peregrine: Environmental protection has to come first. Always. Gotta protect the local ecosystem...
Peregrine: The Dimmr Plains have been isolated for so long. It's a closed ecosystem. Outside personnel and building materials could have a huge impact on local life.
Peregrine: So we utilized "trace-free construction." Prefabricated components wherever possible. Helped us cut down on on-site concrete work...
Peregrine: Anyway, applying this experience to future projects will save me a ton of time and effort down the road.

title: Petrova
content: ' is a female NPC researcher who can be found at the entrance way of Startorch Academy at night, talking with Halvad.

title: Petrova
content:
Petrova: Mr. Halvad, does the Antivoid Canopy work by using cultivated Exostrider coating cells to resist Void Storms?
Halvad: Yes, it all starts with isolating the cells from the Exostrider. We then guide and differentiate them into a massive protective mesh. That's the triumph of Phase-Coating Sciences.
Halvad: On the Exostrider's own surface, these cells maintain a dynamic equilibrium. They resist contamination and regenerate continuously.
Halvad: However, the Antivoid Canopy still can't perfectly replicate that trait. Once wear sets in, we must manually apply newly cultivated coating cells.
Petrova: So we're still a long way from the original's... perfection.
Halvad: But with our intellect and technology, we'll get there one day.

title: Petrova
content:
[Objective: After completing]
Petrova: Senior, did you see this section of the data?
Halvad: Is this... when the Antivoid Canopy was running at critical load? The readings actually went above zero!
Petrova: Does that mean the coating cells temporarily gained the same properties as Exostrider material?
Halvad: That spike... was it because of the Exostrider? But at the time, it was still in Voidspace. Nowhere near Lahai-Roi.
Halvad: And before that interval, the Canopy never behaved like this.
Petrova: Could it be... that Professor Mornye's "Drive Replica" gave the Exostrider a new ability? A way to sense anything connected to it?
Halvad: Perception that can pass through the Stridergate... How would that even work? A new form of Resonance? Huh. A hypothesis worth digging into...

title: Phoebe/Voicelines
Phrolova/Backstory
content: Phrolova is a very melancholic and enigmatic person, whose presence is filled with a pervasive sadness that seems to extend to everyone around her. This utter despair comes from a background of intense suffering, betrayal, and loss, which ultimately drove her to become a Fractsidus member. Her political affiliation with this faction seems to be motivated by a single, driving passion: to somehow reclaim or reawaken a lost past, one from which she is the lone survivor. She is the personification of the conversion of personal tragedy into an incredible and singular ability.

title: Phrolova/Backstory
content: At her very core is being a conductor, not of an orchestra per se, but of having dominion over the fundamental frequencies of the universe itself. Phrolova's own demise coincided with the awakening as a Resonator, granting her the incredible ability to shape and alter these frequencies, basically conducting the "symphonies of souls". With the stroke of an apparently effortless hand, she can shape reality, capable of weaving a new, better world and, with equal facility, summon the forces of destruction. This intrinsic duality, the capability for profound creation and eventual devastation, becomes a defining characteristic. Her overwhelming talent is organically linked to her physical state, yet she demonstrates exceptional self-control, even when trying to push her abilities to the extreme, indicating a very high mental tolerance and a possibility to teach others to wield unstable powers.

title: Phrolova/Backstory
content: Phrolova's very essence is inextricable from mortality and the outside world. The Tacet Discord mutation that is directly caused by her awakening has rendered her ageless, with only the visible difference being the slight hue alteration of her left iris. Her body is endowed with a wondrous ability to regenerate, further attesting to her transcendence from ordinary mortality. Within her, there exists a huge and chaotic universe of frequencies but one that is not harmed by her; instead fluctuating in correspondence with her emotional and mental self. This suggests an inner world as chaotic and as complex as the outside worlds that she governs. She is described as a "Mutant Resonator", suggesting a unique and unreplicable path to her abilities.

title: Phrolova/Backstory
content: Despite a serious demeanor, Phrolova possesses a rich internal life philosophically and aesthetically. Her past life as a musician can also be seen in her most valued possessions, a violin and sheet music. The philosophical definition of the reason being torn, and the breaking and rebirth of the notes into a distorted form in the sheet music, allegorically depicts her own destruction and rebirth. The "exalted cries" and "repeated demises" of the violin are symbols of cycles of death and rebirth, perhaps meaning that she is the one who sorts and bears the death of things. She has her secret obsession of mastering musical phrasing and dynamics skillfully, driving an orchestra to a peak where no one can escape, all in pursuit of the "perfect form" of the symphony in her mind. This is testimony to an underlying desire for complete control and perfection, not just in the act of creation, but over reality itself.

title: Phrolova/Backstory
content: Her monologues provide us with more information about her multifaceted personality. She is performative, inviting others to witness a "wild side" and become complicit with her "show", yet she also carries a rich undertow of nostalgia and longing, as she speaks about the clean, warm sound of a fountain forming the sense of "meeting an old friend". Phrolova considers abstract ideals, like the reflected paths of Ferris wheel houses that long to touch but never do, which could represent her own sense of disconnection or a more allegorical commentary on connection. A transient spark of vulnerability shows itself in questioning her own sanity, feeling her thoughts blown away by the wind, implying a mind under constant battle with suffocating internal and external realities.

title: Phrolova/Backstory
content: Phrolova's philosophical outlook is particularly interesting. She views extreme states, even death, not as an absolute end, but as a portal to a "different kind of rebirth", to a reign of being greater than mere mortality. This perception is the complete reverse of the common human fear of death and self-preservation tendencies. Her ultimate objective is to learn about the cycle of life by experiencing it over and over again, a relentless pursuit of knowledge of existence. She is deeply sympathetic with Hecate, her called-upon friend, regarding Hecate as her own self from another "other world", a guardian of boundaries who perceives all existences. This self-identification supports her status as a liminal creature, one who travels freely across the borders of life and death, and between planes of existence.

title: Phrolova/Backstory
content: In her relations with others, Phrolova is practical and discerning. She recognizes a relation of mutual usefulness to the Grand Architect, whom she regards as an important point of reference. She is skeptical of unadulterated idealism, and she feels that "blind will" without a pragmatic basis is ultimately ephemeral. She despises disordered and unpredictable people, and she likes order and control. Her jealousy of Cartethyia, an offspring of Divinity with a "whole will", suggests a want of the ultimate knowledge of being or absolute state of existence, possibly related to her own ongoing search for significance and a "universal truth".

title: Phrolova/Backstory
content: Even her tastes in food give slight clues as to her character: that she can accept the "sour and bitter" taste of redcurrants suggests a tolerance, even a subdued fondness, for hard or complicated things, having grown "accustomed to it". Her half-hearted distaste for death-smoked or roasted flesh, however, betrays a past trauma or an inherent distaste for rot and endings, as opposed to her existential acceptance of death as rebirth.

title: Phrolova/Backstory
content: Phrolova appears to be a pale-skinned young woman of average build and height with long greyish-white hair kept in braids by red holders. As a result of the Tacet Discord mutation, her left iris has a faint hue alteration. The right half of her face is covered with a bandage. She wears a red dress that is light pink on the underside, with a grey skirt underneath. Her outfit also has detached sleeves. She wears black leggings and red high-heeled shoes.

Resonator Phrolova's Awakening occurred at the time of her death, granting her the ability to tune the frequencies of her target and alter their "melodies" based on the understanding of critical frequency structuring of matters. The strength of such tuning ability is proportional to her physical condition. Latest test data indicate that under extreme Overclock conditions, while maintaining consciousness, Phrolova's tuning can be extended to a maximum of 30 times the normal range, with the longest duration record of 46 seconds. Due to the complexity of its origin, the exact timing and cause of Phrolova's Awakening cannot be defined.

title: Phrolova/Backstory

Phrolova's Tacet Mark is located on her left arm. The Tacet Discord mutation following her Awakening prevents her body from aging, with the alteration in the color of her left iris being the sole physical change observed. Test results indicate that when Phrolova's body is within a healthy state, skin reconstruction and frequency reassembly take approximately 6 seconds, while internal organ restoration requires 15-18 minutes. No fatal weakness has been found as of the writing of this evaluation.

Examinations reveal a large mass of chaotic frequencies housed within Phrolova's body, estimated to be around one thousand frequencies. The exact quantity remains undetermined. Further experiments confirm that these frequencies have no negative impact on her body or Resonance Ability. Such frequencies are deemed of zero significant value and are only related to Phrolova's mental fluctuations.

The late hours of Tricktown belong to the revelry of bonfires, and the second act will begin at the stroke of midnight. Raise your arms, dance with abandon, and let us unveil the wild side of this city together. Free yourself through conducting, and let the notes forever carry the fervent, uninhibited essence of this night. But be careful, I might throw the baton your way at any moment.

title: Phrolova/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_02_title              = Thoughts: II
|vo_01_02_intimacy           = 1
|vo_01_02_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg
|vo_01_02_tx                 = I know full well that the differences in that piece won't go unnoticed. The inspiration for such improvisation is a gift from the city of Peyero. The sound of the city's chiming fountain was pure and clear, with a hint of warmth. When it first reached my ears, it felt somewhat familiar. As I conducted, I couldn't help but think... it was like meeting an old friend I hadn't seen in a long time. Would you like to experience it? Consider it a unique epilogue to this performance.

title: Phrolova/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_03_title              = Thoughts: III
|vo_01_03_intimacy           = 2
|vo_01_03_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg
|vo_01_03_tx                 = Would you care to know why the musical structure of this performance intrigues me so? The massive Ferris wheel I saw to the west side of Skob. Two cabins, locked in a perfect chase, forever parallel, much like a perfect fugue. They are bound to cross paths again, perhaps yearning to draw closer, yet forever unable to touch... How about joining in and becoming a part of this silent piece?

title: Phrolova/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_04_title              = Thoughts: IV
|vo_01_04_intimacy           = 3
|vo_01_04_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg
|vo_01_04_tx                 = The winds of Dolores are more brisk than I imagined. Their bite mirrors the audience's stoic silence, both filled with tension. From the conductor's podium, I can almost hear the wind whispering. It's as if I've stepped outside myself. I stand there, letting the wind scatter my hair. It blows away thoughts I shouldn't have... and maybe even me. Hmm, maybe that concert hall owner was right, and I've gone a bit mad.

Keeping them locked away forever would be too great of a loss. To believe them or not, is up to you.

|vo_03_01_title              = Chat: I
|vo_03_01_file               = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg
|vo_03_01_tx                 = Hecate has always stood at the crossroads of the , waiting, as if knowing that our paths would inevitably meet. The day I finally saw it clearly, I learned its name and understood the boundaries and choices it embodied. It stood there, silently, as if to say, "This is the moment to decide." Only when I placed my hand in its palm did I realize—Hecate is me. The me of the other world, the me of this world, and the me who moves freely between them... From that moment on, "I" became the guardian of the boundary, perceiving all, seeing even the farthest reaches of both worlds.

title: Pier
content:
Pier: Folks don't often find their way to Ostina. You bringing good news, I hope?
[Dialogue Option]  Good news?
Pier: Yeah. Is Phrolova making any headway with her work? Are we getting back to the real world?
Pier: Don't reckon I've seen you around. A friend of hers? Or one of them researchers she works with? Sure don't get many like you out here...
[Dialogue Option]  I'm neither.
Pier: That so? She must trust you plenty, or she wouldn't have told you about us.
[Dialogue Option]  She's still researching.
Pier: Oh, okay... Sorry, I'm being a bit pushy. These things aren't exactly quick and easy, are they?
Pier: You're the only one besides her who can travel between the two realms. You must be powerful.
Pier: I hope you can help her... Ah, sorry, that was selfish of me. Spoke without thinking again.
Pier: Well... truth is, we're all counting on her. She must be work clean out by now. It'd be good if she had someone to share the load, someone who gets it like she does.
[Dialogue Option]  So you support her plan?
Pier: Of course. If she says it's possible, then it's possible. I believe her.
Pier: I don't get all the fancy details, but hey, who doesn't want to live longer?

title: Pilgrim's Sail
content: The Pilgrim's Sail is a tradition in Ragunna, enforced by the Order of the Deep.

title: Pilgrim's Sail
content:
Those deemed faithless by the Order of the Deep are sent to voyage upon the Pilgrim's Sail, following the ancient path of those who once braved the mist and maelstrom seeking the Sentinel's guidance.

The Order claims that only Imperator can grant absolution to these transgressors. They must endure a grueling pilgrimage, suffering both body and soul until their repentance is complete. At the journey's end, it is said Sentinel Imperator will offer them forgiveness and promise of new life.

But no one in Ragunna has ever heard of a faithless "pilgrim" returning from this sacred journey. The Order asserts that they reach Imperator's place of dwelling and devote themselves to Their service for eternity. While many still harbor doubts, few dare to openly challenge the Order—none wish to suffer the same tragic fate as those branded Fools.

title: Pilgrim's Sail
content: The tradition of the Pilgrim's Sail was born from a legend of how Imperator's most devout believer, moved by Their grace, braved storms and mists to find the Sentinel— reaching the once sacred island that is now known as Penitent's End. As the current Primus of Ragunna, Fenrico claimed to have uncovered the path that leads to a place by the Sentinel's side, where They impart Their teachings to mortals.

title: Pilgrim's Sail
content: For a time the Pilgrim's Sail was a great honor among the people for only the most devout worshipers of Imperator despite their great financial cost they imposed through taxes though despite this "vanishingly few" pilgrims would return from these. For a time the Primus Fenrico would cease these large-scale pilgrimages and they would become "a relic of the past" with the burdensome taxes also being lifted. At some point after this however for reasons unknown Fenrico would reinstitute the Pilgrimage as a punishment for "fools" instead of a willing honor, these new pilgrimages would lack the expense of the past and instead be run-down and of poor quality gaining the nickname "Fool's Sail" from the people.

title: Pilgrim's Sail
content: Contrary to the Order's claims, those who are branded Fools and forced to embark on the pilgrimage do not truly find Imperator on Penitent's End Island, but instead a once sacred land that has been corrupted by the Dark Tide. Those who survive the initial shipwreck risk being killed by Tacet Discord, and upon reaching their intended destination, they face the Dragon of Dirge. Under the Order's control, the dragon attacks all living beings, including humans. To keep the dragon's existence a secret, entry to Penitent's End Island has been forbidden by the Order.

title: Pilgrim's Sail
content:
The Troupe of Fools is made up of survivors of the Pilgrim's Sail, founded by Brant after surviving the pilgrimage as a child, and seeks to rescue others who land on the island. They have built a refuge in an underground cavern on the island, called Fool's Elysium, and hope to one day expose the Order's lies through a grand performance at the Carnevale.

Due to the long history of division and holy war in the land, which led to the Dark Tide, Fenrico believes that in order to achieve true unity, it is necessary to immediately root out anyone who questions or fails to conform to doctrine.

The Pilgrim's Sail has seemingly been stopped as a punishment by Fenrico after Rover became the Laureate of the latest Carnevale.

title: Pilgrim's Sail
content:
The Pilgrim's Sail has seemingly been stopped as a punishment by Fenrico after Rover became the Laureate of the latest Carnevale.



==Trivia==
Brant was sent on the Pilgrim's Sail as a child for questioning the appearance of the Sentinel's statue in the Cathedral of Mercury.
Roccia was sent on the Pilgrim's Sail for performing a play that was banned by the Order.
The Dragon of Dirge's original name, Gehinnom, is the name of a place for divine punishment in Jewish theology.

title: Pilgrim's Shell
content:
to . With coral as bones, seaweed as flesh, and blind faith as the catalyst, they collectively form the memetic embodiment of the Dark Tide faith.
Their hunched carapaces hoard nothing but ossified corals, withered bones, and lost relics in the sea. title: Platya
content: Platya is a female Black Shores member. It is later revealed she was originally from Honami City.

title: Platya
content:
[Objective: (During the day)]
Platya: Hope I can see it sprout one day...
[Dialogue Option]  What are you doing here?
Platya: Uh, are you asking me? I-I'm just watching the seed I planted... Sorry, am I bothering you?
[Dialogue Option]  Not at all. I'm just wandering around.
Platya: I see. Do you enjoy these flowers too?
Platya: Every plant here carries the experiences of its owner. Some are pleasant, some regretful. They're like living memories of our past.
Platya: Did you plant anything here? If so, I wonder what stories it might tell.
Platya: I come here often, praying for my platycodon seed to bloom someday.
[Dialogue Option]  What did you plant?
Platya: It's platycodon, a flower from my hometown. When I planted it here, I didn't realize it would be the last of its kind.
[Dialogue Option]  Your hometown...
Platya: It was destroyed in the Lament. This seed is all that's left now, the only proof of its existence.
Platya: Do you think... the Lament can truly erase everything?
Platya: I returned to the ruins of my hometown as an agent, hoping to collect leftover Reverberations, thinking I might uncover the truth of the disaster or find traces of the past.
Platya: But I was wrong. Everything I knew is gone, existing only in my memories.
Platya: However, what if those memories fade with time? What if I forget them, and start to believe they never existed at all...
Platya: No... As long as I have this flower, I'll never forget them.

title: Platya
content:
[Objective: (At night)]
Platya gazes at the sea, lost in silence.
She's looking toward where her hometown once stood.

title: Platya
subsection: (After completing , she'll appear outside the cafe of Chronorift Metropolis)
content:
[Objective: (After completing , she'll appear outside the cafe of Chronorift Metropolis)]
Platya: I remember this Crossing. When I was little, my younger sister and I once snuck out to play in the shopping mall. Oh, we had a blast that whole afternoon...
[Dialogue Option]  So Honami is your hometown?
Platya: Yes, it is. I was on a train leaving Honami when the Lament struck. I, uh... I had a fight with my parents.
[Dialogue Option]  I'm sorry.
Platya: Oh, don't be. That was years ago.
[Dialogue Option]  You still look really young.
Platya: My Resonance ability might not be the strongest out there, but it gives me plenty of time to feel the world.
Platya: In the real world, all that's left of Honami is this giant Tacet Field. But inside this Sonoro Sphere, it still exists.
Platya: To me, the things I need to do stay the same. Collect Reverberations, analyze traces of the Lament, and then... search for the truth.

title: Poppe
content: Poppe is a male Light Energy Sciences student from New Federation, found talking with his classmate, Leroiel.

title: Poppe
content:
Poppe: Have you seen that Skelecanth in the culture chambers?
Poppe: It's exactly like the one in the Collins documentary trilogy.
Leroiel: You've got it backwards. The documentary was filmed based on real animals.
Leroiel: But I get it. Seeing a fish swim through sand must be strange for anyone who didn't grow up in Lahai-Roi.
Poppe: Tell me about it. The deserts outside the New Federation cities don't have fish like that.
Poppe: It's crazy how much you miss when you only see something through a screen. You really have to see it in person.
Poppe: Being able to actually see them swirl through the sand, like fish in water, must be a wonderful feeling.

title: Publius
content: ' Odle is a male NPC noble. A former Gladiator who participated in the Hunt, which he rescued and adopted his daughter, Cilania, from.

title: Publius
content:
[Objective: (Day)]
Cilania: I'm not that little crybaby you remember now, Father. The weak girl I once was... is long gone.
[Dialogue Option]  Silently watch the girl and her father argue.
Publius: You are missing the point, Cilania. Yes, trees will grow tall and shoots will grow lush, and one day, my daughter, you'll have a happier life, far from this home. But not yet. Not now.
Cilania: I... don't need your protection anymore. I'm strong now. I've grown up. I can stand on my own as a gladiator!
Publius: No, you don't understand. I swore an oath to the esteemed one in Septimont that as long as I draw breath, I will not let you set foot on that battlefield again.
Publius: A daughter of the Odle Family is meant to embrace love and family, not clutch a weapon among the dead and dying. Cilania, you don't need to burn so fiercely, like the sun. Why not simply... shine gently as one of Septimont's little stars?
Cilania: I understand how you feel, but I didn't become a Gladiator to find happiness, Father.
Cilania: That rainy night, you carried me in your arms and carved a way through the TD Outbreak in the Sanguis Plateaus. To this day, people still talk about how the Odle Family stole an orphan right back from death's grip.
Cilania: All that we are is forged by our own honor and our victories in battle. The sons and daughters of the Odle Family are born to be as radiant as the sun.
Cilania: So, I'm not here to argue with you today. Father, I've come to say goodbye.
Cilania: All because I am your daughter. I want to be your daughter. I am Cilania of the Odle Family. I am Cilania the Gladiator, who bears our honor.
Publius: No... Cilania, my daughter...
[Dialogue Option]  Leave

title: Publius
content:
[Objective: (Night)]
;Publius Cilania, my daughter...
;Publius It's not that I wish to deny you your own path.
;Publius You just never realize... that your fate was foretold by the esteemed one long ago...

title: Qiangong
content: ' is a male NPC found at Synth Armament Crafting Bay with a Mechascout.

title: Qiangong
content:
;Mechascout Hot, hot, hot, hot, hot...
;Qiangong There we go, that should fix it...

title: Qiangong
content:
Mechascout: Hot, hot, hot, hot, hot...
Qiangong: There we go, that should fix it...
Qiangong: Perfect timing... Hey, you! Got a sec? Want to help me test something?
[Dialogue Option]  Sure, what is it?
Qiangong: Aside from its main job of fending off Void Storms, the Mechascout is also equipped with a module that measures how powerful someone's attacks are.
Qiangong: Pft, the Academy used to strictly ban that kind of "walking by and giving a Mechascout a good whack" thing…
Qiangong: Then they realized the stress was so bad, even some teachers were doing it... It's practically a public service at this point. So instead of cracking down, they decided to leave it as an outlet...
Qiangong: It'll block your hit with that huge shield and give you a fair score. Oh, and don't forget to wear your Terminal, or they'll mark you as a hostile.
[Dialogue Option]  Can we really do that?
[Dialogue Option]  What if I break it?
Qiangong: These mechs are basically walking "Antivoid Canopies," don't underestimate their defense! And so far, no student has ever broken a Mechascout with one punch.
Qiangong: Reveal yourself! Everlasting Shield of Ideals! Oh, don't mind me, that's just the unlock code I set for it... Come on, give it everything you've got! If you break it, I'll take responsibility!
[Dialogue Option]  (Throw a light punch.)
[Dialogue Option]  (Strike it with everything you've got!)
Mechascout: Clang, clang... What an incredibly powerful stri-stri-stri-stri-strike... Your skills are truly rema-remarkable-ble-ble-ble...
(The mech in front of you shakes its head, finally coming to its senses after the impact. The symbols on its display slowly focus… Your final score is…)
Mechascout: ！@#￥%&*()*&#￥%&*...... ∞ ！
Qiangong: Th-this can't be right, can it? Is it acting up again?
Qiangong: What exactly went wrong...
[Dialogue Option]  Sorry, I don't have time for this now.

title: Qianling
content: Qianling is an NPC in . He appears in front of the Pioneer Association building, chatting with Shangwen.

title: Qianling
content:
Qianling: Hi there. I heard that Pioneer Explorers are informed travelers. Maybe you can answer my friend's little question here?
Qianling: There's so much talk about the Magistrate's guest. My friend thinks... it's actually him!
Qianling: My friend's a seasoned traveler. He walks a thousand miles a day and lifts a thousand catties with his bare hands...
Shangwen: Hold on. You're talking about yourself, aren't you?

title: Qianqian
content:
Qianqian: Huaijin, please be alright...
[Dialogue Option]  Who is this Huaijin to you?
Qianqian: Huaijin, Huaijin is my... uh, my childhood friend!
Qianqian: I haven't heard from him since I last saw him.
Qianqian: He said he was going to join the Midnight Rangers, but his name wasn't on the recruit list...
Qianqian: And now I can't reach him at all... Did something happen to him?
[Dialogue Option]  Don't worry, I'm sure he's fine.
Qianqian: Maybe he's fine... Yeah, he's fine, he's fine.
Qianqian: I come every day to check. If Huaijin's name's not here, he must be fine.

title: Qianqian
content:
[Objective: (After talking to Huaijin)]
Qianqian: Oh, I wonder if Huaijin is doing okay...
[Dialogue Option]  I saw him. He's fine.
Qianqian: Really?! Is he okay? Where is he now? Why hasn't he come back?
[Dialogue Option]  He's working at the mine. It's... pretty demanding work.
Qianqian: Oh, really? That's a relief! He's okay, thank goodness.
Qianqian: But how could that boy be so busy with work that he didn't even notice when I called... Doesn't seem like him.
Qianqian: Anyway, thanks for telling me!

title: Qianqian
content:
[Objective: (Talk to Qianqian again)]
Qianqian: I need to find Huaijin... I have to see him.

title: Qichi Village
content: Qichi Village is an area of . The village was abandoned many years ago due to an unknown tragedy in which almost all of the villagers were killed, and some were transformed into Tacet Discords. Scar attributes the destruction to a mysterious individual referred to only as "The Shepherd." Ever since, the surrounding landscape has been transformed, and a large Tacet Field has appeared in a cavern beneath the town.

title: Qifan
content:
[Objective: (Talk to Qifan)]
Qifan: Before placing an order... Ask yourself, why would anyone sell you such flawless ores at such a low price?
Qifan: The- the streets aren't p- paved with gold... They're lined with traps laid up by ill-intent people. D- Don't fall for the tricks. Let's stay alert to frauds.
Qifan: Hello, can I bother you for a moment?
[Dialogue Option]  Don't be nervous.
[Dialogue Option]  You have a lot of sweat on your forehead.
Qifan: Ah, I'm sorry. I'm just a little scared to talk to strangers. Actually... I'm doing anti-fraud publicity.
Qifan: Recently, near the Tiger's Maw. There have been Exiles posing as ore merchants, selling fake ores. It's just one of their many cunning scams.
Qifan: Some male exiles even dress up as females with fake sweet voices to swoon the customers into buying goods. But you can easily see pass it as long as you don't believe in becoming rich overnight.
Qifan: And their scam will fail... Phew... Thank you for listening to me. Don't forget to share this with your family and friends.

title: Qinghe
content: Qinghe is an actress NPC in Jinzhou, found nearby Jinzhou Theater stage. At night, she moves around the back stage.

title: Qinghe
content:
;Qinghe Once I pick up the Torch Sword, I'll eradicate that monster...

;Qinghe I don't know if everyone is ready...
;Qinghe You gotta practice every day, can't slack off in anything, you know.
;Qinghe I need to double-check the props for the next scene. Can't afford to mess around with the Torch Sword...
;Qinghe Here... Hmm, checked.
;Qinghe And these  supplies, all checked!
;Qinghe Fiamma is ready to slay today!

title: Qinghe
content:
;Qinghe Here... Hmm, checked.
;Qinghe And these  supplies, all checked!
;Qinghe Fiamma is ready to slay today!



;What a dazzling performance! When those sparks flew, the whole theater lit up like gold. Kindle truly lives up to its name!
;Bravo, bravo! The moment Fiamma struggled to rise, gripping that flaming blade... Her determination was as fierce as the fire itself! Bravo!
;Junyan Today's show was really something. Just when I thought we were at the end of the line, the fire blazed and Fiamma showed up!
;As long as Fiamma is here, I'm not afraid of anything! Sister Qinghe, I want to be a great hero in the future!
;Qinghe Thank you, everyone! Fiamma couldn't be wielding the Torch Sword without your support!

title: Qinghe
content:
[Objective: (First interaction)]
Qinghe: Once I pick up the Torch Sword, I'll eradicate that monster—
Qinghe: Are you here to watch the show? How did you sneak backstage?
Qinghe: Silent flame, lurking evils—the show hasn't started. Go and have some rest first, and wait for Fiamma's grand entrance!

title: Qinghe
content:
[Objective: 06:00-17:59]
Qinghe: Oh, it's you. What brings you here?
Qinghe: Running around every day, you must have a busy schedule, just like the protagonist in my play...
Qinghe: In the Hero Play, the protagonist, before embarking on a grand mission, always has to deal with some trivial matters first. I guess that's part of the story.

title: Qinghe
content:
[Objective: 18:00-21:59]
Qinghe: Oh, it's you. Perfect timing, I was just thinking about something. I'd like to hear your opinion.
Qinghe: If you were the hero, enlighten me: what would possess you to pick up the Torch Sword and fight to cleanse evils?
[Dialogue Option]  For family and friends.
Qinghe: The lore for family, the bond with friends... So you put a high valuation on trust between those around you.
[Dialogue Option]  For money and honor.
Qinghe: Exorcise demons and monsters and become an undying legend... You're seeking the right stuff!
[Dialogue Option]  No reason.
Qinghe: Oh? But I see a firm and pure determination in your eyes. I guess it's not that you don't have a reason, but you're always ready to lend a hand, right?
Qinghe: So that's how it is... Wait, I've got an idea! Thanks, I'll get back to my rehearsal.

title: Qinghe
content:
[Objective: 22:00-05:59  off the stage.]
Qinghe: Hello, can I help you?
[Dialogue Option]  Chat
Qinghe: Oh, it's you! Got some free time to watch the play today, huh? If you have any questions, feel free to ask me.
[Dialogue Option]  About Jinzhou Theater...
Qinghe: Our Jinzhou Theater is open all year round, with Hero Plays, storytelling, and Liondancing taking turns on stage. We hope that all our audience members leave feeling entertained!
Qinghe: During the holidays, we'll arrange some special performances. The Liondance Troupe, for example, will perform on the theater stage to welcome the .
Qinghe: These Ushers will be walking around the streets, filling my heart with liveness. Quite the spectacle!
Qinghe: Next up, the Torch Sword! Let its flames burn, let the sparks fly and lighten up tonight!
Qinghe: Sorry, I got carried away again. Please forgive my manners.
[Dialogue Option]  About Hero Play...
Qinghe: I've performed this Hero Play hundreds, even thousands of times.
Qinghe: Playing Fiamma over and over, it feels like we're becoming one entity.
Qinghe: But you know, I'll keep playing the Fiamma role. After all, every time the show ends, I feel happy seeing the bright eyes of the children in the audience.
Qinghe: If the performance can move and inspire people, it doesn't matter how tiring the rehearsals can be.
Qinghe: It was Chixia who made me realize this. She was a dedicated audience to my play when she was a kid. Now she's a Patroller. More and more people will know her as Chixia!
Qinghe: Well, I think she fits the real Fiamma of Jinzhou better than me. I'm happy for her.
[Dialogue Option]  About the play...
Qinghe: Same old arrangements. "Speedster" and "Fiamma" are taking turns to perform, making sure the Fluffernox doesn't wreak havoc on the human world.
Qinghe: But we're also working on a new play. Don't forget to come and see it yourself when it's out!
[Dialogue Option]  Nothing.
Qinghe: Alright, feel free to look around. If you have any questions, just ask me.
[Dialogue Option]  Leave

title: Qingning
content: Qingning is an NPC in Huanglong. She guards the western entrance to Jinzhou with Heguang.

title: Qingning
content:
Qingning: When they say, "Make the most of the land, and the people's wisdom will follow," they've gotta be talking about this impressive high wall in Jinzhou.
Qingning: I heard the creation of this wall was a lucky accident. The byproducts from processing Tacetite weapons turned out to be ideal for defense.
Qingning: It's ideal for building strong and stable defense structures.
Qingning: The land was used to its fullest, and everyone did their part. Together, we built Jinzhou brick by brick with our skills.
Qingning: I think it's not only the high wall that keeps Jinzhou safe, but all of us who stand behind it.
Qingning: Thinking about this makes the dullness and weariness of guarding the gate fade away.
