title: Qingxiao
Qingxiao/Backstory
content: Female   Huanglong   Ministry of War|power=Heart Sword|evaluation="From the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs, submitted for the review of the Mengzhou Magistrate: On the Establishment of an Additional Xuan Paragon Post in the Land of Xuanfang"  At the Ministry of War's request, Huaxu Academy has verified that her history of Resonance exceeds one hundred years, and that its origins are all but untraceable. The pair of horns upon her head, shaped like drifting cloud, is a physical trait manifested by that Resonance, and may be related to the all-knowing Auspicious Beast recorded in the Grand Library.  Qingxiao's mastery lies in the "Heart Sword." By forging her very thoughts into Sword Intent, she can instantly manifest ten thousand flying blades that answer to her will, purging all evil wherever they fall. Though her swordcraft was learned blade in hand, it has long since carried her beyond the confines of wrought steel. A plucked string, a drifting petal, a falling leaf—to her, any of these may become a sword.  The Quietude Art, along with the other techniques she has demonstrated, is believed to be part of the esoteric craft Cultivators use to modulate frequency via their Forte, though much about them remains unverified. ... Magistrate's Reply: I have long heard that her swordcraft is divine and her power formidable. This should be a blessing for the Land of Xuanfang. And as the document comes submitted through the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs, I presume it carries Her instruction. Intendant's Reply: It does. There is no need for concern, Magistrate.|overclock="A recent Overclocking assessment report, issued by Huaxu Academy of the Land of Xuanfang" Subject is a Natural Resonator. Rabelle's Curve holds constant in the Time Domain, presenting a steady curve with no anomalous patterns observed. Resonant Criticality: Extremely high. Peak values converge asymptotically toward the threshold. Stability is assessed as high. Cross-referenced against Academy records, the subject's Resonant Criticality and mean curve value show a synchronized upward trend over time. No prior history of Overclocking on file. No psychological counseling required.  Physician's Note: The curve hugs the threshold, the peaks climb toward the ceiling, and yet they never cross it. Remarkable. An ordinary Resonator would tip into Overclocking at the slightest swell of feeling. They say Cultivators temper the mind to steady their Forte Could Qingxiao the Perfected be doing this on purpose?}}

|vo_02_04_tx                 = Chongzhou cuisine is heavily seasoned and spicy, something I have never quite grown accustomed to. Hsin learned of this one day and secretly added Chongzhou chili sauce to some pastries she had me try. I kept my composure at the time, but I did drink a great deal of tea afterward...

title: Qingxiao/Voicelines
content:
|vo_02_05_title              = Ideals
|vo_02_05_file               = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg
|vo_02_05_tx                 = To attain the Way and transcend...? That is the peak most Cultivators strive for. I was no different, once. Yet the Way is boundless. Scale one great mountain, and another waits beyond it. We are all but travelers on this path. Some have merely walked a little further than others. Now, I hone my sword and my spirit for one reason alone... inner peace.

title: Qingxiao/Voicelines
content:
|vo_03_01_title              = Chat: I
|vo_03_01_file               = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg
|vo_03_01_tx                 = When I first studied under my master, I struggled to quiet my mind. Instead of telling her, I began wearing silk ribbons said to possess calming properties. They worked. As my training progressed, I removed them one by one, leaving only the ribbon on my left wrist. Later, I learned Master had known all along. She told me the ribbons held no special power. It was the faith I placed in them that granted me confidence and fewer stray thoughts. I still wear it now as a reminder that cultivation is, above all, about being true.

title: Qingxiao/Voicelines
content:
|vo_03_02_title              = Chat: II
|vo_03_02_file               = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg
|vo_03_02_tx                 = During these years in , I would occasionally descend the mountain to aid the locals. Over time, rumors about me spread. Most are wildly exaggerated. Some revere me as a Transcendent, lighting incense as an offering to me in their homes, while others view the Xuan Paragon as all-powerful. I denied them at first, but eventually, I just let them be. After all, the belief that a Transcendent watches over Xuanfang brings people the comfort they need.

title: Qingxiao/Voicelines
content:
|vo_04_01_title              = About Hsin
|vo_04_01_intimacy           = 1
|vo_04_01_file               = {character}{language} About Hsin.ogg
|vo_04_01_tx                 = Hsin is one to follow Her whims, and carries a wealth of emotions unlike any other  of . It was She who first invited me to hold the honorary title of Xuan Paragon in Xuanfang Hold. In those days, She would often come up the mountain, regaling me with anecdotes and trivia, and once She started, She could go on for hours. Only when I played the qin would She fall quiet. Sometimes, as She listened, a flicker of loneliness would cross Her face… She always believed She hid it well from me.
|vo_04_01_mention            = Hsin

title: Qingxiao/Voicelines
content:
|vo_04_01_mention            = Hsin



|vo_04_02_title              = About Changli
|vo_04_02_intimacy           = 2
|vo_04_02_file               = {character}{language} About Changli.ogg
|vo_04_02_tx                 = The flame she manipulates is indeed a rare and perilous force. My Quietude Art could only ease the burning pain it caused her. To avoid being consumed by it, she had to temper her mind and master the flow of her Forte. The life she had already burned away cannot be restored. But now that she can wield it freely, she should be fine, so long as she respects her limits. That, too, is thanks to you.
|vo_04_02_mention            = Changli

title: Qingxiao/Voicelines
content:
|vo_04_02_mention            = Changli



|vo_04_03_title              = About Yangyang
|vo_04_03_intimacy           = 3
|vo_04_03_file               = {character}{language} About Yangyang.ogg
|vo_04_03_tx                 = When I first met her, I thought the Xuanling Bird had returned. She sees right through the ways of the world and hears the unspoken voices of others. Her Sword Intent seems gentle, yet it carries a resilience second to none. Something seems to be pressing behind her, urging her ever onward, toward some distant journey. Perhaps it is not that she resembles the Xuanling Bird... but that the Xuanling Bird resembled her.
|vo_04_03_mention            = Yangyang

title: Qingxiao/Voicelines
content:
|vo_04_03_mention            = Yangyang



|vo_04_04_title              = About Buling
|vo_04_04_intimacy           = 4
|vo_04_04_file               = {character}{language} About Buling.ogg
|vo_04_04_tx                 = That child is remarkably gifted and sharp. She has already mastered the basics of her Thunder Spells, though she rarely shows them off. At first, I tested her rigorously to see the true depths of her potential. Had she dedicated herself to her cultivation, she might well have reached her master's level within a few years. But that path is clearly not for her. The other day, she sent me a glowing knight's sword, calling it a travel souvenir from . Well... at least she was thinking of me.
|vo_04_04_mention            = Buling

title: Qingxiao/Voicelines
content:
|vo_04_04_mention            = Buling



|vo_04_05_title              = About Jingran
|vo_04_05_intimacy           = 4
|vo_04_05_file               = {character}{language} About Jingran.ogg
|vo_04_05_tx                 = Years ago, his master crossed paths with me and casually asked for a divination before venturing into a Mirage Realm. I know only a little of the art, but I obliged regardless... It was an ill omen. Yet he simply grinned and went on. Later, this young man took up his master's mantle, the smile on his face even more defiant. Even if the road ahead is treacherous and life is fleeting, to live unburdened and unbound... I suppose that, too, is a life well lived.
|vo_04_05_mention            = Jingran

title: Qingxiao/Voicelines
content:
|vo_04_05_mention            = Jingran



|vo_04_06_title              = About Ruoyun
|vo_04_06_intimacy           = 5
|vo_04_06_file               = {character}{language} About Ruoyun.ogg
|vo_04_06_tx                 = Ruoyun was raised by her village, and her every thought was to use Automata Mechanics to give back to them in some way. Even now, much of what you see in the Land of Xuanfang can be traced back to her work. Her late parents named her Ruoyun, hoping she would live as light and free as drifting clouds, but the choice she made in the end carried a weight far from that. And the Sword Transcendent she once sought out... failed to protect her.
|vo_04_06_mention            = Ruoyun

title: Qingxiao/Voicelines
content:
|vo_04_06_mention            = Ruoyun



|vo_04_07_title              = About Jingwei
|vo_04_07_intimacy           = 5
|vo_04_07_file               = {character}{language} About Jingwei.ogg
|vo_04_07_tx                 = My master has walked far along the path of the Way. Having severed all mortal ties and transcended karma, she is a true Transcendent in every sense. She was the one who taught me the breathing exercises and the Quietude Art of the qin, though I cannot say I always heeded her lessons. Yes, she is still in good health. If you ever happen to meet her, please pass along my regards.
|vo_04_07_mention            = Jingwei

title: Qingxiao/Voicelines
content:
|vo_04_07_mention            = Jingwei



|vo_05_01_title              = Birthday Wishes
|vo_05_01_file               = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg
|vo_05_01_tx                 = Today is your birthday. Come, sit. Let me play a piece for you. You are always rushing about for the sake of this world, with scarcely a moment to yourself. Now, rest a while. That bowl on the table? Yes, longevity noodles. I kneaded the dough myself and cut the strands with my flying swords... It was my first attempt, so I cannot vouch for the taste. Why don't you try them first? My disciple, there is no spell in this world that can grant blessings. But from the bottom of my heart, I wish that in all your long years, every path opens before you, and every hope finds its home.

subsection: Outside the Xuanfang Ministry of War
content:
[Objective: Outside the Xuanfang Ministry of War]
Yuanzhi: I thought we'd never meet again after Mengzhou...
Yuanzhi: After that incident, you left the Mengzhou Ministry of War, and I've never heard from you since. I figured you'd lost heart and retired to the mountains.
Qiuhong: Then you thought wrong. I'm the same person as I was. I'm happy to admit my mistakes, but giving up just isn't in my nature.
Yuanzhi: You've always been stubborn, that's for sure. You look carefree on the surface, but deep down, you hold on tighter than anybody I've known.
Qiuhong: Enough with the teasing, old friend. Let's talk about you. You were supposed to be living out your days peacefully in Mengzhou. How'd you end up here in Xuanfang Hold all of a sudden?
Yuanzhi: Me? I retired ages ago. My nephew is a Warden here in Xuanfang Hold, so you could say I'm just a family member here to support the troops.
Yuanzhi: And as long as you're Commander here, I feel safe leaving him in your hands. Put him through training. He needs to grow into an outstanding Xuanfang Warden, just like you.
Qiuhong: Don't worry. He'll become a great Warden, just as his uncle once was. I won't let you down.

title: Qiuhong
content:

Friendly Lady Buying Groceries: Back again today, Mr. Qiuhong? Can I get you something?
Qiuhong: Just looking for whatever's fresh. This place is packed with shoppers, so it's a great place to catch up on the latest gossip.
Friendly Grandpa: There used to be a merchant who sold some pretty good Climber Shoots, but he hasn't shown up for a while.
Qiuhong: Really? That's a shame. Where's his stall? I'd like to stop by and check it out next time.
Friendly Grandpa: Right at the entrance to the alley there. Come to think of it, he seemed like a bit of a newcomer. Rather inexperienced in the business, with prices much lower than everybody else's.
Friendly Lady Buying Groceries: That's right! We all told him it was too cheap. We offered to pay him more, but he refused! He said he'd just picked shoots in his free time and didn't have many expenses to cover.
Friendly Lady Buying Groceries: We locals all know those shoots tend to grow best around those mechanisms, so it's not like anybody can go and pick them. He's taking a risk by doing that, so he ought to get paid for it!
Qiuhong: Does anybody else run their business like that? Sounds like an honest fellow. Give me a shout if you bump into him again, all right?
Friendly Grandpa: Sure thing. You should talk to him if you get the chance, Mr. Qiuhong. He's so young and talented. Maybe he'd fit right in the Wardens!

title: Qiuhong
content:
[Dialogue Option]  About yourself
Qiuhong: Once, few among the new recruits knew my face.
Qiuhong: To most, I looked less like the commander of soldiers than a keeper of birds.
Qiuhong: But that was no bad thing... If I had no need to sit in the Ministry of War's meetings, it meant all was as it should be.
Qiuhong: The Autopuppets could purge the Tacet Discords on their own back then. The Xuanfang Wardens had only to clean the scraps.
Qiuhong: That order is now gone... and the Hold's peace must be upheld by human hands.
[Dialogue Option]  Why collecting the Rafter Kites?
Qiuhong: Since the Fortress and Gorges War, Rafter Kites have served as Xuanfang's messengers in lieu of the Xuanling Birds.
Qiuhong: But they carry more than just letters... The Rafter Kites lost over the last century hold secrets. Intelligence. Pieces of the board.
Qiuhong: In a land as complicated as this one, the smallest detail can be the hinge on which a battle turns... I will not overlook a single one.
[Dialogue Option]
Qiuhong: Should you find a unclaimed Rafter Kite, feel free to bring it to me.

title: Qiuyuan
Qiuyuan
content:
==Trivia==
===Etymology===
Qiuyuan's name may be a reference to Qiu Yuan  (1247-1326), a famed calligrapher and poet, as well as a teacher in the Yuan dynasty. After he stopped teaching, he lived a reclusive life in the mountains.
is a Chinese surname.
An alternative pronunciation of the same character, , can mean "hatred; enmity; resentment".
is the simplified form of  meaning “distant; remote; far”.

title: Qiuyuan/Backstory
content: Qiuyuan is a man with a tall and muscular build. His eyes are muted gray eyes, and he has a fine, straight nose. A scar sits along his left cheek in a straight line. His hair is long and dark with bangs hanging just over his eyes and light gray-tipped ends, and it's styled into a ponytail by a long, emerald green string and a pin. The ponytail ends just between his shoulder blades, but it possibly reaches his hips without it. His tacet mark is located at the palm of his right hand.

title: Qiuyuan/Backstory
content: Qiuyuan has a rice hat on his head with an opening for his ponytail with a design similar to his coat. He wears a long-sleeve, white and gray tunic with a coat over it. The coat is white along the shoulders that ombre to gray and black to his hips with accents of olive green and flecks of red, similar to blood. There's a design on the underside of the sleeves and along the sides with stitched words, and metal arm guards sit on his forearms. He has a garter that wraps around from his back over his right shoulder with his token on it and connects to a garter belt leading to a thick, dark belt sitting around his waist with a brown and green fabric beneath it. His pants are long, black, and slightly baggy with garters on them, and his black, bamboo flask sits attached to his left hip. He adorns black and silver boots lined with fur just up to his knees and shin guards.

title: Qiuyuan/Backstory
content:
Male   Huanglong   Mingting
|power = Bambooscape
|evaluation = Miscellaneous Records of Mingting's Minister of Sentinel Affairs: Correspondence Collection  My dear friend Dongyuan,  A few days prior, the Internal Security Agency forwarded documents from the Justice Commission and the Huaxu Academy to the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs. Without delay, I instructed the Chongzhou official to assist in the matter and thoroughly examine the local Resonator register. It has now been confirmed that the individual in question has no connection with the Sentinel or the Threnodian of Chongzhou.  According to the Ministry's records, this individual has been a Resonator for over fifteen years. Described as one who "sees the world through bamboos and hides his blade within them," he is blind yet wields a remarkable ability known as Mindsight. Through this power, he perceives his surroundings through a "bamboo forest" in his mind, enabling him to discern opponents' intentions and vulnerabilities. He can even manifest the Mindsight into tangible illusions. This is not a person to be underestimated.  Moreover, his swordsmanship appears to stem chiefly from personal skill rather than his Resonance Ability. Observations indicate that he consistently restrains the use of his Resonance power. He claims that the bamboo flask he carries contains a concoction—prepared by a wandering healer in Chongzhou—that stimulates his Mindsight and Forte, and is used only when necessary. This matter may be forwarded to the Academy for further analysis.  As for the detailed test data, please await the Academy's formal report...  Dongyuan's annotation: Simply ensure this is recorded clearly. We follow the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs's judgment… My my, Lin still writes with his characteristic formality.
|overclock = Miscellaneous Records of Mingting's Ministry of Sentinel Affairs: Correspondence Collection  …In my recent observations over the past few days, it appears less that he refuses to employ his Forte and more that he consciously restrains himself from using it. Regarding the nature of the ability itself, he remains decidedly reserved. Only from the Academy's report may one glean a few particulars:  Test subject waveform analysis presents an elliptical oscillation. Time-domain readings are stable, with no anomalous patterns observed. Resonant Criticality: High. Stability is high with no risk of Overclocking. No prior history of Overclocking. Psychological intervention is deemed unnecessary. Note: The subject admits to repeated offenses involving violent breaches of the law, though his demeanor was notably composed. It is recommended that these claims should be verified by the Ministry of Justice and local authorities in Chongzhou.  …Yet, in my own assessment, this man harbors no murderous intent. His composure is unwavering, his demeanor steady. His swordsmanship is among the finest, and few in all of Mingting could rival him. He could have been a remarkable asset to the Internal Security Agency. That such an individual is listed in the Justice Commission's dossiers as a perpetrator of unlawful violence is difficult to believe. I have already communicated with the Ministry of Rites, outlining the advantages and implications of recruiting said individual. Should you wish to employ this man, I expect no obstacle shall arise on that account.  Dongyuan's annotation: Naturally, the steadier the better. But judging from this report... isn't this lad a little too devoid of emotion?
|mention1 = Minister Lin, Liang Dongyuan}}

|vo_02_01_tx                 = Those years I stayed with Master Zhang, I cooked for his patients. Each meal was carefully crafted for their individual need. Beyond those, I know a few spicier dishes from Chongzhou. Whether they suit you, that, I cannot say.

title: Qiuyuan/Voicelines
content:

|vo_02_03_tx                 = Years ago, I'd just wrapped up a case in Yuezhou and had to rush back to  overnight. I was exhausted and famished when I stumbled into a diner by the roadside. title: Quinto
content: Quinto is an NPC in Bank Street, Ragunna. At 6:00 PM - 7.59 AM, he can be seen talking with Cordelia

title: Quinto
content:
[Objective: (At night)]
Quinto: If this keeps up, Averardo Vault will turn into an Averardo General Store.
Quinto:  The Last Jar of Air Before the Lament , from New Federation—what kind of art is just a rusty tin can?
Quinto:  The Scented Banana on the Wall , from Rinascita—this nearly rotting banana is taking up an entire wall!
Quinto:  The Acolyte's Breakfast , from Rinascita—it's a safe...
Cordelia: We're only responsible for storage. We can't judge their artistic value.
Quinto: But can these really be considered art? Maybe next time, I'll frame a leftover slice of pizza.
Cordelia: Just don't use Pizza Tropicale.
Quinto: If only I were an artist. Making money would be too easy.
Cordelia: The pieces you mentioned are highly valued on the market. Please make sure you take good care of them.
Cordelia: Remember to lower the storage room temperature for  The Scented Banana on the Wall .

title: Quinto
content:
The Scented Banana on the Wall  refers to a real life conceptual art piece called "Comedian" by Italian artist Maurizio Cattelan.

title: Rage Against the Statue
Ragunna
content:
Ragunna is the largest known city-state in Rinascita, ruled by the Order of the Deep and centred on its thriving port city. It is protected by the Sentinel Imperator and the local Ragunessi maintain the strongest connection to Them in all of Rinascita. Common Echoes are a normal sight in Ragunna, believed to be gifts from the Sentinel carrying Their divine will.

Ragunna can be reached during .

title: Ragunna
content: The Order of the Deep handle various affairs, from city management, diplomacy and overseeing all Common Echoes. They have declared themselves Imperator's earthly emissaries, ensuring the people remain faithful to Their (Imperator's) divine will. The Order of the Deep's leader is known as the Primus, and the order's current Primus, Fenrico, has declared himself to be Imperator's "Enlightened One". Serving beneath the Primus, Priests oversee the rites and sacred duties of the Order, while the Acolytes dedicate their lives to the study of the Codex and spreading Imperator's teachings throughout Ragunna. The armed Common Echoes that only respond to the Order are called the La Guardia. In Ragunna, the Order controls all Terminals for Echo use. They store Echoes in their Data Bank and only grant access after thorough screening, thus only a select few Resonators are permitted to carry a Pangu Terminal of their own, deemed Reserved Terminals in Ragunna. For that reason, most Ragunnesi rely on the Genesis Nexus and Common Echoes, and do not know much of other Echoes, referred to as Reserved Echoes. Their seat of power is the Cathedral of Mercury.

title: Ragunna
content: Aside from the Order, the families of Ragunna influence the power dynamics of the city, primarily the Montelli and Fisalia families. Renowned for their pioneering spirit, the Montelli family played an instrumental role in charting trade routes that not only connect Ragunna, but also greater Rinascita to the wider world. As the city opened its doors, the Montellis rose to prominence, amassing great wealth and influence. The Montelli family also took the lead in introducing and developing Reserved Terminals across Ragunna. While the Order of the Deep dismissed these Terminals as an inferior mockery of the Genesis Nexus and Common Echoes, the Montellis secured the Order's approval to continue their development in secrecy, offering guarantees of safety and hefty tax payment in exchange.

title: Ragunna
content: Unlike the more traditional families, the Montelli family values emotional bonds and shared ideals above bloodlines and social standing. They advocate for the distribution of opportunities and wealth, believing that riches are worth more when they circulate. Though are often ridiculed by traditional families as "nouveau riche." They are most prevalent in two locations within the Ragunna City: the Montelli Quarter that serves as their base of operations, and the Averardo Vault, the leading bank in all of Rinascita. the Montelli family played a key role in hosting the most recent Carnevale. This endeavor, however, earned them the disdain of the Order of the Deep and, by extension, the Fisalias. Francesco Montelli is the current head of the Montelli Family.

title: Ragunna
content: The Fisalias are also one of the most powerful, and certainly the oldest and most traditional, families in Ragunna, renowned for their expertise in medicine and poison, their craft of extracting toxins from aquatic plants is a legacy passed down in their family. Rosemary's Apothecary is known for its artful blending of medicine and poison and the owner, Rosemary, is a skilled Fisalia pharmacist, yet whispers surrounding the Fisalia family have kept many Ragunnesi wary, leaving her shop paricularly lack of customers. According to rumors, the ancestors of the Fisalia Family were the first to arrive in the islands of Rinascita and the first to establish order and once ignited a war, but were defeated and driven out of the city.

title: Ragunna
content: They are said to predate the Order of the Deep thus their close ties with the religious order. They are well-known for their devotion to the Sentinel Imperator and are often perceived as mystic nobles delighting in the schemes of power. A faction within the Fisalia family believes that the Montelli family's embrace of openness and the privatization of Echoes is a direct affront to Imperator's teachings, threatening to lead Ragunna into an abyss of heresy. They have directly opposed the Montellis through various means. Aside from Porto-Veno Castle, the current Fisalia Residencies in Ragunna are near the Cathedral of Mercury. As the subject of many notorious rumors, their name is unwelcomed by citizens, who call them the "Poison of Ragunna". Cantarella is the thirty-sixth matriarch of the Fisalia family, and the former Blessed Maiden of Imperator.

title: Rakosan's Speech (Excerpt)
content:
"The Spacetrek Observatory stands as a monumental achievement co-built by the Spacetrek Collective and the Roya. Its mission is to map Lahai-Roi's various data points. Unlike the Casettes that store personal data, the Observatory primarily captures and tracks the changes in Lahai-Roi's terrain, ecology, climate, and sky under the influence of Void Storms and Threnodian activity.

As our partnership with the Roya deepened, the Observatory grew to also document their architecture and cultural landmarks. But then, disaster struck. A devastating Void Storm swept through, leaving the structure in ruins. Although the Academy has started the reconstruction, progress has been painstakingly slow. The sheer number of ongoing projects across Lahai-Roi, coupled with the damaged roads leading to the site, has left this massive facility languishing.

title: Rakosan's Speech (Excerpt)
content:
That concludes the introduction to the Spacetrek Observatory. I trust you can now appreciate its importance. Despite the current challenges, its restoration is a necessity! That is why I am calling on each and every one of you to join me in this vital endeavor. We need your help, in whatever form you can offer. Every contribution matters.

My name is Rakosan. I will be here, at the Spacetrek Observatory, waiting for you!"

title: Reactor Drive
content: The Reactor Drive is the Exostrider's power core which acts as Lahai-Roi's underground "sun". The Reactor Drive is the reason Lahai-Roi is the underground haven it is.

title: Reactor Drive
content: Monitoring data confirms that there is a gradual but steady decline in the Reactor Drive's energy output, which both the Roya Tribe and Spacetrek Collective are formulating emergency contingencies for.  According to Ms. Voss, once the Reactor Drive's energy output is depleted, it's gone forever, which is why Lahai-Roi planned the New Solar Ceremony to replace the Reactor Drive with an artificial sun, thus also letting the Exostrider take back the Reactor Drive.

title: Reactor Drive
content: The Hyvatia Detector is a critical sensor for the Reactor Drive. It's a surface detector built by the Spacetrek Collective at Sundermere for the Reactor Drive's inspection and maintenance. It's vital for the Ceremony's data calibration.

title: Reactor Husk
content: to .  Reactor Husk's special ranged attack, Cinder Cut, can be deflected back, dealing damage to the Reactor Husk in return and reducing its Vibration Strength.  After attacking or taking Counterattacks several times, a Vulnerable Core will be exposed on Reactor Husk's left arm. Attacking the exposed core will destroy Reactor Husk's armor, rendering it unable to attack.  Inflicting Negative Statuses on Reactor Husk immediately exposes the Vulnerable Core. If Reactor Husk's armor is destroyed while it is inflicted with Negative Statuses, then it takes 100% more total DMG from Negative Statuses for 30s. During this effect's period, the core will no longer be exposed.  After the Reactor Drive was set above Lahai-Roi by the Exostrider, it remained on high alert to the activities of Aleph-1.  When the Drive's immune response is triggered, a mechanized "Reactor Husk" will arise from the depths of the energy well, with the sole purpose of eliminating intruders at all costs.  Research by Spacetrek Collective shows that Reactor Husk was once part of the Exostrider. Both share a mission to resist the Threnodian threat and safeguard civilization.|Description when discovered}}

title: Real
content:
Real: Techniques or story? Form, or the theme? What should be my focus? What is my message here?"
Real: In this commercialized market, do we still produce anything of substance?
Real: Sigh, these thoughts weigh on me every day... A movie packed with special effects but devoid of real story slips from the audience's mind like sand through the fingers.
Real: No matter how dazzling the form, how can a glossy wrapper around nothing stick in the audience's mind?
Real: Sometimes while editing, I wonder, "What is it that I am making?" Is something that I myself have no feelings for really worth the effort?
[Dialogue Option]  You're still hanging in there. Why?
[Dialogue Option]  Why haven't you given up?
Real: Yes. Why?
Real: Perhaps deep inside me, I'm still feeling the urge. To say words I haven't spoken. To tell a story I haven't told before.
Real: Never mind, what can I do? I know I'll never get over myself if I don't make a movie that captures what I want to say.
[Dialogue Option]  Do you like films?
Real: Haha... It may sound a bit awkward, but it's the love of my life.
Real: A side of me wants to focus on the work itself, while a voice in my head whispers, "Think about the market." And with the deadline approaching, none of it matters as long as I can hand it in in time...

title: Rebecca
Rebecca/Backstory
content:
Rebecca was a very sharp-tongued young woman, and has a tendency to be extreme and unpredictable. She was often shown going all out in fights, sometimes even laughing manically. Nevertheless, Rebecca is loyal and does everything for the crew of Maine, including supporting newcomer David where she can.

Rebecca has feelings for David Martinez, as she mentions that she wasn't okay "playing just friends," and sarcastically comments to Kiwi that perhaps she should change her appearance and attitude to seem more like David's girlfriend Lucy.

title: Rebecca/Backstory
content: Despite her apparent immaturity, she was rather perceptive, being the first to notice when David is beginning to suffer from cyberpsychosis. She also handles her romantic interest in David maturely, never violating his boundaries beyond flirting. Though jealous, she eventually gives up and helps him reunite with Lucy, noting the strength of their bond. She becomes the secondary muscle of the group following Maine and Dorio's passing, demonstrating her extreme skills with firearms and ability to survive in combat despite having relatively little cyberware.

title: Rebecca/Backstory
content: Rebecca is short in stature, with soft features and stark white skin with a faint blue tint, contrasting with her 3 pink tattoos: a Mox-esque one around her neck, a goat's head around her abdomen, and one around her right thigh that stylistically reads "PK DICK".

title: Rebecca/Backstory
content: Clothing is minimal for Rebecca as her preferred dress is simply her black bra and underwear, a black, Kitsch, high collar jacket with green accents that go down below her waist (left half-zipped), and a pair of matching sneakers. Besides the jacket and shoes, she pulls her green hair up into pigtails with a dual clipped hair band. Her cyberware is subtle with only her pink and yellow cyberoptics standing out. Later on, mimicking her brother Pilar, she utilizes oversized cyberarms in red and blue for right and left, respectively.

title: Relay Station Rental Service Notice
content:
"The Relay Station combines garage, warehouse, rest areas, and basic laboratory facilities in a single complex, providing support for arduous field research and logistics operations. One of its key services is vehicle rental.

The station primarily offers three types of vehicles:
- Hauler: A large vehicle designed for transporting heavy cargo.
- Pathfinder: A medium-sized vehicle for personnel transfer, with limited cargo capacity.
- Sprinter: A small vehicle optimized for rapid, solo transport.

Due to limited vehicle availability, all applicants must submit a formal request. The staff will review each application and assign vehicles based on demonstrated need.

'Lately, it seems like all the Haulers in Lahai-Roi are heading to the Spacetrek Observatory. Just how massive is that project?'"

title: Resonance Nexus
content:
Resonance Nexuses are structures found across Solaris-3. When a player unlocks one for the first time, the corresponding region will be revealed in the map. The Nexuses are part of a global monitoring network to anticipate Tacet Discord outbreaks, Waveworn Phenomena and to coordinate their contaiment by local authorities and the Black Shores. They serve as the core of the ecological information network centralising the energy fluctuation detection of Resonance Beacons to convey information forward.

As some of the most imposing structures on the landscape, they often acquire local names and histories. The one in the centre of Jinzhou City is known as the Nexus Tower; Rinascita's are also known as the Genesis Nexuses; Startorch Academy's largest is called the Solis Lens Array; and in Xuanfang they are Lexicon Axes.

title: Riccardo
content: Riccardo is an NPC who appears in Bank Street, Ragunna. He can be seen arguing with Alexandro Montelli during the daytime.

title: Riccardo
content:
[Objective: (at Margherita)]
Riccardo de Fisalia: I heard that Montelli's golds flow on every river in today's Ragunna.
Alexandro Montelli: Simple rule of supply and demand. The market calls and we're only answering their needs.
Riccardo de Fisalia: And I was wondering why Ragunna City reeks of money and snobs these days.
Alexandro Montelli: Some folks are eager to work with us in their pursuit of wealth and self-actualization. We're simply providing them with the platform.
Alexandro Montelli: Since we're on that matter, do you have financial needs we can assist you with? I couldn't help but notice the lofts in Fisalia Residencies seem... out of repair.
Alexandro Montelli: If you're planning on a renovation, rest assured—I have some connections in construction and design.
Riccardo de Fisalia: Hmph—I would not waste my breath lecturing you on defending the longstanding traditions and principles of Ragunna, and of Rinascita.
Riccardo de Fisalia: We Fisalias would never disrespect our values and beliefs. But you Montellis wouldn't wait to walk away from these for your grand "course", would you?
[Dialogue Option]  (It got pretty intense...)
[Dialogue Option]  (Best not to interrupt...)
Alexandro Montelli: We're simply adapting to the times. Even the Order is willing to guide us toward ascension. Only fools would drown in old dreams.
Alexandro Montelli: Oh, forgive me—I nearly forgot.
Alexandro Montelli: In the past, it was you who controlled the Order and the path of ascension. But now...
Riccardo de Fisalia: Mind you, though we may have past our prime, our family still stands stronger than yours.
Alexandro Montelli: There, you said it yourself, Fisalia is history now.

title: Riddle Twiddle
content:
Riddle Twiddle is an event-exclusive point of interest located in Taoyuan Vale, Central Plains, Huanglong during the By Moon's Grace event.

Players can visit every day during the event for prizes.

title: Riddle Twiddle
content:
[Objective: (First interaction)]
Xieyang: A full moon hangs in the midnight sky...
Xieyang: Waves crash and echo, cliffs stand high...
[Dialogue Option]  Excuse me, is this for the lantern riddles?
Xieyang: You're in the right place! See these lanterns? They are all set for the game!
Xieyang: The Moon-Chasing Festival fuels my brilliance! It ignites my creativity, setting the stage for my next masterpiece!
Xieyang: Don't worry about running out of riddles. I'll keep up with your guessing speed...
Xieyang: A promise made is a promise kept!
Xieyang: By the way, your name sounds familiar. Rover... Aha! You must be that legendary hero! The one as knowledgeable as I am!
Xieyang: Eyeing the prizes? Haha, solve the lantern riddles and they're all yours!

title: Riddle Twiddle
content:
Xieyang: Eyeing the prizes? Haha, solve the lantern riddles and they're all yours!



Xieyang: A sharp mind is all you need to solve the riddles. Come on, you can do this!
[Dialogue Option]  Solve the riddle
Xieyang: Rover, would you like to give today's riddle a shot? You'll get a reward regardless.
[Dialogue Option]  Sure.
;(Set 1)
Xieyang: What walks on four legs in the morning, two legs at noon, and three legs in the evening?
[Dialogue Option]  Humans.
Xieyang: Correct. Rover, you're as amazing as they say. Here is your reward.
[Dialogue Option]  Will I be eaten if I get it wrong?
Abby: No, but you'll miss out on the grand prize. Here's your reward.
Abby: Why would you be eaten? This story sounds familiar...
[Dialogue Option]  Isn't this from a popular bedtime story?
Xieyang: Yes... Ahem, anyway, here's your reward.
Abby: You gave me the reward for the wrong answer... How stingy.
;(Set 2)
Xieyang: What makes people feel young again, brings both joy and sorrow, does no harm, and stays with them forever?
[Dialogue Option]  Memories.
Xieyang: Correct. Rover, you're as amazing as they say. Here is your reward.
Abby: You're so amazing, Rover! You even know the answer to such a difficult riddle!
[Dialogue Option]  Loans
Xieyang: What a depressing answer. What makes it worse is that it isn't the correct answer even though it's also very appropriate. Here is your reward.
Abby: Huh, that's not the right answer, but it makes sense to me though...
[Dialogue Option]  Is it the Convene feature?
Xieyang: I'm sorry, but that's not the correct answer. Your answer is a little too depressing. Here's your reward.
Abby: This is scary! How did you know?
;(Set 3)
Xieyang: What is naked in winter, loses all its hair in winter, is fully armed in summer, and grows in spring?
[Dialogue Option]  A tree.
Xieyang: Correct. Rover, you're as amazing as they say. Here is your reward.
Abby: You're so amazing, Rover! You even know the answer to such a difficult riddle!
[Dialogue Option]  Abby.
Abby: Yes, of course it's... Wait a minute! That's not right. I'm not naked!
Xieyang: Hahaha, what an interesting answer, but unfortunately, it's not the correct one. I do love it, though. Here's your reward.
Abby: Rover, so that's what you think of me...
[Dialogue Option]  I can do all that, too.
Xieyang: Really...? Ahem, unfortunately, that isn't the correct answer. Here's your reward.
Abby: You're naked in winter... that's so impressive, Rover!
;(Set 4)
Xieyang: What's cold and breathless in both life and death and drinks water its entire life even though it never gets thirsty?
[Dialogue Option]  Fishes.
Xieyang: Correct. Rover, you're as amazing as they say. Here is your reward.
Abby: You're so amazing, Rover! You even know the answer to such a difficult riddle!
[Dialogue Option]  Are you talking about Sanhua? She does seem quite cold and aloof.
Xieyang: Hahaha, what an interesting answer, but unfortunately, it's not the correct one. I do love it, though. Here's your reward.
Abby: Huh, that's not the answer, but it makes sense to me, though...
[Dialogue Option]  Me!
Xieyang: Cold and b-breathless?! S-Stay away from me! H-here is your reward.
;(Set 5)
Xieyang: What controls the tides, waxes and wanes, yet forever remains in Jinzhou to bring people together?
[Dialogue Option]  The moon.
Xieyang: Correct. Rover, you're as amazing as they say. Here is your reward.
Abby: You're so amazing, Rover! You even know the answer to such a difficult riddle!
[Dialogue Option]  Hehe, is the answer me?
Abby: That's not right! The answer should be me!
Xieyang: Hahaha, what an interesting answer, but unfortunately, it's not the correct one. I do love it, though. Here's your reward.
[Dialogue Option]  It's Magistrate Jinhsi.
Abby: Rover, you would have gotten it right if you chose me!
Xieyang: You're right to some extent, but unfortunately, not even the Magistrate can control the tides. Here's your reward.
;(Set 6)
Xieyang: What's invisible and silent, can heal wounds and break things down, forever devouring and indestructable?
[Dialogue Option]  Time.
Xieyang: Correct. Rover, you're as amazing as they say. Here is your reward.
Abby: You're so amazing, Rover! You even know the answer to such a difficult riddle!
[Dialogue Option]  Abby.
Abby: Yes, that's right (nods). I'm really strong.
Xieyang: Hahaha, what an interesting answer, but unfortunately, it's not the correct one. I do love it, though. Here's your reward.
Abby: Huh, that's not the answer, but it makes sense to me, though...
[Dialogue Option]  That has to be me!
Xieyang: Hahaha, what an interesting answer, but unfortunately, it's not the correct one. I do love it, though. Here's your reward.
Abby: Rover, in what way are you invisible...
;(Set 7)
Xieyang: What's small and invisible yet fills the sky? What connects the sky and the earth?
[Dialogue Option]  Rain.
Xieyang: Correct. Rover, you're as amazing as they say. Here is your reward.
Abby: You're so amazing, Rover! You even know the answer to such a difficult riddle!
[Dialogue Option]  The heavy fire of Disruptor cannons.
Xieyang: What? Cannon fire that fills up the sky? I can't imagine that at all. Here's your reward.
Abby: Why did I end up with the reward for the wrong answer...
[Dialogue Option]  The right answer should finally be me, right?
Xieyang: Unfortunately, that isn't the correct answer... I really don't know what kind of riddle would have Rover be the answer. Here's your reward.
Abby: The answer isn't Rover either this time. What could it be?
Xieyang: Hahaha... actually, the answer is rain.
;(Talk to Xieyang again after solving a riddle)
Xieyang: Rover, you've already tried answering this riddle today.
Xieyang: I need some times to prepare more riddles. Please come back tomorrow.
[Dialogue Option]  Chat
Xieyang: Ling from the Academy usually organizes these activities. But this year, she wanted to join in on the fun, so I asked Professor Bosong to take her around.
Xieyang: Ling is a student at the Academy. Something happened to her family... and ever since then, Professor Bosong has been looking after her.
Xieyang: They get along great, but they hardly ever get a break at the Academy. So I stepped in and let them take off to enjoy the festival.
Xieyang: Besides, for a poet of my talent, writing a few riddles is a piece of cake!
[Dialogue Option]  Leave

title: Rika
content:
' is a  girl that can be found west of from Shashou Cafe, in front of the submerged city in water.

Talking to her after completing  will have her move on when you return.

title: Rika
content:
;Rika: Daddy... Mommy... When are you coming back from the sea...?

(After completing )
;Rika Daddy... Mommy... I'll be good, I promise. I won't let you down.

title: Rika
content:
[Dialogue Option]  What are you doing here?
Rika: Hello... I'm waiting for my Daddy and Mommy to come home.
[Dialogue Option]  Why here?
Rika: Aunties and Uncles said Daddy and Mommy went to a place really, really far away, so we can't meet for now.
Rika: But every year on this day... they ride the sea waves back home to visit me.
Rika: Today's the day. I've been waiting so long, but... they still haven't shown up.
Rika: Do you think... maybe Daddy and Mommy forgot about me?
[Dialogue Option]  No, they're probably just busy.
Rika: Mm... you're right. Even if they moved somewhere else, they must be busy, just like always.
[Dialogue Option]  ...Maybe they trust you to take care of yourself.
Rika: I've been doing what they told me... I even learned how to cook.
Rika: So I'll wait a little longer. Maybe they just want to surprise me.

title: Rika
content:
Rika: I've been doing what they told me... I even learned how to cook.
Rika: So I'll wait a little longer. Maybe they just want to surprise me.



(After completing )
[Dialogue Option]  Hi.
Rika: Hello. I... I saw Daddy and Mommy just now.
[Dialogue Option]  Really?
Rika: Yes. It was only for a few minutes, but... they really came back from the water to see me.
Rika: Mommy hugged me so tight, and Daddy patted my head just like he used to.
Rika: It felt like a dream. I was so happy... but also so sad. Is that strange?
[Dialogue Option]  Not at all.
[Dialogue Option]  You waited so long for this. It's only natural to feel so.
Rika: ...Actually, I know. Mommy and Daddy... and I aren't supposed to be here anymore.
Rika: But I promised them I'd see every beautiful place in our hometown for them.
[Dialogue Option]  You can do it.
[Dialogue Option]  ...I'll be cheering for you.
Rika: Thank you... I'm sorry. It's just... when you leave, I think I need to cry a little longer.

title: Roberto
content: Roberto is a male NPC working at the Averardo Vault (Instance).

title: Roberto
content:
Roberto: Today's loss... Hmm, twenty-three crates. Cause: Discovered they were past their recommended usage date during inventory.
Roberto: Oh! Sorry, I didn't see you there. Anything I can help you with?
[Dialogue Option]  Crates? Are they used for transporting collectibles?
Roberto: Yes. We have specially designed crates for transportation.
Roberto: They're filled with thick paddling tailored to the size and shape of the item, keeping everything snug and secure.
Roberto: This minimizes the risk of damage during shipping.
Roberto: We regularly discard crates once they reach their recommended life span, just to be safe. Wouldn't want them to fall apart in transit!
[Dialogue Option]  Fall apart? Has it ever happened before?
Roberto: Well, I'm new here. I haven't seen anything like that firsthand, but from what I've heard... it's happened before.
Roberto: I didn't think much about the whole "discarding crates" thing until Ludvika mentioned all the past accidents—
Roberto: Everything from minor mishaps like drops to fires, robberies, and even Tacet Discord incursions.
Roberto: The Vault has learned from these incidents over the years, and our procedures and have become much more stringent as a result.
Roberto: I suppose I'm standing on the shoulders of those who came before me... but hey, better safe than sorry, right?

title: Rogate
content: Rogate is a researcher found at the Research Institute above Starward Riseway in Lahai-Roi.

title: Rogate
content:
Rogate: This is the Artificial Sun Lab, the R&D hub for Project Helios. Please refrain from touching any equipment.

Rogate: Also, avoid prolonged direct observation of Helios. It is, technically, a contained star.

[Dialogue Option]  Can you tell me more about it?

Rogate: Certainly. "Helios,"' commonly referred to as the artificial sun, is an energy device built by the Spacetrek Collective. Its purpose is to replace the current sun above Lahai-Roi—the Exostrider's Drive. After we return the Drive to the Exostrider, it will continue to provide sustainable energy for Lahai-Roi's ecosystem.

Rogate: This is our first step towards the future. We`l have a sun that belongs to humanity alone... Our success would be nothing short of historic.

Rogate: We're working to ensure this new sun illuminates Lahai-Ro's future. It's why we're here.

title: Rogate
content:
[Objective: After completing the following]
Rogate: ...Oh, it's you. You're the one who helped Professor Mornye launch Helios during the New Solar Ceremony, right? Never got the chance to extend my gratitude.

Rogate: Thank you.

[Dialogue Option]  It was a collective effort.
Rogate: Haha... I won't deny that.

[Dialogue Option]  I'm just a student. I didn't help much.
Rogate: Haha, is that so? Let's leave it at that.

[Dialogue Option]  How's Helios running now?

Rogate: Stable. Power systems, core output, and signal transmission are all in perfect sync. Not that we're letting our guard down.

Rogate: Don't worry. We'll keep our new sun safe.

title: Rohrwacher
content: Rohrwacher is a cautious Fisalia member NPC who appears outside the Cathedral of Mercury. He can be seen standing next to an Abyssal Mercator at the lounge area from 6:00 AM to 5:59 PM and underneath the Cathedral by the Sentinel statue at 6:00 PM to 5:59 AM.

title: Rohrwacher
subsection: (At night, by the Sentinel statue underneath the Cathedral)
content:
[Objective: (At night, by the Sentinel statue underneath the Cathedral)]
Rohrwacher: Hail Imperator-
Rohrwacher: You who watch over Ragunna at all times, overseeing the people of Ragunna.
Rohrwacher: I have an audacious request- please, look up, look up at the Order sitting on you.
Rohrwacher: Ah, why won't you look up? Is it that you don't wish to, or that you simply can't? Ahahahahaha..
Rohrwacher: ...O Imperator... You are not the Imperator I remembered.

metadata.subsection: (At night, by the Sentinel statue underneath the Cathedral)

title: Rohrwacher
content:
[Objective: (After]
Rohrwacher: Hail Imperator—
Rohrwacher: So you have already perished. Your gaze no longer watches over the people of Ragunna.
Rohrwacher: You cannot look upon the Order, nor can you watch over your people.
Rohrwacher: Haha... Hahahaha...
Rohrwacher: O Imperator! Let us offer you a solemn, eternal farewell!

title: Rohrwacher
content:
Rohrwacher: My friend from afar, I see you're getting close to the Montellis.
[Dialogue Option]  How did you know?
Rohrwacher: Even though Fisalia has been quiet, we still have ears everywhere.
Rohrwacher: But I want to give you a heads-up—don't trust them too much.
Rohrwacher: They're driven by money, measuring everything by what it's worth, even "talent" is just another commodity in their eyes, something to be stored in their vault.
Rohrwacher: They don't share the deep family values and bonds we cherish. A tower built on gold isn't just unrespectable; it's also fragile and prone to fall apart.
[Dialogue Option]  But the people I know from the Montelli family don't seem to think that way...
Rohrwacher: It's best to keep your distance. Getting caught up in our drama isn't worth it. You should always look after your own interests.
Rohrwacher: We all have roles we must see through, but you shouldn't be part of the play, nor just a spectator in the audience.
Rohrwacher: You should go behind the scenes and find the one who's pulling the strings.

title: Route Constructor Operation Manual
content:
"Operators must follow the steps below with strict attention to operate Route Constructors.

Step 1: Put in the required amount of Compressed Bedrock.
Note: Compressed Bedrock is processed material made of natural minerals. After refining native Lahai-Roi stone, the Spacetrek Collective produces a high-density construction medium. Once parsed and separated by the Route Constructor, it can be combined with other resources to form structural baseplates for various building types.

Step 2: Put in the required amount of Mechanite.
Note: Mechanite is a native Lahai-Roi mineral. After the arrival of the Exostrider, mechanical patterns and structures started to grow on it under the influence. The Collective has found that electronic devices made with this mineral exhibit increased computational performance, as if the Mechanite itself has processing capability.

title: Route Constructor Operation Manual
content:
Step 3: Put in the required amount of Constructor Cores.
Note: Constructor Cores are artificial power units designed for the equipment's operation. Since the Route Constructor's immense energy demands, remote deployment, and single-use nature make stable energy lines impractical, the Collective developed these cores to serve as portable, reusable "batteries." They are charged by focusing the Reactor's light through a Solis Lens Array.

Step 4: Verify the construction blueprint.
Note: Blueprints are usually pre-loaded during setup. Only a simple confirmation is required.

Step 5: Ensure the construction area is fully cleared of any personnel, animals, or Exoswarm units.

Step 6: Activate the Route Constructor."

title: Rover
Rover/Backstory
content: Rover is a calm, kind figure. Despite being an amnestic, they show no complete dejection over their condition. If anything, Rover makes it clear that despite their search for their lost past, they also invoke the need to discover what the world has to offer them, including the journey they travel that brims with new novel sounds, stories, and the people they meet. As such, despite being stoic and expressionless at times, they are approachable and make friends with many of the playable characters who each take a liking to them. Having no problem whether they are human or not, only their nature.

title: Rover/Backstory
content: While quiet, the Rover is willing to aid those in need, no matter the circumstances behind it. Even when told by Jinhsi that they did not have to join the battle against the Threnodian, Ovathrax, they support regardless and take part during the battle. Showing courage and bravery, putting the well-being of others despite not knowing them, while humbly working alongside the numerous characters they meet during their time in Jinzhou. As such, they are quick to become angered whenever one of their companions is caught in danger, such as Yangyang who had been sent away by Scar. They also place trust in others, even those who seemingly betray it as Yinlin did, can be regained, showcasing their ability in seeing the good people have. This in turn causes Rover to hold a dislike, at times disdain, towards those who treat human lives as tools. An example being Dollmaker that Rover showed no sympathy towards due to the criminal's action in disregarding those who he could have helped, but treated them without care. The same going towards the Tethys System, whom Rover disliked over it's apathetic nature and decisions in both it's willingness to sacrifice individual humans and disregard towards the Shorekeeper as a person.

title: Rover/Backstory
content: This trait stems from their past-self, with flashbacks and information from the Shorekeeper revealing that they wished to unite humanity against the Lament and the danger it possessed. Professing that no unique or even chosen group can stop it, and thus humans must come together as one. Taking nothing for granted, Rover enjoys what civilization offers, and believes that salvation comes from where nobody needs to be saved, thus why until that day, human lives gone shouldn't be treated in vain. Putting in their full effort to find a way to stop the Lament no matter how much time passes, or even where they travel to, even if it meant purposely losing their own memories.

title: Rover/Backstory
content: However, they can also be rather ruthless at times. When they discover how Medulius, someone who took joy in bloodshed and desired for Aulus to be killed by his daughter, Verbia, Rover attempted to murder them in disgust. They were also suspicious and never truly trusted Phrolova, wary and cautious of her the entire time. While they did hold some level of sympathy towards her when discovering her past, they believed her to be obsessed and when attempting to attain Leviathan's gem, they purposely threw their sword at her, killing her physical form. At the same time, Phrolova accuses them of discarding bonds with friends and allies, pointing out that they purposely wiped their own memory for a chance in solving the Lament, even if it meant breaking previously made promises, something the Rover doesn't deny.

title: Rover/Backstory
content:
Although, while Rover is considerably heroic, some of their other traits include a weariness in doing certain requests that may stem from finding it bothersome. They also ask for compensation for such deeds, a quirk that the Ebony Gatekeeper says was rather normal for them. Likely from realizing some of their participation in certain activities, such as the Lollo Campaign, may have complications when joining in.

title: Roya Tribe
content: The Roya Tribe are the indigenous people of Lahai-Roi. They inhabited the country before the planetary shifts occurred which froze the surface, causing them to relocate underground. They built the Solisylum and consider it their calling to guide the growth and migration of Exoswarm by using a calendar created after observing the behaviour of the Exostrider's Reactor Drive.

title: Roya Tribe
content: Roya chosen by the Soliskin for their pure nature become shepherds. Their duty is to guide and care for the Soliskin. They lead the Soliskin to the best sunlit areas of Bjatr Woods and keep them safe.

title: Roya Tribe
content: Royan individuals gifted in calendrical calculation and a degree of resonance with the Exostrider and Soliskin are permitted into the Solisylum. There, they serve the Heliodic Six as aides and the tribe as healers and teachers, all while being groomed as the Six's eventual successors.

title: Roya Tribe
content: Roya Elders such as the Eye, the Binder, and the Shaper. Each pair in the Six is entrusted with the roles of observation, archival, and extrapolation. They reside within the Solislyum, tracing the Reactor Drive's trajectories and forecasting Void Storms.

title: Rubia
content: Rubia is a female student from the Department of Voidmatters seen with a TAR-D Unit named Pikjo. She talks about her classmates, Erio and Sena. She wants to help her friends reconnect.

title: Rubia
content:
;Rubia You're a minute behind, Pikjo!
;Rubia But that's okay—sometimes even the whole world moves slowly.
;Rubia Or... You could try clapping to a beat.
;Rubia ...
;Rubia Just breathe, relax, and follow the wind's tempo.
;Rubia Yes, just like that. Now the wind is your friend, too!

title: Rubia
content:
[Objective: (First time interacting)]
Rubia: Good, there we go.
Rubia: Maybe try to keep up with Pikbo... even if it's a minute faster than the other TARD-Es.
Rubia: Is that why you haven't seen each other as much lately?
Rubia: Hmm... Though I suppose people who don't get along usually try to avoid each other.
Rubia: ...Just like those two over there.
Rubia: Oh, we have a new friend joining us!
Rubia: Why don't we go over and say hello, Pikjo? Just remember to speak a little more softly and gently.
[Dialogue Option]  Hello there.
Pikjo: Hello, Rover of Rabelle College. Tardy to class: zero times. Late assignment submissions: zero.
Pikjo: Keep up the good work.
Rubia: That's amazing. How do you do it? I've missed morning classes nine times already this semester.
Rubia: Hehe... at least Pikjo never gets mad at me.
Pikjo: Rubia from the Department of Voidmatters. Tardy to class: nine times. Late assignment submissions: zero.
Pikjo: Warning! Serious warning! Invalid warning...
[Dialogue Option]  The semester's only just begun...
Rubia: Huh? What?
[Dialogue Option]  Um... Are you giving lessons to that TARD-E unit?
[Dialogue Option]  Um... Are you teaching that TARD-E unit to sing?
[Dialogue Option]  Um... Are you calibrating that TARD-E unit?
Rubia: No, I'm apologizing to it.
Rubia: Maybe Pikjo's gotten slower because I've been late so many times.
Rubia: But if this continues... Pikjo and Pikbo will always be two minutes apart, and forever out of sync...
Rubia: Just like Erio and Sena...
[Dialogue Option]  Erio?
Rubia: That boy over there with the light brown hair—That's Erio.
Rubia: And Sena is the girl with the short hair over there.
[Dialogue Option]  Sena?
Rubia: That girl over there with the short hair—That's Sena.
Rubia: And Erio is the boy with the light brown hair over there.
Rubia: I think they had an argument.
Rubia: But I'd say they're more like different alarm clocks.
Rubia: It was so lively when they chimed together. But one day, one rang on the hour like always, while the other insisted on ringing a few minutes early.
Rubia: Then... the ticking stopped, and the room fell quiet.
Rubia: ...Rover, maybe you could go see them when you have the time?
Rubia: Maybe... they still want to mesh, but their gears need a gentle nudge to get moving again.

title: Rubia
content:
[Objective: (After completing]
Pikjo: Rubia from the Department of Voidmatters. Tardy to class: ten times. Late assignment submissions: zero.
Pikbo: Warning! Serious warning!
Pikjo: Invalid warning...
Rubia: Rover!
Rubia: Look, look! Pikjo and Pikbo are back together and boisterous as ever!
[Dialogue Option]  You're right... They're totally in sync again.
Rubia: Heh... Didn't I say it was only temporary?
[Dialogue Option]  Now they're giving you warnings together.
Rubia: Hehe, sometimes it's good to have that sense of urgency.
[Dialogue Option]  How were you late again...?
Rubia: Huh? Did I break my old record?
[Dialogue Option]  That reminds me, Erio and Sena...
[Dialogue Option]  They seem to be back on good terms now.
Rubia: Told you so! All they needed was a little time, an opportunity, and a pinch of courage.
Rubia: Of course, the "wind" also did its part to help!
[Dialogue Option]
[Dialogue Option]  That is to say, you were the "wind" carrying the message?
Rubia: Who, me? I didn't do a thing!
[Dialogue Option]  Really? I'm not convinced.
Rubia: Hm... Does making two frequencies with different waveforms briefly intersect at a certain moment count?
Rubia: Erio and Sena... are dear friends of mine.
Rubia: But they both take everything too seriously.
Rubia: They were so afraid that listening to each other's heartbeat would cause them to fall out of lockstep.
Rubia: At the very least, they needed to let the Platinheart Bloom blossom first. The heart's tempo can only be heard once all other noise is silenced.
Rubia: Finally, it's like you said—Different notes can come together to form a beautiful melody.
[Dialogue Option]  ...You really are a magician at work.
Rubia: Well... you added a spell of your own, didn't you?

title: Rugo
content: ' is a male NPC Blacksmith seen at the Smitthy camp up on one of the cliffs by Hunter's Den. He is seen with a Wooter assistant, wearing Blacksmith apparel.

title: Rugo
content:
[Objective: (First Interaction)]
;Rugo Come on, Ferripaws! Make the flames burn brighter!
;Ferripaws *A firm and resolved cry*
;Rugo Don't get too close to the fire, or your whiskers will get singed!
;Ferripaws *A cautious and resolved cry*
Rugo: May applause greet you, young one. What brings you here? Crafting or repairs? As you can see, my hammer's swinging so fast it's practically throwing sparks. If you're looking to place an order, you'll have to wait your turn.
[Dialogue Option]  I'm curious about Wootters.
[Dialogue Option]  Why have they never appeared in Septimont City?
Rugo: Well, folks say the Wootters did live in Septimont City a long time ago. But after the first Dark Tide hit, they all moved out to the Sanguis Plateaus and settled here.
Rugo: Some believe it was the Sentinel Imperator who helped them make the move, so they could support the hunters fighting the Dark Tide.
Rugo: We're grateful for these fuzzy little ones, and even more so to Imperator, who's always been a great ally of Septimont.

title: Rugo
content:
Rugo: We're grateful for these fuzzy little ones, and even more so to Imperator, who's always been a great ally of Septimont.



;Rugo What's the most important trick in smithing, Ferripaws?
;Ferripaws *An agreeing cry*
;Rugo That's right! Just like cooking fish, it's all about the temperature!

title: Ruka
content:
Ruka: Chisa's top of the class again... How impressive...
Ruka: She enrolled not long ago but is already caught up. How can I get that good...?
Arisa: Why not just ask her for advice?
Ruka: Eh?! She feels... I don't know, unapproachable?

title: Ruka
content:
[Objective: During  - Search for Runes]
;Chisa is amazing. That giant TD didn't even last a second against her.
;I figured she was just the brainy type. Didn't expect her to be that good in a fight too...
;You think this operation might be our chance? To become friends with her?

title: Ruka
content:

She is from Xianling Village and a Celestial mechanist from the Court of Savantae.

title: Ruoyun
content:
She was one of the artisans among the other soldiers and artisans who sacrificed themselves by detonating the Yuan Fortress to stop the Tacet Discords from overrunning Mengzhou.

A letter from her can be encountered during  as a hidden interaction. There she wrote to Ling to have them move to Mengzhou with Liang.

It is revealed that alongside other Court of Savantae artisans, she signed a contract with the Sentinel when she joined its construction project to help build the Xuanfang Hold into becoming a Celestial once construction was complete. While she lay dying in the midst of Yuan Fortress' self-destruction, she was personally visited and consoled in her dying moments by Sentinel Hsin, and agreed to become a Celestial after being offered the duty.

title: Ruoyun
content:
As a Celestial, she was restricted from disclosing certain information or revealing her identity to Rover's group, thus she took the form of an owl Autopuppet called Jadie.

After completing Song of the Heart Sword, she can be found at the gazebo near the entrance of the recreated Yuan Fortress in Xuanyuan Domain.

content: Sakura Quarter is an Area located in Chronorift Metropolis. It is accessible via Stranger Things in Honami.

title: Sakura Quarter
content:
Unlocked by finding all Missing Namipons in Namipon Case Files

Once hailed as "Honami City's most beautiful living quarter," Sakura Quarter was a place where cherry blossoms framed the rows of residences in a picturesque harmony. Cross the blossom-shaped footbridge and walk a few blocks, and you would see the famous "Sakura Upon Water" spot, a favourite for young lovers. The housing prices here, however, were anything but beautiful.

title: Sakura Quarter
content: In the past, the neighbourhood was safe, uneventful, and almost free of ghost stories. But after the Lament, tales began to spread. Many speak of the "Mysterious Scissorwoman," a black-haired, red-eyed schoolgirl. At times, she leaps from rooftops, drifting down like a crow's feather. At others, she flashes across the streets, cutting through TDs with her giant scissors. Some say she came from Hell, others call her a hero of justice, while a few whisper that her figure in battle resembles the legendary miko herself.

title: Sanhua
Sanhua/Backstory
content:
Sanhua is a Resonator who rarely lets her emotions show. You can sense a certain distance when you first meet her. Sanhua is also careful not to burden others with her actions. Perhaps, her personality stems from her tragic past.
Sanhua's tragedy started with a heavy snowfall. A sudden emergence of the Waveworn Phenomenon consumed the town where she resided. Sanhua was the sole survivor of this devastating catastrophe. While she managed to escape the clutches of the Tacet Discords, her right eye was injured. Sanhua was born blind, but the erosion of Waveworn Phenomenon gave her terrifying and anomalous vision.
In addition to her anomalous vision, this catastrophe also granted her a powerful Forte of ice manipulation. In her youth, Sanhua struggled to keep her Forte under control. Her body always emitted an unconscious, chilling coldness that repelled those around her.
Her life changed when she met Jinhsi — the first person who appeared normal and untwisted in Sanhua's eyes. Jinhsi gave her hope that destruction could also bring a new birth. As a result, Sanhua wholeheartedly pledged her loyalty to Jinhsi,  and she has been tirelessly working towards creating the future they both dream of.
With the arrival of you, the Rover, Sanhua's world is poised for new and transformative changes: In her eyes, your frequency resonates with the same beauty and clarity that she once saw in Jinhsi.

title: Sanhua/Backstory
content:
As Jinhsi's guard, there's no doubt that Sanhua demonstrates exceptional physical prowess. In fact, she's capable of a lot more than that — Sanhua has a vast reserve of knowledge that enables her to respond fluently to any query. Her outstanding ability to remain composed enables her to handle emergencies flexibly. Furthermore, she boasts excellent cooking skills on par with a seasoned chef, and her adeptness in negotiations paves the way for successful deals.

Sanhua's capabilities extend beyond guarding— she's a proficient secretary as well. For example, she can finish all the paperwork for the next three months in a couple of days, and Jinhsi would joke how Sanhua left her "nothing to do"; she can also deliver all three meals to Jinhsi's doorway quietly, without ever being noticed... These tasks constitute her daily routine.

title: Sanhua/Backstory
content: It's important to note that Sanhua wasn't inherently an all-rounder. Her versatility is a testament to her remarkable fast-learning ability. If she believes that a skill will help Jinhsi, she is going to master it quickly without hesitation.

title: Sanhua/Backstory
content:
Although Sanhua has fully mastered her Forte now, the changes in her mood continue to influence the temperature around her.

When Sanhua senses a lurking danger or unfriendly situation, delicate snowflakes materialize around her, serving as a clear sign that she is becoming defensive. Sometimes, these snowflakes appear not only in response to danger but also when she feels embarrassed or anxious. It is difficult for others to discern the exact trigger behind the emergence of these snowflakes, as Sanhua maintains a poker face.

title: Sanhua/Backstory
content: Sanhua has a deep passion for improving her cooking abilities, especially when it comes to making Loong Buns. She is particularly motivated because Jinhsi loves Loong Buns so much. Sanhua enjoys experimenting with various fillings to create different types of Loong Buns, just to listen to Jinhsi's happy sigh as she savors the delicious treats. Now, Sanhua has a new "customer", and that's the Rover. Sanhua aims to share the delightful taste of her Loong Buns with you. Therefore, her dedication to honing her cooking skills is stronger than ever.

title: Sanhua/Backstory
section: A Hidden Side Revealed by Flower Beverage
content: Sanhua enjoys a unique beverage made from flower petals. However, she doesn't consume it regularly because she knows it can affect her work. When she drinks it, she becomes more lively and uninhibited. Although she appears normal on the outside, she speaks openly and reacts more slowly. She even resists taking breaks and can remain in this dreamy state for an entire day.

title: Sanhua/Backstory
content:
Sanhua's tragic past and her role as a guard naturally paint her as low-key and distant. This led us to choose black as the dominant color to accentuate this aspect. The pairing of black and gold, both muted colors, enhances their respective textures. With black as the dominant color, it effectively highlights the metallic and glossy essence of gold. Therefore, we adopted plenty of golden elements as embellishments in Sanhua's details. The golden pendant featuring the wave pattern further brings out Sanhua's heroic bearing on the battlefield.

Originally, Sanhua's eyes were gray. However, the influence of Tacet Discord's frequency transformed them both to striking crimson. Her Tacet Mark is located in her right eye's pupil and only appears when Sanhua uses her Resonance Skill.

Sanhua Side Head.jpg
Sanhua Tacet.jpg

title: Sanhua/Backstory
content:
For her clothing style, we harmonized classical and contemporary elements. We chose a pure black beret for Sanhua, as it ensures that her silver hair doesn't attract excessive attention while aligning seamlessly with her attire. This fashion item brings out a cool and neat image of Sanhua. When it comes to Sanhua's clothing and decorations, we incorporated a lot of "Wave Patterns". Different from the "Cloud Patterns" that adorns Yangyang, these patterns yet share a similar style, adding a classical touch to the characters.

Sanhua Front.jpg
Sanhua Back.jpg

title: Sanhua/Backstory
content: Sanhua engages in battles with a calm demeanor, always striving to end the battle swiftly. Her skills are simple yet powerful. She mainly deals damage by denotating the ice creations created by her Normal Attacks and skills through enhanced Heavy Attacks. Once Sanhua sheaths her sword, the very traces of ice and snow that once existed vanish.

title: Scarlet Velvet
content:
Scarlet Velvet is a quest-exclusive NPC who previously had an arrangement with the Montelli Family, acting as an intermediary between them and the common folk, particularly in transactions involving the new Terminals that disrupted the Order's monopoly. Their dealings also extended to perfumes and other goods.

However, the partnership ended abruptly due to Capollo Montelli's interference with the Order, which caused significant trouble for Scarlet, leading her to sever ties with the Montellis. Scarlet could only be contacted through one of her associates, Ernesto, who worked as a bartender to gather intelligence for their operations.

She was a close friend of Benett, the former Averardo Vault Keeper, before his death during the events of .

title: Scarlet Velvet
subsection: (After completing , she can be found on the outskirt of Egla Town)
content:
[Objective: (After completing , she can be found on the outskirt of Egla Town)]
Scarlet Velvet: Hey, Rover. Good to see you again.
[Dialogue Option]  It's been a while.
[Dialogue Option]  You're looking cheerful today.
Scarlet Velvet: Well, I owe that to you and Carlotta. Thanks to your efforts, we've been able to restart our cooperation with the Montelli family, along with others whose ties had been severed.
Scarlet Velvet: The Reserved Terminal is still a sensitive subject in public, but at least now, people here are free to explore in the wild and gather Echoes as they please.
Scarlet Velvet: Honestly, I was shocked when Carlotta asked if I'd be interested in joining your plan. I never imagined you'd outmaneuver the Order and strike a deal with Capollo, forcing him to hand over the core data module.
Scarlet Velvet: But in highsight, trusting you, Carlotta... and Benett's judgement turned out to be the right decision.
Scarlet Velvet: Capollo's been removed and dealt with by the family. Carlotta's busy managing the aftermath alongside Padrino while also focusing on charting a new sea route.
[Dialogue Option]  A new sea route? Where to?
Scarlet Velvet: The exact route hasn't been finalized yet, but it's rumored to span three or four countries.
[Dialogue Option]  Looks like Montelli's ambitions are growing.
Scarlet Velvet: Carlotta told me it was your brilliance that made this possible. Your performance at the Carnevale was so inspiring that more and more people are rallying behind Montelli, eager to explore a bigger, grander world.
Scarlet Velvet: We're still figuring out what ventures to take on and what we truly want to achieve. This time, I'm determined to make the right call too.
Scarlet Velvet: Rover, just sit tight—we'll bring you some good news soon!
