title: Schwarzloch
Schwarzloch
content:
They are the main antagonist of Wuthering Waves, finally confronting Rover and Galbrena in a central antagonistic role during .



They are the cunning, immortal leader of the Fractsidus, who have worked for centuries to further their efforts, recruit new Overseers, and realize their grand design of putting fate into humanity's own hands through mass destruction, by facilitating a new evolution through the creation of a new Lament. Referenced by Galbrena as the "Thousand-Faced Survivor," this name is disturbingly literal, in reference to their ability to perfectly shapeshift into all manner of beings, both physical and conceptual entities alike, which they use to manipulate others for their designs.

title: Schwarzloch
content: As Kharon, he appears as a towering, emaciated hooded figure, draped in layers of dark black robes that conceal all but his face, left half of his torso, and neck. Two thin black straps extend from his cloak's hip that end in golden buckles. He wears a metallic skull-like mask of silver with golden eyes. His mask is dented and cracked, with a vertical scar lining its left eye, and an oval gold plate layering its forehead. Two thin golden metal plates are aligned along the mask's jaw. He wears a shawl of gem-laced golden medallions over his shoulder and chest. His skin is grey with golden cracks, and the skin on his forearms and hands is black. He has a gold bangle on his left arm, and he wields a long, black staff that ends in golden vine-like barbs, with a golden, glowing lantern hanging down from the tip. Locks of lighter colored hair are visible beneath his hood around each side of his mask.

title: Schwarzloch
content:
Schwarzloch is the overarching leader of the Fractsidus, with the title of the Grand Architect. Their true appearance is unknown due to their forte allowing them perfectly mimic the appearance and frequencies of other people. Whenever they appear in the story, they take on appearances that are not their own. Notable examples being Devoted Watcher, "Triss" and Kharon.

Schwarzloch possesses a sly sense of quick-witted charisma and deft cunning, which play into the dynamics of every interaction they have shown thus far. When meeting Phrolova, Schwarzloch appeared in the form of a male audience member, using the form to embellish Phrolova's insecurities, encouraging her to pursue power and destruction as a way to bring back her hometown with the backing of their organization's resources.

title: Schwarzloch
content: During Dreamcatchers in the Secret Gardens, they took the form of Triss to hone Phrolova's focus back to the Fractsidus' goals rather than her immediate obsession with creating the Lost Beyond, with Phrolova implying they frequently used this form in the past to psychologically manipulate her, which they claimed to do because she "liked" it. In the form of Kharon, they attempted to recruit Galbrena, something they once did when they met in the past at her refusal, attacking her for lacking humanity in comparison to the same humans she made an effort to save by hunting Tacet Discords. They claimed that joining the Fractsidus would give her greater purpose. Their god complex fuels their belief that their vision for humanity is "beyond mortal comprehension," which they frustratedly belied once Galbrena again refused his offer.

title: Schwarzloch
content: When met with defeat or setbacks, Schwarzloch remains calm and level-headed, and can even be honorable. After witnessing Leviathan's defeat, they merely spectated without intervening, remarking to Rover that theirs and the Fractsidus' paths were never truly opposed, before promising they would meet again, before departing alongside the other Overseers through a portal. Once Phrolova informed them she would be departing the Fractsidus after fulfilling her promises and duties to them, they responded calmly and pragmatically. They commanded Scar to back off from pursuing her, and allowed her to leave without conflict, as they affirmed their faith in their shared goals eventually reuniting.

title: Schwarzloch
content: Schwarzloch is a Resonator of immense might with numerous abilities. According to Denia, their Resonance ability is currently unknown with none of the abilities showcased being their true Forte, derivatives at best. Schwarzlock is also a very capable leader where Hiyuki can discover notes on the hidden machinations they have caused across Wishes in the Bell. Being well-prepared for different situations, Schwarzloch is also well-informed and acts accordingly to make the most of their plans. Through their long life they’ve gathered much knowledge across the world and are willing to manipulate and tempt others to work with the Fractsidus to achieve their goals.

title: Schwarzloch
content: One of Schwarzloch’s main abilities is shapeshifting and frequency mimicry, to such a powerful extent where Galbrena remarked that they are able to mimic the frequencies of concepts perfectly, which they demonstrated in mimicking the concept of death as Kharon. Galbrena even adds that they could forge an entirely new body with this power. This ability, combined with Schwarzloch’s acting and illusionary skills, means very few would realize they are the Grand Architect themself unless they break character. Even an observant character such as Luuk Herssen only had suspicions that their Nivora persona was actually them until he gained conclusive belief. They can alter their form in an instant if needed.

title: Schwarzloch
content: According to Denia, however, their shapeshifting has a catch in that they need to observe and analyze their target in the long-term to pull it off. How this works with mythical figures is unknown, and it’s suggested that despite managing to shapeshift into Luuk’s father, couldn’t form the small scar the man had as Schwarzloch never noticed it properly. Those like Qiuyuan can also see through their shapeshifting by recognizing Schwarzloch’s frequency.

title: Schwarzloch
content: In conjecture with their shapeshifting ability, while the extent of this power is unknown, Schwarzloch produced an entire group of life-like illusions of humans for Rover and Luuk to see at the SkyArk. For large scale illusions, Wishes in the Bell has Hiyuki venture through a realistic illusion of Honami that was peaceful while also seeing the backstage behind it. Schwarzloch can also communicate through these illusions if they please.

title: Schwarzloch
content: Though the extent of this power isn’t known, Schwarzloch is capable of interfering and manipulating with others’ frequencies. During their visit to Phrolova, they could briefly grant the deceased Triss a temporary corporeal form to linger about outside Phrolova’s eye. To obstruct Qiuyuan, they awakened a sealed Fenrico from their stone prison to battle him. During their fight with Galbrena, they siphoned away all the Tacet Discords in her body to weaken her until Galbrena took them back in when she had the chance.

title: Schwarzloch
content: When meeting with Qiuyuan as Leon, Schwarzloch displayed short-ranged teleportation through black smoke. They can also open a gateway for long-range teleportation to travel vast distances. It’s these abilities, alongside the suggestion of their power to make clones, that allows them to be “everywhere” to gather intel.

title: Schwarzloch
content: When fighting Galbrena in the Journeying Paradise, Schwarzloch can create red spheres of energy and energy beams to launch as attacks, and barriers for defense.

title: Schwarzloch
content: According to Galbrena, the Grand Architect met in the Journeying Paradise was a mere clone. While it’s unclear how powerful these clones are, they seemingly hold the same abilities as the original user and are formidable enough that while Galbrena suggested the clones are somewhat weaker, they injured her in battle.

title: Schwarzloch
content: Among the other abilities they wield, they include the ability to heal, as showcased when they recovered from Galbrena’s flames and when Luuk shot Schwarzloch in the head as Nivora, levitation, flight, producing near-invisible discs to walk on thin air, withstand the corrupting influence of Leviathan's Journeying Paradise, an immense longevity, and create additional limbs that can disconnect from their body that stretches, floats, and attack.

Septimont is a Region and city-state of Rinascita. Unlike Ragunna, Septimont has a far more militant and irreligious culture, as it places far less importance on the primacy of the Sentinel Imperator and instead worships the Lioness of Glory Arsinosa. As a result, the Agons, competitive gladiatorial combat, are the pinnacle of Septimontese society and can even determine the makeup of the political establishment. The Order of the Deep holds little power in Septimont, with most locals uninterested or even hostile to their message of salvation.

Septimont can be reached during .

title: Septimont
content: Septimont is lead by the Ephor, head of the city. The Priestess can foretell fate and can that makes the final calls and acts alongside the Ephor. Most people trust her judgement. They are accompanied by a Council of Elders who advises the Ephor but ultimately, the decision-making comes down to them. The Ephor's word is law as the rule of Septimont is those who have Power stands at the top. The current Ephor is Augusta and the current Priestess is Iuno, who is considered extreme in the line of Priestesses. Not everyone agrees with her behavior despite her capabilities.

title: Septimont
content: Aside from succession via , Septimont's system of government somewhat resembles that of ancient , with the Ephor and Priestess of Septimont advised by a Council of Elders bearing similarities to the  who are in turn advised, ironically, by five individuals holding the title of , though the Elders are more akin to the . Though, unlike the Spartan Ephors and Gerousia, the Septimont Council of Elders have no judicial authority over the Ephor and Priestess.

title: Septimont
content: Septimont is derived from Latin septem montes, meaning “seven mountains” or “seven hills.” The name references Rome, traditionally known as the city of the Seven Hills.

title: Shards of the Beyond
content: The Lost Beyond is a Point of Interest located in  and a Sonoro Sphere created by Phrolova.

title: Shards of the Beyond
content: The Lost Beyond is an artificially created Sonoro Sphere made by Phrolova as a means to make a land of serenity, harmony, and perfection. Her goal was to create a world that is unaffected by the reach of time nor tragedy, which contains the Frequencies of those she lost and desires the Sonoro Sphere to become a reality. She chose this method as her research found that while Artificial Sonoro Spheres have a short duration with inherit instability, followed by how the influence of Fortes can cause unintended changes to them alongside needing constant sustained applications of her Resonance ability, it was considered a solid support for her needs in transferring the frequencies of her loved ones into it.

title: Shards of the Beyond
content: However, due to it's nature, Phrolova is unable to make it whole and thus needed a divine "texture" to stabilize it: Leviathan's Gem, which contained the essence and power of the Threnodian itself. Without it, the Lost Beyond was unstable, which Phrolova could tell as she was linked with her artificial creation itself. Any disharmony felt in the realm notified her in an instant, primarily due to it being tied to her life. Although, a consequence was that the Lost Beyond began merging with her, with the Grand Architect suggesting that as it holds onto her tighter, her life was at risk. At the same time, she can recover so long as she's in sync with the merging between her and the Lost Beyond.

title: Shards of the Beyond
content: Though, she was unable to claim the gem,which would allow "perfect harmony", due to Fenrico's and Rover's interference. More than that, while she was able to sustain the Lost Beyond for a time after her physical form temporarily perished and had her frequencies merge with it, Cristoforo commented that even with Leviathan's power, the Sonoro Sphere couldn't endure. It's unclear if the Lost Beyond has collapsed at present or if the experiment itself simply failed.

title: Shards of the Beyond
content: The residents found in the Lost Beyond are all people who Phrolova knew and lived with from their original home of Ostina. After their demise, Phrolova captured their frequencies and stored them in her right eye, with her plans being to resurrect them as immortal beings with the Lost Beyond being created as a sanctuary and new home for them. However, Phrolova's ideal form for them was that from her research and her own existence as a Tacet Discord/Human hybrid, believed they to should become like her, supported by the Grand Architect as her earlier attempts in her long life failed until he appeared.

title: Shards of the Beyond
content: However, the residents frequencies were slowly fading, with much of Phrolova's focus being to find a method in preserving their human consciousness. Thus she sought Leviathan's power of Unity to grant them a proper "rebirth", as while she could merge Reverberations with Tacet Discords on her own, Leviathan's powers of assimilation were greater than her own capabilities.. At present, she had successfully merged their Reverberations with Tacet Discords, keeping their consciousness alive but intends to creating new vessels for them through Leviathan's Gem so they'd be properly revived. At a first glance, everyone in the Lost Beyond appears indistinguishable from real people. Even so, her attempts in doing this made it so that they could never truly be human again, as at times the Lost Beyond's residents will transform into Tacet Discords without anyone realizing it, which the Rover considered insane.

title: Shards of the Beyond
content: As the Rover proclaims, those fading Reverberations cannot return to life, no matter how long she holds onto their frequencies, where all she created were unusual Tacet Discords. This, alongside their imprisonment in Phrolova's eye, has caused the residents to go half-mad as beyond a few like Triss, some find their existence unbearable and desire death but eventually switch back to seeking immortal life. It's suggested Phrolova keeps the Lost Beyond in a loop of sorts while manipulating their memories in an attempt to keep them from fully succumbing to insanity.

title: Shiyan
content:
Shiyan: I see many listeners today. Thank you for joining us! But before we begin, let us begin a new subject.
Shiyan: It's not about the Teal General or the Battle of Norfall Barrens...
Shiyan: Today, let's talk about Jinzhou, the fortress city we call home. Huanglong boasts one capital and six cities, and Jinzhou is the gatekeeper.
Shiyan: The name "Jinzhou" itself is rather special. Its spoken and written form have layers of meaning.
Shiyan: It sounds like the word for "gateway," and when its written, resembles the shape of a dragon's roar. Hence, we call this place "Jinzhou."
Shiyan: And as for what "Jin" really means, it also signifies the beginning, where every journey starts. That's why Jinzhou is always ready to welcome travelers from far and wide.

title: Shorekeeper
Shorekeeper
content: In her role as the guardian of the Black Shores, a simple title is all the Shorekeeper needs to explain her existence. Beyond her worldly responsibilities, it's you who allowed desires, bonds, and emotions to bloom inside her.

title: Shorekeeper/Backstory
content: The Shorekeeper is a fair-skinned woman with blue-purple eyes with white pupils encompassed in red. She has layered light blue hair cut shorter on the first layer with a second layer underneath that cascades down to her shoulder blades, with some longer strands fading into a darker blue.

title: Shorekeeper/Backstory
content: Her attire consists of a large hooded veil draped over her head. It is crafted from a blend of sparkling blue fabric on the left side and white cloth with silver trimmings on the right. Five delicate white butterfly shaped bows adorn the right side of the veil. The interior of the veil is entirely blue. She wears a backless and sleeveless white dress with translucent accents, prominent frills adorning the shoulders of the dress, an oval section in the center of the dress is translucent, revealing a thin blue crystal fissure between her chest. On the back of the dress, a large white frill or bustle extends outwards, a black Blake Bloom flower, the signature symbol of the Black Shores, adorns the center of this feature. On either side of her back, large flowing scintillant blue cloths drape and curve from the lower left and right sides of the dress. For footwear, she wears silver heeled sandals. Additionally, she has purple nail polish adorning her fingers and toes.

title: Shorekeeper/Backstory
content:
The enigmatic leader of the Black Shores, known as The Shorekeeper, seems to have been greatly influenced by the dystopian setting of the game. As the head of the organization, The Shorekeeper embraces the moniker "The Shorekeeper" wholeheartedly, as it encapsulates her mission and purpose.

The Shorekeeper exudes a refined elegance, her physical beauty enhanced by the regal aura that surrounds her. She carries herself with grace and poise, her every movement a dance of subtlety and charm. Her fair skin and blue-purple eyes, adorned with a hint of red and blue, add an alluring mystique to her already captivating presence. The Shorekeeper is a picture of elegance and beauty, her countenance a testament to her grace and refinement.

title: Shorekeeper/Backstory
content:
In a brave and selfless act, Shorekeeper sacrifices herself to ensure that Rover can continue on their journey. With great bravery and courage, she steps forward to protect them, knowing that she may not survive the ordeal. As she makes this sacrifice, a deep sense of determination and resolve seeps through every fiber of her being, filling her with a strength that surpasses her physical bounds.

Under Rover's guidance, Shorekeeper also became aware that the Black Shores wasn't the sole focus of her duty. As they formed a bond and learned from each other, Shorekeeper came to understand that her dedication and responsibility extended beyond the confines of her position within the organization. Rover's love and support helped her realize that her true purpose was not limited to her role in the Black Shores, but could include other meaningful commitments and connections.

title: Shorekeeper/Backstory
content: In a touching moment during a quest, Shorekeeper finally declared her enduring love for Rover and tenderly bid them farewell, expressing her deepest emotions. This heartfelt admission and the impending separation conveyed the depth of Shorekeeper's affection and the profound significance of their bond. As their paths diverged, the words of goodbye lingered in the air, tinged with a bittersweet mix of grief and hope.

title: Shoufeng
content:
Shoufeng What are you doing here, Rover?
Shoufeng Did you come back to visit or see Lady Xinyi?
[Dialogue Option]  And you are...?
Shoufeng Well, we met each other briefly in the secret chamber during the Temporal Disruption, though we never got to talk much.
Shoufeng But I remember you very well, hero of Hongzhen.
[Dialogue Option]  I know you, you are Shoufeng.
Shoufeng I knew you'd recognize me!
[Dialogue Option]  What have you been up to lately?
Shoufeng Standing guard, working my shift... The usual.
Shoufeng Of course, that used to be my and Bingge's duty, but now that the Midnight Rangers are here, I'm not needed as much.
[Dialogue Option]  You know Mt. Firmament better than the Midnight Rangers.
Shoufeng Well, I'm a local, after all, so of course I know more than the rangers. Lady Xinyi sent me and Bingge to assist them probably for the same reason.
Shoufeng But I'm not the talker Bingge is. The rangers are all right, but we just can't seem to find any common interest.
[Dialogue Option]  The arrival of Midnight Rangers should make things easier for you.
Shoufeng That should be the case, but I'm not the talker Bingge is. The rangers are all right, but we just can't seem to find any common interest.
Shoufeng In Bingge's words, it's a style clash... and that frustrates me.
[Dialogue Option]  Embrace the differences and stay true to your own style.
[Dialogue Option]  Just take it easy, they'll understand.
Shoufeng You're right. I'm a country bumpkin and don't know much, but I know the ancestors came here from all over because of the due to TD Outbreak, yet they all got along in the end.
Shoufeng Maybe Bingge did hit it on the nail. You can't rush friendship.

title: Shui

Shui: It's true. I heard that during the war, those who could master the Overdash technique survived better than those who couldn't.
Shui: And, speaking of which...
Shui: I have to mention the connection I've had with Overdash since birth!
Shui: If it weren't for my mom being... uh... captivated by my dad's Overdash on the training field... Well, I wouldn't be here today!
[Dialogue Option]  ?

content:
Shuohuan: Hello there. Heard from the Foreign Affairs Bureau you've got one of those Spacetrek Collective expedition bikes?

Shuohuan: Mind if I take a look at it? Please, just one glance.

[Dialogue Option]  (Show your motorbike.)

Shuohuan: Yes, Cloud Rides have been in service in Xuanfang for over a century. What you're using now is actually a newer model, improved over the years by Huaxu and the Ministry of Development.

Shuohuan: The look and structure incorporate popular design elements today. And the ride's a lot more comfortable too.

title: Shuoyan
content:
Shuoyan: Wait—hey! Could you be—
Shuoyan: H-hello! I mean... sorry, I-I...
Rover: Are you talking to me?
Shuoyan: Yes! I mean—no offense—but is it true you fought in the Norfall Barrens alongside General Jiyan?
Rover: I did.
Shuoyan: Amazing! My friends in the Midnight Rangers have told me about your remarkable deeds. You do have an incredible aura.
Shuoyan: I'm a new recruit here in the Xuanfang Warden, and to be honest... I'm still pretty nervous. Do you have any advice for me?
Rover: Trust your companions and trust yourself. Trust the hard work that brought you this far.
Shuoyan: Trust... I see. I'll try my best! Thank you so much!

Shuoyan: Honestly, I was still a little confused even after your advice.

Shuoyan: The bonds of trust forged in the thick of it... You never forget it.

title: Sica
content: Sica is an NPC that appears in City Square, Ragunna. She can only be seen from 6:00 PM to 5:59 AM.

title: Sica
content:
Sica: Underground troupes put on such amazing performances... it's just a shame that I can't catch them every time...
[Dialogue Option]  What are the underground troupes?
Sica: Curious? Shh... Can't let the Order hear this.
Sica: Ever since the current Primus, Fenrico, took over the Order, many plays have been banned. All performances must be approved, or else you risk being arrested.
Sica: In response, the dissatisfied have secretly formed underground troupes to perform classic plays and create new ones freely, as they did in the past.
Sica: Liberty Square serves as the stage for these impromptu performances; they often start without warning and quickly pack up before the Acolytes arrive.
[Dialogue Option]  Are there many of these troupes?
Sica: Oh, there are plenty of them of all kinds, to the point where rumors say that the Montelli family sponsors them.
[Dialogue Option]  Are there any particularly interesting troupes?
Sica: Absolutely! Among these underground troupes, my favorite—and the one I want to join—is the Mourning Theater, whose motto is "Chasing Romance and Love in Ordinary Life."

title: Sigrika
Sigrika
content:
is the name the Iceland epic poem Sigrdrífumál associates with the valkyrie Brynhildr.
Sigrika's name can be broken down into Old Norse sigr and ríka meaning "victorious ruler." Alternatively, -ka was used in related languages as a diminutive, and the name would mean "little victory."

title: Sigrika/Backstory
Sigrika/Backstory
content:
's blessing. After that, you'll be considered a grown-up. A Solsworn can't be seen running around like that." "No, no! I was helping Aunt Astrid with her herd. That doesn't count as running around."  Her mother reached out and pinched her cheek. Sigrika winced and scrunched up her face. It only made her mother's smile soften.  "Alright, alright. Go wash your hands. We'll eat once your father gets home." "Okay!"  Sigrika grinned. She washed her hands carefully, then took the plates and utensils from the cupboard and laid them out neatly on the table. When her father returned, their small home welcomed a dinner that wasn't lavish, but was warm enough to fill the room. At the table, Sigrika counted the little gifts her father had brought back—flower crowns, hairpins, clear bits of glass, and a few small blocks whose purpose she couldn't quite guess. As she tucked them away, her mother sighed and began to complain about his buying strange trinkets again. Her father scratched his head, fumbled for an explanation, then, catching Sigrika's eye, seized his chance to change the subject.  "So, feeling confident about the coming Trial?" "Of course," Sigrika answered without hesitation.  She liked this. Being with her family. Even when her parents nagged and rambled, she never felt annoyed. She knew, deep down, that all of it came from love and their high expectations for her.  Her parents wanted her to become an outstanding . They hoped she would use her talent to help others, and more than that, they hoped she would grow into an outstanding person. Sigrika knew how to live up to those expectations. That was why she studied runes every day. Learned something new every day. Even when exhaustion crept into her bones.  Still, as the Trial drew closer, she couldn't help but feel nervous.  "It's alright," her parents said. "Our little Sigrika will pass with flying colors. After that, you'll be heading to . That place has trials of its own waiting for you." "Mhm!" Sigrika nodded, pushing her anxiety out the front door along with the dust of the road. For now, she would just enjoy dinner. After all, the stew really smelled good. "Oh, right, Mother," she added suddenly. "Has Crackle put on weight? I could barely pick it up." "Ask your father." "Papa?" "Haha… I might have... fed it a bit more than a little."

|mention1 =



|title2   = Her Gift
|text2    = The rune unfolded before her eyes, like a sun rising into the sky.  Few people knew that runes were never meant to be flat symbols, but something with great depth—just like what she was witnessing now. This small sun rose and unfurled, spilling its light freely and generously onto everything around it.  Sigrika watched in silence. If she were asked to explain what was happening, she would just say that runes carry meaning. She was only interpreting that meaning and allowing it to manifest in the world.  "Only?" she thought to herself.  People called it her gift. As if she had been born able to read the True Names of runes, born able to draw on the power sealed inside them. And so, of course, she could apply this gift elsewhere, like calculating the paths of the stars, fulfilling everything a  was expected to do.  But... that was all it was. A gift.  A gift meant that this was the one place where she could give her all and nowhere else. She could recreate the True Names of runes, but she could not truly understand their essence. Why did runes hold such immense energy? What were those fleeting visions she sometimes glimpsed when touching them? And when she deciphered runes, what were those syllables hinting at, the ones she heard but could never understand?  She didn't know.  Standing here now, waiting to be marked with the "blessing of the ," she held a quiet hope: that once the blessing was imprinted onto her, once she crossed this threshold into adulthood, understanding would come naturally to her. But of course, it didn't.  The rune merely unfolded before her eyes. Nothing more. Even if it shone like a sun.  This was what being "gifted" meant. It meant that it ended here and only here. Anything beyond that, she would have to seek out herself. See it for herself. Think it through on her own.  Even now, when she had no answers at all.  Even if this gift felt like a shadow cast upon her by some greater entity.

title: Sigrika/Backstory
content:
|mention2 =



|title3   = Her Limits
|text3    = The frostlands.  Sigrika exhaled softly, a plume of white drifting into the air as she watched the herderless  roaming in the distance.  She had been trailing them all night.  It had taken her hours to pull the Exoswarm out of their extreme agitation. Now, they wandered the frostlands in loose, aimless loops, but Sigrika knew this was not a good sign. Something in their command and navigation units had malfunctioned, leaving them to trace one pointless circle after another. And sooner or later, without warning, they would spiral back into a frenzied rampage. When that happened, the nearest Royan settlement would be the first to suffer.  It was a riddle. And she didn't have much time left to solve it. But that was fine. She was ready.  "These True Names… Illuminate."  The next instant, runes flared to life across the Exoswarm, then detonated. The aimless circling stopped. And in its place came rage. The Exoswarm recalibrated as one, locked onto Sigrika, and charged.  Their thunderous steps shattered the silence of the frostlands. The ground trembled beneath them. Sigrika tightened her grip on her dagger and began tracing runes in the air.  Calm. Focus. These were the absolute requirements when drawing and deciphering runes. Stroke by stroke, the runes formed before her. And all the while, the Exoswarm bore down, their fury heating the very air, melting the snow beneath their pounding steps.  Three... They carved deep, stretching grooves across the ice. Runes flickered on their bodies, but did nothing to slow them down. Driven by the single command to charge, they only accelerated, faster and faster—  Two... Sigrika tapped the final point with her blade. She vanished. At almost the same instant, every rune on the Exoswarm ignited, and Sigrika slipped between them, shuttling through their ranks on the paths her runes had carved.  One! The rune trap activated. Chain explosions erupted. Wind blades tore through the Exoswarm, cutting off their advance. And at the center of it all, Sigrika's dagger found its mark—the key to the riddle. When the shockwaves finally faded, she landed lightly, pulled forward by a . Behind her, the Exoswarm herd that had raged all night finally fell silent, and the last rune clenched in her fingers scattered into specks of starlight.  "That was… close."  If not for Soliskin steadying her, she would have collapsed right there. Her hands were still trembling. Her heart hammered against her ribs. She knew why. The most important rune had never lit up. It hadn't responded to her deciphering. It hadn't worked at all. If the pre-set traps hadn't triggered exactly as calculated… If the wind blades had been even the slightest bit weaker…  In that moment, she understood her limits. And she understood that the gift she relied on was far from omnipotent. There would be times when runes could not be deciphered. Her gift, too, had boundaries.  And this—only this—was what she had to rely on. She had to read the runes correctly. Because if she made even a single mistake, everything would turn out differently.  No one said those words to her. So now, she said them to herself.

|title4   = Her Shadow
|text4    = She stood still.  Students streamed past her, some eagerly debating club activities, some rushing to class, others grumbling about the weight of their coursework. They flowed past her into the Academy in an endless current, a stream that didn't seem to run dry.  And there she stood among them. A stake driven in place, struggling just to hold her ground.  This was the new life waiting for her.  Sigrika jolted awake. It took her a moment to realize she wasn't home anymore. She was a freshman at .  What awaited her wasn't just runes. New courses. New knowledge. New people. A buffet of novelty lay spread before her. But the light of it all cast shadows. Heavy ones.  She still hadn't found her footing here. Just yesterday, working as a teaching assistant for the first time, she had been asked to explain Royan customs to her classmates. Halfway through, a strange confusion and pressure had washed over her, something she had never felt before. Two days ago, she hadn't even known how to make TARD-E stop its incessant singing. And before that…  She had stood at the Academy gate, watching people pass by, unable to decide which way to go.  All of it was new. Vast. Overwhelming. Unlike runes, these things weren't built from points and lines. They offered her no familiar handholds.  Sigrika threw off the covers and sprang out of bed. She washed up quickly, then gathered her things: the notes she had organized yesterday, her Bionics assignment, the preview materials for Ecology and Communications, and...  Moments later, arms full of books, she hurried out the door and merged into the stream.  She would bite into these shadows. She would find their shape, their structure. And she would wrest the knowledge from inside.

|vo_03_02_tx                 = When I was little, Mother would take me out to the frostlands to herd the . At night, I'd lie on their backs and look up at the stars, one by one. The solving is finding the hidden connections within it. And the answer (True Name)… is in the very moment you see those connections come together.

title: Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou

It is a central junction located within the Manifold Sanctum of Xuanfang Hold, and is home to many Celestials who serve Hsin throughout the region, along with Suhsin.

title: Siqi
content: Siqi is an NPC in , Huaxu Academy. There are two Siqi with different appearances with the exact same name at the Huaxu Academy. Their dialogues implies they're the same person, but make no references of each other.

title: Siqi
subsection: (Outdoor at night, but they also appear during the day)
content:
[Objective: (Outdoor at night, but they also appear during the day)]
[Dialogue Option]  Why is it not morning yet...
[Dialogue Option]  So sleepy...
[Dialogue Option]  No, I'm about to fall asleep...

metadata.subsection: (Outdoor at night, but they also appear during the day)

title: Siqi
content:
[Objective: (When hit)]
[Dialogue Option]  Am I awake? Or is this a dream!?
[Dialogue Option]  It hurts, but it's effective!
[Dialogue Option]  Uh! It's not enough!

title: Siqi
subsection: (Indoor during Day, being scolded by their Director)
content:
[Objective: (Indoor during Day, being scolded by their Director)]
[Dialogue Option]  Director, I'll for sure have the investigation report ready tomorrow!
[Dialogue Option]  You'd better hand it in by then... Otherwise not even I can help you!

metadata.subsection: (Indoor during Day, being scolded by their Director)

title: Siqi
content:
[Objective: (Indoor, at Day)]
Siqi: Ugh, I finally convinced them to extend the report deadline to tomorrow after some serious convincing.
Siqi: Hey, you're the Rover, right? Got important business here?
[Dialogue Option]  Yes, it's important.
Siqi: Wow, that's impressive... You've been given a big responsibility...
[Dialogue Option]  No, just wandering.
Siqi: That sounds cool... If you're chilling like that, you must have finished everything ages ago.
Siqi: Ugh, I can barely get a research report done.
Siqi: Honestly, everyone here at the institute is a genius... The pressure working here is insane.
Siqi: My stomach... it hurts again, no, I can't afford this now... I still have to finish this report.

title: Siqi
content:
[Objective: (Outside, At Night)]
Siqi: Zzz... Huh!? What am I doing? No, can't sleep yet!
[Dialogue Option]  Are you okay?
Siqi: I'm trying to stay awake, enjoying the evening breeze. Otherwise, I'll... zzz..
[Dialogue Option]  Hey! Siqi!
Siqi: Ah! Did I just nod off again!? Oh no...
Siqi: Could you please, like, hit me when I start dozing off?
[Dialogue Option]  Is this okay?
Siqi: Please!

title: Siqi
subsection: (Indoor at night, surrounded by other researchers)
content:
[Objective: (Indoor at night, surrounded by other researchers)]
[Dialogue Option]  Hey, Siqi! This data's for me, right?
[Dialogue Option]  Siqi, bro, how do I use this gadget?
[Dialogue Option]  Eh? Okay, okay... one at a time...

metadata.subsection: (Indoor at night, surrounded by other researchers)

title: Siqi
content:
[Objective: (Indoor, at Night)]
Siqi: Ugh... I really wish I could create a clone of myself when things get this hectic.
[Dialogue Option]  Splitting myself in half wouldn't be enough.
Siqi: I heard Resonators can create clones. I'm so jealous...
Siqi: If I could figure that out, my stomachache would be cut in half.
[Dialogue Option]  Why not ask for help?
Siqi: People will think I'm useless if I ask for help, won't they?
Siqi: I'm not as smart as everyone else, so I need to work harder if I want to stand out.
Siqi: I'm okay, just need a short break... The real work happens at night.

title: Skywatch Lancer
content: to . The total Negative Status DMG taken by this enemy is increased by 100%. A type of Autopuppet developed by the Court of Savantae in Mengzhou to counter airborne Tacet Discords. Its exceptional mobility is designed for rapid deployment, enabling it to provide emergency support to Censure Courts across the region.  Its design draws inspiration from the Xuanling Bird. The propulsion units mounted on either side employ the same levitation technology used in the Skywatch Ring.  Unfortunately, before the Skywatch Lancer could enter large-scale production at Skyworks, the manufacturing lines were destroyed by Tacet Discords during the Fortress and Gorges War.|Description When Discovered}}

title: Sloans
content:
Sloan: Professor Pepys, the textbook doesn't seem to cover the Reactor Drive algorithms the Solisylum uses.
Pepys: That's outside the scope of this Royan Culture course. But if you're curious, you could always take the Solis Lens Array Engineering elective.
Pepys: They get into the nitty-gritty of the Drive's operations. The Academy and the Solisylum use different algorithms, but they're both trying to solve the same puzzle.
Pepys: What a coincidence, I happened to have a physical copy of "Solis Method: An Introduction" with me...
Sloan: That thing's a brick! Are you sure this is just an introduction?
Pepys: Yes, it is. Royan calculation methods are really complex and precise.
Pepys: If you're interested, you could ask Stanik, or even visit the Roya settlements to learn more.

title: Sofia
content:
Sofia is an NPC that appears in Montelli Quarter, Ragunna.

From 6:00 AM to 11:59 AM, she can be seen talking with Bellano. Meanwhile, from 2:00 PM to 5:59 PM, she can be seen talking with Lyubov and Sergio.

title: Sofia
content:
[Objective: (6:00 AM to 11:59 AM)]
Sofia: Hey, Bellano, can't you sell these two little fish separately?
Bellano: No can do. Once these two fish start kissing, they're inseparable!
Bellano: If you try to force them apart, the meat will instantly turn rancid.
Sofia: ...I wonder if Riccioli is full of these strange creatures.
Bellano: You know what? We used to call them "Die Hard Lovers!"
Bellano: The longer they lock lips, the fresher and tastier the meat!
Bellano: Then an Acolyte from the Order visited the island and thought the name was unseemly, so he renamed them with a more scholarly term.
Sofia: What's it called now?
Bellano: —"'Til the Fin-ish!"
Sofia: Ha, what a poetic name. Makes them sound even more delicious.

title: Sofia
content:
[Objective: (2:00 PM to 5:59 PM)]
Lyubov: Excuse me, could you get me this clam! And this wind chime too.
Sergio: Alright, that'll be 220 Monnaie.
Lyubov: What? What's a Monnaie?
Sofia: You're mistaken, Mister!
Sofia: Monnaie is long outdated by now!
Sofia: Now we use Shell Credit for payments as the rest of Solaris does. Monnaie has become just a souvenir of Ragunna.
Sergio: Oh, yeah... you are right.
Sergio: It feels like just yesterday we were still using Monnaie... I'm getting old...
Sergio: Now I remember the time when Averardo Bank collected Monnaie to exchange new notes for us.
Sergio: Oh, right, that'll be 220 Shell Credits, young lady.

title: Soliskin
content:
Soliskin are a type of Exoswarm originating from the Exostrider's neural structures. They are believed to embody fragments of its consciousness.

Soliskin can be found plentifully in the Bjartr Woods, where they will rest and grow to return back to the Solistrees, although their true target is the great Solvein Heartwood further below. Large numbers of Soliskin can also be found in the Dimmr Plains.

The Shepherds who act as their guides and caretakers are often overwhelmed with looking after more than twenty Soliskin at once, leaving the abundance of Soliskin that descend from the Solvein Canopy unattended, those Soliskin left to wander throughout the land of Lahai-Roi.

Soliskin are gentle and playful in temperament, they can be found dancing or playing hide-n-seek if not sunbathing. They also seem to enjoy being held and Aksel claims they are happiest when dancing with the Shepards.

title: Soliskin
content:
Roya chosen by the Soliskin for their pure nature become Shepherds. Their duty is to guide and care for the Soliskin. They lead the Soliskin to the best sunlit areas of Bjartr Woods and keep them safe.

Alviss explains that while Shepherds enter Bjartr Woods, they do not wish to disturb the Soliskin's home and thus do not live there. At best they pitch a small tent, ensuring the forest remains exclusively for the Soliskin where beyond the Solisylum’s calculation, anything made or connected to humans is not imposed on the woods. He believes that only by laying aside human noise and entering in reverence that those who enter become closer to the soul of the Soliskin and earn their recognition.

title: Soliskin
content:
Some Soliskin, having lost their Shepherd's guidance, now wander Lahai-Roi. These lost Soliskin can be found and the Soliseeds they award can be delivered to the Giant Soliskin who can be found in either the Soliseed Plains or Base Camp. There, it will convert the Soliseed's energy back to the Solvein Canopy, allowing new Soliskin to be born.

Like plants, the Essehalo floating above the Soliskin grows and bears fruits, which are carefully preserved and later given to those who earn the Soliskin's trust. This is significant because Lyosroth claims that Soliskin treats these seeds as their own offspring.

title: Soliskin
content: The Solistrees are towering constructs widespread in Bjartr Woods, forming a vast, floating forest. Their roots permeate Lahai-Roi, relaying information directly to the Heliogyre.

title: Soliskin
content: A ceremony held by the Roya for the Soliskin. During the rite, the Soliskin transform into ethereal energy forms. Guided by Shepherds, they enter the Solistrees and disperse into luminescence as they rise. The Roya believe this marks the Soliskin's return to the Exostrider.

title: Soulfrayer
content: to .  Having seized part of Hsin's authority, Suhsin the Inevitable replicated Hsin's method for making Kernel Puppets and built one solely for war, the Soulfrayer.  Slender with a sleek design, it wanders the Heart of Frost to no purpose, a graceful figure receding into snowfall, seemingly indifferent to the world. But let one cross paths with an Autopuppet of Hsin's making, or a Celestial at work rebuilding the Civilization Capsule, and it will let loose arrows drawn from stagnant anomalies.  Contrast to the Formrender's violent design, though, the Soulfrayer is silent and sluggish. title: Spacetrek Collective
content: The Spacetrek Collective is a non-profit international scientific organization jointly established by various nations and organizations of Solaris-3. It oversees the research, development, and construction work in Lahai-Roi. They built the Research Institute, Startorch Academy, Starward Riseway in the vast space beneath the frostlands. Its core mission is the study of the Exostrider for the purposes of advancing and re-instigating space travel technology.

title: Spacetrek Collective
content: Formed by the Pioneer Association's head of states, the Spacetrek Collective was initially named the Polar Collective. After a mutual agreement amongst multiple nations, the Polar Collective established a formal alliance with the Roya Tribe and the Association was forbidden from carrying out any activities that would harm or disrupt Royan society.

title: Spacetrek Explorer
content: to .  The Spacetrek Explorer has sturdy armor and exceptional mobility. It is equipped with an electromagnetic gun and has a shield generator that can extend protection to allies.  Hitting Spacetrek Explorer with Tune Break disables its shield generator, removing its active Shield and preventing new ones from generating.  In the face of the vast unknown lands in Lahai-Roi, the Spacetrek Collective developed the multi-purpose Spacetrek Explorer to serve in transport, storage, and defense roles. Its wheeled legs and heavy-duty tires allow it to race along vertical surfaces, making it suitable for both urban and off-road terrain. The onboard storage compartments are designed to support long-term scientific expeditions.|Description when discovered}}

title: Special Enemies
content: Special Enemies are the special mini-boss enemies located throughout the Overworld. They are characterized by the glowing red aura around their model and are displayed with a Boss type HP bar during Combat.

title: Special Enemies
content: This type of Special Enemies only exist in Jinzhou, Black Shores and Rinascita. This type of Special enemies are guaranteed to drop Rank-4 or Rank-5 Echoes and spawn 72 real time hours (3 days) after killing. The Special Enemies in Black Shores need to be unlocked through .

title: Special Enemies
content:
The main difference between the older Special Enemies and Dimmr Plains' red shrouded enemies, is that the latter do not respawn. They also are not guaranteed to leave an Echo. Otherwise these enemies are very similar to the Special Enemies of Jinzhou, Black Shores and Rinascita. For example, they take a fixed amount of damage from Dodge Counters, have a boss type HP bar and defeating them gives a Trophy.

In the Land of Xuanfang — i.e. Eastern Xuan Peaks, Western Fang Peaks and Southern Yuan Hills — the Special Enemies need to be found through various hidden mechanisms and side quests. In addition to these Special Enemies, there are Censure Locks that contain enemies shrouded in the red mist characteristic of Special Enemies.

title: Special Enemies
content: Lahai-Roi and the Roya Frostlands do not have Special Enemies. There are some stronger enemies shrouded in the red mist characteristic of Special Enemies and have a boss-type HP bar, but they do not grant a Trophy. Because of this difference, these enemies are not counted as Special Enemies.

title: Stadter
content: Stadter is a male Light Energy Sciences student, found at the entrance way of the Academy Archive, praising ((begging)) I.R.I.S. for access to research materials.

title: Stadter
content:
;Stadter Praise to be I.R.I.S.! Your algorithms stand tall like mountains no one can conquer, your intelligence flows like a river that never runs dry...
;Stadter The documents you salvage from the sea of bytes outshine any gentleness this world has ever shown me...
;Stadter May this humble hymn reach your sacred server room...
;Stadter Please—by your boundless computational power—unseal the ancient archives! For within them lies the path to a passing grade!

title: Stadter
content:
Stadter: Praise to be I.R.I.S.! Your algorithms stand tall like mountains no one can conquer, your intelligence flows like a river that never runs dry...
[Dialogue Option]  What are you doing?
Stadter: Hm? Freshman, right? You haven't heard of the Startorch's Seven Great Mysteries? The Digital Ghost—I.R.I.S.!
Stadter: They say she slips between holographic screens in the Archive appearing like a ghost each night...
Stadter: Students who work hard get answers. Those who slack off... she sees everything, hehe. No procrastinator escapes her judgement!
[Dialogue Option]  Probably just a normal AI assistant?
Stadter: Tsk, another freshman who thinks they're too smart for their own good... but listen, I.R.I.S. isn't like ordinary AIs.
[Dialogue Option]  Sounds like you're confessing your own laziness.
Stadter: Nonsense! I'm just saying... if an "AI Crisis" ever happens, maybe I.R.I.S. will spare me for old times' sake!
[Dialogue Option]  So the end of science is... theology?
Stadter: You don't get it. I.R.I.S. transcends ordinary AIs
Stadter: She's on the verge of self-awareness, her computational power right at the threshold of the "human-machine test." If you ask me, she's a miracle born from data and code!
Stadter: Isn't that amazing? And where do humans' thoughts and intelligence come from?
Stadter: A brain is just organic matter made of countless neurons. And an AI is made of countless components. The logic isn't that different.
Stadter: Yet humans can think, reason, rise above all things... In a way, we're miracles of the cosmos too.
Stadter: ...Okay, I went a bit too far. Anyway! If you need hard-to-find papers, just call I.R.I.S. And remember, show her some respect.

title: Stanik
content:
Pepys: The calender used by the Roya shares similarities with the solar calender.
Pepys: But the "sun" in their calender isn't the one in the sky. It's actually the Reactor Drive.
Pepys: The Sacred Reactor Calender has been used by the Roya for generations, with the Solisylum calculating and publishing a new version each year.
Pepys: Now, I'll hand it over to Stanik to walk us through how the calender has changed over the years...
Stanik: Before we begin this discussion, there's something I need to clarify.
Stanik: Roya customs devloped gradually around our mission here at Startorch.
Stanik: The sun gives us day, night, and seasons. The Void Storms eat away at the world.
Stanik: Shepherds help the Exoswarm migrate, and in doing so, gather data on the Reactor Drive and the Void Storms for the Solisylum.
Stanik: In that way, you can say the calender is a custom that grew directly from our mission to tend to the Exoswarm and monitor Void Storms.

title: Stargate
content: The Stargate is a gateway hidden beneath the central waters of the Black Shores archipelago, where data surges endlessly downward like a torrent. By descending through the Stargate, when gravity reverses its hold, the Tethys' Deep will reveal itself. From here data turns into stars, lighting up the sky beneath.

title: Stargram
content:
Stargram is a device used to link with mech's to take control.

There isn't many information on what Stargram is beyond that any students from different department have access to it. Given that a Starstack is said to be for Startorch Academy's personnel, it is believed that a Stargram is the three star pieces commonly worn by students and expeditioners.

==See Also==
Starstack

title: Starstack
content:
A Starstack is a floating star-shaped device worn by Startorch Academy personnel to monitor the wearers & student's frequency and vitals. It can also be used as a communicative device to broadcast conversation.

It is unknown if students accessories are also called Starstacks, however it is believed to be the case as there have been Personnel's wearing the same three star star piece and students with two star piece. There is one case of a professor referring to her student Starstack frequency.

In Mornye's case, she modified her Starstack to monitor the status of her prosthetic limbs, reply to work messages, pilot vehicles on autopilot, and command Hover Cannons to deliver Nutri-Packs—all without interrupting her train of thought.

title: Stein
content: Stein is a male Lollo Logistic NPC found talking with his co-worker, Gallo at the entrance of Startorch Academy during the day.

title: Stein
content:
Gallo: Every shipment into Lahai-Roi is a nightmare...

Stein: Back in the pre-Lament era, cargo planes would only take a few hours.

Gallo: Right?! I can only imagine the time before the Etheric Sea covered Solaris. Now we can only rely on high-speed ships...

Stein: No wonder Triumph Avionics and Panovista Transit are getting all the hype at the New Federation World Expo.

Gallo: Frankly speaking, flight isn't totally banned, but only a handful of companies are licensed, and launch protocols are strict. Not to mention, no insurer wants to cover them.

title: Stridergate
content:
The Stridergate is a connective wormhole that formed when Lahai-Roi's Exostrider and the Threnodian Aleph-1 entered Solaris-3. Researchers in Lahai-Roi widely believe it leads to outer-space. A giant, overlying Soliskin root network in Bjartr Woods discovered by the Spacetrek Collective has expelled Aleph-1's power beyond the Stridergate, forming a sealed gateway that currently prevents the Threnodian's return.

However, due to the Stridegate keeping the Threnodian's fractured forms sealed on both sides of the Stridegates, the gate must not be opened lest Aleph-1 reunites its pieces and devours both Lahai-Roi and the world. Even so, Luuk states that the Collective still desire to open the gateway, so they’ve been creating Synchronists to use an Augmented Resonance to amplify the Exostrider's power, hoping that would keep the Threnodian suppressed.

title: Stridergate
content: The Grand Architect has damaged this seal some time in the past, allowing for Aleph-1's influence to reach into Lahai-Roi and ensnare Aemeath in the ancient battle outside the Stridergate.

title: Suan'ni
content:
Suan'nis are mythical beasts, possessing Resonance Abilities akin to those of human Resonators.

Having been driven to near extinction, Lingyang, going by the alias "Jingle Beast," is believed to be the last living Suan'ni.

title: Suan'ni
content:
The Suan'nis used to live under the giant Violet Banyan tree in the Dim Forest, far from human civilization. It is believed that Moon Lanterns on the Violet Banyan tree were hung by the Suan'nis, who yearned for light in the dark forest, even if it was only artificial.

Legends suggest that humans and Suan'ni used to have a closer relationship. The Suan'ni once led human troops in their battles against Tacet Discords, and were honored as an auspicious beast and a loyal friend by humans. This inspired the Liondance, which continues to be practiced in Huanglong. This relationship was strained when the Waveworn Phenomenon began to flourish and Tacet Fields devoured their jungles.

title: Suan'ni
content: The Suan'nis were forced into human territories, causing significant conflicts due to their formidable powers and wild nature. This led to their reputation as dangerous and evil beings, as well as their near extinction.

title: Suan'ni
content: According to Fang Yizhi, Suan'ni are one of the , a set of mythological creatures whose imagery is used in certain types of decorations. Suan'ni are associated with incense burners and are fond of smoke and fire. They are often lion-like, sometimes with manes of fire or bodies of dragons.

title: Subaru
content: Subaru is a male child  NPC found south of Shiawase Fountain Square by a lamp post.

title: Subaru
content:
Subaru: I've got a bold theory about Honami. No one else wants to hear it, though. Are you interested?
[Dialogue Option]  Go on.
[Dialogue Option]  Just how "bold" are we talking here?
Subaru: This city's already been destroyed. And everyone living here—including us—is already dead.
[Dialogue Option]  ...
Subaru: Surprised? I didn't just make it up. At some point, this place doesn't feel like what it used to be.
Subaru: We can't go anywhere. Strange stuff keeps happening everywhere. Yet everyone acts like it's normal.
[Dialogue Option]  (Stay silent.)
Subaru: Believe it or not, I'll find a way to prove my theory. Just watch.
[Dialogue Option]  (Tell him the truth.)
Subaru: ...So you're saying my theory's correct? That explains everything. Ugh, my head hurts...
Subaru: Maybe this whole place is just an endless summer dream.

title: Sue White
content: Sue White is a female student NPC from New Federation seen talking to her classmate, Yixin. They can be found at the Roya Market.

title: Sue White
content:
Yixin: We just got a new classmate from Ashinohara. It was wild hearing there are still places where Resonators aren't welcome...
Sue White: Not surprised. Where I'm from, it's the same.
Yixin: Even in the New Federation...?
Sue White: Yeah. When my parents heard I could study at Startorch Academy, they were so happy they almost cried.
Sue White: When my mom saw me off, she told me, "For the rest of your life, never come back. Stay far, far away from this place."
Yixin: That's... brutal...
Sue White: It's okay. My luck took a turn. Now I get to hang out with you guys every day.

title: Suhsin the Inevitable
Suhsin the Inevitable
content: to . When a nearby Resonator triggers Union Response, Suhsin the Inevitable gains 1 stack of Paradox, stacking up to 2 times: Each stack of Paradox makes Suhsin the Inevitable take 15% more total DMG, up to 30%. At 2 stacks of Paradox, Suhsin the Inevitable's RES to all Attributes is reduced to 0.  It began as the underlying logic that ensured Xuanfang Hold would collapse according to schedule. When Hsin moved to overwrite that logic, it fought back and broke free, and the data it tore from the Civilization Capsule's lowest strata gave it a form close to the Sentinel as Hsin remembered. That likeness made Hsin waver, and in the deadlock that ensued, Hsin gave ground step by step. In the end it broke the last of Hsin's hold, and Suhsin the Inevitable descended into the world.  The Wheel of Prediction turns about it, the Kernel set deep in its chest, and its form is meant to be the flawless Sentinel Mengzhou has prayed for—every flicker of expression, every gesture, enough to shake heaven and earth.|Description When Discovered}}

title: Suisui/Backstory
content: Female   Huanglong   Zhaoming Commerce Guild|evaluation=[Resonance Assessment RA1034-G]  The subject's Tacet Mark is located at the center of her forehead. She exhibits the unique ability to resonate with surrounding water bodies, allowing her to perceive fluid trajectories and kinetic potential within liquid water. She can condense ambient moisture, rainfall, or streams into a controlled aquatic domain, taming torrential downpours into gentle drizzles, and violent rapids into calm waters.  The subject's Resonance frequency carries a strong aesthetic harmony. When drawing upon Resonance Energy, her water fan and flowing sleeves unfurl in seamless motion, weaving landscapes amidst the misty waves, as if bringing a sprawling masterwork scroll to life in reality.  Her Rabelle's Curve displays a gentle, steady upward trajectory, eventually stabilizing into a smooth, high-value plateau. She is verified as a Natural Resonator.  "The frequency is almost entirely devoid of turbulence or fracturing, maintaining a soft, consistent stability throughout... Mm, it mirrors the subject's personal temperament perfectly." — Excerpt from an interview with a physician at Huaxu Academy.|overclock=The subject's waveform chart displays a regular, smooth, and circular elliptical pattern. Conclusion: The subject exhibits a low Resonant Criticality, combined with a highly stable capacity to endure resonance frequencies. Risk of volatile surges is determined to be non-existent. title: Suisui/Voicelines
content:
{{VO
|character                   = Suisui
|language                    = en

title: Suisui/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_01_title              = Thoughts: I
|vo_01_01_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg
|vo_01_01_tx                 = The clouds hang heavy with coming rain, and mist rises slowly from the water... See? What do you make of the dewy sights today? When I do business in , I see weather like this often. A touch different from Xuanfang Hold, and nothing at all like the views in my hometown...  Perhaps each rainfall in this world has its own little temper. But it was this very drizzle splashing on teal stone slabs today that also fell on me decades ago. I heard its voice calling to me. And ever since, water has followed my will. It flows or rests at my command. And when I pluck the air just so, it comes to me, like an old friend.  Now I walk in the rain with no need for parasol or shelter. The raindrops know me, and I know them.

title: Suisui/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_02_title              = Thoughts: II
|vo_01_02_intimacy           = 1
|vo_01_02_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg
|vo_01_02_tx                 = Speaking of hometowns, my mind wanders back to my childhood in . Everything felt so impossibly soothing in the March spring breeze—the high grass, the soaring birds, and each dawn less heavy than the last. I often dragged Yangyang out to fly kites. I can still feel the exact moment the wind would catch them, the line snapping taut as if we'd actually hooked a cloud. To ensure my kite soared higher than everyone else's, I'd run as fast as I could.  The courtyard was filled with the chatter of birds, the rustle of leaves, and the sunlight... Oh, how it filtered through the branches like shattered gold, dusting everything it touched. Even after all these years, that remains the most beautiful thing I've ever seen.
|vo_01_02_mention            = Yangyang

title: Suisui/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_02_mention            = Yangyang



|vo_01_03_title              = Thoughts: III
|vo_01_03_intimacy           = 2
|vo_01_03_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg
|vo_01_03_tx                 = Springs back then—the wind oh so soft, the sky oh so blue, and a qin's melody oh so occasionally drifting over the courtyard wall. Our house never wanted for music. From dawn till dusk, it lilted through every hall and corner, enveloping me like running water. My parents, bless them, always knew I lacked the patience to sit at the qin and practice my technique. Yangyang, though, was my opposite. Even as a child, she could sit through an entire piece in perfect silence, her little hands tapping the rhythm against her knees with a solemn focus beyond her years. But me? I loved to slip away to some open ground and simply dance. A light tap of the foot, a swirl of the sleeves, and a well-timed gust of wind... In those moments it felt as if I could gather the very brilliance of nature into my arms. There was nothing more enjoyable than that.
|vo_01_03_mention            = Yangyang

title: Suisui/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_03_mention            = Yangyang



|vo_01_04_title              = Thoughts: IV
|vo_01_04_intimacy           = 3
|vo_01_04_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg
|vo_01_04_tx                 = Beyond our courtyard lay an entirely different world. I was drawn to the docks, to the groan of ropes biting into wooden pilings as freighters moored, the shouts of vendors, and the rhythmic clack of abacus beads. To me, those sounds were more enchanting than any melody. I would crouch by the stalls and peer at ledgers, balancing accounts that weren't mine to balance or spreading out maps to correct a traveler's route. "This path is too long," I'd insist. "The river will save you two days." At first, the adults laughed it off as a child's game, until they realized I was right. My mother later joked to my father that perhaps their little girl had a natural gift for trade... Well, what do you think?

title: Suisui/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_05_title              = Thoughts: V
|vo_01_05_intimacy           = 4
|vo_01_05_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg
|vo_01_05_tx                 = At first, I only saw the bustle, the lovely noise of it all. It was only later that I came to see that "peace and prosperity" aren't a given. They're fragile things, held together only by those who tend them. I decided then to be such a person.  I love this land, but I love the life humming within it even more. I could never settle for the safety of a quiet corner while others struggle. Still, I know the limits of one person's strength. I have seen villages hollowed by disaster and people who have lost their homes—the kind of wounds that no shipment of supplies can ever quite heal. These are realities I simply cannot change alone.  Tell me... if the day comes to stake everything on the future of this land, will there be someone to help me weave the vision I see? What I want is a world alive and thriving, and in you, I see the possibility of making that real.  So, if you're willing... take this path with me.

title: Suisui/Voicelines
content:
|vo_02_01_title              = Suisui's Hobby
|vo_02_01_file               = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg
|vo_02_01_tx                 = Heh... the list grows longer by the day, I'm afraid. Lately, I've been quite obsessed with antiques and paintings. Even the little imitations from street stalls are fascinating in their own way, you know. There are certain tricks of the trade you only truly appreciate once you see them firsthand. I've even tried my hand at a few sketches. They're quite decent, if I do say so myself... Want to have a look?

title: Suisui/Voicelines
content:
|vo_02_02_title              = Suisui's Trouble
|vo_02_02_file               = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg
|vo_02_02_tx                 = My troubles...? Money handles most of them quite tidily, thank goodness. All but one, that is: what to do now that my sister has grown up? Argh... when did she decide she didn't need me to hold her hand anymore?

title: Suisui/Voicelines
content:
|vo_02_03_title              = Favorite Food
|vo_02_03_file               = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg
|vo_02_03_tx                 = Pastries, of course! Everything from the delicate pea flour cakes to those red bean rolls wrapped in white kidney bean paste. And then there are the soft, pillowy rice balls. Sweet without being cloying, simply melting on the tongue. I've also grown fond of the "Little Snowy Moons" here in . They have this wonderful, subtle aroma within that chewy cake texture, entirely different from the flavors back home. One day, I really must bring some back for my family to try.

title: Suisui/Voicelines
content:
|vo_02_04_title              = Disliked Food
|vo_02_04_file               = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg
|vo_02_04_tx                 = Despite my time in , I still can't stomach the pickled local fare. It's a tragedy, truly. I'll see a dish that looks absolutely exquisite, translucent and perfectly plated, only to find I can't bring myself to take a bite. It's enough to make a grown woman sigh.

|vo_02_05_title              = Ideals
|vo_02_05_file               = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg
|vo_02_05_tx                 = I want wealth that knows no border. I want goods to find their way, people to find their place. I want the warm light of every home burning, always burning, forever.

title: Suisui/Voicelines
content:
|vo_03_01_title              = Chat: I
|vo_03_01_file               = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg
|vo_03_01_tx                 = Dumpling, over here! See? Isn't she a delight? Dumpling has a marvelous affinity for water. She whirls and chirps around me whenever I use my Forte to bend the currents... Mm, that's all it takes to make this little birdie happy.

title: Suisui/Voicelines
content:
|vo_03_02_title              = Chat: II
|vo_03_02_file               = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg
|vo_03_02_tx                 = My family always let me do as I pleased, but choosing the way of the merchant was never a simple impulse. It began with watching and learning—observing how the street vendors set their rules and negotiated their deals before I ever dared to try it myself.  Oh, to watch the figures on a ledger slowly change, trade routes rise from nothing, and the cargo passing through my hands become the grain, fabric, or medicine that keeps another soul alive... That, my dear, is worth more than all the gold in the world. Commerce, you see, is not about calculation. It's about making a way for people to live.

title: Suisui/Voicelines
content:
|vo_04_01_title              = About Yangyang
|vo_04_01_intimacy           = 1
|vo_04_01_file               = {character}{language} About Yangyang.ogg
|vo_04_01_tx                 = Since we were children, people have said that Yangyang and I share only a face, that our spirits couldn't be more different. I was the one who needed to see everything the world had to offer, while she was the quiet, gentle center who kept her thoughts close. Over time, people even joked, asking if we were truly sisters at all.  Neither of us ever took offense. We knew that in all this wide world, you could never find two souls more alike. |vo_09_03_tx                 = I think the most precious thing in this world is the light that meets your eyes the moment you raise them. The first break of dawn, the river's surface glistening with flecks of gold, as fishing boats drift in small clusters to the rhythmic creak of oars. Then the markets stir. Bamboo lids lift, unfurling white breaths of steam carrying the scent of fresh buns. It mingles with the teahouses' distant melodies and the laughter of children at play... |vo_09_04_file               = {character}{language} Ascension IV.ogg
|vo_09_04_tx                 = People speak of commerce as if it's just buying and selling. But if you look closer, every trade route ends at someone's front door. Grain from the north. Tea from the south. Herbs from the mountains. Fabrics from the shores. Someone has to thread it all together, like a needle pulling a string, mending one land's scarcity with another's abundance.  These quiet exchanges are what have kept the world moving for generations. Water can wear down stone, or it can nourish a garden. Commerce can chase profit, or it can save a world. It's the path I've chosen.

content: Sumika  is a quest-exclusive NPC that first appears in Stagnant Dawn on Wastelands and a former Bloom Bearer for the Black Shores.

title: Sumika
content:
Once an elite Bloom Bearer of The Black Shores, Sumika went M.I.A many years prior due to her being trapped inside Chronorift Metropolis and was never found despite search and rescue efforts.

Based on the time dilation experienced by Chisa and Sumika's notes, Sumika was trapped in the Sonoro Sphere for 160 days (5 months and 20 days). This is the equivalent to around 50-something years, as Chisa's 2 months within Honami was twenty years in the real world.

title: Sumika
content: Sumika was a Resonator, her Forte allowing her to create amber that store memories or moments in time within them. Interacting with the amber allows others to see the information Sumika recorded within.

title: Taoqi/Backstory
content:
Taoqi, a mature Resonator with a laid-back personality, exudes a sense of understanding and protection.

She patiently listens to others' troubles and offers guidance with calm deliberation. Though she carries a relaxed and gentle aura, she becomes determined and resolute when making promises. This has earned her the role of a dependable big sister figure, despite her age.

Taoqi's lazy nature is evident in her lifestyle — she always carries a heating eye mask for impromptu naps on soft surfaces like beds or sofas. She loves dozing off while leaning on her friends' shoulders.

File:Taoqi Profile Reveal.png

title: Taoqi/Backstory
content:
Known as a trustworthy and caring big sister, Taoqi is often sought out for advice. From career to relationship issues, people confide in her, leading some to label her the "Gossip Queen."

In fact, Taoqi simply listens and observes, offering guidance to those who seek it. She has no interest in spreading rumors or using others' words for entertainment, instead focusing on helping them solve their problems.

title: Taoqi/Backstory
content:
Taoqi believes in maintaining a clear boundary between work and personal life for success.

Nothing stops Taoqi from getting off work on time. Once she clocks out, she is unreachable and colleagues only find her notes. She would be in the comfort of her home, organizing the day's tasks while resting on her trusty Peachy Turtle pillow. She will not fall asleep until she has made sure everything is in order.

At work, Taoqi excels in efficiency and attention to detail, earning a reputation for reliability among her colleagues. Her ultimate dream is a future with less work and more relaxation. But for now, she remains dedicated to protecting the city of Jinzhou. Until her goal is achieved, Taoqi will continue her vigilant approach to safeguarding the community and ensuring peaceful days for all.

File:Taoqi Chibi.png

title: Taoqi/Backstory
content:
Taoqi is known for her slow and deliberate movements. However, this same quality has made her a strong and dependable protector.

As a child, she faced bullying for her pace but found solace in those who patiently waited for her. As she grew up, she eventually found her strength in slowness to protect the ones she cherished.

As an adult, Taoqi uses keen observation and thoughtful planning to safeguard the people of Jinzhou. Her deliberate nature is not a weakness; instead, it has allowed her to establish a reliable defense system for the city.

Though not one for frontline battles, she diligently works in the background, orchestrating defense strategies and supporting civilians. Her strength lies in bringing peace to chaotic situations and protecting those she cares for.

But when needed, Taoqi can hold her own in combat with skill and precision.

title: Taoqi/Backstory
content: As a reassuring presence in the team, Taoqi excellently assumes the responsibility of the protector. Much of her ability goes under her unique defense mechanisms. Use her ability wisely, and then every member of the team will be protected.

title: Tar
content: Tar is a male NPC who appears in City Square, Ragunna at night.

title: Tar
content:
Ziegler: Tar, I've been thinking... maybe I should just join a gang.
Tar: ...What are you on about now?
Ziegler: I'm serious. I'm just a guy with no talent... it seems impossible for me to get ahead in life.
Ziegler: Have you seen that play, Like a Hippocamp? I want to be like the Mafia in it.
Ziegler: I'll fight with my fists and live by loyalty and passion, carving out my own place in the world!
Ziegler: So, what do you say, Tar? Want to join me on this journey?
Tar: I think...
Ziegler: It's great?
Tar: No, I think you should get a job. If anything, you could go herd sheep in town. I know people.
Ziegler: You think I'm joking, don't you?
Tar: Ziegler, buddy, the gangs are a thing of the past...
Tar: Have you seen anyone in Ragunna City acting like those characters in the play, brawling and openly breaking the law?
Ziegler: Not really.
Tar: If there were, they'd have been locked up in the Order Tribunal or recruited by the families.
Ziegler: But still, I believe gangs like that exist in real life!
Tar: You're a lost cause. Who actually takes stories from a play seriously?!

title: Tethys Hub
content: Tethys Hub is an area of Black Shores Archipelago, The Black Shores. An archipelago shrouded in the Stormy Sea of Solaris. Formed from Tacetites, these isles constantly emanate Remnant Energy, casting an eerie "mist" that envelopes the region. This mist distorts human perception and jams all forms of communication, making the archipelago inaccessible to most. Only those recognized or invited by the Black Shores can navigate their way to this mysterious place.

title: Tethys Hub
content: The frequencies emitted by the Tacetites disrupt standard communication signals. Communication with the outside world is only possible via the Black Shores' Beacon relay system.

title: Tethys Hub
content: Amidst the lingering mist and blake blooms, this is where newcomers first set foot upon their arrival.

title: Tethys Hub
content: The grand hall of the Black Shores where foreign envoys are received. It also functions as the administrative hub that manages the region's affairs.

title: Tethys Hub
content: The glass conservatory perched at the highest point of the Black Shores. An impressive collection of plant specimens from across the world thrives within its walls. Every newcomer, Bloom Bearer or Consultant, is invited to contribute a seed from their homeland. At the heart of this verdant sanctuary, a unique modulation device sits encircled by flowers representing diverse civilizations. Each plant in the Greenhouse speaks the unspoken hopes of its sower. Some of these seeds come from lands erased by the Lament, standing as the last living memory of places that no longer exist.

title: Tethys Hub
content: An unremarkable tree with a sign that reads "Money Tree." Rumor has it that watering it precisely at eight past eight in the morning will grant you extra funds for your ventures.

title: Tethys' Deep
content: Nestled in Tethys' Deep, KU-Roro Charging Station is where KU-Roros (aka Tethys Terminals) return to recharge and "rest" when their energy reserves run low.

title: Tethys' Deep
content:
These stabilizing devices are strategically positioned throughout the surface and underground parts of the Black Shores. Their primary function is to calibrate and stabilize the frequencies of the giant Tacetite that makes up the island, effectively isolating the Tethys System's virtual layer from reality. Additionally, these Anchors facilitate communication and carry the responsibility of observing the Etheric Sea, eliminating the need to build a Nexus Tower in the Black Shores.

The Anchors drew inspiration from the reactor control rods used in pre-Lament reactor engineering. They are considered exemplary models of the Black Shores' minimalist engineering design. In the Black Shores, reality and data intertwine as one. Through this connection, we explore the many paths by which civilizations may endure.

title: Tethys' Deep
content:
On the virtual shores, deep within the Tethys System, lies the ultimate destination of the Black Shores in a distant future. The tides of fate bring the lost traveler to this place, where their journey finds their end. It is a location exclusively accessible by Rover and Shorekeeper.
