title: Tetragon Temple
content: Tetragon Temple, more commonly known as The Tetragon, is a faction consisting of the Priestesses of Septimont. It is founded by the Head Priestess Lillibet and currently led by Iuno. The Temple is responsible for handling and delivering prophecies (one of the most notable being the "Hero of Heroes" prophecy) typically through the Book of Prophecies or murals within the temple.

title: Tetragon Temple
content:
Hero of Heroes - The legendary ruler of Septimont. The legend traces its roots to an ancient prophecy that only the one who becomes the Hero of Heroes can save Septimont from falling into ruin.
Book of Prophecies - A scroll Lillibet carries, recording visions glimpsed in the flame light. Both this book and the murals within Tetragon Temple are media through which the Priestesses of Septimont convey prophecies to the people.

title: The Binder
content:
The Binder is one of the Heliodic Six members and makes his first appearance inside the Elysium in .

After completing Ode to the Second Sunrise, The Binder is freed from his duties and can be found Starward Riseway at .

title: The Binder
content: The Binder: The next stop is...

title: The Binder
content:
The Binder: Startorch Academy... Sundermere... Nice places, they are. The Spacetrek Collective's public transport is very convenient...

[Dialogue Option]  Excuse me, are you one of the Heliodic Six?

The Binder: The old Horstvald was indeed the Binder of the Six. But now, a wandering old man I'd rather be.

[Dialogue Option]   What brings you here?

The Binder: Observing this and that, as was my dream. In my youth, a traveler I always wished to be.

The Binder: After your Spacetrek Collective launched Helios into the sky, lighter grew the burden in the Solisylum. "No longer stay confined," the Shaper told us. "For the Royan governance and the new season laws, gather knowledge," he said.

The Binder: But we knew his true wish. It was for us, who had given our lives to the Solisylum, to finally go out and see the world.

title: The Binder
content:
The Binder: But we knew his true wish. It was for us, who had given our lives to the Solisylum, to finally go out and see the world.



The Binder: So here I am, an old man riding the train. I look upon the Academy, listen to the market's noise, speak with different souls... and in their faces, their joys and worries I observe.

The Binder: And what I observe... to the Shaper, I will carry.

content:
;The seat turnover rate...
The Chronicler: During the peak dining hours, seat turnover rises by 37%, yet the average meal time falls by 15%. Such herd behavior is worth chronicling.
[Dialogue Option]  Excuse me, are you one of the Heliodic Six?
The Chronicler: Greetings, Arbiter from the chronicles. I am Eivind the Chronicler. For your aid in the Solisylum, our deep gratitude you have.
The Chronicler: Since the Spacetrek Collective launched Helios, the Heliogyre is no longer our sole observational tool. From pure computation, we are freed. Our attention may turn to other significant realms.
[Dialogue Option]  What brings you here?
The Chronicler: Research. For Roya under the new sun, new Lahai-Roi season laws are required. Local diets, their social rhythms... Yes, all precious first-hand data.
The Chronicler: Look at those mingling at shared tables. Their conversations, food preferences, and even body language... they paint a portrait of present society.
The Chronicler: Subtle data, this. For the Heliogyre to quantify, difficult. But important to the drafting of new season laws and their guiding procedures.
The Chronicler: As Chronicler, I will report my thoughts and observations back to the Shaper. Such services can still be of use to him.

content:
Although not explicitly confirmed, the Excellency is very likely to be the Fractsidus member mentioned in the diary written by Wuli, described as a strange man in red with a pretentious attitude whom he encountered someplace outside of Huanglong. Having somehow known that Wuli was traveling in search of a cure for his girlfriend Fuling's condition, he claimed to have a way to save her, and sent Wuli to Mt. Firmament to help them find the Temporal Program from the legend of the Weiqi game.

Although the Excellency later enters the Sonoro Sphere containing the Temporal Program at some point, they are indirectly injured as Changli destroys it with her flame manipulation Forte. They manage to evade capture as well as identification.

title: The Excellency
content: Due to his authority as an Overseer, The Excellency is suspectedly theorized to be the "uncle" of Qichi Village (who is responsible for the gruesome experiment to his niece fused with a Tacet Discord), which makes him one of The Shepherd's possible identities alongside Phrolova.

title: The Farwatcher
content:
The Farwatcher was one of nine interstellar probes launched by the Pre-Lament Civilization in the time before the Etheric Sea enveloped Solaris during the first Lament 10,000 years ago. Although it had been continuously transmitting information of the galaxies it travelled through back to Solaris for millennia, as the Etheric Sea blocks all contact between Solaris and the outside world, these signals failed to reach their creators.

The Exostrider would later pick up on these signals, recording them and burning them into a cassette which would be gifted to Rover and the people of Lahai-Roi during Starlights from Yesterdays.

As one of the nine interstellar probes launched in ancient humanity's spacefaring era, the Farwatcher is represented as one of the nine stars in the logo of the Spacetrek Collective.

title: The Genesis of the Spacetrek Explorer Project: A Developmental Retrospective (Excerpt)
content:
"The sprawling, secret-filled lands of Lahai-Roi made it necessary for the Spacetrek Collective to establish mid-to-long-term field research programs. However, sustaining these operations in such dangerous terrain required dependable mobile bases.

After weighing its options, the Collective developed a versatile transport platform capable of handling logistics, storage, and emergency defense. They named it Spacetrek Explorer.

The Explorer's design is based on a wheel robot. Its massive tires provide exceptional grip, allowing it to climb smooth vertical surfaces and easily navigate the dense architecture of Startorch Academy, delivering cargo to otherwise inaccessible locations. The large storage container mounted on its top further supports fieldwork, enabling researchers to access supplies or auxiliary equipment directly on-site.

metadata.page_title: The Genesis of the Spacetrek Explorer Project: A Developmental Retrospective (Excerpt)

title: The Genesis of the Spacetrek Explorer Project: A Developmental Retrospective (Excerpt)
content:
To defend against the Exoswarm affected by the Waveworn Phenomenon and attacks from Outcasts, the Explorer is equipped with a heavy electromagnetic cannon and a protective shield projector. However, due to its weight, frequent cargo load, and energy-saving design, it carries only small thrusters. These are useful for brief bursts of acceleration, but not for sustained flight.

In addition to field expeditions, the Spacetrek Explorer now serves as one of Lahai-Roi's primary heavy logistics vehicles. In its logistics configuration, its weapons are removed and replaced with expanded storage modules to maximize cargo capacity."

metadata.page_title: The Genesis of the Spacetrek Explorer Project: A Developmental Retrospective (Excerpt)

title: The Genesis of the Twin Nova Project: A Developmental Retrospective (Excerpt)
content:
"…In short, developing high-performance combat mechs had become a pressing need.

The project was assigned to a pair of twin researchers: an older sister who was bold and daring, and a younger sister who was quiet and steady. Their personalities shaped the Twin Nova series they created.

The melee model, Twin Nova: Collapsar Blade, engages with fast and aggressive actions, while its ranged counterpart, Twin Nova: Nebulous Cannon, prefers to stay back and provide support. Their very names embody the Spacetrek Collective's mission: to descend into the unknown as they continue to reach for the stars.

metadata.page_title: The Genesis of the Twin Nova Project: A Developmental Retrospective (Excerpt)

title: The Genesis of the Twin Nova Project: A Developmental Retrospective (Excerpt)
content:
The idea of building the mechs in pairs began as something almost poetic. The Threnodian of Void, Aleph-1, erases individuals from memory, and the twins couldn't imagine a world where they might forget each other. They hoped their creations, at least, would always have a companion and never face that silence alone. While Aleph-1's influence may not extend to inorganic matter, this sentiment became the emotional core of the Twin Nova project.

This philosophy also influenced their form. The Collective opted for humanoid frames to symbolize humanity's presence on the frontier. Rumor has it the design also helps them seem less intimidating when serving as security at Startorch Academy, and perhaps caters to a few researchers' personal tastes.

metadata.page_title: The Genesis of the Twin Nova Project: A Developmental Retrospective (Excerpt)

title: The Genesis of the Twin Nova Project: A Developmental Retrospective (Excerpt)
content:
An autonomous tactical intelligence model was built for the units. However, with little combat data available in the Collective, the sisters had to pilot the prototypes themselves to generate the initial data. Their influence made the Twin Nova units move with a graceful, almost showy flair, a style that is sometimes more artistic than practical.

Now, with the accumulating real combat data, the models continue to evolve. The melee unit leads the charge and breaks through enemy lines, while the ranged unit coordinates with human teams, offering support fire and protecting the formation."

metadata.page_title: The Genesis of the Twin Nova Project: A Developmental Retrospective (Excerpt)

title: The Recorder
content:
;Rinascita... the Carnevale... Gondolas... Gladiator battles...
The Recorder: Laetia has finished reading the history of Rinascita. Next, a book about Huanglong she will read.
[Dialogue Option]  Excuse me, are you one of the Heliodic Six?

[Dialogue Option]  What brings you here?
The Recorder: Isander (The Shaper) remains in the Solisylum, computing the sun's properties. So Laetia has come here, to compute the properties of humankind.
The Recorder: Isander (The Shaper) wishes to know how people from different places mark time, how they celebrate festivities... This knowledge extends beyond Lahai-Roi, and thus beyond Isander's ken.
The Recorder: Therefore, Laetia the Recorder is here to read the world and record what she sees. To Isander, she will carry these stories.
The Recorder: That way, alone with the Heliogyre he will not be. What Laetia sees, he too shall see.

title: The Refiner
content:
The Refiner is one of the Heliodic Six members and makes her first appearance in Ode to the Second Sunrise.

After completing , The Refiner is freed from her duties and can be found at Atuja Camp at

title: The Refiner
content:
;The Refiner What's your name, cute one?
;Well-behaved Soliskin Chuuluu!
The Refiner: What's your name, cute one?
Well-behaved Soliskin: Chuuluu
The Refiner: Oh, "Sweetie" is your name? The one who named you must have had a sweet tooth, hmm?
Well-behaved Soliskin: Chuuluu, chuuluu...
[Dialogue Option]  Excuse me, are you one of the Heliodic Six?
The Refiner: Good day, Arbiter from the chronicles. Yes, I am Freamir. The Refiner, they call my seat.
The Refiner: For now, to my old work as a Shepherd I have returned. I also serve as liaison to the Solisylum.
[Dialogue Option]  What brings you here?
The Refiner: Now that the Heliogyre turns once more, the natural world's subtleties are important references for us in drafting new season laws. And these little creatures... are most sensitive to shifts in the environment.
The Refiner: So I am here noting their behavioral changes. A task for which a Shepherd's touch is best suited.
The Refiner: We convey to the Shaper things that the Solisylum readings cannot fully capture.

title: The Shaper
content: The Shaper , also known as Isander, is a quest-exclusive NPC that makes his first appearance in . He later reappears during .

title: The Shaper
content: He is a member of the Heliodic Six and oversees the Heliogyre within the Solisylum. He has a calm demeanor and puts his responsibility as the Heliodic Six above everything.

title: The Shaper
content:
[Objective: Complete the following]
You see the Shaper bathed in the Heliogyre's radiance, silent as an inanimate vessel. As you prepare to speak to him, he slowly opens his eyes.
"The Shaper": To lay eyes on you once more, Arbiter, is a pleasure.
"The Shaper": The Heliogyre has shown me that the Spacetreck Collective's ceremony was a success. To you and your companions, my congratulations I offer.
"The Shaper": If questions remain for me, or the Heliogyre. I, the Shaper, shall answer.
[Dialogue Option]  Ask about the Solisylum.
"The Shaper": Because of your aid, the Heliogyre turns anew. The Solisylum has returned to normality.
"The Shaper": The Helios in the sky now weaves together wisdom from both the Spacetrek Collective and the Roya. Data once seen only by the Heliogyre... now the Hyvatia Detector may also obtain.
"The Shaper": The Heliogyre's operations stand ready to perform primary verificiation tasks.
"The Shaper":  Thus, in the Solisylum, I alone am sufficient.
[Dialogue Option]  Ask about the remaining Five.
"The Shaper": After your authorization, the Heliogyre has concentrated all of its computational power within me. No longer do the Six need to bear those immense calculations in parallel, at all times.
"The Shaper": Now, the other Five may devote their energies to managing Royan affairs. Under the new sun, the Roya need new season laws.
"The Shaper": For this, I require them to gather outside knowledge. With this, I will weave into my own computations.
"The Shaper": Iselde (The Eye)'s perception, Horstvald (the Binder)'s foresight, Laetia (the Recorder)'s curiosity, Eivind (the Chronicler)'s discipline, and Freamir (the Refiner)'s empathy... they are the Heliogyre's senses in the world. And to the Solisylum, they will return their findings.
"The Shaper": Before they entered the Solisylum, the Heliodic Six were but mere mortals.
"The Shaper": Now they enjoy some time to lay down their burden. I hope... their lives will unfold as they wish. At least for the time being.
"The Shaper": If you see them in Lahai-Roi, please, as a witness, offer them your blessing.
[Dialogue Option]  Ask about him.
"The Shaper": All of the Heliogyre's computational power is now concentrated within me. Wherever the sunlight touches, so too do my thoughts.
[Dialogue Option]  But this is not without cost.
"The Shaper": ...
"The Shaper": As you once said... I am now bound to the Heliogyre's will. From the Solisylum, I cannot depart.
"The Shaper": Human flesh and blood were not made to bear such vast quantitites of information in so short a span. Should this continue, my body's decay will quicken tenfold until electricity within my nerves ceases... and a final computation concludes.
"The Shaper": Yet... the Spacetrek Collective already seeks a remedy. Just as the Heliodic Six with mortal strength touched the divine, so too does their technology strive to undo the toll the gods have exacted upon me.
"The Shaper": I believe in them. Just as I have always believed in the Roya.
"The Shaper": In the future where the light shines brighter, we will one day witness together.
[Dialogue Option]  I have no more questions.
"The Shaper": Goodbye, Arbiter.
"The Shaper": Do not forget that all the knowledge of the Heliogyre is mine to share with you. Should you have need, I will respond.

title: The Shaper
content:
Laetia - The Recorder
Iselde - The Eye
Horstvald - The Binder
Freamir - The Refiner
Eivind - Freamir
Yngvar - Former Successor

title: Tianhe
content:
Tianhe: It seems like my leg really doesn't hurt anymore...
Tianhe: Huh? I'm sorry, is there anything I can help you with?
[Dialogue Option]  Are you injured?
Tianhe: Uh... Yes, the Tacet Discord in Norfall Barrens is active and the attacks are intense. It's inevitable to get injured.
Tianhe: Last week, we, the defenders, successfully repelled ten attacks from the Tacet Discord. It's already good that I only have these minor injuries.
Tianhe: But luckily, General Jiyan is here. That's why I was able to recover from my injuries so quickly.",
[Dialogue Option]  Jiyan?
Tianhe: Yes, that day he noticed that my legs seemed a bit strange after standing for a long time, and he quickly brought me ointment.
Tianhe: I don't know how he could see the symptoms at a glance, and I didn't expect him to pay attention to such small details...
Tianhe: He took the time to personally deliver the medicine and told me how to take care of myself. Look, I'm already jumping around now. It's amazing, isn't it?!
Tianhe: Hehe, I didn't expect him to be such a caring person.

title: Tianheng
content:
Tianheng: Hmm?
Tianhe: Um... Does he mean "What's your business at the Vanguard Base"?
[Dialogue Option]  Vanguard Base?
Tianheng: Hmph.
Tianhe: He means "If you have nothing to do, don't loiter around here".
Tianhe: I'm sorry! My brother can be a bit rude... Let me explain for him!
Tianhe: The Midnight Rangers have three divisions: Outrider, Vanguard, and Rearguard, all under the command of General Jiyan.
Tianhe: The Vanguard is the vanguard force of the Midnight Rangers, mainly responsible for frontline combat. This is the Vanguard Base.
Tianhe: We are very close to the frontline here, and there are often Tacet Discord sightings around. If you have nothing important, please do not linger around, especially do not proceed further to the east.
[Dialogue Option]  Has the situation on the battlefield become more intense?
Tianhe: Although he doesn't talk much, he is very dedicated to his work and skilled, which is why General Jiyan specifically appointed him to guard this place.
Tianhe: Hmph, with the two of us, the Vanguard Base is impregnable!
[Dialogue Option]  How do you understand what he's saying?
Tianhe: That's right, even some of the soldiers who were originally stationed at the base have recently been deployed to the battlefield...
Tianhe: In order to defend this place, we can't leave our posts to ensure your safety, so please stay away from the front lines as much as possible.
Tianhe: Ah... Well, we grew up together, so even without words, I can understand what he means just from his expression.

title: Tommaso
content: Tommaso is an musician from Ragunna, Rinascita. His Echo is an Aria Mummer named Melody.

title: Tommaso
content:
Tommaso: Oh... my soulmate, my king of inspiration... what has happened to you...

Melody: *Buzz—buzz—whirr—clickety-clack—*

[Dialogue Option]  What seems to be wrong with this Echo?

Tommaso Hello, traveler from afar. My name is Tommaso, and I am a musician. This here is my Echo partner, the "Aria Mummer" Melody.

[Dialogue Option]  Oh my gosh, it's starting to transform!

Tommaso Transform? Melody can't do that, I'm afraid... Hello, traveler from afar. My name is Tommaso, and I am a musician. This here is my Echo partner, the "Aria Mummer" Melody.

Tommaso Melody possesses the ability to capture every melody it hears and orchestrate its surrounding "Melody Ensemble" to replay them.

Tommaso I have known Melody for many years, and it is thanks to its presence that I can savor these fleeting melodies, with an endless stream of inspiration flowing to me each day.

title: Tommaso
content:
Tommaso We often venture out together to gather inspirations, but lately, with preparations for the Carnevale, I've been caught up and had to leave Melody to handle it alone in the city.

Tommaso Once I finally finished my work, I realized Melody had already ended up like this...

Melody: *Buzz—buzz buzz—whimper—*

Tommaso It can no longer perform entire melodies. Even its voice shows signs of "distortion"... Melody... without you, how am I supposed to live?

[Dialogue Option]  Maybe it's because it has listened to too many different things...

[Dialogue Option]  All work and no play makes even the sharpest mind dull...

Tommaso Sure... It seems likely... Ah, my friend, judging by your posture and attire, you must be a seasoned adventurer.

Tommaso Have you heard or recorded any particularly memorable music during your adventure?

title: Tommaso
content:
Tommaso Have you heard or recorded any particularly memorable music during your adventure?



Tommaso Could you share them with Melody? This might ease its "symptoms"...

Tommaso Oh... oh! Yes! This is the sound Melody was meant to have! This... this is true music!

Tommaso Thank you! Traveler from afar! This… "Melody Box" in your hands, where did you find it? Such wondrous music, captured on a tiny disc like this...

[Dialogue Option]  Just a stroke of luck.

[Dialogue Option]  Adapted from True Experiences.

[Dialogue Option]  I am merely a porter in this world.

Tommaso Hmm... So, what you're saying is, these are the things you've gathered through countless adventures in this vast world? Like a... response from the world to you?

title: Tommaso
content:
Tommaso I once heard a saying: All the music in this world is prewritten by the divine, scattered across the land. It is the duty of musicians to discover and record them.

Tommaso It seems Melody and I should venture beyond Ragunna City and explore the wider world.

Tommaso In the cacophony of the world's sounds, the lifelong challenge for every musician is to distill the purest melodies... and "Aria Mummers" are no exception.

Tommaso Perhaps within Rinascita, you may encounter other "Aria Mummers." They might be facing similar challenges.

Tommaso I have always believed, alongside Melody, that great music has the power to touch others and inspire change.

Tommaso During your adventure, if you happen to gather other "Melody Boxes," please lend a hand to the other "Aria Mummers" as well.

Tommaso Please accept these as a token of my gratitude for your help!

title: Tornatore
content: Tornatore is a scriptwriter who appears next to Ragunna's Pioneer Association, after the completion of Carlotta Companion Quest; If On a Rainy Night a Family.

title: Tornatore
content:
Tornatore: "The rain poured relentlessly, cloaking the world in a shroud of gloom, stripping away its pretense of grandeur to reveal its barren core."

Tornatore: "Under the storm's shadow, people were fighting at each other's throats—fragile yet ferocious, like... like beasts cornered in a cage." No, no, Tornatore, that's far too trite! Think, man! You can craft something better!

Tornatore: You're the playwright of this drama. Give it an ending that lingers, and echo that won't fade!

Tornatore: "As she fell, her trembling hand raised the gun. The old acquiantance, a traitor to his ideals, stared down the barrel. One last shot. Addio." Hmm, does that come across too... passive?

title: Tornatore
content:
Tornatore: Ah, I see. Rumors, ripe and waiting, a wellspring of inspiration at my fingertips. Let's see... "Can I really trust him? She wondered. Yet instinct urged her forward. She clasped him hand firmly, then turned her back, offering it wholly to her new companion." Yes, yes, that has promise!

The creator in front of you is completely consumed by the tale of storm and betrayal he's spinning. Perhaps it's best to let him remain in his trance.

title: Troy
content: Troy is a male NPC who appears at the bar in Montelli Quarter, Ragunna. He can be seen talking to Andrius during the daytime.

title: Troy
content:
Andrius: You should know that people from Rinascita place a high value on family honor and kinship.
Andrius: Without an influential family behind you, it's nearly impossible to rise in Ragunna.
Andrius: But the Montellis are different. We believe opportunities multiply when they're shared. Money means nothing unless it's in circulation.
[Dialogue Option]  Are you a Montelli?
Andrius: Of course! That's why we get to sit here.
Troy: I want to be rich too! I want people to be in awe whenever they speak my name! I'll make the most of this opportunity!
Andrius: Then go for it! Do whatever it takes to earn your status and honor.
Andrius: These things won't just fall into your lap—they're up to you to pursue.
Andrius: If you share my belief, I promise that serving the Montelli family will not leave you wanting.
Andrius: Shall we toast?
Troy: C-can I?
Andrius: Of course! I might be your employer, I prefer to see us as partners.
Troy: W-well, cheers, then!

title: Tuanjin
content:
Tuanjin: Hey? You must be that Rover. How are you?
[Dialogue Option]  Are you a Patroller? Anything happened here?
Tuanjin: No, no, don't worry. I just got off work and decided to pay a visit.
Tuanjin: There are names I know here... they're lonely souls, so I visit them from time to time.
Tuanjin: And as you can see, there are lots of seniors here. If anything happens, I'll be around to help out.
Tuanjin: Even though I'm off duty, as long as I'm wearing this uniform, I'm still a Patroller, and I have a duty to protect people.

title: Tulio
content: Tulio is an NPC located in . He is a member of the Servitude Hall in the Order of the Deep. After the third interaction with him, he can be found in Fool's Elysium until talked to, after which he leaves the Fool's Elysium by boat.

title: Tulio
content:
[Objective: (First interaction)]
Tulio: Light of Genesis, please purify these lost souls...
[Dialogue Option]  Lost souls?
Tulio: Hello, I am Tulio, a member of the Servitude Hall of the Order of the Deep.
Tulio: Within the realm of Rinascita, once the frequency of Tacet Discord is dispersed, the remaining Reverberation, if not collected over time, will gradually be absorbed by the Data Bank of the Genesis Nexus, subsequently becoming a frequency sample for Common Echoes.
Tulio: Therefore, we believe Tacet Discords and Echoes are essentially the same. Tacet Discords are simply wayward, fallen " Divine Envoys Common Echoes  ".
Tulio: The function of the Servitude Hall is to regularly purge the Tacet Discords around Ragunna City, maintain the surrounding safety, and expand the frequency reserves within the Genesis Nexus Data Bank.
Tulio: We also believe this will allow Tacet Discords to receive the Sentinel's "initiation and purification," enabling them to return to the embrace of the divine, once again becoming  Divine Envoys Common Echoes   to assist humanity.
Tulio: The gourd you're wearing is a Reserved Terminal, correct? Oh, don't worry. I'm not here to inspect your Terminal.
Tulio: The Servitude Hall oversees the distribution of Reserved Terminals within the region and manages foreign Reserved Terminals.
Tulio: Your Terminal has passed approval and certification, but its unique appearance made it particularly memorable among the applications.
Tulio: I want to remind you that recent Tacet Discord activities outside Ragunna City have increased. If you plan to venture into the wild to collect Echoes, please be careful.
Tulio: May the Sentinel bless you.

title: Tulio
content:
[Objective: (Second interaction)]
Tulio: Hello again. I'm placing some frequency samples from Vitreum Dancers.
Tulio: Vitreum Dancer's frequency originates from the stained glass windows in the ruins. Some scholars believe that their frequencies contain a portion of history related to the Sentinel.
Tulio: Recently, some questions regarding the history of Rinascita—specifically a prophecy concerning Napoli the Second, the first Primus—have surfaced, sparking considerable debate among scholars.
Tulio: Scholars want more frequency samples for analysis. And with the sea of clouds... things have been unsteady, so the Servitude Hall has extended "operations" to Nimbus Sanctum.
[Dialogue Option]  You look a bit tired.
[Dialogue Option]  The workload at the Servitude Hall isn't easy.
Tulio: While undertaking tasks in Nimbus Sanctum, we often have to ascend and descend through the cloud tunnels of the sea of clouds. That sense of weightlessness is not a pleasant experience.
Tulio: But every time I see these Vitreum Dancers, I can't help but marvel at the Sentinel's power over all creation... to bring such wonders to the people, to show His miracles—that is my mission.
Tulio: Their every move reflects a mesmerizing radiance, exuding a beauty of resilience and grace that emerges from transformation.
Tulio: And with its elegant yet agile demeanor, it's no wonder the Montelli family favors them as personal guards.
Tulio: If you're planning to travel to Nimbus Sanctum soon, it's safer to set sail during the day.
Tulio: May the Sentinel bless you.

title: Tulio
content:
[Objective: (Third Interaction)]
Tulio: Ah, it's you. How many times have we met now? Truly a sign of fate.
Tulio: This time, I'm introducing some frequency samples of the Fae Ignis.
Tulio: Fae Ignis... it's supposed to only appear around Penitent's End, yet lately, sightings report them gathering at the Hallowed Reach.
Tulio: The Servitude Hall members have been dispatched to handle this matter, but so far, we haven't reached any solid conclusions...
[Dialogue Option]  You seem to have a lot on your mind.
[Dialogue Option]  You look like you've got dark circles under your eyes.
Tulio: Fae Ignis is particularly drawn to fiery frequencies. The candles on the Isle burn constantly; with their nature, there's no way they'd leave for no reason.
Tulio: Perhaps... something secretive is happening in Penitent's End... I worry that this anomaly might impact all Common Echoes, even threatening the safety of the people.
Tulio: ...If large-scale Fae Ignis migrations happen again, I'll have to go to the Isle to investigate.
Tulio: When you're out in the wild, be cautious. There are strange currents beneath the sea... Ragunna's high tide season is coming early this year.
Tulio: May the Sentinel bless you.

title: Tulio
content:
[Objective: (Found at Troupe of Fools)]
Tulio: Sigh, what should we do...
[Dialogue Option]  Acolyte Tulio, you're still alive!
[Dialogue Option]  Acolyte Tulio, what are you doing here?
Tulio: It's truly fortunate to encounter you here.
Tulio: Earlier, I went alone to the Grave Isle to investigate the truth behind the migration of the Fae Ignis, only to unexpectedly encounter an attack by a dragon on the island.
Tulio: In a moment of crisis, it was the members of the Troupe of Fools who saved me and brought me back to life.
[Dialogue Option]  You should be grateful to them.
[Dialogue Option]  You should feel happy about that.
Tulio: I understand... but did you know, everyone here... they're all... lost souls...
[Dialogue Option]  But you, too, were saved by those lost souls.
[Dialogue Option]  What do you mean? Please be clear.
Tulio: Pilgrimage... Fools... it all aligns. I merely went from purgatory to hell...
Tulio: I may know much about Tacet Discords and Echoes but about people... I know nothing...
Tulio: Do you  think... they saved me to eat me? Judging by their food quality, it wouldn't be surprising...
Tulio: No, no... I mustn't keep talking. If they realize I know their secret...
Tulio: I must come up with a plan... to escape from here...

title: Tulio
subsection: (Where Tulio was last seen in Fool's Elysium)
content:
[Objective: (Where Tulio was last seen in Fool's Elysium)]
Claudio: Ah... of all days, why'd he pick such awful weather...
[Dialogue Option] : Acolyte Tulio, what are you doing here?
Claudio: A member witnessed the Acolyte secretly sailing away from the stronghold alone at night.
Claudio: We can understand why Order members don't recognize us... it's understandable if they leave.
Claudio: But... ah, with this weather... fog all around, and the storm is closing in.
Claudio: I hope the Sentinel's blessings see him safely ashore...

title: Tuppence
content: ' is a Roya girl who can be found quizzing to two Students from the Department of Voidmatters at the front of Startorch Academy entrance, to find her brother who is attending.

title: Tuppence
content:
Merill: The square root of this is... and when I square that, I get... Oh!  19!
Struss: From a bird's-eye view of the Academy, the Reactor's light... is angled directly at the Energy Sciences!

Merill: If you want to find him, wouldn't it be easier to just tell us what he looks like?

title: Tuppence
content:

Tuppence: Of course. Listen closely. My brother's problem goes like this...

title: Tykwer
content:
Tykwer: What took her so long...
[Dialogue Option]  Are you waiting for someone?
Tykwer: Oh yes. I'm waiting for Camellya—the Bloom Bearer covered in vines.
[Dialogue Option]  What does she do here?
Tykwer: She usually handles the "germination test." It's the test we give to new candidates.
Tykwer: The Gardeners organize their personal info, and the Tethys System decides how they'll be evaluated.
Tykwer: I've heard Camellya takes care of all the combat-oriented tests. She always grabs the candidates' profiles without notifying us and does her thing.
Tykwer: By the time we find her, the test is already over, and she just smacks the results in our faces.
[Dialogue Option]  That sounds efficient.
Tykwer: Not exactly. She's gotten a lot of complaints... Honestly, I don't know how to talk to her about it. It's just too awkward...
[Dialogue Option]  What do the complaints say?
Tykwer: Mostly that she's more interested in fighting that actually running the tests...
[Dialogue Option]  Of course she is.
Tykwer: Her methods can be a bit intense, but they're great for pressure tests or for vetting candidates in dangerous regions.
Tykwer: If you can pass her test, it means you've got the physical and mental strength to handle extreme situations.
Tykwer: Overall, she's a solid tester. I just wish I didn't have to clean up the mess she leaves behind...

title: Ulfrida
content: is an elderly Roya found at the Roya Frostland camps who speaks about a Glommoth.

title: Ulfrida
content:
Ulfrida: Have you ever seen a "Glommoth," child?
[Dialogue Option]  A Glommoth?
[Dialogue Option]  I'm not from around here...
Ulfrida: Ah, forgive my eagerness. I am Ulfrida. Folk here once called me a "Cryptozoologist."
Ulfrida: Would you like to hear a story about a Glommoth?
[Dialogue Option]  (Listen)
Ulfrida: It happened when I was just a girl. Lost on the ice I was, gathering herbs, when the avalanche struck.
Ulfrida: I ran, but found no place to hide. I could only watch as the mountain of snow came for me...
Ulfrida: And then... it appeared. With its great tusks it shattered the falling stone. With its body, it shielded me from the snow.
Ulfrida: When the roar was gone, the Glommoth raised its trunk and blew, pointing in the direction I was to go. And in its eyes I saw... a guarded, lonely depth.
Ulfrida: There I stood, in fear or awe, I cannot say... until it turned and faded back into the storm.
Ulfrida: ...Heh. Sounds a tale spun from dream-stuff, does it not?
Ulfrida: I was just a girl at the time. No image could I keep, no trail could I follow. But in my bones, I know what I saw.
Ulfrida: I have looked for it ever since, but never have I found it...
[Dialogue Option]  Maybe it doesn't actually exist?
[Dialogue Option]  Maybe it was just your imagination?
Ulfrida: I believe what I saw.
Ulfrida: Older than we know is Solaris. Grander. Full of mysteries our minds cannot hold.
Ulfrida: Now my hope lies in the Spacetrek Collective's technology to confirm its existence... I want to hear news of the creature as soon as it's found. That's why I live here.
Ulfrida: If you ever meet it, do tell me... May the Soliskin protect you, child of Solaris.
[Dialogue Option]  I'm a bit busy right now...

title: Ulma
content:
Ulma is an NPC that appears in Ragunna, Rinascita. She is originally from Huanglong.

From 6:00 PM - 5:59 AM, she can be found talking to Cueto about Pizza Tropicale, which Cueto believes is not a real pizza but actually a demon that nearly destroyed Ragunna.

title: Ulma
content:
[Objective: (At night)]
Ulma: Hi there! I'm Ulma, an inspector for the Mochelin Dining Guide, and I'm currently working on the Ragunna Food Guide.
Cueto: Whoa! Welcome! Welcome! Ragunna has an endless array of culinary delights! We have Margherita Steak, Nectarwine, Pizza Classica, and Nuvola Pasta...
Ulma: Uhh, sorry to interrupt you. I actually wanted to ask how you feel about modified local dishes, like the Pizza Tropicale I just ordered.
Cueto: Hey! You! Watch it. That thing you just mentioned. IS. NOT. A. REAL. PIZZA!
Cueto: It's a demon that nearly destroyed Ragunna, a Threnodian trying to wipe out our culinary culture.
Ulma: Is it really that serious? But it looks just like any other pizza...
Cueto: We Ragunnesi would never consider Pizza Tropicale to be a real pizza! It's just a fruit tart that looks like a pizza!
Cueto: We're asking the Order to differentiate traditional pizza from this import in writing and pronunciation.
Ulma: That's a bit over the top...
Cueto: Over the top? Tell me, where are you from?
Ulma: Me? I'm originally from Huanglong.
Cueto: What would you think if someone tossed canned fruit into Jinzhou stew?
Ulma: Oh my god, yuck! Okay, I see your point.

title: Umberto
content: Umberto is a NPC in  who only appears during Cloudy or Rainy weather during the day until 16:00.

title: Umberto
content:
Umberto: The rainy season in Ragunna seems to drag on longer every year... Ugh, how much longer do I have to sort through these soaked goods?

Umberto: Are you looking to buy something? Ugh, look at me, getting ahead of myself! No one's going to want these now that they look like garbage.

[Dialogue Option]   Is this because of the rainy season?

Umberto: Yeah. But you haven't seen the worst. There was a year when the rising seawater flooded the main streets of the city, nearly up to my waist.

Umberto: Many Gondolas got stuck in the streets, and we spent two sleepless nights trying to salvage the soaked goods.

[Dialogue Option]   Did you not receive any help?

Umberto: Of course, we did.

Umberto: Surprisingly, the Order and the nobles sent out a fleet of Gondolas to rescue those in the lowlands, taking them to higher ground in the Order and Fisalia district for shelter.

title: Umberto
content:
Umberto: That was the first time I saw the usually quiet Fisalia district so lively. Even though they acted all high and mighty, they still did their best to help.

[Dialogue Option]   So that's how they are.

Umberto: Yeah, after that, I realized that some people from Fisalia can seem tough on the outside but are actually kind-hearted. They're not as malicious as we often think.

title: Umberto
content:
[Objective: (Night)]
Umberto: Hmph, easy for you to say from a distance...

Umberto: “Why don't you follow my example and move your goods to a Gondola?”

Umberto: And then, "I've lived my whole life, never seen a Ragunna native get seasick!"

Umberto: Bah! Bah! Go to blazes, Sergio!

title: Uncle Dong
content:
[Objective: (Day)]
Uncle Dong: You guys just don't know what makes a good play!
Uncle Dong: Back in my day, those actors were real gluttons for hard work. And that makes them great performers.

title: Uncle Dong
content:
[Objective: (Night)]
Uncle Dong: Hero Play it's about the story of responsibility, honor, loss and gain.
Uncle Dong: Honor and responsibility can easily be confused while burdens may as well bring applause.
Uncle Dong: Actors should be able to distinguish the difference, or they fail to play as a hero.
Uncle Dong: The Hero Play isn't just for us old folks, it's for the kids too. How many kids started dreaming of becoming heroes after watching Hero Play?
Uncle Dong: So, the performers will do their job while we should devote all our heart to the watching.
Uncle Dong: After all, life's a stage, and all the men and women are mere players...

title: Uncle Dong
content:
[Objective: (First interaction)]
Uncle Dong: ...Let's see, we've got 21 fireworks and the full moon on the 15th. Together, that makes 36! Six times six! Such a lucky number!
Uncle Dong: A good omen for a lucky life!
[Dialogue Option]  ... I don't understand a word you're saying.

Uncle Dong: A good draw will bring you luck and fortune.
[Dialogue Option]  What if I get a bad one?
Uncle Dong: Just laugh it off! It's only a divination, no big deal.
Uncle Dong: Besides, with the Sentinel's blessings on this special day, how could you possibly get a bad draw?
[Dialogue Option]  ... Don't tell me they're all good draws.
Uncle Dong: Well, well, if you say it out loud, the luck might not work.

title: Uncle Fu
content:
He was the former Mayor of Hongzhen, a city in Mt. Firmament, prior to Xinyi. At one hundred years old, he is said to be the oldest person in Mt. Firmament.

He owned the Scale of Memories before giving it to Rover.

title: Uncle Gao
content:
Uncle Gao: *sigh* Ruiyun, you're just a girl. What's joining the Rangers got anything to do with you?
Uncle Gao: What if something happens to you? Then there'd be nothing but this old man left in this family.
Uncle Gao: Oh, you wouldn't believe the amount of strings I had to pull to get her a place in the city patrol.
Uncle Gao: Do you have any idea how many people are out there right now who want to be in her shoes? Tsk, she should be glad she got the job!
Uncle Gao: If she finds out that I was the one who kept her from going to the frontlines, oh boy, she'd probably make a huge fuss over it... *sigh*.

title: Uncle Gao
content:
Uncle Gao: How's work been lately? No one said anything strange to you, did they?
Ruiyun: Say something strange? Why would anyone do that?
Uncle Gao: Nothing, it's nothing.
Ruiyun: Dad, I feel like you've been acting a bit weird ever since I started my job.
Uncle Gao: Hey, don't you be getting any of that occupational hazard or whatever they call it, all right? You're starting to look at everyone the wrong way.
Ruiyun: Are you getting lonely while I'm gone? Do you want me to find someone to keep you company?
Uncle Gao: What? What do you mean lonely? I'm just worried about my daughter!
Ruiyun: Oh, come on, Dad... I'm an adult now. I can take care of myself, okay?
Uncle Gao: Oh, no, you're not. You'll always be a child in your father's eyes.

title: Uncle Li
content:
Uncle Li is an NPC in .

He is located to the far right of Panhua's Restaurant in Jinzhou, behind a table with four customers. You can only see him at daytime.

Players can learn the recipe for Clear Soup by interacting with him.

During the event By Moon's Grace, Uncle Li is a shop NPC in Taoyuan Vale for Yumyum Haven.

title: Uncle Li
content:
Uncle Li: Oh my! Young man, you look worn from travel. Are you here to eat, or heading somewhere else?
[Dialogue Option]  Gourmet Rumors
Uncle Li: Second-rate cooks might make a broth that tastes good on first sip, but lacks richness of flavor after a while.
Uncle Li: Don't underestimate that pinch of sugar. It makes all the difference in the taste and depth of flavor!
Uncle Li: That's why you asked me. I don't share this with just anyone.
[Dialogue Option]  Chat
Uncle Li: As someone who's dined at many restaurants, I can say Panhua's Restaurant is the best!
Uncle Li: Just look at this food, taste it! If I could, I'd eat here every day!
[Dialogue Option]  Leave

title: Uncle Li
content:
[Objective: (First interaction)]
[Dialogue Option]  Chat
Uncle Li: ...Peel the shring, leave the tails, coat them all with bean flour... Once that's done, arrange them in the shape of a fan...

content: Uncle Wei is a weapon forger NPC located in . He has a wife and son.

title: Uncle Wei
content:
Uncle Wei: I repair and make Tacetite Weapons here. Everyone likes to call me Uncle Wei.
[Dialogue Option]  I want to rearm.
[Dialogue Option]  Gourmet Rumors

[Dialogue Option]  Do you know how to make the marinade?
Uncle Wei: ...

[Dialogue Option]  ...Apologies for the inconvenience.
Uncle Wei: Wait, hold on, I never said I didn't know.

title: Uncle Wei
content:
Uncle Wei: She says it makes everything taste meaty, and our son loves it... hmm.
[Dialogue Option]  Leave



Uncle Wei: That weapon on you seems well maintained. You must be a Resonator.
[Dialogue Option]  Indeed, I am.
Uncle Wei: Yeah, I can tell. You're holding a Tacetite Weapon, after all.
Uncle Wei: You've probably used it countless times by now, but I'm sure you're not familiar with how it's made.
Uncle Wei: The more you understand, the handier it will be. If you're curious about Tacetite weapons, feel free to ask me anything.
[Dialogue Option]  What are Tacetite Weapons?
Uncle Wei: Tacetite Weapons are designed for Resonators to combat Tacet Discords.
Uncle Wei: These weapons are adaptable in form and size for different needs. They're all essentially the same thing.
[Dialogue Option]  Tell me about different types of Tacetite Weapons.
Uncle Wei: There are five main types of Tacetite Weapons. Pistols, Gauntlets, Rectifiers, Swords, and Broadblades.
Uncle Wei: Which one piques your interest?
[Dialogue Option]  Pistols.
Uncle Wei: Pistols are compact firearms that use Resonance Energy to create powerful bullet projectiles.
Uncle Wei: The amount of energy used determines the bullets' effects. You'll understand once you try it yourself.
Uncle Wei: Compared to traditional guns, these Tacetite pistols have low recoil and do not require frequent reloading. Perfect for ranged combat.
[Dialogue Option]  Gauntlets.
Uncle Wei: Gauntlets are arm-mounted combat gear, commonly worn as gloves or vambraces.
Uncle Wei: With a limited range, their design priortizes both offense and defense capabilities.
Uncle Wei: This makes them highly selective in terms of material and the physical abilities of their wielders.
[Dialogue Option]  Rectifiers.
Uncle Wei: Rectifiers capture and amplify specific frequencies. I'd say they work more like musical instruments.
Uncle Wei: While not as lethal, they have the strongest amplification effect on Resonance Abilities, or Fortes as we call it.
Uncle Wei: Additionally, Rectifiers can scan and interfere with the unique frequencies of Tacet Discords. As a type of Tacetite Weapon, Rectifiers test the user's skills.
[Dialogue Option]  Swords.
Uncle Wei: Swords are a stable weapon for Resonators like you, with their balanced and agile design.
Uncle Wei: They're versatile and efficient in combat, making them a popular choice for dealing with different enemies.
Uncle Wei: That being said. Swords are also the hardest to master among of all Tacetite Weapons. They may seem simple, but there's more to them than meets the eye.
[Dialogue Option]  Broadblades.
Uncle Wei: Need a weapon to take down tough Tacet Discords? Then the Broadblade is your choice. It does a lot of damage.
[Dialogue Option]

content: Valentina is an NPC in Tethys Hub, The Black Shores. She is a Bloom Bearer and the remote commander of the organization's emergency response team, a combat unit sent by the Black Shores to deal with the Waveworn phenomenon.

title: Valentina
content: Infinite Battle Simulation (Quest) (October 24, 2024-November 13, 2024)

title: Valentina
content:
[Objective: (Day)]
Valentina: You have 48 hours to assist the locals and evacuate everyone to the designated safe zones before the Lament strikes.
Valentina: The disaster relief will last for one week. After that, I'll issue new orders based on the situation.
Valentina: Report any unexpected events immediately. No unauthorized actions or disobedience will be tolerated within the emergency response team.
Emergency Response Team Member: Yes, Madam.
[Dialogue Option]  What's an emergency response team?
Valentina: It seems you're not familiar with our team. While I wait for my next communication, let me give you a quick briefing.
Valentina: I'm Valentina, the remote commander of the emergency response team. This is a combat unit sent by the Black Shores to deal with the Waveworn phenomenon.
Valentina: Every member here has been rigorously trained and selected.
Valentina: They're the backbone of the Black Shores, each with extensive experience in handling TDs and rescues.
Valentina: Final preparations are underway. This team will deploy shortly.
Emergency Response Team Member: Don't you worry about us, Commander! You know we've got this. We'll be back with a victory, no question about it.
Valentina: ...This is not the time for jokes. Stay focused.

title: Valentina
content:
[Objective: (Night)]
Valentina is communicating with the dispatched members of the emergency response team.
Valentina: The TD Outbreak will hit your position in 30 minutes. There's almost no time left for a rescue operation.
Valentina: ...
Valentina: Yes, your assessment is accurate.
Valentina: You've never been wrong, Yuri. That's why I've always trusted your judgment.
Valentina: I've never regretted the decisions I've made, and I hope this one won't be an exception.

title: Valerius
content: Valerius is the surveyor at the Echo Depository in Averardo Vault. He is fascinated by Echoes, unlike his co-worker, Aurelius.

title: Valerius
content:
Valerius: Same as always today. No irregularities in the Echoes' frequencies.
[Dialogue Option] : Hello. What are you doing?
Valerius: Greetings, my name is Valerius. I am the surveyor here at the Echo Depository.
Valerius: This area of the depository uses cutting-edge technology developed by the Montelli family. Echoes are secured on mountings, allowing them to be preserved without requiring dedicated Terminals.
Valerius: That said, it's still new technology. We still need to be monitoring their resting frequencies around the clock so any anomalies can be dealt with swiftly.
[Dialogue Option] : Hold on, you're saying...
[Dialogue Option] : These Echoes could hypothetically escape?
Valerius: Haha, well, from what I know of the Montellis, the chances of that happening are about as likely as the entire population of Ragunna suddenly developing a taste for Pizza Tropicale!
Valerius: Still, imagine if all these magnificent specimens―frozen in place―suddenly came to life. Now that would be a sight to see.
Valerius: Many of the Echoes here are types I could never hope to see in my lifetime. Some of them are extinct, officially declared as such by the outside world.
Valerius: To witness them move, even once... That's all I could ever ask for as a researcher in the field of Echoes.

title: Verina
Verina
content: With an extensive knowledge of botany, Verina is always solicitous, always smiling, and always wishing for every flower to be blessed with the miracle of life.s ends up taking on caretaker duties in any expedition, showing remarkable tenacity for her age.

title: Verina/Backstory
Verina/Backstory
content:
love flowers.

During tense battles, the military often requested extra bouquets with their supplies. These orders would end up in Verina's hands, which felt strange at first.

The bouquets bloomed for only a short time. Those picked today would wilt tomorrow. A bouquet that blooms in a greenhouse may have withered petals by the time it makes it to its recipient. At this point, the flowers would have already lost most of their beauty in people's hands, so why the need for them?

Until one day, she read the wishes attached to one of the orders.

"In honor of my comrade in arms. He gave his life for the peace of Jinzhou, yet his name is not known to many. Yet I still remember his heartfelt smile when he received an Iris from a friend long ago. If one's name cannot be remembered, let the meanings of these flowers honor him forever."

That night, Verina locked herself in the greenhouse.

title: Verina/Backstory
content:
That night, Verina locked herself in the greenhouse.



Flowers are adored for their intricate leaf patterns, but it's the fleeting feelings they evoke that truly captivate us. Verina carefully selected and cultivated the finest seeds, preserving those precious emotions in her garden.

She longed to preserve the stories and emotions associated with each bouquet, wishing for them to last beyond their natural lifespan. She hoped that by doing so, recipients would experience the true essence and beauty of the flowers, igniting a deeper connection to the emotions they held within.

It was at these times that Verina wished she could work a little harder and a little longer.
|mention2      =

title: Verina/Backstory
content:
It was at these times that Verina wished she could work a little harder and a little longer.
|mention2      =



|title3        = Noting the Differences
|text3         = People always ask Verina why she loves plants so much. It’s a question that Verina has answered countless times, but she knows that people will always start off the conversations with question after question, so each time she would give out her well-thought-out answer: “When I was little, my mom would place two pieces of leaves in my hand and ask me what the differences were between them.

I would reply, ‘Aren’t they exactly the same? They came from the same tree.’

And Mom would shake her head, ‘Look closely, Verina.’

title: Verina/Backstory
content:
I would reply, ‘Aren’t they exactly the same? They came from the same tree.’

And Mom would shake her head, ‘Look closely, Verina.’



So I gave them a closer look, and then I realized that even though they looked the same on the outside, their veins spread out in varying directions. They drew completely different patterns.”

This changed Verina’s perspective entirely, the differences which she had never noticed nor cared about in the past were now displaying right before her eyes.

Some flowers may look similar but grow in completely different environments. Some trees or plants may grow in near identical environments but end up taking on various shapes.

title: Verina/Backstory
content:
Verina was captivated by the similarities and differences among plants, spurring her passion for botany. She meticulously studied their traits to help them thrive in different environments and cultivate stunning flowers. Through this, she also began to notice the unique qualities of those around her. Just as every leaf is distinct, so are people and experiences. Verina observes her friends closely, noting their preferences and sorrows with care.

“For example, some people like to eat Lemongrass and some people don’t. It must feel nice to have someone remember their preferences.”

With this sentiment in mind, Verina carefully and conscientiously jotted down every little thing about her friends.
|mention3      = Verina's Mom

|title4        = Moments of Woe
|text4         = Being an ordinary girl, Verina has her moments of woe, too.

title: Verina/Backstory
content:
|mention3      = Verina's Mom

|title4        = Moments of Woe
|text4         = Being an ordinary girl, Verina has her moments of woe, too.



Plant cultivation can be unpredictable. Often, Verina would wake up to find dried seedpods in the petri dish after a night’s rest. And then after working tirelessly all day, she would realize she had skipped her lunch again. In these moments, she missed her parents dearly.

“If Mom and Dad were still around, I wouldn’t have to worry about all this...” Verina thought. A hot, hearty lunch would be right there waiting for her as she walked in the door, and she would get all the help she needed in time whenever she wanted to figure something out. But all of that had long since become a memory, left in the notes that she had lost when she departed the New Federation a long time ago.

title: Verina/Backstory
content:
Now she would have to pull herself together and live on her own.

Sometimes, she wondered: Is there any meaning to all the work I’ve done? Is there any meaning in the life I’m living?

But then, she would always find the answer in her thriving plants.

Despite the struggle, the dry seedpods continued to produce new life and their growth whispered tales of perseverance and joy into her ears. As she nestled herself in this green oasis, Verina could hear the plants sharing their stories of pain and triumph, reminding her of the beauty of growth and blooming.

Perhaps this was the meaning of her endeavors. Verina thought as she stood up and put on her gardening gloves again.

Even if her parents aren’t by her side, she is still determined to keep working hard and show them how much she’s grown.

title: Verina/Backstory
content:
Even if her parents aren’t by her side, she is still determined to keep working hard and show them how much she’s grown.



After a brief moment of sorrow, she picked up the spray can and carried on with her day’s work.
|mention4      = Verina's Mom,Verina's Dad

|title5        = A little Time Off
|text5         = Verina would give herself some time off from time to time.

Verina set the flower room temperature and watering schedule. As she finished, she exhaled in relief.

After days of work, she knew the importance of taking a break for both herself and her plants. She cleared her mind and grabbed her adventure notes to explore the streets of .

title: Verina/Backstory
content:
Jinzhou was a far cry from her hometown in the New Federation. No inflated flower prices or elaborate competitions here. As she strolled through the bustling alleyways, Verina was struck with a sense of genuine relief. The steam rising from vendors’ stalls and the busy shoppers around her brought a comforting normalcy to this new city.

This is good, this is good. As she walked along the road, Verina thought to herself. Memories flooded her mind of studying plants with her parents, and the painful loneliness she felt after their absence. But now, standing on her own two feet, she could finally treat herself to a peaceful vacation. After what felt like an eternity of walking alone, she had grown into her own person.

title: Verina/Backstory
content:
And then she saw her friends waving to her: Chixia and Yangyang were walking towards her with freshly purchased Salted Milk Tea in their hands. The  must be taking a little vacation as well. Verina hurriedly rummaged through her satchel, pulling out a few bouquets of tiny, star-like flowers from it.

This was the most precious gift Verina would ever give her friends. The selection had taken far, far too long, and while the  had waited for the best of times and sunshine, she had also waited for sunshine that would make her feel warm.

Now that she saw her sunshine, Verina ran toward her friends.

There was a long road ahead, and it would take some time for the flowers to bloom.

And for now, she is content to enjoy the vacation.
|mention5      = Verina's Mom,Verina's Dad,Chixia,Yangyang
}}

title: Vicki
content:
[Objective: (Aftermath of )]
Vicki: Tethys, I require... the list of all Bloom Bearers involved in this mission.
Tethys System: This system is terribly sorry to inform you that all twelve Bloom Bearers in this mission have lost vital signs.

title: Vida
content: Marcello is an NPC in . She is the owner of Stillwind Sundries, which is unlocked by the Tutorial Quest: When Colors Fade.

title: Vida
content:
[Objective: (First Interaction)]
Vida: You're here at last! I was just wondering how much longer I'd have to wait.
[Dialogue Option]  Why did you suddenly reach out to me?
Vida: Because... 'Here's to a world of discoveries and wonders.'
Abby: Hmm, sounds familiar. Isn't that the slogan of the Pioneer Association?
[Dialogue Option]  Are you with the Pioneer Association?
Vida: I used to be. Back when I was a traveling merchant, I also worked briefly as a contract photographer for the Pioneer Association, capturing landscapes along the trade routes to earn some travel expenses.
Vida: Now... as you can see, those strange phenomena have drained the color from many places, making it harder to capture great photos. I've settled down and opened my own shop, so I haven't renewed my contract.
Vida: But deep down, I am still unable to move past the faded landscapes.
[Dialogue Option]  Do you want me to restore those areas?
Vida: Always feels like a breeze to chat with a sharp mind like yours. That is exactly why I got your contact from a former colleague. After all, no one wants the places in their memories to be covered in dull patches, right?
Vida: If we can only see those familiar landscapes in photos from now on... it's a depressing thought, isn't it?
[Dialogue Option]  Let's talk terms first.
[Dialogue Option]  How about a little something to sweeten the deal?
Vida: Certainly, I wouldn't expect you to help for free. The Faded Zones often hold abundant mineral deposits and resources. But they can't be accessed due to the influence of the Overflowing Palettes.
Vida: Restoring the zones will not only bring back the colors but also the resources. You can trade them with me for some... rare items on the market.
Abby: Sounds like this is her true intention...
Vida: As a merchant, it's my fundamental skill. So, what do you think? Those goods and offers are exclusively for partners.
[Dialogue Option]  Understood, let's seal the deal.
Vida: Alright, take a look at what's on the shelves. The resources are just what you need right now.

title: Vida
content:
Vida: Alright, take a look at what's on the shelves. The resources are just what you need right now.



[Dialogue Option]  Stillwind Sundries
;(Opens shop)
[Dialogue Option]  Chat
Vida: Rover, Welcome! Would you like to see what's on the shelves?
[Dialogue Option]  Where did these rare items come from?
Vida: I used to travel across different regions of Rinascita and built numerous business connections. Many of my goods come through their channels.
Vida: Some items, however, have yet to hit the market for various reasons, such as master chef's secret recipes or practical medicine crafted by local artisans...
[Dialogue Option]  Isn't that... a kind of black market?
Vida: Hah, don't worry. Feel free to use whatever you buy here. No one's going to cause you any trouble. And even if they do... I'm sure you can handle it, right?
[Dialogue Option]  Ask about the special shop in Ragunna.
Vida: Ragunna has a shop called "Rosemary's Apothecary." Perhaps you've visited it already. Its owner, Miss Rosemary, is an odd client of mine. I wonder if you've noticed—
Vida: She sometimes acts like a different person.
[Dialogue Option]  I'm good now.
Vida: Some of the items on the shelves are limited in supply, but they will be restocked periodically. Be sure to check back often!

title: Villeneuve
content:
[Dialogue Option]  Where is this place?
Villeneuve: It is the end of simulated civilizations, where the stars quietly fade away.
[Dialogue Option]  Why do the stars fade?
Villeneuve: The Tethys System once dedicated its entire computational capacity to simulating the civilization development within Stellar Matrices.
Villeneuve: It generated numerous potential futures based on various decisions to predict the impact of critical choices on the trajectory of a civilization.
Villeneuve: Nonetheless, these simulated futures within the Stellar Matrices were either doomed to collapse or became breeding grounds for errors.
[Dialogue Option]  What if we introduce a new variable?
Villeneuve: A new variable brings the potential for an unknown future.
Villeneuve: It could be a force of change, or simply nothing.
Villeneuve: You alone hold the answer, don't you? Hee hee hee...
[Dialogue Option]  Who are you?
Villeneuve: This dream continues... Good night... Hmm... Eh...
[Dialogue Option]  ...
Villeneuve: Ah... I feel dizzy. What is this? A nightmare? Wait, who are you? When did you...
Villeneuve: Oh, I remember you! You're the Bloom Bearer who guided us through the crisis!
Villeneuve: Nice to meet you. I'm Villeneuve. Do you need any help?
[Dialogue Option]  Nothing. Just taking a walk here.
[Dialogue Option]  You're the one who may need some help.
