title: Void Storm
content: Void Storms are a form of Waveworn Phenomenon native to Lahai-Roi, caused by the Threnodian, Aleph-1. Void Storm activity can make local frequencies unstable with fluctuating Voidmatter Levels.

title: Void Storm
content: Void Storms erupt when Voidmatter concentrations reach a critical threshold, causing widespread destruction within a cyclical range that disrupts the frequencies around it before those affected by it find their existence fading away from both the physical world and the memories of others. This Waveworn Phenomenon is linked to the existence of Aleph-1, that currently remains sealed, but continues to influence Lahai-Roi behind the Stridergate where it is sealed.

title: Void Storm
content:
Coming in cycles, or perhaps being irregular, Void Storms appear when they do and disintegrate the frequency of those living until they cease to be, being considered natural disasters for those caught up in it. Though, there are some exceptions, such as Bjartr Woods, one of the rare locations untouched by the ravages of Void Storms, or Sundermere, repelling the Void Storms which in turn also causes the Voidworm to stay clear of the area. Although, in spite of Void Storms being dangerous through it's erasure properties, the phenomenon is equally corrupting as it can make Tacet Discords highly unstable and turn humans like Clemente into Tacet Discords (Nameless Explorer) through Voidmatter contamination.

Before one strikes an atmospheric light known as the Shimmer typically appears, serving as an early warning to the residents before a Void Storm appears.

title: Void Storm
content: The Void Storms are a reoccurring phenomenon that endangers the land of Lahai-Roi through it's ability to erase the existence from others through contact itself. The most basic fact known in Lahai-Roi is that those consumed by the Void Storm will lose their existence until it’s forgotten entirely. This is because any living being caught within are fatally affected, losing all vitality. This is not biological death, but a dissolution of frequency itself. Form unraveling as bodies fade, becoming translucent, then silent, until they dissolve into nothing. Those who survive initial exposure find their frequency flickering like dying candlelight... until they, too, vanish from this world. If a Cassette makes it out, a record of their existence is verified. But if there are those who vanish without a Cassete Tape on them before a Void Storm, then even the fact that they died is erased, where across Lahai-Roi, or perhaps beyond, everyone have their memories altered in a way that victims consumed by the Void Storms (or a location with enough Voidmatter) are slowly forgotten by others until the memories of forgetting itself are wiped away. Aemeath is a known exception who is immune to the memory erasure as she is considered a deceased being, allowing her to recall old memories.

title: Void Storm
content: Void Storms can corrupt Exoswarm, contaminating them, making them aggressive and attack others, including their own kind whist being inclined to listen to the Outcasts too a degree. Other machines such as Hyvata Detector can also be compromised and become rogue due to the Exoswarm contaminated by the Void Storm turning those afflicted by Voidmatter becoming Tacet Discords that attack ordinary Exoswarm.

title: Void Storm
content: This is caused by the internal system of the Exoswarm material being eroded by Voidmatter, which can cause malfunctions in the machines utilizing the parts. Students are taught this so that if they ever enact experiments, to only do so in a controlled environment since such contaminated material makes the machines inherently unstable. For safety reasons, units affected by this must be shut down where the user can clean the contaminated parts. Soliskin can also be afflicted by the Void Storm's corruption, turning them purple. Beyond the change in color, however, it is unknown how the Soliskin are affected exactly unless they are purified.

title: Void Storm
content: The Void Storm also has the possibility of displacing others caught in its power instead of consuming them, with one example being that enough Voidmatter concentration can allow the possibility of entering Voidspace. Although, for unknown reasons both Chisa and Sumika, instead of being erased upon being consumed by a Void Storm, instead found themselves trapped in Honami City alongside an assortment of items from Lahai-Roi, unable to escape. It is unclear on why this occurred, with no explanation if there was an external factor for this unusual displacement. At the same time, after the loops ended in Honami City, a rift opened up that allowed the Rover to enter the Lahai-Roi region after precautions were made in establishing coordinates. Though, it did hold dangers as the Rover was nearly consumed by Aleph-1, who had seemingly been waiting to consume them in the portal. It's possible this may have been the doing of Aleph-1, but is unconfirmed.

title: Void Storm
content: According to Hiyuki, she claims that beyond humans, structures devoured by Aleph-1 may drift off as they don't hold its interest, which causes some structures once consumed to land in Dimmr Plains.

title: Void Storm
content: Due to the inherit dangers of the Void Storm, precautions have been made in a variety of manners.

title: Void Storm
content: One of the most known defenses created by the institute in Lahai-Roi is the Cassete itself. Described as a ID and safety device, the Cassette is a very essential item in Lahai-Roi. They store the frequencies and memories of their user, made up of specialized equipment to defend against the Void Storms which disintegrate the frequency of any living beings. This is all so that the user’s “existence” is safeguarded and fully preserved so that those who may have been lost to the Void Storms will have some semblance of their existence known than forgotten, where they are kept safe at the Spacetrek Collective area.

title: Void Storm
content: There's also the Rabelle Cassette, an identity authentication device issued by the Spacetrek Collective, serving as mandatory safety gear for navigating Lahai-Roi. All first-year students must complete the Cassette’s burning and registration under faculty supervision at the Research Institute before venturing beyond the Academy’s protected zones. Once a Cassette is burned, it means the users frequencies have been copied and transcribed into it and simply needs calibrating before being put to survive. Identical codes can sometimes cause a conflict during transcribing, but are usually handled smoothly.

title: Void Storm
content: There's also the Frequency Cassette Recorder. A standard Terminal for the Spacetrek Collective members, designed to hold the Rabelle Cassette. Its casing is constructed from a special composite that mimics the Exostrider’s engineering, granting partial resistance to Void Storms. However, without adequate precautions, it won’t fully protect a user from the Void Storm’s effects, where many surveyors and students have had their frequencies erased this way. While some cassette's could survive, they become what Arsenio calls "Tapes of Last Words". Despite being made to resist the Void Storm’s erasure properties, if not erased the cassettes can be corrupted with the data disrupted, contaminated with Voidmatter. Only through Arsenio's abilities can the date be regained through cleaning the contamination, restoring the frequencies within properly.

title: Void Storm
content: For more protective infrastructure, large barriers are made, such as Startorch Academy being granted a defensive barrier for the Void Storm as a defense protocol. In the academy Petrova and Halvad discuss how the Institute has developed the Antivoid Canopy by using cultivated Exostrider coating cells to resist Void Storms. By first isolating the cells from the Exostrider, developers guide and differentiate them into a massive protective mesh, which is a triumph of the Phase-Coating Sciences. Though, unlike the Exostrider’s own surface, whose cells maintain a dynamic equilibrium, thus resisting contamination and regenerate continuously, the Antivoid Canopy cannot perfectly replicate this trait. Once wear sets in, developers must manually apply newly cultivated coating cells. Though the institute believes that they can reach the same perfection as the original one day if they keep moving forward.

title: Void Storm
content: Thanks to this unique protection, it it set as a standard protective measure for Spacetrek Collective camps, research outposts, transit hubs, and more with the academy having the largest installation.

title: Void Storm
content: The Reactor Husk is a self-defense mechanism of the Reactor Drive itself, which is on alert from any activities made by Aleph-1. When the Drive's immune response is triggered, a mechanized "Reactor Husk" will arise from the depths of the energy well, with the sole purpose of eliminating intruders at all costs while absorbing Voidmatter to ensure the Reactor Drive's own stability, lest it be corrupted. Research by Spacetrek Collective shows that Reactor Husk was once part of the Exostrider. Both share a mission to resist the Threnodian threat and safeguard civilization.

title: Void Storm
content: The spread of Voidmatter can also affect the surface of the Roya Frostlands through Fluctuating Voidmatter Levels, being a unique phenomenon found in the surface. Scholars theorize that this anomaly emerged when the Threnodian’s power there attempted to devour the Exostrider, which triggering abnormal Voidmatter transformations. Affected objects enter a state of unstable “existence”, becoming impossible to observe directly.

title: Void Storm
content:
This is turn causes the need of the Module Adapter. a specialized device developed by the Spacetrek Collective for research operations in the Roya Frostlands. It forces entities with fluctuating Voidmatter levels back into the observable state for practical use. In areas with stable signal coverage, the device can be deployed directly to the user’s location. These devices detect frequencies disrupted by Voidmatter and manifests them as Adaptive Modules, allowing one to interact with frequencies disrupted by Voidmatter.

This will allow the Unstable Frequency Core, which the Module Adapter is used for shoot the Unstable Frequency Core or Unstable Barriers to switch those afflicted by the Voidmatter into the two states where that affected by the weapon become both tangible and intangible state.

title: Void Storm
content: Voidspace is a higher-dimension that resides within Aleph-1. The realm is described as a pitch-black kaleidoscope where all that Aleph-1 has consumed now exists within this location, where time and space are in a chaotic state.  High-density Voidmatter is required for one to enter the location, which is described by Aemeath as a severe Void Storm manifesting and a portal into Voidspace itself. However, humanity is unable to enter the space as any living entity entering this domain suffers a rapid loss of frequency, eventually leading to the total dissolution of their existence.

title: Void Storm
content: Voidworms are creatures born under the influence of Aleph-1 and the Void Storm itself. Created by the Threnodian's power through the Exoswarm material gathered and used, these creatures act as agents of the Threnodian in causing harm across the Lahai-Roi region itself. Similar to the Void Storm itself, the Voidworm is a calamity that cannot be predicted and is seen as a threat where even in their defeat, a Void Storm can allow it to function once again.

title: Void Storm
content: Voidcreeps are flowers that release Voidmatter to erode the surrounding environment, hazardous to the player and restrict movement, found in Dimmr Plains.

title: Void Storm
content:
To create chaos without being seen, Warren created unsettling devices that releases an unsettling aura that causes the creation of an artificial Void Storm. Through his knowledge, Warren managed to store and amplifies a tiny slice of the Voidworm Frequency, which can cause malfunctions or corrupt technology designed from Exostrider Tech lose control  the device capable of being activated remotely.

Upon activation, the device becomes the epicenter to spread Voidmatter across Lahai-Roi, causing great harm. More than that, Void Storms created using this method cannot be predicted by the Heliodic Six, making the devices dangerous and unpredictable in the wrong hands. These devices can also lure, unintentionally, a Voidworm, which the Rover and Lynae used as bait to draw the Voidworm away from the academy.

title: Voidspace
content: Voidspace is a dimension that exists inside Aleph-1. It is an abstract realm that exists beyond linear causality and the laws of time and space, where anything that had been consumed by Aleph-1 now permanently resides within the space itself. This realm is explored by Aemeath, who explains what lays within the dimension.

title: Voidspace
content: Voidspace is a dimension that resides within the Threnodian, and was unknown to humanity until it appeared on Solaris-3. However, it is inaccessible to humanity at the moment. This is primarily because for one to enter Voidspace, a high-concentration of Voidmatter is required. Aemeath describes the greater depths of Voidmatter as a severe Void Storm manifesting and a portal into Voidspace itself—a higher dimensional plane. However, it's because the Voidmatter concentration is too high, humanity is unable to enter the realm as Voidmatter indiscriminately dissolves all matter and existence within its range.

title: Voidspace
content: Just falling into Voidspace can cause one to be consumed, erased from existence. Any probes that had been sent previously cannot enter the depths of Voidmatter in higher concentration, leaving research on the substance scarce. Only Aemeath reached it because she was already dead, as no living soul can withstand a place like Voidspace.

title: Voidspace
content: By her description, upon exploring the dimension, the realm is essentially a graveyard of civilizations Aleph-1 already ended. Time is chaotic with the addition of space being warped in Voidspace, where anything lost inside can exist in multiple moments at once. Things caught in the realm can be thrown into junctures of time they were never part of.  Within the space itself everything is pitch-black, but like a kaleidoscope, where inside, time and space aren’t linear. Everything is warped where things the Threnodian devoured from different eras can be sitting right next to each other due to the laws of time and space being disconnected from normal physics.  Although, because of this unique trait, Aemeath discovered that if the conditions are met, one can initiate time-travel within the realm itself. Though, it should be mentioned that attempting this is difficult and very dangerous.

title: Voidspace
content: Aemeath, when attempting to finalize the time-loop she was a part of, could feel her body breaking down despite previously stating that Voidmatter cannot touch her, suggesting that the Voidmatter concentration is high enough that her own soul was at risk of collapsing, forcing her to Overclock to succeed.

title: Voidspace
content: However, anything that finds itself within Voidspace doesn't fade away immediately. Numerous Roya and Spacetrek Collective members who were devoured claim they can feel other individuals presence, but cannot see them nor hear, though thoughts replace sound. Many eventually faded, though during the crisis upon Aleph-1's attempt in entering Solaris-3, the devoured humans managed to create coordinates within Voidspace by working together despite the impossibility of such an act by coordinating and passing on their work towards those within until they succeeded and gave Aemeath the required knowledge for her to pass onto Rover so they and both the Roya and Spacetrek Collective may translate and decode the coordinates to locate the Exostrider to defeat Aleph-1.

title: Voidspace
content: With the defeat and banishment of Aleph-1, entering Voidspace has become nigh-impossible now with current methods; Arman claims however the future is yet unknown with the potential to one day access Voidspace despite Aleph-1's banishment.

title: Voidwing Moth
content: to .  When the Voidwing Moth recovers from Immobilization, it cycles between the Wings Spread, Wings Folded, and Curled Up states. While in the Wings Spread state, its Vibration Strength reduces faster. While in the Wings Folded State, it takes less Vibration Strength reduction, and 30% less total DMG. While in the Curled Up state, it takes 50% more total DMG.  A unique TD endemic to the Dimmr Plains, often seen in areas heavily contaminated by Voidmatter. it assumes a moth-like form with wings that shed Voidmatter particles. Moving with instinct under the influence of Voidmatter, these creatures were once the vanguard of Aleph-1's incursion. Though naturally passive, it will stop at nothing to annihilate its target once aggravated.|Description when discovered}}

title: Voidworm
content: Voidworm are higher-dimensional beings originating from Aleph-1, which shaped its body with Exoswarm devoured by the Void Storm and forged its spine with the Exostrider remnants. To the inhabitants of Lahai-Roi, Voidworm and Voids Storms are equally terrifying. Both are unpredictable natural disasters that devour everything in their path. During the lulls between Storms, it primarily inhabits the  of the Mawburrow Desert.

title: Voidworm
content:
The Voidworm is a being created from the Exoswarm components, reshaped by the Threnodian's power, reconstitute into the dreadful forms known as Voidworms. To Lahai-Roi, the Voidworm is an amalgamated horror that often emerges alongside Void Storms; wherever it passes, life is extinguished, leaving only the void in its wake. Normally, it resides in Mawburrow Dessert due to the environment containing a high concentration of Voidmatter, usually staring their in lull between Void Storm.

In general, the creatures usually stay clear of the institute (Spacetrek Collective) due to the Exostrider's Greatsword in Sundermere repelling the Void Storms At the same time, the Institute has developed anti-Voidworm defense, such as the three Defense Arrays that once activated, must be calibrated for all three until they sync and trigger the Voidworm's containment.

title: Voidworm
content: As an agent of Aleph-1, the Voidworm was designed and made with abilities similar to the Threnodian itself. Having the same capability of erasing one's existence where those caught will find themselves erased from the world with none having any memories of those who fell victim to it, barring those who had Cassettes to verify their existence. Up until the Rover's arrival, Mornye states no one has ever survived having their frequency devoured by the Voidworm, and even upon escape an individual who loses their frequencies, even some, won’t recover what they lost unless the Voidworm is defeated.  The source of its power comes from the Voidmatter Regulators on its head which serve as both its power source and its weakness. Through the regulators, alongside its erasure ability, the Voidworm can fire numerous lasers that bend from either its mouth or across it's body and can also launch spherical energy orbs that chase after an enemy or settle on the ground, acting as a land-mine that explodes on contact.

title: Voidworm
content:
Due to its size and durability, defeating it in normal combat is ill-advised with specialized equipment needed to take it down or restrain it before battling it. One method in harming it is the gathering of the Voidmatter Orbs that spawn when the Voidmatter burrows and surfaces from the ground. They can be taken and used to charge and increase the Energy Pulse of the motorbike to empower the vehicle's weapons, firing a Photonic Beam when fully charged that can damage the Voidworm.

The Voidworm is also capable of tracking a target if needed through those whose frequencies it has devoured and locate them, as it does with the Rover. Although, it is suggested the Voidworm only contained the Rover's frequencies due to Aleph-1 transferring said frequencies into it, as it had never met the Rover before until their arrival in Lahai-Roi.

title: Voidworm
content: Voidworms spawn under the influence of Aleph-1’s energy, where so long as the Void Storm and the Threnodian exist, they can’t really be destroyed. The closest to stopping one from reviving is by recycling the Voidworm’s debris whenever one is destroyed, where by dismantling it the risk of a Void Storm engulfing it and resurrecting it will decrease. Otherwise, upon a Void Storm enveloping a deactivated Voidworm, it will reactivate and resume its normal duties.

title: Voidworm
content: By capturing the frequency of the Voidworm with high-precision and storing the data, a device that utilizes it can make itself the epicenter to spread Voidmatter, which creates an artificial Void Storm.

title: Wenmo (Mengzhou)
content:
[Dialogue Option]  What are you doing here?

Wenmo: Oh, I'm testing the motion coordination of these two Autopuppets. They just finished maintenance two days ago. Need to run them in again.

Wenmo: Hmm... I'm not seeing any major issues. A few more days, and they should be ready to hand over to the Ministry of War.

title: Wenshui
content:
Wenshu: Welcome to Wenshu Repair, we fix your broken things and broken backs. How may I be of help, sir?
[Dialogue Option]  About the routine maintenance.
Wenshu: The old neighbors around here consider me a "fix-it" guy when it comes to daily items. Although, I'm not sophisticated enough to repair high-end items.
Wenshu: As long as it's a day-to-day thing found around the house, I can always fix them when you come to me.
Wenshu: The elders are used to living in frugality and don't have a habit of throwing away things that are old or broken. That's why some out-dated electrical parts can only be found here.
Wenshu: Hey, I gradually grew attached while repairing these old gadgets. After all, we're all a bit nostalgic.
[Dialogue Option]  Who's that kid...?
Wenshu: Oh, you're speaking of Wenmo. He's my son. That boy always likes to be alone, tinkering with mechanical things.
Wenshu: He has been watching me repair these things since he was a child, and perhaps he has memorized the steps just by watching.
Wenshu: Sometimes, I have to read an instruction manual for some of the more complex items customers bring in, but he'd be able to understand and start dismantling the structure in a few minutes.
Wenshu: Once I caught him completely disassembling an item to its last gear. I panicked so hard as I thought there had been no way to restore it. But he put it back together in moments like it was brand new.
Wenshu: He also fixed those things. So, I let him do his things from then on. Later, he became increasingly more sophisticated with it.
Wenshu: Maybe one day he can become a great inventor. And I'll be known as the father of a great inventor.
[Dialogue Option]  About the repair shop.
Wenshu: This repair shop has also been on this street for many years. Maybe it's eligible to be a AAAA tourist destination in Jinzhou in another few decades.
Wenshu: Well, I'm not ashamed to crack this to you: I opened this shop because I had no talents. My late grandfather was once a prominent craftsman in the Ministry of Development.
Wenshu: I didn't match his talents and had to live under his halo as the grandson of the celebrity craftsman.
Wenshu: Like "If it's him, he can definitely do it...", but I can't be as perfect as my father.
Wenshu: Later, I left the Ministry of Development and opened this shop. Now I'm content with this life of fixing things for the folks of Jinzhou.
Wenshu: But the talent of Wenmo was as high as his grandfather's, and he may be able to accomplish what I have not done in the future.
Wenshu: I really hope to see that day.
[Dialogue Option]  Leave

content: Weyl is an NPC that sometimes appears in TD Observatory, Black Shores Archipelago during the daytime (06.00 AM - 05.59 PM). He works for both Black Shores and Lollo Logistics as a courier, handling package shipments to and from the organization.

title: Weyl
content:
Weyl: All the supplies are here. Now, what's next...

[Dialogue Option]  Lollo Logistics can even send packages to the Black Shores?
Weyl: Absolutely. Wherever our clients are, we make sure their packages get delivered safe and sound.
Weyl: I handle all the shipments to and from the Black Shores. If you have any issues with deliveries or transportation routes, just let me know anytime.
[Dialogue Option]  So that's how the Black Shores gets its supplies.

[Dialogue Option]  But how did you get onto this island?

[Dialogue Option]  ...That's not what I meant.
[Dialogue Option]  And how do the ships even find this place?
Weyl: Haha, just messing with you. But honestly, I can't share that—it's a company secret.
Weyl: No offense, but is there some misunderstanding here? Oh, I forgot to wear my Blake Bloom. No wonder you're asking all these questions.
Weyl: I'm also a Black Shores Consultant, but I usually don't wear the Blake Bloom outside this island.
[Dialogue Option]  Why not? It's convenient.
Weyl: Most places are indeed accommodating to Consultants, but some people aren't too happy with us. They even disconnected the local Nexus from the Tethys System.
Weyl: Since the Black Shores isn't exactly popular everywhere, it's better to go low-profile when delivering. People tend to open up more that way, too.
[Dialogue Option]  Makes sense.
Weyl: Anyway, I've got to check the inventory. If you have any packages to send, just come find me.

title: Who Are the "Outcasts" (Excerpt)
content:
Alienated by their tribes, openly rejecting tradition, or lured by an insatiable curiosity for a world they had never seen, a group of Roya set out on a path separate from their people. They began trading in Exostrider cell remnants and Exoswarm materials to fulfill their own desires.

Their actions were intolerable to the rest of the Roya. As a result, they were exiled and branded Outcasts. But they did not see this as a punishment, but a liberation, a chance to embrace their true natures. They spread across Lahai-Roi, becoming a force of unrestrained chaos. Their defiance was more than a simple rejection of tradition. They actively inverted it, mocking the old ways in every gesture, every object, and every action.

They cast aside ornaments drawn from nature, instead tearing skulls from the Exoswarm to wear as grisly masks. They reforged their Shepherd's Staffs into weapons.

title: Who Are the "Outcasts" (Excerpt)
content: But what exactly is their purpose? Some say they see themselves as the new, true branch of the Roya, striving to carve out a place in a changing world. These, however, are only rumors. In truth, the Outcasts demonstrate no unified ideology and voice no common demands. They appear consumed instead by the thrill of discovery and the hunt for the Exoswarm.

title: Wicktorio
content:
John Wicktorio is the mayor of Egla Town, who is a retired Acolyte and accountant of the Order. After the passing of his wife, her Echo named Daisy, appeared to keep him company for the next twenty-years.
That is until an unfortunate event occurred.

He can be found with Cosimo in front of an overgrown and abandon house during 07:00 to 10:00, seemingly with regrets.

title: Wicktorio
subsection: (Daytime, in front of the abandoned house)
content:
[Objective: (Daytime, in front of the abandoned house)]
Cosimo: Heh... How many years have we been strolling here every morning?
Wicktorio:  I can't remember. My memory is not what it used to be. We're just old fools approaching the grave.
Cosimo: Every time I see this house, I feel as if the child's right before me...
Cosimo: Oh Imperator, is her fate also part of your design?

title: Wicktorio
content:
Wicktorio: Welcome to Egla Town, traveler from afar. May you enjoy your time here.
Wicktorio: I'm Wicktorio, the mayor. Feel free to ask me about anything related to the town.
[Dialogue Option] : Could you tell me about the history of this place?
Wicktorio: Certainly, not many young people care about history these days...
Wicktorio: The history of our town begins with the first settlers in Rinascita. Later, The Order united the people during the Dark Tide and established a city-state. Over time, Ragunna City became the cultural and life center of the region.
Wicktorio: Egla has managed to preserve its original essense due to its relatively peaceful enviornment, thus placing greater importance on the traditions of Ragunna.
[Dialogue Option] : What do you recommend here?
Wicktorio: You can find the most traditional Ragunna cuisine at the Burrata Bakery, or immerse yourself in town life at the Sorrentino Inn.
Wicktorio: Or... you could quietly hide behind the curtains at night and enjoy the Night Reveries, prepared for the knights.
[Dialogue Option] : About the unattended house.
Wicktorio: The house you're talking about... That family left Rinascita nearly twenty years ago.
Wicktorio: It's just old news, not worth delving into. Please don't concern yourself with it.
[Dialogue Option] : Thank you. See you around.
Wicktorio: Goodbye, foreign visitor. May the glory of the Sentinel be with you.

title: Xianchen
content: Xianchen is an NPC in Jinzhou. She is a member of the Pioneer Association.

title: Xianchen
content:
Xianchen: I've tried every way, but I can't persuade him. What should I do... Rover, you came at the right time. Help me think of a solution.
[Dialogue Option]  What happened?
Xianchen: It's about my junior, Zhuyi. He recently joined the Pioneer Association and is now working as an intern photographer.
Xianchen: According to the regulations, new members are required to participate in the regular "Fireside Chats" to share and learn the history and culture of the Pioneer Association.
Xianchen: The recent adventure story was about the Icebreakers, who ventured into places far and between, like the distant polar oceans, the revived volcanoes, and the Great Rift Valley after the Lament occurred.
Xianchen: They reported about nature's warning signs that they spot around the world and became the first witnesses of countless powerful Tacet Discord.
Xianchen: After hearing these stories, Zhuyi suddenly became restless and applied to the Association to join the next expedition to the unchartered danger zones.
Xianchen: I'm worried that he's moving too fast and might make the mistakes I made before.
Xianchen: To be honest, when I was young, I was just as hotheaded as him. Always at the forefront of the team.
Xianchen: Later, in one of the missions, I rushed forward without properly surveying the terrain and accidentally fell into a cave.
Xianchen: As a result, I injured my thigh, and since then had to gradually retire from the field. Now I'm starting to think about transferring to support.
Xianchen: What if he makes my mistake again?
Xianchen: Rover, if you have a solution, you must tell me.

content: Xianfeng is a Midnight Ranger stationed at Memento Square. His Forte allows him to find "the right launching" point when moving heavy objects. This has become a useful asset during his time on an exploratory mission, as he's used it to help clear roadblocks and rescue trapped citizens.

Xianfeng: Luckily, I've saved a lot of trapped people with this empathic ability.
Xianfeng: If you run into any difficulties, especially if you need to clear a rocky roadblock or something like that, just call me.

His right arm has been completely replaced by a cybernetic prosthetic arm on which his Tacet Mark is located.

title: Xuanqing
Xuanqing
content: Xuanqing was the Resonator chosen by Sentinel Hsin the Moon Fox to stop the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs's nagging. However, Hsin grew genuinely fond of Xuanqing over time, and the two grew close, even sharing gifts with one another.

title: Xuanqing
content: Years ago, the original Hsin, the Moon Fox grew tired of the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs's nagging for a Sentinel Resonator. In order to find one, she decided to lay out several fox statues across Mengzhou via her power of Fractal Proliferation. If the statue glowed from being touched by someone, they would be capable of becoming her Resonator, which would ping Hsin. One day, Xuanqing touched the statue and it glowed, notifying Hsin, who made her as Hsin's Sentinel Resonator. Hsin later visited the village to meet Xuanqing, speaking with the local villagers to ask after her whereabouts, including the baker who created the Moon Fox Rice Cake. Overhearing Xuanqing playing a folk song under the village's central pagoda, Hsin felt a sense of joy at hearing her talent, before going on to meet her.

title: Xuanqing
content: During the Tacet Discord Outbreak caused by Ovathrax, desperate to save her village and others like it, Xuanqing baited the Tacet Discords to the choke point as a trap, and asked Hsin about performing the Second Awakening in order to buy more time to save more people. However, Hsin told her that this ritual requires the Arbiter's authorization, as it would cause a violent collision of frequencies that would consume Xuanqing otherwise. Upon hearing Hsin's answer and learning from her that it would keep them at bay for about 3 days, Xuanqing accepted the "bargain" with grace, wanting to give her life for the sake of giving her home village more time without hesitation. After receiving Hsin's reluctant approval, she performed the ritual, tragically sacrificing herself for the greater good, which bought the time she hoped for to save more people.

title: Xuanqing
content: Moonlike Heart Mortal Longing CG Xuanqing in Battlefield 1.png|Xuanqing talking to Hsin and sacrificing herself

title: Xuanqing
content: After she was born from the original Hsin, the Moon Fox, Hsin cast out several emotions from herself that included the human emotions of joy, sorrow, anger, and fear, which formed the various Heart Realms around the Simulacrum Nexus. However, she sealed them away to prevent herself from being overwhelmed. As time went on, she spent time living amongst the people of Mengzhou while observing them, gradually reintegrating these emotions as she developed a sense of humanity. Hsin's emotional experience of Xuanqing was condensed into a device known as the Feeling Capsule, which was intended to be the final emotion meant for Hsin to confront and integrate in order to complete her transformation into a true Sentinel.

title: Xuanqing
content: However, Hsin's memory of Xuanqing's story glitched during its creation, becoming a turbulent anomaly known as the Heart of Ruin. A memory of Xuanqing was created by this anomaly, with her memories and personality fully intact. However, due to lacking the Sentinel's authority, she was unable to repair the Feeling Capsule. At some point, the Feeling Capsule was shattered across the Simulacrum Nexus.

title: Xuanqing
content: Over two centuries later, following the defeat and surrender of Suhsin, Hsin's authority would be restored. This prompted Xuanqing to contact Rover via Wavesline, where she requested their help in reassembling the Feeling Capsule, which had been scattered into shards across the Simulacrum Nexus. Once done, Xuanqing revealed her true identity as Hsin's Resonator to Rover.

title: Xuanqing
content: Her Tacet Mark was located on the top part of her chest. Xuanqing was a young, fair-skinned woman, with a lithe, slender build. She had bright crimson-red hair that she kept styled in a short, flowing bob, that ended in locks of hair that curled around her face, carefully framing it. She had a single large crimson bang, which hung between her eyes. She wore a golden hair ornament with a geometric diamond pattern that crowned the center of her hair, and had long twin pig tails that she styled with golden geometrically braided hair clamps.

title: Xuanqing
content: Her most notable feature, which she initially hid from Rover to conceal her true identity, were her Resonator mutation characteristics. She had a large, flowy dark red fox tail, and her hair extended out into two large crimson fox-like ears which hung down at outward angles from each side of the back of her head. The fur underneath each fox ear had a light rose pink color.

title: Xuanqing
content: Xuanqing wore an intricate, flowing white ankle-length dress, which was predominantly white, with black and golden accents. The dress was a fitted bodice with golden wave-like patterns embroidered on the upper chest. It was tied together by four bright red straps, with two at the waist and upper arms respectively. These were fitted on with golden buckles that bore a similar geometric design to her hair crown, with the arm straps trailing out from her lower shoulders. The dress extended into a black swallow-tail coat at the back with a red underside, which framed her tail.

title: Xuanqing
content:
Her dress exposed her shoulders and upper chest, which showed her Tacet Mark, framed by dark, angular shoulder coverings at the sides of her upper chest, and a black and white collar that was adorned with a small ornament at its center. Its sleeves were asymmetrical, with one arm fully draped in a white sleeve that extended to her wrist, while she wore a black glove on her left hand, while the arm was exposed. One hand is covered by a black glove, while the other remains bare beneath a white sleeve. Around her waist is a circular jade ring accessory, crested with a black-and-green target-esque pattern at its center. Two decorative white hair tassels hung beneath it.

She wore white, open-toed heeled sandals with red segments at the center of her ankles, with small golden cross-shaped ornaments on their front.

|text2         = Most people didn't know that Yangyang had a perfect pitch.



Perhaps it was because how she was always a passive presence, never singing in public or taking the spotlight. She preferred to stay in the background and listen. It seemed like she was born to be a listener.

That's why Chixia was shocked at Yangyang's ability to accurately hum a melody she had only heard. She couldn't help but exclaim, “How did you memorize that so fast? And it sounded amazing! Good heavens!”

Suddenly, everyone remembered Yangyang's other identity, the second daughter of a family of music. It would be only unnatural if she didn't understand music theory or know how to sing.

title: Yangyang/Backstory
content:
This revelation resolved some of the previous confusion. That perfect way of dealing with people, that etiquette which seemed faultless to even the most demanding people. Yes, of course, she had to come from such a well-educated family.

However, it also begged another question: Why would the daughter of such a renowned family go to the border city alone, at the expense of her otherwise luxurious life and promising career? Was there an underlying reason that compelled her to leave?

If there really was such a reason, Yangyang never mentioned it to anyone. She never complained or avoided responsibilities, whether when she fulfilled her Outrider responsibilities, or when she spent time with friends. If one had to say, it was her Outrider companions that bothered her more, because... She was always patiently lending an ear.

title: Yangyang/Backstory
content:
Many sought solace in confiding to Yangyang, not seeking solutions but simply venting their stress. She knew this well and remained neutral, empathizing with the narrator's feelings. She listened without interruption, offering guidance when needed before returning to a silent role. With her help, the tangled emotions were untangled unnoticed. These cathartic sessions proved valuable. However, Yangyang's support was not blind agreement; she offered advice prioritizing the speaker's desires.

Soon enough, Chixia told everyone else about Yangyang's amazing talent, sparking playful requests for a song. Yangyang shyly waved off their request, saying, “Maybe... I'll sing it for everyone later, when I am ready?”

title: Yangyang/Backstory
content:
Yangyang looked sincere, so it seemed not just perfunctory or an excuse. It was truly what she thought from the bottom of her heart. But when would that be? Perhaps she wanted to wait until everyone else who wanted her to hear out their worries had finished talking?

Understanding and critiquing performances requires a deep knowledge of music.  However, being skilled in music does not necessitate taking the stage.

So thought Yangyang, as she again chose to step back, allowing others to shine.

title: Yangyang/Backstory
content:
|text3         = To some extent, there isn’t much difference between the sixteen-year-old Yangyang and the six-year-old Yangyang.



She still holds the same expectations for the world, believing in fairy tales as always, believing in the goodness between people, believing in miracles, believing that all things beautiful will eventually happen.

Many would call this naive luck, the thoughts of a spoiled child who has never faced the harsh realities of life.

Indeed, Yangyang grew up in a privileged and nurturing home, shielded from suffering. Her life was perfect...

...Until that fateful day.

title: Yangyang/Backstory
content:
Indeed, Yangyang grew up in a privileged and nurturing home, shielded from suffering. Her life was perfect...

...Until that fateful day.



At age 11, her tranquil life was shattered by a ruthless attack from Exiles while traveling with her family’s caravan. The brutal reality of death and cruelty left her reeling as she fled and sought refuge among strangers in an unfamiliar settlement. These resilient people lived off the land, cautious yet resourceful. She was forced to fend for herself, adapting to this harsh new world at a young age. She couldn’t tell if they were like the ruthless attackers or not. The constant alertness of these settlers made her question if it was safe to trust anyone. Dressed in fine clothes and alone, she stood out among them, and they too were suspicious of her. Could it be a trap?

title: Yangyang/Backstory
content:
In the end, they passed food to her, and she took it, though she’d never seen anything like it.

Kindness found its roots even in the most barren of lands. Yangyang wanted to repay the trust they released before her, but her knowledge proved not helpful at all in the wild, and her sword skills proved too childish against real hostility. Everything seemed entirely unfamiliar to her, yet this was the harsh reality most people had to face. The reality felt so overwhelmingly agonizing.

“Grandma, have you... been living like this all the time?” As Yangyang tried to help an old lady sort out the meager resources they had, she couldn’t help but ask this abrupt question.

“Yes, why? City girl. You shocked? Relax. Everything will be fine.”

“But when? Will things really be fine one day?”

title: Yangyang/Backstory
content:
“Yes, why? City girl. You shocked? Relax. Everything will be fine.”

“But when? Will things really be fine one day?”



“Of course. How will good things come true if you don’t even believe them yourself? We were skeptical of you, too, but we chose to believe. It’s the same for you. Gotta have faith in something in life. Even if you don’t know how it’ll turn out. That’s what faith is all about.”

“When? Hm, maybe when you grow up, little one.”

So yes, perhaps Yangyang hasn’t experienced enough hardship yet. Or maybe one’s inclination to show kindness isn’t based on past experiences, but inherent in their character.

In the darkest of situations, some will show kindness simply because others chose to trust them. And this in turn will spark more acts of goodwill.

Ever since, Yangyang always spread kindness to strangers, sparked by that one encounter.

title: Yangyang/Backstory
content:
Ever since, Yangyang always spread kindness to strangers, sparked by that one encounter.



Of course, her kindness is not without boundaries. Betrayal can turn her warm breeze into a harsh storm.

But she holds onto hope, believing in the power of goodness. She chooses to trust and expects the best from others. This is her chosen way to make the world a better place.
|mention3      =

|title4        = What Wind Taught Her
|text4         = Yangyang has fallen into the winds three times.

The first time was when she fell from her mother’s arms.

Shortly after Yangyang’s birth, she was already surrounded by love. Her mother playfully swung her in her arms, pretending she was flying and landing.

title: Yangyang/Backstory
content:
But when the swing went a little too high, Yangyang felt the whispers of wind and sensed an approaching storm, even before she could speak. As she landed, her babbling was mistaken for fear from the accident, but it was actually a reaction to the oncoming tempest.

The second time was when she passed out from sensory overload.

As she grew up, Yangyang’s once vague sensing ability strengthened, allowing her to feel intangible airstreams in her palms. She called them the “Streams” and they gave her insights into energy fluctuations, anomalies, and even the smallest physical details of a person.

Trapped in a self-destructive cycle, Yangyang yearned to explore her ability and gain more insight. But the more she tried to be thorough, the deeper she fell into a maze of details.

title: Yangyang/Backstory
content:
What followed cannot be called a fall, for it was a descent through time, not space. The sensory overload lasted for months, between faintness and sobriety. Yangyang felt as light as a feather caught in a raging storm, perpetually falling.

“I must focus on the key details within my reach, rather than trying to capture everything...” Finally, Yangyang pulled herself out of the never-ending free fall and safely landed.

The third, but maybe not the last time, was when Yangyang leaped up and threw herself into the winds.

The continual sensory overload altered her hair and taught Yangyang to tolerate the discomfort. Despite the Streams’ excessive information, the recipient could sift through and extract crucial details. Signs of a struggle at the disappearance site, unusual fluctuations outside the city, and a steady rise in energy reactions...

title: Yangyang/Backstory
content:
Yangyang had never used her ability in such a dire situation, but her determination to help overrode any hesitation. The Streams surged, forming a distinct line that led to a missing child, being chased by  and teetering on the edge of a cliff. Without hesitation, Yangyang leaped towards the precarious figure, outstretching her hand to save the child.

Feathers danced in the air, carrying Yangyang and the child in a gentle yet powerful wind. The child looked around at the floating feathers and asked, “Are you the lark fairy that flies in the wind, big sister?”

Lost in memories, Yangyang smiled. She thought of the times when she fell into the winds, again and again. Perhaps she truly was one with the winds.

title: Yangyang/Backstory
content:
|mention4      =

|title5        = The Answer Lies in the Winds
|text5         = On her journey away from home, Yangyang met two kinds of people.



The first kind always seemed in such haste, yet remained unsure where they were heading, and often ended up lost and returned in regret. The other kind always had a clear destination in mind. They always made it finally, despite arduous roads and occasional stumbles. Yangyang held up her head and looked at Jinzhou city on the horizon, unsure if she could be considered one of the second kind of people. Once again, she thought of the term “One Instrument for Life”.

title: Yangyang/Backstory
content:
“One Instrument for Life”. That is the most important principle in Yangyang’s family teachings. Originally, it meant that every family member could strive to excel in everything, but they must choose one musical instrument to specialize in and practice continuously throughout their life to become a master. As circumstances changed, the principle gradually evolved into dedicating one’s entire life to one pursuit, striving for excellence to make this life worthwhile.

Her mother’s Instrument was composing. Yangyang had seen people dancing to her mother’s songs. On the other hand, Yangyang’s sister was already a successful figure in the chamber of commerce.

However, Yangyang could not easily decide her own Instrument as they once did. What was the thing worthy of dedicating her life to? What person should she be?

title: Yangyang/Backstory
content:
She turned to her mother for help: Mother, do you want me to inherit the family business? Or, what do you want me to do? I can try anything and I will strive for excellence. Although life is full of infinite possibilities, in the end, we can only choose one path, right?

Her mother looked at her with love and said, my child, it is precisely because of this that you should not seek answers from me, but rather ask your own heart. This is a difficult question, but you need not rush an answer.
speakers: She turned to her mother for help
She turned to her mother for help

title: Yangyang/Backstory
content:
And so, Yangyang held onto her question, waiting patiently for an answer that seemed to elude her. She waited through her return home from the desolate settlement, through the climb out of an abyss, and through growing weary of her family’s overprotectiveness. The desire to join the world and experience its harshness grew stronger, no longer content with being a mere leaf drifting in the wind. She longed to bear the weight of reality, instead of hiding away from it.

That was when a sudden ambush in the wilderness resulted in heavy casualties from  attacks on the frontline. News of this tragedy quickly spread through the city, igniting feelings of sorrow, anger, and despair among its inhabitants. Emotions boiled over, with people gathered around a bonfire. Tears flowed freely, hoarse cries echoed through the night. But by morning, grief became a luxury as life returned to normal.

title: Yangyang/Backstory
content:
Yangyang stood among them, tears streaming down her face. She hadn’t experienced any personal loss, but witnessing their sorrow and the joy of the rescued children stirred something inside her. It was a transformative moment, as she realized her true calling: to protect others, just as she had been protected before. She wanted to shield them from misfortune and give them hope for a brighter future.

As Yangyang stood at the edge of Jinzhou on her enrollment night as an , she gazed at the sky and the bustling residents below. Doubt crept in as she questioned her ability to protect these lively citizens, a responsibility she had always dreamed of fulfilling.

The Streams came from afar and gently held Yangyang in their embrace, dispelling her last bits of doubt.

title: Yangyang: Xuanling/Backstory

content:
{{VO

|vo_01_01_title              = Thoughts: I
|vo_01_01_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg
|vo_01_01_tx                 = ...I thought that when I saw you again, words would come pouring out—so many that I wouldn't know where to start. But... now that you're really here, my heart is so full of joy that it pushed everything else away.

|vo_01_02_title              = Thoughts: II
|vo_01_02_intimacy           = 1
|vo_01_02_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg
|vo_01_02_tx                 = A lot has happened in  while you were away. I've written to you about the long and short of it. Yet, some stories are just better told face to face, right? So, the adventures you mentioned in your letters—the , , Septimont, and —would you share them with me again?

title: Yangyang: Xuanling/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_03_title              = Thoughts: III
|vo_01_03_intimacy           = 2
|vo_01_03_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg
|vo_01_03_tx                 = The role of a Xuan Watcher... Though it's only a temporary undertaking, I'm still orienting myself. Sometimes I catch myself worrying about Jinzhou. But Chixia, Baizhi, , and General Jiyan... these names bring peace just at their mentioning. I hope that one day, my name can bring that same reassurance to others.
|vo_01_03_mention            = Chixia, Baizhi, Jinhsi, Jiyan

title: Yangyang: Xuanling/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_03_mention            = Chixia, Baizhi, Jinhsi, Jiyan



|vo_01_04_title              = Thoughts: IV
|vo_01_04_intimacy           = 3
|vo_01_04_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg
|vo_01_04_tx                 = The night before I left for Xuanfang Hold, I had a nightmare... In it, I was searching for a person... someone I'd never actually met. It wasn't until I woke up that I realized that person was you. But like what you said in your letter—a dream is only a dream. Now that I can see you, touch you, and feel you... I don't think I'll ever have a dream like that again.

title: Yangyang: Xuanling/Voicelines
content:
|vo_01_05_title              = Thoughts: V
|vo_01_05_intimacy           = 4
|vo_01_05_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg
|vo_01_05_tx                 = I know that after this reunion, the time will come for us to part again. But this time, our shared memories are the stories we lived, we didn't have to reduce them to words in letters. And, through the bittersweetness of our parting, our next meeting may be all the more worth looking forward to... Who knows? Maybe next time, I'll be the one coming to see you.

title: Yangyang: Xuanling/Voicelines
content:
|vo_02_01_title              = Yangyang's Hobby
|vo_02_01_file               = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg
|vo_02_01_tx                 = My sister used to take me kite-flying all the time. She'd joke that as long as I was there, we could catch a breeze even on a windless day. But when we were competing to see whose kite flew higher, she'd watch me like a hawk to make sure I didn't cheat—not that she'd stand a chance catching me if I did.

title: Yangyang: Xuanling/Voicelines
content:
|vo_02_02_title              = Yangyang's Trouble
|vo_02_02_file               = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg
|vo_02_02_tx                 = I've crossed paths with all kinds of people on this journey. Some walked with me, some passed me by, and some... drew the line against me. With them, there was no middle ground nor room for compromises, no matter how much of ourselves we shared. I know there will be more of this kind the further down this path. But it won't stop me from moving forward. My ideals and faith have forged the blade I carry. It protects at the same time as it cuts... Should the day come when I must point it at others... my resolve was made long ago.

title: Yangyang: Xuanling/Voicelines
content:
|vo_02_03_title              = Favorite Food
|vo_02_03_file               = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg
|vo_02_03_tx                 = My mother's cooking... My sister and I both love it. Though neither of us can say we love it as much as Father does. After all, it was her cooking that captured my father's... Ahem—if you're curious about its taste, Rover, I could try my hand at it. I haven't quite mastered her touch yet, but... I'd probably improve faster with a good taste tester.

|vo_02_04_title              = Disliked Food
|vo_02_04_file               = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg
|vo_02_04_tx                 = Food I dislike? Hm... I'm not a picky eater. But when it comes down to it... eating alone makes the heartiest meal taste bland.

title: Yangyang: Xuanling/Voicelines
content:
|vo_02_05_title              = Ideals
|vo_02_05_file               = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg
|vo_02_05_tx                 = Protection takes many forms. It can be stepping up for the defenseless, lifting someone out of hardship, or simply offering a quiet ear for someone who's hurting. But whatever the case may be, you must be strong enough to support others. That is why I must press on along my path. I don't dream of gaining the power to protect the world, but for now... I want to stand by your side. Together, I believe we can protect so much more.

title: Yangyang: Xuanling/Voicelines
content:

|vo_03_01_file               = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg
|vo_03_01_tx                 = The sword once enshrined in Xianling Village... I didn't realize until the very end that it carried a faint trace of a Xuanling Bird's frequency. title: Yangyang: Xuanling/Voicelines

|vo_03_02_file               = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg
|vo_03_02_tx                 = I had never been to  before, and yet... the Streams here feel strangely familiar. After learning the legend of the Xuanling Birds, I've started to sense their presence in the Streams... If only they still existed in the world—no, call it a hunch, but I know they shall re-emerge, and one day, the people of Xuanfang will see them soaring through the skies once more.

title: Yanning
content: Yanning is found at the northern entry to Hongzhen, near Gulan.

title: Yanning
content: A lonely girl, Yanning was climbing in dangerous places because her parents were always away. To keep her safe, Gulan asked Rover to borrow a self-moving suitcase as a toy. The plan worked, keeping Yanning safe. However, Gulan knew this was just a temporary solution, and that what Yanning truly needed was not a distraction, but the companionship of her parents.

title: Yanning
content:
[Objective: (1st Interaction)]
Gulan: Hey, kid. Where are your parents?
Yanning: It's dangerous there. Get down now!
Yanning: My parents are working.
Yanning: I always play here.
Yanning: Or else I'd be bored out of my mind since I don't have anyone to play with...
Gulan: Then why don't we build a snowman together? Come down first. Let's build a big one.
Yanning: Well... I guess it has been a while since I last built a snowman... Okay then.

title: Yeye
content:
Yeye: Tell you what, Mister Yuanwu's got really awesome boxing moves!
Yeye: See these muscles? I bet you wouldn't even believe it if I told you I used to get sick all the time back in the day. I wouldn't even be here if it weren't for my bigger brother looking after me.
Yeye: He joined the Rangers after I got older, so I went ahead to take boxing lessons from Mister Yuanwu, and he'd offer me Trine Tea after each session. Man, boxing really gets your body going!
[Dialogue Option]  Can't say no to that.
Yeye: Hehe. I need to put in some more practice, that way one day I can be just as strong as that girl Jianxin!
Yeye: And by then, I'll be the one that's protecting my brother!

title: Yeyhe
content: Yeyhe is a researcher in Huaxu Academy in the Branch of Tacetite Weaponry.

title: Yeyhe
content:
Yeyhe: Hmm... Tacetite weapons have their limits, you know...
[Dialogue Option]  What limit?
Yeyhe: Oh, hey! I was just discussing a new weapon project with the department head.
Yeyhe: Your timing is impeccable. I have a question for you.
Yeyhe: You know what? We just had this epiphany! So, regular Tacetite weapons are like, for one person, right? They don't have much impact on a big battle?
[Dialogue Option]  That's right.
Yeyhe: But imagine this: a Tacetite weapon that needs a whole team to operate. That would pack a serious punch!
[Dialogue Option]  Can it actually move at that size?
Yeyhe: Uh... then just fix it!
[Dialogue Option]  What if you're surrounded by Tacet Discords?
Yeyhe: Uh, hold on a sec...
Yeyhe: Ugh, yeah... Still a bunch of kinks to work out...

title: Yeyhe
content:
[Objective: (In the afternoon)]
Yeyhe: Man, everytime I read Mr. Mortefi's research, I learn something new...
[Dialogue Option]  You're the researcher I've seen before.
Yeyhe: No way, you were there too?
Yeyhe: Did you see Mr. Mortefi shut down that guy making all those crazy demands?
Yeyhe: Seriously! Who's the genius behind these thoughtless demands on our R&D?
Yeyhe: Only Mr. Mortefi has the guts to challenge them openly, it's pretty cool!
[Dialogue Option]  It seems you admire him a lot.
Yeyhe: I've always looked up to him. His genius and fearless attitude... I hope to emulate that one day.
Yeyhe: Some folks might not get Mr. Mortefi, seeing him as only short-tempered, but there are plenty who secretly admire him.

title: Yhan
content:
[Dialogue Option]  Get in teams of two and we'll do another simulation battle.
[Dialogue Option]  Perseverance is not the same as recklessness. Do you hear me?

[Dialogue Option]  First, about weapon damage-
[Dialogue Option]  Break time is over. All stand up! The training resumes. Attention!

title: Yhan
content:
[Objective: (First interaction)]
Yhan: Hey, new guy. Care for some sparring? Necessary training will keep your mind sharp. Remember, you have no chance for mistakes out there.

title: Yhan
content:
Yhan: Hey, new guy. Care for some sparring? Necessary training will keep your mind sharp. Remember, you have no chance for mistakes out there.



Yhan: Combat isn't just about strength. You need skills and wisdom too when facing enemies on the battlefield.
[Dialogue Option]  Enter Simulation Training
Yhan: You there, looking to put on some training? Good training keeps you sharp. The enemies won't go easy on you out there.
[Dialogue Option]  Chat
Yhan: Greetings.
[Dialogue Option]  What can you teach me?
Yhan: Combat skills and tactics. Or anything you're willing to learn, as long as I have it.
Yhan: Practicality is key on the battlefield. Years of combat have taught me that. If you want fancy tricks, go elsewhere.
Yhan: I'll teach you how to surive, and how to win.
[Dialogue Option]  Is surviving more important?
Yhan: Absolutely. But let me be clear, I am not condoning cowardice.
Yhan: I will give my life for Huanglong anytime, but I've also witnessed too many pointless deaths.
Yhan: I do not want to see our new recruits make the same mistakes. My purpose is to teach you how to avoid them and give you a better chance at life.
Yhan: Do not rush blindly into battle like those before you. You deserve more than that.
[Dialogue Option]  Is winning more important?
Yhan: While winning is important, the battlefield is constantly changing.
Yhan: Avoid rushing for success and making costly mistakes. Focus on improving your skills and knowing what actions to take.
Yhan: Remember, you have many years ahead of you. You should prioritize staying alive.
[Dialogue Option]  Leave

title: Yhoran
content: Yhoran is an NPC and a member of the Black Shores' Emergency Response Team. They're currently researching combat strategies against Tacet Discords.

title: Yi'an
content: Yi'an can be found leaning against a wall at the northern border of Hongzhen.

title: Yi'an
content:
Yi'an: Have you talked to Yuanzhi yet?
[Dialogue Option]  (Nod.)
Yi'an: She told you everything, I presume?
Yi'an: She wants to go to school in Jinzhou and maybe become a researcher... That's what she said.
Yi'an: Being a researcher doesn't sound that impressive to me...
Yi'an: I think staying at home and sticking around Mt. Firmament is pretty great.
[Dialogue Option]  There are pros and cons in either choice.
Yi'an: Well, I'm not trying to say who's right or wrong. Everybody has their own perspective.
Yi'an: But I've realized that I just don't know Yuanzhi as well as I used to.
[Dialogue Option]  What Yuanzhi needs is your understanding.
Yi'an: We've been friends for years, so I can understand her...
Yi'an: But I've realized that I just don't know Yuanzhi as well as I used to.
[Dialogue Option]  You're just afraid of losing a friend.
Yi'an: You're probably right all along...
Yi'an: I've realized that I just don't know Yuanzhi as well as I used to.
Yi'an: The gap between me an her seems to grow wider and wider...
Yi'an: Regardless, I still respect her decision to become a researcher. After all, it's the path she's chosen for herself.
Yi'an: I wouldn't like it either if she were telling me how to live my life.
Yi'an: She's my friend, so the least I can do is wish her happiness.

title: Yihu
content: Yihu is a waiter at Panhua Restaurant who enjoys gossips and telling jokes in Guankou (stand-up show) style. Later, it's revealed he's an undercover intel for the Public Security Bureau.

title: Yihu
content:
[Dialogue Option]  Ready to order? We've got Chili Oil Chicken, Pulled Chicken, Poached Chicken...
[Dialogue Option]  Alright. If you need help with anything, just holler. I'm always at your service!
[Dialogue Option]  Here's your meal. Enjoy!

title: Yihu
content:
[Objective: (During the day)]
Yihu: Hehe, I'll let you in on a little secret. You can overhear all kinds of things here.
Yihu: From big news to juicy gossip, just hang around long enough and you'll know everything there is to know about Jinzhou!
Yihu: Don't believe me? I myself have a whole list of stories I could share with you.
[Dialogue Option]  I'm not interested.
Yihu: Oh! Alright, alright, it's not urgent. We can chat when you're interested.
[Dialogue Option]  Can you describe what happened?
Yihu: So much is happening. Look at Liuxian Teahouse, it's bustling. So many people come here to drink tea and chat.
Yihu: But I heard the teahouse is secretly owned by some big shot who just so happens to also be a great fighter, and kind of a gentleman at that.
Yihu: Alright, that's it for now. If you have any interesting stories, feel free to share. We love hearing them! I'll leave you to it.
[Dialogue Option]  Leave

title: Yihu
content:
[Objective: (During the evening)]
Yihu: I tell you, nighttime is when it really gets lively. Everyone's out and about, chatting and relaxing.
Yihu: You might run into folks from all walks of life, even some big shots you wouldn't see during the day.
Yihu: If you're hoping to bump into someone, don't miss out on the nightlife here!

title: Yihu
content:
[Objective: (Past 2AM behind Panhua's Restaurant)]
Yihu: Huh? Wh-what are you doing here in the middle of the night...?
[Dialogue Option]  Well, you're here too.
Yihu: I-I'm here to prepare a birthday meal for a customer who's celebrating tomorrow!

title: Yihu
content: Guankou, also known as called talk strings or cross talk, refers to an oral technique used in Xiangsheng performances where two performers exchange dialog with each other in a comedic matter.

title: Yingda
content: Yingda is an NPC in Huanglong. Yingda is the Captain of Chenbi and Shuhe.

title: Yingda
content:
[Objective: (During the day)]
Yingda: Hello, to schedule a meeting with the Jinzhou Magistrate, please submit the necessary paperwork.
[Dialogue Option]  Someone has already completed the procedures for me.
Yingda: OK, in that case, just produce it when you are at the meeting.
[Dialogue Option]  Why have you been staring over there?
Yingda: Hmm... It's part of my duties as a City Hall guard.
Yingda: But there might be other reasons. The two guards over there, Chenbi and Shuhe. I'm their leaders.
[Dialogue Option]  Why don't you trust Chenbi?
Yingda: Since her father died in the war, she's always wanted to complete her father's unfinished business.
Yingda: That's why she signed up to be a City Hall guard. If not shining as a Midnight Ranger, she's finding other ways to make a mark.
Yingda: But you know, they're young, and already a few days on guard duty has them so stressed. I do find it concerning.
[Dialogue Option]  Why don't you trust Shuhe?
Yingda: Him? That kid's got all the strength in the world.
Yingda: It's just that sometimes, once she decides on something, she will never change her mind. She's straightforward and a bit stubborn...

title: Yingda
content:
[Objective: (During the evening)]
Yingda: City Hall is the heart of Jinzhou.
Yingda: I need to give everything I have for the event happening today.
Yingda: I hope they grow competent enough soon...

title: Yingda

content: Yinyu is a female local NPC located in . After talking to her about her dilemma, she becomes a guide for visitors.

title: Yinyu
subsection: ( Between 06:00- 17:59 , north from the center plaza)
content:
[Objective: ( Between 06:00- 17:59 , north from the center plaza)]
Yinyu: Hongzhen was founded very early. It was thriving when Jinzhou was just an idea.
Yinyu: Back then, Hongzhen rivaled Jinzhou now.
Yinyu: That's also the reason many scholars believe Hongzhen is not only the ancestral land of the early settlers of Jinzhou, but also the predecessor of Jinzhou itself.
Yinyu: As you can see, the houses that have been preserved in town share many similarities with Jinzhou architecture.

title: Yinyu
subsection: ( Between 18:00- 11:59 , northern boarder of town, in front of the water screen)
content:
[Objective: ( Between 18:00- 11:59 , northern boarder of town, in front of the water screen)]
Yinyu: The stone wall before you is called the Water Shadow Screen. It is naturally formed by years of continuous erosion from the waters of Sagaci Springs.
Yinyu: What's notable is that it inspired the ancestors of Hongzhen to invent a delightful form of entertainment—the Water Shadow Play.
Yinyu: All you need to do is gather some maple leaves that are scattered throughout the mountains and cut them into various shapes. Then, by using small twigs to manipulate them, the shadows of the leaves will dance in the water, bringing fascinating stories to life.
Yinyu: And that's why brewing and sipping tea while watching a Water Shadow Play became the favorite past time for the folks of Mt. Firmament.

metadata.subsection: ( Between 18:00- 11:59 , northern boarder of town, in front of the water screen)

title: Yinyu
content:
[Objective: ( Between 00:00- 05:59 , nearby Xinyi)]
Yinyu: Oh, it's you.
Yinyu: I appreciate what you did last time. I think I got a lot better since then.
Yinyu: Now everyone loves to hear my Mt. Firmament stories, and quite a few want me to be their guide.
[Dialogue Option]  Congrats.
[Dialogue Option]  You did it all on your own.
Yinyu: Well, I couldn't have done it without your suggestions and encouragement.
Yinyu: Of course, I can't be complacent. I learned much of Mt. Firmament's history from these documents.

title: Yirou
content:
Yirou is one of the leaders of the restoration of Memento Square. She holds the Sentinel Jué in high regard, which is why she puts such a high value on repairing and restoring the statue. In her opinion, this project will help inspire and console the people of Jinzhou in the face of the attacks and disasters of the Tacet Discords. This idealistic perspective is at odds with Hao'bai, who believes that the main priority of the project should be repairing and defending the area.

Yirou seems oblivious to Hao'bai's feelings for her, but others in the camp have commented on their conflicting opinions.

title: Yirou
content:
Yirou: Just curious why they haven't started repairing the Sentinel statue yet...
Yirou: All the issues mentioned in the report can be solved!
[Dialogue Option]  What's wrong with it all?
Yirou: The mountains and rocks are unstable... Frequent Tacet Discord Outbreaks...
[Dialogue Option]  I'm afrain it won't be resolved for a while.
[Dialogue Option]  Not a small problem indeed.
Yirou: People are living in fear, afraid that these disasters will happen again...
Yirou: A restoration of the Sentinel sculpture would surely inspire everyone.
Yirou: After all, we all grew up listening to Sentinel's stories!

title: Yngvar
content: Yngvar is a quest-exclusive NPC that first appears in Ode to the Second Sunrise. He is the successor for the title of "The Eye" in the Heliodic Six.

title: Yngvar
content:
Often skipping ceremonies and neglecting his duties as a Foreseer to the Heliodic Six, Yngyar's qualification to being a successor is often questioned by other Roya members.

It is later revealed he did not wish to succeed "The Eye" and become a member of the Heliodic Six, chosen only for his Resonance Ability. To escape his fate, he aligns himself with the Fractsidus to destroy the Heliogyre in exchange for a pass to New Federation.

title: Yngvar
content:
[Objective: (Down the stairs of Solisylum)]
Angry Shepard: Yngvar never even bothered to care about the Soliskin. And he never joins the ceremonies. How was he chosen as one of the Heliodic Six's future successors?
Nervous Roya: Let's not talk about this here...
Angry Shepard: Why is that? Are you afraid? I'm simply stating the facts. Among all the candidates, Sigrika is clearly the one who meets the necessary qualifications!

title: Yngvar
content:
[Objective: (After completion of )]
;Did you hear Yngvar is subject to disciplinary action by the Solisylum?
;Serves him right! I told you he never deserved to be a successor in the first place!

;I knew it! Yngvar walks a crooked path.
;To think, even one named a successor to the Heliodic Six could fall to treachery...

title: Yngvar
content:
;I knew it! Yngvar walks a crooked path.
;To think, even one named a successor to the Heliodic Six could fall to treachery...



;Herja To think it was Yngvar who did such a thing...
;Aksel Sigh...
Herja: Ah. I felt it in my gut, but to think it was Yngvar who did such a thing...
Aksel: From the Void Storm we pulled him, Herja. And now by our own hands, to judgement he goes. It is a closed circle.
[Dialogue Option]  Hello.
Aksel: Ah, the Predicted One? We meet again. Welcome to Haldarheim.
[Dialogue Option]  So what happened to Yngvar in the end?
Aksel: Sigh...
Aksel: Everything changed the day of that Void Storm. When the sky brightenened again, a Soliskin found us. We followed it into Bjartr Woods, and there, Yngvar we found, unconcious.
Aksel: He had no fatal wounds, only signs of scorching. We brought him back to Haldarheim to recover.
[Dialogue Option]   (Sounds like Mornye gave Yngvar a good thrashing.)
Aksel: When he woke, silence he kept. But then, those from the Solisylum came. The truth of his deeds they laid bare, and he broke down and wept, confessing everything.
Aksel: To the Solisylum's custody, he has been given. His punishment will not be pleasant.
[Dialogue Option]  And the world rejoices.
[Dialogue Option]  A bitter end, at any rate.

title: Ynkwell
content:

She can be found talking to Grace near the well where Phrolova violin is submerged in.

title: Ynkwell
content:
Ynkwell: I want to stick close to home this week. I walked too far with Betty last time, and my feet are still sore.
Grace: Oh dear, I forgot you went out not too long ago.
Ynkwell: Betty and I went to every clothing shop in all of the nearby cities just to pick out the right skirt  for Phrolova to wear in her performance.
Grace: To be fair, it's a nice skirt. Must've taken you ages to find the right one.
Ynkwell: Hehe, naturally. We're both excellent shoppers.

title: Yuan Fortress
content:
Yuan Fortress was an area of Xuanfang, Huanglong, whose ruins lie under what is now Xuanfang Hold. A preserved recreation of it exists in the Xuanyuan Domain inside of the core of Xuanfang Hold, at the base of the Ren Realm.

After completing Song of the Heart Sword, it becomes accessible via a portal outside of the Sanctum. Ruoyun can be found and interacted with at a gazebo near the entrance of the fortress. The rest of Xuanyuan Domain is not accessible.

title: Yuan Fortress
content: Yuan Fortress was originally built by the Zhuojun Atelier's Jiangshui Branch over 200 years ago, under the tutelage of Muyu. It was the former operational stronghold of Xuanfang that preceded Xuanfang Hold, and was the base of the Xuanfang Wardens. It was destroyed during the Fortress and Gorges War when a coalition of Court of Savantae artisans and Xuanfang Wardens banded together to sacrifice themselves to trigger the self-destruction of its core, pushing out Ovathrax's Tacet Discord forces in the ensuing explosion.

title: Yuan Fortress
content: Xuanfang Hold, having already been in the middle of construction, was initially forced to prematurely wield its artillery systems and newly-built Autopuppet armada against the Tacet Discords by Sentinel Hsin in an attempt to safeguard the fortress and Xuanfang's people from being overwhelmed by Ovathrax. Hsin directly oversaw the regional war effort with the aid of a Xuanling Bird messenger, delivering orders to the troops on the ground to prioritize the evacuation of civilians, before being ordered to prioritize their own survival once most civilians were safely escorted out of the region.

title: Yuan Fortress
content: However, a coalition of devout Court of Savantae personnel and Xuanfang Wardens remained in Yuan Fortress to Hsin's shock, who refused her order to evacuate. Instead, they chose to take their fate into their own hands by voluntarily sacrificing themselves to detonate Yuan Fortress in order to protect Hsin, while also ensuring the survival of Xuanfang Hold by protecting its Lexicon Axis. A team of artisans and soldiers that included Ruoyun mounted a brave effort to reach the core, before detonating the entire Fortress and wiping out the surrounding hordes in a fell swoop. The coalition's sacrifice was not be in vain, as Xuanfang Hold's construction was successfully completed in the aftermath, ultimately taking the Fortress' place as the new capital stronghold of the region.

title: Yuan Fortress
content: In place of employing the traditional manpower that safeguarded the Fortress for generations, Hsin opted to replace them with Autopuppets, while installing the Censure Court system to restructure Xuanfang's local defense around a trap-and-kill system. Rather than being deterred by Xuanfang Wardens from the Yuan Fortress, Tacet Discords were lured into Censure Court traps via the use of Disorienting Fog fields, before being caught and taken to the Sunken Warren underneath Fogveil Pagoda to be destroyed.

title: Yuan Fortress
content:
Hsin later recreated an idealistic, preserved version of the Fortress inside of the Manifold Sanctum of Xuanfang Hold, within the Xuanyuan Domain. It was encountered by Rover and Qingxiao upon their arrival after being forcibly transported into the Domain while in pursuit of Muyu, who had taken over the Domain as a base of operations for his Reverberation experiments. The duo met Ruoyun there, who had been piloting an owl Autopuppet under the alias of Jadie to mask her identity.
