title: Yuanwu
Yuanwu/Backstory
content:
Yuanwu is a martial artist known for his mastery of Leihuangquan, a swift and powerful style named after lightning and thunder. His lightning-fast fists strike with streaks of blue energy, leaving his opponents reeling from the full force of their destructive power.

As a teenager, Yuanwu sought absolute power and relied on raw force to defeat his enemies. This obsession led to his downfall, as he fell into a trap laid by his rival and was exiled from his home.

title: Yuanwu/Backstory
content:
During his years of wandering, Yuanwu reflected on his past mistakes and honed his martial arts skills. With his expanding knowledge and improved techniques, he gradually grasped the essence of Leihuangquan — the art of balance between strength and adaptability. A martial artist's path of vengeance is destined to begin and end on the fighting ground. As fate would have it, his sworn enemy crossed paths with him once again in the arena, where their conflict would come to its ultimate climax.

As lightning flashed, Yuanwu's fist broke through his opponent's gauntlet, revealing the illegal add-on hidden within. This moment marked Yuanwu's mastery of Leihuangquan, and exposed the years of lies and slander that had been concealed for ages.

The tale of Yuanwu's vengeance drew to a close, but his story as a boxing gym owner was only beginning.

"Welcome to Yuanwu’s Boxing Gym."

title: Yuanwu/Backstory
content:
The tale of Yuanwu's vengeance drew to a close, but his story as a boxing gym owner was only beginning.

"Welcome to Yuanwu’s Boxing Gym."



Yuanwu, now an amiable middle-aged proprietor, can always be found at the entrance of his boxing gym, greeting visitors with a warm smile daily.

title: Yuanwu/Backstory
content:
Gone are the days when the young Yuanwu fought his way with brute force. He has matured into a composed and confident middle-aged gentleman.

Yuanwu dons a dark-colored coat paired with a white top hat that perfectly aligns with his composed, modest, and courteous demeanor. The tailored waistcoat underneath highlights his robust physique, reflecting his years of martial arts training. The addition of navy blue in his attire further elevates the impression of thunder and lightning.

Though known to those around him as a kind gentleman, Yuanwu sheds his usual composed demeanor when faced with combat. He swiftly unleashes precise and fierce strikes, overwhelming his opponents. Yuanwu does not like to engage in physical altercations, but once forced into it, he throws himself fully into the fight, aiming for a quick and resounding victory.

File:Yuanwu Design.png

title: Yuanwu/Backstory
content:
In Yuanwu's boxing gym, every visitor can receive dedicated coaching from the owner himself.

Whether the person wants to exercise, pursue a career in boxing, or simply soak up the energizing ambiance of the gym, Yuanwu is always ready to suggest tailored training plans based on their unique physical abilities and health needs.

At the end of every training session, Yuanwu always graciously serves his clients with a cup of Trine Tea.  He takes great care in preparing each cup himself. The steaming hot tea effectively soothes the sore muscles and fatigue from the intense workout. Yuanwu's boxing gym is a unique place where clients can engage in a spirited boxing match and then relax with a pot of tea, basking in comfort and contentment.

title: Yuanwu/Backstory
content:
Yuanwu is a regular consumer of Bittberry Tea from the renowned Liuxian Teahouse. This secret blend is known for its intense bitterness and exorbitant price, making it a luxury only a select few can afford. Rumor has it that Yuanwu is the only one who can down a cup without flinching.

Yuanwu always carries a flask with him during his daily activities. Some say it contains his secret potion for staying fit, but in reality, it's usually just ordinary hot water.

File:Yuanwu jug.png

title: Yuanwu/Backstory
content: When in combat, Yuanwu maintains his elegant composure. His mastery of lightning manipulation amplifies his team's capabilities and shines through in his impressive combat skills. When the situation turns dire, Yuanwu can take charge as the team's primary damage dealer, unleashing powerful fists of twisting thunder to crush any enemy in their path.

content: Yuanzhi can be found on the staircase to the right of the Synthesizer.

title: Yuanzhi
content:
Yuanzhi: Excuse me, but did you just get back from the mountain? Did you see Xunwei and Lili?
Yuanzhi: They are both researchers from Huaxu Academy, wearing uniforms, and are about my age.
[Dialogue Option]  Yes.
Yuanzhi: I see, so they did go into the mountain for research.
[Dialogue Option]  Nope.
Yuanzhi: It's ok. I'm guessing they're still in the mountain doing their research.
[Dialogue Option]  Maybe, but I can't recall for sure.
Yuanzhi: It's ok. I'm guessing they're still in the mountain doing their research.
Yuanzhi: I'd really like to see Xunwai and Lili's work routine. I think I can learn a lot even just by watching them work.
[Dialogue Option]  But you're from Hongzhen, so how did you know them?
Yuanzhi: There was a blizzard a few days ago. They and Wei took shelter in my house. We chatted and got to know each other.
Yuanzhi: From then on, they come to see me whenever they're free and share all kinds of interesting things.
Yuanzhi: Like why Scarefrost Deer have heart-shaped fur and how Airsailers feed themselves.
Yuanzhi: I never thought I could see the world through such a perspective. Things I thought couldn't be any more ordinary turned out to be so interesting and... valuable.
Yuanzhi: Maybe I'm daydreaming here, but I thought perhaps I could become a Huaxu researcher, too, like Xunwei, and Wei
Yuanzhi: At least I'm working toward that goal.
[Dialogue Option]  Being a researcher takes a lot of effort.
Yuanzhi: Lili told me that, too, but I'm determined.
Yuanzhi: I think there are very few things in this world that are easy... If they all take an effort anyway, might as well do what you like.
[Dialogue Option]  That's a nice aspiration, but how do you plan to achieve it?
[Dialogue Option]  Nice aspiration. Good luck.
Yuanzhi: I plan to head to Jinzhou to study.
Yuanzhi: I must take my first step. More doing, less talking. That's what I learned from Xunwei.
Yuanzhi: But before I do that, I want to say goodbye to Yi'an.
Yuanzhi: Yi'an is my best friend. We grew up together. I don't want him to be troubled by my decision.

title: Zakarias
content: ' is a former Roya Outcast found at a former Outcast's camp in Etching Plains Resonance Beacon. He granted forgiveness by the Solsworn, but opted to remain at the camp to help reform other Outcasts.

title: Zakarias
content:
Peder: Professor Zakarias, you were once accepted by the Solsworn, and they even invited you to return to Bjartr Woods.
Peder: Why come back?
Zakarias: I believe the question you really meant to ask is why I came back, Peder? Or... how was I accepted by the Solsworn in the first place?
Peder: I-I admit, what I really wanted to know is what I should do to justify my return to Bjartr Woods.
Peder: This is no means my act of weakness, nor do I expect my past mistakes to just be wiped away. It's just that... this path of atonement, with seemingly no end in sight, scares me.
Zakarias: Hmm... Once, there was a Roya who committed a crime so unspeakable that if I tried to put it into words alone, it would probably chill you to the bone.
Zakarias: The Solsworn, in a rare act of punishment, cast judgment upon him, drove him out of Bjartr Woods, and left the sinner to roam the wilderness.
Zakarias: Though he should have been utterly alone, he suddenly found himself bathing in the warmth of the Reactor's glow, the river soothing his parched throat, and the fruit filling his empty belly.
Zakarias: Realizing that even bearing such sin, he was still sheltered by Lahai-Roi and the Exostriders, he broke down in tears.
Zakarias: From then on, he walked the lands of Lahai-Roi. For every ounce of malice in his past, he would repay it with an equal share of kindness. Whether to every blade of grass and every tree, to outsiders, to the Roya, or even to the Exoswarm.
Zakarias: At last, one day, when his hair had turned completely white and he was leading a lost mech reindeer back to Bjartr Woods, a Soliskin appeared and took his hand.
Peder: A Soliskin... I've only ever seen them when I was a child. Only those with a pure heart can see them...
Peder: I understand now, Professor Zakarias. I know what I need to do. But I still wish to know... Why have you not returned to Bjartr Woods?
Zakarias: Heh, because there are still plenty of lost people like you out there.

title: Zani
Zani
content: A Zani (more commonly spelled Zanni) was a character performed during Italian comedy, typically appearing as an immigrant working as a servant. Typically, a Zani was a shrewd, successful trickster.

title: Zani/Backstory
content: Zani has a fascinating duality of character: a fastidiously well-ordered and extremely competent professional during the day, and a powerful, nearly elemental, force for justice at night. Her public image is one of steadfast devotion to routine and order, a quality she nurtures through her decades-long association with the Montelli family's Averardo Bank. She is a disciplined professional in the way she goes about her job, and her penchant for an ordered existence extends even to her personal habits and tastes, including her desire for comfort foods at the end of a long day. Despite her obvious professionalism, she often expresses a dry, matter-of-fact weariness with her work, viewing it as a part of her existence that is inevitable, if not always welcome, and looking at inefficiency or busywork with a practical disdain. Her secret history as the "Blazing Nightwalker" tells of a deep-seated sense of justice beyond the law.

title: Zani/Backstory
content: Zani dismantled a reigning criminal syndicate one-handed in this covert identity, becoming a vigilante when the established channels were useless. Her motives are not narcissistic or fueled by the desire to be famous; indeed, she finds her heroic moniker "ridiculous" and actively avoids the limelight, understanding that fame gets in the way of her job. This is a pragmatic choice, as it allows her to pursue justice without targeting herself. But this past has had a lasting effect.

title: Zani/Backstory
content: Zani carries a subtle exhaustion that she tends to express as insomnia, a testament to the heavy toll of what she has endured. She is not very forthcoming about much, but she is quite candid about the fact that this vigorous vigilante work "changed her", causing a "lost spark" and a crushing exhaustion. Despite this personal cost, her internal drive to protect the innocent and bring order is steadfast. Her mental strength is amazing, channeling her stress into positive, albeit unconventional, outlets. Joining the Montelli family was a tactical decision, offering structure and resources to help her continue her mission of bringing order and tidying up the residual chaos of her own activities. Zani is defined by her powers of observation, analytical nature, and quick wit in her interactions.

title: Zani/Backstory
content: Her dry sarcasm and understated humor are favorite devices that she uses both as a defense and to communicate her special point of view. Zani is fiercely loyal to those she trusts and to the Montellis, always putting their interests first. This loyalty is balanced, however, by a strong moral compass; she doesn't shy away from navigating dangerous political waters or taking on corruption when it gets in the way of justice. Her ability to read situations quickly, connect seemingly unrelated clues, and act swiftly wins her a worthwhile ally. Not overtly emotional, Zani possesses a strong, if unassuming, sense of compassion.

title: Zani/Backstory
content: She keeps a small, cherished doll, a gift from one of the children she rescued, as a quiet, personal reminder of the worth of her work and the true motivation for her to carry on her fight. Zani has a protective instinct for others, particularly those near and dear to her, and is constantly advising them to rest and not fall into the trap of doing too much, drawing on her own experience. She values integrity and open-mindedness in others, even in members of the opposing factions, and is not averse to forming alliances when there are common goals to be pursued. Zani's journey is one of grappling with the tension between her natural preference for order and her strong, almost primal, need for immediate action.

title: Zani/Backstory
content: Zani dreams of a peaceful, secure Ragunna where every individual can find his or her niche, a dream inextricably tied to her sense of belonging to her hometown. The introduction of new issues, and particularly her meetings with the Rover, seem to bring a new sense of direction and a "burst of color" into her otherwise highly regulated life. She recognizes the Rover's unique capacity for positive change, even going so far as to admit that their presence might render her own vigilante function "increasingly irrelevant" - a development she welcomes, as it brings her one step closer to the quiet, peaceful life she secretly desires. Her fondest wish, after all, is for a world peaceful enough that she can finally "sleep through the night", undisturbed by the constant fight for justice. She is a testament to unlimited potential, understated resilience, and an unwavering, if often concealed, dedication to a greater, more orderly world.

title: Zani/Backstory
content: Zani is a tall woman with pale skin, white hair, and dark red eyes with slitted pupils. She has a distinct beauty mark under her right eye, as well as dark eyebags. Due to her awakening, she now has black, ram-like horns and a slim tail with a pointed tip.

title: Zani/Backstory
content: Zani wears a high collared white button-up shirt with cuffed sleeves that reach past her elbows and has golden buttons. She wears a bright red tie atop her shirt, along with a black leather harness that goes above her chest and hooks over her right shoulder, clasped with a circular golden buckle. Beneath her shirt collar is a frilled collar as well as a black choker that matches her harness, the pouch on her right bicep contains a radio, and she wears a black arm band around her left bicep bearing the Montelli family sigil. She wears a black jacket with a white fabric underlayer and frilled sleeves, attached to her shoulders by a harness. The lower half of her outfit consists of tight black high-waist pants with golden zippers on each leg ending mid-way down her thighs.

title: Zani/Backstory
content:
Among her other accessories are a golden pair of key-shaped earrings with green gems, as well as black half-palm leather gloves. She wears red socks and a pair of strapless black high heels with red soles.

When using her Forte, Zani's outfit changes, mostly the upper half. Her shirt becomes ripped, with the sleeves ending before her shoulders and a low-cut V-shaped collar that dips halfway down her chest. The back of her shirt is completely torn, with the cut going all the way down and showing her Tacet Mark located on her back. She loosely wraps her tie around her right arm and wears two thin black bands on both her biceps. Her black choker stays but is adorned with golden horizontal stripes that match her horns and the golden scars on her body. The lower half of her outfit stays the same as it does in her regular form. The vents on her horns also glow a bright yellow.

metadata.section: Annals of Huanglong Ubiquitous — Zhaoming Commerce Guild

title: Zhaoming Commerce Guild
section: Annals of Huanglong Ubiquitous — Zhaoming Commerce Guild
content:
As trade routes opened up in every direction, flavors from across Huanglong's one capital and six cities gradually converged



To improve people's livelihoods and boost their local economies, cities throughout Huanglong have partnered with Lollo Logistics to build transport networks while working with local commerce guilds to open new trade routes.
Among these guilds, one of the most renowned is the Zhaoming Commerce Guild of Mengzhou.
Its Chairwoman, Suisui, is celebrated for her discerning eye. Wherever she travels, whatever she acquires tends to spark a trend.
Even in Jinzhou, the youngest of the six cities, the bustling Panhua's Restaurant and the well-stocked Mahe's Grocery both have ties to the Zhaoming Commerce Guild.

metadata.section: Annals of Huanglong Ubiquitous — Zhaoming Commerce Guild

title: Zhaoming Commerce Guild
section: Annals of Huanglong Ubiquitous — Zhaoming Commerce Guild
content: Word has it that when Panhua's Restaurant first rolled out its Spicy Pulled Chicken, the dish was such a hit it caused a local chili shortage in Jinzhou. When Suisui heard about it through her regular letters with her younger sister, she sent guild staff to Jinzhou to look into the matter. happened, Jinzhou City Hall was also seeking to expand its commercial partnerships. As it With the Zhaoming Commerce Guild's help, chili peppers from as far away as Chongzhou soon found their way to Jinzhou, becoming a fixture on local dinner tables. This initiative also solved a headache for Chongzhou's farmers, who'd had a bumper chili harvest and nowhere to sell it.

metadata.section: Annals of Huanglong Ubiquitous — Zhaoming Commerce Guild

title: Zhaoming Commerce Guild
section: Annals of Huanglong Ubiquitous — Zhaoming Commerce Guild
content:
Beyond fresh produce, the Zhaoming Commerce Guild also excels at sourcing regional specialty goods and getting them exactly where they're needed. Blue-and-white porcelain, fine bolts of silk, intricately crafted mechanical dolls, bamboo-woven baskets... As the Guild's Chairwoman, Sulsul's eye for quality is sharp enough that whatever catches it tends to become the hottest item in town.

With the guild's support and Lollo Logistics' delivery network, goods from every comer of Huanglong flow more freely now, like a gentle stream reaching farther and farther, soft rain quietly rescuing farmers and artisans who'd been struggling to find buyers, easing worries that were all too real. And so people across every city can now find goods from a thousand miles away right on their own doorstep, and taste specialty dishes from lands far from home.

title: Zhenjian
content:
Zhenjian The corrupted data at the Anchor has been cleared, and the backlog of anomaly data is finally running smoothly again.
[Dialogue Option]  Anomaly data?
Zhenjian Yes, it's a collection of data on Reverberations, Tacet Discords, and other anomalies caused by the Lament.
[Dialogue Option]  What can we do with it?
Zhenjian For example, with Tethys' computing power, we can build evolutionary models of the Tacet Discords to predict how they might develop in the future.
Zhenjian We can also input Reverberations gathered from the Lament zone into Tethys to recreate those areas in the Sand Table.
Zhenjian But from what we've observed so far, the Sand Table has its limits.
Zhenjian The more ancient the Lament, the more diluted the Reverberations are, which makes it harder to replicate the affected areas accurately.
Zhenjian Still, I believe this is just the beginning of what Tethys can do. There's much more potential to tap.

content: Zhichun is an NPC in . A child from Hongzhen who can be found with her mother, Xiangyi.

title: Zhichun
content:
;(Second interaction)
Zhichun: ...
[Dialogue Option]  Hello.
[Dialogue Option]  What are you looking at?
Zhichun: Oh, it's you. I remember you!
Zhichun: It was you and the Magistrate who saved us all!
Several researchers from Jinzhou happen to pass by. Zhichun clings to you, nervous and curious.
Zhichun: ...
[Dialogue Option]  What's wrong?
Zhichun: That's because... because a lot of grown-ups have come here lately.
Zhichun: Maybe not that many, but I've never seen so many strangers in my life.
Zhichun: I-I'm just a little scared. But they seem quite interesting.

[Dialogue Option]  I can introduce you to them.

[Dialogue Option]  (Introduce the person in a white gown.)
Zhichun: Hua... Huashi Academy... That's such a difficult name to pronounce.
Zhichun: But I now know everyone in a white gown is very impressive, very smart!

Zhichun: Logistics person of Lollo Logistics... Hehe, that sounds like one of Grandma's tongue-twisters.
Zhichun: I know the people wearing bamboo hats deliver stuff to people now.
[Dialogue Option]  (Introduce the person in a blue uniform.)
Zhichun: Midnight Rangers... I like that! Easy to remember and has a nice ring to it!
Zhichun: So the people in neat blue uniforms are here to protect us!
[Dialogue Option]  That's everybody.

title: Zhihuai
content:
[Objective: Interact with the cat]
Cat: Meow, meow... meow.
The cat elegantly licks its paw and shows you its soft, furry belly.
[Dialogue Option]  Pet its belly.
The cat is startled at first, but succumbs to your superior cat-petting technique and quickly starts purring again.
Zhihuai: Wow, most people who go straight for the belly usually get the teeth. No wonder you're famous around the Academy. You're quite the cat-petting pro.
[Dialogue Option]  Pet its head.
The cat accepts your petting, its warm head nuzzling and rubbing against your palm.
Zhihuai: Isn't Malma a sweetie?
[Dialogue Option]  Play with it with the toy over there.
The cat is delighted and immediately starts playing with you.
Zhihuai: It's Malma's favorite toy. I always bring it along with her wherever I go.
Zhihuai: Malma is very smart and has a good temper. I was worried that traveling across the ocean with me might stress her out at first, but turns out she's not scared at all.
Lumy: I've been following the club's socials! They sometimes post Malma's daily routine, and just a single glance is enough to heal me from a long day of work.
Lumy: I heard the club is planning to have Malma do a meet & greet with fans during the Celebration, so I got here as fast as I could!
Stig: I wasn't a big cat-person before… and I wasn't very good at taking care of one either.
Stig: Fortunately, Malma takes good care of herself. Aside from the usual hide-and-seek, she's trouble-free. Before meeting her, I thought all cats were home destroyers…
Zhihuai: Playfulness is part of a cat's nature. There's no need to worry, Stig.
Zhihuai: We plan to have her come out and meet everyone more often, even after the Celebration. Oh, it's a call from our leader. Mind looking after Malma for a little while, Stig?
Zhihuai:M-Me? Okay.
Zhihuai: Aw, here I was hoping to chat with you, Rover. Guess I'll see you next time.
[Dialogue Option]  See you.
With that, Zhihuai hurries away.

content: Zhiyu is a Midnight Ranger with the ability to sense incoming rainfall. Though he once believed his Forte was useless, serving on an exploratory team has given him increased confidence.

title: Zhiyu
content:
Zhiyu: Did you know water can speak?

Zhiyu: It's more like... the raindrops in the clouds are talking to me, telling me when they're coming and how long they'll stay.

[Dialogue Option]  Retroact Rain?

Zhiyu: Remnant Energy replays old events. When the rain flows up, you get these mirages of the past showing up in it.
Zhiyu: If you can't tell what's real and what's not, those mirages can mess with your head. I guess everyone's got someone they can't let go of...
Zhiyu: So if you run into Retroact Rain, stay sharp. Don't let your emotions get the better of you.
Zhiyu: I can't hear the Retroact Rain, only the ordinary kind... Do you think my Resonance Ability is weak?

Zhiyu: I used to feel insecure about it, but since I started working on the Exploration Canal, my skills have been super helpful.

title: Zhuojun Atelier
content: Zhuojun Atelier  is a politically influential enclave of mechanist artisans based out of Mengzhou. They are a notoriously clandestine organization of engineers, craftspeople, tinkerers, and inventors of automata mechanics with dubious morals. Led by the enigmatic Flowerveil Puppet, who holds the rank of Grand Helm, it has several different branches, each overseen by Helmsmasters.

title: Zhuojun Atelier
content: Consistently described by several such as Balanophora and Suisui as being shifty and calculating, they are infamous for their questionable morals and unknown goals in their technocratic pursuit of automata arts, such as the construction of Bladepuppets, and a multitude of various synthetic puppet models that are found throughout Mengzhou. The Atelier has given rise to infamous Huanglong criminals such as Muyu and the Séance Society's Dollmaker.

title: Zhuojun Atelier
content:
The historical origins of Zhuojun Atelier are unknown. It is known that they have existed as far back as 200 years ago, and been an influential player in the Mengzhou political sphere during the early days of the Fortress and Gorges War. Zhuojun Atelier was one of two factions of mechanists based in Mengzhou, with the other being the Mengzhou branch of the Court of Savantae.

Two centuries ago, Muyu led the Jianshui Branch in overseeing the construction of Yuan Fortress, with the Fortress designed to be a stronghold for the region prior to its eventual destruction and replacement.

title: Zhuojun Atelier
content:
In response to the threat of Ovathrax, Hsin, the Moon Fox summoned the two factions to Mengzhou City Hall in order to deliberate between which faction would be best suited to construct Xuanfang Hold. The Zhuojun Atelier delegation confidently asserted that they were the better fit for the task, due to their knowledge of the local terrain, peoples, and greater experience with larger-scale feats of engineering in comparison to the Court of Savantae.

However, Hsin, having preemptively decided the Court to be the better fit due to their willingness to sacrifice themselves in pursuit of knowledge. In a move that shocked the Atelier's delegation, she publicly chose the Court despite the Atelier's local expertise to oversee the project, causing the Atelier's delegation to leave in bitter spite from being cut out of the construction.

title: Zhuojun Atelier
content:
Muyu, then-Helmsmaster of the Atelier's Jiangshui Branch, later participated in the Fortress and Gorges war and contributed his Artisan skills to the war effort. Reeling from Yuan Fortress' catastrophic self-destruction as a sacrifice by the Court of Savantae and the Xuanfang Wardens to regain a regional advantage against the Tacet Discord threat, he was overwhelmed by the countless horrors of war and strife he witnessed and snapped, experiencing a Resonator awakening in the midst of his insanity.

During an incident orchestrated by Muyu 10-15 years ago, he hijacked a troupe of Bladepuppets, reprogramming them to go on a killing spree that took the lives of several in Mengzhou, including Jingran's parents, who were employed as Artisans by the Atelier.

title: Zhuojun Atelier
content: Over 20 years ago, Muyu was chosen as the Flowerveil Puppet's successor to inherit the position of Grand Helm. However, as Muyu grew increasingly inclined towards misanthrophy and hyper-rationalism, he eventually left Zhuojun Atelier, and begin plotting a centuries-long plot against Sentinel Hsin, leading to him working with Balanophora to enact the Autopuppet Crisis against Xuanfang Hold and its Sanctum, before being defeated by Rover, Qingxiao, and Jingran- who had sought revenge for Muyu's killing of his parents years ago and feigned aiding him to get close- in his attempt to become a self-proclaimed Celestial in the form of the Calamity Effigy and pilfer the Mengzhou Civilization Capsule for the Sentinel's knowledge.

title: Zhuojun Atelier
content: In the aftermath of his defeat and death, Muyu's accomplices in the Atelier who aided in his insurrection began being exposed. This included a group intercepted outside of Xuanfang by Suoming and Yinlin, who were rounded up and reported to the Grand Helm by the duo.

title: Zhuyi
content:
He recently joined the Pioneer Association, and serves as an intern photographer. He idolizes the Icebreakers and wishes to become one.

==Dialogue==



Zhuyi: Do you know the adventure stories of the Icebreakers? They are legends in the history of the Pioneer Association, my idols!
Zhuyi: On the polar regions, up the volcanoes, deep in the great rifts, and across the wetlands... their footprints are spread across every corner of the world. This is what adventurers should be like.
Zhuyi: As written on the front page of "Tidal Geography": Go see the world and witness history in the making.
Zhuyi: Go see the masterpieces of humanity, paintings, architecture, and inventions, and find joy in the journey.
Zhuyi: The seniors always tell me to wait a little longer. I guess it's because I don't have the resonance ability that they never took me on the expeditions.
Zhuyi: But there are members of the Icebreakers that discovered their Resonance in times of crisis. Perhaps it's the same for me.
Zhuyi: You'll never know if you never try.

Ziegler: Tar, I've been thinking... maybe I should just join a gang.
Tar: ...What are you on about now?
Ziegler: I'm serious. I'm just a guy with no talent... it seems impossible for me to get ahead in life.
Ziegler: Have you seen that play, Like a Hippocamp? I want to be like the Mafia in it.
Ziegler: I'll fight with my fists and live by loyalty and passion, carving out my own place in the world!
Ziegler: So, what do you say, Tar? Want to join me on this journey?
Tar: I think...
Ziegler: It's great?
Tar: No, I think you should get a job. If anything, you could go herd sheep in town. I know people.
Ziegler: You think I'm joking, don't you?
Tar: Ziegler, buddy, the gangs are a thing of the past...
Tar: Have you seen anyone in Ragunna City acting like those characters in the play, brawling and openly breaking the law?
Ziegler: Not really.
Tar: If there were, they'd have been locked up in the Order Tribunal or recruited by the families.
Ziegler: But still, I believe gangs like that exist in real life!
Tar: You're a lost cause. Who actually takes stories from a play seriously?!

title: Zip Zap
content: .  Zip Zap is a type of ironclad electromagnetic Murmurin TD that attracts metal to form a protective shell around itself. Electric arcs are faintly visible through cracks in its metallic armor.  They may attach themselves to other Clamorling Tacet Discords to provide power amplification. When spent, Zip Zaps reverse the flow of their electricity to recharge themselves.  People in Lahai-Roi often catch Zip Zaps in the wild as an emergency power source.|Description when discovered}}
